kept.name: Kindred Dominance
kept.why: Destroys every creature on the battlefield that is not the chosen type, so it affects the whole board. Not scope:wipe: the type restriction is exactly what makes it one-sided, and marking it a wipe would make the anti-synergy check refuse it in the tribal decks that want it.

kept.name: Snuff Out
kept.why: "You may pay 4 life rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is a life cost to cast and nothing recorded it. Deliberately not adding cares:color:b: destroying a nonblack creature is a restriction on the target, not a card that cares about black.

kept.name: Whip of Erebos
kept.why: "It gains haste" on the reanimated creature was unread. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile for the delayed "exile it at the beginning of the next end step": that exile is a drawback on your own reanimated creature, and eff:exile confers the removal role, which would file a lifegain reanimation enchantment as an answer.

kept.name: Riveteers Overlook
kept.why: Only the enters trigger was read. The card searches the library for a basic land and gains 1 life, and none of that was written down, so it could not be seen as ramp or as lifegain.

kept.name: Howling Mine
kept.why: The list recorded only the draw-step trigger and not the draw itself. "Each player draws an additional card" is the whole card: it draws, and it draws for everybody, which is the group-hug word eff:draw-each.

kept.name: Archaeomancer's Map
kept.why: The second ability puts a land card from your HAND onto the battlefield, which is eff:put-onto-battlefield precisely; eff:extra-land-drop alone understates it. It also searches for basic Plains, which is the library-land word. eff:extra-land-drop kept, since the practical effect is extra lands.

kept.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
kept.why: Her static ability doubles every token created under your control and nothing recorded it, which is the single most important line on the card. The 0 ability also gives your creatures flying until your next turn.

kept.name: Lion's Eye Diamond
kept.why: Discarding your hand is the ACTIVATION COST, not merely an effect. cost:discard-self is not used, since by the cost:sacrifice-self precedent the -self suffix on a cost means the card discards itself, and this discards your hand.

kept.name: Hammer of Nazahn
kept.why: The trigger reads "Whenever Hammer of Nazahn OR another Equipment you control enters", so it fires on itself as well as on others. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Enduring Innocence
kept.why: Two of its three lines were entirely unread. It draws a card when small creatures you control enter, and when it dies it returns itself to the battlefield as an enchantment, which is eff:recur-self. eff:gain-life follows from printed lifelink, matching how Danitha Capashen is recorded.

kept.name: Flare of Fortitude
kept.why: Sacrificing a white creature is an ALTERNATIVE COST TO CAST, so cost:cast-sacrifice is the right word; cost:sacrifice means an on-demand sacrifice outlet and would file an instant-speed protection spell as aristocrats fodder. eff:set-life is wrong: "your life total can't change" locks the total, it does not set it to a value, and eff:prevent-damage plus eff:protect already carry the real effect.

kept.name: Isochron Scepter
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unread: it taps, it copies the imprinted card and it casts the copy without paying its mana cost. Imprinting exiles a card from your hand and the ability plays off the exile zone.

kept.name: Champion's Helm
kept.why: "As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has hexproof" was not recorded at all, and hexproof-granting is the entire reason this Equipment is played.

kept.name: Bloodchief Ascension
kept.why: The payoff triggers on a card being put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, which is genuine graveyard-caring and the reason it pairs with mill.

kept.name: Chimil, the Inner Sun
kept.why: Both lines were unread beyond the keyword. "Spells you control can't be countered" is eff:uncounterable, and discover 5 exiles cards off the top of your library and casts one free, which is exactly eff:impulse plus eff:cast-free.

kept.name: Kaya's Ghostform
kept.why: The triggers were recorded and the effect was not: it returns the card to the battlefield, from the graveyard or from exile, which is the whole card.

kept.name: Ranger-Captain of Eos
kept.why: "Sacrifice this creature" is the activation cost of the second ability, which is why it is played as a free sacrifice body alongside the tutor.

kept.name: Inkshield
kept.why: Making a 2/1 flier for every point of combat damage prevented is the payoff half of the card and no token effect was recorded at all.

kept.name: Liliana, Dreadhorde General
kept.why: Both minus abilities make players sacrifice permanents and no sacrifice effect was recorded, so her two removal modes were invisible. The minus abilities also cost loyalty counters, as recorded on Elspeth, Sun's Champion.

kept.name: Vanquish the Horde
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature on the battlefield" is the line that makes the card playable and it was unread.

kept.name: Fleshbag Marauder
kept.why: Only the enters trigger was recorded. The effect itself, each player sacrificing a creature, was missing entirely, which is the whole reason the card is played as an edict body.

kept.name: Enduring Tenacity
kept.why: The dies trigger was recorded without its effect: it returns itself to the battlefield as an enchantment. It is also a lifegain payoff, draining an opponent whenever you gain life.

kept.name: Elspeth, Sun's Champion
kept.why: The ultimate's emblem gives your creatures +2/+2 and flying, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Tocasia's Welcome
kept.why: The trigger is on OTHER creatures you control entering, never on this enchantment itself, and only the bare trig:enters was recorded.

kept.name: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
kept.why: The proliferate ability costs a card discard and only the mana and life costs were recorded.

kept.name: Darksteel Mutation
kept.why: "base power and toughness 0/1" is a set-pt effect and nothing recorded it; that is the half of the card that makes a commander harmless, alongside the ability-stripping already caught by eff:neutralise.

kept.name: Saw in Half
kept.why: Only the destroy clause was read. The second sentence creates two tokens that are copies of the destroyed creature, so both eff:create-token and eff:copy are stated outright.

kept.name: Strionic Resonator
kept.why: The activation cost is "{2}, {T}" and cost:tap was missing. It copies a triggered ability you control, which is exactly eff:multiply-triggers rather than the generic eff:copy - it makes your own triggers happen twice and cannot copy a spell or a permanent.

kept.name: Access Tunnel
kept.why: The second ability reads "target creature with power 3 or less", a power condition, which is the same reading Altar of Dementia already carries.

kept.name: Selfless Spirit
kept.why: Sacrificing to give your whole board indestructible is the definition of keeping your creatures alive; only the keyword grant was recorded, not that the card is a protection spell.

kept.name: Mangara, the Diplomat
kept.why: "Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures" is an attack trigger and only the cast trigger was recorded. Trouble in Pairs carries trig:attacks for the identical wording.

kept.name: Carrion Feeder
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed drawback and was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Torment of Hailfire
kept.why: Only the life loss was read. The card makes each opponent sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card X times, and those two clauses are the reason it wins games.

kept.name: Trouble in Pairs
kept.why: The trigger fires on an OPPONENT casting their second spell and on an opponent drawing their second card each turn; the bare trig:cast was recorded but neither the direction nor the draw event.

kept.name: Banner of Kinship
kept.why: It enters with a fellowship counter on ITSELF for each creature of the chosen type; the generic eff:add-counters was recorded but not that the counters land on this permanent, which is what the pump then counts.

kept.name: Caretaker's Talent
kept.why: Almost nothing this card does was recorded. Level 1 draws a card whenever tokens you control enter (a draw plus an enters-other trigger), level 2 creates a token that is a copy of a token you control, and level 3 pumps all your creature tokens - the same shape Intangible Virtue carries as eff:pump plus scope:all.

kept.name: Plaguecrafter
kept.why: "Each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker" is the primary effect and only the fallback discard was recorded, so an edict was reading as a discard spell.

kept.name: Boggart Trawler // Boggart Bog
kept.why: The front face's whole effect - exile target player's graveyard - was missing, so a piece of graveyard hate carried no verb at all, and the back face's "{T}: Add {B}" was unread too. eff:exile-graveyard rather than eff:exile, since it is targeted graveyard hate.

kept.name: Mentor of the Meek
kept.why: The trigger is on ANOTHER creature you control entering, it is gated on power 2 or less, and the draw only happens if you pay {1} - none of those three were recorded.

kept.name: Trailblazer's Boots
kept.why: Nonbasic landwalk is evasion: the reminder text says the equipped creature can't be blocked while the defender controls a nonbasic land. Only the attach was recorded, so the boots read as a blank Equipment.

kept.name: Windbrisk Heights
kept.why: Hideaway was left entirely unread - only the mana ability was recorded. When it enters you look at the top four of your library and exile one, and the second ability plays that exiled card without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Imp's Mischief
kept.why: The life loss happens on resolution, equal to the redirected spell's mana value; it is not an additional cost to cast and nothing is paid to activate anything, so cost:life is the wrong word and the effect was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Changeling Outcast
kept.why: The card can't block as well as being unblockable; only the evasion half was recorded.

kept.name: Gravecrawler
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is printed and unrecorded; the recursion half was already read.

kept.name: Deadly Rollick
kept.why: "If you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost" is the whole reason this card is played and nothing recorded it. The free-cast cycle is exactly what eff:cast-free names.

kept.name: Teferi's Protection
kept.why: The card's entire function - saving your whole board from a wipe - was unrecorded; only eff:exile-self (its own cleanup line) was there. eff:protect is the honest existing word for it. The phasing itself still has no word, hence the proposal.

kept.name: Cavern of Souls
kept.why: "that spell can't be countered" is half of why this land is played and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Urza's Saga
kept.why: Only chapter III was read. Chapter I grants it "{T}: Add {C}" and chapter II grants "{2}, {T}: Create a Construct token", so the card genuinely produces mana, makes tokens, and taps to do both. It also searches your library, so cares:zone:library belongs alongside the eff:search-library already there.

kept.name: Black Market Connections
kept.why: The Buy Information mode draws a card and eff:draw was missing entirely. The card is also "choose one or more", which is eff:choose.

kept.name: War Room
kept.why: The whole second ability - "Pay life equal to the number of colors in your commanders' color identity: Draw a card" - was unread. This land is played as a draw engine, not as a mana source.

kept.name: Mana Vault
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {4}. If you do, untap this artifact" is an optional payment for a bigger effect, which is what eff:do-if-cost-paid names.

kept.name: Chrome Mox
kept.why: cost:tap was missing although the only mana ability is "{T}: Add one mana...". The imprint exiles a card from your hand, so cares:zone:hand applies. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: it exiles your OWN card as a cost of use, and the word would file a mana rock as removal.

kept.name: Herald's Horn
kept.why: "look at the top card of your library... you may reveal it and put it into your hand" is the card-advantage half of the card and nothing recorded it. eff:reduce-cost only covered the first ability.

kept.name: Ghostly Prison
kept.why: The tax applies to every creature that would attack you, not to one target. eff:unless-pays alone reads as a single-target tax. Not adding eff:cant-attack: it does not stop an attack, it prices it.

kept.name: Austere Command
kept.why: "Choose two —" is a modal spell and the choice is the card's whole identity; without it the record says it does all four things at once.

kept.name: Farewell
kept.why: "Choose one or more —" is eff:choose. It also exiles all creatures including your own, which is a symmetric board wipe: the same claim Austere Command already carries. A token or go-wide deck needs to know this card is a trap, and eff:exile alone does not say so.

kept.name: Gemstone Caverns
kept.why: The card is about your opening hand and exiles a card from your hand to come down. Nothing recorded any hand interaction. Not adding eff:exile: it exiles your own card as a cost, and the word would read as removal.

kept.name: Flawless Maneuver
kept.why: The free-cast clause was unrecorded, and granting your whole team indestructible is exactly "keeps your creatures alive". Without eff:protect the card looks like a generic pump spell.

kept.name: Command Beacon
kept.why: The land sacrifices itself and moves your commander from the command zone to your hand. Both clauses were unread, so the record described a plain colourless land.

kept.name: Akroma's Will
kept.why: The second mode was read only halfway: lifelink and protection from each color were both missing while flying, vigilance, double strike and indestructible were recorded. "Choose one... you may choose both" is eff:choose, and the indestructible-plus-protection mode is what eff:protect names. No eff:cast-free here: the commander clause upgrades the choice, it does not make the spell free.

kept.name: Fell the Profane // Fell Mire
kept.why: Only the instant face was read. The land face taps for {B} and offers to pay 3 life to enter untapped, so a card that is half a black source was recorded as producing no mana at all.

kept.name: Patchwork Banner
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is an anthem and was entirely unread; the record described a mana rock. Not adding scope:all, because the chosen type restricts it.

kept.name: Ash Barrens
kept.why: Basic landcycling discards this card as its cost, which nothing recorded. cares:zone:library belongs beside cares:zone:library-land, as it does on Wayfarer's Bauble and Prismatic Vista, since the ability searches your library.

kept.name: Animate Dead
kept.why: The reanimation is recorded but three later clauses are not: it attaches itself, it shrinks the creature (-1/-0 is not a pump), and it has a leaves-the-battlefield trigger that sacrifices the creature.

kept.name: Sensei's Divining Top
kept.why: Four facets and not one of them says what the card does. It draws a card, taps for that draw, is entirely about the top of your library, and puts itself from the battlefield back onto the library.

kept.name: Mirkwood Bats
kept.why: The drain hits every opponent, which the engine marks scope:all on Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance and Syr Konrad for the identical wording. The 'create a token' half of the trigger is unrecorded and has no word.

kept.name: Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire
kept.why: Only 'you lose 2 life' was read. The whole point of the spell is saving a creature by granting it a dies-trigger that returns it, and the entire land face is missing.

kept.name: Takenuma, Abandoned Mire
kept.why: Channel is paid by discarding the card itself and that cost is unrecorded.

kept.name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
kept.why: The drain hits each opponent, the same wording the engine marks scope:all on Zulaport Cutthroat and Bastion of Remembrance.

kept.name: Mox Diamond
kept.why: Discarding a land card is how this permanent gets onto the battlefield at all, and the cost is unrecorded.

kept.name: Foundry Inspector
kept.why: Its only line is a cost reduction and eff:reduce-cost is absent, so the card currently reads as doing nothing at all.

kept.name: Everflowing Chalice
kept.why: It enters with charge counters on itself and how much mana it makes depends on them. The -self form is the right one: the counters go on the Chalice, so this is not a counters-matters card.

kept.name: Orcish Bowmasters
kept.why: Both halves of its trigger condition are missing: it has an enters trigger, and it triggers on opponents drawing, which is the reason the card is played.

kept.name: Syr Konrad, the Grim
kept.why: Two of his three trigger conditions are creature cards changing zones rather than dying, and only the dies half is recorded.

kept.name: Academy Manufactor
kept.why: It is a replacement effect that turns one token into three. That multiplication is the card, and it is unrecorded.

kept.name: Bolas's Citadel
kept.why: Casting from the top of the library is paid for in life, which is unrecorded, and the play-from-the-top ability itself has no word at all.

kept.name: Exsanguinate
kept.why: It drains every opponent at once, the wording the engine marks scope:all elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Ruby Medallion
kept.why: It cares about red spells and carries no colour word, while the identical Jet Medallion in this same batch carries cares:color:b.

kept.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
kept.why: Half the payoff is missing: each opponent who declines also makes you draw a card, and eff:draw is absent.

kept.name: Witch Enchanter // Witch-Blessed Meadow
kept.why: The land face is entirely unread: it taps for white and it can be paid for with life to come in untapped.

kept.name: Scavenger Grounds
kept.why: Its only real ability, exiling all graveyards, is completely unrecorded, along with the sacrifice cost that pays for it.

kept.name: The Ozolith
kept.why: Nothing about counters is recorded on a card that exists only to move counters. It triggers on your creatures leaving, collects counters onto itself, then takes them off and puts them on a creature.

kept.name: Shadowspear
kept.why: Its second ability, which is why the card sees play as interaction, is unrecorded. It names hexproof and indestructible explicitly.

kept.name: Angel of the Ruins
kept.why: Plainscycling {2} is paid by discarding this card, which nothing in the list records.

kept.name: Witch's Clinic
kept.why: It grants lifelink until end of turn; it gives no +X/+X. grants:lifelink already says what it does and eff:pump is a false claim that it makes a creature bigger.

kept.name: Door of Destinies
kept.why: Only the type choice was recorded. It puts a charge counter on ITSELF whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type (a cast trigger you control), and it pumps every creature you control of that type.

kept.name: Mesmeric Orb
kept.why: The card's entire effect is milling and eff:mill was missing; only the kw:mill printed word was there, which the ranker cannot read as an effect.

kept.name: Thriving Heath
kept.why: The list held nothing but the type line. It is a tap-for-mana land that chooses a colour as it enters.

kept.name: Ugin, the Ineffable
kept.why: The +1 exiles the top card of your library and returns it to your hand when the Spirit leaves the battlefield; none of the exile, the return, the leaves trigger or the loyalty cost of the -3 was recorded.

kept.name: Not Dead After All
kept.why: It creates a Wicked Role token, and that Role gives the creature +1/+1. Neither the token creation nor the pump was recorded.

kept.name: Mishra's Bauble
kept.why: The activation costs {T} as well as the sacrifice, and the card draw is a delayed trigger at the next turn's upkeep.

kept.name: Ocelot Pride
kept.why: The second half creates a token that is a COPY of each token that entered this turn, which is a different effect from the plain 1/1 Cat already recorded.

kept.name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
kept.why: "Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards" is the reason this card is played and eff:draw was absent entirely.

kept.name: Skrelv, Defector Mite
kept.why: "Skrelv can't block" was unrecorded, and the activated ability grants hexproof from a colour, which is a protection effect that keeps your creature alive through targeted removal.

kept.name: Kozilek, Butcher of Truth
kept.why: The death trigger shuffles the graveyard into the library, which is a real graveyard interaction and a shuffle; annihilator 4 is an attack trigger.

kept.name: Well of Lost Dreams
kept.why: "You may pay {X} ... If you do, draw X cards" is exactly the optional-payment shape and it was not recorded.

kept.name: Restoration Magic
kept.why: Every mode grants hexproof as well as indestructible, the card's whole job is saving your permanents, and the Curaga mode covers all permanents you control.

kept.name: Spymaster's Vault
kept.why: Connive X is draw X then discard X. Only the counters half of connive was recorded.

kept.name: Grasp of Fate
kept.why: The exile lasts only until this enchantment leaves the battlefield, which is a leaves trigger on itself, and it exiles a permanent from EACH opponent rather than one target.

kept.name: Haven of the Spirit Dragon
kept.why: The recursion ability sacrifices this land as part of its cost, so the land is a one-shot; nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Nightscape Familiar
kept.why: It reduces blue and red spells specifically. Without the colour words the cost reduction reads as universal, which is how blank cost reducers end up in decks that cannot use them.

kept.name: Plumb the Forbidden
kept.why: Sacrificing one or more creatures is an additional cost to cast, which makes this a sacrifice-outlet spell rather than a plain draw spell.

kept.name: Silent Arbiter
kept.why: The second line restricts blocking and was not recorded at all, and both restrictions apply to every player.

kept.name: Steel Hellkite
kept.why: The {X} ability destroys EACH nonland permanent of that mana value controlled by a damaged player, which is a mass effect rather than the single-target destroy the list implies.

kept.name: Kambal, Profiteering Mayor
kept.why: He copies opponents' tokens, and both his triggers fire on OTHER permanents entering rather than on himself, which trig:enters alone does not distinguish.

kept.name: Luminous Broodmoth
kept.why: The returned creature comes back with a flying counter on it, and the return is from the graveyard.

kept.name: Damning Verdict
kept.why: It destroys ALL creatures with no counters, your own included, so it is a symmetric board wipe and must be readable as one by the anti-synergy check that keeps wipes out of go-wide decks.

kept.name: Bojuka Bog
kept.why: The entire reason this land is played is unrecorded. "When this land enters, exile target player's graveyard" is the format's cheapest piece of graveyard hate and the list carries only the trigger and the mana ability (rec:partial). eff:exile-graveyard is the exact word for it and is deliberately kept apart from eff:exile, and the card plainly cares about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Path of Ancestry
kept.why: "When that mana is spent to cast a creature spell that shares a creature type with your commander, scry 1" is precisely cares:mana-spent, and nothing in the list records that the scry is conditional on how the mana is used. The scry and the commander clause are already there; the linkage between them is not.

kept.name: Myriad Landscape
kept.why: The activated ability is "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library..." and cost:sacrifice-self is missing, although every other fetch-style land in the batch carries it. cares:zone:library is likewise missing while cares:zone:library-land is present - it searches the library, so both apply, exactly as on Evolving Wilds and Terramorphic Expanse.

kept.name: Fabled Passage
kept.why: "Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land" is the whole difference between this and Evolving Wilds and it is unread (rec:partial). scope:all is parser noise: the card searches for and moves ONE card, it affects nothing else on the board. Note the identical Myriad Landscape and Path to Exile carry no scope:all, which is what shows the word is inconsistent rather than meaningful here.

kept.name: The One Ring
kept.why: "When The One Ring enters, if you cast it, you gain protection from everything until your next turn" is unread (rec:partial) and it is half of why the card is played - it buys a full turn of immunity. grants:protection is the vocabulary's word for a card that hands out protection; nothing else in the list says the card protects anything. I have left eff:lose-life alone even though the loss is aimed at you, because no directed word exists yet (see the Reanimate proposal).

kept.name: Godless Shrine
kept.why: The mana ability sits in reminder text - "({T}: Add {W} or {B}.)" - so eff:add-mana was recorded without the tap cost that pays for it; every other land in this batch carries cost:tap alongside it. "you may pay 2 life" is a real life payment and is unrecorded, which is what makes this a shockland rather than a dual. I have not tried to express the enters-tapped choice itself, which is a player decision the vocabulary cannot state.

kept.name: Swords to Plowshares
kept.why: "Its controller gains life equal to its power" - the life goes to the creature's CONTROLLER, which in practice is the opponent you are aiming this at. It is the drawback, not an effect the caster gets. Under the convention that an unqualified word means the effect is yours, eff:gain-life here would offer the format's best removal spell to a lifegain deck as a lifegain enabler, which is the opposite of what it does. Same shape as the Path to Exile and Generous Gift entries in this batch.

kept.name: Path to Exile
kept.why: "Its controller may search their library for a basic land card" - the OPPONENT ramps, as compensation for having their creature exiled. These two words are the pair that marks a card as ramp, so as written this reads as a one-mana ramp spell that also removes a creature. It is a removal spell with a drawback. cares:type:land is left alone as a printed-text fact.

kept.name: Generous Gift
kept.why: "Its controller creates a 3/3 green Elephant creature token" - the token goes to the player whose permanent you just destroyed. It is the cost of hitting any permanent at instant speed, not a token this deck gets. Left in, a Krenko or Adeline deck reads this as a token maker when it in fact hands the opponent a 3/3. The card is removal and nothing else.

kept.name: Evolving Wilds
kept.why: It searches for and moves exactly ONE basic land; it affects nothing else on the board. The word is a selector artefact - Myriad Landscape and Path to Exile do the same thing and carry no scope:all, which is what shows this is noise rather than a claim about the card.

kept.name: Terramorphic Expanse
kept.why: Same text as Evolving Wilds, same reasoning: one basic land fetched, nothing affected board-wide.

kept.name: Demonic Tutor
kept.why: "Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand" - one card, into your hand. Nothing on the battlefield is touched. scope:all should mean the card affects everything, and this is the narrowest possible effect.

kept.name: Solemn Simulacrum
kept.why: One basic land fetched on arrival and one card drawn on death. Neither clause affects everything. The rest of the list (search, draw, both triggers) is correct and complete.

kept.name: Polluted Delta
kept.why: The word for 'looks for a land card in your library' is missing here while its identical siblings Flooded Strand, Misty Rainforest, Windswept Heath and Wooded Foothills all carry it - the ten fetchlands should not disagree with each other about what they do. scope:all is the same selector artefact: one land, fetched.

kept.name: Bloodstained Mire
kept.why: Missing the library-land word its identical siblings carry, and carrying a scope:all that describes nothing - it fetches a single Swamp or Mountain.

kept.name: Scalding Tarn
kept.why: Missing the library-land word its identical siblings carry, and carrying a scope:all that describes nothing - it fetches a single Island or Mountain.

kept.name: Flooded Strand
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Misty Rainforest
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Windswept Heath
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Wooded Foothills
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Verdant Catacombs
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Marsh Flats
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Arid Mesa
kept.why: One land fetched from the library; nothing board-wide. The rest of the list is right.

kept.name: Sejiri Shelter // Sejiri Glacier
kept.why: The land half was never read: it taps for {W}, so eff:add-mana and cost:tap. Granting protection from a colour is a protection trick, which is eff:protect.

kept.name: Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt
kept.why: Only the sorcery half was read. The land taps for {B} and offers 'you may pay 3 life' to enter untapped.

kept.name: Mindcrank
kept.why: 'Whenever an opponent loses life' is the card's only trigger and it was not recorded.

kept.name: Cabaretti Courtyard
kept.why: Nothing but the enters trigger was read. It sacrifices itself, searches the library for a basic land, shuffles and gains 1 life.

kept.name: Monument to Endurance
kept.why: 'Choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn' is a modal choice, so eff:choose. The discard trigger itself has no word in the vocabulary.

kept.name: Krosan Verge
kept.why: The activated ability's cost includes sacrificing this land, and the search ends with a shuffle. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Mirror Entity
kept.why: The activated ability was read as nothing at all. It sets base power and toughness of every creature you control to X/X and gives them all creature types, which is the card's entire purpose as a tribal finisher.

kept.name: Alhammarret's Archive
kept.why: eff:multiply alone does not say what is doubled. The card replaces a draw with drawing two cards and a life gain with twice as much, so it both draws and gains life, and 'if you would gain life' is caring about lifegain.

kept.name: The Soul Stone
kept.why: The reanimation happens at the beginning of your upkeep, and harnessing costs exiling a creature you control. Neither the trigger nor the cost was recorded.

kept.name: Defile
kept.why: -1/-1 for each Swamp makes a creature smaller, not bigger. This is a removal spell and eff:pump files it as a pump spell.

kept.name: All Is Dust
kept.why: Every player sacrifices all their coloured permanents, which is a symmetric board wipe that empties your own side too.

kept.name: Approach of the Second Sun
kept.why: Nobody ever loses the game from this card; eff:lose-game is simply wrong. It does put itself into its owner's library seventh from the top, which is a real library interaction.

kept.name: Blightsteel Colossus
kept.why: The replacement effect reveals it and shuffles it into its owner's library. Deliberately not adding cares:zone:graveyard: the clause exists to AVOID the graveyard, it is not a graveyard-matters card.

kept.name: Cut a Deal
kept.why: 'Each opponent draws a card' is group draw, which eff:draw alone does not say.

kept.name: The Wind Crystal
kept.why: The lifegain-doubling line was read as nothing. It doubles life gained (eff:multiply, eff:gain-life, cares:lifegain) and the cost reduction is specifically for white spells.

kept.name: Necromancy
kept.why: Only the enters trigger and the reanimation were read. It becomes an Aura and attaches itself, it triggers when it leaves the battlefield, that trigger makes the creature's controller sacrifice it, and it may be cast as though it had flash.

kept.name: Fumigate
kept.why: 'Destroy all creatures' with no restriction is the definitive symmetric board wipe. Unlike Hour of Reckoning it spares nothing, so the wipe word is correct here.

kept.name: Swarmyard
kept.why: Regenerating a creature keeps it alive, which is exactly what eff:protect means. The land's only non-mana ability was otherwise invisible.

kept.name: Bloodghast
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' and 'has haste as long as an opponent has 10 or less life' were both unread. Only the landfall recursion had been recorded.

kept.name: Oketra's Monument
kept.why: The cost reduction applies to WHITE creature spells specifically, which is what makes it a mono-white card rather than a generic creature-cost reducer.

kept.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
kept.why: 'Whenever you gain life' is the canonical lifegain payoff clause; trig:gains-life records the timing but nothing says the card belongs to a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Steelshaper's Gift
kept.why: The tutor ends with a shuffle, which was not recorded.

kept.name: Charismatic Conqueror
kept.why: The trigger is another permanent (an opponent's) entering, which trig:enters alone does not distinguish. The card itself never gains life: lifelink is a characteristic of the token it makes, and Wurmcoil Engine's lifelink token correctly produces no eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Jhoira's Familiar
kept.why: Half the card is 'historic spells you cast cost {1} less' and it produced no facet at all, so the engine reads it as a vanilla 4-mana flier.

kept.name: Syphon Mind
kept.why: 'Each other player discards' hits the whole table, the same shape as Dictate of Erebos and All Is Dust which both carry scope:all.

kept.name: Portal to Phyrexia
kept.why: 'Each opponent sacrifices three creatures' hits every opponent, the same shape as Dictate of Erebos which carries scope:all.

kept.name: Commander's Plate
kept.why: The equipment grants protection from every colour outside your commander's identity and no protection word was recorded - only the +3/+3 half of the line was read.

kept.name: Field of the Dead
kept.why: The trigger reads "Whenever this land OR another land you control enters", so it fires on its own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Plaza of Heroes
kept.why: The last ability grants hexproof AND indestructible; only indestructible was read. Exiling the land is an activation cost, which was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Maskwood Nexus
kept.why: The whole first paragraph was unread: it makes every creature you control every creature type, which is changeling granted to your whole board, and the token it makes has changeling printed on it.

kept.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
kept.why: "Whenever you attack" is an attack trigger and nothing recorded it, so her token-making was floating with no event attached.

kept.name: Blind Obedience
kept.why: Extort triggers on YOU casting a spell, so the generic trig:cast needed the -own form. The static line affects every artifact and creature your opponents control, which is a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
kept.why: It puts creatures from ALL graveyards onto the battlefield under YOUR control, so it takes opponents' cards. eff:return-from alone reads as reanimating only your own.

kept.name: Necropotence
kept.why: The list was two words for a card with three abilities. It pays life as an activation cost, exiles the top of your library, and puts that card into your hand on a delayed end-step trigger. eff:draw is added because putting library cards into your hand IS this card's whole function - without it the format's best black card-advantage engine reads as drawing nothing.

kept.name: Felidar Retreat
kept.why: "Landfall - ... choose one" is a modal trigger and the choice itself was never recorded, so the engine reads it as doing both halves unconditionally.

kept.name: Exquisite Blood
kept.why: Two words for a card whose entire text is a trigger. "Whenever an opponent loses life" is exactly trig:loses-life; the gain was recorded with no event.

kept.name: Wishclaw Talisman
kept.why: The three wish counters go on the artifact ITSELF. The generic eff:add-counters makes a black tutor read as a counters card, which is exactly the split eff:add-counters-self exists for. The tutor also puts the card into your hand.

kept.name: Blasphemous Edict
kept.why: "Each player sacrifices thirteen creatures" is symmetric mass removal that empties YOUR board too. A go-wide token deck should never be offered this, and only scope:wipe carries that warning; eff:sacrifice alone reads as an aristocrats outlet.

kept.name: Imperial Seal
kept.why: "You lose 2 life" points at YOU, so filing it as eff:lose-life tells the engine a one-mana tutor is a drain payoff. Removed rather than left, since with it the card is a candidate for every lifedrain deck.

kept.name: Crypt Ghast
kept.why: Extort is "Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay..." and no cast trigger was recorded at all, so its life drain hung off nothing.

kept.name: Ripples of Undeath
kept.why: Only the mill half was read. You then pay {1} and 3 life optionally, and if you do you take one of the milled cards out of the graveyard and into your hand - which is recursion and is the reason to play the card.

kept.name: Voice of Victory
kept.why: Mobilize sacrifices the two tokens at the beginning of the next end step. That is a delayed end-step trigger and a real sacrifice of your own creatures, which matters for anything paid when creatures die.

kept.name: Dread Return
kept.why: The flashback cost is sacrificing three creatures - an alternative cost paid in bodies, which is why the card sits in aristocrats decks. Nothing recorded a cost.

kept.name: Emergence Zone
kept.why: The land sacrifices itself to grant flash. The cost was not recorded, so the land reads as a repeatable effect.

kept.name: Sword of Feast and Famine
kept.why: The static line is +2/+2 AND protection from black and green, and neither was recorded - only the combat-damage trigger was read.

kept.name: Maze of Ith
kept.why: Half the card is "prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature", which is the reason the land is played. Only the untap was recorded.

kept.name: Bonders' Enclave
kept.why: The draw is gated on controlling a creature with power 4 or greater, which is a genuine power-matters condition and the reason the land belongs in big-creature decks.

kept.name: Unbreakable Formation
kept.why: The addendum puts a +1/+1 counter on each of your creatures and no counter effect was recorded, only the two keyword grants.

kept.name: Nesting Grounds
kept.why: Moving a counter is taking one off one permanent and putting it on another. Neither half was recorded, so a land built entirely for counters decks says nothing about counters.

kept.name: Marionette Apprentice
kept.why: Fabricate is an enters-the-battlefield trigger offering a choice between a counter and a token, and none of that was recorded - both outcomes were listed with no event and no choice. The second ability watches permanents being put into a graveyard.

kept.name: Opposition Agent
kept.why: "They exile each card they find" is the working half of the card and no exile word was recorded.

kept.name: Talon Gates of Madara
kept.why: The {4} ability puts the land from your hand straight onto the battlefield, which is a real effect nothing recorded. Its enter trigger phases a creature out and there is no word for that at all.

kept.name: Thespian's Stage
kept.why: The land's only real ability is becoming a copy of another land and no copy word was recorded, so the card reads as a plain colourless source.

kept.name: Martial Coup
kept.why: "destroy all other creatures" is a mass battlefield destroy restricted only by the source-exclusion 'other', so it kills your own board too. Neither scope word was recorded.

kept.name: Call of the Ring
kept.why: The whole second ability was unread: "you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card." The list held only the upkeep trigger, so a card that draws and pays life said neither.

kept.name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
kept.why: The activation cost is "{T}, Sacrifice two other creatures". cost:sacrifice was recorded and the tap half was not.

kept.name: Exalted Sunborn
kept.why: "twice that many of those tokens are created instead" is a doubler. eff:create-token alone says it makes tokens, which it does not - it multiplies other cards' tokens.

kept.name: Abzan Falconer
kept.why: Outlast's cost is "{W}, {T}", and "Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has flying" is a mass grant, the same shape as Eldrazi Monument's scope:all.

kept.name: Rings of Brighthearth
kept.why: "you may pay {2}. If you do, copy that ability" is the pay-for-more shape and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Contagion Clasp
kept.why: The proliferate ability costs "{4}, {T}" and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Elixir of Immortality
kept.why: Only the lifegain half was read. "Shuffle this artifact and your graveyard into their owner's library" is the reason the card is played - it is graveyard-to-library recursion and a shuffle, and none of the three words were there.

kept.name: Caduceus, Staff of Hermes
kept.why: The granted "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature" was unread, and the whole card is gated on "As long as you have 30 or more life", which is a life-total payoff nothing recorded.

kept.name: Dark Depths
kept.why: "sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage" - the sacrifice is the entire point of the card and no sacrifice word was present.

kept.name: Eldrazi Monument
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature" was unread: the upkeep trigger was recorded with no effect attached to it.

kept.name: Fell the Mighty
kept.why: "all creatures with power greater than target creature's power" is a power check and cares:power was missing. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe - it is a filtered wipe, the same shape as Elspeth, Sun's Champion, which is already refused.

kept.name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
kept.why: "Creatures and nonbasic lands your opponents control enter tapped" affects every opponent permanent of two types, and no scope word was recorded.

kept.name: No Mercy
kept.why: The card carried NOTHING but its type line. "Whenever a creature deals damage to you, destroy it" is a repeatable removal engine and the engine could see none of it.

kept.name: Cover of Darkness
kept.why: The grant itself was unread - the list recorded choosing a type and not what the choice does. "Creatures of the chosen type have fear" is a mass evasion grant.

kept.name: Feign Death
kept.why: The creature dies and is returned from the graveyard, so this is graveyard recursion; eff:return-from was recorded without the zone it returns from.

kept.name: Dreadhorde Invasion
kept.why: The second ability was entirely unread: "Whenever a Zombie token you control with power 6 or greater attacks, it gains lifelink until end of turn."

kept.name: Cleric Class
kept.why: Level 1 is a lifegain replacement effect and level 2 triggers on gaining life. trig:gains-life was recorded but nothing said the card is a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Monumental Henge
kept.why: "Look at the top five cards of your library" is library manipulation; eff:look-and-pick was recorded without the zone.

kept.name: Lae'zel, Vlaakith's Champion
kept.why: "or on yourself" puts counters on a player and was unread, and the replacement applies to every creature, planeswalker and player you control.

kept.name: Fake Your Own Death
kept.why: "gets +2/+0" was unread entirely, and the Treasure is CREATED - only eff:add-mana from the reminder text was recorded, so the card never said it makes a token. It also returns the creature from the graveyard.

kept.name: Patriarch's Bidding
kept.why: "Each player chooses a creature type" is the choose shape already recorded on Cover of Darkness and was missing here.

kept.name: Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl, Profane Prince
kept.why: The transform ability was completely unread: "Sacrifice five creatures: Transform this land, then untap it." That sacrifice is a real on-demand outlet and the flip is the reason the card exists.

kept.name: Odric, Lunarch Marshal
kept.why: The card names thirteen keywords and the list held five of them. Odric both CARES about each keyword and GRANTS it to your whole team, so every one needs both words, and the grant is to all creatures you control.

kept.name: Arid Archway
kept.why: "surveil 1" was in the reminder text and the keyword was recorded, but the effect word was not. Deliberately no bounce word: it returns a LAND, which is outside the narrowed eff:bounce-own.

kept.name: Lavaspur Boots
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +1/+0 and haste, and neither was recorded - the card said only that it attaches to something.

kept.name: Guide of Souls
kept.why: Most of the card was unread. "you gain 1 life and get {E}" recorded neither the life nor the energy counter on you, and the entire second ability - the attack trigger, the optional energy payment and the flying counter - was absent.

kept.name: Stonecoil Serpent
kept.why: Its cost is {X} alone, so mana value collapses to 0 and it reads as a cheap card. It is one of the 19 X-only cards CLAUDE.md names for exactly this, and a commander wanting cheap creatures is being offered a card that is only cheap if you pay nothing for it.

kept.name: Myrel, Shield of Argive
kept.why: The stax half applies to every opponent, for every artifact, creature and enchantment, and no scope word was recorded.

kept.name: Horizon of Progress
kept.why: "You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped" is exactly eff:put-onto-battlefield's gloss and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Hangarback Walker
kept.why: Its cost is {X}{X}, so mana value computes to 0 and it reads as a two-drop. Nobody casts this for nothing; a deck asking for cheap cards is being offered a card that is only cheap if you pay zero.

kept.name: Marionette Master
kept.why: Fabricate 3 is a "when this creature enters" trigger and no enters word was recorded, so the token/counter half of the card had no trigger attached to it.

kept.name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
kept.why: "Commanders you control have ward {2}" is a real protective effect and nothing in the list said the card protects anything.

kept.name: Rumor Gatherer
kept.why: "draw a card instead" on the second resolution each turn. It had eff:scry and no draw at all, so the payoff half of the card was invisible.

kept.name: Tortured Existence
kept.why: Nothing on the battlefield is returned to hand. The card moves a creature card from graveyard to hand, which eff:return-from already says. eff:bounce-own would file it with Cloudshift and Whitemane Lion.

kept.name: Pawn of Ulamog
kept.why: The Eldrazi Spawn it makes read "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}". The card is a mana source in every deck that runs it, and the granted quoted ability is the only place that is written.

kept.name: It That Betrays
kept.why: "Whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent" is a sacrifice trigger, and the card then returns that card from the graveyard onto the battlefield. Only eff:gain-control was recorded, so neither the trigger nor the graveyard return was.

kept.name: Unstoppable Slasher
kept.why: Three of its four lines produced nothing. It halves a player's life (eff:lose-life), it returns itself to the battlefield when it dies (eff:recur-self), and it comes back carrying two stun counters it puts on itself.

kept.name: Monastery Mentor
kept.why: Prowess is "this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn" and the card is one of the format's prowess payoffs; only the token half was recorded.

kept.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
kept.why: The whole point of the front face is putting an opponent's card onto the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL and that was missing. The Lantern makes a player sacrifice or discard, and it taps to do it.

kept.name: Crux of Fate
kept.why: "Destroy all non-Dragon creatures" kills your board too in any deck that is not Dragons, which is what scope:wipe exists to say. It is also a modal choose one.

kept.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
kept.why: The counter ability is paid by discarding a card, which was recorded as an effect but never as a cost, and the cast trigger reads your hand size.

kept.name: Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd
kept.why: She exiles and returns a permanent and explicitly rewards it entering under YOUR control, so she is a blink outlet. Generic eff:exile files her as removal instead.

kept.name: Null Elemental Blast
kept.why: "Choose one" modal and nothing said so.

kept.name: Losheel, Clockwork Scholar
kept.why: Losheel is not an artifact creature, so its draw trigger only ever fires on other creatures entering. Preventing all combat damage to your attacking creatures is keeping your creatures alive.

kept.name: Haliya, Guided by Light
kept.why: The end step ability draws a card and no draw was recorded at all. It also checks how much life you gained this turn, which is a lifegain-matters card, and Haliya's own arrival triggers her first ability.

kept.name: Thran Power Suit
kept.why: "+1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it" is a pump and none was recorded, so an Equipment whose job is making a creature big said nothing about size. Ward {2} is protection.

kept.name: Ondu Spiritdancer
kept.why: "Create a token that's a copy of it" is the entire card and neither word was there. It read as an enchantments-care creature that does nothing.

kept.name: Eldrazi Conscription
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and nothing said it attaches to anything.

kept.name: Replicating Ring
kept.why: At eight night counters it removes all of them and creates eight mana-producing tokens. Only the counter accumulation was recorded, so the payoff was missing.

kept.name: Call the Coppercoats
kept.why: It creates X 1/1 Human Soldiers and carried no effect word at all - the list was three cares words and a keyword.

kept.name: Chronicle of Victory
kept.why: Everything but the choose-a-type line was unread. It is an anthem giving +2/+2, first strike and trample to your chosen type, and it draws a card whenever you cast one.

kept.name: Resourceful Defense
kept.why: The card had TWO facets and neither described anything it does. It triggers when your permanents leave the battlefield, and both abilities relocate counters.

kept.name: Unmarked Grave
kept.why: It puts a card from your library into your graveyard. eff:search-library says it tutors but nothing said where the card ends up, which is the only reason the card is played.

kept.name: Fomori Vault
kept.why: The dig ability costs a discard and looks at the top X of your library; neither was recorded.

kept.name: Illusionist's Bracers
kept.why: Copying the equipped creature's activated ability is the whole card and no effect word was present.

kept.name: Sting, the Glinting Dagger
kept.why: "Equipped creature has first strike as long as it's blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc" - haste and the pump were recorded, first strike was not.

kept.name: Rhox Faithmender
kept.why: Doubling all life gain is a lifegain payoff, and eff:multiply alone does not say what it multiplies.

kept.name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
kept.why: The ultimate gains 7 life and puts seven permanents from your hand onto the battlefield, and neither was recorded. The minus abilities are paid with loyalty counters (only the plus was), and the -X hits each permanent on the board.

kept.name: Stitch Together
kept.why: Nothing is returned from the battlefield to hand. It is a graveyard return, already covered by eff:return-from and eff:move-zone; eff:bounce-own would file a reanimation spell with the blink cards.

kept.name: Obscura Storefront
kept.why: A fetchland that carried nothing but "it enters". It sacrifices itself to search for a basic land and gains a life, and none of that was written down.

kept.name: Blast Zone
kept.why: The destroy ability sacrifices the land as part of its cost, and it destroys EACH nonland permanent at that mana value rather than one target.

kept.name: Archfiend of Ifnir
kept.why: The whole second line is unread: it puts a -1/-1 counter on EACH creature your opponents control, which is a counters effect, a shrink effect and a mass one. Only the cycling half (draw, discard-self) was recorded, so the card reads as a cycling payoff that does nothing.

kept.name: Rune-Scarred Demon
kept.why: "then shuffle" is a real part of the tutor and nothing records it.

kept.name: Lethal Scheme
kept.why: Connive is loot-then-counter: it draws a card and makes you discard one, and neither was recorded, only the +1/+1 counter. Convoke taps your own creatures to help cast it, which is what cost:cast-tap-others says (Sephara carries it for the same shape). cares:color:b is a word scan - the card names no colour it cares about, it is a removal spell with two black pips, and every other black card in this batch correctly lacks it.

kept.name: Summon: Bahamut
kept.why: Chapter IV deals damage to EACH opponent, which is a mass effect; the list records eff:damage as though it were a single-target burn spell.

kept.name: Guildless Commons
kept.why: The enter trigger returns a land you control to your hand and nothing records it, so the card reads as a plain colourless dual with a triggered ability that does nothing. This is your own permanent going back to your hand, which is what -own means.

kept.name: Brokers Hideout
kept.why: Everything this land does is missing: it eats itself, fetches a basic land onto the battlefield, shuffles, and gains a life. The list says only "a land with an enter trigger", so the engine cannot tell it from a card that does nothing. cares:zone:library-land is the word that makes it read as fixing rather than as a generic tutor.

kept.name: Vexing Bauble
kept.why: The whole condition is "if NO MANA WAS SPENT to cast it" - it is a free-spell hoser and that is exactly what cares:mana-spent names. Without it the card reads as a blanket counterspell for every spell cast.

kept.name: Mikaeus, the Unhallowed
kept.why: The second line - whenever a Human deals damage to you, destroy it - is entirely unread. It is a removal effect on a damage trigger, and neither the verb nor the trigger is recorded.

kept.name: Valgavoth, Terror Eater
kept.why: The replacement effect applies to every card headed to ANY opponent's graveyard, which is a symmetric table-wide static, not a one-shot exile.

kept.name: Undying Malice
kept.why: The granted ability returns the creature from the graveyard to the battlefield, so the card genuinely interacts with the graveyard and nothing says so.

kept.name: Astral Cornucopia
kept.why: mv:cheap is an artefact of {X}{X}{X} having a printed mana value of zero - this is never a two-mana card, you pay three mana per counter, and calling it cheap offers it to decks that asked for cheap spells. It enters with X charge counters ON ITSELF, which is what -self records (Palantir carries the same word for its influence counters).

kept.name: Key to the City
kept.why: The activated ability's costs are unread: it taps and it makes you discard ANOTHER card (cost:discard, not cost:discard-self, which is for discarding the card itself as with cycling). The draw is not free either - "you may pay {2}. If you do, draw a card" is precisely eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Organic Extinction
kept.why: Improvise taps your other permanents to help cast the spell, the same cost shape as convoke, and nothing records that this ten-mana sorcery is castable off a board of artifacts. Deliberately NOT adding scope:wipe: "nonartifact" is a restriction, and the established rule is that a restricted wipe is a payoff rather than a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Rootborn Defenses
kept.why: This is a protection spell - it is how you save your board from a wrath - and eff:protect is the word for that; only eff:pump was recorded, which files it as a combat trick. Populate creates a token that is a COPY of a creature token you control, so the copy is real and not just token creation.

kept.name: Sword of Fire and Ice
kept.why: Two thirds of the static line is unread: it gives +2/+2 and protection from red and from blue. The list records only the trigger half (damage, draw), so the best equipment in the format reads as a damage trigger with no body.

kept.name: Dolmen Gate
kept.why: Preventing all combat damage to your attackers is a protection effect on your whole team, and neither the protective purpose nor the mass scope is recorded.

kept.name: Palantír of Orthanc
kept.why: "target opponent may have you draw a card" is a real draw and it is missing, so the card reads as pure mill and drain when its usual mode is drawing you a card every end step.

kept.name: Conqueror's Flail
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each colour among your permanents - the entire first line - and no pump word is recorded.

kept.name: Persist
kept.why: It returns the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it and the counter clause is unread. Deliberately NOT adding eff:shrink: the counter is a drawback on your own reanimation target, not a way to make an opponent's creature smaller, and eff:shrink would file a reanimation spell as removal.

kept.name: Staff of Compleation
kept.why: The first ability - destroy target permanent YOU OWN - is unread. eff:destroy-own rather than eff:destroy because it cannot touch an opponent's board and must not be counted as removal; it is a sacrifice-style outlet for your own permanents.

kept.name: Vraska, Betrayal's Sting
kept.why: The ultimate gives a player up to nine poison counters and can win the game on the spot, and neither the poison nor the fact that counters go on a PLAYER is recorded.

kept.name: Scroll Rack
kept.why: The list is four words long and none of them describe the card. It taps, it swaps cards between your hand and the top of your library, and that is the whole point of it. eff:move-zone is the honest verb - deliberately not eff:draw, because it never draws, and not eff:exile, because the exile is a face-down staging area and would file this as removal.

kept.name: Decree of Pain
kept.why: The cycling trigger gives ALL creatures -2/-2 and is unread, so the cheap half of the card - which is the half most decks cast - does nothing as far as the engine is concerned.

kept.name: Agatha's Soul Cauldron
kept.why: It exiles cards from graveyards and then cares about what it has exiled - both zones are load-bearing and neither is recorded. Soul-Guide Lantern in this same batch carries cares:zone:graveyard for the identical clause.

kept.name: Rankle, Master of Pranks
kept.why: The third mode - each player sacrifices a creature - is missing entirely, which is the mode that makes Rankle removal. Every mode hits EACH player, so it is symmetric rather than aimed, and "choose any number" is a genuine modal choice.

kept.name: Ulamog, the Infinite Gyre
kept.why: The death trigger shuffling its owner's graveyard into their library is unread, and it is the reason this Ulamog is uncounterable-in-practice as a mill wall. Annihilator triggers on attack, and the sacrifice already recorded has no trigger attached to it.

kept.name: Giver of Runes
kept.why: This card exists to keep a creature alive and that is what eff:protect names; only eff:pump was recorded, which is not true of it in any case - it changes no power or toughness.

kept.name: Grand Crescendo
kept.why: Giving your whole board indestructible at instant speed is a protection effect, not merely a pump; without eff:protect it cannot be found by a deck looking for a way to survive a wrath.

kept.name: Archangel of Thune
kept.why: Lifelink gains you life and that is unread here, though the other lifelink cards in this batch carry it. More importantly this is the definitive lifegain PAYOFF - its whole trigger is "whenever you gain life" - and cares:lifegain is the word for that.

kept.name: Mantle of the Ancients
kept.why: Nothing this card does is recorded. It mass-reanimates every Aura and Equipment out of your graveyard, attaches them, and pumps the creature by the number attached. The list says only "an Aura that mentions Auras and Equipment".

kept.name: Damn
kept.why: Overload {2}{W}{W} changes "target" to "each", so the card is a symmetric one-sided-nothing board wipe that destroys every creature including yours. That is the whole reason it is played, and the list only recorded the single-target mode.

kept.name: Buried Alive
kept.why: It moves three creature cards from library to graveyard. The list has eff:search-library and the two zone words but nothing saying cards actually change zone, which is the entire point for a reanimator deck.

kept.name: Anointed Procession
kept.why: It is the archetypal token doubler and carried no word for doubling. eff:multiply ("doubles or triples what happens") is exactly this clause.

kept.name: Vanquisher's Banner
kept.why: rec:partial, and only the "choose a creature type" clause was read. Both real abilities were missing: a mass +1/+1 anthem on your chosen-type creatures (eff:pump, scope:all) and a draw trigger on casting a creature spell of that type (eff:draw plus the cast-trigger words).

kept.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
kept.why: "Whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn" produced no lifegain word at all. The card had eff:damage for the 50-life shot but nothing for the gain that pays for it, which is half the card.

kept.name: Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire
kept.why: Channel is "{2}{W}, Discard this card" - discarding the card itself is the activation cost and was unrecorded. Same shape as cost:sacrifice-self and cost:exile-self.

kept.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
kept.why: The last ability costs "{T}, Sacrifice this creature" and only the sacrifice half was recorded. cares:zone:graveyard because the replacement effect is entirely about cards going to opponents' graveyards; eff:exile-graveyard is deliberately kept apart from eff:exile so the zone word is not implied by it.

kept.name: Helm of the Host
kept.why: "Create a token that's a copy of equipped creature" is a copy effect and carried no eff:copy, and "That token gains haste" carried no grant. rec:partial - only the token creation was read.

kept.name: Silence
kept.why: "Your opponents can't cast spells this turn" hits every opponent, not one target. The card has no rec: word at all and only eff:cant-cast was recorded.

kept.name: Orzhov Basilica
kept.why: "When this land enters, return a land you control to its owner's hand" produced nothing. Returning your own permanent to hand is eff:bounce-own; the trigger words were there with no effect attached to them.

kept.name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
kept.why: A Treasure token adds mana - Warren Soultrader in this same batch carries eff:add-mana for creating one, so Lotho was inconsistent. "Whenever a PLAYER casts their second spell" triggers on you and on opponents alike, so both direction words are true; the bare trig:cast said neither.

kept.name: Mystic Forge
kept.why: The list is very thin - no rec: word and only cares: words plus cost:life. The third ability is "{T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library", so cost:tap and eff:exile were both missing. The card-advantage ability needs a new word (below).

kept.name: Welcoming Vampire
kept.why: It triggers on OTHER creatures you control entering, never on itself, so the bare trig:enters was ambiguous in the direction that matters - this is not a card you blink. "with power 2 or less" is a power check and cares:power was missing.

kept.name: Mondrak, Glory Dominus
kept.why: The token-doubling replacement produced no word at all - neither eff:create-token nor eff:multiply - so the format's second-best token doubler read as a sacrifice outlet that grows itself. Anointed Procession in this batch had eff:create-token and Mondrak did not, so they also disagreed with each other.

kept.name: Walking Ballista
kept.why: "Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: it deals 1 damage" is a removal cost and was unrecorded, which is the ability the whole card is played for. eff:add-counters is wrong: every counter it places goes on itself, which is what eff:add-counters-self already says, and the generic word makes it read as +1/+1-counters support for other creatures. mv:cheap is wrong: the printed cost is {X}{X}, so mana value is 0 only because X is zero outside the stack - it is never actually a two-mana card, and a deck asking for cheap cards is being handed one that costs whatever you pay.

kept.name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
kept.why: "Each player draws a card, then discards a card" affects everyone (scope:all), draws YOU a card (eff:draw - the land is played as a draw engine), and makes YOU discard (eff:discard-self), which is the looting half reanimator decks want. Only the outward-facing eff:draw-each and eff:discard were recorded.

kept.name: Psychosis Crawler
kept.why: Its power and toughness are equal to the number of cards in your hand. eff:set-pt records that the P/T is set but nothing recorded what it is set BY, so the card does not read as caring about hand size.

kept.name: Accursed Marauder
kept.why: rec:partial, and the entire effect was missing - the list had the enters trigger with no effect hanging off it. "Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature" is a mass edict: eff:sacrifice for the effect, scope:all because it hits every player.

kept.name: Starfield Mystic
kept.why: "Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less to cast" is the card's first line and produced no facet at all. The counters half is read correctly.

kept.name: The Black Gate
kept.why: "you may pay 3 life" as it enters is a life payment and nothing recorded it. The mana ability and the unblockable ability are read.

kept.name: Painful Quandary
kept.why: "loses 5 life unless they discard a card" is a tax on every opponent spell - the punisher choice itself was unrecorded, only its two outcomes were.

kept.name: Archon of Sun's Grace
kept.why: "Pegasus creatures you control have lifelink" is a grant to other creatures and produced nothing; kw:lifelink only records the Archon's own printed keyword.

kept.name: Homeward Path
kept.why: "Each player gains control of all creatures they own" is half the card and produced nothing. scope:all is right for a board-wide effect; the direction of control needs a word that does not exist.

kept.name: Moonshaker Cavalry
kept.why: The entire ETB - a mass +X/+X and mass flying, which is the card's whole reason for existing as a finisher - produced no effect facet at all. Only the printed kw:flying survived.

kept.name: Thriving Moor
kept.why: The facet list is empty apart from acost:1 and type:land. This is a two-colour tapland and the engine does not know it makes mana.

kept.name: Forge Anew
kept.why: "You may pay {0} rather than pay the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate" makes equipping free each turn, which is the card's main line and produced nothing.

kept.name: The Darkness Crystal
kept.why: The replacement effect exiles opponents' dying creatures and gains 2 life - neither was recorded. The activated ability costs {T} and reaches back into the exile pile it built, so cares:zone:exile is the mechanic rather than an incidental mention.

kept.name: Junji, the Midnight Sky
kept.why: "Each opponent discards two cards and loses 2 life" hits every opponent; the effects are recorded but the mass scope is not, unlike Painful Quandary and Suture Priest which carry it for the same shape.

kept.name: Midgar, City of Mako // Reactor Raid
kept.why: The Adventure half is completely unread: "sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, draw two cards" is a Deadly Dispute effect, so the card draws and is an on-demand sacrifice outlet. Only the land half produced facets.

kept.name: Waste Not
kept.why: All three abilities watch every opponent, and the trigger event itself is unsayable in the current vocabulary.

kept.name: Exemplar of Light
kept.why: "draw a card" from the second triggered ability produced no facet; only the counter half was read.

kept.name: Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter
kept.why: "if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than Liberator's power" is exactly what cares:mana-spent names, and it is the condition the whole growth ability turns on.

kept.name: Tezzeret, Cruel Captain
kept.why: The 0 ability puts a +1/+1 counter on a target artifact creature and the emblem puts three more, so counters go on OTHER permanents, not only on Tezzeret (only eff:add-counters-self for loyalty was recorded). The emblem also turns a noncreature artifact into a 0/0 Robot creature, which is eff:animate and produced nothing.

kept.name: Maestros Theater
kept.why: Only trig:enters/-self and type:land were recorded. This is a fetch land: it eats itself, searches for a basic Island, Swamp or Mountain and gains a life, and none of that was written down, so the engine cannot see it as a mana source at all.

kept.name: Coveted Jewel
kept.why: "Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked" is an attack trigger and produced no trigger facet - the draw, the untap and the control change were all recorded as arriving from nowhere.

kept.name: Wandering Archaic // Explore the Vastlands
kept.why: "they may pay {2}. If they don't..." is the canonical tax clause and was unrecorded - it is what makes this a stax-ish card rather than a copy card. The back half has each player look at the top five of their library and take cards, which is library manipulation the list does not mention.

kept.name: Peer into the Abyss
kept.why: "and loses half their life" is half the card - the reason it is a kill spell rather than a draw spell - and produced nothing.

kept.name: Amulet of Vigor
kept.why: "Whenever a permanent you control enters tapped" is a trigger on other permanents entering and no trigger facet was recorded, so the untap reads as unconditional.

kept.name: Sheltered by Ghosts
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has lifelink" is the static half of the Aura and produced nothing; only the ETB exile was read.

kept.name: Flare of Malice
kept.why: "Each opponent sacrifices" is a mass edict; the sacrifice is recorded but not that it hits every opponent, unlike other symmetric edicts.

kept.name: Dakmor Salvage
kept.why: Dredge returns THIS card from the graveyard to hand every time you would draw. eff:return-from is present but generic; the self-recursion is the point of the card and is what makes it fodder for a graveyard engine.

kept.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
kept.why: He is a free, repeatable sacrifice outlet on enter and on every attack - the single most important thing about the card for deck building - and cost:sacrifice was missing. eff:sacrifice is used on this data for edicts that make OPPONENTS sacrifice (Flare of Malice, Artisan of Kozilek's annihilator); Sephiroth sacrifices your own creatures, so it misfiles him as removal. He also transforms himself on the fourth death trigger, which had only the printed kw:transform.

kept.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
kept.why: "Whenever Ayara OR another black creature you control enters" triggers on itself too. It carries trig:enters and trig:enters-other and not the self half.

kept.name: Bitter Triumph
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay 3 life" is unrecorded. Both options apply; the card can be paid either way.

kept.name: Nadier's Nightblade
kept.why: Half the clause is missing: "and you gain 1 life". The trigger is on LEAVING the battlefield, not only dying (bounce and exile count), so trig:leaves belongs beside trig:dies. scope:all for "each opponent", matching Cruel Celebrant and Ayara which carry it for the identical clause.

kept.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
kept.why: "if no mana was spent to cast it" is exactly cares:mana-spent and is unrecorded. eff:pump is wrong: the sacrifice ability grants indestructible and changes no power or toughness. Confirmed against this batch, where Darksteel Plate and Blade of Selves grant keywords and correctly carry no eff:pump, while Bastion Protector and Excalibur carry it for real +N/+N. eff:protect for the instant-speed team save.

kept.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
kept.why: Half the card is missing. It carries eff:pump for "+2/+2" and nothing for "Creatures your opponents control get -2/-2", which is the half that acts as a one-sided sweeper.

kept.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
kept.why: "Whenever an opponent loses life" is a trigger the vocabulary already names, and the card records only the eff:gain-life it produces, not what fires it.

kept.name: Heraldic Banner
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+0" is entirely unrecorded. cost:tap for "{T}: Add one mana", which every other card in the batch with an explicit {T} mana ability carries.

kept.name: The Mycosynth Gardens
kept.why: "This land becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control" is unrecorded; the list holds only the two mana abilities.

kept.name: Breach the Multiverse
kept.why: It reanimates from EVERY player's graveyard under YOUR control, which is theft, not just recursion. scope:all for "each player mills ten cards".

kept.name: Beseech the Mirror
kept.why: Bargain is an additional cost paid as you cast, which is the cast-time word, not the generic cost:sacrifice already present. It searches your library and the library zone is unrecorded. Note the cares:type:artifact/enchantment/token on this card come from Bargain's reminder text and make a black tutor look like an artifacts card, but cares:type:* is out of scope for me to remove.

kept.name: Witch's Cottage
kept.why: "When this land enters untapped, you may put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library" is a real enters trigger and neither trigger word is present, though the effect words are.

kept.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
kept.why: Three unrecorded clauses. Tripling token creation is the whole front face. "When Ojer Taq dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed" is both self-recursion and a transform, and the back face transforms again. I deliberately did NOT add eff:add-mana or cost:tap for the back face's {T}: Add {W}: it would give a token-tripler the ramp role for mana you only reach after it dies.

kept.name: Grim Hireling
kept.why: "Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player" is what makes the Treasures; only the effects were recorded, not the trigger.

kept.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
kept.why: "You may activate abilities of creatures you control as though those creatures had haste" is unrecorded, and it is the reason the card is played. Stated as a limitation for whoever reads this: it is haste for activated abilities only, not for attacking, so the word is a fair reading of the text but not the whole truth.

kept.name: Field of Ruin
kept.why: "Each player searches their library for a basic land" affects every player, and the symmetry is the card's defining downside.

kept.name: Sword of Hearth and Home
kept.why: Three unrecorded clauses on a card whose list holds only the tutor half. "+2/+2", "protection from green and from white", and "exile up to one target creature you own, then put both cards onto the battlefield" is a blink, which is the entire reason this Equipment is played.

kept.name: Forsaken Monument
kept.why: "Whenever you tap a permanent for {C}, add an additional {C}" is unrecorded in both halves: the trigger and the mana. That clause is why the card is in colourless decks.

kept.name: Reconnaissance
kept.why: Removing your attacker from combat before damage saves it, and nothing on the card records any effect except the untap.

kept.name: Excalibur, Sword of Eden
kept.why: It is the only Equipment in the batch with no eff:attach, though it has an equip cost. "This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of historic permanents you control" is unrecorded, and that clause is the only reason a twelve-mana card is playable.

kept.name: Buster Sword
kept.why: "draw a card" is missing from the combat damage trigger; only the free cast half was recorded.

kept.name: Myr Battlesphere
kept.why: "you may tap X untapped Myr you control" is a cost paid with other permanents and is unrecorded, as is the "+X/+0" it buys.

kept.name: Caged Sun
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1" is entirely unrecorded; the list holds only the mana half. I left the mana trigger alone: "whenever a land's ability causes you to add mana" is close to trig:tapped-for-mana but not literally a tap, so I did not stretch it.

kept.name: Dusk // Dawn
kept.why: Both halves are gated on power ("power 3 or greater", "power 2 or less") and nothing records it. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: it is a filtered wipe, which the vocabulary keeps apart from a true board wipe.

kept.name: Promise of Loyalty
kept.why: Every player keeps one creature and sacrifices the rest, yours included. It is a mass sacrifice rather than a destroy, but by the word's meaning it clears the whole board both ways, and a go-wide deck playing this is the exact case the word exists to prevent.

kept.name: Ichor Wellspring
kept.why: "When this artifact enters" refers to itself. It carries trig:enters and trig:dies but not the self form.

kept.name: Felidar Sovereign
kept.why: Lifelink is unread here though the convention elsewhere in the batch (Vampire Nighthawk) emits eff:gain-life for it. The win condition checks a life total of 40 or more, so this is a lifegain payoff and cares:lifegain is what makes it findable as one.

kept.name: Blood Money
kept.why: The whole second sentence is unread. It creates a tapped Treasure for each nontoken creature destroyed - a mass wipe that also ramps - and nothing records that it makes tokens at all.

kept.name: Murderous Rider // Swift End
kept.why: Lifelink on the creature half is unread. The 'You lose 2 life' clause has no word that is not a lie about direction.

kept.name: Valgavoth's Lair
kept.why: The only functional line on the card, '{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color', is entirely unread - the list records the hexproof and nothing else, so a mana land looks like a blank permanent.

kept.name: Gingerbrute
kept.why: '{1}: This creature can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste' is the reason this card is played - it is the cheapest evasive equipment carrier in the format - and no facet records the evasion. Deliberately not adding cares:kw:haste: the haste reference is an exception clause, not a haste-matters payoff.

kept.name: Avatar's Wrath
kept.why: Only the self-exile clause was read. Airbending all other creatures exiles the whole board except one, which is a symmetric wipe that hits your own side, and the exiled cards become castable from exile. The final clause stops opponents casting from anywhere but hand, which is a genuine casting restriction.

kept.name: Moonsilver Key
kept.why: The activation is '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact' and the tap half of the cost is unrecorded.

kept.name: Parting Gust
