kept.why: The gift-not-promised half returns the exiled card to the battlefield with a counter, which is a blink, and only the exile half was read. Not adding eff:exile-own: the target is 'nontoken creature' with no controller restriction, so guessing whose it is would be inventing direction the text does not state.

kept.name: Kaldra Compleat
kept.why: The equipped creature gets five keywords and only indestructible is recorded. The granted quoted ability triggers on dealing combat damage to a creature, which is why eff:exile is already present, so the trigger that carries it should be too.

kept.name: The Gaffer
kept.why: The entire condition is 'if you gained 3 or more life this turn' and nothing records that this is a lifegain payoff. Not adding trig:gains-life: it triggers on the end step and checks a condition, it does not trigger on the gain itself.

kept.name: The Eternity Elevator
kept.why: Station is completely unread. It taps another creature you control as a cost and puts charge counters equal to that creature's power on itself, so all three of the cost, the counters and the power reference are missing.

kept.name: Sword of Truth and Justice
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +2/+2 and protection from white and from blue; neither the pump nor the protection grant is recorded, leaving only the counter-and-proliferate trigger. Left cares:color:w alone rather than guessing whether a protection colour counts as caring about it.

kept.name: Smuggler's Share
kept.why: Half the card is unread: it draws a card for each opponent who drew two or more cards this turn. Only the Treasure half was recorded, so one of the best white draw engines in the format carries no draw word.

kept.name: Adagia, Windswept Bastion
kept.why: Two whole abilities are unread. Station taps another creature you control for charge counters equal to its power, and the 12+ ability creates a token copy of an artifact or enchantment you control.

kept.name: Woe Strider
kept.why: The escape cost is 'Exile four other cards from your graveyard' and the exile half of that cost is unrecorded. Not adding eff:exile-graveyard: that word is graveyard hate aimed at opponents, and this is paying with your own.

kept.name: Metalwork Colossus
kept.why: Both of the card's abilities are unread as verbs. It costs {X} less for the mana value of your noncreature artifacts, and the sacrifice ability returns this card from your graveyard to your hand - which is exactly what eff:recur-self names.

kept.name: Massacre Girl
kept.why: The second sentence, 'Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than Massacre Girl gets -1/-1', is the clause that makes this a cascading wipe rather than a one-shot -1/-1, and its dies trigger is unrecorded.

kept.name: Oversold Cemetery
kept.why: eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand, which is a blink or re-buy enabler. This returns a creature CARD from the graveyard to hand - recursion, already correctly covered by eff:return-from. As written it would offer this enchantment to a deck looking for Whitemane Lion effects.

kept.name: Spirit Mantle
kept.why: The aura gives +1/+1 and the pump is unrecorded; only the protection and the resulting unblockability were read.

kept.name: Extraplanar Lens
kept.why: This is one of the strongest ramp artifacts in mono-coloured Commander and no facet says it produces mana. The whole second ability - a trigger on a land being tapped for mana that adds another mana - is unread.

kept.name: Lively Dirge
kept.why: The first Spree mode searches your library and puts the card into your graveyard, which is a library-to-graveyard move and was unrecorded (eff:search-library alone reads as a tutor to hand or battlefield). Spree itself is modal, so the card lets you choose what it does.

kept.name: Stridehangar Automaton
kept.why: The replacement effect creates an additional 1/1 Thopter whenever artifact tokens are created under your control; nothing records that this card makes tokens. Not adding eff:multiply: it adds one extra token rather than doubling.

kept.name: Twinning Staff
kept.why: The activated ability's {T} is unrecorded, and the static ability - copying a spell an additional time whenever you would copy it - is a genuine multiplier, which is the half of the card that is actually played.

kept.name: Lithoform Engine
kept.why: The entire card is copying and it carries no eff:copy at all - three abilities, all of them copies, and the tap in each cost is unrecorded too. The first ability copies a targeted triggered ability you control, which is precisely making one of your triggers happen twice.

kept.name: Dread Presence
kept.why: Modal "choose one —" with two bullets; nothing recorded that the card offers a choice.

kept.name: Gauntlet of Power
kept.why: Two of its three lines were unread: "Creatures of the chosen color get +1/+1" is a global pump, and the mana doubling is a trigger on a basic land being tapped for mana.

kept.name: Spine of Ish Sah
kept.why: "When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand" is the card bringing itself back from the graveyard, which is the whole reason it is played.

kept.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
kept.why: The tax is a static applying to every creature that would attack you, not a targeted effect.

kept.name: Witch of the Moors
kept.why: "Each opponent sacrifices" is a mass effect, and the recursion returns a card to your hand.

kept.name: Virtue of Loyalty // Ardenvale Fealty
kept.why: The entire Adventure half, "Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token", was unread. tok:knight is printed and left alone.

kept.name: Puppeteer Clique
kept.why: "It gains haste" and "at the beginning of your next end step, exile it" were both unread, and persist returns the creature itself from the graveyard.

kept.name: Yawgmoth's Will
kept.why: The card returns nothing. It grants permission to cast spells and play lands from the graveyard, and replaces graveyard-bound cards with exile. Both permissions have exact words in the vocabulary; eff:return-from is false and would file it as a reanimation spell.

kept.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
kept.why: Her only non-keyword ability exiles herself (and Bruna) to meld; nothing recorded that the card leaves the battlefield on its own.

kept.name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
kept.why: The shutdown applies to every creature every opponent controls, not to a target.

kept.name: Ajani's Pridemate
kept.why: It is the archetypal lifegain payoff; trig:gains-life records the timing but nothing records that the card belongs in a lifegain deck. Witch of the Moors in this same batch carries cares:lifegain for a weaker version of the same clause.

kept.name: Brass Squire
kept.why: Its only ability costs {T} and that was not recorded.

kept.name: Ghirapur Orrery
kept.why: The second half, "that player draws three cards", was unread, and both abilities apply to each player.

kept.name: The Immortal Sun
kept.why: Two of its four lines were unread: the extra card each draw step, and "Players can't activate planeswalkers' loyalty abilities".

kept.name: Burglar Rat
kept.why: "Each opponent discards" hits every opponent, and the discard is from hand.

kept.name: Final Parting
kept.why: It searches the library and puts one of the two cards into your hand; only the graveyard destination was recorded.

kept.name: Kabira Takedown // Kabira Plateau
kept.why: The entire land half, "{T}: Add {W}", was unread, so the card reads as a spell that produces no mana.

kept.name: Angelic Destiny
kept.why: The aura grants flying and first strike, neither recorded, and it returns itself from the graveyard to hand when the creature dies.

kept.name: Will of the Abzan
kept.why: It is modal ("Choose one", both with a commander), and the sacrifice is keyed on the greatest power among that player's creatures.

kept.name: Thornbite Staff
kept.why: The granted second ability, "Whenever a creature dies, untap this creature", is the reason the card exists and its trigger was unread.

kept.name: Cunning Rhetoric
kept.why: It exiles the top card of the attacker's library and lets you play it, which is exactly impulse. It puts nothing in a graveyard, so eff:mill is false and would offer it as a mill payoff.

kept.name: Ghoulish Impetus
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread: +1/+1, deathtouch, the goad itself, and the return of the aura to the battlefield from the graveyard when the creature dies.

kept.name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
kept.why: "Each opponent loses life" is a mass drain, not a targeted one.

kept.name: Cursed Totem
kept.why: It shuts off activated abilities of every creature on the battlefield, including yours.

kept.name: Valorous Stance
kept.why: Modal, and the first mode is a protection trick, which nothing recorded. It changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong and would file a removal/protection instant as a pump spell.

kept.name: Cloudstone Curio
kept.why: The bounce returns your permanent to its owner's hand.

kept.name: Black Mage's Rod
kept.why: Job select creates a Hero token when the Equipment enters, and the granted ability triggers whenever YOU cast a noncreature spell and damages each opponent. None of that was recorded, so a card that makes a body and pings the table read as a bare Equipment.

kept.name: Scholar of New Horizons
kept.why: The activation cost is {T} plus removing a counter from a permanent you control, neither recorded; the card can also land in hand and the ability shuffles.

kept.name: Heroes' Podium
kept.why: It looks at the top X and puts a legendary creature into your HAND, putting the rest on the bottom. Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top, so eff:impulse and cares:zone:exile are both false; eff:look-and-pick already says what it does correctly.

kept.name: Adaptive Automaton
kept.why: "Other creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is a mass static pump and neither the pump nor its scope was written down. Same shape as Lyra Dawnbringer, which carries both.

kept.name: Renewed Solidarity
kept.why: Three clauses, one recorded. "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+0" is a mass pump (eff:pump, scope:all), and the end step clause makes "a token that's a copy of it", which is eff:copy, not merely eff:create-token.

kept.name: Supernatural Stamina
kept.why: "Target creature gets +2/+0" is half the card and was missing; only the granted death trigger was read.

kept.name: Battle Angels of Tyr
kept.why: The combat damage trigger draws a card, makes a Treasure and gains 3 life. Only the token half was recorded; the draw and the lifegain were dropped.

kept.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
kept.why: "{4}, {T}: Transform Matzalantli" is an actual activated effect that flips the permanent, and eff:transform exists for exactly that. kw:transform only records that the card is printed as a transforming card.

kept.name: Dazzling Theater // Prop Room
kept.why: "Untap each creature you control during each other player's untap step" affects the whole board and had no scope word; the front half is unread entirely.

kept.name: Charming Prince
kept.why: The third mode exiles a creature you own and returns it at the next end step. That is a blink, and the card is one of the format's canonical blink creatures, yet only scry and lifegain were recorded. Without these three it can never be reached by a blink plan.

kept.name: Collector's Vault
kept.why: Every activation makes a Treasure, which is a mana source. Treasure makers carrying no mana facet is a known systematic gap, and Teval's Judgment in this same batch already carries eff:add-mana for the same token.

kept.name: Ugin, Eye of the Storms
kept.why: The -11 searches the library and then lets you cast the exiled cards without paying their mana costs. Neither the search nor the free casting was recorded, so the ultimate reads as an exile effect only.

kept.name: Get Lost
kept.why: The card puts no counters on anything. The word comes from the explore reminder text inside the Map token's ability, and those Maps go to the OPPONENT. Carrying it files a white removal spell as a +1/+1 counters card.

kept.name: The Eternal Wanderer
kept.why: The +1 exiles a permanent and returns it to the battlefield, which is a blink and is why this card is played; only the exile half was recorded. The -4 makes every player sacrifice all creatures but one, which is a board-wide effect. Left scope:wipe off deliberately: it is a sacrifice, not a destroy, and each player keeps a creature.

kept.name: Sage's Reverie
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature", so it attaches to a creature. The attach word was missing although the pump it confers depends on being attached.

kept.name: Contagion Engine
kept.why: Only proliferate was read. The enters trigger puts a -1/-1 counter on EACH creature a player controls, which is a counter effect, a mass shrink and board-wide, and the activated ability includes {T} in its cost.

kept.name: Razorgrass Ambush // Razorgrass Field
kept.why: The land half is entirely unread: "{T}: Add {W}" is a tap for mana. Only the instant half's damage was recorded.

kept.name: Orim's Chant
kept.why: "Creatures can't attack this turn" is every creature, not a target, and the card had no scope word.

kept.name: Drivnod, Carnage Dominus
kept.why: His whole first ability is conditioned on a creature dying causing a triggered ability to trigger. He is a death-trigger payoff commander and nothing in his list said so, so no aristocrats plan can key off him. Judgement call: it is a replacement over death triggers rather than a death trigger itself, but the card is about creatures dying and no other word says that.

kept.name: Bloodline Pretender
kept.why: "Whenever another creature you control of the chosen type enters" is a real enters trigger on another permanent, and the card carried no trigger word at all.

kept.name: Emrakul, the Promised End
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each card type among cards in your graveyard" is the reason the card is playable and eff:reduce-cost exists for exactly it. Nothing recorded the discount.

kept.name: Abstergo Entertainment
kept.why: The whole third ability was unread. It exiles itself as a cost, returns a historic card from your graveyard to hand, then exiles ALL graveyards - a real piece of symmetric graveyard hate the list said nothing about.

kept.name: Liliana, Death's Majesty
kept.why: The -7 destroys all non-Zombie creatures, which takes your own board too. eff:destroy plus scope:all does not say 'this is a sweeper'.

kept.name: Everybody Lives!
kept.why: Mass hexproof and indestructible for one turn is the definition of keeping your creatures alive; it is a fog/protection trick, not just a pump.

kept.name: Hagra Mauling // Hagra Broodpit
kept.why: The land half was entirely unread - '{T}: Add {B}' is a mana source and the card is played as a land as often as as removal. Did not add eff:reduce-cost: the discount applies only to itself, so it is not a cost-reduction payoff.

kept.name: Sudden Spoiling
kept.why: 'base power and toughness 0/2' is a set, not just a neutralise, and it hits every creature one player controls rather than a single target.

kept.name: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor
kept.why: The draw trigger is on YOUR cast, of an ENCHANTMENT spell (an Aura), that TARGETS something. The bare trig:cast said none of the three.

kept.name: Skrelv's Hive
kept.why: The corrupted clause gives your toxic creatures lifelink and nothing recorded it. Deliberately did not add eff:lose-life: the 1 life is a cost you pay yourself, and tagging it would read as a drain payoff.

kept.name: Karn, the Great Creator
kept.why: Only the -2 was read. The static shuts off every activated ability of opponents' artifacts - the reason this card is played - and the +1 animates a noncreature artifact and sets its power and toughness to its mana value. Loyalty costs were missing on both abilities.

kept.name: Grafdigger's Cage
kept.why: 'Players can't cast spells from graveyards or libraries' is the card's main clause and nothing recorded it. Left eff:exile-graveyard in place even though the Cage exiles nothing: it is the only word carrying the graveyard-hate signal, and removing it would make the engine willing to put the Cage in a graveyard deck. See the proposed word.

kept.name: Angel of Vitality
kept.why: Its whole card is about life gain - it replaces every life-gain event and checks your life total - and no word said so. Did not add eff:gain-life: it never gains life on its own, it modifies gains other cards cause.

kept.name: Ruthless Technomancer
kept.why: It makes a pile of Treasure tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power and neither the token-making nor the mana those Treasures produce was recorded. The Treasures are yours, so this genuinely is acceleration.

kept.name: Illustrious Wanderglyph
kept.why: 'Other artifact creatures you control get +2/+2' is an anthem and nothing recorded any pump at all - only the Gnome token was read.

kept.name: Liesa, Forgotten Archangel
kept.why: Printed lifelink, which every other lifelink creature in this batch carries as eff:gain-life. Did NOT add eff:exile for the replacement clause: it exiles opponents' dying creatures, which is graveyard hate rather than removal, and eff:exile would file her as an answer she is not.

kept.name: Archon of Emeria
kept.why: 'Each player can't cast more than one spell each turn' is the reason this card exists and nothing recorded it. Left eff:tap alone - the nonbasic clause is a stretch for that word but it is the only thing pointing at the land tax.

kept.name: Flicker of Fate
kept.why: This is a blink spell - exile and return to the battlefield - and the blink word was missing. Yes, it can be pointed at an opponent's permanent, but it is played to re-use your own arrivals.

kept.name: Semblance Anvil
kept.why: The imprint exiles a card from your hand and the discount then keys off that exiled card; neither zone was recorded. Did not add eff:exile - exiling your own hand card as setup is not removal and the word would file it as such.

kept.name: Cityscape Leveler
kept.why: The Powerstone is created by the destroyed permanent's CONTROLLER, which is an opponent. Tagging this as a mana source makes an eight-mana beater read as ramp - the same fault as An Offer You Can't Refuse. For the same reason I did not add eff:create-token: the token is theirs, not yours.

kept.name: Diregraf Colossus
kept.why: A Zombie spell is a creature spell, so the token trigger is a creature-cast trigger and the plain trig:cast could not say which kind.

kept.name: Primal Amulet // Primal Wellspring
kept.why: The back face's mana ability needed cost:tap; the front face transforms itself once four charge counters are on it; and 'when that mana is spent to cast an instant or sorcery' is exactly a mana-spent condition, which is how the copy is earned.

kept.name: Horn of Greed
kept.why: The trigger is another permanent (a land) entering, not this artifact; bare trig:enters reads as its own arrival, which is how landfall cards like Emeria Shepherd are already recorded.

kept.name: Liliana of the Dark Realms
kept.why: Only the +1 was read. The -3 both pumps and shrinks depending on your choice, the -6 emblem turns every Swamp into a four-mana source, the minus abilities cost loyalty, and the tutor is specifically for a land.

kept.name: Kozilek's Command
kept.why: Two of the four modes were unread: it makes X Eldrazi Spawn tokens that sacrifice for mana, and it exiles up to X cards from graveyards, which is graveyard hate rather than the generic eff:exile already listed for the creature mode.

kept.name: Erode
kept.why: The basic-land search is done by the destroyed permanent's CONTROLLER as compensation - it ramps your opponent. As written, a one-mana removal spell reads as a land tutor and would be offered as ramp. Same error class as An Offer You Can't Refuse.

kept.name: Rise of the Eldrazi
kept.why: 'Take an extra turn after this one' and 'This spell can't be countered' are two of the four things a twelve-mana sorcery does and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Font of Mythos
kept.why: The card had a trigger and no effect at all. It makes every player draw two extra cards each turn, which is the single most important thing about it.

kept.name: Aura of Silence
kept.why: The tax half - opponents' artifact and enchantment spells cost {2} more - was entirely unread; only the sacrifice destroy was.

kept.name: Swarmyard Massacre
kept.why: The card gives -1/-1, never +1/+1. As written it reads as an anthem when it is a one-sided sweeper. Deliberately did NOT add scope:wipe: it spares Insects, Rats, Spiders and Squirrels, so it is a filtered wipe your own board survives.

kept.name: Touch the Spirit Realm
kept.why: Both halves exile a permanent and nothing recorded it - the enters trigger is an Oblivion Ring exile, and Channel exiles then returns it at the next end step. Channel's cost is discarding this card.

kept.name: Elenda's Hierophant
kept.why: The whole death trigger was unread: it creates X 1/1 Vampire tokens. The list had the counter half and the lifegain trigger and nothing about the bodies.

kept.name: Sword of Forge and Frontier
kept.why: The equip bonus clause was skipped entirely - +2/+2 is a pump and protection from red and from green is a granted keyword. Only the combat-damage trigger had been read.

kept.name: Lazotep Quarry
kept.why: The third ability creates a token that's a copy of an exiled creature card; nothing said it copies. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile-graveyard - it exiles from YOUR graveyard to reanimate, so tagging it as graveyard hate would make graveyard decks refuse a card built for them.

kept.name: Susur Secundi, Void Altar
kept.why: The 12+ ability's costs were all unread: sacrifice a creature, pay 2 life. Station is a cost that taps another creature you control.

kept.name: The Aetherspark
kept.why: It is an Equipment whose +1 attaches it to a creature, and it carries a granted combat-damage trigger. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Bronze Guardian
kept.why: Giving your other artifacts ward 2 keeps them alive and nothing in the list said so. The granted keyword itself has no word - proposed.

kept.name: Aven Interrupter
kept.why: Two clauses unread: it exiles a spell off the stack, and it taxes opponents' spells cast from graveyards or exile by {2}. The list held only the keywords and the enters trigger.

kept.name: Terrain Generator
kept.why: It puts a basic land from your hand straight onto the battlefield, which is exactly what that word means. eff:extra-land-drop alone describes a different action.

kept.name: Smuggler's Copter
kept.why: Crew is a cost paid by tapping other creatures you control, and nothing recorded the cost.

kept.name: Mutavault
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. {1} turns the land into a 2/2 creature - that is an animation - and it has all creature types, which is what makes it a land every tribal deck plays.

kept.name: Wedding Ring
kept.why: Two of its three abilities were entirely unread. It draws you a card whenever that opponent draws and gains you life whenever they gain life, and the enters trigger makes a token copy for them.

kept.name: Halo Fountain
kept.why: Nothing on this card makes anybody lose - the third ability says you win, which eff:win-game already covers, so eff:lose-game is wrong. All three abilities carry {T} and the tap cost was missing.

kept.name: Gift of Immortality
kept.why: Everything the card does was missing - it had only the trigger. It returns the dead creature from the graveyard to the battlefield, returns ITSELF from the graveyard attached to it, and that loop is how it keeps a creature alive.

kept.name: Loran's Escape
kept.why: Nothing on this card changes power or toughness; it grants hexproof and indestructible, which is a protection trick. Left as a pump it competes for slots against auras that make a creature bigger, which is a different job.

kept.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
kept.why: The trigger is on spells YOU cast, and only the undirected trig:cast was recorded.

kept.name: Hazoret's Monument
kept.why: The cost reduction applies only to RED creature spells, which is the one thing that decides whether this monument belongs in a deck. The colour was not recorded.

kept.name: Drumbellower
kept.why: It untaps ALL creatures you control, on every other player's untap step. The list said it untaps without saying it is a mass effect.

kept.name: Tree of Perdition
kept.why: The whole ability was unread. Exchanging an opponent's life total with its toughness sets their life, and the ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
kept.why: Setting base toughness to 1 on every creature your opponents control both sets power/toughness and shrinks them, and it is a mass effect. Only the vaguer eff:neutralise was there.

kept.name: Guardian of Faith
kept.why: Phasing out your other creatures in response to a board wipe is the whole card, and nothing in the list said it does anything at all beyond entering.

kept.name: Black Sun's Zenith
kept.why: X -1/-1 counters on EACH creature makes creatures smaller and sweeps the board symmetrically, yours included. Recorded as a plain counter effect it read as a counters card rather than a sweeper.

kept.name: Tempt with Bunnies
kept.why: Half the card was unread - it makes 1/1 Rabbit tokens on both sides of the offer. Only the draw was recorded.

kept.name: Sheoldred // The True Scriptures
kept.why: Chapter II mills three, chapter III puts ALL creature cards from ALL graveyards onto the battlefield under YOUR control - mass reanimation that steals opponents' creatures - and the front face's activated ability transforms it. None of that was recorded.

kept.name: Virtue of Persistence // Locthwain Scorn
kept.why: The Adventure half was unread: -3/-3 is a shrink and the only removal on the card. The enchantment reanimates from ANY graveyard under your control, the same wording that carries eff:gain-control on The Eldest Reborn.

kept.name: Mikaeus, the Lunarch
kept.why: The second ability pays by removing a +1/+1 counter, which was not recorded, and it puts a counter on EACH other creature you control - a mass effect, not a single target.

kept.name: Duplicant
kept.why: The imprint clause sets its own power, toughness and creature types from the exiled card, which is eff:set-pt and nothing recorded it. It also reads the exile zone continuously.

kept.name: Glasswing Grace // Age-Graced Chapel
kept.why: The entire land back face was unread: '{T}: Add {W} or {B}' is a mana source and neither the tap cost nor the mana was recorded.

kept.name: Rottenmouth Viper
kept.why: The whole first paragraph was unread: sacrificing nonland permanents is an additional cast cost that reduces its own cost. The blight trigger is a punisher aimed at each opponent, who must sacrifice or discard or lose life.

kept.name: Maze's End
kept.why: It literally wins the game with ten Gates and nothing said so. Returning itself to hand is part of the activation cost.

kept.name: Angel of Destiny
kept.why: Both of its abilities were unread. The combat damage trigger gains life for you and the damaged player, the end step ability makes players lose the game, and the damage trigger watches every creature you control.

kept.name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal
kept.why: Hero's Sundering transforms it, and the back face's Blessing of Light is a beginning of combat trigger. No step trigger was recorded at all.

kept.name: Umezawa's Jitte
kept.why: All three modes were missing: +2/+2 is a pump, -1/-1 is a shrink, and it gains 2 life. Removing a charge counter is the activation cost.

kept.name: Pariah
kept.why: Damage to you is dealt to the enchanted creature instead, which is a redirection rather than only a prevention. eff:prevent-damage alone loses the defining half of the card.

kept.name: Sanctum of Ugin
kept.why: The whole triggered half was unread: it triggers on you casting a big colourless spell, sacrifices itself as the cost, and searches your library.

kept.name: The Chain Veil
kept.why: The activated ability is '{4}, {T}' and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Athreos, God of Passage
kept.why: 'unless target opponent pays 3 life' is the taxing clause the card is built on, and the death trigger watches every creature you own.

kept.name: Storm Herd
kept.why: The card's only effect is creating X Pegasus tokens and eff:create-token was absent, so nothing recorded that it makes tokens at all.

kept.name: Crystalline Crawler
kept.why: Removing a +1/+1 counter is the cost of its mana ability, and Converge means it cares how many colours of mana were spent to cast it.

kept.name: Nykthos Paragon
kept.why: It puts counters on each creature you control, which is a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Beacon of Immortality
kept.why: It shuffles itself back into its owner's library, which is the whole reason the Beacon cycle is repeatable and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Wrecking Ball Arm
kept.why: It sets the equipped creature's base power and toughness to 7/7, which is a set rather than a pump, and its evasion clause reads creatures' power.

kept.name: Crossroads Village
kept.why: Nothing at all was read from this land. It chooses a colour as it enters and taps for that colour, so it is a mana source and none of the three clauses were recorded.

kept.name: Dragonstorm Globe
kept.why: The counter replacement applies to each Dragon you control rather than to one creature.

kept.name: Syr Ginger, the Meal Ender
kept.why: The lifegain ability costs '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice Syr Ginger' and neither the tap nor the self sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Hall of the Bandit Lord
kept.why: Mana from this land gives a creature spell haste, which is the only reason to play it over a basic and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Citadel Gate
kept.why: The mana ability was entirely unread; it taps for white or the chosen colour.

kept.name: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward
kept.why: The enters trigger was recorded with no effects. It blinks your own nonland permanents until it leaves, which is eff:exile-own plus a leaves trigger, and it makes a Soldier token per permanent exiled.

kept.name: Meathook Massacre II
kept.why: Three of its four clauses were half read. It makes each player sacrifice X creatures on entry, it takes opponents' dying creatures under your control unless they pay 3 life, and the returned cards come back with a finality counter.

kept.name: Eldrazi Displacer
kept.why: Exiling a creature and returning it to the battlefield is a blink, and it can target your own creature, which is the use the card is played for. eff:exile alone reads it as removal.

kept.name: Robe of Stars
kept.why: Astral Projection phases the equipped creature out, which nothing recorded, and phasing out in response to removal is what keeps the creature alive.

kept.name: Surge of Salvation
kept.why: It is a protection spell for your board and carried no protective effect word. It also names black as well as red sources, and only red was recorded.

kept.name: Library of Leng
kept.why: A discarded card may go on top of your library instead of the graveyard, so the library is a zone this card reads and acts on.

kept.name: Treasure Map // Treasure Cove
kept.why: Only the scry was read. The front face removes its landmark counters, transforms and creates three Treasures, and the entire Treasure Cove back face taps for mana and sacrifices a Treasure to draw a card.

kept.name: Giggling Skitterspike
kept.why: The trigger is "attacks, blocks, or becomes the target of a spell" and only the attack half was recorded. Monstrosity 5 puts five +1/+1 counters on itself, which nothing said.

kept.name: Sepulchral Primordial
kept.why: It reanimates creatures out of every OPPONENT'S graveyard under YOUR control. eff:return-from alone reads as self-recursion; taking an opponent's card is stealing.

kept.name: Dragonfire Blade
kept.why: An Equipment with an equip cost that gives +2/+2, and neither the attaching nor the pump was written down. Every other Equipment in this batch carries eff:attach.

kept.name: Archangel of Tithes
kept.why: It stops creatures attacking and stops creatures blocking (both taxed), across all opponents' creatures, and neither restriction was recorded. trig:attacks is wrong: "as long as this creature is attacking" is a static condition, not a triggered ability, and leaving it files a pillowfort Angel as an attack-trigger payoff.

kept.name: Ondu Inversion // Ondu Skyruins
kept.why: The back face is a land that taps for {W} and nothing recorded that it makes mana at all. The front destroys all nonland permanents including your own, which is a wipe, and the front face costs {5}{W}{W}.

kept.name: Merciless Executioner
kept.why: The card's entire text is an edict and there was no sacrifice word on it. "Each player" makes it symmetric.

kept.name: Aerith Gainsborough
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life" is the engine on this card. Nothing said she was a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Brainstealer Dragon
kept.why: The whole first ability was unread: it exiles the top of each opponent's library and lets you play those cards, which is exile-to-play off a library. The second ability triggers on a permanent entering under your control, which is a second trigger nothing recorded.

kept.name: Deep Gnome Terramancer
kept.why: The trigger is other players' lands entering, not its own arrival; only the bare trig:enters was there.

kept.name: Multiversal Passage
kept.why: The list held nothing but type:land. The card chooses a basic land type on entry and offers to pay 2 life to come in untapped.

kept.name: Sword of Wealth and Power
kept.why: +2/+2 and protection from instants and sorceries are the static half of the card and neither was written down.

kept.name: Final Showdown
kept.why: The third mode destroys all creatures, yours included. scope:all was there; the wipe was not.

kept.name: Starfield of Nyx
kept.why: Half the card turns every other non-Aura enchantment you control into a creature with base power and toughness equal to its mana value, and none of that was recorded.

kept.name: Glacial Chasm
kept.why: Its two defining lines were both missing: it prevents all damage dealt to you and stops your own creatures attacking. Cumulative upkeep is paid in life.

kept.name: Sword of Light and Shadow
kept.why: +2/+2 and protection from white and from black were not recorded, same gap as the other Swords.

kept.name: Demon's Disciple
kept.why: An edict with no sacrifice word on it. "Each player" is symmetric.

kept.name: Summon: Knights of Round
kept.why: Chapter V puts an indestructible counter on each other creature you control; only the temporary pump and the keyword grant were recorded.

kept.name: Stuffy Doll
kept.why: It only carried eff:damage-self. The point of the card is that it deals that damage on to the chosen player, which is real damage to an opponent.

kept.name: Explorer's Scope
kept.why: The attack trigger looks at the top of your library and puts a land onto the battlefield. The list recorded the equipping and nothing the card actually does; this is a ramp equipment and read as a blank one.

kept.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
kept.why: Nothing said it attaches, nothing said +2/+0, and nothing said it goads. The whole card was unread apart from its type line.

kept.name: Flickerwisp
kept.why: "Exile another target permanent, return it at the next end step" is a blink and may be aimed at your own permanent, which is how the card is played. eff:exile alone reads as removal.

kept.name: Bubbling Muck
kept.why: The trigger is a player tapping a Swamp for mana, and the effect is an extra {B} on top of it, which is doubling that mana rather than a plain mana ability.

kept.name: Agent of the Iron Throne
kept.why: The granted trigger is permanents being put into a graveyard from the battlefield; the graveyard zone was not recorded.

kept.name: Thrumming Stone
kept.why: Ripple triggers whenever you cast a spell and reveals the top four of your library; only the free cast was recorded.

kept.name: Dance of the Dead
kept.why: Only the reanimation was read. It attaches itself to the creature it returned, gives +1/+1, sacrifices that creature when the Aura leaves, and has an upkeep trigger for the untap payment.

kept.name: Tome of Legends
kept.why: "Whenever your commander enters or attacks" is two triggers and neither was recorded, so the card that fills itself up read as having no trigger at all.

kept.name: Blacksmith's Skill
kept.why: Hexproof plus indestructible at instant speed is a protection spell; the grants were there but nothing said the card keeps a permanent alive.

kept.name: Grafted Exoskeleton
kept.why: The unattach clause sacrifices the permanent and nothing recorded that the card sacrifices anything.

kept.name: Mind's Eye
kept.why: A five-mana card-draw artifact whose list had no draw word at all, only the trigger. The draw is gated on paying {1}.

kept.name: Umbral Mantle
kept.why: {Q} is the untap symbol paid as a cost, which is what makes this an untapper for mana creatures. Only the resulting untap was recorded, never that untapping is the cost.

kept.name: Riot Control
kept.why: Half the card prevents all damage that would be dealt to you this turn, and only the lifegain was recorded.

kept.name: Oblivion Sower
kept.why: The opponent's cards go to EXILE, not to a graveyard, so eff:mill is wrong and would offer this to a graveyard deck. The exiling itself was never recorded.

kept.name: Force of Despair
kept.why: The free-cast clause 'exile a black card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost' is an alternative casting cost and was unread. The destroy hits every creature that entered this turn, on all sides, so it is a mass effect (not scope:wipe - it is restricted to creatures that entered this turn, the same reason a filtered wipe is refused).

kept.name: God-Eternal Oketra
kept.why: The whole third ability - 'put it into its owner's library third from the top' - produced no effect word. The triggers were read (trig:dies, trig:leaves-self) but not what actually happens, which is a battlefield-to-library move. This is the reason the God-Eternal cycle is hard to kill and nothing in the list said so.

kept.name: Dollmaker's Shop // Porcelain Gallery
kept.why: 'Creatures you control have base power and toughness each equal to the number of creatures you control' is a static that rewrites every creature you control. eff:set-pt was read, the fact that it is a mass effect was not.

kept.name: Disciple of the Vault
kept.why: The trigger is 'whenever an artifact is put into a GRAVEYARD from the battlefield'. The graveyard is named in the trigger condition and was missing.

kept.name: Bruna, the Fading Light
kept.why: 'When you cast this spell' is a cast trigger on your own cast. trig:cast was recorded but the direction was not, so nothing distinguished this from a trigger on an opponent casting.

kept.name: Ancient Cellarspawn
kept.why: 'if the amount of mana spent to cast it was less than its mana value' is precisely what cares:mana-spent names, and it is the whole condition of the drain half of the card. Without it nothing records that this card cares how much you actually paid, which is the entire reason it is paired with its own cost reduction.

kept.name: Forsaken Miner
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' produced nothing at all. And 'you may pay {B}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard' is a pay-to-get-more clause; the recursion was read but not the fact that it is optional and costed.

kept.name: Aetheric Amplifier
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read; the entire second ability produced nothing. 'Choose one' is a mode choice, 'Double the number of each kind of counter on target permanent' both multiplies and results in counters being added, and 'Double the number of each kind of counter you have' is counters on a PLAYER (poison, energy, experience), which is a different thing from counters on a permanent.

kept.name: Darksteel Colossus
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever. Its third line - 'If it would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal it and shuffle it into its owner's library instead' - is a replacement that names the graveyard, moves the card to the library and shuffles. That clause is the card's defining trait and was entirely unread.

kept.name: Crib Swap
kept.why: 'Its controller creates a 1/1 colorless Shapeshifter creature token' was unread. The exile was recorded and the compensation the removal gives back was not, which understates the cost of the card.

kept.name: Nine-Lives Familiar
kept.why: The list held trig:dies and NOTHING else - the card's entire point, that it returns itself from the graveyard eight times, was unrecorded. It also enters with counters on itself, and the return is a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step.

kept.name: Weatherlight
kept.why: 'look at the top five cards of your library' - the digging is read as eff:look-and-pick but the zone it digs in was not recorded.

kept.name: Emrakul, the World Anew
kept.why: 'When you cast this spell, gain control of ALL creatures target player controls' produced no effect word and no trigger. That clause is the reason the card is played; only the downside (sacrifice all creatures when it leaves) had been read, so the list described a drawback with no payoff.

kept.name: Unquestioned Authority
kept.why: An Aura with 'Enchant creature' attaches to a creature, and 'Enchanted creature has protection from creatures' is a genuine keyword grant. The engine inferred eff:cant-be-blocked from the protection but never recorded the protection itself, so nothing knows this keeps a creature alive.

kept.name: Kozilek, the Broken Reality
kept.why: 'When you cast this spell' is a cast trigger and neither trigger word was present. The manifest is from players' HANDS, which is the zone the ability operates on.

kept.name: Accursed Duneyard
kept.why: Regenerating a creature keeps it alive through a destroy effect. kw:regenerate was recorded as a printed word but nothing said the card protects anything, so the only ability it has beyond tapping for colourless was invisible to any question about keeping creatures alive.

kept.name: Skyclave Relic
kept.why: 'create two tapped tokens that are copies of this artifact' was read as eff:copy but not as token creation - this card makes three mana rocks, not one, and nothing said so. Kicker paying for the extra copies is the pay-more-get-more shape.

kept.name: Selfless Squire
kept.why: 'prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn' produced nothing. That is the whole reason the card is played - it is a fog for your face - and only the counters it collects afterwards were recorded.

kept.name: Court of Ambition
kept.why: 'each opponent loses 3 life UNLESS they discard a card' is a tax with a choice, not a flat drain plus a flat discard. The two halves were recorded separately with nothing saying the opponent picks one.

kept.name: Gonti, Night Minister
kept.why: 'exiles it face down. They may play that card for as long as it remains exiled' is exactly impulse draw off the top of a library. The zones were recorded but the effect was not, so the card could not be reached by anything asking for exile-and-play. Deliberately NOT adding a bare eff:exile: nothing here answers a threat and that word would file it as removal.

kept.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
kept.why: The ability is '{B}, {T}, Sacrifice another creature'. The sacrifice was recorded and the tap was not, so nothing knows the ability is once per turn without an untapper.

kept.name: Envoy of the Ancestors
kept.why: Outlast is '{W}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature'. The counter was read, the tap in its cost was not.

kept.name: Grave Researcher // Reanimate
kept.why: 'You lose life equal to that card's mana value' on the Reanimate half was unread - the reanimation was recorded with none of its price.

kept.name: Black Dragon Gate
kept.why: '{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color' produced NO effect word at all. A land whose only function is producing mana was recorded as producing none.

kept.name: Karn, Legacy Reforged
kept.why: 'Karn's power and toughness are each equal to the greatest mana value among artifacts you control' is a characteristic-setting static and was unread. It is half the card.

kept.name: Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage
kept.why: '{B}: Transform this creature' produced no effect (kw:transform is only the printed marker). The whole back face was unread: 'Other Vampire creatures you control get +2/+2' is a mass anthem, which is the payoff the front face is building toward.

kept.name: Temple of the Dragon Queen
kept.why: '{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color' produced no effect word. Only eff:choose was recorded, so a land was described as choosing a colour and never producing mana.

kept.name: Mari, the Killing Quill
kept.why: Only the token half of the granted ability was read. Mari exiles opponents' dying creatures, grants deathtouch to three creature types, and the ability she grants triggers on combat damage and draws a card. Using eff:exile rather than eff:exile-graveyard on purpose: it hits only creatures an OPPONENT controls as they die, so it is asymmetric removal, not graveyard hate that would work against a graveyard deck's own plan.

kept.name: The Regalia
kept.why: The card carried no effect or zone word - only the attack trigger. 'reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a LAND card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped' is land ramp out of the library, which is the only thing this Vehicle does.

kept.name: Armored Skyhunter
kept.why: 'look at the top six cards of your library' - the dig and the attach were recorded, the library was not.

kept.name: Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal // Temple of the Dead
kept.why: Four separate clauses were unread. 'For each opponent who can't, you draw a card'; 'When Aclazotz dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed' is self-recursion from the graveyard and is why the card is a resilient commander; the land face's '{T}: Add {B}' produced no mana word; and both faces transform. Lifelink also gains life - the same reading Envoy of the Ancestors already gets from granting it.

kept.name: Tinybones, the Pickpocket
kept.why: 'you may cast target nonland permanent card from that player's graveyard' is casting from a graveyard, not returning a card. eff:return-from is left in place as a reasonable approximation, but the precise word existed and was missing.

kept.name: Prized Statue
kept.why: The whole card is "create a Treasure token" and eff:create-token is absent. The enter trigger is on itself, so trig:enters-self belongs beside trig:enters.

kept.name: Chthonian Nightmare
kept.why: The activation cost is Sacrifice a creature (an on-demand outlet, not itself) and Return this enchantment to its owner's hand. Neither cost was recorded, so an aristocrats deck cannot see it as a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Hazel's Brewmaster
kept.why: It exiles a card from a graveyard (graveyard interaction) and its third line reads the creature cards exiled with it, which is exile-zone interaction. Neither zone was recorded.

kept.name: Rev, Tithe Extractor
kept.why: eff:create-token is present but the Treasure's own reminder text (add one mana of any color) supports eff:add-mana, as recorded on Prized Statue and Summon: Yojimbo. It also exiles the top card of a player's library and lets you cast it, which is an exile and is exactly the impulse pattern.

kept.name: Summon: Primal Odin
kept.why: Nothing on this card wins the game. Chapter II makes the DAMAGED PLAYER lose, which eff:lose-game already records; eff:win-game is a misread that would file it as an alt-win card. Chapter III's "each player loses 2 life" is symmetric, so scope:all applies.

kept.name: Vraska's Fall
kept.why: "gets a poison counter" is half the card and eff:poison is absent, so no infect deck can find it. "Each opponent" is a global effect, matching how Sanctum Seeker is marked.

kept.name: Lord Skitter, Sewer King
kept.why: His first ability exiles cards from an opponent's graveyard, which is graveyard hate, and neither the effect nor the zone was recorded. Only the token half of the card is currently visible.

kept.name: Greedy Freebooter
kept.why: The Treasure reminder text is printed on the card and supports eff:add-mana, consistent with Prized Statue and Rev.

kept.name: Your Temple Is Under Attack
kept.why: Neither mode changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. Granting your whole board indestructible is a protection effect, which eff:protect names.

kept.name: Greater Auramancy
kept.why: Shroud on your enchantments and enchanted creatures is what this card is played for. It is the premier protection piece for an enchantress or voltron deck and carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Tainted Strike
kept.why: Granting infect turns combat damage into poison counters, and the reminder text on the card says so. This is the definitive poison finisher and eff:poison was missing.

kept.name: Slaughter the Strong
kept.why: Every player sacrifices all but four power of creatures. It is a symmetric board sweeper that hurts your own board, which is precisely what scope:wipe is for and what should keep it out of a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Sedgemoor Witch
kept.why: Magecraft triggers on YOUR casts and specifically on instants and sorceries; only the bare trig:cast was recorded, so a spellslinger plan reads her as generic. Ward asks the opponent to pay 3 life, which is eff:unless-pays.

kept.name: Conduit of Ruin
kept.why: The tutor reveals and shuffles, and eff:shuffle was absent.

kept.name: Mimic Vat
kept.why: The activated ability creates a TOKEN COPY and grants it haste, neither recorded, and it costs {3} and a tap. The imprint half exiles the dying card and the ability reads cards exiled with the artifact. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard: it exiles a creature as a value engine, not as graveyard hate, and marking it hate would make it anti-synergy in a graveyard deck.

kept.name: Dowsing Dagger // Lost Vale
kept.why: The Equipment transforms into Lost Vale on combat damage, which is the entire reason the card is played, and eff:transform was missing. The back face's mana ability costs a tap.

kept.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
kept.why: His first line gives every enchanted or equipped creature DOUBLE STRIKE and that was not recorded anywhere, so a voltron deck cannot see the payoff. The back face gives +2/+0 and triggers when the equipped creature dies.

kept.name: Super State
kept.why: "has base power and toughness 9/9" is a set, not a pump, and eff:set-pt was absent. It is an Aura with "Enchant creature you control", so it attaches.

kept.name: Perch Protection
kept.why: Phasing your permanents out with your life total locked is a protection effect and the card carried no effect word for it. Deliberately NOT eff:extra-turn: the extra turn is given to an OPPONENT as the gift cost, and marking it would file this as an extra-turns payoff.

kept.name: Icon of Ancestry
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is an anthem and neither eff:pump nor scope:all was recorded, so no tribal deck can find it. The dig ability costs a tap and looks at the top of your library.

kept.name: Together Forever
kept.why: The second ability returns a creature card from the graveyard to hand when it dies. Only the support half of the card was recorded.

kept.name: Professor Onyx
kept.why: Magecraft is her whole reason for existing and only bare trig:cast was there. The +1 looks at the top three, takes one and puts the rest in the graveyard. The -3 keys off greatest power, and both the drain and the -3 hit each opponent.

kept.name: Summon: Yojimbo
kept.why: Chapter IV creates X Treasures and eff:create-token was missing entirely. The count keys off creatures with power 4 or greater.

kept.name: Endbringer
kept.why: His second activated ability stops a creature attacking or blocking, and neither word was recorded, so only the ping and the draw were visible.

kept.name: Amonkhet Raceway
kept.why: The land grants haste and changes no power or toughness. grants:haste already says what it does; eff:pump is a misread.

kept.name: Mutilate
kept.why: All creatures get MINUS X/MINUS X. eff:pump has the sign backwards and eff:shrink is the word for it. It is symmetric and kills your own board, so it is a wipe.

kept.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
kept.why: The first line taxes every spell your opponents cast and eff:increase-cost was absent, so half the card — the stax half people play it for — was invisible. Both abilities affect every opponent.

kept.name: Circle of Power
kept.why: It creates a 0/1 Wizard token and eff:create-token was missing. The token's damage was already credited to the card, so its trigger, which fires on your own noncreature casts, belongs too.

kept.name: Mycosynth Wellspring
kept.why: The trigger is on the artifact itself entering, and the search shuffles.

kept.name: Nether Traitor
kept.why: "you may pay {B}. If you do, return this card" is an optional cost gated recursion, and that conditional was not recorded.

kept.name: Dawn of Hope
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life" makes this a lifegain payoff and cares:lifegain was absent, so a lifegain deck cannot find it.

kept.name: Qarsi Revenant
kept.why: Renew puts three keyword counters on a target creature; the grants were recorded but the act of putting counters on something was not.

kept.name: Duty Beyond Death
kept.why: Mass indestructible in response to a wipe is what this card is for, and no protective effect word was present.

kept.name: Mirrorpool
kept.why: Both activated abilities cost 'Sacrifice this land', and the second one creates a token copy of a creature. Neither the sacrifice cost nor the token-making was recorded.

kept.name: Lae'zel's Acrobatics
kept.why: 'Exile all nontoken creatures you control, then return them' is a mass blink of your own board, which is exactly eff:exile-own. Only the return half was recorded.

kept.name: Heartless Summoning
kept.why: 'Creatures you control get -1/-1' makes creatures smaller, not bigger. eff:pump tells the engine this is an anthem when it is the opposite, and would put it in go-wide decks it actively ruins.

kept.name: Sidisi, Undead Vizier
kept.why: Exploit is an enters trigger that sacrifices a creature, and the tutor is a second trigger keyed on that sacrifice. Only the sacrifice cost survived; the ETB, the sacrifice-trigger and the library search's zone were all missing.

kept.name: Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher
kept.why: 'Whenever a player sacrifices a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen and you gain 1 life' — the trigger condition and the lifegain were both dropped, leaving only the counter. She is an aristocrats payoff and read as a counters card.

kept.name: Gisa, Glorious Resurrector
kept.why: The card had NO effect words at all, only an upkeep trigger. She exiles opponents' dying creatures, then puts all of them onto the battlefield under your control — an exile, a return from exile, and a theft of every one of them.

kept.name: Emeria's Call // Emeria, Shattered Skyclave
kept.why: The land half was read as nothing: '{T}: Add {W}' and the optional 3-life payment to enter untapped are both absent. The sorcery half grants indestructible to every non-Angel creature you control, which is a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Parasitic Impetus
kept.why: An Aura that attaches to a creature, gives +2/+2, and goads it. Only the drain trigger was recorded; the attachment, the pump and the goad effect were all missing.

kept.name: Vorpal Sword
kept.why: The whole reason this card is played is the granted 'that player loses the game' on combat damage. Neither the alt-win effect nor the combat damage trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Meekstone
kept.why: 'Creatures with power 3 or greater' keys directly on power, and cares:power was missing. The lock itself has no word in the vocabulary at all.

kept.name: Transcendent Envoy
kept.why: 'Aura spells you cast cost {1} less to cast' is the card's only non-keyword line and it produced no verb. Without eff:reduce-cost the engine knows only that it looks at Auras.

kept.name: Valkyrie Harbinger
kept.why: 'If you gained 4 or more life this turn' is a lifegain-matters condition and it was not recorded, so the card cannot be found by a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Ratadrabik of Urborg
kept.why: The dies trigger creates 'a token that's a copy of that creature'. The token was recorded but the copying was not.

kept.name: Tragic Arrogance
kept.why: Every player sacrifices all other nonland permanents, yours included. This is a symmetric board wipe and is a disaster in a go-wide deck, which is precisely what scope:wipe exists to flag.

kept.name: Revenge of Ravens
kept.why: There is no 'unless that player pays' clause anywhere on this card. The attacker's controller simply loses 1 life; nothing is taxed and no opponent is given a choice.

kept.name: Urza's Bauble
kept.why: The activation cost is '{T}, Sacrifice this artifact'. The sacrifice was recorded and the tap was not.

kept.name: Ugin's Labyrinth
kept.why: The imprint clause exiles a card from your hand and the third ability returns that exiled card to hand. Only the mana abilities were read, so the entire imprint half of the card was invisible.

kept.name: Celestine, the Living Saint
kept.why: 'where X is the amount of life you gained this turn' is a lifegain payoff and was not recorded. She reads as a plain reanimator with no reason to be in a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Metamorphosis Fanatic
kept.why: The reanimated creature comes back 'with a lifelink counter on it' — a counter is placed and lifelink is granted. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Aettir and Priwen
kept.why: 'Equipped creature has base power and toughness X/X' sets power and toughness outright. The equipment carried the attach but no effect on the creature at all.

kept.name: Zhulodok, Void Gorger
kept.why: The granted cascade casts an exiled spell without paying its mana cost. grants:cascade records the keyword but not that the card's purpose is casting spells for free.

kept.name: Sacrifice
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature' is the cast-sacrifice shape (Village Rites, Deadly Dispute), not a repeatable on-demand outlet. Carrying cost:sacrifice tells an aristocrats deck it has found a sac outlet when it has found a one-shot ritual.

kept.name: The Seriema
kept.why: Station is 'Tap another creature you control: put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft'. The tap-others cost, the counters it puts on itself, and the fact that it keys on power were all missing.

kept.name: Unholy Annex // Ritual Chamber
kept.why: The back half's entire text is 'create a 6/6 black Demon creature token with flying'. The token type was recorded but the act of creating it was not.

kept.name: Gwenom, Remorseless
kept.why: 'pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost' is a life cost and was not recorded. The top-of-library permission has no word in the vocabulary.

kept.name: Magewright's Stone
kept.why: The ability costs '{1}, {T}'. The tap in the activation cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Oswald Fiddlebender
kept.why: The cost is '{W}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact' and the effect searches your library. The tap component of the cost and the library zone were both missing.

kept.name: Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni
kept.why: She reanimates a creature from THAT PLAYER'S graveyard under YOUR control, which is theft and not just recursion. Ninjutsu's cost also returns an unblocked attacker you control to hand, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Nowhere to Run
kept.why: The static half applies to every creature your opponents control and specifically negates hexproof and ward. Only the one-shot -3/-3 was read, so the half of the card people actually play it for was missing.

kept.name: The Mightstone and Weakstone
kept.why: "When it enters, choose one -" is a modal ETB and nothing recorded the choice.

kept.name: Chivalric Alliance
kept.why: The whole first line, "Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card", was unread: no trigger and no draw. Only the activated token half was recorded.

kept.name: Nuclear Fallout
kept.why: "Each player gets X rad counters" puts counters on players and nothing said so. Left eff:mill alone - rad counters do mill, so it is defensible as a downstream truth.

kept.name: Brimaz, King of Oreskos
kept.why: Half his card is the block trigger and only the attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Blinkmoth Nexus
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. It animates itself into a creature and its third ability pumps a Blinkmoth. Deliberately did not add grants:flying: the flying is on itself, and this project has no grants:*-self word.

kept.name: Selfless Savior
kept.why: Sacrificing to grant indestructible is protection, not a pump - nothing on the card gets bigger, and eff:pump reads as a combat trick. This is the definitive one-mana protection creature.

kept.name: Mirrorworks
kept.why: It creates a token that is a COPY, which is the point of the card, and "you may pay {2}. If you do" is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid. Phyrexian Triniform in this same batch already carries eff:copy for a token copy.

kept.name: Necrogoyf
kept.why: "Necrogoyf's power is equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards" is a characteristic-defining ability and nothing recorded it. The upkeep discard is on EACH player's upkeep, so you discard too - which is the half a madness deck cares about.

kept.name: Temple Altisaur
kept.why: Preventing all but 1 damage to your other Dinosaurs keeps your creatures alive, and it is a blanket static over a group - the same shape Legion Lieutenant and Marrow-Gnawer in this batch get scope:all for.

kept.name: Abyssal Harvester
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and had no cost:tap. It exiles a creature card FROM A GRAVEYARD (graveyard hate, kept apart from eff:exile) and makes a token COPY of it. Did not add plain eff:exile for the trailing "exile all other Nightmare tokens you control" - exiling your own tokens is not removal.

kept.name: Walking Atlas
kept.why: "Put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield" is the literal gloss of eff:put-onto-battlefield. Kept eff:extra-land-drop, which is also true of it.

kept.name: Nesting Dovehawk
kept.why: The third line, "Whenever a creature token you control enters", had no trigger word at all, and populate creates a token that is a COPY of a creature token.

kept.name: Cornered by Black Mages
kept.why: It makes a 0/1 Wizard and had no eff:create-token - half the card was missing. The token's trigger is "whenever YOU cast", so the existing trig:cast wants trig:cast-own beside it.

kept.name: Diamond City
kept.why: "Move a shield counter from this land onto target creature" is a removal of a counter as well as an addition, and a shield counter is what keeps that creature alive through a removal spell.

kept.name: Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice
kept.why: It puts the Aura onto the battlefield ATTACHED to Light-Paws, which nothing recorded, and it is a library search - Mountain Valley and World Map in this batch both carry cares:zone:library for the same act.

kept.name: Spirit Link
kept.why: The card's entire effect is gaining life and the word was absent. Did not add eff:attach: hundreds of Auras exist and only 695 cards carry it, so the engine plainly does not give it to plain Auras.

kept.name: Settle the Wreckage
kept.why: THE OPPONENT searches for the basic lands, not you - as written these two words file a white board wipe as ramp and land tutoring. trig:attacks is a triggered-ability word and this instant has no triggered ability; it targets attackers.

kept.name: Phyrexian Triniform
kept.why: Encore is a graveyard ability whose cost is exiling this card from your graveyard, and neither the zone nor the cost was recorded. Did not add grants:haste - it is the token copies gaining it inside reminder text and says nothing about the deck.

kept.name: Stinkweed Imp
kept.why: "Destroy that creature" is why this card is played and eff:destroy was absent. Dredge returns this card from your graveyard to your hand, which is the literal gloss of eff:recur-self.

kept.name: Mask of Griselbrand
kept.why: "You may pay X life... If you do, draw X cards" - both the life payment and the pay-for-more shape were unrecorded.

kept.name: Power Conduit
kept.why: The ability is "{T}, Remove a counter" and cost:tap was missing, and "Choose one -" is modal.

kept.name: Etchings of the Chosen
kept.why: Only the choose and the indestructible grant were read. "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is a group-wide pump, the activated ability sacrifices a creature as a cost, and granting indestructible keeps a creature alive.

kept.name: Heap Gate
kept.why: "Tap an untapped Gate you control" is a cost paid by tapping another permanent, which is what cost:tap-others names.

kept.name: Merciless Eviction
kept.why: "Choose one -" is modal and nothing recorded it. Three of its four modes exile everything of a type including your own board, which is the symmetric-wipe warning scope:wipe exists to carry.

kept.name: Staff of the Storyteller
kept.why: It puts a story counter on itself whenever you make creature tokens and no counter-adding word was present.

kept.name: Athreos, Shroud-Veiled
kept.why: Only the coin counter half was read. The whole second ability - "whenever a creature with a coin counter DIES OR IS PUT INTO EXILE, return that card to the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL" - was missing its trigger, its return and, most importantly, the fact that it steals opponents' creatures. His devotion is to white AND black and only cares:color:b was there.

kept.name: Master of Ceremonies
kept.why: "For each player who chose secrets, you and that player each draw a card" - one of the three modes was unread. Did not add eff:choose: the OPPONENTS choose, and that word is glossed as you choosing.

kept.name: Stonespeaker Crystal
kept.why: "Exile any number of target players' graveyards" is the reason this card sees play and there was no graveyard word on it at all.

kept.name: Twilight Diviner
kept.why: The second ability triggers on OTHER creatures you control entering and creates a token that is a COPY of one of them; neither was recorded.

kept.name: Appa, Steadfast Guardian
kept.why: Airbend exiles your OWN nonland permanents, which saves them from removal and lets you recast them, and nothing recorded that it touches your own board. "Whenever you cast a spell from exile" had no trigger word.

kept.name: Darkstar Augur
kept.why: Offspring's token copy is an ETB trigger. eff:copy and eff:create-token were already taken from that same reminder text, so the trigger words belong with them.

kept.name: Norn's Annex
kept.why: No rec: at all - the compiler read nothing but the Phyrexian cost. The card is a pillowfort: it restricts attacks against you, and the restriction applies to every creature, not one target. eff:unless-pays alone says a tax exists without saying what is being taxed.

kept.name: Deafening Silence
kept.why: No rec: at all. The card's entire text is a casting restriction and nothing recorded that it stops spells being cast.

kept.name: Kor Spiritdancer
kept.why: The +2/+2 for each Aura attached is a real pump clause and nothing recorded it. An Aura spell is always an enchantment spell, so the cast trigger is an enchantment cast trigger - this is one of the format's definitive enchantress creatures and only the generic trig:cast was written down.

kept.name: Hero of Bladehold
kept.why: Battle cry gives each other attacking creature +1/+0. The keyword is recorded as printed but the pump it performs is not, so the card reads as tokens-only when half of it is an anthem on attack. Not adding scope:all: the Purphoros trap is that an unrelated global pump on a creature with a keyword reads as a grant.

kept.name: Solitude
kept.why: Evoke - Exile a white card from your hand is a cost paid to cast the spell and nothing recorded it. Deliberately NOT adding eff:gain-life: the life goes to the exiled creature's controller, normally an opponent, and there is no opponent-directed gain-life word, so writing eff:gain-life would file a removal spell as a lifegain card.

kept.name: Split Up
kept.why: Modal card with no eff:choose. It is also a sweeper: tapped or untapped is not a deckbuilding restriction the way 'nonvampire' or 'power 4 or greater' is - every board has both, and a go-wide deck's attackers are all tapped, so it destroys your own board and belongs behind the anti-synergy check.

kept.name: Drownyard Temple
kept.why: Colour identity is empty - no coloured mana symbol anywhere on the card. Every colourless ARTIFACT in this batch carries col:none and none of the colourless LANDS do, which looks like the derivation missing lands systematically rather than four separate cards being wrong.

kept.name: Power Depot
kept.why: 'Add one mana of any color' contains no coloured symbol, so the identity is colourless. Same lands-shaped gap as Drownyard Temple, Inkmoth Nexus and Conduit Pylons.

kept.name: Conduit Pylons
kept.why: Adds {C} and 'one mana of any color'; no coloured symbol, so colourless identity. Same lands-shaped gap.

kept.name: Inkmoth Nexus
kept.why: The whole second ability - the reason the card exists - was unrecorded except for eff:poison. It turns itself into a creature (eff:animate) with flying and infect. This is the defining infect land in the format and grants:infect was absent. Colourless identity as well.

kept.name: Kederekt Parasite
kept.why: 'if you control a red permanent' is a genuine colour condition, not a word scan - the card is unplayable outside a red-black deck and nothing said so.

kept.name: Nevinyrral's Disk
kept.why: The archetypal symmetric board wipe - destroys all artifacts, creatures and enchantments including yours - and it carried only scope:all. Exactly the card scope:wipe's anti-synergy consumer exists to keep out of a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor
kept.why: No rec: at all. eff:mill is wrong: nothing is put into a graveyard, the cards are exiled from the top of a library and you may play them, which is eff:impulse. The first ability is a pay-life-then-draw, which is the do-if-cost-paid shape. 'Discard X cards' is an activation cost and only the effect-side eff:discard-self was written.

kept.name: Starscape Cleric
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' is a printed drawback clause that went unrecorded. Not adding cares:lifegain because trig:gains-life already states the lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Winds of Abandon
kept.why: Overloaded this exiles each creature you don't control, which is a mass effect and was not recorded. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: it is restricted to creatures you don't control, so it never touches your own board.

kept.name: Adaptive Omnitool
kept.why: Nothing on this card exiles anything. It looks at the top six and puts one in HAND - that is eff:look-and-pick, which is already present and correct. eff:impulse tells the engine this is an exile-and-play card and cares:zone:exile tells it the card belongs in an exile-matters deck; both are false.

kept.name: Perpetual Timepiece
kept.why: Only the mill half was read. The second ability is the reason the card is played: it shuffles targeted cards from your graveyard back into your library, which is graveyard recursion and anti-mill insurance, and none of it was recorded - not the shuffle, not that it touches the graveyard, not that exiling itself is the cost.

kept.name: Crippling Fear
kept.why: rec:partial, and what it missed is the whole effect. -3/-3 to every creature not of the chosen type is a tribal sweeper; eff:choose alone says a choice is made and never says what happens. Not scope:wipe: 'aren't of the chosen type' is precisely the restriction that makes it one-sided for the deck playing it.

kept.name: Righteous Valkyrie
kept.why: rec:partial with BOTH abilities missing. She gains life on every Angel or Cleric entering and gives your whole board +2/+2 once you are 7 life up. Not one of the three things she does was written down - she is a lifegain payoff and read as a bare flier.

kept.name: White Sun's Twilight
kept.why: Creating X Phyrexian Mite tokens is the main mode of the card and eff:create-token was absent entirely. 'Destroy all other creatures' is a mass effect. Holding back on scope:wipe: the 'other' here spares the Mites it just made, so the card is deliberately asymmetric for its caster.

kept.name: Resplendent Angel
kept.why: The pump ability also grants lifelink and that was dropped. More importantly her token trigger is gated on having gained 5 or more life this turn - she is a lifegain payoff and nothing recorded it. It is a state check rather than a trigger, so trig:gains-life would be wrong and cares:lifegain is the right word.

kept.name: Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion
kept.why: rec:partial that recorded only the combat damage trigger, not what the trigger does. It exiles the top card of every library and lets you play them for life instead of mana - impulse draw off every opponent's deck. Ninjutsu's cost is returning an unblocked attacker to hand, which was also unrecorded.

kept.name: Anticausal Vestige
kept.why: The leave trigger draws AND cheats a permanent out of your hand onto the battlefield; only the draw was recorded. eff:put-onto-battlefield is the exact word for 'from your hand onto the battlefield'.

kept.name: Single Combat
kept.why: No rec: at all. Every player keeps one permanent and sacrifices the rest - a symmetric board clear that empties your side too, and the follow-up stops you rebuilding. eff:sacrifice alone does not say it hits the whole board, so a token deck would happily be offered it.

kept.name: Thousand Moons Smithy // Barracks of the Thousand
kept.why: rec:partial with the flip condition and the entire back face unread. The front transforms itself by tapping five artifacts and/or creatures you control; the back triggers whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana it produced. kw:transform is the printed keyword, eff:transform is the thing the card actually does.

kept.name: Gonti, Lord of Luxury
kept.why: rec:partial recording ONLY deathtouch and that it has an enter trigger. The trigger is the card: look at the top four of an opponent's library, exile one face down, and cast it later. Nothing about looking, picking, the library or exile was written down, so a theft or exile-matters deck cannot find one of the format's best-known cards for it.

kept.name: Warping Wail
kept.why: Modal with no eff:choose, and the third mode - create a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion - had no eff:create-token at all. Two of three modes were recorded and the token mode was invisible.

kept.name: Eldrazi Confluence
kept.why: The third mode creates a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion token and nothing recorded it. +3/-3 is a toughness reduction, which is how this mode kills a creature, so it shrinks as well as pumps.

kept.name: Hyena Umbra
kept.why: An Aura with 'Enchant creature' attaches to a creature exactly as an Equipment does. Umbra armor replaces destruction and saves the creature, which is the whole reason this card is played, and no word said so.

kept.name: Pip-Boy 3000
kept.why: The Sort Inventory mode draws a card and then makes you discard one. Only the counter and untap modes were recorded.

kept.name: Currency Converter
kept.why: It exiles cards from your graveyard, holds them in exile, and puts them back into the graveyard later. Both zones are load-bearing and neither was listed. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard: it only ever touches your own graveyard, so calling it graveyard hate would be wrong.

kept.name: PuPu UFO
kept.why: It puts a land from hand straight onto the battlefield, which is the exact gloss of eff:put-onto-battlefield; it does not grant an additional land play, so eff:extra-land-drop is untrue. The {3} ability sets base power to a count, which is eff:set-pt.

kept.name: Zul Ashur, Lich Lord
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and no tap cost was recorded. It lets you cast a card from your graveyard rather than returning it, which is what eff:cast-from-graveyard names.

kept.name: Gandalf the White
kept.why: The static reads 'entering or leaving the battlefield'. trig:enters was recorded for the first half and the leave half was dropped, which matters because this is a blink and sacrifice payoff both ways.

kept.name: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar
kept.why: It exiles cards from opponents' graveyards and then plays them from exile. Both zones and the graveyard exile were missing; the exile is asymmetric and hits opponents only, so eff:exile-graveyard is correct here in a way it is not on Currency Converter.

kept.name: Cid, Freeflier Pilot
kept.why: The ability returns an Equipment or Vehicle from your GRAVEYARD to hand. eff:bounce-own means returning your own permanents from the battlefield, which this card never does, and the graveyard zone was missing entirely.

kept.name: Shadrix Silverquill
kept.why: The second mode draws a card and that was never recorded. The counter mode puts a counter on EACH creature a player controls, a mass effect, not Shadrix growing itself, so the -self word misdescribes it.

kept.name: Serra's Emissary
kept.why: 'As this creature enters, choose a card type' is both a choice and an enters event, and neither was recorded. Blinking it to pick a new type is a real line of play the engine could not see.

kept.name: Bloodline Bidding
kept.why: 'Return ALL creature cards of the chosen type' is a mass effect. Nothing in the text refers to the colour black, so cares:color:b appears to have come from the mana cost rather than from anything the card does.

kept.name: Sword of War and Peace
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unrecorded: the +2/+2, the protection from red and from white, and the fact that both halves of the damage trigger count cards in hand.

kept.name: Persistent Constrictor
kept.why: It puts a -1/-1 counter on a creature each opponent's upkeep and no counter effect was recorded. Persist brings the creature back from the graveyard by itself, which is what eff:recur-self names; eff:return-from alone reads as returning other cards.

kept.name: Voyager Quickwelder
kept.why: The card has exactly one line, a cost reduction for artifact spells, and carried no effect word at all. It was invisible to anything looking for cost reduction.

kept.name: Cosmos Elixir
kept.why: Both halves of the only ability were missing: it draws a card or gains 2 life. The condition is your life total against your starting total, which makes it a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Zack Fair
kept.why: Sacrificing it gives a creature indestructible and moves the counters and Equipment across. Keeping your creature alive through removal is the card's purpose and only the granted keyword was recorded.

kept.name: Archfiend of Despair
kept.why: 'Each opponent loses life' is a mass drain and no scope word was present.

kept.name: Dawnsire, Sunstar Dreadnought
kept.why: Station puts charge counters on this Spacecraft, equal to the tapped creature's power. The self-counters and the power reference were both missing, and this card is nothing but a counters engine.

kept.name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
kept.why: Sacrificing it to give a creature or enchantment protection is a save from removal. grants:protection records the keyword; nothing recorded that the card keeps your permanent alive.

kept.name: Bone Shards
