kept.name: Astarion's Thirst
kept.why: It puts +1/+1 counters, which eff:add-counters already records. Every other counter card in this batch (Summon: Ixion, Smile at Death, Abzan Battle Priest) correctly carries no eff:pump, and treating counters as a pump would misfile it into the enhance role.

kept.name: Risky Shortcut
kept.why: "Each player loses 2 life" is symmetric and hits you too; nothing recorded that this is a group effect.

kept.name: Abzan Battle Priest
kept.why: Outlast is "{W}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature", so the tap cost was missing. "EACH creature you control with a +1/+1 counter has lifelink" is a mass grant.

kept.name: Eye of Nidhogg
kept.why: The entire middle line was unread. It sets base power and toughness to 4/2, grants flying and deathtouch, and goads. It also returns ITSELF to hand when it hits the graveyard, which is eff:recur-self; only the generic move-zone words were there.

kept.name: Summon: Ixion
kept.why: Chapter I exiles a creature "until this Saga leaves the battlefield", which is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger on itself and was not recorded.

kept.name: Squall, SeeD Mercenary
kept.why: The Rough Divide ability grants double strike on an attack trigger and produced nothing at all; only the combat-damage recursion half had been read.

kept.name: Study Hall
kept.why: "When you spend this mana to cast your commander" is literally a mana-spent condition; cares:commander was recorded but the mana-spent half was not.

kept.name: Ghostly Dancers
kept.why: The enter trigger returns an enchantment from your graveyard to your hand and none of that was recorded. The Eerie ability also triggers on OTHER enchantments you control entering, not only on itself.

kept.name: Liquimetal Coating
kept.why: acost:1 was recorded without the {T} that is half the activation cost. The card currently carries no eff: word at all, so the engine cannot see that it does anything.

kept.name: Smile at Death
kept.why: It only returns creatures "with power 2 or less", a power restriction that was not recorded, the same wording Titan's Presence records with cares:power.

kept.name: Arcbound Ravager
kept.why: Modular 1 is a death trigger that moves its +1/+1 counters onto another artifact creature. Only the self-growth half was recorded; the trigger and the counters it puts on ANOTHER creature were not.

kept.name: The Deck of Many Things
kept.why: Only the d20 roll and the graveyard return were read. The 10-19 and 20 outcomes, the discard clause and the tap cost were all missed.

kept.name: Bloodsoaked Champion
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a whole line of the card and produced nothing.

kept.name: Seasoned Dungeoneer
kept.why: The attack trigger and the protection grant were both missed, and explore looks at the top of your library.

kept.name: Battle Mastery
kept.why: An Aura that enchants a creature attaches to it, the same read Equipment gets from its equip clause.

kept.name: Ugin's Mastery
kept.why: The second ability, an attack trigger that reads the top of your library via manifest, produced nothing.

kept.name: Strixhaven Stadium
kept.why: Counters coming off, and the alternate win condition, were both unread. This card can end the game and nothing said so.

kept.name: Mindslaver
kept.why: The activated ability costs {4}, {T} and sacrifice; only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Boon Reflection
kept.why: A lifegain doubler that carried no lifegain word at all, so no lifegain deck could ever find it.

kept.name: Phyrexian Scriptures
kept.why: Chapter I puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature and was not read. Not marking scope:wipe deliberately: the destroy clause is restricted to nonartifact creatures, which is a filter rather than a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Entrapment Maneuver
kept.why: You create X Soldier tokens and the token half of the card was missing entirely.

kept.name: Zodiark, Umbral God
kept.why: The mass sacrifice on entry was completely unread. eff:add-counters is wrong: the only counters this puts down go on Zodiark itself, which eff:add-counters-self already says, and leaving the generic word makes a five-black-pip edict commander read as a +1/+1 counters deck.

kept.name: Thran Portal
kept.why: "Mana abilities of this land cost an additional 1 life to activate" is a real cost and produced nothing.

kept.name: Hunted Horror
kept.why: The tokens are created by TARGET OPPONENT, not by you. This is the drawback half of a Hunted card, and eff:create-token files it as a token generator, so a Krenko or Rhys deck would be offered a card that gives the table two 3/3s with protection from black.

kept.name: Skittering Invasion
kept.why: Five Eldrazi Spawn that each sacrifice for {C} is a ramp spell, and no mana word was present, so it could never fill a ramp slot.

kept.name: Pyre of Heroes
kept.why: The tap cost was missed and the ability searches your library.

kept.name: Grim Affliction
kept.why: The card proliferates and only carried the keyword, not the effect. Not adding eff:add-counters: the counter is -1/-1 and eff:shrink already says that, while the generic word would read as a +1/+1 counters card.

kept.name: Calamity of the Titans
kept.why: The additional cost, revealing a colorless creature card from your hand, was entirely unread.

kept.name: Rally the Ranks
kept.why: This is an anthem and carried no pump word, so the one thing it does was missing.

kept.name: Shadow of Mortality
kept.why: The whole card is a cost reduction and it carried no effect word at all. Same wording Ghalta uses, "this spell costs {X} less to cast".

kept.name: Restless Fortress
kept.why: The land becomes a 1/4 Nightmare creature and nothing recorded the animation, which is why it attacks in the first place.

kept.name: Within Range
kept.why: "Whenever you attack" is the drain trigger and was missing.

kept.name: Hakoda, Selfless Commander
kept.why: The sacrifice ability is a fog that saves your board (+0/+5 and indestructible), which eff:pump alone does not say. Casting Ally spells off the top of your library is unread.

kept.name: Gilraen, Dúnedain Protector
kept.why: A repeatable blink engine that was missing the return half and both counters. The exile-and-return pattern needs cares:zone:exile and eff:return-from alongside eff:exile-own or no blink package can see it, and the lifelink counter grants lifelink exactly as the vigilance counter grants vigilance.

kept.name: Spawning Bed
kept.why: The entire second ability was unread: it sacrifices itself to make three Scion tokens that each sacrifice for mana. The land had no token word at all.

kept.name: Season of Loss
kept.why: cost:sacrifice is wrong. Nothing here is a sacrifice outlet and nothing is an additional cost to cast: "Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice" is an edict, which eff:sacrifice already records. Leaving cost:sacrifice offers this sorcery to an aristocrats deck as a repeatable outlet, which it is not.

kept.name: Slaughter Specialist
kept.why: Each OPPONENT creates the 1/1 Human, not you. It is the drawback that pays for a two-mana 3/2, and eff:create-token files it as a token maker when it makes tokens for the other side of the table.

kept.name: Wondrous Crucible
kept.why: "Permanents you control have ward {2}" is a mass static over your board (scope:all) and is a protective shield (eff:protect); neither was recorded. The end-step engine was read but the ward line was not.

kept.name: Containment Priest
kept.why: The entire body of the card is "exile it instead" and no effect word was recorded at all. Without eff:exile this reads as a vanilla 2/2 with flash.

kept.name: Wand of Orcus
kept.why: "Whenever equipped creature attacks or blocks" is two triggers and only trig:blocks was kept. The ability grants deathtouch, and it grants it to all Zombies you control, not just the equipped creature.

kept.name: Heartless Act
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and nothing recorded that the caster picks the mode.

kept.name: Filigree Vector
kept.why: The counters go on any number of target creatures and target artifacts, so this is a counter spreader (eff:add-counters), not a card that grows itself. The activated ability's costs, {T} and sacrificing another artifact, were both unrecorded, which hides that this is a repeatable sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Mindless Automaton
kept.why: "Remove two +1/+1 counters from this creature: Draw a card" is the whole reason to play the card and neither the draw nor the counter-removal cost was recorded.

kept.name: Frodo, Adventurous Hobbit
kept.why: The attack trigger draws a card and it is conditioned on "if you gained 3 or more life this turn", which is a lifegain payoff. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Lupinflower Village
kept.why: The ability looks at the top six and puts a card into your HAND, putting the rest on the bottom. Nothing is exiled and nothing is played from exile, so both the impulse word and the exile-zone word are false. eff:look-and-pick already says what the card does.

kept.name: Arvinox, the Mind Flail
kept.why: The end-step ability was recorded only as a trigger with no effect at all. It exiles the bottom card of each opponent's library and lets you cast permanent spells from exile with any colour of mana, which is exile-and-play value in the Prosper shape.

kept.name: Relic of Progenitus
kept.why: This is a dedicated graveyard hate artifact and carried no graveyard word whatsoever. Both abilities exile from graveyards, the second hits ALL graveyards, the first costs {T}, and the second exiles the artifact itself as a cost.

kept.name: Liliana Vess
kept.why: The ultimate puts all creature cards from ALL graveyards onto the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL. eff:return-from alone reads as self-reanimation and misses that it steals every opponent's creatures too.

kept.name: Bilbo's Ring
kept.why: Three of the card's four clauses were unrecorded: it grants hexproof, it draws on the attack trigger, and the attack trigger itself was missing. Only "can't be blocked" survived.

kept.name: Sword of Once and Future
kept.why: Only the surveil was read. The equipped creature gets +2/+2 and protection from blue and black, and the trigger casts an instant or sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, which is the card's whole reason to exist.

kept.name: Hateful Eidolon
kept.why: The one triggered ability draws a card for each Aura attached and no draw word was recorded, leaving an aura payoff that appears to do nothing.

kept.name: Treasure Chest
kept.why: The 2-9 result creates five Treasure tokens and no token-making word was recorded.

kept.name: Zenos yae Galvus // Shinryu, Transcendent Rival
kept.why: Only the enters trigger was read. The card gives every other creature -2/-2 (a mass shrink), transforms on the chosen creature leaving the battlefield, and the back face outright wins the game when the chosen player loses. An alternate win condition being invisible is the most serious omission in the batch.

kept.name: Glass-Cast Heart
kept.why: "Whenever one or more Vampires you control attack" had no attack trigger recorded, and the drain ability sacrifices the artifact itself as part of its cost.

kept.name: Cryptolith Fragment // Aurora of Emrakul
kept.why: The upkeep trigger transforms the artifact and the back face has an attack trigger draining each opponent for 3. Neither the transform effect nor the attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Digsite Engineer
kept.why: "You may pay {2}. If you do, create..." is exactly a pay-for-more effect and nothing recorded that the token is optional and costs mana.

kept.name: Suspended Sentence
kept.why: "Exile Suspended Sentence with three time counters on it" self-exiles after resolution and, with suspend, the card lives in exile. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Brainstone
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the sacrifice, and "put two cards from your hand on top of your library" moves cards between zones, which is the half of a Brainstorm that makes it work with shuffles. None of it was recorded.

kept.name: Combat Calligrapher
kept.why: "Inklings can't attack you or planeswalkers you control" is a whole unrecorded clause, and it applies to every Inkling on the board rather than to one target.

kept.name: Defiler of Faith
kept.why: The card is built entirely around WHITE permanent spells and no colour word was recorded, so the mono-white payoff is invisible. The cost reduction is also conditional on choosing to pay 2 life.

kept.name: Terminus
kept.why: It puts ALL creatures, yours included, on the bottom of their owners' libraries. That is a symmetric board wipe in every sense a deck builder cares about, and without scope:wipe nothing stops it being offered to a go-wide token deck. The existing eff:move-zone plus scope:all does not say the caster's own board is destroyed.

kept.name: Elenda, Saint of Dusk
kept.why: Both of her static abilities key off your life total being above your starting total, which is the lifegain-matters signal, and both make her bigger. Neither was recorded, so a lifegain commander read as a plain lifelinker.

kept.name: Imotekh the Stormlord
kept.why: "Whenever one or more artifact cards leave your graveyard" had no trigger word at all, so half the card had an effect with nothing to fire it.

kept.name: Machinist's Arsenal
kept.why: Job select is an enters trigger that makes a 1/1 Hero token and attaches to it; the equipped creature also gets +2/+2 for each artifact. Only eff:attach was recorded.

kept.name: Haystack
kept.why: Whole card was unread: an activated ability with {T} in its cost that saves your own creature from removal.

kept.name: With Great Power . . .
kept.why: "All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature instead" redirects damage; nothing is prevented, the damage still happens to the creature. eff:redirect-damage says exactly this.

kept.name: Braids, Cabal Minion
kept.why: Her entire ability is a symmetric recurring sacrifice and no effect verb was recorded at all - only the upkeep trigger and the three type words.

kept.name: Barrensteppe Siege
kept.why: Both modes trigger at the beginning of your end step and the card had no trigger words. The Abzan/Mardu choice as it enters is a mode choice.

kept.name: Summon: Good King Mog XII
kept.why: Chapters II and III create a token that's a copy of a token you control (eff:copy) off casting your own noncreature spells (trig:cast-own), and IV puts counters on each other Moogle you control (scope:all).

kept.name: Storm of Souls
kept.why: The returned creatures each become a 1/1 with flying, which sets power and toughness and grants an evasion keyword. Only the mass return was recorded.

kept.name: Bant Panorama
kept.why: It fetches a basic land, which is the whole point of the card and is what cares:zone:library-land says. scope:all is a false positive from the three-way basic land selector - the card affects nothing board-wide.

kept.name: Aang, Airbending Master
kept.why: "Whenever one or more creatures you control leave the battlefield without dying" is a leaves trigger, and the experience counter goes on YOU, which is eff:player-counter rather than eff:add-counters. The token count scales off it.

kept.name: Brought Back
kept.why: It returns permanent cards from your graveyard, which nothing recorded. trig:dies is wrong: this is an instant with no triggered ability at all, picked up from the words "put there from the battlefield this turn".

kept.name: Horn of Valhalla // Ysgard's Call
kept.why: The Adventure half creates X 1/1 Soldier tokens and the list only read the Equipment face.

kept.name: Sorin, Lord of Innistrad
kept.why: The minus abilities cost loyalty counters; the emblem gives creatures you control +1/+0 board-wide; and the ultimate returns everything it destroyed from the graveyard to the battlefield under YOUR control, which is both a recursion and a steal.

kept.name: Uchuulon
kept.why: The end step trigger exiles a creature card from an opponent's graveyard, which is graveyard hate and is the cost of the copy. Neither the zone nor the exile was recorded.

kept.name: Slash the Ranks
kept.why: It destroys all creatures and planeswalkers, including yours - the commander exemption does not make it one-sided. Villainous Wrath in the same batch carries scope:wipe for the same clause.

kept.name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
kept.why: No effect verb at all was recorded: it makes a 4/4 Beast token on entry and gives every creature token you control flying while you have four or more.

kept.name: Profane Command
kept.why: "Choose two" is a modal spell, and the fourth mode gives up to X creatures fear until end of turn.

kept.name: Oriq Loremage
kept.why: It searches your library, and the library zone was missing while the graveyard destination was recorded.

kept.name: Changeling Wayfinder
kept.why: A false positive from the "basic land card" search selector. The card searches for one land and affects nothing board-wide.

kept.name: Ensnaring Bridge
kept.why: It reads creatures' power against your hand size to decide who can attack, which is the whole card.

kept.name: Pile On
kept.why: Nothing on this card cares about black. It is a word scan off the convoke reminder text ("one mana of that creature's color"). Cliffhaven Vampire and Ruthless Lawbringer, both black cards in this batch, correctly carry no cares:color:b.

kept.name: Ruthless Lawbringer
kept.why: It sacrifices one creature and destroys one target nonland permanent. scope:all next to eff:destroy risks it reading as a board wipe, which would keep it out of the go-wide decks that most want it.

kept.name: Brass Knuckles
kept.why: The equipped creature gains double strike under a condition, and "When you cast this spell, copy it" is a cast trigger - eff:copy was recorded with nothing to say when it happens.

kept.name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
kept.why: Half the card is "whenever you cast a white spell". cares:color:b was recorded for the black half and the white half was dropped.

kept.name: Oblivion Ring
kept.why: The exiled card is tracked in exile and comes back when the ring leaves. I deliberately did not add eff:return-from: it returns the card to its OWNER, so reading it as recursion would be wrong.

kept.name: Batterskull
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger - the Germ token and the attach only happen because the Equipment entered. eff:create-token and tok:germ were recorded with no trigger.

kept.name: The Wanderer
kept.why: Her static ability, which is most of the card, was entirely unread: it prevents all noncombat damage to you and every other permanent you control. The minus also keys on power 4 or greater.

kept.name: Sword of Hours
kept.why: The second trigger rolls a d12 and doubles the +1/+1 counters on the creature. Neither the die roll nor the doubling was recorded.

kept.name: Cliffhaven Vampire
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life" makes this a lifegain payoff. trig:gains-life records the trigger but nothing said the deck needs to gain life.

kept.name: Aerial Surveyor
kept.why: False positive from the "basic Plains" search selector; the attack trigger fetches one land.

kept.name: Restoration Seminar
kept.why: The whole Paradigm clause was unread: it exiles itself, then at the beginning of each of your first main phases you may cast a copy from exile without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Slip On the Ring
kept.why: This is a blink - exile a creature you own and return it - and only eff:protect was recorded. Without eff:exile-own no blink deck can find it.

kept.name: Agility Bobblehead
kept.why: The second ability gives up to X creatures haste until end of turn; only the unblockable half was recorded.

kept.name: Infesting Radroach
kept.why: Three unread clauses: it can't block, its combat damage puts rad counters on a PLAYER, and it returns itself from your graveyard to your hand whenever an opponent mills a nonland card.

kept.name: Arvad the Cursed
kept.why: He has lifelink. Baneslayer Angel in this same batch carries eff:gain-life for the identical keyword.

kept.name: Lingering Souls
kept.why: Flashback lets you cast this card from your graveyard, which is the same self-recursion Timeline Culler's warp gets eff:recur-self for. The graveyard zone is load-bearing on this card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Trespasser's Curse
kept.why: The trigger is on other creatures entering, never on the Curse itself. It already carries the bare trig:enters and nothing said which direction.

kept.name: Akroma, Vision of Ixidor
kept.why: Her whole ability is a mass pump of every other creature you control and no pump or scope word was recorded at all. She also names thirteen keywords by name and only five of them were captured, so the engine could not see her as a keyword-matters payoff.

kept.name: Bounty Board
kept.why: The third ability - a death trigger that draws cards and gains 2 life - produced no facets whatsoever. Only the mana and counter halves were read.

kept.name: Chains of Custody
kept.why: The exile lasts only until the Aura leaves, which is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger nothing recorded. The granted ward is a real tax on opponents targeting your creature.

kept.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
kept.why: A symmetric edict on every player each upkeep, and the sacrifice - the only thing the card does - was not written down at all.

kept.name: Pack Leader
kept.why: The attack trigger prevents all combat damage to your Dogs and no facet recorded it.

kept.name: Valkyrie's Call
kept.why: It returns the dead creature card from the graveyard to the battlefield. This is a reanimation engine and the graveyard was never mentioned.

kept.name: Timeline Culler
kept.why: Warp exiles the creature itself at the next end step and then lets you cast it from exile. Both the exile zone and the self-exile are printed on the card and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Sinister Gnarlbark
kept.why: It draws a card every end step and that was missing entirely. Blight also puts a -1/-1 counter on a creature. Deliberately NOT adding eff:shrink: the counter goes on your OWN creature, so filing it as shrink would read as removal.

kept.name: Mirror Shield
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +0/+2 and hexproof, and neither the pump nor the granted hexproof was recorded, so nothing could offer this as a way to protect a creature. The destroy is a granted blocking trigger.

kept.name: Pendant of Prosperity
kept.why: Both halves put a land card from hand straight onto the battlefield, which is the exact word for it.

kept.name: Sadistic Shell Game
kept.why: It destroys one creature per player, so it is mass one-sided removal rather than a spot kill. NOT scope:wipe - it explicitly spares creatures you control.

kept.name: Anvil of Bogardan
kept.why: Every player draws an additional card each draw step and no draw word was recorded, only the discard half.

kept.name: Cast Out
kept.why: THE CARD IS AN EXILE EFFECT AND CARRIED NO eff:exile AT ALL. Only the cycling half was read, so a four-mana catch-all answer looked like a cantrip. The exile also ends when the enchantment leaves.

kept.name: HELIOS One
kept.why: The removal ability sacrifices the land itself as part of its cost, which is a real drawback nothing recorded.

kept.name: Champions of Minas Tirith
kept.why: The entire second ability was unread: a combat trigger on each opponent's turn that taxes them and stops them attacking you if they decline.

kept.name: Great Unclean One
kept.why: Each opponent loses 2 life, so the drain is symmetrical across the table rather than a single target.

kept.name: Doomsday
kept.why: It exiles the rest of your library and graveyard, which is most of the card. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard: that word means graveyard hate aimed at opponents, and marking Doomsday with it would read as anti-synergy in the graveyard decks that actually play it.

kept.name: Ajani Steadfast
kept.why: The +1 gives a creature +1/+1 until end of turn and no pump was recorded.

kept.name: Griffin Aerie
kept.why: It only makes a token if you gained 3 or more life this turn. This is a pure lifegain payoff and nothing said so, so a lifegain deck could never be offered it.

kept.name: Moxite Refinery
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and nothing recorded it. It is also modal - 'Choose one' with two bullets.

kept.name: Cataclysmic Gearhulk
kept.why: Each player sacrifices all but one artifact, creature, enchantment and planeswalker. This is a symmetric board wipe that hits your own side hardest, and with no scope word a go-wide deck would happily take it.

kept.name: Gavel of the Righteous
kept.why: Almost nothing about this Equipment was read: it attaches, it pumps by counter count, it grants double strike at four counters, and its equip cost can be paid by removing a counter.

kept.name: Necrogen Communion
kept.why: Every effect on this Aura was missing. It reanimates the enchanted creature when it dies and it grants toxic 2, which is poison counters.

kept.name: Big Mother Mouser
kept.why: The death trigger creates Robot tokens - a token payoff with no token effect recorded - and the attack trigger doubles the counters on it.

kept.name: Victor, Valgavoth's Seneschal
kept.why: The Eerie trigger fires on another enchantment you control entering, never on Victor himself.

kept.name: Illuminor Szeras
kept.why: The mana ability costs {T} as well as the sacrifice.

kept.name: Boompile
kept.why: It destroys ALL nonland permanents including yours, and no scope word was recorded, so a token deck could be handed its own board wipe. The ability also costs {T}.

kept.name: Shefet Dunes
kept.why: The white mana ability costs 1 life and nothing recorded the payment.

kept.name: Raiders' Wake
kept.why: The first ability is a discard payoff with no way to say so, and the hand zone was never recorded.

kept.name: Teyo, Geometric Tactician
kept.why: The +1 draws cards for you and an opponent, and no draw word was recorded.

kept.name: Spear of Heliod
kept.why: The destroy ability costs {T} in addition to {1}{W}{W}.

kept.name: Gollum, Obsessed Stalker
kept.why: The drain is sized by "the amount of life you gained this turn" — the whole card is a lifegain payoff and nothing said so.

kept.name: Bonehoard
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +X/+X" is a pump and was unrecorded. Living weapon is an enters trigger on itself (create a Germ, then attach), so the token creation already listed had no trigger under it.

kept.name: Soul Snuffers
kept.why: A -1/-1 counter on each creature makes every creature smaller and kills the small ones. This is the card's whole function as a one-sided-ish sweeper and only the neutral eff:add-counters was recorded.

kept.name: Carnifex Demon
kept.why: Removing a -1/-1 counter is the activation cost and was missing. The ability puts a -1/-1 counter on each other creature: that is a repeatable mass shrink, so both eff:shrink and scope:all belong (Soul Snuffers in this same batch carries scope:all for the identical selector).

kept.name: Suspicious Bookcase
kept.why: The ability is {3}, {T} — the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Tomb Fortress
kept.why: "Exile this land" is part of the activation cost. The land eats itself to reanimate and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Elspeth Tirel
kept.why: The -5 destroys all other permanents, a board-wide effect with no scope word. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: it spares lands and tokens, so it is the rare mass destroy a token deck actively wants, and scope:wipe is the narrow word that keeps sweepers out of go-wide decks.

kept.name: March of the Canonized
kept.why: Devotion to white AND black. cares:color:b was recorded and its twin was dropped, so a mono-white devotion deck cannot see it.

kept.name: Underworld Connections
kept.why: The granted ability is "{T}, Pay 1 life: Draw a card". The draw was recorded and both halves of its cost were lost, which is what makes this a life-as-a-resource card rather than a free draw engine.

kept.name: Putrid Imp
kept.why: Threshold gives it +1/+1 and "can't block" — a real drawback on itself that was unrecorded.

kept.name: Endless Foot Assault
kept.why: "Whenever you attack" is an attack trigger and had none. Squad's copies are made by an enters trigger on itself, so eff:copy and eff:create-token were both sitting with no trigger under them.

kept.name: Relentless Dead
kept.why: "When this creature dies, you may pay {B}. If you do, return IT to its owner's hand" is self-recursion from the graveyard, the Gravecrawler shape, and eff:return-from alone reads as generic reanimation of other things. Both abilities are pay-to-get-more, which is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Stoneforge Masterwork
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature that shares a type" is a pump, and in a tribal deck a very large one. Only eff:attach was recorded, so nothing said what attaching achieves.

kept.name: Ring of Valkas
kept.why: The counter is put on the equipped creature only "if it's red". The card is conditioned on a colour and that condition was unrecorded.

kept.name: Idol of False Gods
kept.why: The token ability is {1}{C}, {T} and the tap cost was missing. The Spawn it makes sacrifice for {C}, so this is a mana engine — Coin of Mastery in this same batch is correctly credited with eff:add-mana for its Treasures, and the Eldrazi Spawn case is the same claim. At eight counters it becomes a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types, which is eff:animate on itself.

kept.name: Cloudsteel Kirin
kept.why: "Equipped creature has flying" is a grant and only the Kirin's own printed flying was recorded.

kept.name: Sand Scout
kept.why: "Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere" — a graveyard trigger on a card recorded as caring only about the library.

kept.name: Clive's Hideaway
kept.why: Hideaway 4 is an enters trigger that looks at four cards and takes one, and none of that was recorded — the land read as a plain colourless tap-land. The payoff plays the exiled card without paying its mana cost, which is eff:cast-free, and it plays from exile.

kept.name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
kept.why: WRONG AND HARMFUL. eff:neutralise means turning a permanent into something harmless, and it confers the removal role. Xu-Ifit reanimates YOUR OWN creature; the "has no abilities" clause is a limit on your own reanimation target, not an answer to an opponent's threat. As it stands a reanimator commander is being counted as a removal spell.

kept.name: Valley Questcaller
kept.why: "Whenever one or more other Rabbits, Bats, Birds and/or Mice you control enter, scry 1" — the scry was recorded with no trigger under it, so nothing knew this is an enters-matters card.

kept.name: Sothera, the Supervoid
kept.why: The second half puts a creature card exiled with Sothera onto the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL. Those exiled cards are the opponents' creatures, so this is both a return from exile and genuine theft, and only the exiling half was recorded.

kept.name: Necrotic Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability's cost is "Sacrifice this permanent" — each Sliver eats itself to destroy a permanent. -self is right rather than cost:sacrifice: it is not a sacrifice outlet for other creatures.

kept.name: Minthara, Merciless Soul
kept.why: "Creatures you control get +1/+0 for each experience counter" is a team-wide anthem and the entire payoff for the experience counters. Nothing recorded it, so the card read as counters that do nothing.

kept.name: Stensian Sanguinist // Exsanguinate
kept.why: Prepared lets you cast A COPY of its spell, which is copying and was unrecorded. Nothing in either half of the card mentions exile, so cares:zone:exile is a false reading and would put this in exile-matters decks.

kept.name: Kefnet's Monument
kept.why: The cost reduction applies only to BLUE creature spells, which is a colour condition and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Snarling Gorehound
kept.why: The trigger is on ANOTHER creature you control entering, and only the bare trig:enters was recorded. Deliberately NOT adding cares:power: the card cares about power 2 OR LESS, and cares:power drives plans toward big creatures, so it would be exactly backwards here.

kept.name: Coin of Mastery
kept.why: "for each mana from an artifact source spent to cast it" is precisely cares:mana-spent, and it is the whole reason this card is in an artifact deck rather than a counters deck.

kept.name: Jund Panorama
kept.why: It searches for basic land cards, which is the land-tutor word every other fetcher in this batch carries (Gift of Estates, Sand Scout, Thaumatic Compass). scope:all is false: a fetch land affects one card in your own library, not everything.

kept.name: Curse of the Restless Dead
kept.why: The trigger is another permanent entering (a land the cursed player controls) and only the bare trig:enters was recorded.

kept.name: Destroy Evil
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and the mode choice was unrecorded.

kept.name: The Ten Rings
kept.why: THE CARD DRAWS AND CARRIED NO DRAW WORD. "At the beginning of your end step, if you have fewer than ten cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference" is a refill-to-ten every turn — an eight-mana artifact whose entire purpose was invisible to the engine.

kept.name: Skyknight Squire
kept.why: At three or more +1/+1 counters it has flying. The evasion it grants itself was unrecorded.

kept.name: Thaumatic Compass // Spires of Orazca
kept.why: The back face is a land that taps for {C} and had no eff:add-mana at all, so a mana source read as producing none. The front face transforms itself at end step and eff:transform was missing.

kept.name: Rush of Dread
kept.why: An entire mode — "Target opponent loses half their life, rounded up" — was unrecorded, which on a Commander life total is the strongest of the three. Spree is a choose-one-or-more, so the mode choice is real too.

kept.name: Vampiric Link
kept.why: The whole card is "you gain that much life" and no life word was recorded. It had the trigger and not the effect.

kept.name: Desmond Miles
kept.why: Two of the three lines were unread. "gets +1/+0 for each other Assassin" is a pump (same shape as Persistent Marshstalker, which carries eff:pump), and the damage trigger surveils X - kw:surveil is the printed keyword, eff:surveil is the thing it actually does.

kept.name: Strength-Testing Hammer
kept.why: The attack trigger does three things and none were recorded: rolls a six-sided die (eff:random is exactly "flips a coin or rolls a die"), gives +X/+0, and draws a card. Only the equip half had been read.

kept.name: Glimmer Lens
kept.why: For Mirrodin! is "When this Equipment enters, create a token" - the token effect was recorded but not the trigger that makes it. The second line is an attack trigger that draws a card, entirely unread.

kept.name: Grimoire of the Dead
kept.why: The payoff ability's costs were half-recorded: removing three study counters and sacrificing itself are both costs and neither was there. It reanimates every creature card in every graveyard, which is a mass effect.

kept.name: Elegy Acolyte
kept.why: The middle line - "Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you draw a card and lose 1 life" - produced nothing at all. Only the Void end-step trigger had been read.

kept.name: Super Shredder
kept.why: It triggers on ANOTHER permanent leaving, never on itself. Only the bare trig:leaves was recorded, which is the same word a self-leaves trigger gets.

kept.name: Honden of Cleansing Fire
kept.why: The card's only effect is gaining 2 life per Shrine and no effect word was recorded at all - it had the upkeep trigger and nothing else.

kept.name: Tomb Tyrant
kept.why: The reanimation ability costs {2}{B}, a tap, and sacrificing a creature. Neither the tap nor the sacrifice was recorded, so nothing marks this as a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Persistent Marshstalker
kept.why: Threshold triggers "whenever you attack with one or more Rats" - no attack trigger was recorded. It then offers "you may pay {2}{B}. If you do", which is the pay-for-more shape.

kept.name: Benevolent Blessing
kept.why: The entire point of the aura is that the enchanted creature has protection from the chosen color, and no grant word was recorded. eff:choose alone says it picks something without saying what it gives.

kept.name: Mortivore
kept.why: "Mortivore's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards" is a characteristic-setting effect and produced nothing. The card carried no eff: word of any kind.

kept.name: Karn, Scion of Urza
kept.why: The +1 exiles one of the two revealed cards and the -1 returns a card from exile to hand. Neither the exile nor the return was recorded, so a planeswalker whose first two abilities are an exile loop looked like it only made a token.

kept.name: Ainok Bond-Kin
kept.why: Outlast is {1}{W}, {T} - the tap is part of the activation cost and was not recorded.

kept.name: Bottomless Pit
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all - just the upkeep trigger. It makes every player discard a card at random, which is both a discard effect and a symmetric global one.

kept.name: Astrid Peth
kept.why: The Brand-new Sky ability triggers "whenever you sacrifice a Clue or Food" and no sacrifice trigger was recorded. Explore reveals the top card of your library, which the list did not reflect either.

kept.name: Make an Example
kept.why: "For each opponent, you choose one of their piles" is precisely the you-decide-what-they-do shape; only the sacrifice half was recorded.

kept.name: Venerated Stormsinger
kept.why: Mobilize 1 is "whenever this creature attacks, create a token". The token effect was recorded but not the attack trigger producing it.

kept.name: South Pole Voyager
kept.why: The second sentence draws a card on the second resolution and was unread. The trigger is "whenever THIS creature or another Ally enters", so it fires on itself as well as on others.

kept.name: Archangel Elspeth
kept.why: The -2 makes the target an Angel and gives it flying. The counters were recorded and the keyword grant was not.

kept.name: Go-Shintai of Hidden Cruelty
kept.why: "you may pay {1}. When you do, destroy target creature" is the pay-for-more shape - the destruction is gated behind an optional payment and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Dalek Squadron
kept.why: Myriad is an attack trigger. The token copies were recorded but not the fact that attacking is what causes them.

kept.name: Wave of Reckoning
kept.why: Every creature on the battlefield deals damage to itself equal to its power, which kills your board along with everyone else's. It is unconditional and symmetric, so a go-wide deck must be steered away from it - scope:all alone does not say that.

kept.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
kept.why: It creates a Lander token and no token word was recorded. Only the graveyard hate and the token's own search ability had been read.

kept.name: Karoo
kept.why: The card is kept only by returning an untapped Plains you control to hand, and nothing recorded that it bounces one of your own lands.

kept.name: Ayli, Eternal Pilgrim
kept.why: The first activated ability gains life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness and no life word was recorded. The second is gated on having 10 life more than your starting total, which is a genuine lifegain-matters condition rather than an incidental mention.

kept.name: Cavalier of Night
kept.why: "you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls" - the removal is conditional on paying, which the list did not record.

kept.name: Radiant Destiny
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is an anthem and no pump word was recorded - the card only carried the vigilance grant. Same shape as Tomb Tyrant's lord line, which carries both.

kept.name: Hidden Courtyard
kept.why: Discover 4 exiles cards off the top of your library until a nonland card and casts it without paying its mana cost. None of that was recorded - the land carried only its mana ability - and the ability sacrifices the land as a cost.

kept.name: Crown of Gondor
kept.why: It is an Equipment with an equip cost and carried no attach word, unlike the other Equipment in this batch.

kept.name: Monk Gyatso
kept.why: He triggers when another creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability. Only the generic cast trigger was recorded, which does not say that being targeted is the event.

kept.name: Glamdring
kept.why: "Equipped creature has first strike" and no grant was recorded - the pump half of the same sentence was.

kept.name: Karn, Living Legacy
kept.why: The -1 looks at cards from the top of your library and puts the rest on the bottom; nothing recorded that the card touches the library.

kept.name: Liliana, Waker of the Dead
kept.why: +1 is "Each player discards a card", which includes you (eff:discard-self) and hits everyone (scope:all). The -7 emblem reanimates a creature and "It gains haste", which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Into the Pit
kept.why: Sacrificing a nonland permanent here is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST a spell, not an on-demand outlet you can activate, so cost:cast-sacrifice is the accurate word and cost:sacrifice would file it alongside Ashnod's Altar.

kept.name: Campfire
kept.why: The second ability was entirely unread: exiling itself is the cost, it returns commanders from the graveyard and command zone to hand, and it shuffles your graveyard into your library.

kept.name: Sarevok's Tome
kept.why: The {3},{T} ability exiles off the top of the library until a nonland card and lets you cast it without paying its mana cost - the textbook impulse plus free cast, none of which was recorded.

kept.name: Shredder, Shadow Master
kept.why: The attack trigger was unread: it triggers on attacking, makes token copies, and sacrifices those tokens at end of combat. The damage trigger makes a player lose half their life.

kept.name: Continue?
kept.why: It returns creature cards from your graveyard, so cares:zone:graveyard was missing. trig:dies is wrong - this is an instant with no triggered ability at all; it merely checks that the cards got there this turn.

kept.name: Pontiff of Blight
kept.why: Extort is "whenever you cast a spell ... each opponent loses 1 life AND YOU GAIN THAT MUCH LIFE". The life gain and the cast trigger were both missing; only the drain half was recorded.

kept.name: Grixis Panorama
kept.why: It searches your library for a basic land and puts it onto the battlefield. The generic library word was there but the land-fetch word - the one that says this is a ramp/fixing effect - was not.

kept.name: Mindblade Render
kept.why: "you draw a card AND YOU LOSE 1 LIFE" - only the draw half was recorded.

kept.name: Lifecraft Engine
kept.why: "Each creature you control of the chosen type ... gets +1/+1" is a static anthem over your whole board, and neither the pump nor its breadth was recorded.

kept.name: Defiant Bloodlord
kept.why: Its whole payoff keys off you gaining life. trig:gains-life records the trigger but nothing said the card cares about lifegain as a theme.

kept.name: Oft-Nabbed Goat
kept.why: The activated ability puts a -1/-1 counter on this creature itself, and the death trigger counts them. Marked -self deliberately so it is not read as a counters-matters card.

kept.name: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker
kept.why: "Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you" - the card had the sacrifice effect but no trigger word at all.

kept.name: Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr // Katilda's Rising Dawn
kept.why: Disturb lets you cast this card from your graveyard, which is exactly the self-recursion shape (unearth, escape, disturb, blitz). cares:zone:graveyard alone does not say it brings itself back.

kept.name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
kept.why: It draws for each creature that died under your control this turn - an aristocrats payoff whose relationship to creatures dying was not recorded anywhere.

kept.name: Gaius van Baelsar
kept.why: The entire enters trigger was unread. It is a modal ("choose one") symmetric edict: every mode makes EACH PLAYER sacrifice something.

kept.name: Blessed Sanctuary
kept.why: "Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control" - the whole first line was unrecorded; only the token half was there.

kept.name: The Queen of Dale
kept.why: Recruit is "draw a card, then discard a card", then a token if the discard was nonland. Only the token was recorded.

kept.name: Gwaihir, Greatest of the Eagles
kept.why: The end-step trigger is gated on "if you gained 3 or more life this turn", so this is a lifegain payoff and nothing said so.

kept.name: Abhorrent Overlord
kept.why: Its enters trigger makes a pile of Harpy tokens equal to your devotion to black - the token facet was missing entirely while the upkeep sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Elspeth, Knight-Errant
kept.why: The -8 is a minus loyalty ability (cost:remove-counters was recorded on the other Liliana in this batch but not here), and the emblem grants indestructible to your artifacts, creatures, enchantments AND lands at once.

kept.name: Vorrac Battlehorns
kept.why: "Equipped creature has trample" - the equipment attached and its equip cost were recorded, but not the keyword it actually grants.

kept.name: Phyrexian Soulgorger
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep. The generic trig:step was there but not which step.

kept.name: Perception Bobblehead
kept.why: It looks at the top X cards of your library and lets you cast one "without paying its mana cost"; only the look-and-pick half was recorded.

kept.name: Hourglass of the Lost
kept.why: The second ability - the whole reason to play the card - was unread. Removing X time counters and exiling it are the costs, and it mass-reanimates EACH nonland permanent card with mana value X from your graveyard.

kept.name: Obsessive Pursuit
kept.why: "When this enchantment enters AND at the beginning of your upkeep, YOU LOSE 1 LIFE and create a Clue" - both triggers and the life loss were all missing; only the attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Killing Wave
kept.why: "unless they pay X life" is the tax clause, and this hits FOR EACH CREATURE including your own board, so it is a symmetric sweeper and should be refused by decks that go wide.

kept.name: Cultist of the Absolute
kept.why: Grants +3/+3 to your commander creatures and nothing recorded the pump. Ward has no word at all.

kept.name: The Seedcore
kept.why: The Corrupted ability gives a 1/1 creature +2/+1 and the list stops at the mana abilities.

kept.name: Dreadhound
kept.why: Second ability triggers on any creature dying or a creature card hitting a graveyard from a library; only the enters-trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Prowess of the Fair
kept.why: Watches Elves going to your graveyard from the battlefield, which is a graveyard-matters card, not just a dies trigger.

kept.name: Reverent Hoplite
kept.why: Its entire effect is making Human Soldier tokens equal to devotion to white, and neither the token making nor the devotion was recorded.

kept.name: Hex Parasite
kept.why: The reminder text states {B/P} can be paid with 2 life, so the ability is payable entirely with life.

kept.name: Skinrender
kept.why: Three -1/-1 counters on a creature is a removal effect that makes it smaller; eff:add-counters alone reads as a counters payoff rather than removal.

kept.name: Heartless Conscription
kept.why: Exiles ALL creatures including yours, so it sweeps your own board, and the payoff is playing the cards while they remain in exile.

kept.name: Skeleton Crew
kept.why: Anthem line giving each other Skeleton or Pirate you control +1/+1 was not recorded.

kept.name: Reprobation
kept.why: Sets the enchanted creature to base power and toughness 0/1; eff:neutralise covers losing abilities but not the P/T change.

kept.name: Static Orb
kept.why: Nothing on this card concerns vigilance; the word came from a scan of 'untap'. Its actual effect, stopping untapping, has no word.

kept.name: Ravenloft Adventurer
kept.why: Replaces the death of every opponent creature with exile and then counts cards in exile with hit counters; only the life loss was recorded.

kept.name: Fungal Fortitude
kept.why: Returns the enchanted creature from the graveyard to the battlefield when it dies; the recursion, which is the whole point of the aura, was missing.

kept.name: Shelob, Dread Weaver
kept.why: Exiles dying opponent creatures, draws a card off the second ability and puts exiled creature cards onto the battlefield under your control. Three of the four abilities were unrecorded.

kept.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
kept.why: For {4} it becomes a 3/3 creature; the manland half of the card was not recorded.

kept.name: Tangled Colony
kept.why: Makes X Rat tokens on death and cannot block; neither its own restriction nor the tokens were recorded.

kept.name: Tenza, Godo's Maul
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1, plus +2/+2 if legendary; the pump was missing entirely and the trample grant is conditional on the creature being red.

kept.name: Radiant Lotus
kept.why: The activation cost is {T} plus the sacrifice, and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Palace Siege
kept.why: Both modes are upkeep triggers and no timing word was recorded.

kept.name: On Serra's Wings
kept.why: Gives +1/+1 alongside the three keywords; only the keyword grants were recorded.

kept.name: Cybership
kept.why: Crew 4 taps other creatures you control, and the damage trigger takes the top two cards of the defending player's library onto the battlefield under YOUR control.

kept.name: Sauron, the Necromancer
kept.why: The attack trigger creates a token that is a copy of an exiled creature card; the copying was not recorded.

kept.name: Cruelclaw's Heist
kept.why: It exiles the chosen nonland card out of the opponent's hand. eff:discard alone understates it as a discard spell.

kept.name: Hidden Necropolis
kept.why: Sacrifices itself as part of the activation cost and Discover 4 exiles from the top of your library and casts the hit without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Shambling Vent
kept.why: Becomes a 2/3 creature with lifelink; the manland half of the card was not recorded.

kept.name: Knight Paladin
kept.why: The 4 damage to each opponent is an enters trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Cloudpost
kept.why: Its mana ability costs {T} and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Acererak the Archlich
kept.why: Returns himself to his owner's hand on entry unless the dungeon is complete, which is the loop the card is built around.

kept.name: Endurance Bobblehead
kept.why: The second ability gives up to X of your creatures +1/+0 as well as indestructible; only the keyword grant was recorded.

kept.name: Ivory Tower
kept.why: Its only ability gains you life each upkeep and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Blinkmoth Urn
kept.why: The mana arrives on a first main phase trigger and no timing word was recorded.

kept.name: Shepherd of Rot
kept.why: Costs {T} to activate, and each player loses the life, so it drains symmetrically rather than only opponents.

kept.name: Serra the Benevolent
kept.why: The +2 pumps your fliers and the emblem stops damage reducing your life below 1; only the token mode was recorded.

kept.name: Angelic Chorus
kept.why: Its only ability gains life equal to the toughness of each creature entering and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Aether Vial
kept.why: The whole point of the card, tapping to put a creature from HAND onto the battlefield, was missing; only the charge counter half was recorded.

kept.name: Entropic Battlecruiser
kept.why: Station puts charge counters on itself equal to the tapped creature's power, so it grows itself and scales with power. It HAS flying and deathtouch at 8+ (already recorded as kw:), it does not grant them to anything, and grants: would read as a keyword granter.

kept.name: Pili-Pala
kept.why: {Q} is the untap SYMBOL in the activation cost - the card untaps itself to pay, it does not untap anything as an effect. cost:untap already records it correctly.

kept.name: Crypt Rats
kept.why: The damage hits each creature AND each player, including you - a symmetric sweeper, not a targeted ping. Neither the breadth nor the self-damage was recorded.

kept.name: Minion's Return
kept.why: The whole point of the card - reanimating the enchanted creature from the graveyard onto the battlefield - was not recorded at all. Only the trigger was.

kept.name: Staff of Eden, Vault's Key
kept.why: The draw ability is '{T}: Draw a card for each permanent...' and the tap cost was never written down (acost:1 is there but cost:tap is not).

kept.name: The Wandering Emperor
kept.why: The +1 also grants first strike until end of turn, which is unrecorded.

kept.name: Michiko's Reign of Truth // Portrait of Michiko
kept.why: Chapter III exiles the Saga itself and returns it transformed. Neither half was recorded; only the pump from chapters I and II.

kept.name: Spitting Dilophosaurus
kept.why: The second ability stops opponents' -1/-1 countered creatures blocking, which is half the card and is unrecorded.

kept.name: Magistrate's Scepter
kept.why: The card's entire payoff - taking an extra turn for three charge counters - was missing, as was the counter-removal cost that pays for it.

kept.name: Abstruse Appropriation
kept.why: You may cast the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled, so the card cares about the exile zone as a place it plays from.

kept.name: Gatta and Luzzu
kept.why: The damage prevention is the whole ability and only the counters half was recorded. Preventing all damage to a creature for a turn is a protection effect.

kept.name: Ironwill Forger
kept.why: The ability grants myriad until end of turn (grants:myriad is already recorded). No power or toughness changes, so the pump is a misreading.

kept.name: Liesa, Shroud of Dusk
kept.why: The first line is explicitly about casting her from the command zone. The life-loss trigger fires on any player casting, which is the tax on opponents; trig:cast-own is deliberately not added because you losing life too is a drawback, not a spellslinger payoff.

kept.name: All-Fates Scroll
kept.why: The draw ability sacrifices the artifact as part of its cost and that was unrecorded.

kept.name: Aetherflux Conduit
kept.why: Most of the card was missing: the energy counters go on you, the amount keys off mana spent, the ability is a tap ability, and the payoff is casting any number of spells for free.

kept.name: Myr Enforcer
kept.why: Affinity for artifacts is a cost reduction on itself and nothing recorded that the card gets cheaper; cares:type:artifact alone says only that it looks at artifacts.

kept.name: Abstruse Archaic
kept.why: The card's only ability copies an activated or triggered ability and neither the copying nor the tap cost was recorded. Not eff:multiply-triggers, since it copies activated abilities too.

kept.name: Font of Agonies
kept.why: The blood counters go onto the enchantment itself and that accumulation was unrecorded; only the removal cost and the destroy were.

kept.name: Pact Weapon
kept.why: Almost nothing on this card was recorded. It is an Equipment that attaches, its attack trigger draws a card and pumps the creature, and its equip cost is discarding a card.

kept.name: Lantern of Insight
kept.why: The activated ability is '{T}, Sacrifice: Target player shuffles' - the tap cost and the shuffle were both missing.

kept.name: Oblivion Stone
kept.why: The card is a symmetric board wipe that destroys your own permanents too, and it sacrifices itself to do it, then removes all fate counters. Only 'destroys' was recorded.

kept.name: Fractured Powerstone
kept.why: The second ability rolls the planar die, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Case of the Uneaten Feast
kept.why: The solve condition is a lifegain threshold, the solved ability sacrifices the Case, and it lets you cast creature cards from your graveyard rather than returning them.

kept.name: Splinter's Technique
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative casting cost that requires returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand, and no cost word recorded it.

kept.name: Apothecary White
kept.why: 'Whenever you attack' is the card's main trigger and it was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Steel Seraph
kept.why: The combat trigger offers a choice of three keywords and only vigilance was recorded; the choice itself is also part of what the card does.

kept.name: Mindslicer
kept.why: Each player discards their hand, including you - the symmetry and the self-discard are the whole reason to play or fear the card.

kept.name: Sewer Nemesis
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unread. "As this creature enters, choose a player" is an enters trigger on itself. Its power and toughness are DEFINED by the chosen player's graveyard, which is eff:set-pt. And "whenever the chosen player casts a spell" is a cast trigger - the mill is already there but nothing said what makes it happen.

kept.name: Out of Time
kept.why: Only the untap was read. It untaps and phases out ALL creatures, so scope:all, and grants:phasing is the vocabulary's only phasing word. Vanishing is real card text: an upkeep trigger that removes a counter and then sacrifices it. Deliberately NOT adding eff:add-counters-self for the time counters - its gloss is "grows itself with counters" and a time counter is a fuse, not growth.

kept.name: Benevolent Bodyguard
kept.why: The card's entire purpose is saving a creature from removal by giving it protection from a colour, and eff:protect ("keeps your creatures alive") is exactly that. Left eff:pump alone because the file's convention is that any "gains X until end of turn" carries it (Nezumi Prowler does the same for deathtouch and lifelink).

kept.name: Osteomancer Adept
kept.why: It lets you cast creature spells from your graveyard, which is eff:cast-from-graveyard verbatim, and the ability costs {T}. Left eff:return-from in place: it is loose here, but it is the only word carrying the reanimation signal and removing it would cost more than it gains.

kept.name: Fell Stinger
kept.why: Exploit is a printed enters trigger that sacrifices a creature - "when this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature" - and none of that was recorded. Only the reflexive draw/drain half had been read.

kept.name: Soldevi Adnate
kept.why: The ability is "{T}, Sacrifice a black or artifact creature". The sacrifice half was recorded and the tap half was not.

kept.name: Rodolf Duskbringer
kept.why: He returns a creature with mana value X or less "where X is the amount of life you gained this turn" - the deck is built on how MUCH life is gained, not merely that it happens, which is what cares:lifegain says beyond the trig:gains-life already present. And "you may pay {1}{W/B}. When you do..." is the pay-for-more template eff:do-if-cost-paid describes.

kept.name: Arcbound Crusher
kept.why: Modular's second half was unread: "when it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature" is a death trigger that puts counters on ANOTHER creature, which the existing -self word cannot say.

kept.name: Golden Argosy
kept.why: The card carried nothing but trig:attacks. It exiles your own crew and returns them at the next end step, which is a blink - eff:exile-own plus eff:return-from plus the delayed end-step trigger. Crew taps creatures you control as a cost, which is cost:tap-others.

kept.name: Ominous Cemetery
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. Exiling the land itself is the activation cost, and shuffling a creature into its owner's library is a zone move - the removal half of the card was entirely absent.

kept.name: Lamentation
kept.why: The whole Encore ability was unread. It is activated from the graveyard by exiling itself, makes a token copy per opponent, gives them haste, and sacrifices them at the next end step. Only the enters-trigger half of the card had been recorded.

kept.name: Endless One
kept.why: Its cost is {X} alone, so its mana value is 0 anywhere but the stack and it reads as a two-drop. It is not a cheap card - it is whatever you pay for it - and offering it to a deck that asked for cheap creatures is wrong. Same artefact as Hangarback Walker, Walking Ballista and Chalice of the Void.

kept.name: Hopeless Nightmare
kept.why: "Each opponent discards a card and loses 2 life" hits the whole table, which is the same reading South Wind Avatar and Sling-Gang Lieutenant already carry for their each-opponent clauses.

kept.name: Myrkul's Edict
kept.why: Two of its three outcomes are "each opponent sacrifices a creature", so the card is a table-wide edict rather than a single-target one. Did NOT add cares:power for the 20 result - naming the greatest-power creature as a tie-break does not make this a power-matters card.

kept.name: Voracious Vermin
kept.why: The card makes a 1/1 Rat token on arrival and nothing said so. It was recorded only as a card that grows on deaths, which loses half of what it does and the half that feeds the other half.

kept.name: Hidden Blade
kept.why: "If that creature is an Assassin, it gains deathtouch until end of turn" - the first strike grant was recorded and the deathtouch grant was not.

kept.name: Faerie Bladecrafter
kept.why: "Whenever one or more Faeries you control deal combat damage to a player" is a damage trigger and nothing recorded it, so the card looked like it grew for no reason. The death trigger drains EACH opponent, which is scope:all.

kept.name: Dalkovan Packbeasts
kept.why: Mobilize's tokens are sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step. That end-step trigger and the sacrifice are printed card text and both were missing, which matters because it is the difference between a token generator and a temporary attacker.

kept.name: Wall of Junk
kept.why: It returns itself to your hand when it blocks, and the standing rule is that a CREATURE returning itself still counts as eff:bounce-own - Whitemane Lion's own re-entry is the recast. The card had no effect word at all.

kept.name: Armix, Filigree Thrasher
kept.why: Giving a defender's creature -X/-X is the entire point of the card and no effect word recorded it, so a repeatable removal engine read as a golem that discards. "You may discard a card. When you do..." is the pay-for-more template.

kept.name: River Song's Diary
kept.why: The Imprint clause was unread entirely: it triggers on any player casting an instant or sorcery and exiles that spell. The upkeep half then chooses one of the exiled cards AT RANDOM, which is eff:random, and the whole card is built on its own exile zone.

kept.name: Blood Tribute
kept.why: Kicker here is an additional cost paid AS YOU CAST, which cost:cast-tap-others says and the plain cost:tap-others does not, and "if this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to the life lost" is the pay-for-more shape exactly.

kept.name: Endless Sands
kept.why: The third ability - sacrifice the land to return EVERY creature it exiled - was unread. Without it the card looks like it only exiles your own creatures, which is a downside rather than a blink engine.

kept.name: South Wind Avatar
kept.why: "You gain life equal to its toughness" was missing, and it is the first half of the card's own loop: the deaths gain life, and the lifegain then drains the table. Only the drain end was recorded.

kept.name: Nezumi Prowler
kept.why: Ninjutsu was unread. It returns an unblocked attacker to hand as a cost and puts this card onto the battlefield from hand, which is precisely what eff:put-onto-battlefield describes.

kept.name: Eternal Scourge
kept.why: The card exiles ITSELF when an opponent targets it, and that trigger and that effect were both absent - the whole reason it survives removal and can be recast. Left eff:return-from alone: loose, but it is the only word saying the card comes back.

kept.name: Kaya the Inexorable
kept.why: The emblem casts legendary spells without paying their mana cost, which is eff:cast-free, and the ghostform counter grants a dies-or-exiled trigger that nothing recorded. Did not add grants:flying - the flying belongs to the token, not to a creature being granted anything.

kept.name: Visions of Glory
kept.why: {5}{W} is mana value 6, which is the mv:big threshold, and it was missing. Deploy to the Front in the same batch carries it at 7. Did NOT add eff:reduce-cost for the flashback discount - it reduces only its own cost, and that word means making spells generally cheaper.

kept.name: Stony Silence
kept.why: The card had NO effect word at all - its entire text is "activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated" and eff:cant-activate says exactly that. As it stood the engine knew nothing about what this card does.

kept.name: Fang, Fearless l'Cie
kept.why: "Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard" had no trigger word, so a card that draws off graveyard movement read as a creature that draws for no stated reason. trig:leaves would be wrong - that is about leaving the battlefield.

kept.name: Bloatfly Swarm
kept.why: The replacement effect does three things and none were recorded: it prevents the damage, removes that many +1/+1 counters from itself, and gives EACH PLAYER a rad counter, which is a counter on a player.

kept.name: Elspeth Resplendent
kept.why: The +1 puts a keyword counter from among flying, first strike, lifelink or vigilance; only vigilance was recorded, so three of the four grants were missing. The -3 digs seven cards deep into your library.

kept.name: Final Vengeance
kept.why: It exiles ONE target creature and the additional cost sacrifices one creature or enchantment. Nothing here touches everything.

kept.name: Lord Skitter's Butcher
kept.why: The first mode creates a 1/1 black Rat token and no token-making word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Ultron, Artificial Malevolence
kept.why: The token is a COPY of the artifact that entered, which is the whole card and was unrecorded. It is gated on 'you may pay {2}. If you do', and a non-creature copy becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain creature, which is animating a permanent.

kept.name: Gravelighter
kept.why: The 'otherwise' half is an edict on EVERY player and was entirely missing, so the list read as though the card only drew a card.

kept.name: Servo Schematic
kept.why: The card's only ability creates a Servo token and eff:create-token was absent. Its trigger is on this artifact itself entering, not on another permanent.

kept.name: Lake of the Dead
kept.why: A mana land that sacrifices a single Swamp. No effect reaches more than one permanent.

kept.name: Emperor of Bones
kept.why: The reanimated creature explicitly gains haste. The card exiles cards from graveyards and then returns cards exiled WITH IT, so the exile zone is where its whole engine lives.

kept.name: Conspiracy
kept.why: It changes the type of every creature you control, plus your creature spells and creature cards elsewhere. That is a board-wide static effect.

kept.name: Clackbridge Troll
kept.why: The combat trigger makes an opponent sacrifice a creature and pays you 3 life and a card. All three halves of the payoff were missing, leaving the card looking like it only makes Goats for an opponent.

kept.name: Go-Shintai of Shared Purpose
kept.why: The end step trigger is 'you may pay {1}. If you do, create...' - the tokens are gated behind an optional payment.

kept.name: Gideon's Sacrifice
kept.why: It does not prevent the damage, it redirects ALL damage that would be dealt to you and every permanent you control onto one chosen permanent. eff:redirect-damage is the exact word for it.

kept.name: Oblation
kept.why: The permanent is shuffled into its owner's library, which is a genuine shuffle effect and not merely a zone move.

kept.name: Bandit's Haul
kept.why: Committing a crime puts a loot counter on this artifact itself, which is what fuels the draw ability.

kept.name: Nihil Spellbomb
kept.why: The card's entire purpose - exiling a player's graveyard - was unrecorded, so the most played piece of cheap graveyard hate in the format read as 'an artifact that draws a card'. Its activation costs a tap and sacrificing itself, and the replacement draw is gated on paying {B}.

kept.name: Mariposa Military Base
kept.why: 'you get two rad counters' puts counters on a player, which is exactly eff:player-counter and is the cost that makes the draw ability affordable.

kept.name: Street Wraith
kept.why: Its cycling cost is paying 2 life and discarding the card. Neither was recorded, so the reason this card is played at all - a free cantrip paid for with life rather than mana - was invisible.

kept.name: Citadel Siege
kept.why: Both modes trigger at the beginning of combat and no trigger word was recorded at all. A mode is locked in by a choice made as the enchantment enters, matching how the same wording is read on Conspiracy and Progenitor's Icon.

kept.name: Thieving Amalgam
kept.why: The second ability triggers on a creature you control but do not own dying, and pays you 2 life as well as draining its owner. The trigger and the lifegain half were both missing.

kept.name: Verge Rangers
kept.why: Playing lands off the top of your library is a statement about lands in your library and is the card's whole function beyond first strike.

kept.name: Dimir House Guard
kept.why: Regenerating itself off a sacrifice is a keep-it-alive effect, matching how Crypt Sliver is read. Transmute costs discarding this card and searches your library.

kept.name: March from the Black Gate
kept.why: It amasses when it enters AND whenever an Army you control attacks. No trigger word was recorded, so a repeatable attack payoff read as a one-shot enchantment.

kept.name: Greymond, Avacyn's Stalwart
kept.why: Two abilities are chosen from among first strike, vigilance and lifelink and handed to every Human you control; only the vigilance grant was recorded. The choice itself is made as it enters, the same shape already read on Conspiracy.

kept.name: Phyrexian Revoker
kept.why: A nonland card name is chosen as it enters, which is the same 'choose as it enters' shape already recorded on Conspiracy and Progenitor's Icon.

kept.name: Doomsday Excruciator
kept.why: The enters trigger exiles all but the bottom six cards of EVERY player's library. That is the defining effect of the card and none of it was recorded - the list described a flier that draws a card each upkeep.

kept.name: Szat's Will
kept.why: The second mode creates X 0/1 Thrull tokens and no token-making word was present.

kept.name: Scaretiller
kept.why: The first mode puts a land card from your HAND straight onto the battlefield, which is precisely eff:put-onto-battlefield. scope:all is wrong because each mode touches a single land.

kept.name: Sword of the Paruns
kept.why: Both static abilities give your creatures +2/+0 or +0/+2 and no pump word was recorded. The {3} ability taps or untaps your own equipped creature, which is why this card is played as an untapper.

kept.name: Shardmage's Rescue
kept.why: The hexproof grant is the reason this card is played as a flash protection trick and it was missing entirely. As an Aura it attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Academy Rector
kept.why: It searches out a single enchantment. Nothing here affects a board.

kept.name: Offer Immortality
kept.why: Granting indestructible at instant speed is a save-your-creature effect, matching how regeneration is read on Crypt Sliver.

kept.name: Smallpox
kept.why: There is no sacrifice COST on this card - the sacrifices are the effect, already recorded as eff:sacrifice. cost:sacrifice marks a repeatable sacrifice outlet, and reading Smallpox as an outlet would put it in aristocrats decks as an engine piece when it is a symmetric one-shot.

kept.name: Polluted Cistern // Dim Oubliette
kept.why: The front half triggers on cards going to your graveyard FROM YOUR LIBRARY, which is a self-mill payoff. The library half of that trigger was not recorded.

kept.name: Skullsnatcher
kept.why: Its combat trigger exiles up to two cards from the damaged player's graveyard. That is graveyard hate and the entire second line of the card was unread.

kept.name: Sojourner's Companion
kept.why: Landcycling discards this card as its cost and searches the library; affinity for artifacts is a cost reduction on its own casting cost, which is the whole of the first line.

kept.name: Sidisi, Regent of the Mire
kept.why: The reanimation ability costs {T} as well as a sacrifice; the tap half of the cost was missing.

kept.name: Nine Lives
kept.why: Three of its four lines were unread: it prevents all damage to you, puts incarnation counters on itself, and exiles itself at nine.

kept.name: Assassin Initiate
kept.why: The ability grants a choice of flying, deathtouch OR lifelink. Only deathtouch was recorded.

kept.name: Necrogen Mists
kept.why: It is symmetric - EACH player discards on their upkeep, you included - and nothing recorded that it hits everyone.

kept.name: Scrapyard Recombiner
kept.why: Modular puts its counters on another creature WHEN IT DIES, so the death trigger belongs. Nothing on the card affects everything: it targets one artifact creature and searches for one Construct, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Asmodeus the Archfiend
kept.why: Two of his three abilities were unread: the binding contract exiles the top of your library face down, and the third ability returns everything exiled with him to hand at the cost of that much life.

kept.name: Getaway Glamer
kept.why: The first mode exiles a creature and nothing recorded the exile itself; the second mode is conditional on no other creature having greater power, which is a power-matters clause.

kept.name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on a WHITE creature attacking, which is a real colour-matters condition and was not recorded.

kept.name: Sandstorm Verge
kept.why: The whole second ability - target creature can't block this turn - was unread; only the mana ability was recorded.

kept.name: Celestial Mantle
kept.why: It is an Aura, so it attaches to a creature, and doubling its controller's life total is a lifegain effect. Only the +3/+3 was recorded.

kept.name: Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
kept.why: The trigger is on entering OR ATTACKING and the attack half was missing; it is a modal 'choose one'; and airbend exiles another nonland permanent YOU control, which is the second mode and was entirely unread.

kept.name: Jolted Awake
kept.why: The reanimation is conditional - you MAY pay energy equal to the card's mana value, and only if you do does it return. That optional payment gate was not recorded.

kept.name: Reidane, God of the Worthy // Valkmira, Protector's Shield
kept.why: The back face's last line counters the spell or ability unless its controller pays {1}. Both the counter and the tax were missing.

kept.name: Dream-Thief's Bandana
kept.why: The combat trigger exiles the top card of the defending player's library and lets you play it - impulse draw off their deck. The entire trigger body was unread; only that it had a trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Rot-Curse Rakshasa
kept.why: Renew puts a decayed counter on each of X target creatures and nothing recorded that it puts counters at all; decayed means this creature itself can't block.

kept.name: Hostile Negotiations
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread. It digs six deep off your library, you look at both piles and one ends in your hand while the other goes to your graveyard; only the 3 life was recorded.

kept.name: Crawling Chorus
kept.why: Its death trigger creates a Phyrexian Mite token and the card carried no token-making word at all, only the printed tok: entry.

kept.name: Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor
kept.why: Undying returns this creature from the graveyard to the battlefield, which is precisely bringing itself back and was not recorded.

kept.name: Lapse of Certainty
kept.why: It is a counterspell and nothing recorded that it interacts with the stack.

kept.name: Energybending
kept.why: It affects every land you control at once, which was not recorded; only the cantrip was.

kept.name: Planar Disruption
kept.why: Stopping a permanent attacking, blocking and using abilities without destroying it IS turning it into something harmless - this is the Pacifism shape, and without eff:neutralise the card can be offered for no removal job at all. It is also an Aura, so it attaches.

kept.name: Clarion Conqueror
kept.why: Its entire second line shuts off activated abilities of artifacts, creatures and planeswalkers, and no word recorded that. Only scope:all was there, with nothing for it to scope.

kept.name: Racers' Scoreboard
kept.why: "Max speed — Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast" is a blanket cost change over every spell you cast, the same shape as Thorn of Amethyst's global tax, which carries scope:all.

kept.name: Caustic Bronco
kept.why: Saddle 3 is paid by tapping any number of OTHER creatures you control. That is a genuine tap-your-team cost and nothing in the list said so.

kept.name: Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts
kept.why: The whole first half of her trigger was unread: "whenever a creature deals combat damage to you" (an event she is DEALT, hence trig:dealt-damage) "destroy that creature". She is a repeatable removal engine and carried no removal verb at all. eff:cant-be-blocked left alone: protection from creatures genuinely means no creature can block her.

kept.name: Interdimensional Web Watch
kept.why: The mana ability is "{T}: Add two mana" and no tap cost was recorded, unlike every other tap-for-mana card in this batch. It also exiles the top two cards of your library, so the library is a zone it reads.

kept.name: Layla Hassan
kept.why: Her entire ability was missing. "When Layla Hassan enters AND whenever Assassins deal combat damage, return target historic card from your GRAVEYARD to your hand" — only the damage trigger was read, so the enters trigger and the recursion itself were both absent.

kept.name: Glimmerpost
kept.why: "You gain 1 life for each Locus on the battlefield" is the only thing this land does beyond tapping for mana, and the lifegain was not written down.

kept.name: Batwing Brume
kept.why: Both halves are gated on WHICH mana paid for it ("if {W} was spent", "if {B} was spent"), which is exactly cares:mana-spent. The prevention is of ALL combat damage this turn and the drain hits each player, so it is a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Historian's Boon
kept.why: The trigger reads "whenever THIS enchantment or another nontoken enchantment you control enters". Only the other-permanent half was recorded; it triggers off its own arrival too.

kept.name: Vault 12: The Necropolis
kept.why: Chapter II creates X Zombie Mutant tokens and nothing said the card makes tokens at all. Chapter I gives each PLAYER three rad counters, which is counters on players, not on permanents.

kept.name: Foulmire Knight // Profane Insight
kept.why: The Adventure half is "You draw a card and you lose 1 life". The draw was read and the life loss was dropped.

kept.name: Laser Screwdriver
kept.why: "{3}, {T}: Goad target creature" is a real effect and only the printed keyword marker was present, so nothing looking for goad effects could find it.

kept.name: Benevolent Offering
kept.why: "You and that player each create three 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying" — six tokens, and the card was not marked as making tokens at all.

kept.name: Glaring Spotlight
kept.why: Its main line exists purely to read opponents' hexproof creatures and switch that keyword off. It cares about hexproof in the strongest possible sense.

kept.name: Aang's Iceberg
