kept.why: This is an Oblivion Ring: "exile up to one other target nonland permanent until this enchantment leaves the battlefield". The exile removal was completely unread, only the scry survived. It also sacrifices itself for the waterbend ability, and the exile ends when it leaves the battlefield.

kept.name: Phyrexia's Core
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything: it taps for {C}, or eats one artifact for 1 life. scope:all is a false positive from the generic "an artifact" selector.

kept.name: Dokuchi Silencer
kept.why: The removal is paid for by discarding a creature card from hand, and ninjutsu's cost is returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand. Both are real costs the list did not carry.

kept.name: Three Blind Mice
kept.why: Chapters II and III "create a token that's a copy of target token you control". Token copying is the middle two thirds of the Saga and no copy verb was present.

kept.name: Crabomination
kept.why: Only the free cast was read. It exiles from an opponent's library, their GRAVEYARD (real graveyard hate) and their hand, then casts from exile. Emerge is an alternative cost that sacrifices an artifact to cast it.

kept.name: Spectacular Tactics
kept.why: The destroy mode is "target creature with power 4 or greater" — any creature, so eff:destroy-own is simply wrong and would read as sacrificing your own board. The power restriction is what the card actually keys on.

kept.name: Curse of Fool's Wisdom
kept.why: "Whenever enchanted player draws a card" is the trigger the whole card runs on, and no trigger word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Wedding Announcement // Wedding Festivity
kept.why: The back face, Wedding Festivity, is "Creatures you control get +1/+1" — a team anthem that was entirely unread. The front face also transforms itself at three counters, and only the printed keyword marked that.

kept.name: Anrakyr the Traveller
kept.why: He returns nothing. He lets you CAST an artifact spell from your hand or graveyard for life instead of mana, which is what eff:cast-from-graveyard is for. eff:return-from would file him as a reanimator that puts cards back in hand, which he never does.

kept.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
kept.why: "Whenever another permanent you control leaves the battlefield" is her token trigger and no trigger word was present, so nothing could connect her to sacrifice or blink.

kept.name: Gix's Command
kept.why: The first mode ends "It gains lifelink until end of turn" and the keyword grant was dropped. Not marked scope:wipe: "destroy each creature with power 2 or less" is a filtered sweeper, not a whole-board one.

kept.name: Ringwraiths
kept.why: "When the Ring tempts you, return THIS CARD from your graveyard to your hand." It brings itself back, which is a different and much more useful fact than the generic return already listed.

kept.name: Night Market
kept.why: It is a land whose mana ability was never read: "{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color". Only the cycling half was recorded, so it looked like a cantrip with no mana at all.

kept.name: Environmental Sciences
kept.why: The search ends "then shuffle", which was not recorded. Nothing about fetching one basic land affects everything, so scope:all is a false positive.

kept.name: Candelabra of Tawnos
kept.why: "{X}, {T}: Untap X target lands" — the tap half of the activation cost was missing.

kept.name: Spirit Loop
kept.why: "Whenever enchanted creature deals damage, you gain that much life" is the card's purpose and the lifegain was missing entirely. It is an Aura that enchants a creature, so it attaches, and it returns ITSELF from the graveyard to hand every time it falls off, which is self-recursion rather than a generic return.

kept.name: Sunscape Familiar
kept.why: Blue spells you cast cost less, so it is a colour-matters card for blue. There is no green word in the vocabulary at all, which is why the other half of the same sentence cannot be recorded.

kept.name: Blightwing Bandit
kept.why: It exiles the top card of an opponent's library face down and lets you PLAY it, which is impulse draw off someone else's deck, not milling - nothing goes to a graveyard. The trigger is on spells YOU cast, so it wants the -own form.

kept.name: Elena, Turk Recruit
kept.why: Half the card is unrecorded. The enters trigger returns a card from your graveyard to your hand, and the second ability is a cast trigger on your own historic spells. Only the counter half was read.

kept.name: Archghoul of Thraben
kept.why: Only the dies trigger was recorded and none of what the trigger DOES. It looks at the top card of your library, may put it into your hand, and otherwise may put it into your graveyard - a repeatable card-advantage and self-mill engine for Zombie decks.

kept.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
kept.why: Nothing but keywords and the phase trigger was read. Both faces pay mana to transform themselves, and the back face gives persist to each other nontoken creature you control, which is a whole-board static grant.

kept.name: Erebos's Intervention
kept.why: It is modal and the second mode is missing entirely - exiling up to twice X cards from graveyards is real graveyard hate and the card reads as pure creature removal without it.

kept.name: Lord Skitter's Blessing
kept.why: The enters trigger creates a Role token attached to a creature you control, which is both a token and an attachment, and the draw step trigger draws an additional card. Only the life loss half was recorded.

kept.name: Esper Panorama
kept.why: It searches for a basic land specifically. cares:zone:library is there but the land-fetch word is what separates a fetch land from a creature tutor.

kept.name: Sunken Citadel
kept.why: Both mana abilities are {T} costs and the tap cost is missing. This is the thinnest list in the batch.

kept.name: Tourach, Dread Cantor
kept.why: Kicker is exactly a pay-more-get-more cost, and the enters trigger only does anything if it was kicked. Nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Altar of the Pantheon
kept.why: The mana ability gains you 1 life whenever you control a God, Demigod or legendary enchantment. Only the mana half was read.

kept.name: Dino DNA
kept.why: The whole payoff is creating a token that is a COPY of a creature card exiled with this artifact. Neither the copying nor the exile zone it reads from was recorded.

kept.name: Battle at the Helvault
kept.why: Chapter III creates Avacyn, an 8/8 Angel token. The exile chapters were read and the token chapter was not.

kept.name: Make Your Move
kept.why: The creature half is gated on power 4 or greater, which is a power check the list does not carry.

kept.name: Crumb and Get It
kept.why: Gift is an optional additional cost and the indestructible half only happens if the gift was promised. Deliberately not adding eff:create-token: the Food token is created by the OPPONENT, so counting it would put this in a token deck for a card that makes tokens for someone else.

kept.name: The Celestus
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. The day/night trigger gains you 1 life and loots - draw a card then discard a card - which is the card's actual reason to be in a deck.

kept.name: Faith's Reward
kept.why: This is a one-shot instant with no triggered ability at all, so trig:dies is wrong and would file it as an aristocrats dies-trigger card. What it does have is a mass return of every permanent that hit your graveyard from the battlefield this turn, which is a scope:all effect.

kept.name: Glorious Protector
kept.why: Nothing the card does was recorded, only its keywords and that it enters. Flashing it in to exile your own creatures until it leaves is a blink and a board-wipe dodge, and the return is a delayed trigger on this creature leaving.

kept.name: Signal Pest
kept.why: Battle cry is the entire card: each other attacking creature gets +1/+0, a mass pump every time it attacks. The list records the attack trigger and not what the trigger does.

kept.name: Aang, the Last Airbender
kept.why: The second ability is a cast trigger on your own Lesson spells that grants lifelink, and none of it was recorded. The airbent permanent stays exiled and castable from there, so the exile zone matters too.

kept.name: Incremental Blight
kept.why: It puts six -1/-1 counters across three creatures. eff:shrink was recorded but the counter-placing was not, and this is a card a -1/-1 counters deck wants.

kept.name: Perimeter Captain
kept.why: The trigger is on a creature you control with defender BLOCKING, which trig:blocks already covers. trig:becomes-blocked means this creature was blocked by something, which never happens - it has defender and cannot attack.

kept.name: Revenge of the Rats
kept.why: Flashback lets you cast it a second time from your graveyard, which is the same self-recursion shape as unearth, escape and 'you may cast this from your graveyard'.

kept.name: Retreat to Emeria
kept.why: It is modal on every landfall trigger - choose the token or the team pump. Both modes are recorded but not that you pick between them.

kept.name: Jirina, Dauntless General
kept.why: The enters trigger exiles a player's entire graveyard, which is graveyard hate and was not recorded at all. Only the sacrifice ability was read.

kept.name: Nimblewright Schematic
kept.why: The card's only ability creates a Construct token, twice over - on entering and on dying - and the token creation is missing entirely. The enters trigger is on this artifact itself.

kept.name: Hall of Tagsin
kept.why: The third ability creates a Powerstone token. Only the two mana abilities were read.

kept.name: Akroma's Vengeance
kept.why: Destroys all artifacts, creatures and enchantments with no restriction to opponents, so it takes your own board down too. That is the narrow sense scope:wipe is for; scope:all alone does not say the deck's own permanents die.

kept.name: Nadaar, Selfless Paladin
kept.why: "Other creatures you control get +1/+1 as long as you've completed a dungeon" is an anthem and produced no facet at all - the card reads as a bare venture trigger.

kept.name: The Speed Demon
kept.why: "you draw X cards and lose X life" - the draw half was recorded and the life half was not. Faerie Dreamthief and Mastermind Plum carry eff:lose-life for the identical "draw and lose life" wording.

kept.name: The Peregrine Dynamo
kept.why: The card's only ability is "{1}, {T}: Copy target activated or triggered ability" and neither the tap cost nor the copying was written down - it carries no eff: word whatever. Deliberately not eff:multiply-triggers, since it copies activated abilities as readily as triggered ones.

kept.name: Leonin Lightscribe
kept.why: Magecraft is "whenever YOU cast or copy an INSTANT OR SORCERY". Only the bare trig:cast was recorded, so nothing says whose spells or which kind - which is exactly the distinction that separates a spellslinger payoff from a stax card.

kept.name: Temporal Extortion
kept.why: "any player may pay half their life... If a player does, counter Temporal Extortion" is a tax clause and produced nothing. Not adding eff:counter: the spell counters ITSELF, and reading that as a counterspell would file an extra-turn sorcery as interaction.

kept.name: Company Commander
kept.why: Both abilities were missing entirely. It makes a Soldier token per opponent on entry, and on attack gives every creature you control deathtouch. The list held only the ETB trigger with nothing attached to it.

kept.name: Invasion of Fiora // Marchesa, Resolute Monarch
kept.why: "Choose one or both" is modal and unrecorded; both modes together destroy every creature including yours, which is scope:wipe rather than a one-sided sweep. The back face's attack trigger and its whole upkeep clause (draw a card, lose 1 life) produced nothing at all.

kept.name: Loyal Unicorn
kept.why: The lieutenant clause prevents all combat damage to your creatures - a fog for your board, unrecorded. eff:pump is wrong: nothing on this card changes power or toughness, it grants vigilance only, and reading it as a combat pump misfiles a protective effect.

kept.name: Sentinel's Eyes
kept.why: Escape is "{W}, Exile two other cards from your graveyard". eff:recur-self records that it comes back; nothing recorded what paying for it costs, which is what makes it a graveyard-fuel card.

kept.name: Mastermind Plum
kept.why: "if mana from a Treasure was spent to cast it" is precisely cares:mana-spent and was missing. The Treasures it makes are mana sources, so the card ramps - Noble's Purse in this same batch carries eff:add-mana off the identical Treasure reminder.

kept.name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian // Braska's Final Aeon
kept.why: "return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control" - the exile and the return were both recorded and the transform, which is the whole point of the trigger, was not.

kept.name: Hooded Blightfang
kept.why: "destroy that planeswalker" produced nothing. The card is a genuine removal engine in a deathtouch deck and carried only the drain half.

kept.name: Kaervek, the Punisher
kept.why: The payoff is casting a copy of a black card sitting in your graveyard, which is graveyard recursion; eff:copy alone reads as a copy-spell card. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard - it exiles from YOUR OWN graveyard as fuel, and that word means graveyard hate, which would mark a graveyard commander as anti-synergy with its own deck.

kept.name: Crawling Barrens
kept.why: "you may have it become a 0/0 Elemental creature" is animation and produced nothing - the counters were recorded but not what they are for. It also produces {C} only and has an empty colour identity, so col:none is simply true of it.

kept.name: Scorched Ruins
kept.why: It taps for {C}{C}{C}{C} and has no colour identity at all, so col:none belongs. Nothing added for the two-land sacrifice: cost:sacrifice means an on-demand outlet, and treating an entry replacement as one would offer this land to aristocrats decks as a sac outlet.

kept.name: Vile Mutilator
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or enchantment" is unrecorded, and it is the clause that makes this a payoff for a deck already sacrificing things rather than a plain seven-drop.

kept.name: Burakos, Party Leader
kept.why: The X Treasure tokens are mana sources, so the card ramps on every attack; only the token creation was recorded. Same reasoning as Noble's Purse, which carries eff:add-mana off the same Treasure reminder text.

kept.name: Mazemind Tome
kept.why: Both activated abilities need {T} and both put a page counter on it as part of the cost, and neither cost was written down. The fourth counter exiles the card itself, which is why it eventually leaves the board for 4 life - also unrecorded.

kept.name: Ultramarines Honour Guard
kept.why: Squad's token copies come from a real triggered ability, "When this creature enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it". eff:copy and eff:create-token were recorded with nothing saying when they happen.

kept.name: Plague Drone
kept.why: "If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead" is a lifegain replacement and the card carried only eff:lose-life, which reads as a plain drain.

kept.name: Darksteel Splicer
kept.why: "Whenever THIS CREATURE or another nontoken Phyrexian you control enters" - it triggers on its own arrival as well as on others, so it wants trig:enters-self beside the trig:enters-other it already has.

kept.name: Unexplained Absence
kept.why: "For EACH PLAYER, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls" - this is a symmetrical multi-permanent exile, not a single-target removal spell.

kept.name: Starscream, Power Hungry // Starscream, Seeker Leader
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unread. "Whenever Starscream deals combat damage to a player" is trig:deals-damage; "that player becomes the monarch" is eff:set-monarch, and the card is a monarch engine on both faces; "convert Starscream" appears twice and converting is turning it to its other face. The record held only the draw trigger and the life loss.

kept.name: The Rise of Sozin // Fire Lord Sozin
kept.why: Chapter I is "Destroy all creatures", which destroys YOUR board too - eff:destroy plus scope:all does not say that, and scope:wipe is what keeps a wipe out of a go-wide deck. Chapter III is "Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed", an exile of itself followed by a transform; neither was recorded.

kept.name: Shakedown Heavy
kept.why: Everything after the trigger was unread. "defending player may have YOU DRAW A CARD. If they do, UNTAP this creature and remove it from combat" - drawing cards is the whole point of the card and it had no eff:draw at all.

kept.name: Rankle's Prank
kept.why: Only two of the three modes were read. "Each player sacrifices two creatures" is eff:sacrifice; "Choose one or more" makes it modal; every mode says EACH PLAYER, so it is symmetrical, and "each player discards two cards" includes you (Memory Jar in this same batch carries both eff:discard and eff:discard-self for the same shape).

kept.name: Case of the Stashed Skeleton
kept.why: "When this Case enters, CREATE a 2/1 black Skeleton creature token and suspect it." It already carries tok:skeleton but no verb saying it makes a token, so nothing looking for token makers can find it.

kept.name: Tainted Remedy
kept.why: The entire card is a lifegain replacement - "If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead" - and it carried nothing saying it cares about life gain. It applies to every opponent continuously, not to one target.

kept.name: Soulcatchers' Aerie
kept.why: "Whenever a Bird is PUT INTO YOUR GRAVEYARD FROM THE BATTLEFIELD" is a dies trigger, and "put a feather counter on THIS ENCHANTMENT" is a counter it places on itself. Only the resulting pump was recorded, so the trigger and the counter engine were invisible.

kept.name: Rune of Sustenance
kept.why: "As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, IT HAS LIFELINK", and the Equipment clause grants lifelink onward too. The card carried only the cantrip; the keyword grant it exists to give was missing.

kept.name: Nemesis Mask
kept.why: "ALL creatures able to block equipped creature DO SO" was read as nothing at all - the record held only eff:attach. This is the definitive lure effect.

kept.name: Acclaimed Contender
kept.why: The card exiles nothing. It looks at the top five, puts one in HAND and the rest on the bottom of the library. eff:impulse means exiling off the top to play the cards, and cares:zone:exile says it cares about the exile zone; both are false and would file a Knight tutor as an impulse-draw card.

kept.name: Exsanguinator Cavalry
kept.why: "...and CREATE A BLOOD TOKEN" - it carries cares:sub:blood but no verb saying it makes one. It also has printed lifelink, which gains life (Vampire Cutthroat in this same batch carries eff:gain-life for lifelink alone).

kept.name: Nexus of Becoming
kept.why: "create a token that's A COPY OF THE EXILED CARD" - copying was unrecorded, and the card it copies comes from your HAND, which is where the whole engine draws its fuel.

kept.name: The Stasis Coffin
kept.why: The activation cost was entirely unread: "{2}, {T}, EXILE The Stasis Coffin". It taps and it exiles itself to pay, and neither was written down.

kept.name: Canoptek Wraith
kept.why: "Wraith Form - This creature CAN'T BE BLOCKED" was read as nothing; evasion is the reason this card ever connects. The land search also costs "pay {3} and SACRIFICE IT".

kept.name: Voracious Fell Beast
kept.why: "CREATE A FOOD TOKEN for each creature sacrificed this way" - it carries cares:sub:food and kw:food but no verb saying it makes them. "EACH OPPONENT sacrifices" is a mass edict, not a single target.

kept.name: Knowledge Pool
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread - the record held only "it enters". "each player EXILES the top three cards of their LIBRARY"; "Whenever a player CASTS A SPELL FROM THEIR HAND, that player exiles it"; "they may CAST a spell from among other cards EXILED with this artifact WITHOUT PAYING ITS MANA COST". It is a cast-from-exile prison and nothing said so.

kept.name: Dawnbringer Cleric
kept.why: The third mode, "Gentle Repose - EXILE TARGET CARD FROM A GRAVEYARD", was unread; that is graveyard hate and matters both as a role and as anti-synergy in a graveyard deck. "choose one" also makes it modal.

kept.name: Soul Partition
kept.why: "A spell cast by an opponent this way COSTS {2} MORE to cast" was unread, and the taxing half is what makes this a real answer rather than a temporary exile. The card also stays in exile and is played from there.

kept.name: Bad River
kept.why: It searches the library specifically for LAND cards ("an Island or Swamp card"), which is the signal that separates a fetch land from a generic tutor.

kept.name: Memory Jar
kept.why: The cost is "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact" and the tap was missing. The effect exiles every hand, has EACH PLAYER draw seven, and then "AT THE BEGINNING OF THE NEXT END STEP" returns each exiled card to its owner's hand - the exile, the return and the delayed end-step trigger were all unrecorded.

kept.name: Field-Tested Frying Pan
kept.why: "CREATE A FOOD TOKEN, then CREATE a 1/1 white Halfling creature token" - two tokens and no eff:create-token. The granted ability is "WHENEVER YOU GAIN LIFE, this creature GETS +X/+X", which is both a lifegain trigger and a pump; neither was read.

kept.name: Archon of Coronation
kept.why: "As long as you're the monarch, DAMAGE DOESN'T CAUSE YOU TO LOSE LIFE" is the ability that makes this a wall against burn and combat, and it was read as nothing.

kept.name: Archfiend of the Dross
kept.why: "if it has no oil counters on it, YOU LOSE THE GAME" - the drawback that defines the card was entirely unread. Every counter it places goes on itself ("enters with four oil counters ON IT"), so the generic eff:add-counters is the wrong word and reads as a counters payoff; the -self verb is the accurate one, matching Bloodthirsty Aerialist in this same batch.

kept.name: Espers to Magicite
kept.why: "CREATE A TOKEN THAT'S A COPY of that card" was unread - both the token and the copy. Nothing is returned anywhere by this card: the graveyards are exiled and a copy is made, so eff:return-from is false and would file it as recursion.

kept.name: Necrotic Hex
kept.why: "EACH PLAYER SACRIFICES SIX CREATURES of their choice" is the entire front half of the card and it was read as nothing; only the Zombie tokens were recorded. It is symmetrical, so it costs you creatures too.

kept.name: Wingmantle Chaplain
kept.why: "Whenever ANOTHER creature you control with defender enters, create a 1/1 white Bird" - the repeatable half of the card had only the self-ETB recorded.

kept.name: Constricting Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability is "When this creature ENTERS, you may exile target creature an opponent controls UNTIL THIS CREATURE LEAVES THE BATTLEFIELD". It carries the rare trig:etb but not the ordinary enters trigger, nothing for the leaves-the-battlefield return, and nothing saying the ability is handed to every Sliver you control rather than being a one-shot.

kept.name: Hellish Rebuke
kept.why: "PERMANENTS YOUR OPPONENTS CONTROL gain" blankets every opposing permanent, and the granted ability is "When this permanent DEALS DAMAGE to the player who cast Hellish Rebuke". Only the resulting sacrifice and life loss were recorded, so nothing said what triggers them.

kept.name: Legions to Ashes
kept.why: "and ALL TOKENS that player controls with the same name as that permanent" - it is a one-sided sweeper against a token deck, not a single-target exile.

kept.name: The Circle of Loyalty
kept.why: Affinity for Knights is a cost reduction ("This spell costs {1} less to cast for each Knight you control") and nothing recorded it. The rest of the card (anthem, cast trigger, token maker) is already right.

kept.name: Resentful Revelation
kept.why: eff:impulse is wrong: nothing is exiled and nothing is played from exile, it looks at three and takes one to hand. The two cards it does not take go to your graveyard, which is a mill, and flashback both cares about the graveyard and casts the card back out of it.

kept.name: Adorned Pouncer
kept.why: Eternalize is activated from the graveyard and exiles this card as part of its cost. Neither the zone it operates from nor the exile cost was recorded.

kept.name: Eagles of the North
kept.why: Plainscycling discards this card as the activation cost. The search and the land-in-library care are already there; the cost was missing.

kept.name: Iron Mastiff
kept.why: On a roll of 1-9 it deals damage equal to its power TO YOU. The list carried only eff:damage, which reads as pure removal and hides the downside half of the die.

kept.name: Voldaren Bloodcaster // Bloodbat Summoner
kept.why: Only the front face's first line was read. The front also transforms itself at five Blood, and the whole back face was skipped: a begin-combat trigger that turns a Blood token into a 2/2 Bat with flying and haste.

kept.name: Sigarda's Splendor
kept.why: The upkeep ability DRAWS A CARD and that was not recorded at all, which is the main reason to play the card. The last line triggers on casting a white spell, so the colour it cares about is white.

kept.name: Underdark Rift
kept.why: Everything past "{T}: Add {C}" was unread. The second ability rolls a d10, exiles this land as a cost, and buries a target artifact, creature or planeswalker into its owner's library. As it stood the card read as a plain colourless land with no answer on it.

kept.name: Cacophony Unleashed
kept.why: "Destroy all nonenchantment creatures" kills your own board too, so it is a wipe rather than plain destruction. The second ability animates the enchantment into a 6/6 creature with menace and deathtouch; only the deathtouch half was recorded.

kept.name: Dawn-Blessed Pennant
kept.why: The lifegain trigger fires on OTHER permanents you control entering, not on this artifact entering, and the recursion ability costs {2} and a tap as well as the sacrifice already listed.

kept.name: Ebondeath, Dracolich
kept.why: Ebondeath is a 4/1. pt:big means power 5 or more, so this is simply false and would offer him to decks looking for a big body.

kept.name: Ring of Xathrid
kept.why: "{2}: Regenerate equipped creature" keeps the creature alive through removal and combat, and nothing in the list said so - the card read as a counter-adder with an equip cost only.

kept.name: Cryptic Trilobite
kept.why: The mana ability's cost is removing a +1/+1 counter from itself. The list recorded that it adds counters and adds mana but not that it spends counters to do it, which is the whole engine of the card.

kept.name: Skullport Merchant
kept.why: The entire second ability was unread: "{1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature or a Treasure: Draw a card". It is a sacrifice outlet and a draw engine, and only the enters-the-battlefield Treasure was recorded.

kept.name: Summon: Primal Garuda
kept.why: Chapters II and III give another target creature +1/+0 and flying. The flying grant was recorded and the +1/+0 was not.

kept.name: Black Cat, Cunning Thief
kept.why: The card had NO effect words at all, only a trigger. It digs nine deep into an opponent's library, exiles two face down and lets you play them for as long as they remain exiled - a look-and-pick plus an impulse off someone else's deck.

kept.name: Coveted Prize
kept.why: Two of the three things this card does were missing: it costs {1} less per party creature, and with a full party it casts a mana value 4 or less spell from your hand for free. Only the tutor was read.

kept.name: Francisco, Fowl Marauder
kept.why: "Francisco can't block" is a printed restriction on itself and was not recorded.

kept.name: Glistening Oil
kept.why: "When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand" makes it a recurring aura you can re-cast every turn. eff:move-zone alone does not say the card that comes back is this one.

kept.name: Changing Loyalty
kept.why: The payoff line was entirely unread: when the enchanted creature dies it comes back FROM THE GRAVEYARD UNDER YOUR CONTROL. That is reanimation and theft, and the list held only the replicate copy.

kept.name: Lotus Vale
kept.why: It only enters if you sacrifice two untapped lands. The list read it as a land that taps for three mana with no cost attached, which is a materially different card.

kept.name: Taborax, Hope's Demise
kept.why: The Cleric half of the death trigger was dropped: "you may draw a card. If you do, you lose 1 life." Only the counter was recorded.

kept.name: Roshan, Hidden Magister
kept.why: "you draw a card and you lose 1 life" - the life loss half was dropped.

kept.name: Mystifying Maze
kept.why: The exiled creature comes back on a delayed trigger "at the beginning of the next end step", so the card genuinely has an end-step trigger and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Aegis Angel
kept.why: Granting another permanent indestructible for as long as you control this is exactly keeping your things alive. The keyword grant was recorded but not that the card's job is protection.

kept.name: Inquisitorial Rosette
kept.why: Nothing on this card changes power or toughness. Attacking creatures GAIN MENACE, which is already recorded as grants:menace, and the token is created at a fixed 2/2. eff:pump would offer it to decks looking for an anthem.

kept.name: Sigarda's Summons
kept.why: The effect applies to every creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it, not to one target, and nothing said it was a global effect.

kept.name: Dawnhand Dissident
kept.why: The third ability casts creature spells from among the cards it has exiled, so exile is a zone it actively works out of. The graveyard exile was recorded and the exile zone it feeds was not.

kept.name: Radiant Solar
kept.why: The trigger reads "this creature or another nontoken creature you control enters", so it fires on itself as well - only the -other half was kept. The whole second ability was also unread: discard this card as a cost to venture and gain 3 life.

kept.name: Sram's Expertise
kept.why: Half the card was missing: "You may cast a spell with mana value 3 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost." Only the three Servos were recorded.

kept.name: Haakon, Stromgald Scourge
kept.why: Haakon lets you cast every Knight spell in your graveyard, not just himself. eff:recur-self covers his own self-cast; nothing said he turns the graveyard into a second hand for a whole card type.

kept.name: Earthshape
kept.why: Earthbend 3 puts three +1/+1 counters on a land — ctr:+1/+1 is recorded but the act of putting them is not. The creature clause reads 'power less than or equal to that land's power', which is cares:power.

kept.name: Epicure of Blood
kept.why: 'Whenever you gain life' — this is the archetypal lifegain payoff and trig:gains-life alone does not say the deck is about gaining life.

kept.name: Alesha's Legacy
kept.why: Granting indestructible to your own creature is protection, and eff:protect is what the other indestructible-granting cards in this batch carry. eff:pump means +X/+X and this card changes no power or toughness at all.

kept.name: Basri Ket
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unread: the -2 triggers on creatures attacking, the emblem triggers at the beginning of combat, and it puts a counter on each creature you control. The +1 also grants indestructible, which is protection.

kept.name: Justiciar's Portal
kept.why: 'It gains first strike until end of turn' is the second half of the card and is not recorded.

kept.name: Kinbinding
kept.why: 'Creatures you control get +X/+X' is the card's main line and produced nothing. Only the token trigger was read.

kept.name: Ancestral Statue
kept.why: The bounce sends a permanent to its owner's hand; the hand zone is what the card interacts with, and other bounce cards here carry it.

kept.name: Dogged Detective
kept.why: 'Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn' is a draw trigger, and returning this card from your graveyard to your hand is self-recursion. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Unidentified Hovership
kept.why: Manifest dread looks at the top two cards and takes one, which is look-and-pick as much as it is a mill. The leave trigger refers back to the exiled card.

kept.name: Colfenor's Urn
kept.why: Only the end-step trigger was read. The card triggers on creatures being put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exiles them, sacrifices itself, and returns those cards to the battlefield — the whole engine was missing.

kept.name: Reaper's Scythe
kept.why: It puts soul counters on itself each end step, and the equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each of them. Only the attach and the trigger timing were recorded.

kept.name: Basilica Screecher
kept.why: Extort triggers on spells YOU cast. The bare trig:cast does not say whose spell, and the split word exists.

kept.name: Eiganjo Dynastorian // Replenish
kept.why: Prepared lets you cast a copy of its spell, which is a copy effect. Nothing on either half touches exile — that word is unsupported by the text.

kept.name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
kept.why: 'you gain that much life' is half the effect and was not recorded; the counters are distributed among any number of creatures you control.

kept.name: Thrull Parasite
kept.why: The ability costs '{T}, Pay 2 life' — cost:life is recorded but the tap is not. Extort triggers on your own spells.

kept.name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
kept.why: The card carried no effect words at all. It hands an opponent control of one of your permanents, draws you a card, and taps to do it.

kept.name: Leonin Relic-Warder
kept.why: The leave trigger returns the exiled card to the battlefield. Only the exile half was read.

kept.name: Charitable Levy
kept.why: 'Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast' is the card's first line and produced nothing. It also sacrifices itself and shuffles after the search.

kept.name: Afterlife Insurance
kept.why: The grant applies to all creatures you control, and the afterlife grant itself has no word.

kept.name: Cramped Vents // Access Maze
kept.why: 'this Room deals 6 damage to target creature an opponent controls' is the whole front half and was not recorded — only the lifegain that follows it.

kept.name: Leonin Arbiter
kept.why: 'Any player may pay {2} to ignore this effect' is a tax, and the prohibition itself has no word.

kept.name: Vizier of the Scorpion
kept.why: 'Zombie tokens you control have deathtouch' is the second ability and was entirely unread.

kept.name: Shimmerdrift Vale
kept.why: It is a mana land whose tap ability was not recorded at all. Only the colour choice was read.

kept.name: Realm-Cloaked Giant // Cast Off
kept.why: 'Destroy all non-Giant creatures' is a mass destroy that is not restricted to opponents — it takes your board too unless the deck is Giants, which is what scope:wipe is for.

kept.name: Belladonna Took
kept.why: Two of the three token triggers were lost: gain 1 life the first time and draw a card the second. Only the counters were recorded.

kept.name: Lobelia Sackville-Baggins
kept.why: The card carried no effect words. It exiles a creature card from an opponent's graveyard, which is graveyard hate, and then creates X Treasure tokens.

kept.name: Thorough Investigation
kept.why: 'Whenever you attack, investigate' — the attack trigger is what makes the Clues, and only the sacrifice trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Salvation Colossus
kept.why: The attack trigger gives other creatures you control indestructible until end of turn, which is protection alongside the pump already recorded.

kept.name: Warlock Class
kept.why: Level 2 is "look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard" - a look-and-pick off the library that also fills the graveyard. None of that was recorded; the card read as life-loss only.

kept.name: Rakshasa Debaser
kept.why: The attack trigger reanimates from the DEFENDING player's graveyard under YOUR control, which is a steal and not just a return. Encore exiles this from your graveyard as a cost and creates a token copy per opponent with haste; none of the encore body was read.

kept.name: Multiclass Baldric
kept.why: Every ability of this card is a grant and not one was recorded. It hands out lifelink, deathtouch, haste and flying on the party conditions, and prevents all damage to the equipped creature with a full party.

kept.name: Stone Idol Generator
kept.why: The token-making ability is "{T}, Pay six {E}" - it taps itself and that was not recorded.

kept.name: Graaz, Unstoppable Juggernaut
kept.why: "Other creatures you control have base power and toughness 5/3" is a base P/T set and had no facet at all - the card looked like an evasion granter only.

kept.name: Static Prison
kept.why: THE WHOLE CARD IS MISSING. It exiles a target nonland permanent an opponent controls until it leaves the battlefield, and the list records only energy counters and triggers. As it stands this white removal enchantment cannot be offered to any deck as removal.

kept.name: Protection Racket
kept.why: The card puts the revealed card into your hand every turn an opponent declines to pay, which is the reason to play it - a repeating draw engine off the top of your library. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: the exile is an opponent choosing to bin your own library card, and marking it would file this as removal.

kept.name: Painter's Servant
kept.why: "All cards that aren't on the battlefield, spells, and permanents are the chosen color" is as global as an effect gets.

kept.name: Ruthless Winnower
kept.why: It triggers at EACH player's upkeep and makes each of them sacrifice, so it is a symmetric board effect rather than a one-shot.

kept.name: Marchesa's Decree
kept.why: "Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control" is an attack trigger and only the enters trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Hero of Iroas
kept.why: "Aura spells you cast cost {1} less to cast" is half the card and had no facet. This is the reason the card is in every voltron shell alongside its heroic trigger.

kept.name: Meteor Crater
kept.why: The only ability is "{T}: ... Add one mana of that color" and the tap cost was not recorded. Compare Painted Bluffs and Manalith in the same batch, which both carry it.

kept.name: Profane Transfusion
kept.why: "You create an X/X colorless Horror artifact creature token" - the token half of the card was entirely unread.

kept.name: Ring of Evos Isle
kept.why: The upkeep counter only happens "if it's blue", which is a real colour condition and the only thing tying this Equipment to a blue deck.

kept.name: Spectra Ward
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2" was not recorded, and an Aura with "Enchant creature" attaches to a creature the same way an Equipment does.

kept.name: Karn Liberated
kept.why: The +4 is a loyalty-adding cost and only the minus abilities were recorded. Liliana, Untouched by Death in this same batch carries both cost:add-counters and cost:remove-counters.

kept.name: Barbara Wright
kept.why: Doctor's companion is a rule about how many commanders you may have, which is what cares:commander records.

kept.name: Ninja Teen
kept.why: Level 1 is "whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield" and no leave trigger was recorded. Level 3 grants sneak to creature cards in your graveyard and lets you cast them from there, which is casting from the graveyard rather than returning cards.

kept.name: Lazotep Sliver
kept.why: The granted afflict 2 triggers when a Sliver becomes blocked, which is where the life loss already recorded actually comes from.

kept.name: The Haunt of Hightower
kept.why: "Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, put a +1/+1 counter" - the card watches graveyards for its entire growth engine and did not say so.

kept.name: Onakke Oathkeeper
kept.why: "Exile this card from your graveyard: Return target planeswalker card from your graveyard to the battlefield" is reanimation and had no effect facet at all - only the cost and the attack tax were read.

kept.name: Liliana, Untouched by Death
kept.why: The -3 lets you cast Zombie spells from your graveyard, which is casting from there rather than returning a card. The +1 drains EACH opponent, which is the scope every other "each opponent" card in this batch carries.

kept.name: Demonlord Belzenlok
kept.why: The enters trigger digs your library and puts every nonland card it finds into your hand, often several. Only the self-damage downside was recorded, so the card read as a drawback with no payoff. NOT adding eff:exile: the exile is of your own library and marking it would read as removal.

kept.name: Nuka-Nuke Launcher
kept.why: The attack trigger gives the defending player rad counters - counters on a PLAYER - whenever they cast a spell, and neither the counters nor the opponent-cast trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet
kept.why: The replacement effect keys on an opponent's nontoken creature dying, which is why the token half already recorded ever happens. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: this exiles a creature that was already dying, so recording it would file Kalitas as a removal spell.

kept.name: Butcher Ghoul
kept.why: Undying is the card bringing ITSELF back from the graveyard, which is exactly what eff:recur-self names. The generic eff:return-from does not say the returned card is this one, which is the whole point for a sacrifice deck.

kept.name: Asylum Visitor
kept.why: It checks EACH player's upkeep, so it is a symmetric table-wide trigger rather than one that only watches you.

kept.name: Valor's Flagship
kept.why: "When you cycle this card, create X 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens" - the payoff for cycling it was unread, so the card looked like a plain cycler.

kept.name: Paladin Danse, Steel Maverick
kept.why: Exiling itself gives a group of your creatures indestructible until end of turn, which is keeping your board alive and not a stat boost. There is no +X/+X anywhere on the card, so eff:pump is a misread of "gains".

kept.name: Giant Killer // Chop Down
kept.why: Chop Down only answers a creature "with power 4 or greater", which is a real restriction the list did not carry.

kept.name: Defiling Daemogoth
kept.why: The end-step drain is sized by "the amount of life you gained this turn", so the card is a lifegain payoff and not merely a card that gains life. It also drains each opponent.

kept.name: Rally of Wings
kept.why: "Creatures you control with flying get +2/+2 until end of turn" - the pump half was unread and only the untap was recorded, which makes a combat trick look like a Seedborn effect.

kept.name: Ayara's Oathsworn
kept.why: The tutor clause ends 'then shuffle', which is a real library effect, and the search reads the library zone.

kept.name: Barrow-Blade
kept.why: 'Whenever equipped creature blocks or becomes blocked' is two combat triggers and neither was recorded; only the resulting eff:neutralise was.

kept.name: Feed the Cycle
kept.why: Forage is an additional cost to cast: exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food. The card both eats a Food as a cast cost and uses the graveyard as a resource.

kept.name: Blightbeetle
kept.why: The second line is a mass static on every creature your opponents control, not a targeted effect. The prohibition itself has no word in the vocabulary.

kept.name: SOLDIER Military Program
kept.why: The trigger is modal - 'choose one', or both with a commander - and the modality was unrecorded.

kept.name: Lobelia, Defender of Bag End
kept.why: Almost nothing of this card was read. The ETB exiles the top card of each opponent's library; the activated ability costs a tap plus sacrificing an artifact, is modal, and the first mode plays those exiled cards without paying their mana cost. Only the drain mode had been recorded.

kept.name: Colossus of Akros
kept.why: Monstrosity 10 puts ten +1/+1 counters on it - the whole point of the activated ability, and only the keyword was recorded. Self-granted trample deliberately left alone, since grants: on a card's own keywords is noted as imprecise.

kept.name: Ugin's Nexus
kept.why: The death replacement exiles the Nexus itself, and the first line makes players skip extra turns they would begin. Only the extra turn it hands back was recorded.

kept.name: Batterbone
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger on the Equipment - it creates the Germ and attaches on entry - and no enters trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Blazing Archon
kept.why: 'Creatures can't attack you' is a static covering every creature in the game, not one target.

kept.name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
kept.why: The Throne grants defender, and the quoted ability it grants pumps and gives trample to all other creatures you control. Only the equip itself had been read.

kept.name: Selfless Samurai
kept.why: The first ability triggers on a Samurai or Warrior attacking alone and grants it lifelink; both the trigger and the keyword grant were missing.

kept.name: Golem-Skin Gauntlets
kept.why: 'Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each Equipment attached to it' is a pump and the card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Carrot Cake
kept.why: The Rabbit token and both halves of its trigger ('when this enters AND when you sacrifice it') were entirely unread; only the life gain from the separate activated ability was recorded.

kept.name: Boon of Safety
kept.why: A shield counter replaces damage or destruction, so this card's job is keeping a creature alive; without the word nothing in its list says so.

kept.name: Celebr-8000
kept.why: It rolls two dice, which is the whole card, and each result of 1 gives +1/+1. The self-granted keywords are left alone deliberately.

kept.name: Plague of Vermin
kept.why: The card makes a Rat for each life paid and carried no effect word for it - only the cost:life.

kept.name: Lash of the Balrog
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature' is a genuine cast-sacrifice and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Mindwrack Harpy
kept.why: 'Each player mills three cards' is symmetric across the table, not a single target.

kept.name: Fall of the First Civilization
kept.why: Chapter III destroys all other nonland permanents including your own, which is a symmetric board wipe rather than plain removal.

kept.name: Kindred Boon
kept.why: The activated ability puts a divinity counter on a creature, and the indestructible static covers every creature you control carrying one.

kept.name: Behemoth of Vault 0
kept.why: The death trigger only destroys if you choose to pay energy equal to the permanent's mana value - 'you may pay... when you do' is exactly a paid-for bonus.

kept.name: Scytheclaw
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger that was unread, and the combat damage trigger halves the player's life, which no effect word recorded.

kept.name: Splitskin Doll
kept.why: The ETB makes you discard unless a condition is met, and that condition reads a creature's power.

kept.name: Midnight Snack
kept.why: The drain costs sacrificing this enchantment, and its size is the amount of life you gained this turn, which makes it a lifegain-matters card.

kept.name: Coercive Impetus
kept.why: The aura goads the enchanted creature and gives it +1/+1; only the attack trigger's draw and life loss had been read.

kept.name: Bismuth Mindrender
kept.why: The entire combat damage trigger was unread: it exiles off the top of that player's library until a nonland card and lets you cast it from exile.

kept.name: Éowyn, Lady of Rohan
kept.why: Only half the granted keywords were recorded, the grant is a choice between two, and the second ability makes your equip abilities cost less to activate.

kept.name: Requiem Monolith
kept.why: The ability's cost includes {T} and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Tithe Drinker
kept.why: Extort triggers specifically on spells YOU cast, which the bare trig:cast does not distinguish from an opponent-cast trigger.

kept.name: Big Apple, 3 a.m.
kept.why: The land's mana ability was completely unread - it taps for one mana of a colour chosen as it enters - and only the Rat ability had any word.

kept.name: Delivery Moogle
kept.why: The tutor searches the library as well as the graveyard and shuffles afterwards; only the graveyard half was recorded.

kept.name: Overwhelming Remorse
kept.why: The first line is a cost reduction that scales with creature cards in your graveyard, which makes this a graveyard-count card, not just an exile spell.

kept.name: Josu Vess, Lich Knight
kept.why: The eight tokens only arrive if the kicker was paid, which is a paid-for bonus rather than an unconditional enters trigger.

kept.name: Danse Macabre
kept.why: Nothing is sacrificed as a cost here - the spell makes each player sacrifice on resolution, which eff:sacrifice already records. Leaving cost:sacrifice on it reads as a repeatable sacrifice outlet and would put an edict into aristocrats decks as an enabler. The d20 result is modified by the sacrificed creature's toughness, so it does read a body's stats.

kept.name: Haunted Fengraf
kept.why: The activated ability sacrifices the land itself as a cost, and returns the creature card AT RANDOM. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: The Capitoline Triad
kept.why: Its first ability is entirely a cost reduction counting historic cards in your graveyard - both the reduction and the graveyard-caring were unrecorded. The ability's cost is exiling cards from your graveyard (cost:exile), and the emblem sets base P/T for every creature you control (scope:all beside the existing eff:set-pt).

kept.name: Welcome the Dead
kept.why: Half the card was missing: it creates X Zombie Druid tokens, and X counts cards put into your graveyard this turn.

kept.name: Sword of the Meek
kept.why: Its whole recursion engine is 'whenever a 1/1 creature you control enters', and no enter trigger was recorded at all.

kept.name: Mausoleum Secrets
kept.why: It searches your library; the other tutors in this batch (Thalia's Lancers, Myr Kinsmith, Forerunner of the Coalition) all carry cares:zone:library beside eff:search-library.

kept.name: Lightfoot Rogue
kept.why: Two of the three d20 outcomes give +1/+0 or +3/+0, and the 20 also grants first strike. Only the deathtouch half was read.

kept.name: Starving Revenant
kept.why: Its descend ability is 'whenever you draw a card' - a draw trigger, which was not recorded.

kept.name: Bygone Bishop
kept.why: The entire trigger condition, 'whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 3 or less', was unrecorded; only the resulting Clue was.

kept.name: Oath of Gideon
kept.why: Its second ability puts an additional loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control. Only the token half was read.

kept.name: Delirium Skeins
kept.why: 'Each player' includes you, so it makes you discard three cards too - a symmetrical effect that a deck must be built to survive, not a one-sided one.

kept.name: Gruesome Fate
kept.why: It hits each opponent, the same shape as Forerunner of the Coalition's 'each opponent loses 1 life', which does carry scope:all.

kept.name: Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin
kept.why: It makes them sacrifice the creature with the LEAST POWER, so power is what the card reads - the same reason Body Launderer carries cares:power for 'equal or lesser power'.

kept.name: Morningtide's Light
kept.why: An entire clause was unread: it prevents all damage that would be dealt to you until your next turn. The exiled creatures also come back on a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step.

kept.name: Altar of Bhaal // Bone Offering
kept.why: The Adventure half creates a 4/1 Skeleton token and was completely unread. The activation also taps. cost:sacrifice is wrong and actively harmful: the cost is EXILING a creature you control, which triggers no death triggers, so an aristocrats deck would count this as a sacrifice outlet it is not.

kept.name: Intellect Devourer
kept.why: Both named abilities were unread. It makes each opponent exile a card from their hand, and lets you play the cards exiled with it.

kept.name: Attempted Murder
kept.why: It puts -1/-1 counters on the creature; eff:shrink records the outcome but not that counters are placed, which is what a proliferate or counter-removal deck reads.

kept.name: Disruptor Flute
kept.why: 'As this artifact enters, choose a card name' is an enter-time choice, which is also why blinking or recasting it is worth doing - and nothing recorded that it does anything on entering.

kept.name: Steel-Plume Marshal
kept.why: Its only ability gives every other attacking flier you control +2/+2, and neither the pump nor its mass scope was recorded.

kept.name: Demonic Embrace
kept.why: The Aura gives +3/+1 and nothing recorded that it pumps at all; only the granted flying was read.

kept.name: Momo, Friendly Flier
kept.why: Its second ability is 'whenever ANOTHER creature you control with flying enters, Momo gets +1/+1' - the pump was unrecorded and the trigger was filed only as the generic trig:enters.

kept.name: Southern Air Temple
kept.why: Its second ability triggers on another Shrine you control entering, and both abilities put counters on EACH creature you control.

kept.name: Body Launderer
kept.why: Connive is 'draw a card, then discard a card'. The engine read the +1/+1 counter half of connive and dropped the draw and the discard entirely.

kept.name: Gerrard's Hourglass Pendant
kept.why: The extra-turn denial clause was completely unread - it is the reason this card is played. The ability also taps and exiles itself as costs, and returns ALL qualifying cards rather than a target.

kept.name: Refurbished Familiar
kept.why: Affinity for artifacts is a cost reduction, the same shape that earns eff:reduce-cost elsewhere, and the discard hits each opponent.

kept.name: Arcade Cabinet
kept.why: Its second ability was unread: it taps, sacrifices a token as a cost, and DOUBLES every kind of counter on a creature.

kept.name: Phage the Untouchable
kept.why: Combat damage from Phage destroys the creature it hit. Only the 'loses the game' clauses were read.

kept.name: Void Beckoner
kept.why: The cycling trigger puts a deathtouch counter on a creature you control - a counter placed and deathtouch granted to another creature, neither recorded.

kept.name: Razorfield Ripper
kept.why: The attack trigger gives +X/+X and nothing recorded a pump, and reconfigure literally attaches it to a creature you control - the same reason Sword of the Meek carries eff:attach.

kept.name: Golden Guardian // Gold-Forge Garrison
kept.why: The whole flip mechanism was unread: when it dies it returns itself to the battlefield transformed. The land face taps for mana and to make tokens. It is a colourless card in both faces.

kept.name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
kept.why: Its trigger is 'you draw a card and lose 1 life' - the life loss was unrecorded - and it watches cards leaving GRAVEYARDS as well as the battlefield, which is why it is built alongside graveyard hate.

kept.name: Frodo, Sauron's Bane
kept.why: Both activated abilities set base power and toughness (2/3) and the first grants lifelink. The Scout mode grants a combat-damage trigger that makes a player LOSE THE GAME, which is an alternate win condition and was entirely unwritten. Only the subtype changes were recorded.

kept.name: Contamination
kept.why: Only the upkeep trigger was recorded. The card's whole purpose - every land producing {B} instead of anything else - was unwritten, as was the sacrifice it demands each upkeep. The mana replacement applies to every land in play, so scope:all.

kept.name: Rowan's Grim Search
kept.why: The bargained half was completely unread: it digs four off the library and puts the rest in the graveyard, which is self-mill. Bargain is an additional sacrifice cost paid on cast, and the extra effect only happens if it was paid.

kept.name: Canoptek Tomb Sentinel
kept.why: The Exile Cannon ability is an enters trigger and neither trigger word was recorded, so the exile reads as having no cause.

kept.name: Spatial Contortion
kept.why: +3/-3 is as much a toughness reduction as a pump. Recorded only as eff:pump, so the engine cannot see that this is how a colourless deck kills a small creature.

kept.name: Aryel, Knight of Windgrace
kept.why: The destroy ability is bounded by 'creature with power X or less', which the list did not record.

kept.name: Wyrm's Crossing Patrol
kept.why: Myriad triggers on attacking. The token copies were recorded but not what causes them.

kept.name: Avengers Tower
kept.why: Nothing on this card exiles anything. The third ability looks at the top three and puts a Hero into HAND with the rest on the bottom, so eff:impulse (exiling off the top to play them) and the exile zone are both wrong - a word scan on 'Look at the top three cards'.

kept.name: Derelict Attic // Widow's Walk
kept.why: The front door's life loss and the back door's +1/+0 were both dropped; only the draw and the deathtouch grant were recorded.

kept.name: Admonition Angel
kept.why: The second ability returns everything exiled with it to the battlefield when it leaves. The exile half was recorded and the return half was not, which makes a card that gives everything back read as permanent removal.

kept.name: Primaris Eliminator
kept.why: Only the first mode was read. It is modal (eff:choose) and the second mode gives all creatures a player controls -2/-2, which is a one-sided shrink affecting a whole board.

kept.name: Tegwyll's Scouring
kept.why: The alternate flash timing costs tapping three flying creatures you control in addition to the mana cost, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Callous Bloodmage
kept.why: It is a three-mode ETB and the third mode - exile target player's graveyard - is real graveyard hate that was missing entirely. Without it the engine cannot see this as an answer, and worse, could put it in a graveyard deck.

kept.name: Tip the Scales
kept.why: The sacrifice was recorded and the effect it pays for was not. All creatures get -X/-X, which is a symmetric sweeper that kills your own board too, the same shape as Toxic Deluge.

kept.name: Jacob Frye
kept.why: Partner with is an enters trigger that searches a library and shuffles, and neither the trigger nor the shuffle was recorded. The combat-damage ability copies the exiled card, which is the whole payoff and was missing.

kept.name: Demonic Covenant
kept.why: The entire first ability was unread - Demons attacking draws you a card and costs you a life. Only the end-step token and mill were recorded.

kept.name: Cunning Lethemancer
kept.why: 'Each player' includes you, so this is a repeatable self-discard outlet as well as a symmetric attack on hands. Recorded only as eff:discard, which reads as one-sided.

kept.name: Matter Reshaper
kept.why: Nothing but the death trigger was recorded. It reveals the top of your library and puts the card into your hand (or onto the battlefield), which is real card advantage the list did not express at all.

kept.name: Oketra the True
kept.why: The restriction clause was not read. Oketra cannot attack or block without three other creatures, which is the reason she is a go-wide card rather than a beater.

kept.name: Rite of Consumption
kept.why: Sacrificing a creature is an explicit additional cost to cast, and the damage is sized by the sacrificed creature's power. Neither was recorded, so an aristocrats finisher reads as a plain burn spell.

kept.name: Valiant Veteran
kept.why: The second ability is activated from the graveyard - cost:exile-self is recorded but not that the card operates from the yard at all.

kept.name: Blot Out the Sky
kept.why: When X is 6 or more it destroys all noncreature, nonland permanents. The destroy was recorded but not that it is a mass effect.

kept.name: Faith of the Devoted
kept.why: The optional {1} payment gating the drain was unrecorded, as was the fact that it hits each opponent.

kept.name: Nurgle's Rot
kept.why: Both halves of the death trigger were missing: it makes a 1/3 Demon token and returns itself to hand, which is what makes it a repeatable sacrifice engine rather than a one-shot aura.

kept.name: Localized Destruction
kept.why: The energy half was unread. You get an energy counter (a counter on a player), you may pay one or more of them, and which of your creatures survive is decided by their power matching the amount paid.

kept.name: Nettling Nuisance
kept.why: The token it gives an opponent is goaded for the rest of the game, which is the point of the card and was recorded only as the printed keyword, never as an effect.

kept.name: Fortune, Loyal Steed
kept.why: Only the enters-scry was read. The attack trigger blinks Fortune and the creature that saddled it - exile your own permanents and return them - which is a blink effect and the entire reason to play the card. Saddle taps other creatures as a cost, as recorded on Guardian Sunmare.

kept.name: Guardian Sunmare
kept.why: It searches the library, and the library zone was not recorded alongside eff:search-library the way it is on other tutors.

kept.name: Eumidian Wastewaker
kept.why: Two things were half-read. The attack trigger makes YOU discard or sacrifice as well as the defender, and counts lands hitting a graveyard. Encore was ignored entirely: it is activated by exiling this card from your graveyard and makes hasty token copies, the same reminder-text reading the engine already applies to myriad and unearth.

kept.name: Henrika Domnathi // Henrika, Infernal Seer
kept.why: Mode one is an edict ("Each player sacrifices a creature") and nothing recorded it; mode three is literally "Transform Henrika", which eff:transform names exactly; the back face's activated ability pumps every creature you control with those keywords, a mass effect.

kept.name: Brotherhood Scribe
kept.why: The whole second line is "creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn" and the list carried no pump verb at all, only the energy half. It is a team pump, so it also takes scope:all.

kept.name: Balemurk Leech
kept.why: The trigger is on ANOTHER permanent arriving ("whenever an enchantment you control enters"), not on itself, and only the bare trig:enters was written down. The split word is what an enchantments-matter deck reads.

kept.name: Lesser Masticore
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card" is exactly cost:cast-discard and was missing. Persist returns the creature from the graveyard to the battlefield under its own power, which is eff:recur-self; only the generic eff:return-from was there.

kept.name: Dissection Tools
kept.why: The card states "attach this Equipment to that creature" outright, and its equip cost is "Sacrifice a creature" rather than mana, which is a real sacrifice outlet the list did not record.

kept.name: Dark Salvation
kept.why: The first half of the card creates X 2/2 Zombie tokens and there was no token verb at all, only the -1/-1 half. tok:zombie is printed and untouched.

kept.name: Stronghold Rats
kept.why: "Each player discards a card" is symmetrical group discard, not a single-target discard, and nothing recorded the breadth.

kept.name: Armored Ascension
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each Plains you control" is a pump and the list held only grants:flying. No eff:attach added, matching how the other Auras in the set are read.

kept.name: Kinscaer Sentry
kept.why: The attack trigger puts a creature card from your HAND straight onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, which is precisely eff:put-onto-battlefield; the list recorded the trigger and none of the effect.

kept.name: Dusk Legion Sergeant
kept.why: Granting persist keeps your Vampires alive through a wipe and returns them from the graveyard. Same shape as Return to Action in this batch, which carries eff:protect and eff:return-from for granting a dies-return trigger.

kept.name: Back for Seconds
kept.why: Bargain is an additional cost paid by sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token as you cast, and the reward (battlefield instead of hand) only arrives if it was paid. Neither the cost nor the conditional upside was recorded.

kept.name: Blood on the Snow
kept.why: "where X is the amount of {S} spent to cast this spell" is a mana-spent check, which is the one thing the list did not carry; the wipe and reanimation halves were already right.

kept.name: Gryff's Boon
kept.why: The activated ability returns the card from the graveyard "attached to target creature", so both the return and the attachment are explicit text; only eff:recur-self was there.

kept.name: Kaya's Guile
kept.why: "Exile all opponents' graveyards" is one of four modes and produced nothing at all - this is graveyard hate, the mode a Meren or Muldrotha deck must not be handed. The edict mode and the graveyard mode are both all-opponent effects.

kept.name: Ondu Cleric
kept.why: The trigger reads "Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters", so it fires on itself as well; trig:enters-other was recorded and the self half was not.

kept.name: Mishra's Foundry
kept.why: "{2}: This land becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker artifact creature" is a manland and no facet said so - the list read the mana and the pump only.

kept.name: Unshakable Tail
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread: it surveils, it does so both on arrival AND every upkeep, it watches creature cards going from your LIBRARY to your graveyard, and it buys itself back from the graveyard with a Clue. Only the Clue token and the sacrifice cost had been recorded.

kept.name: Annihilating Glare
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay {4} or sacrifice an artifact or creature" - the sacrifice-as-cast-cost was missing, which is what makes this a one-mana removal spell in an aristocrats deck.

kept.name: Don't Move
kept.why: The second sentence is a delayed trigger, "whenever a creature becomes tapped, destroy it", and nothing recorded the trigger. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: "all tapped creatures" is a restricted selector, not a board wipe.

kept.name: Northern Air Temple
kept.why: The second ability triggers on ANOTHER Shrine entering, which is the whole Shrine payoff; only its own enters-self trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Tithe Taker
kept.why: The entire first paragraph is a tax on opponents' spells and activated abilities and produced no facet at all. Afterlife 1 is a dies trigger, and only its token output had been written down.

kept.name: Osseous Sticktwister
kept.why: The delirium trigger makes each opponent sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card - two real effects on opponents, neither recorded; only the damage backstop and the lifelink were there.

kept.name: Eventide's Shadow
kept.why: "Remove any number of counters from among permanents on the battlefield" reaches every permanent in play, including opponents', and no facet recorded the breadth. The "lose life" half still has no word - see the proposal.

kept.name: Virtus the Veiled
kept.why: "That player loses half their life, rounded up" is the entire point of the card and produced nothing; the list recorded the partner tutor and the combat-damage trigger only.

kept.name: Wintermoor Commander
kept.why: The attack trigger gives another Knight indestructible until end of turn, which is a protection effect saving a creature from removal; grants:indestructible alone describes the keyword, not the job.

kept.name: Repay in Kind
kept.why: "Each player's life total becomes the lowest life total among all players" hits every player at the table and nothing recorded that it is symmetrical.

kept.name: Wispdrinker Vampire
kept.why: Both abilities were unread past their drain. The trigger fires on another small creature you control entering, both abilities key on "power 2 or less", and the activated ability grants deathtouch and lifelink to your whole small-creature board.

kept.name: Pactdoll Terror
kept.why: "Whenever this creature or another artifact you control enters" fires on itself too; only the -other half was recorded.

kept.name: Return to Action
kept.why: "Target creature gets +1/+0" is in the text and no pump verb was recorded - the list captured the granted lifelink and the dies-return only.

kept.name: Godsend
kept.why: The exile ability triggers on the equipped creature blocking OR becoming blocked, and neither trigger was recorded. The third paragraph stops opponents casting spells with the same name as anything exiled with it, which produced nothing at all.

kept.name: Love Song of Night and Day
kept.why: Chapter II creates a 1/1 Bird token and there was no token verb. Chapter I draws for you AND a target opponent, which plain eff:draw does not say - it is a symmetrical draw and belongs in group-hug reading.

kept.name: White Mage's Staff
kept.why: Only the equip half was read. Job select is an ETB that creates a Hero token and attaches, so trig:enters/-self and eff:create-token. The equipped creature gets +1/+1 (eff:pump) and a granted attack trigger that gains life (trig:attacks, eff:gain-life).

kept.name: Cling to Dust
kept.why: The 'you gain 3 life' half of the split effect was dropped. The card exiles from a graveyard and its escape cost exiles five more from yours, so it genuinely cares about the graveyard, and escape recasts it from there.

kept.name: Space Marine Devastator
kept.why: Both squad and Grav-cannon are 'When this creature enters' triggers and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Sorin the Mirthless
kept.why: The +1 is a top-of-library look-and-take and nothing recorded it; the loyalty abilities were only read for the token, damage and lifegain.

kept.name: Aetherstorm Roc
kept.why: The energy trigger reads 'this creature or another creature you control enters', so it fires on itself too. The attack trigger is a 'you may pay {E}{E}, if you do' payment gate, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Deep-Cavern Bat
kept.why: The whole point of the ETB is exiling a nonland card from an opponent's hand and that was not written down at all.

kept.name: Nameless Inversion
kept.why: +3/-3 is both halves. Only the -3 (eff:shrink) was recorded, so the card cannot be found as a way to make a creature bigger or to combine with toughness matters.

kept.name: Cursecloth Wrappings
kept.why: The granted embalm makes a token that is a COPY of the graveyard creature; eff:create-token alone loses that it is a copy.

kept.name: Lashwrithe
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger that creates the Germ and attaches. The token and attach were recorded but the trigger was not.

kept.name: Ebony Fly
kept.why: 'Roll a d6' is a die roll and nothing recorded it. The {4} ability turns the artifact into an Insect artifact creature, which is an animation and was missing entirely.

kept.name: Ninja's Blades
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread. Job select is an ETB creating a Hero token; the equipped creature gets +1/+1 and a combat damage trigger that draws then makes you discard. Only the life loss and the attach survived.

kept.name: Geralf's Messenger
kept.why: Undying is a dies trigger that returns the creature from the graveyard to the battlefield. The +1/+1 counter was recorded but neither the trigger nor the self-recursion was, so a sacrifice deck cannot find it.

kept.name: Screams from Within
kept.why: The aura gives -1/-1, which is a shrink, not a pump; recording it as a pump makes it look like a buff aura. It also returns ITSELF from the graveyard whenever the enchanted creature dies, which is self-recursion and was only recorded as a generic return.

kept.name: Weathered Runestone
kept.why: The card exiles nothing. It is a prohibition: cards can't enter the battlefield from graveyards or libraries and players can't cast from them. eff:exile-graveyard misdescribes it as a graveyard-exile effect.

kept.name: Hexavus
kept.why: Both activated abilities pay by removing a counter and neither was recorded as a cost. The first puts a flying counter on another creature, which grants flying.

kept.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
kept.why: Nothing on this card changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is simply wrong. Granting protection from white to a permanent you control is how it saves your things from removal and from combat, which is what eff:protect describes.

kept.name: Kain, Traitorous Dragoon
kept.why: The combat damage trigger draws that many cards and only the Treasures and the control change were recorded.

kept.name: Colonel Autumn
kept.why: Exploit is an enters trigger that sacrifices a creature, and the card also triggers whenever a creature you control exploits one. None of the sacrifice half was recorded, only the counters it pays out.

kept.name: Wedding Invitation
kept.why: The second ability costs a tap and sacrificing itself, neither recorded, and it grants lifelink to a Vampire.

kept.name: Murderous Cut
kept.why: Delve exiles cards from your own graveyard to pay for the spell, so the card is genuinely better with a full graveyard. Nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Sidequest: Catch a Fish // Cooking Campsite
kept.why: Most of both faces was unread. The upkeep trigger looks at the top card and takes it, makes a Food token and transforms the enchantment; the land face taps for white and has a tap-plus-sacrifice-an-artifact ability that counters up every creature you control.

kept.name: The Fire Nation Drill
kept.why: The ETB only kills a creature with power 4 or less, which is a power check and was not recorded.

kept.name: Scriv, the Obligator
kept.why: The Contract token's trigger gives the enchanted creature +2/+0 when it attacks one of your opponents; only the life loss branch was recorded.

kept.name: Geth, Lord of the Vault
kept.why: The activated ability ends with 'then that player mills X cards' and only the reanimation half was recorded.

kept.name: Adarkar Valkyrie
kept.why: The entire activated ability was unread. It costs a tap and reanimates a creature that dies this turn under your control, which is a dies trigger and graveyard recursion. As it stood the card recorded nothing but its keywords.

kept.name: Angelic Aberration
kept.why: The ETB was recorded as a trigger with no effect. It sacrifices any number of small creatures (a power/toughness check) and creates that many 4/4 Angel tokens.

kept.name: Scrabbling Claws
kept.why: Both abilities exile from graveyards only. Plain eff:exile reads as removal that answers a permanent, which this card cannot do; the vocabulary keeps graveyard exile separate for exactly this reason.

kept.name: Pointed Discussion
kept.why: YOU lose the 2 life, not an opponent. eff:lose-life reads as a drain, which would make this look like an aristocrats payoff when it is a draw spell with a drawback.

kept.name: Wasteland Raider
kept.why: The ETB makes each player sacrifice a creature and the effect was not recorded at all, only the squad copies. 'Each player' makes it symmetric.

kept.name: Final Judgment
kept.why: Exiling all creatures takes your own board with it, which is what scope:wipe exists to warn a go-wide deck about. scope:all alone does not say the deck's own creatures die.

kept.name: Herald of the Host
kept.why: Myriad is an attack trigger. The token copies were recorded but nothing said when they happen.

kept.name: Rune-Tail, Kitsune Ascendant // Rune-Tail's Essence
kept.why: The back face prevents ALL damage to every creature you control, which is a blanket effect and not a single-target trick, so scope:all is missing. The front face literally says "flip Rune-Tail", turning the permanent to its other face.

kept.name: Crystal Fragments // Summon: Alexander
kept.why: Chapters I and II prevent all damage to creatures you control, which nothing in the list records. Chapter III taps ALL creatures your opponents control, and the prevention is likewise blanket, so scope:all. The Equipment's activated ability says outright "return it to the battlefield transformed".

kept.name: Altar of the Wretched // Wretched Bonemass
kept.why: "{2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is the card bringing itself back out of the graveyard, which is exactly eff:recur-self and is absent. Left grants:deathtouch alone: the back face genuinely does have the keyword, conditionally.

kept.name: Immortal Obligation
kept.why: The whole spell is returning a creature card from a graveyard to the battlefield, and eff:return-from was missing entirely. Only the counter and the goad restrictions were recorded, so the reanimation itself was invisible.

kept.name: Symmetry Matrix
kept.why: The trigger is on ANOTHER creature you control entering, not on itself, so trig:enters-other. "You may pay {1}. If you do, draw a card" is a pay-for-more clause. And the whole condition is a power/toughness comparison, so it cares about power.

kept.name: Release to Memory
kept.why: Half the card is "create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token" for each creature card exiled, and no token-making word was recorded at all. Kept eff:exile-graveyard rather than adding eff:exile, per the graveyard-hate distinction.

kept.name: Diamond Mare
kept.why: The engine read only "choose a color" and stopped. The card's actual payoff, "Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color, you gain 1 life", contributed nothing: no lifegain, no cast trigger. It triggers on YOUR casts, so trig:cast-own.

kept.name: Brimaz, Blight of Oreskos
kept.why: The end-step ability is gated on "if a Phyrexian died under your control this turn". Nothing in the list records that this commander is paid for its creatures dying, which is the half of the card an aristocrats build is drafted around.

kept.name: The Birth of Meletis
kept.why: Chapter II creates a 0/4 Wall token and no token word was present. Chapter I searches the library for a basic Plains, so both the library word and the land-search word are missing beside the bare eff:search-library.

kept.name: Thrilling Encore
kept.why: It returns ALL creature cards in ALL graveyards that died this turn, including opponents'. Recorded as a plain eff:return-from, it reads like a single-target raise dead rather than a mass reanimation.

kept.name: Zero Point Ballad
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures with toughness X or less" is symmetric and kills your own board, which is the scope:wipe case. scope:all alone does not tell the builder that this card is dangerous in a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Promise of Aclazotz // Foul Rebirth
kept.why: Populate creates a token that is a COPY of a creature token you control, and no copy word was recorded. That is the entire enchantment half's payoff.

kept.name: Predators' Hour
kept.why: The granted trigger exiles the top card of the damaged player's library and lets you look at and play it, which is impulse draw off an opponent's deck, not milling: nothing goes to a graveyard, so eff:mill is simply the wrong verb. The menace and the granted ability go to every creature you control, hence scope:all.

kept.name: Myr Welder
kept.why: It exiles artifact cards out of graveyards, so it cares about the graveyard, and its whole body of abilities comes from the cards exiled with it, so it cares about exile. Neither zone was recorded.

kept.name: Apostle's Blessing
kept.why: The card grants protection until end of turn and changes no power or toughness at all, so eff:pump is wrong. It is a protection trick, which is what eff:protect is for, and that word was absent.

kept.name: Felidar Umbra
