kept.why: "{1}{W}: Attach this Aura to target creature you control" is a real attach effect and was not recorded. Umbra armor removes all damage and destroys the Aura instead of letting the creature die, which is exactly keeping your creature alive.

kept.name: Belonging
kept.why: Encore's cost is "Exile this card from your graveyard", so the card both pays itself as a cost and operates from the graveyard. Neither was recorded, so the encore half of the card was invisible.

kept.name: Petrified Field
kept.why: It taps only for {C} and its rules text carries no coloured mana symbol, so its colour identity is genuinely empty. Other colourless permanents in the same batch carry col:none and this land did not.

kept.name: Plague Spitter
kept.why: Both abilities hit EACH creature and EACH player, which is a board-wide ping rather than a targeted one, and "each player" includes you, so it damages its own controller. Only the bare eff:damage was recorded.

kept.name: Vindictive Lich
kept.why: "Choose one or more. Each mode must target a different player" is a modal card and no choice word was recorded, so nothing distinguishes it from a fixed death trigger.

kept.name: Magus of the Moat
kept.why: The card's entire text is "Creatures without flying can't attack" and the list contained no effect word at all: it recorded what the card looks at and nothing about what it does. This is a pillowfort piece and could be reached by no role.

kept.name: Killian, Decisive Mentor
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread. The first ability goads the tapped creature (kw:goad is only the printed keyword; the card genuinely goads). The second is "whenever ... creatures ... attack, draw a card", giving both an attack trigger and card draw, neither of which was present.

kept.name: Plaza of Harmony
kept.why: It adds {C}, or a type a Gate could produce, and prints no coloured mana symbol, so its colour identity is empty.

kept.name: Court Street Denizen
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on another WHITE creature you control entering. The colour condition is the whole point of the card in a mono-white build and was not recorded.

kept.name: Dalek Drone
kept.why: "When this creature enters, destroy target creature" and no enter trigger of any kind was recorded, so the destroy and the life loss were floating with nothing to say when they happen.

kept.name: Battle Screech
kept.why: The flashback cost is tapping three untapped WHITE creatures you control, which is a casting cost paid with other permanents plus a real colour condition, and flashback casts it from the graveyard. Only the token-making half was read.

kept.name: Archon of Absolution
kept.why: The tax applies to every creature that would attack you or your planeswalkers, not to one target, so the effect is board-wide. Did not add eff:cant-attack: it is a tax rather than a prohibition, and eff:unless-pays already says that correctly.

kept.name: Vincent's Limit Break
kept.why: Tiered is literally "choose one additional cost" and paying more gives a bigger body, which is the pay-for-more shape. The granted ability returns the creature from the graveyard to the battlefield, so the graveyard zone is load-bearing and was not recorded.

kept.name: Feldon's Cane
kept.why: The activation cost is "{T}, Exile this artifact" and neither the tap nor the self-exile was recorded, so the card looked free to use. It also shuffles your graveyard into your library, and eff:move-zone alone does not say a shuffle happens.

kept.name: Zoetic Cavern
kept.why: It taps only for {C} and its morph cost is generic, so it has no colour identity.

kept.name: Hunter's Blowgun
kept.why: "Equipped creature has deathtouch during your turn" and only the reach half of that same sentence was recorded. Deathtouch is the reason this Equipment is played.

kept.name: Huskburster Swarm
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature card you own in exile and in your graveyard" is a genuine cost reduction and the list recorded only the zones it counts, never the discount itself.

kept.name: Qala, Ajani's Pridemate
kept.why: "Other attacking creatures you control get +X/+0" is a team pump and no pump word was present. The second ability is paid whenever you gain life, so this is a lifegain-matters card, which trig:gains-life alone does not say for deck building.

kept.name: Discerning Financier
kept.why: "Choose another player. That player gains control of target Treasure you control" hands a permanent away, and that word was missing, so the card read as plain Treasure-and-draw.

kept.name: Unknown Shores
kept.why: Adding one mana of any colour does not give a card a colour identity, and it prints no coloured symbol, so its identity is empty.

kept.name: Ally Encampment
kept.why: It prints no coloured mana symbol; adding any colour confers no colour identity, so this land is colourless.

kept.name: Deathbringer Liege
kept.why: The card names white twice, "Other white creatures you control get +1/+1" and "Whenever you cast a white spell", but only the black half was recorded. It is a two-colour tribal payoff and half of it was invisible.

kept.name: Cat Collector
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life for the first time during each of your turns, create a 1/1 white Cat" had no lifegain trigger at all: the token creation was recorded with nothing to say what causes it. It is a lifegain payoff, not just a Food maker.

kept.name: Winding Canyons
kept.why: It taps for {C} and its second ability costs generic mana, so it has no colour identity.

kept.name: Ruin-Lurker Bat
kept.why: Descend is a graveyard condition - it checks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard this turn - and nothing recorded that. Lifelink gains life (Arcbound Mouser in this same batch carries eff:gain-life for the same keyword).

kept.name: Unstable Glyphbridge // Sandswirl Wanderglyph
kept.why: The front half is a one-sided-ish board wipe: it destroys ALL creatures except the chosen ones, yours included, so scope:wipe and scope:all belong. It selects on power 2 or less. Craft exiles the card itself and another artifact as a cost and returns it transformed. The back half triggers on an opponent casting a spell and stops them attacking, which is a different effect from the eff:cant-cast already recorded.

kept.name: Nalia de'Arnise
kept.why: The combat trigger gives every creature you control deathtouch until end of turn - the grant was missing entirely, and the counters go on each creature you control rather than one target.

kept.name: From the Catacombs
kept.why: The reanimated creature arrives with a corpse counter on it, and the card exiles that creature instead of letting it leave the battlefield. Neither clause was read.

kept.name: Elixir
kept.why: The activation cost is {5}, {T}, Exile this artifact - it exiles itself rather than sacrificing, so cost:sacrifice-self is simply the wrong word and cost:tap was missing. The effect shuffles your graveyard into your library, which is the whole point of the card and neither zone nor the shuffle was recorded.

kept.name: Firja's Retribution
kept.why: Chapter I creates a 4/4 Angel Warrior token and the card carried no token-making word at all (tok:angel is not even present). Chapters II and III both affect all Angels you control, not a single target.

kept.name: Slice from the Shadows
kept.why: The first line is 'This spell can't be countered', which is exactly eff:uncounterable and was not read.

kept.name: Cryptic Gateway
kept.why: It puts a creature card from your HAND straight onto the battlefield - that is the precise meaning of eff:put-onto-battlefield, and the generic eff:move-zone alone loses which zone it comes from.

kept.name: Fallen Ideal
kept.why: The enchanted creature has flying, which no facet recorded, and the granted ability's cost is sacrificing a creature - this is a genuine sacrifice outlet an aristocrats deck wants.

kept.name: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread. Convert is a transform. The back face chooses flying or indestructible AT RANDOM at the beginning of combat, granting whichever it picks, and it converts again whenever it deals combat damage to a player.

kept.name: What Must Be Done
kept.why: Mode one destroys ALL artifacts and creatures including your own, so scope:wipe is the right word for it. Mode two reanimates a historic permanent from your graveyard, which had no return word and no graveyard zone at all, and the card is modal.

kept.name: Honored Heirloom
kept.why: Its second ability exiles a card from a graveyard - eff:exile-graveyard was recorded but the graveyard zone was not.

kept.name: Grave Endeavor
kept.why: It rolls two d10 and you choose one result, which is both a die roll and a choice; neither was read.

kept.name: Arguel's Blood Fast // Temple of Aclazotz
kept.why: The transform clause and the ENTIRE back face were unread. Temple of Aclazotz taps for {B} and has a sacrifice outlet that gains life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness - a real mana source and a real outlet, both invisible.

kept.name: Essence of Orthodoxy
kept.why: It triggers on 'this creature or another Phyrexian', so it fires on its own arrival too, not only on other creatures.

kept.name: Worthy Knight
kept.why: A Knight spell is a creature spell, so this is a cast-a-creature trigger rather than only a generic cast trigger.

kept.name: Angelic Sell-Sword
kept.why: 'This creature or another nontoken creature' includes itself, and the attack trigger is conditional on its power being 6 or greater, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Slagstone Refinery
kept.why: The card's entire effect is creating a Powerstone token and that word was missing - only the token's mana ability had been read. It also triggers on artifacts leaving the battlefield to exile as well as to the graveyard.

kept.name: Adrestia
kept.why: Crew 1 is a cost that taps other creatures you control; nothing recorded that this vehicle needs bodies tapped to work.

kept.name: Strata Scythe
kept.why: The imprint trigger searches your library for a LAND and shuffles, and the equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each matching land. None of the search, the shuffle or the pump was read - only that it attaches.

kept.name: Decree of Justice
kept.why: The cycling trigger is 'you may pay {X}. If you do, create X Soldier tokens' - the pay-more-get-more shape eff:do-if-cost-paid names.

kept.name: Salvation Swan
kept.why: This is a repeatable BLINK and the list contained no effect words at all. It exiles a creature you control and returns it with a flying counter, it triggers on its own arrival as well as other Birds, and it selects creatures without flying.

kept.name: Tax Collector
kept.why: The card had NO effect words. It is modal: one mode taxes opponents' spells by {1}, the other detains a creature, which stops it attacking, stops it blocking and stops its activated abilities.

kept.name: Indebted Spirit
kept.why: Afterlife triggers when it dies, and the bestow half gives the enchanted creature +1/+1. Only the token creation had been read.

kept.name: Mind Rake
kept.why: Overloaded it reads 'each player discards two cards', so it is a symmetric discard rather than a single-target one.

kept.name: Doc Ock's Tentacles
kept.why: It has a triggered ability - whenever a creature you control with mana value 5 or greater enters, attach it - and no trigger word was recorded, so it read as a plain equip-only Equipment.

kept.name: Phoenix Down
kept.why: The activation cost is {1}{W}, {T}, Exile this artifact, and the ability is modal. None of the tap, the self-exile or the choice was read.

kept.name: Moonshadow
kept.why: Its whole function is REMOVING the -1/-1 counters it entered with, triggered by permanent cards going to your graveyard. Only the counters going on had been read, so the card looked like it did nothing but shrink itself.

kept.name: Wake the Dead
kept.why: The returned creatures are sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step - the sacrifice half of the effect was unrecorded, which makes it look like permanent reanimation.

kept.name: Serra Avatar
kept.why: Power equals your life total, so in Commander it is always a huge body (pt:big) and it is a genuine life-total payoff (cares:lifegain). The second line shuffles it from the graveyard into the library, which nothing recorded: that is a shuffle and a zone move.

kept.name: Firja, Judge of Valor
kept.why: Nothing on this card touches exile, and impulse means exiling off the top to play those cards; Firja puts one card in hand and the REST INTO YOUR GRAVEYARD, which is self-mill and graveyard filling, not impulse draw.

kept.name: Stonehorn Dignitary
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all. 'Target opponent skips their next combat phase' is exactly eff:skip-phase, which is the whole reason the card is played.

kept.name: March of Otherworldly Light
kept.why: The additional cost to cast is exiling any number of WHITE cards FROM YOUR HAND, and none of that was recorded: the cast-time exile cost, the hand as the source zone, or the fact that it specifically wants white cards.

kept.name: Armed and Armored
kept.why: 'Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn' is an animation and the list only carried the attach half of the card.

kept.name: Grasping Dunes
kept.why: A -1/-1 counter on target creature makes it smaller, which is how this land removes a creature. It also produces only {C} and has no coloured symbol anywhere, so its identity is colourless.

kept.name: Dragoon's Lance
kept.why: Job select is 'when this Equipment enters, CREATE a 1/1 Hero token, then attach this to it' - an enters trigger and a token maker, neither of which was recorded. The equipped creature also gets +1/+0.

kept.name: Evangel of Heliod
kept.why: The card's only ability creates Soldier tokens and eff:create-token was missing entirely. The count is your devotion to white, so it genuinely cares about the colour.

kept.name: Honor of the Pure
kept.why: The anthem applies only to WHITE creatures, which is a real deck-building condition and was not recorded.

kept.name: Indestructibility
kept.why: Granting indestructible to a permanent is the definition of keeping it alive; the card had the keyword grant but nothing saying it is a protection effect.

kept.name: Sanctuary Warden
kept.why: The trigger draws a card and that was missing outright. It also enters with two shield counters ON ITSELF, and the draw plus token is paid for by removing a counter from something you control.

kept.name: Urdnan, Dromoka Warrior
kept.why: The whole second ability was unread: 'whenever you attack' is an attack trigger, and it grants first strike, or double strike on two or more counters.

kept.name: Chrome Dome
kept.why: Only the anthem was recorded. The activated ability creates a token that is a COPY of an artifact you control and gives that token haste - three things, none of them written down.

kept.name: Surveyor's Scope
kept.why: The activation cost is tapping AND exiling the artifact itself, and the search ends 'then shuffle'. None of the three was recorded.

kept.name: Miara, Thorn of the Glade
kept.why: The card's payoff is drawing a card and eff:draw was missing entirely. It is paid for with {1} and 1 life, which is a life cost and the 'you may pay, if you do' shape.

kept.name: Faceless Haven
kept.why: The manland half was completely unread: it animates itself into a 4/3 with vigilance and ALL CREATURE TYPES, which is changeling in effect and is exactly why tribal decks run it. It also has no coloured symbol, so its identity is colourless.

kept.name: Hive of the Eye Tyrant
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. Activating it animates the land into a 3/3 with menace whose attack trigger exiles a card from the defending player's graveyard - which is graveyard hate and must be visible as such.

kept.name: Lich's Mastery
kept.why: 'Whenever you gain life, draw that many cards' is the engine of the card and eff:draw was missing; it is also one of the strongest lifegain payoffs printed and nothing said so.

kept.name: Weapons Vendor
kept.why: 'You may pay {1}. When you do, attach...' is the optional-payment shape and it was not recorded.

kept.name: Silverquill, the Disputant
kept.why: Casualty COPIES the spell - that is the payoff and it was missing, leaving only the sacrifice cost. Granting it to every instant and sorcery you cast also makes this a spells-cast card.

kept.name: Genesis of the Daleks
kept.why: Chapter IV destroys all creatures on either branch of the choice and no destroy word was recorded. Left off scope:wipe deliberately: both modes are filtered (Dalek / non-Dalek), which is the case this project has already ruled is not a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Vampire Gourmand
kept.why: Both halves of the payoff were unread: sacrificing draws a card and makes this creature unblockable for the turn.

kept.name: Bilbo's Gambit
kept.why: 'Return target spell to its owner's hand' stops the spell resolving - a soft counter, and the card carried no interaction word at all. Left the gifted Treasure alone because the OPPONENT creates it, so eff:create-token would read as token-making for you.

kept.name: Transmogrifying Wand
kept.why: It enters with three charge counters on itself; only the generic counter word was present.

kept.name: Liliana, the Last Hope
kept.why: The +1 gives a creature -2/-1, which is how this planeswalker removes small creatures, and no shrink word was recorded.

kept.name: Mite Overseer
kept.why: {W/P} is Phyrexian mana and can be paid with 2 life, so the token-making ability has a life cost that was not recorded.

kept.name: Myrsmith
kept.why: 'You may pay {1}. If you do, create...' - the optional payment gating the token was not recorded.

kept.name: Plague Reaver
kept.why: The activation cost is discarding two cards and sacrificing this creature, and neither was recorded - only the effect it buys.

kept.name: Drogskol Reinforcements
kept.why: 'Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to Spirits you control' is a whole line of the card with no facet at all.

kept.name: Shatter the Sky
kept.why: The draw is symmetric - every player with a power 4 or greater creature draws - so it is a group draw gated on a power check, and neither the power condition nor the everyone-draws shape was recorded.

kept.name: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer
kept.why: The front face's trigger is 'whenever you gain life', which makes it a lifegain payoff, and converting is turning the permanent to its other face. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Cave of the Frost Dragon
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read; the activated ability turns the land into a 3/4 Dragon with flying.

kept.name: Helitrooper
kept.why: The attack trigger grants flying and changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. The third line, 'equip abilities you activate that target this creature cost {2} less', is a real cost reduction and was unread.

kept.name: The Vision
kept.why: Modal trigger: the Technopathy mode draws a card, and the other two modes give it double strike and indestructible. 'Choose one that hasn't been chosen' is eff:choose. Nothing here touches more than the card itself, so scope:all is false.

kept.name: Chalice of Life // Chalice of Death
kept.why: It transforms itself once you are 10 life above starting. kw:transform is the printed keyword; the effect word was missing.

kept.name: Shredder's Technique
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative casting cost that returns your own unblocked attacker to hand, which is what cost:cast-return-to-hand names.

kept.name: Miren, the Moaning Well
kept.why: '{3}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature' is a repeatable on-demand sac outlet, and the whole payoff is gaining life equal to toughness. Only the mana ability had been read.

kept.name: Unbounded Potential
kept.why: The second mode proliferates (kw:proliferate was there, the effect word was not) and 'Choose one' plus Entwine is eff:choose.

kept.name: Guardian Idol
kept.why: '{2}: This artifact becomes a 2/2 Golem artifact creature' is exactly eff:animate. Only the mana ability had been read.

kept.name: Arnyn, Deathbloom Botanist
kept.why: The trigger reads 'and you gain 2 life', which was dropped, and it only fires on creatures with power or toughness 1 or less, so it genuinely cares about power.

kept.name: Death's Shadow
kept.why: It gets -X/-X. It never pumps anything. Not replaced with eff:shrink either, since that word is read as removal and this only shrinks itself.

kept.name: Launch the Fleet
kept.why: The granted attack trigger makes 1/1 Soldier tokens, so the card is a token maker. Only the trigger word had been read.

kept.name: Eriette's Tempting Apple
kept.why: The stolen creature 'gains haste until end of turn' - the untap and the theft were read and the haste grant was not.

kept.name: Rat King, Verminister
kept.why: The second ability costs {T} and 'Sacrifice three Rats', so it is a tap ability and a real sacrifice outlet. Neither cost was recorded.

kept.name: Terisiare's Devastation
kept.why: It creates X Powerstone tokens, which was not recorded at all, and 'all creatures get -1/-1 for each artifact you control' is a symmetric shrink that kills your own board too, not a pump.

kept.name: Staff of the Death Magus
kept.why: 'Whenever YOU cast a black spell' is a cast-own trigger, and the second half triggers on a Swamp you control entering, which is another permanent entering. Neither the ownership nor the enters half was read.

kept.name: Resolute Watchdog
kept.why: Sacrificing it grants indestructible to another creature - that keeps a creature alive, it does not change power or toughness.

kept.name: Thancred Waters
kept.why: Both abilities grant indestructible, which is protection rather than a pump. The ETB hits one target legendary permanent and the cast trigger hits only Thancred, so nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Phyrexian Crusader
kept.why: The only mention of red and white is 'protection from red and from white'. Being protected from a colour is not caring about it, and this reads to the engine as a red/white-matters card.

kept.name: Devourer of Destiny
kept.why: The opening-hand ability triggers at the beginning of your first upkeep and digs four cards deep, keeping one on top. None of the library selection or the upkeep timing was read; only the cast trigger's exile was.

kept.name: Ashnod's Intervention
kept.why: 'gets +2/+0' is a genuine pump and was missing. The granted trigger is a dual event, 'dies OR is put into exile from the battlefield', so it wants trig:leaves alongside trig:dies.

kept.name: Sacred Cat
kept.why: Embalm is activated from the graveyard by exiling this card, and it brings the creature back as a token copy - a body that returns after dying, which is what aristocrats plans ask for. Only the token and copy words had been read.

kept.name: Ashes of the Abhorrent
kept.why: 'Players can't cast spells from graveyards' was dropped entirely (only the activate half was read), and the card is graveyard hate, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Breathkeeper Seraph
kept.why: The granted ability returns the creature from the graveyard at the beginning of your next upkeep. The timing and the graveyard were both unread.

kept.name: Tangle Wire
kept.why: 'At the beginning of EACH player's upkeep, that player taps an untapped artifact, creature, or land' is symmetric and hits every player, which is what scope:all says.

kept.name: Careening Mine Cart
kept.why: Every attack makes a Treasure, and a Treasure is mana. The card is a mana source and carried no mana facet.

kept.name: Mephitic Draught
kept.why: 'When THIS artifact enters' is its own arrival. trig:enters was there without the self split, so nothing could tell it from a card watching other permanents.

kept.name: Shred Memory
kept.why: It exiles up to four cards from a graveyard, so it is graveyard hate and should say so, and transmute is activated by discarding this card.

kept.name: Emergency Eject
kept.why: 'ITS CONTROLLER creates a Lander token' - the basic-land search in the reminder text belongs to the opponent whose permanent you destroyed. As written this reads as our own ramp and lands-matter card. It is a removal spell.

kept.name: Angelic Renewal
kept.why: It returns the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield; the graveyard was never recorded.

kept.name: Morbid Curiosity
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature' is the cast-time cost, the Village Rites shape, not a repeatable on-demand outlet. cost:sacrifice claims it is an outlet a deck can rely on.

kept.name: Kamber, the Plunderer
kept.why: Partner with is a real 'when this creature enters' trigger that fetches Laurine. The search was recorded but the trigger that causes it was not.

kept.name: Unbreathing Horde
kept.why: The damage replacement removes a +1/+1 counter from it each time. Only the counter-adding half was read.

kept.name: Scrying Sheets
kept.why: 'Look at the top card of your library. If that card is snow, you may reveal it and put it into your hand' is a repeatable look-and-take, the card's whole reason for being played. Only the {C} ability was read.

kept.name: Starry-Eyed Skyrider
kept.why: It grants flying, twice, and never changes power or toughness. grants:flying already says what it does.

kept.name: Rotating Fireplace
kept.why: Both abilities use {T} so cost:tap. It enters with a time counter on itself. Time travel literally says you may add or remove a time counter on each suspended card and each permanent you control, which is both counter verbs.

kept.name: Emerge Unscathed
kept.why: Nothing gets bigger, so eff:pump is wrong. Granting protection from a colour until end of turn is a protection trick that keeps the creature alive.

kept.name: Petrify
kept.why: Enchanted permanent can't attack, can't block and can't activate abilities. That is the Pacifism/Darksteel Mutation shape: the permanent is made harmless without being destroyed.

kept.name: Country Roads
kept.why: The third ability creates a 1/1 Pilot token and sacrifices this land as part of the cost. Neither was recorded, so the land read as mana only.

kept.name: Makindi Stampede // Makindi Mesas
kept.why: The land half is '{T}: Add {W}' and had no mana verb at all.

kept.name: Essence Sliver
kept.why: 'its controller gains that much life' is the whole payoff and no lifegain word was recorded.

kept.name: Demonic Gifts
kept.why: '+2/+0' is a pump. The granted ability returns the creature to the battlefield when it dies, which is a return from the graveyard.

kept.name: Invasion of Gobakhan // Lightshield Array
kept.why: Front exiles a nonland card from an opponent's hand, keeps it in exile and taxes it {2} more. Back triggers at the beginning of your end step and sacrifices itself to give your creatures hexproof and indestructible.

kept.name: My Precious // Allure of Power
kept.why: It is an Equipment, so it attaches. The sacrifice is an additional cost to CAST the adventure, not an on-demand outlet, so cost:sacrifice wrongly marks it as a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Sunset Revelry
kept.why: 'create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens' had no token verb, only the draw and the lifegain.

kept.name: Ultima
kept.why: 'Destroy all artifacts and creatures' hits your board too, which is a wipe. 'End the turn' skips the rest of the turn's phases.

kept.name: The Arkenstone // Seek the Heart
kept.why: The adventure searches your library for a legendary creature card and the library was not recorded.

kept.name: Brass Infiniscope
kept.why: 'When you next cast a spell with {X} in its mana cost, you draw a card and gain half X life' was completely unread: no draw, no lifegain and no cast trigger.

kept.name: Arena
kept.why: {T} is in the activation cost. A fight deals damage equal to power, which is how this land removes a creature. It also taps a creature you control, not only the opponent's.

kept.name: The Creation of Avacyn
kept.why: Chapter II makes you lose life as an EFFECT, not as a cost paid, so cost:life is wrong and eff:lose-life is right. Chapter I searches your library and exiles the card face down, and III reads it back out of exile.

kept.name: Azor's Gateway // Sanctum of the Sun
kept.why: 'Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand' had no draw verb, and the ability untaps Azor's Gateway. Both faces tap for their ability.

kept.name: Kabira Evangel
kept.why: Protection from a chosen colour changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong and eff:protect is the effect. The trigger reads 'this creature or another Ally', so it fires on itself entering as well.

kept.name: Vadmir, New Blood
kept.why: Every counter Vadmir places goes on Vadmir. eff:add-counters-self already says so; the generic word makes him read as a counters-matter payoff for the whole board, which he is not.

kept.name: Battle of Hoover Dam
kept.why: The NCR mode triggers at the beginning of your end step and no step trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Smokestack
kept.why: 'At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices' affects every player, not one target.

kept.name: The Dawning Archaic
kept.why: 'you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost' is precisely casting from the graveyard, which eff:cast-free alone does not say.

kept.name: Lena, Selfless Champion
kept.why: 'Sacrifice Lena' is a cost. Mass indestructible for your creatures is a protection effect and it affects a group rather than a target.

kept.name: Conqueror's Galleon // Conqueror's Foothold
kept.why: The land half is a draw engine and had no draw verb: it taps for {C}, loots for {2}, and draws for {4}. The Vehicle exiles itself at end of combat to transform.

kept.name: Progenitor Exarch
kept.why: '{T}: Transform target Incubator token you control' is a tap cost and an effect that transforms another permanent.

kept.name: Clawing Torment
kept.why: The granted ability is 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life', an upkeep trigger the list never recorded.

kept.name: Voyager Staff
kept.why: It exiles the creature and returns the exiled card to the battlefield at the next end step. Only the exile half was recorded.

kept.name: Sigil of Valor
kept.why: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control' is an attack trigger and a pump, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Aphotic Wisps
kept.why: 'gains fear until end of turn' is a granted evasion keyword and only the cantrip was recorded.

kept.name: Sigiled Sword of Valeron
kept.why: 'Equipped creature gets +2/+0' had no pump word.

kept.name: Omarthis, Ghostfire Initiate
kept.why: The counters only ever go on Omarthis. It TRIGGERS on counters landing elsewhere but places none there, and eff:add-counters-self already covers what it does.

kept.name: Worldslayer
kept.why: 'destroy all permanents other than this Equipment' wipes the whole board including yours, and the list only had a bare eff:destroy.

kept.name: Villainous Hideout
kept.why: Connive is 'draw a card, then discard a card'. The counter half was recorded and the draw and discard were not.

kept.name: Unbury
kept.why: This returns creature cards from your GRAVEYARD to hand. eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield, which would make this read as a blink/re-buy enabler it is not.

kept.name: Fleeting Flight
kept.why: Two of its three clauses were unread: it grants flying and prevents all combat damage that would be dealt to the creature, which is what makes it a combat trick that saves a creature.

kept.name: Jhoira's Timebug
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all. Its only ability taps to add or remove a time counter on a permanent you control or a suspended card you own.

kept.name: Hero of Goma Fada
kept.why: Mass indestructible changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong and eff:protect is the effect. The rally trigger reads 'this creature or another Ally', so it fires on itself entering.

kept.name: Rotting Rats
kept.why: 'each player discards a card' hits everyone rather than a single target.

kept.name: Sunbond
kept.why: The granted ability is a lifegain trigger and nothing recorded that. The card is a lifegain payoff, not merely a counters card.

kept.name: Abiding Grace
kept.why: "choose one —" is modal and no word said so.

kept.name: Spelltithe Enforcer
kept.why: "unless they pay {1}" is the whole card: a tax. eff:sacrifice alone reads it as an edict.

kept.name: Grim Poppet
kept.why: The activation cost is removing a -1/-1 counter from itself; only the effect half was recorded.

kept.name: Their Number Is Legion
kept.why: "You may cast this card from your graveyard" was not read at all.

kept.name: Yahenni's Expertise
kept.why: The second sentence casts a spell with mana value 3 or less from hand without paying its cost; the list stopped after the sweep.

kept.name: Dark Leo & Shredder
kept.why: The combat damage trigger and the "loses half their life" drain were both missing; only the token half was read.

kept.name: Angelsong
kept.why: It prevents ALL combat damage dealt this turn, a mass effect rather than a single prevention.

kept.name: Fraying Omnipotence
kept.why: Each player loses half their life and that was unrecorded. cost:sacrifice is wrong: this is a sorcery with no sacrifice in its cost, so it is not a sacrifice outlet; the sacrifice is the effect, already covered by eff:sacrifice.

kept.name: Brilliant Wings
kept.why: "attach this Aura to that creature" is an actual attach effect, and the whole trigger is gated on "you may pay {1}. If you do".

kept.name: Arterial Flow
kept.why: Each opponent discards two cards, so it acts on hands.

kept.name: T-45 Power Armor
kept.why: The upkeep ability puts a keyword counter on the equipped creature, which is a counter effect and grants that keyword; and it is gated on "you may pay {E}. If you do".

kept.name: Rune of Mortality
kept.why: It gives the enchanted permanent deathtouch, directly or through the Equipment clause. Only the cantrip was read.

kept.name: Markov Purifier
kept.why: The card draws a card and nothing said so; the draw is gated on "you may pay {2}. If you do".

kept.name: Stick Together
kept.why: Each player keeps at most four creatures and sacrifices the rest, symmetrically. That is a board wipe and a wide deck should be warned off it.

kept.name: Profane Memento
kept.why: It triggers on a creature card entering an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, which is a zone-change trigger and not a dies trigger (mill and discard count too). No trigger word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Mutated Cultist
kept.why: "When you cast this spell" is a cast trigger on your own spell; only the generic trig:cast was there.

kept.name: Battle Menu
kept.why: Two of the four modes were unread: the 2/2 Knight token and the +0/+4. It is also modal, and the Magic mode keys on power 4 or greater.

kept.name: Abigale, Eloquent First-Year
kept.why: It puts three keyword counters on a creature. Only the ability-stripping half was read, so the card looks like pure removal when it also hands out three evasion and combat keywords.

kept.name: Overwhelming Splendor
kept.why: "base power and toughness 1/1" sets P/T and nothing said so, and it applies to every creature that player controls.

kept.name: Karametra's Blessing
kept.why: It grants hexproof as well as indestructible; only indestructible was recorded.

kept.name: Forsworn Paladin
kept.why: The second ability grants deathtouch when Treasure mana paid for it, and that condition is exactly what cares:mana-spent describes. Neither was read.

kept.name: Bonder's Ornament
kept.why: The second ability draws a card and no draw word was present. Left eff:draw-each off deliberately: in practice only the controller holds one.

kept.name: Harsh Mercy
kept.why: It destroys all creatures that were not named, yours included. A symmetric mass destroy is a wipe and should be refused by a go-wide plan.

kept.name: Poxwalkers
kept.why: The trigger is on spells YOU cast; only the generic trig:cast was there.

kept.name: Lita, Little Orphan Amphibian
kept.why: The Food token mode was completely unread, and the ability is modal.

kept.name: Night Shift of the Living Dead
kept.why: The whole card is about rolling dice and no word said so; the result modification is gated on "you may pay 1 life. If you do".

kept.name: Torment of Scarabs
kept.why: The upkeep trigger was not recorded at all, and the player may sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card instead of losing the life. Only the life loss was read.

kept.name: Journey to Nowhere
kept.why: The leave trigger returns the exiled card, which is why the card is answerable; only the exile half was read.

kept.name: Death Tyrant
kept.why: The token trigger is a dies trigger and no trigger word was present.

kept.name: Splinter, the Mentor
kept.why: It creates a Mutagen token on every trigger and no token word was there at all. The trigger also fires on Splinter itself leaving.

kept.name: Appa, the Vigilant
kept.why: "Whenever Appa or another Ally you control enters" includes Appa's own arrival; only the -other half was recorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Processor
kept.why: Paying life is how the card works and the token ability costs {4} and a tap. Neither cost was read.

kept.name: Hanweir Militia Captain // Westvale Cult Leader
kept.why: The front face's whole purpose is transforming and no word said so. The back face sets its own power and toughness by creature count and makes its token at the end step, which is a second step trigger.

kept.name: Parker Luck
kept.why: It reveals the top card of two libraries and then puts those cards into their owners' hands, which is a draw for both. Only the life loss was read.

kept.name: Relic Golem
kept.why: It cannot attack or block until an opponent has eight cards in their graveyard: both the restriction and the graveyard condition were unread.

kept.name: Blackbloom Rogue // Blackbloom Bog
kept.why: The back face is a land that taps for {B} and nothing recorded that it makes mana, so the card cannot be seen as a mana source.

kept.name: Wickersmith's Tools
kept.why: The first line accumulates charge counters on itself and the last ability cashes them in for tokens; nothing recorded that it puts counters on itself.

kept.name: Colossal Plow
kept.why: Crew 6 is paid by tapping any number of creatures you control, which is a cost that taps other permanents.

kept.name: Sigarda's Vanguard
kept.why: The enters-or-attacks trigger gives the chosen creatures double strike and no grant was recorded at all.

kept.name: Astelli Reclaimer
kept.why: The whole enters ability - reanimating a noncreature permanent out of your graveyard, sized by the mana spent casting her - was unread; only the keywords were recorded.

kept.name: Gideon Blackblade
kept.why: The +1 offers lifelink as well as vigilance and indestructible; the damage prevention clause and the self-animation into a 4/4 creature were both unread; and the +1 loyalty cost was missing while the -6 cost was present.

kept.name: Empyrial Plate
kept.why: The equipped creature is sized by the number of cards in your hand, which is the whole point of the card.

kept.name: Paladin's Arms
kept.why: Job select is an enters trigger that makes a 1/1 Hero token and attaches to it, and the equipped creature gets +2/+1. None of that was recorded.

kept.name: Prism Ring
kept.why: Only the colour choice was read. The card's actual function - gaining life whenever you cast a spell of that colour - was entirely absent.

kept.name: Holy Mantle
kept.why: The aura gives +2/+2 as well as protection from creatures; the size change was unread.

kept.name: Rustler Rampage
kept.why: The first mode untaps ALL creatures a player controls, which is a mass effect rather than a single target.

kept.name: Kaya, Intangible Slayer
kept.why: The -3 makes a token that is a copy of the exiled permanent; only the exile half was recorded.

kept.name: Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord
kept.why: Connive draws and then discards, and only the +1/+1 counter half was read. He also taxes down his own Villain spells on the stack.

kept.name: Molecule Man
kept.why: His only ability is about the nonland cards in your hand; eff:cast-free was recorded but not what it applies to.

kept.name: Ministrant of Obligation
kept.why: Afterlife 2 triggers when this creature dies. The token creation was recorded but not the death trigger that causes it.

kept.name: Cynical Loner
kept.why: "Can't be blocked by Glimmers" is a blocking restriction and nothing recorded that the card has evasion at all.

kept.name: Carrier Thrall
kept.why: The death trigger was read but not what it does: it makes an Eldrazi Scion, and that Scion sacrifices for {C}. The card is a ramp body and carried neither word.

kept.name: Angel of Sanctions
kept.why: Embalm is paid by exiling this card from your graveyard, so the card wants to be in the yard; only the token-copy half was recorded.

kept.name: Bill the Pony
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is sacrificing a Food, i.e. another permanent, which was not recorded.

kept.name: Old Flitterfang
kept.why: The Food it makes gains 3 life (the other Food cards in this batch all carry eff:gain-life), and the end-step trigger is conditional on a creature having died this turn, which is what makes this a sacrifice payoff.

kept.name: M.O.D.O.K.
kept.why: His static ability gives opponents' creatures -1/-1 and no shrink was recorded; connive's draw and discard were missing; the activation cost is 3 life; and lifelink gains life.

kept.name: Thwart the Grave
kept.why: The first line reduces its own cost by {1} for each creature in your party and nothing recorded a cost reduction.

kept.name: Mister Negative
kept.why: Exchanging life totals sets both players' life, which was unread, and lifelink gains life.

kept.name: Elite Scaleguard
kept.why: The second ability triggers whenever a countered creature you control attacks; only the enters trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Zoraline, Cosmos Caller
kept.why: Her main ability - pay {W}{B} and 2 life to reanimate a cheap nonland permanent - was entirely unread. Only the Bat lifegain trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Orzhov Enforcer
kept.why: Afterlife 1 is a death trigger; the token was recorded but not the trigger that makes it.

kept.name: Pinnacle Kill-Ship
kept.why: "When this Spacecraft enters, it deals 10 damage" is an ETB trigger and neither trigger word was recorded. Station puts charge counters on THIS Spacecraft (eff:add-counters-self) and the number is the tapped creature's power (cares:power).

kept.name: Malboro
kept.why: The ETB also "exiles the top three cards of their library" - a third clause with no word at all. Swampcycling's cost is "Discard this card", which is cost:discard-self, and both the cycling search and the library exile touch the library.

kept.name: Intrepid Hero
kept.why: "Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater" selects on power and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker
kept.why: He triggers on a creature "put into your graveyard from the battlefield" and returns that card from there, so the graveyard is the zone he works in. The whole ability is gated on "power 1 or less".

kept.name: Rescue Retriever
kept.why: The third line, "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to other attacking Soldiers you control", produced no word at all. It is damage prevention and it is what keeps the team alive through combat.

kept.name: Cryptek
kept.why: Only the activation cost tier was recorded; the entire ability was unread. It costs {T}, it sets up a delayed trigger on that creature dying, and it returns it to the battlefield from the graveyard - the same shape Abnormal Endurance carries.

kept.name: Dauthi Horror
kept.why: "This creature can't be blocked by white creatures" is evasion on itself and had no word. eff:cant-block-self is kept because shadow also restricts what it may block.

kept.name: Tainted Sigil
kept.why: The ability costs "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact" and only the sacrifice half was recorded.

kept.name: Tablet of the Guilds
kept.why: The card's only payoff is "you gain 1 life for each of the chosen colors it is" and the list had the trigger without the effect - it recorded that something happens when you cast a spell, but not what.

kept.name: Dead Man's Chest
kept.why: Only the trigger and cares:power were recorded. The payoff exiles cards from the top of a library and lets you cast them, which is exactly impulse draw, and none of the three zone/effect words were present.

kept.name: Archfiend of Spite
kept.why: "Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to this creature" is the trigger that drives the whole card and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Vault 75: Middle School
kept.why: Chapter I is "Exile all creatures with power 4 or greater", a power-gated mass exile. Deliberately NOT adding scope:wipe: the power restriction makes it a filtered sweeper, which the narrow reading of that word excludes.

kept.name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
kept.why: Backup 1 is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ("When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature"). The counter and the granted keywords were recorded but the trigger that causes them was not.

kept.name: Hagra Constrictor
kept.why: "Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has menace" is a team-wide keyword grant and produced no word - the list only recorded the counters it enters with.

kept.name: Kunoros, Hound of Athreos
kept.why: eff:exile-graveyard is wrong - he does not exile anything from any graveyard. He is graveyard hate of a different kind, and the proposed word is what actually describes it. cares:zone:graveyard is genuinely missing: both of his static lines are about graveyards.

kept.name: Arena Rector
kept.why: "...put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle" - the library shuffle was not recorded. Not adding eff:put-onto-battlefield: its gloss says specifically from your HAND, and this is from the library.

kept.name: Astral Drift
kept.why: The list captured only the cycling half. The card's entire reason to exist - "you may exile target creature ... return that card to the battlefield ... at the beginning of the next end step" - had no effect word, so a blink engine read as a cycling card that draws.

kept.name: Kíli the Resourceful
kept.why: "you may pay {0} rather than pay the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate each turn" is a cost reduction and produced nothing. Only the draw trigger was read.

kept.name: Archway Commons
kept.why: "When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you pay {1}" had a trigger but no effect. It also has no mana symbols in its cost or text - "one mana of any color" sets no colour identity - so it is colourless.

kept.name: Spider-UK
kept.why: Web-slinging is an alternative cost paid by returning a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand, and no cost word recorded it.

kept.name: Gatewatch Beacon
kept.why: "move a loyalty counter FROM this artifact onto that planeswalker" takes a counter off as well as putting one on, and only the adding half was recorded.

kept.name: Hand of the Praetors
kept.why: Two of its three lines were entirely unread. "Other creatures you control with infect get +1/+1" is a team-wide anthem, and "Whenever you cast a creature spell with infect" is a cast trigger of your own creature spells. Only eff:poison had been recorded.

kept.name: Abnormal Endurance
kept.why: "target creature gets +2/+0" was not recorded at all, and the granted ability returns the creature from the graveyard.

kept.name: Bleeding Effect
kept.why: The card hands your whole team ten keywords and only two of the ten grants were recorded. It also checks your graveyard for each of those keywords, so the cares:kw words for the six that were missed belong too, and it affects every creature you control, which is scope:all.

kept.name: Termination Facilitator
kept.why: The second ability is "whenever a creature or planeswalker ... is dealt damage, destroy it", which is exactly trig:dealt-damage. Without it the destruction reads as unconditional removal rather than a damage-triggered kill.

kept.name: The Cauldron of Eternity
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard" is the card's headline clause and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Kutzil's Flanker
kept.why: It is a modal "choose one" enter trigger, and the third mode exiles a player's graveyard. Both the modality and the graveyard hate were missing; only the counter, life and scry modes had been read.

kept.name: Curious Colossus
kept.why: eff:neutralise covers losing abilities, but "has base power and toughness 1/1" is a genuine set-P/T, and it hits every creature that opponent controls rather than one target.

kept.name: The Night of the Doctor
kept.why: Chapter I is "Destroy all creatures" - a symmetric board wipe that takes your own board too, which scope:all alone does not say. Chapter II also puts a keyword counter on the reanimated creature, and no counter effect was recorded.

kept.name: Great Hall of the Biblioplex
kept.why: The {5} ability turns the land into a 2/4 Wizard, which is eff:animate, and the ability it gains pumps it +1/+0 per instant or sorcery. Only the two mana abilities had been read.

kept.name: Spectacular Pileup
kept.why: It strips indestructible from everything and then destroys all creatures and Vehicles, yours included. A one-sided eff:destroy badly understates a symmetric wrath.

kept.name: The Kenriths' Royal Funeral
kept.why: The static ability makes your legendary spells cost {1} less for each card exiled with it, which nothing recorded, and the card tracks its own exile pile as a resource.

kept.name: Pelakka Predation // Pelakka Caverns
kept.why: The back face is a land that taps for {B} and the entire mana ability was missing, so the card reads as a discard spell with a land type line and no way to make mana.

kept.name: Capital Punishment
kept.why: Council's dilemma is a vote card and the vote word was missing. The effect also hits every opponent rather than a single target.

kept.name: Mobilized District
kept.why: The {4} ability turns the land into a 3/3 Citizen with vigilance. Only the {T}: Add {C} half had been read, so half the card was invisible.

kept.name: Plea for Guidance
kept.why: "then shuffle" is part of the effect and is recorded on comparable tutors in this batch, so it was inconsistently missing here.

kept.name: Spellbook Vendor
kept.why: Only the scry from the Role's granted text was read. The card creates a token, attaches it to a creature you control, that Role gives +1/+1, and the whole thing happens only if you choose to pay {1}.

kept.name: Daring Fiendbonder
kept.why: The graveyard-activated ability puts an indestructible counter on a creature. eff:protect and grants:indestructible were recorded but the counter placement itself was not.

kept.name: Dusk Rose Reliquary
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature" was entirely unrecorded, which matters because it makes this a sacrifice outlet. The exile is also linked to this permanent leaving the battlefield, which is what returns the card.

kept.name: Phoenix Fleet Airship
kept.why: The end-step trigger only does anything if you sacrificed a permanent this turn, so the card is a sacrifice payoff and nothing said so.

kept.name: Scouting Hawk
kept.why: "then shuffle" completes the land search, matching how the other tutors in this batch are recorded.

kept.name: Ingenuity Engine
kept.why: Cascade casts the exiled card without paying its mana cost. kw:cascade names the keyword but nothing recorded that the card actually casts a spell for free.

kept.name: Harper Recruiter
kept.why: The attack trigger digs four cards deep into your library; the zone it operates in was not recorded even though eff:look-and-pick was.

kept.name: On Thin Ice
kept.why: The entire point of the card, exiling an opposing creature, carried no effect word at all - it read as an Aura that does nothing. The exile is also linked to this Aura leaving the battlefield.

kept.name: The Death of Gwen Stacy
kept.why: Chapter II makes each player discard and no discard effect was recorded. cost:life is wrong: nothing here asks you to pay life to activate or cast anything - the 3 life is a punisher penalty for players who decline to discard, so calling it a cost tells the engine this is a pay-life card.

kept.name: Technomancer
kept.why: The card's whole reason to exist - mass reanimating artifact creatures out of your graveyard - was missing. Only the mill was read, so it looked like a seven-mana mill three.

kept.name: Dragon-Cursed Halls
kept.why: The granted ability triggers on dealing combat damage to a player. The token creation from that granted text was already credited to the card, so its trigger belongs with it.

kept.name: Demonic Pact
kept.why: It is a modal upkeep trigger, and the fourth mode is "You lose the game", which is the single most important thing about the card and was unrecorded.

kept.name: In the Trenches
kept.why: The exile lasts only until this enchantment leaves the battlefield, so the permanent comes back when it goes - the linked return was not recorded.

kept.name: One Last Job
kept.why: Spree is a modal choose-one-or-more spell and nothing recorded that the card offers a choice of modes.

kept.name: Jinxed Idol
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature:" is the activation cost of the give-away ability, which makes this a free repeatable sacrifice outlet. That cost was entirely missing.

kept.name: Creepy Doll
kept.why: "If you win the flip, destroy that creature" — the card's whole payoff is destruction and no destroy word was recorded. eff:random covers only the coin flip.

kept.name: Gilded Pinions
kept.why: The Treasure token it makes taps and sacrifices for one mana of any colour. Token reminder text is already read on this batch (Novice Inspector takes eff:draw from the Clue), and a Treasure maker is a real mana source.

kept.name: Kangee's Lieutenant
kept.why: Encore was read only as far as eff:copy. It creates token copies, grants them haste, and its cost is exiling this card from your graveyard, which also makes it a graveyard card.

kept.name: Stab Wound
kept.why: -2/-2 is shrink, not pump; recording pump files a removal aura as a creature buff. The life loss is an upkeep trigger and no step facet was recorded.

kept.name: Curse of Exhaustion
kept.why: The card's entire text restricts casting and it carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Second Sunrise
kept.why: An instant with no triggered ability. "Cards put there from the battlefield this turn" is a filter on which cards return, read as a dies trigger.

kept.name: Havengul Laboratory // Havengul Mystery
kept.why: kw:transform was recorded but not the effect of transforming itself, which happens twice. "{T}, Pay 1 life: Add {B}" is a life cost, the Clue it makes draws a card, and the back face triggers when the reanimated creature leaves the battlefield.

kept.name: Arcbound Slith
kept.why: Only the combat-damage half of the card was read. Modular is a dies trigger that puts its +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature, which is counters on something other than itself.

kept.name: Timeless Dragon
kept.why: Both alternative costs were unrecorded: plainscycling discards this card, eternalize exiles it from your graveyard, which is also what makes it a graveyard card.

kept.name: Gideon, Ally of Zendikar
kept.why: Only the 0 ability was read. The +1 turns him into a 5/5 creature with indestructible and prevents all damage to him, the -4 emblem pumps your whole board, and the minus abilities cost loyalty counters.

kept.name: Master Piandao
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played from exile. He looks at four, takes one to hand and bottoms the rest, which eff:look-and-pick already says correctly. Recording impulse would offer him to a deck built around exile-and-cast payoffs.

kept.name: Planar Cleansing
kept.why: Destroys every nonland permanent including your own — the defining case for the wipe word, which the engine needs to keep it out of go-wide decks.

kept.name: Call of the Death-Dweller
kept.why: It puts a deathtouch counter and then a menace counter on the returned creatures. The grants were recorded but not the counters that carry them.

kept.name: Bonecache Overseer
kept.why: The draw is gated on three or more cards having left your graveyard this turn, which is the card's whole reason to exist in a graveyard deck.

kept.name: Trepanation Blade
kept.why: Nothing but the equip was read. The equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each card revealed, and the defending player puts all those revealed cards into their graveyard.

kept.name: Twisted Sewer-Witch
kept.why: It creates a Rat token and then a Wicked Role token per Rat, and no token word was recorded at all. The Role gives +1/+1; its life-loss clause was already read from the same reminder text.

kept.name: Panoptic Projektor
kept.why: The cost-reduction ability is a tap ability and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Insatiable Hemophage
kept.why: It simply has printed Deathtouch; it gives it to nothing. Rancid Rats and Triumphant Adventurer in this same batch print Deathtouch and correctly carry kw: only. Leaving the grant would offer it as a deathtouch enabler.

kept.name: Thought-Knot Seer
kept.why: The hand attack — choose a nonland card from the revealed hand and exile it — was not recorded, so only the drawback clause had an effect word.

kept.name: Lumen-Class Frigate
kept.why: Station puts charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to the tapped creature's power. Nothing on the card sets power or toughness, so set-pt has no source clause.

kept.name: Battlefly Swarm
kept.why: No power or toughness changes anywhere on the card. The activated ability grants deathtouch, which grants:deathtouch already records.

kept.name: Starnheim Unleashed
kept.why: "If this spell was foretold, create X of those tokens instead" checks the mechanic rather than merely having it, which is the difference between kw:foretell and caring about it.

kept.name: Crown of Doom
kept.why: The whole first ability was unread: it triggers when a creature attacks you and gives that creature +2/+0. Only the give-control ability had been recorded.

kept.name: Nahiri, the Lithomancer
kept.why: The -2 puts an Equipment from hand or graveyard straight onto the battlefield, which is both a hand-to-battlefield cheat and equipment recursion, and neither was recorded. The minus abilities cost loyalty, and the Stoneforged Blade grants double strike alongside the +5/+5 already read.

kept.name: Tarnation Vista
kept.why: Both mana abilities include {T} and no tap cost was recorded.

kept.name: Thieves' Guild Enforcer
kept.why: The trigger reads "this creature or another Rogue", so it fires on itself as well and only the -other half was recorded. The +2/+1 and the condition of an opponent holding eight or more cards in their graveyard were both unread.

kept.name: Teyo, the Shieldmage
kept.why: "You have hexproof" is the reason the card is played and nothing recorded it. Only the -2 token had any facet.

kept.name: Market Gnome
kept.why: The second ability triggers when it is exiled from the battlefield during a craft. That is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger on itself and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Serra Redeemer
kept.why: It triggers on ANOTHER creature entering, not itself, and the trigger is gated on power 2 or less.

kept.name: Coercive Portal
kept.why: The homage mode draws a card, which was not recorded at all, and the carnage mode destroys all nonland permanents including yours - a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Dungeon Descent
kept.why: The venture ability costs tapping an untapped legendary creature you control, not just tapping the land.

kept.name: Raise the Draugr
kept.why: eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand. This returns creature cards from the GRAVEYARD to hand, which eff:return-from already says. As it stood the engine would read this as a blink or bounce enabler.

kept.name: Entangler
kept.why: An Aura with Enchant creature attaches to a creature, exactly as an Equipment does. The card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Sword of Kaldra
kept.why: Whenever the equipped creature damages a creature it EXILES that creature - the removal half of the card was entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Biting-Palm Ninja
kept.why: The payoff exiles a nonland card out of an opponent's hand, which nothing recorded. It also enters with a menace counter on ITSELF, so the counter word wants the -self form.

kept.name: Elder Arthur Maxson
kept.why: He literally grants training to your creature tokens, and training is an attack trigger that puts the +1/+1 counters the list already credits him with.

kept.name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
kept.why: The whole card watches permanents being put into graveyards from the battlefield.

kept.name: Minwu, White Mage
kept.why: Its only ability triggers whenever you gain life, so it is a lifegain-matters card. trig:gains-life records the trigger but nothing recorded that it wants lifegain as a theme.

kept.name: Guidelight Matrix
kept.why: Both abilities cost {T}, and the second turns a Vehicle into an artifact creature, which is exactly eff:animate.

kept.name: Six-Sided Die
kept.why: Three of the six die results were unrecorded: 3 damage, two -1/-1 counters, and setting base toughness to 1.

kept.name: Summoner's Sending
kept.why: It feeds on creature cards in graveyards every turn; eff:exile-graveyard records the action but not that the card wants graveyards to be full.

kept.name: The Falcon, Airship Restored
kept.why: The damage trigger is paid by sacrificing the Falcon itself - it eats only itself, which is the -self form.

kept.name: Azula, On the Hunt
kept.why: The Clue token draws a card, which nothing recorded. eff:lose-life reads as draining an opponent and this is Azula's own life going down, the same direction error the effect.who split exists to prevent. See the eff:lose-life-self proposal on Kothophed.

kept.name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
kept.why: It creates a token that is a COPY of the exiled card and gives it haste - neither was recorded - and the copy is paid for by exiling a creature card from your graveyard.

kept.name: Cathar's Call
kept.why: It is an Aura, so it attaches, and the granted ability makes a token at the beginning of your end step - the token creation was recorded with no timing at all.

kept.name: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
kept.why: The granted ability is an upkeep trigger, and the whole point of the card is the tax: destroy unless you pay {1}. eff:destroy on its own reads as unconditional removal.

kept.name: Mace of the Valiant
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each charge counter. The counter accumulation was recorded but not that it makes the creature bigger.

kept.name: Lita, Mechanical Engineer
kept.why: The token-making ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Dauthi Embrace
kept.why: It grants shadow and changes no power or toughness. grants:shadow already carries the effect; eff:pump wrongly tells the engine this is a creature-buff card.

kept.name: Annex Sentry
kept.why: The entire removal half was missing - it exiles an artifact or creature an opponent controls. The exile lasts only until this creature leaves the battlefield, which is a real leaves trigger.

kept.name: By Invitation Only
kept.why: Every player sacrifices up to 13 creatures. It is a symmetric board wipe and a go-wide deck should never be offered it, which is what scope:wipe is read for.

kept.name: Psychomancer
kept.why: You gain 1 life on every trigger and nothing recorded it. The trigger watches artifacts going to the graveyard OR to exile from the battlefield, so it is a leaves trigger as well as a dies one.

kept.name: Brigone, Soldier of Meletis
kept.why: The draw ability costs {T} and removing a +1/+1 counter, and neither cost was recorded. scope:all is wrong: nothing on this card affects everything, the heroic trigger and the draw both concern Brigone alone.

kept.name: Doomsday Confluence
kept.why: The Dalek token mode was entirely missing. cost:sacrifice means an on-demand sacrifice outlet; this is a mass edict, which eff:sacrifice already says correctly. mv:cheap comes from {X}{X}{B} collapsing to mana value 1 - the card is never actually cheap and mv:cheap would offer it to decks asking for one and two drops.

kept.name: Argent Dais
kept.why: The oil counters go on the Dais itself, and the attack trigger - whenever two or more creatures attack - was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Basal Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability is 'Sacrifice this permanent: Add {B}{B}' - every Sliver becomes a one-shot self-sacrifice mana source, and only the mana half was recorded.

kept.name: Vampire Nocturnus
kept.why: It gives itself and every other Vampire flying, not just +2/+1.

kept.name: The Animus
kept.why: The copy ability costs {T}. The end step trigger exiles a card from any graveyard, and the whole engine then reads cards in exile.

kept.name: Unexpected Fangs
kept.why: A lifelink counter grants lifelink to the creature. The counter types were recorded but not what the lifelink counter does.

kept.name: Null Rod
kept.why: The card's entire text - activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated - produced no effect word at all. eff:cant-activate exists for exactly this.

kept.name: Prototype Portal
kept.why: It creates a token that is a COPY of the imprinted card, the ability costs {T}, and the imprint exiles an artifact card out of your hand.

kept.name: Pull from Eternity
kept.why: It moves a face-up exiled card into its owner's graveyard. Nothing is returned to hand or the battlefield, so eff:return-from wrongly marks it as recursion; eff:move-zone is the accurate word, and the card only matters in a deck that wants cards in graveyards.

kept.name: Tribute to Horobi // Echo of Death's Wail
kept.why: Most of this card was unread. Chapters I and II make Rat tokens, chapter III exiles the Saga and returns it transformed, and the back face's enter trigger gains control of ALL Rat tokens - the steal is the entire payoff and nothing recorded it. mv:cheap is wrong: the front face costs {2}{B}, mana value 3.

kept.name: Ward Sliver
kept.why: "All Slivers have protection from the chosen color" — the grant itself was never recorded, only the choosing. It affects every Sliver on the battlefield, opponents' included.

kept.name: Hostile Desert
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. The second ability turns the land into a 3/4 Elemental (animate) and pays for it by exiling a land card from your graveyard, which is both an exile cost and a genuine graveyard payoff.

kept.name: Regal Sliver
kept.why: Nothing on this card draws — the monarch is what draws, and the card never says the word. The granted ability's real second half is becoming the monarch, which was missing entirely.

kept.name: Deification
kept.why: "Choose a planeswalker type" is a choice on resolution like Ward Sliver's. The damage-replacement clause keeps your planeswalkers alive through what would otherwise kill them, which is the card's whole job.

kept.name: Stalactite Dagger
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1" was not recorded at all. "and is all creature types" is changeling by another name, which matters to any tribal deck running this.

kept.name: Eternity Vessel
kept.why: The landfall trigger sets your life total to the number of charge counters. The list recorded the trigger and none of what it does.

kept.name: Bontu the Glorified
kept.why: "Bontu can't attack or block unless a creature died under your control this turn" is a real restriction on itself and is the reason the card needs a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Dauntless Bodyguard
kept.why: "As this creature enters, choose another creature you control" — the choice is what the whole card hangs on and was not written down.

kept.name: Maximum Overdrive
kept.why: Granting indestructible until end of turn is a protection trick, and that is what this instant is for. Marked rec:full while missing it.

kept.name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
kept.why: The second sentence exiles cards from the controller's hand. Only the destroy half was recorded.

kept.name: Magister of Worth
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures other than this creature" is a symmetric board wipe — it kills your own creatures too. Only the bare eff:destroy was present, which reads as spot removal.

kept.name: Liliana's Specter
kept.why: "Each opponent discards a card" is a mass effect, the same shape scope:all already carries on Bontu's "each opponent loses 1 life".

kept.name: Bane of the Living
kept.why: "All creatures get -X/-X" kills the whole board including yours. eff:shrink alone does not say it is a sweeper.

kept.name: Ring of Thune
kept.why: The upkeep counter only happens "if it's white" — the card genuinely conditions on a colour, which nothing in the list said.

kept.name: Ebonblade Reaper
kept.why: The list carried two triggers and NOT ONE effect word. Both triggers halve a life total: yours on attack, the defending player's on combat damage.

kept.name: Flickerform
kept.why: The exile half was read and the return half was not — the creature comes back at the next end step with its Auras. This is the same shape as a blink spell, which carries eff:exile-own, cares:zone:exile and eff:return-from together.

kept.name: Petrified Hamlet
kept.why: "When this land enters, choose a land card name" — everything else the card does keys off that choice and the choice itself was not recorded.

kept.name: Feral Deathgorger // Dusk Sight
kept.why: "Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard" is graveyard hate and produced no word at all. Only the back face's counter and draw were read.

kept.name: Runechanter's Pike
kept.why: "Equipped creature has first strike and gets +X/+0" — both the keyword grant and the pump were missing, leaving an Equipment that appears to do nothing when attached.

kept.name: Battle-Rage Blessing
kept.why: Indestructible until end of turn is a protection trick and that is the only reason the card is played.

kept.name: Hissing Miasma
kept.why: There is no "unless that player pays" clause anywhere in the text — the life loss is unconditional. The word wrongly marks this as a taxing effect.

kept.name: Rasaad yn Bashir
kept.why: The list held two keywords and a trigger and NO effect word. "Double the toughness of each creature you control until end of turn" is a mass pump.

kept.name: Shimmercreep
kept.why: "Each opponent loses X life" reaches the whole table, the same way scope:all is already used for Bontu's each-opponent drain.

kept.name: Altar of the Goyf
kept.why: "Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +X/+X" — an entire triggered ability, its trigger and its effect, produced no words. Only the trample grant was read.

kept.name: Blessing of Leeches
kept.why: A free regenerate on the enchanted creature is the whole point of the Aura — it keeps that creature alive. The list recorded only the upkeep life loss, which is the drawback.

kept.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
kept.why: Each opponent exiles a card from hand, and "each spell cast this way costs {1} more". Neither the exile nor the tax was recorded.

kept.name: Shroudstomper
kept.why: "Each opponent loses 2 life" hits the whole table, consistent with how scope:all is used for other each-opponent drains.

kept.name: Gluttonous Guest
kept.why: The second ability — "whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, you gain 1 life" — produced neither its trigger nor its effect. Only the token creation was read.

kept.name: Rat King, Pale Piper
kept.why: The token creation and the sacrifice outlet were read but not what sets them off: Rat King or another nontoken creature LEAVING the battlefield, which includes itself.

kept.name: Sentinel Tower
kept.why: The bare trig:cast does not say WHICH spells set this off, and instant-or-sorcery is the entire condition — this card only belongs in a spellslinger deck.

kept.name: Game Over
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast if..." is a cost reduction and nothing recorded it. Same shape as Ghalta's own wording. The wipe half is already correct.

kept.name: Underworld Coinsmith
kept.why: Constellation reads "whenever THIS CREATURE or another enchantment you control enters", so it triggers off its own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Castle Doom
kept.why: The token ability's cost is "{3}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact" - it eats another permanent on demand, which is a sacrifice outlet and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Raiders' Karve
kept.why: It looks at the top of your library and puts a LAND from there onto the battlefield. That is land ramp off the library and neither the zone nor the land-from-library word was present.

kept.name: Sierra, Nuka's Biggest Fan
kept.why: Three clauses unread: it creates a Food token, it puts a quest counter on ITSELF (self, so it does not read as a counters deck), and the whole thing triggers on your creatures dealing combat damage to a player.

kept.name: Contractual Safeguard
kept.why: "Put a counter of that kind on each OTHER creature you control" is a board-wide effect, not a single target.

kept.name: Preeminent Captain
kept.why: The attack trigger puts a Soldier card FROM YOUR HAND onto the battlefield - exactly the put-onto-battlefield gloss - and nothing recorded that it reads your hand.

kept.name: Recruitment Drive
kept.why: Every one of the three d20 outcomes creates tokens and the card carried no token verb at all - only eff:random.

kept.name: Puppet Strings
kept.why: The ability is "{2}, {T}:" and the tap symbol in the cost was not recorded, so the card reads as though it were free to use repeatedly.

kept.name: Blight Pile
kept.why: "Each opponent loses X life" hits the whole table, matching how every other each-opponent drain in this batch is marked.

kept.name: Sivriss, Nightmare Speaker
kept.why: Only the mill half was read. The ability taps as part of its cost, it returns the milled card FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD to hand, that return is taxed ("unless that player pays 3 life"), and it repeats for each opponent.

kept.name: Boggart Mischief
kept.why: Blight 1 puts a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control - a counter placement on another permanent, unrecorded. The token, drain and lifegain halves are already right.

kept.name: Ghouls' Night Out
kept.why: "For each player, choose a creature card in that player's graveyard" reaches every graveyard at once, not one target.

kept.name: Perilous Snare
kept.why: The main clause - exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls - was entirely unread; the card carried only its counter ability. The linked return also fires when the artifact leaves the battlefield.

kept.name: Phyrexian Dreadnought
kept.why: The enters trigger sacrifices creatures (itself, or a pile with total power 12). No sacrifice verb at all was recorded, which is the entire drawback of the card.

kept.name: Demonic Taskmaster
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature other than this creature" - the card had the trigger recorded and nothing for what the trigger DOES.

kept.name: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath
kept.why: The +2 drains each opponent, matching how each-opponent life loss is marked elsewhere.

kept.name: Charge of the Mites
kept.why: The second mode creates two Phyrexian Mite tokens and no token verb was recorded - only the damage mode and the toxic poison.

kept.name: Whiskervale Forerunner
kept.why: Valiant triggers on the creature BECOMING THE TARGET of your own spell or ability, which trig:cast alone does not say, and the effect digs five cards deep with no library zone recorded.

kept.name: Tombstone Stairwell
kept.why: The whole third paragraph was unread: it destroys all the tokens it made, at the beginning of EACH end step, and again when the enchantment leaves the battlefield. The token half is symmetric across every player, hence scope:all.

kept.name: Guildmages' Forum
kept.why: "If that mana is spent on a multicolored creature spell" is exactly the mana-spent condition, and it is the only reason the +1/+1 counter clause exists.

kept.name: Knight-Captain of Eos
kept.why: The fog ability's cost is "{W}, Sacrifice a Soldier" - a sacrifice outlet, unrecorded - and it prevents ALL combat damage that turn rather than damage to one creature.

kept.name: Squad Commander
kept.why: The enters trigger creates a Kor Warrior token per party member and the card carried no token verb; only the anthem half was read.

kept.name: Kataki, War's Wage
kept.why: The granted ability is "sacrifice this artifact UNLESS YOU PAY {1}" - the tax is the whole point of the card and only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Liliana's Devotee
kept.why: "You may pay {1}{B}. If you do, create..." is an optional cost gating the token, unrecorded.

kept.name: Ashe, Princess of Dalmasca
kept.why: She exiles nothing. She looks at the top five, reveals an artifact card and puts it INTO YOUR HAND, with the rest going to the bottom. eff:impulse means exiling off the top to play the cards, which would file her with Prosper and Wild-Magic Sorcerer, and cares:zone:exile is the same misread. eff:look-and-pick and cares:zone:library already say what she does.

kept.name: Netherborn Altar
kept.why: The ability costs {T} AND putting a soul counter on itself, neither recorded, and its actual effect - moving your commander from the command zone to your hand - had no verb at all, leaving the card with nothing but cares:commander.

kept.name: Secret Salvage
kept.why: Exiles from your graveyard and searches your library, then shuffles. Both zones and the shuffle were unrecorded.

kept.name: Neva, Stalked by Nightmares
kept.why: Nothing on Neva is a mass effect: one targeted return, one counter on herself, scry 1. scope:all is a false positive from the 'an enchantment you control' selector.

kept.name: Ria Ivor, Bane of Bladehold
kept.why: The begin-combat ability prevents the next combat damage a creature would deal, which was entirely unrecorded. Battle cry's printed reminder is a trigger on attacking that pumps each other attacker, the same way toxic and annihilator are read elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Souls of the Lost
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or sacrifice a permanent' is a cast cost, not an on-demand outlet and not a discard effect. cost:sacrifice would advertise it to aristocrats decks as a sacrifice outlet, which it is not.

kept.name: Eldrazi Ravager
kept.why: Annihilator triggers on attacking, which was missing. 'Sacrifice two Eldrazi: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand' is literally the eff:recur-self shape.

kept.name: Penance
kept.why: It answers a black OR red source and only red was recorded. The source is 'of your choice', which is a real choice on resolution.

kept.name: Destined Confrontation
kept.why: Every player sacrifices all creatures over total power 4, yours included. It is a symmetric board wipe and should be refused by go-wide decks the way a Wrath is.

kept.name: Okiba-Gang Shinobi
kept.why: Ninjutsu's cost is returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Omen Machine
kept.why: The list held only the timing. Each player exiles the top card of their library and casts it without paying its mana cost, which is exactly impulse plus a free cast, and it applies to every player.

kept.name: Cruel Reality
