kept.name: Starseer Mentor
kept.why: "loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card" is a punisher clause. eff:lose-life alone hides that the opponent gets a choice and that this taxes them every turn.

kept.name: Wakestone Gargoyle
kept.why: The ability affects every creature you control with defender, not one target.

kept.name: The Spot's Portal
kept.why: "You lose 2 life unless you control a Villain" is a penalty on the caster. Recorded as eff:lose-life it tells the engine this is a drain spell for a Marchesa or Vito deck, which is exactly backwards.

kept.name: Discreet Retreat
kept.why: The draw trigger is "whenever YOU cast your first outlaw spell each turn". Bare trig:cast covers any player casting, which would file this with Noosegraf Mob rather than with a spellcaster payoff.

kept.name: Shield of Duty and Reason
kept.why: An Aura attaching to a creature: eff:attach beside grants:protection is what identifies a protection piece rather than a generic enchantment. It also names blue and no colour was recorded.

kept.name: Sheltering Light
kept.why: Granting indestructible to a creature until end of turn in response to removal is precisely keeping your creature alive. eff:pump does not say that.

kept.name: Blood Tithe
kept.why: "Each opponent loses 3 life" hits the whole table, which is what makes it a Commander card rather than a two-player one.

kept.name: Scourglass
kept.why: The activation cost includes {T} and nothing recorded it. Destroying all permanents except artifacts and lands wipes your own creatures, enchantments and planeswalkers too, which is what scope:wipe is for.

kept.name: Mornsong Aria
kept.why: Both halves are symmetric across the table ("players can't", "each player's draw step") and the search happens in the library, which no word recorded.

kept.name: Oath of Liliana
kept.why: "Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice" is a table-wide edict, not a single-target one.

kept.name: Prowl, Stoic Strategist // Prowl, Pursuit Vehicle
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unread: it draws a card when an exiled card is played, it is a genuine exile-zone payoff (the cards stay exiled and are played from there), and the back face triggers on another creature or Vehicle you control entering. Converting is transforming. Every counter it adds goes on itself, so the generic add-counters word is unsupported.

kept.name: Diamond Lion
kept.why: None of the three activation costs was recorded. Discarding your hand as a cost is what makes this a discard outlet for madness and graveyard decks, and cost:discard-self is the word for it; eff:discard-self alone leaves it looking like a downside rather than an enabler.

kept.name: Treacherous Greed
kept.why: The additional cost is a sacrifice made to cast the spell, which is what cost:cast-sacrifice names, and the drain hits each opponent, the same wording that carries scope:all on Acolyte of Aclazotz and Wicked Visitor in this batch.

kept.name: Haazda Marshal
kept.why: The card gains no life. It makes a token that HAS lifelink, which is a word scan picking up the keyword on the token. Nothing about this card belongs in a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Trailblazer's Torch
kept.why: The whole middle ability is a blocked trigger and no trigger word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Interceptor, Shadow's Hound
kept.why: "Whenever you attack with one or more legendary creatures" is an attack trigger and none was recorded. "You may pay {2}{B}. If you do" is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Gollum's Bite
kept.why: The second ability is activated from the graveyard by exiling the card itself, which is cost:exile-self, and a spell that keeps working from the graveyard is genuinely graveyard-relevant.

kept.name: Nettle Guard
kept.why: "It gets +0/+2 until end of turn" is a pump and was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Unholy Indenture
kept.why: The whole point of the card is returning the dead creature from the graveyard to the battlefield, and only the counter was written down.

kept.name: Caress of Phyrexia
kept.why: "Gets three poison counters" is untouched by the list. Poison counters are also counters placed on a player, which is what eff:player-counter names.

kept.name: Ethereal Absolution
kept.why: Two of the three abilities were unrecorded: the -1/-1 on opponents' creatures is a shrink, and the activated ability is graveyard hate that exiles from an opponent's graveyard.

kept.name: Forbidding Watchtower
kept.why: The land turns itself into a 1/5 Soldier, which is precisely eff:animate. Only the mana ability was read.

kept.name: Deadly Precision
kept.why: The additional cost to cast includes sacrificing an artifact or creature, so it is a real sacrifice outlet at cast time.

kept.name: Gate to the Aether
kept.why: Nothing recorded what the card actually does. It reveals the top card of every player's library, which is library interaction, and it applies to each player symmetrically.

kept.name: Spellweaver Helix
kept.why: The list said only that it enters and mentions sorceries. It exiles two cards out of a graveyard, keys off the cards exiled with it, triggers whenever a player casts a card, copies the other card, and lets you cast that copy without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Tune Up
kept.why: "If it's a Vehicle, it becomes an artifact creature" turns a permanent into a creature.

kept.name: Ghastly Conscription
kept.why: It exiles ALL creature cards from a target player's graveyard, which is both graveyard hate and a mass effect, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Trove Warden
kept.why: The death trigger returns each permanent card exiled with it, so the exile zone is where the card keeps its value.

kept.name: Gandalf, White Rider
kept.why: The death trigger puts Gandalf into his owner's library fifth from the top. That clause was entirely unread: it moves a card between zones and it targets the library.

kept.name: Vanguard Seraph
kept.why: The trigger condition is gaining life and no trigger word was recorded, so the card reads as a flier that surveils for no reason. This is a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Ammit Eternal
kept.why: The third ability removes all -1/-1 counters from it, and only counter-adding was written down.

kept.name: Arcbound Overseer
kept.why: Modular carries a death trigger that moves its +1/+1 counters to another artifact creature. The counter effect was recorded but the trigger that delivers it was not.

kept.name: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills
kept.why: The attack tax is a global static applying to every creature that would attack you, not a targeted effect.

kept.name: Astral Slide
kept.why: The card exiles a creature and that verb was missing entirely, so it carried a protect and a return with nothing to say how the creature left.

kept.name: Shrieking Affliction
kept.why: The condition is that the opponent has one or fewer cards in hand, which is a hand-size payoff and the whole reason the card exists, and it applies to each opponent.

kept.name: Whispering Specter
kept.why: The discard trigger is paid for by sacrificing the Specter itself ("you may sacrifice it. If you do..."), which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Curse of Silence
kept.why: The whole card watches spells being cast by the enchanted player, both to tax them and to trigger the draw.

kept.name: Moonstone, Harsh Mistress
kept.why: Nothing is returned anywhere: the card is exiled from the graveyard and you are given permission to play it from exile, so eff:return-from is wrong. The real effect is casting a card that was in your graveyard, by way of exile.

kept.name: Embrace Oblivion
kept.why: It destroys ONE target creature or Spacecraft. scope:all reads as a mass effect and would let a board wipe check see it.

kept.name: Knight of Dawn's Light
kept.why: "If you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead" is a lifegain replacement effect and the card was recorded as caring about nothing.

kept.name: Campus Guide
kept.why: It searches for one basic land and shuffles; the shuffle was unrecorded. scope:all is wrong - a single tutor affects nothing broadly.

kept.name: Lucy MacLean, Positively Armed
kept.why: The token created is "a copy of it", and the ability ends "then you draw a card if an opponent created a token this way". Neither the copying nor the draw was written down.

kept.name: Devouring Swarm
kept.why: Sacrificing one creature to pump itself affects nothing globally.

kept.name: Sylvia Brightspear
kept.why: Partner with is an enter-the-battlefield trigger that tutors Khorvath out of a library and shuffles. eff:search-library was recorded but the trigger that causes it, the library zone and the shuffle were all missing.

kept.name: Toxin Sliver
kept.why: The card's entire function is destroying a creature dealt combat damage by a Sliver, and eff:destroy was absent. Nothing recorded that this card removes anything.

kept.name: Never // Return
kept.why: The whole Return half was unread: it exiles a card from a graveyard (graveyard hate) and makes a 2/2 Zombie. Aftermath also casts this card from your own graveyard, which is eff:recur-self.

kept.name: Moonstone Harbinger
kept.why: "Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn" is the only trigger on the card and neither event was recorded, so the pump and deathtouch grant had no cause attached.

kept.name: Collective Brutality
kept.why: It is a modal "choose one or more" spell, and Escalate is an additional cost of discarding a card to cast it. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Promise of Bunrei
kept.why: The card makes four 1/1 Spirits by sacrificing itself, and NEITHER was recorded - the list said only that it triggers on a creature dying, with no effect at all.

kept.name: Bite of the Black Rose
kept.why: Will of the council is a voting card and the vote facet was missing, unlike the other voting cards in this batch.

kept.name: Panther Robot
kept.why: Affinity for artifacts is a cost reduction on this spell and nothing recorded that the card costs less; the ten-mana printed cost is otherwise taken at face value.

kept.name: Kismet
kept.why: It affects every artifact, creature and land every opponent plays for the rest of the game - a genuine mass static effect, recorded as an unqualified eff:tap.

kept.name: Torgaar, Famine Incarnate
kept.why: Everything the card does was missing. It sacrifices any number of creatures as an additional cost, costs {2} less per creature, and halves a player's life total on entry - the list held only the trigger with no effect on it.

kept.name: Elspeth's Nightmare
kept.why: Chapter I only hits a creature "with power 2 or less", which is a power-conditioned effect and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Ajani Fells the Godsire
kept.why: Chapter II makes a 2/1 Cat Warrior token and puts a vigilance counter on a creature - neither was recorded. Chapter I is conditioned on power 3 or greater.

kept.name: Dark Knight's Greatsword
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and no pump was recorded. Job select is this Equipment's own enter trigger, so trig:enters-self belongs alongside trig:enters.

kept.name: Edgar's Awakening
kept.why: The discard-triggered half offers an optional {B} payment for a second recursion, which is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid, and the card is discarded from hand to do it.

kept.name: Gloom Ripper
kept.why: Both halves of the enter trigger were missing: +X/+0 to your creature and -0/-X to an opponent's. The card was recorded as entering the battlefield and doing nothing.

kept.name: Fíli the Pathfinder
kept.why: "Creatures you control get +1/+1" while you have an enduring story is an anthem and no pump was recorded. Fíli's own entry also triggers the Dwarf token, so trig:enters-self belongs with trig:enters-other.

kept.name: Pit Automaton
kept.why: The second ability copies the next exhaust ability you activate; nothing recorded that this card copies anything.

kept.name: Wall of Limbs
kept.why: The drain is "X life, where X is this creature's power", which scales with power and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Armed with Proof
kept.why: It grants Clues "+2/+0" and equip {2}, so it both pumps and attaches, and the Clues it makes sacrifice for a card. None of the three was recorded.

kept.name: Lantern of the Lost
kept.why: The activated ability costs {1}, a tap and exiling itself, and empties EVERY graveyard - a mass effect. Only the draw and one targeted exile were recorded.

kept.name: The Fall of Lord Konda // Fragment of Konda
kept.why: Chapter III exiles this Saga and returns it transformed - neither the self-exile nor the transform effect was recorded, only the printed keyword. Chapter II touches all permanents every player owns.

kept.name: Hexgold Hoverwings
kept.why: "Creatures you control that are equipped get +1/+0" is a pump nothing recorded, and For Mirrodin! is an enter trigger that was missing entirely.

kept.name: King of the Oathbreakers
kept.why: The phase-out fires when a Spirit "becomes the target of a spell", which is precisely trig:cast:targeting; the list carried only the generic trig:cast.

kept.name: Innocuous Rat
kept.why: Manifest dread looks at the top two cards of your library and takes one; only the token and the mill half were recorded.

kept.name: Eternal Dragon
kept.why: "Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is self-recursion, not a generic return. Plainscycling discards this card as a cost, puts the land in hand and shuffles.

kept.name: Okiba Reckoner Raid // Nezumi Road Captain
kept.why: Chapter III exiles this Saga and returns it transformed; none of that was written down. The Saga also puts lore counters on itself.

kept.name: Amazing Alliance
kept.why: The whole second line - a lifegain payoff triggered by attacking with legendary creatures - was missing; only the anthem was read.

kept.name: Fire Nation Occupation
kept.why: "Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn" is a cast trigger on your own spells and was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Case of the Shattered Pact
kept.why: The search puts the land in hand and shuffles. Nothing on this card affects everything - the solved ability targets one creature you control - so scope:all misreads it as a mass effect.

kept.name: Vizier of Remedies
kept.why: The replacement applies to every creature you control, and the card's only real effect had no word at all.

kept.name: Venom's Hunger
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast if you control a Villain" is a stated cost reduction and was unread.

kept.name: Pyxis of Pandemonium
kept.why: Nothing this card does was recorded. Both abilities tap it, the second sacrifices it, each player exiles off the top of their library, and the payoff moves every exiled permanent onto the battlefield.

kept.name: Karn, Silver Golem
kept.why: Neither ability was read. He triggers on blocking and on becoming blocked with a P/T change, and the activated ability animates a noncreature artifact and sets its power and toughness to its mana value.

kept.name: Ransack the Lab
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top - the card goes to your hand, so impulse and the exile zone are both wrong. The other two cards go to your graveyard, which is self-mill.

kept.name: Cut of the Profits
kept.why: Casualty 3 is an additional cost to cast that sacrifices a creature; only the copy it produces was recorded.

kept.name: Return from Extinction
kept.why: This returns creature cards from the graveyard, not permanents from the battlefield, so bounce-own is wrong. It is a modal spell and nothing said so.

kept.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
kept.why: Each opponent discards their whole hand, which is a mass effect. It also gives itself indestructible while the divinity counter is there and the engine had no record of that at all.

kept.name: Fates' Reversal
kept.why: The returned creature card goes to your hand.

kept.name: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +2/+2" is an anthem over your board and only the choose and the token half were read.

kept.name: Banishing Slash
kept.why: The second sentence makes a 2/2 Samurai and was not recorded.

kept.name: Eater of Days
kept.why: The entire drawback - skipping your next two turns - had no word; eff:skip-phase is the vocabulary's word for skipping or adding a phase.

kept.name: Infernal Sovereign
kept.why: The trigger draws a card AND loses you 1 life, and it is your own casts that fire it. Only the draw half was read.

kept.name: Flash Thompson, Spider-Fan
kept.why: "Choose one or both" is a modal enters trigger and nothing said the card offers a choice.

kept.name: Insidious Dreams
kept.why: Discarding X cards is an additional cost to cast, which is a stronger and more precise statement than the bare discard already recorded, and the search shuffles.

kept.name: Lotus Blossom
kept.why: The mana ability taps and sacrifices this artifact; neither cost was recorded, so it does not read as the one-shot ritual it is.

kept.name: Compleated Huntmaster
kept.why: This is a repeatable sacrifice outlet - "Sacrifice another creature or artifact" - and that is the whole reason the card is played. Neither the tap nor the sacrifice cost was written down.

kept.name: Stasis Snare
kept.why: "until this enchantment leaves the battlefield" means the exiled creature comes back when the Snare goes, which is a leaves trigger on itself and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Elsewhere Flask
kept.why: "Each land you control becomes that type" affects your whole mana base, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Davriel, Rogue Shadowmage
kept.why: The damage trigger checks whether the opponent has one or fewer cards in hand - the card is a hand-size payoff and that was unread.

kept.name: Light the Way
kept.why: It is a modal spell, and the second mode returns a permanent YOU control to hand, which is exactly bounce-own rather than the generic move-zone already there.

kept.name: Cartel Aristocrat
kept.why: The ability gives protection to this creature only. Nothing here affects everything, and scope:all makes a one-creature protection outlet read as a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Spider-Suit
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and the pump was never recorded - only the attach was.

kept.name: Spread the Sickness
kept.why: Half the card is a proliferate and no effect word said so.

kept.name: Pentarch Ward
kept.why: This is an Aura that attaches to a creature and grants it protection from a chosen colour - the protection, which is the whole point of the card, had no word at all.

kept.name: Kalastria Highborn
kept.why: The trigger drains: the opponent loses 2 AND you gain 2, and only the loss was recorded. It is also gated on paying {B}, which do-if-cost-paid states.

kept.name: Mana Web
kept.why: The whole effect is "tap all lands that player controls" and no tap word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Rakish Crew
kept.why: Second ability is "Whenever an outlaw you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life". The dies trigger and the lifegain half were both missing; only the drain half was recorded.

kept.name: Gorex, the Tombshell
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast for each card exiled this way" is a cost reduction and nothing said so. The exile is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, which is what cost:cast-exile names. The attack/death trigger returns a card from EXILE, so the card cares about the exile zone as a resource.

kept.name: Gloryheath Lynx
kept.why: It searches your library for a basic Plains, which is a land tutor and the only reason the attack trigger exists. eff:search-library alone does not say a land was the target.

kept.name: Skyboon Evangelist
kept.why: "that creature gains flying until end of turn" is a flying grant and was absent entirely, and the ability is a "whenever a creature ... attacks" trigger, so the attack trigger was missing too.

kept.name: Dark Sphere
kept.why: The ability costs "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact". Only the sacrifice half of the cost was recorded.

kept.name: Web-Shooters
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 (a pump), has reach (a keyword grant), and gains an attack trigger. Only the tap half of the granted trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Butch DeLoria, Tunnel Snake
kept.why: "Whenever Butch DeLoria attacks, it gets +1/+1 for each other Rogue and/or Snake" is an attack trigger and a pump, neither recorded. The menace counter grants menace to another creature, which is a grant rather than a bare counter.

kept.name: Cairn Wanderer
kept.why: The card names thirteen keywords and only eight grants were recorded; double strike, lifelink, reach and vigilance are all in the same sentence as the ones that were. More importantly the entire card is conditioned on what is in GRAVEYARDS, and no graveyard word was present at all.

kept.name: Chain Devil
kept.why: "each player sacrifices a nontoken creature" was recorded as nothing but an enters trigger. The edict itself, the only effect on the card, had no word.

kept.name: Nezumi Graverobber // Nighteyes the Desecrator
kept.why: The front face's whole ability is "Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard", which is graveyard hate and kept apart from plain exile. "flip this creature" turns it to its other face.

kept.name: Humility
kept.why: "have base power and toughness 1/1" is exactly setting power and toughness; only the ability-stripping half was recorded.

kept.name: Venom, Evil Unleashed
kept.why: The activated ability is played FROM the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"), so the card is a graveyard-zone card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Terminal Moraine
kept.why: Nothing on this card is global. It searches for one basic land and puts it onto the battlefield; a wrongly global scope makes it look like a mass effect.

kept.name: Spark Harvest
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" is the defining line of the card and carried no cost word at all, so the one-mana price of the removal was invisible.

kept.name: Hollow Marauder
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard" is both a cost reduction and a graveyard-count card; neither was recorded.

kept.name: Stirge
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed line on the card and had no word.

kept.name: Alliance of Arms
kept.why: The card creates X 1/1 Soldier tokens for every player and carried no token word at all, which is the entire effect.

kept.name: Aerith Rescue Mission
kept.why: Mode one creates three Hero tokens (no token word recorded) and mode two puts a stun counter on a creature (no counter word). It is a modal "Choose one" spell, which nothing recorded either.

kept.name: Joo Dee, One of Many
kept.why: "then sacrifice an artifact or creature" is part of the resolving ability, not a cost, and had no word. It makes the card a repeatable sacrifice engine rather than only a token copier.

kept.name: Spawnsire of Ulamog
kept.why: "{20}: Cast any number of Eldrazi spells ... without paying their mana costs" is the famous half of the card and had no word. Annihilator is an attack trigger, so the trigger was missing as well.

kept.name: Vedalken Shackles
kept.why: The list held nothing but printed facts for a card whose whole purpose is stealing creatures. It gains control of a creature, costs {2} and a tap, and the target is chosen by comparing its POWER to your Island count.

kept.name: Zephyrim
kept.why: Squad reads "When this creature enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it". The copy and token words were recorded but the enters trigger that produces them was not.

kept.name: Desperate Measures
kept.why: "When it dies under your control this turn, draw two cards" is a death trigger and is the reason the card exists; only the draw was recorded.

kept.name: Imperial Recovery Unit
kept.why: Crew 2 taps other creatures you control to pay for it, the same cost shape recorded for saddle elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Ascendant Evincar
kept.why: "Nonblack creatures get -1/-1" is a one-sided sweeper against the rest of the table and only the +1/+1 half for black creatures was recorded.

kept.name: Ugin's Conjurant
kept.why: The second paragraph prevents the damage and removes that many +1/+1 counters from itself; neither the prevention nor the counter removal was recorded, and they are the whole reason the card is playable. mv:cheap is false: its cost is {X} alone, so its printed mana value collapses to zero and it reads as a two-drop when it is only cheap if you pay nothing for it.

kept.name: Myojin of Grim Betrayal
kept.why: The ability is paid for by removing the indestructible counter, which had no cost word, and it reanimates ALL creature cards in ALL graveyards, which is a mass effect. trig:dies is wrong: there is no death trigger anywhere on the card, only the phrase "put there from anywhere this turn", which is a filter on which cards come back.

kept.name: Scourge of the Skyclaves
kept.why: "each player loses half their life, rounded up" is the kicked payoff and the reason the card is played, and it had no word for the life loss at all.

kept.name: Dread Statuary
kept.why: The second ability turns the land into a 4/2 Golem artifact creature and nothing recorded it. The card is also entirely colourless (adds {C}, no coloured symbols anywhere), so it has no colour identity.

kept.name: Thawing Glaciers
kept.why: The activated ability ends with a shuffle, which was unrecorded. The land produces no mana and prints no coloured symbol, so its identity is empty. scope:all is wrong: it fetches one basic land and bounces itself, it affects nothing globally.

kept.name: Proud Pack-Rhino
kept.why: A shield counter is a protection effect - it replaces damage or destruction - and nothing on the list says the card keeps a permanent alive.

kept.name: Mole Module
kept.why: Only the mill half was read. "You may put a permanent card from among them onto the battlefield" puts a milled card back from the graveyard, which is recursion, and the card is therefore a graveyard card rather than a pure miller.

kept.name: Vault 11: Voter's Dilemma
kept.why: Chapter I creates a Human Soldier token per opponent and eff:create-token was missing entirely. Chapters II and III affect every player: each player votes, each player draws if no creature got votes (a symmetric draw, not just yours), and the destruction hits every creature tied for most votes. The card is also a genuine vote card.

kept.name: Price of Knowledge
kept.why: Both halves are global: "Players have no maximum hand size" is a static affecting everyone, and the damage trigger fires on each opponent's upkeep.

kept.name: Flensing Raptor
kept.why: The entire enters trigger was unread: it gives +1/+1 and grants flying to another toxic creature. Only the toxic keyword itself had been recorded.

kept.name: The Duke, Rebel Sentry
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T} and the removal of a counter, and neither cost was recorded. Granting hexproof until end of turn is a protection trick, which is what eff:protect is for.

kept.name: Corpse Harvester
kept.why: The ability taps and ends with a shuffle, both unrecorded, and it searches the library. cost:sacrifice-self is wrong: "Sacrifice a creature" eats any creature on demand, which is a repeatable sacrifice outlet (cost:sacrifice, already present), not a card that only eats itself once.

kept.name: Mortarion, Daemon Primarch
kept.why: The token count is gated behind "you may pay {X}. If you do", which is exactly the pay-for-more shape and was not recorded.

kept.name: Augusta, Order Returned
kept.why: The attack trigger makes each player exile a card from their graveyard - graveyard hate that also feeds the counters - and none of that was recorded. It hits every player, so it is global.

kept.name: Evil Eye of Urborg
kept.why: "Non-Eye creatures you control can't attack" is a real attack restriction on your whole board and was not written down at all. trig:blocks is wrong - the Eye never blocks, it triggers on BECOMING blocked, which trig:becomes-blocked already says.

kept.name: Lorcan, Warlock Collector
kept.why: The creature comes back onto the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL from an opponent's graveyard, which is theft and not merely recursion. It is also gated on "you may pay life equal to its mana value. If you do".

kept.name: Twinblade Paladin
kept.why: Both abilities key off life - a counter whenever you gain life and double strike at 25 or more life. It is a definitive lifegain payoff and only the trigger was recorded, not that the card cares about lifegain.

kept.name: Fleshwrither
kept.why: Transfigure searches the library and then shuffles. The search was already read from the reminder text, so the library interaction and the shuffle belong with it.

kept.name: Rush of Vitality
kept.why: Granting indestructible until end of turn is a protection trick that saves a creature from removal, which no word on the list currently says.

kept.name: Venom, Eddie Brock
kept.why: "If that creature was a Villain, draw a card" was missed entirely - only the counter half of the death trigger was read.

kept.name: Grey Host Reinforcements
kept.why: The enters trigger exiles a whole player's graveyard, which is graveyard hate, and nothing recorded it - only the counters it gets from doing so.

kept.name: Flowerfoot Swordmaster
kept.why: Valiant triggers when the creature becomes the target of your own spell or ability, which trig:cast alone does not say. The offspring token is made by "when this creature enters", a trigger on itself.

kept.name: Locust Miser
kept.why: It hits every opponent. Beyond that the card's only effect cannot be expressed at all - see the proposal.

kept.name: Spirit Bonds
kept.why: The sacrifice ability grants indestructible to save a creature, which is protection and was not recorded. eff:pump is wrong - nothing on this card changes power or toughness.

kept.name: Clay Golem
kept.why: The activation rolls a d8, which is a real randomness card and was unrecorded. Monstrosity X puts X +1/+1 counters on the Golem itself, so it grows itself; only the berserk destroy half had been read.

kept.name: Phantom Train
kept.why: The ability makes the Vehicle a Spirit artifact creature until end of turn, which nothing said. scope:all is wrong: sacrificing one artifact or creature to grow itself affects nothing globally.

kept.name: Parallax Wave
kept.why: The leave-the-battlefield trigger returns every card exiled with it to the battlefield, which is the whole point of the card and was unrecorded, and it parks creatures in exile in the meantime.

kept.name: Misfortune Teller
kept.why: The trigger fires on the Teller's own arrival as well as on combat damage, and only the generic trig:enters was recorded. cost:exile is wrong - exiling a card from a graveyard is the EFFECT, not a cost paid to activate anything, and eff:exile-graveyard already says it.

kept.name: Prismatic Strands
kept.why: Preventing all damage from every source of a chosen colour is a board-wide fog that keeps your creatures alive, and neither the global reach nor the protective purpose was recorded.

kept.name: Chronomantic Escape
kept.why: It exiles itself with three time counters, which nothing recorded. "Creatures can't attack you" is a blanket effect, not a single target, so scope:all.

kept.name: Transcendence
kept.why: The whole point of the card - "you gain 2 life for each 1 life you lost" - was unwritten, and it also states an outright loss condition ("When you have 20 or more life, you lose the game").

kept.name: Tavern Swindler
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as 3 life; only the life half was recorded.

kept.name: Razorlash Transmogrant
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed restriction on itself and was not written down.

kept.name: Terror of Towashi
kept.why: The reanimation is gated on "you may pay {3}{B}. When you do" - the optional-payment shape, which is the difference between a free attack trigger and one you must fund.

kept.name: Evin, Waterdeep Opportunist
kept.why: "Whenever one or more players sacrifice one or more creatures" is the card's only trigger and it was missing, so nothing connected it to a sacrifice deck.

kept.name: Bonebind Orator
kept.why: It returns a creature CARD from your graveyard to your hand. eff:bounce-own means picking your own creature up off the battlefield, which this cannot do. eff:return-from already states the real effect.

kept.name: Summoning Station
kept.why: The token ability is "{T}:", a tap cost that was not recorded - which matters because the second ability untaps it.

kept.name: Corpses of the Lost
kept.why: "you may pay 1 life. If you do" is both a life cost and the optional-payment shape. Descend checks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard, so it genuinely cares about the graveyard.

kept.name: Scrounge for Eternity
kept.why: "Then create a Lander token" - it makes a token every time and nothing said so.

kept.name: Mobile Homestead
kept.why: "This Vehicle has haste as long as you control a Mount" grants haste. The attack trigger puts a land from the top of your library onto the battlefield, which is land acceleration out of the library.

kept.name: Tegan Jovanka
kept.why: The trigger gives +1/+1 and indestructible; only the keyword grant was recorded, so the stat buff and the keep-it-alive effect were both missing.

kept.name: Lantern of Revealing
kept.why: The second ability looks for a land on top of your library and puts it onto the battlefield - land acceleration, same shape as Mobile Homestead.

kept.name: Eagle of Deliverance
kept.why: "Draw a card if that creature's power is 2 or less" reads power off a creature. An indestructible counter is there to keep the creature alive.

kept.name: Magus of the Mirror
kept.why: The cost is "{T}, Sacrifice this creature"; only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Bitterheart Witch
kept.why: The death trigger searches your library for a Curse card; the library search was noted as an effect but the zone it cares about was not.

kept.name: Rent Is Due
kept.why: The card's entire payoff is "draw a card" and it was absent. It pays for that by tapping two creatures and/or Treasures you control, which is tapping your own permanents.

kept.name: Vibranium Strike Gauntlets
kept.why: Only the attach was recorded. The equipped creature gets +3/+0, gains trample, and gains "whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card" - three real effects and a trigger, none written down.

kept.name: Panther Habit
kept.why: "prevent that damage" is half of what the card does and was missing; only the counters half was recorded.

kept.name: Bandage
kept.why: The first line of the card prevents 1 damage to any target and nothing recorded it, so the card read as a bare cantrip.

kept.name: Poison-Blade Mentor
kept.why: The trigger grants deathtouch and nothing else. There is no +N/+N anywhere in the text, so eff:pump is wrong; grants:deathtouch already carries the real effect.

kept.name: Resplendent Marshal
kept.why: Everything the card does was missing: it puts a +1/+1 counter on EACH other creature you control sharing a type, and it exiles a creature card from your graveyard to do it. Only the triggers were recorded. Note I have deliberately not proposed eff:exile-graveyard here - it eats your OWN graveyard as fuel, and that word is graveyard hate, so it would misfile a graveyard-deck payoff as an attack on graveyards.

kept.name: Sporogenic Infection
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature", so it attaches. "When enchanted creature is dealt damage, destroy it" is a damage-dealt trigger, and the destroy was recorded with no trigger to fire it.

kept.name: Dollhouse of Horrors
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the exile, and it creates a token that is a COPY of the exiled card - the copying was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Planar Void
kept.why: It exiles every card put into any graveyard from anywhere, everyone's included, so it is a blanket effect and it plainly cares about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Vayne's Treachery
kept.why: "Kicker - Sacrifice an artifact or creature" is a sacrifice paid as you cast, and the -6/-6 mode only happens if you paid it.

kept.name: Reaper of Sheoldred
kept.why: "Whenever a source deals damage to this creature" is the card's only trigger and the poison effect was recorded with nothing to fire it.

kept.name: Rescue Skiff
kept.why: "When this Spacecraft enters" was missing entirely, so the reanimation had no trigger. Station puts charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to the tapped creature's power - it grows itself with counters and reads power off a creature.

kept.name: Sunder the Gateway
kept.why: "Choose one -" is a modal spell and nothing recorded it. The second mode says "transform an Incubator token you control", which is eff:transform (turning a permanent to its other face), distinct from the kw:transform the reminder text mentions.

kept.name: Valiant Endeavor
kept.why: Half the card was unrecorded: it creates a number of 2/2 Knight tokens and had no eff:create-token at all. It also selects creatures by power ("power greater than or equal to that result"), which is cares:power. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: it is a power-filtered destroy, the same shape as Elspeth, Sun's Champion, which is correctly refused that word.

kept.name: Order of Sacred Dusk
kept.why: cares:color:b is a word scan off the convoke reminder text, "one mana of that creature's color". The card says nothing about black; it is a white-black Vampire lord and marking it as caring about a colour makes it look like a colour-matters card.

kept.name: Yip Yip!
kept.why: The conditional half of the card was dropped: "it also gains flying until end of turn". eff:pump covered only the +2/+2.

kept.name: Gideon Jura
kept.why: The 0 ability was entirely unread. It turns him into a 6/6 creature (eff:animate) and prevents all damage that would be dealt to him (eff:prevent-damage). Only the -2 destroy had been recorded.

kept.name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
kept.why: "It gains haste" was unrecorded, and it is the clause that makes the whole card function - a reanimated Vehicle without haste does nothing that turn.

kept.name: Coordinated Maneuver
kept.why: "Choose one -" is a modal spell and no word recorded it; both modes were read but not the choice.

kept.name: Long Goodbye
kept.why: "This spell can't be countered" is the first line of the card and had no word at all.

kept.name: Scorpion, Seething Striker
kept.why: Connive is spelled out in the reminder text - "Draw a card, then discard a card" - and only the counter half was recorded. The card draws and makes you discard every end step a creature died.

kept.name: Yarok's Fenlurker
kept.why: The entire enter trigger was unrecorded: "each opponent exiles a card from their hand". Only cares:zone:hand hinted at it. Using eff:exile rather than eff:discard because the text says exile and the card is played precisely because the card does not reach a graveyard.

kept.name: Collector's Cage
kept.why: Only the counter ability had been read. Hideaway 5 is an enter trigger that looks at the top five of your library, exiles one face down and later lets you play it without paying its mana cost - that is eff:look-and-pick, eff:impulse and eff:cast-free, across the library and exile zones, and none of it was written down.

kept.name: Windshaper Planetar
kept.why: The card's only ability is an enter trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Anointer Priest
kept.why: The card's whole first ability was missing. It is a lifegain payoff - "whenever a creature token you control enters, you gain 1 life" - and carried neither the trigger nor eff:gain-life. The recorded eff:copy/eff:create-token come from the embalm reminder, so nothing described the card's actual function.

kept.name: Clowning Around
kept.why: A token-making sorcery with no eff:create-token. It makes two, and often three, 1/1 Clown Robot tokens; only the die roll had been read.

kept.name: The Sackville-Bagginses
kept.why: The enter trigger was unread: it has no trigger word, it eats another creature or artifact (cost:sacrifice) and it creates a Treasure token (eff:create-token). eff:draw and eff:lose-life were recorded from the payoff halves without the clause that pays for them.

kept.name: Storm Cauldron
kept.why: The second, and more important, ability was unrecorded: every land tapped for mana returns to its owner's hand. Only the extra land drop had a word, so the card read as pure ramp when it is a symmetric stax piece.

kept.name: Faithbound Judge // Sinner's Judgment
kept.why: The back face is an alternate win condition and nothing said so. It puts a judgment counter on itself each upkeep (eff:add-counters-self), the enchanted player loses the game at three (eff:lose-game), and it exiles itself instead of going to a graveyard (eff:exile-self). All three were missing.

kept.name: Herald of Leshrac
kept.why: The card steals a land every upkeep and nothing recorded it. Cumulative upkeep is an upkeep trigger (trig:step, trig:step:upkeep), the cost is gaining control of a land (eff:gain-control), and when it leaves every player takes their lands back (eff:give-control). Only cares:type:land hinted at any of it.

kept.name: Ephemeral Shields
kept.why: The card gives no power or toughness at all - it grants indestructible only - so eff:pump is wrong and would put it in enhance slots against auras that make a creature bigger. eff:protect is what a one-mana indestructible instant actually does.

kept.name: Rattleback Apothecary
kept.why: "gains your choice of menace or lifelink" is a choice made on resolution and both grants were recorded without it.

kept.name: Knighted Myr
kept.why: Half the card was unrecorded - it gains double strike whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on it, which is the entire reason to play it. Only the adapt half had words.

kept.name: Merchant of Venom
kept.why: Both abilities were under-read. The enter trigger is an edict hitting every player (eff:sacrifice, scope:all) and the second ability is paid whenever a player sacrifices a permanent (trig:sacrificed). Only the counter it grows by had been recorded.

kept.name: Dimir Machinations
kept.why: eff:mill is wrong: the card exiles from the top of a library, nothing reaches a graveyard, so a self-mill or graveyard deck would be offered a card that actively denies it fuel. eff:exile is what it does. Transmute also discards this card as a cost, which had no word.

kept.name: Axis of Mortality
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all - only its upkeep trigger. Exchanging two players' life totals sets both, which is eff:set-life.

kept.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
kept.why: Only the exile half was read. It also returns every other permanent card exiled with it to the battlefield, which is the whole engine of the card and needs eff:return-from and the exile zone.

kept.name: Faerie Tauntings
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on spells YOU cast (trig:cast-own, not merely trig:cast, which reads as any cast), and the drain hits each opponent (scope:all).

kept.name: Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged
kept.why: Most of both faces was unread. The front exiles itself and returns transformed at end of combat (eff:exile-self, eff:transform, trig:step) and grants indestructible (eff:protect); the back's 0 makes him a 4/4 creature and prevents all damage to him (eff:animate, eff:prevent-damage). eff:pump is removed because nothing on either face gives power or toughness - it grants indestructible and untaps.

kept.name: Wernog, Rider's Chaplain
kept.why: The card had no trigger words at all, and it triggers on BOTH entering and leaving the battlefield, which is what makes it a blink target. The trigger also touches each opponent (scope:all).

kept.name: Ace's Baseball Bat
kept.why: The middle line was unread: while attacking, the equipped creature has first strike and must be blocked by a Dalek if able. eff:pump covered only the +3/+0.

kept.name: Vicious Battlerager
kept.why: The drain is recorded but not what triggers it - "whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature" is trig:becomes-blocked, and without it nothing says the card only pays off in combat.

kept.name: Stunning Reversal
kept.why: "your life total becomes 1" is a set, not a gain or a loss, and had no word.

kept.name: Arachne, Psionic Weaver
kept.why: "As Arachne enters" had no trigger word, and choosing a card type on resolution had none either - the tax is recorded but not that you pick what it taxes.

kept.name: H.E.R.B.I.E. Scout Unit
kept.why: eff:extra-land-drop is wrong: the card does not let you play an extra land, it puts a land from your hand straight onto the battlefield tapped, which is exactly eff:put-onto-battlefield. The difference matters because it works with your land drop already spent. scope:all is a stray - nothing on the card affects everything.

kept.name: Rhys, the Evermore
kept.why: The activated ability was unread - it removes any number of counters from a creature (eff:remove-counters) and costs {W} and a tap (cost:tap). eff:pump is wrong: the enter trigger grants persist and gives no power or toughness.

kept.name: The Long Reach of Night // Animus of Night's Reach
kept.why: Chapter III was unread entirely (exiles itself and returns transformed), the back face's attack trigger pumps it by the defending player's graveyard (eff:pump), and the sacrifice hits each opponent (scope:all).

kept.name: Writ of Return
kept.why: Cipher was only half read. It exiles this card encoded on a creature (eff:exile-self) and later lets its controller cast a copy without paying its mana cost (eff:cast-free) - eff:copy alone does not say the copy is free, which is the whole point of the mechanic.

kept.name: Kemba, Kha Enduring
kept.why: The trigger reads "Whenever Kemba OR another Cat you control enters", so it fires on her own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded, which says the opposite.

kept.name: Dross Skullbomb
kept.why: The second ability returns a creature card from the graveyard to your HAND; the hand zone was never recorded.

kept.name: Revive the Fallen
kept.why: Clash reveals the top card of each player's library and lets them put it on top or bottom. That is library manipulation and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Rescue from the Underworld
kept.why: The reanimation happens on a delayed trigger at the beginning of your next upkeep, which was unrecorded. scope:all is wrong: the spell sacrifices one creature as a cost and returns two named cards, it affects nothing globally.

kept.name: Stormbeacon Blade
kept.why: Whenever the equipped creature attacks and you have three or more attackers, you draw a card. The whole second clause of the card was missing.

kept.name: Vislor Turlough
kept.why: When an opponent takes control of him he is goaded for as long as they control it. Goading is a real effect the list did not carry, and kw:goad is only the printed keyword line.

kept.name: Charred Graverobber
kept.why: Escape costs exiling four other cards from your graveyard, which is an exile cost and was unrecorded. The enters trigger returns an outlaw card to your HAND.

kept.name: Catastrophe
kept.why: Destroy all lands or all creatures is a symmetric board wipe that kills your own permanents too. scope:all alone does not say the whole board dies.

kept.name: Gumdrop Poisoner // Tempt with Treats
kept.why: Three whole clauses were missing: the -X/-X (eff:shrink), the Food token on the Adventure half (eff:create-token), and X being the life you gained this turn (cares:lifegain). It gains life through lifelink and through the Food it makes.

kept.name: Construct a Cosmic Cube
kept.why: It puts a plan counter on itself every time the trigger fires, which is how the whole card works, and no counter word was recorded.

kept.name: Angelic Purge
kept.why: It exiles ONE target artifact, creature or enchantment. Naming three permanent types in one clause is not affecting everything, and scope:all tells the engine this is a board-affecting card.

kept.name: Shepherd of the Flock // Usher to Safety
kept.why: The Adventure returns a permanent YOU control to hand, which is a self-bounce (blink/save effect), not the generic eff:move-zone it was carrying.

kept.name: Blighted Fen
kept.why: The edict ability requires sacrificing the land itself as part of its cost, and that cost was unrecorded.

kept.name: Kor Celebrant
kept.why: It triggers on 'this creature OR another creature you control' entering, so its own arrival is one of the triggers. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Marshal of the Lost
kept.why: Whenever you attack, a creature gets +X/+X. The only non-keyword ability on the card was not written down at all.

kept.name: Virtus's Maneuver
kept.why: Friends return a creature card to their HAND, and the spell resolves for every player at the table rather than at a single target.

kept.name: Stalactite Stalker
kept.why: Descend asks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard this turn, so the card genuinely cares about the graveyard filling up.

kept.name: Rally the Monastery
kept.why: The second mode gives up to two creatures +2/+2 and the third only kills a creature with power 4 or greater. Two of the three modes were unreadable to the engine.

kept.name: Cradle of Vitality
kept.why: 'You may pay {1}{W}. If you do' is exactly the pay-for-more shape, and the number of counters scales with the amount of life gained, which is what makes it a lifegain card.

kept.name: Water Tribe Rallier
kept.why: It digs four cards deep into your library and can only take a creature with power 3 or less, so both the library dig and the power restriction were missing.

kept.name: Extruder
kept.why: Sacrifice an artifact to put a counter on ONE target creature. Nothing here touches every permanent, and scope:all mis-signals a board-wide artifact.

kept.name: Crackdown
kept.why: It only hits creatures with power 3 or greater, and it applies to every nonwhite creature on the board, not a target. It had no scope and no power word.

kept.name: Wanderer's Strike
kept.why: The card proliferates on resolution. Only the printed keyword line was recorded, so the effect itself was invisible to the engine.

kept.name: Oblivion Crown
kept.why: The granted ability's activation cost is discarding a card, which is the whole point of the aura and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Unscrupulous Contractor
kept.why: Target player draws two cards, which was missing entirely. scope:all is wrong: one sacrifice and one target player, nothing global.

kept.name: Judgment of Alexander
kept.why: It prevents ALL damage from opponents' sources this turn, and the damage it deals back is equal to each commander's power.

kept.name: Knight-Errant of Eos
kept.why: Only the keyword and the trigger were recorded, so the entire ability was blank: it looks at the top six of your library, takes up to two cards to hand, then shuffles. Convoke is a cast-time cost paid by tapping your other creatures.

kept.name: Blood Reckoning
kept.why: Nothing here taxes anyone. The attacker's controller simply loses 1 life; there is no "unless that player pays" clause, so eff:unless-pays is a false positive that files a punisher enchantment as a stax tax piece.

kept.name: Friendly Neighborhood
kept.why: The granted land ability is "Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature you control" - a real pump effect, and the whole payoff of the card, which the list never recorded. Not adding eff:attach: this Aura enchants a LAND, not a creature.

kept.name: Taste of Death
kept.why: "Each player sacrifices three creatures" is a mass edict and neither half was written down: the sacrifice itself, nor that it hits every player. The list only recorded the Food tokens, which is the smaller half of the card.

kept.name: Voldaren Pariah // Abolisher of Bloodlines
kept.why: "Sacrifice three other creatures: Transform this creature" is the entire point of the front face and the transform is an effect, not just the kw:transform printed marker.

kept.name: Scrapheap
kept.why: The trigger reads "put into your graveyard from the battlefield" - the card explicitly watches the graveyard as a zone, which the trig:dies word alone does not record.

kept.name: Loxodon Gatekeeper
kept.why: It affects every artifact, creature and land every opponent controls, not a single target. Global reach was unrecorded.

kept.name: Weaponcraft Enthusiast
kept.why: Fabricate is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ("When this creature enters, put two +1/+1 counters on it or create two Servo tokens"). Both effects were recorded and the trigger that produces them was not, so nothing knows this is an ETB card.

kept.name: Spirit-Sister's Call
kept.why: "You may sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with the chosen card. If you do, return..." is a repeatable sacrifice outlet gated on paying, and both halves were missing - the list recorded only the reanimation. An aristocrats deck wants this card for the outlet as much as the recursion.

kept.name: Imposing Sovereign
kept.why: "Creatures your opponents control enter tapped" is a global static effect on every opponent's creatures, not a targeted tap.

kept.name: Reroute Systems
kept.why: Mode one grants indestructible until end of turn, which is a protection trick - the reason a player holds this card up. eff:pump records that something gets better; nothing recorded that it keeps a permanent alive.

kept.name: Soul Foundry
kept.why: Four clauses unread. The activated ability is "{X}, {T}" so tapping is a cost; "Create a token that's a copy of the exiled card" is a copy effect, which is the whole card; imprint exiles from your hand and the ability then reads that exiled card, so both zones are genuinely cared about.

kept.name: Gauntlets of Light
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +0/+2" is a pump and was not recorded at all, and this Aura attaches to a creature. Only the granted untap ability had been read.

kept.name: Chant of Vitu-Ghazi
kept.why: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt by creatures this turn" is a global fog and the scope was unrecorded. cares:color:w is a word scan of the convoke reminder text ("one mana of that creature's color") - the card cares about nothing white; it would file a fog as a white-matters card.

kept.name: Unnerve
kept.why: "Each opponent discards two cards" hits the whole table, which is the only thing that separates this from a single-target discard spell.

kept.name: Popular Egotist
kept.why: The activated ability gives itself indestructible, which is how this card survives its own sacrifice loop. eff:pump and grants:indestructible record the numbers and the keyword but not that the card keeps a creature alive.

kept.name: Glory
kept.why: Two unread clauses, and one of them is the entire card: "Activate only if this card is in your graveyard" makes Glory a graveyard card that never wants to be on the battlefield, and "Creatures you control gain protection from the chosen color" is a one-sided fog that saves your whole board.

kept.name: Disciple of Griselbrand
kept.why: "{1}, Sacrifice a creature" eats OTHER creatures on demand - it is a repeatable sacrifice outlet, which cost:sacrifice already records correctly. cost:sacrifice-self means a card that can only eat itself once, and marking both makes an outlet look like a one-shot.

kept.name: Lightwheel Enhancements
kept.why: It is an Aura that enchants a creature or Vehicle and attaches to it. Everything else on the card was read correctly.

kept.name: Ward of Bones
kept.why: Every clause is "each opponent who controls more X than you" - a symmetric table-wide lock, and nothing recorded that it reaches beyond one player.

kept.name: Fated Clash
kept.why: "Target creature you control ... gains indestructible until end of turn. Then destroy all creatures" is a one-sided wrath: the protection clause is what makes it playable and it was unrecorded, leaving the card looking like a plain symmetric wipe.

kept.name: Gutless Plunderer
kept.why: The entire Raid ability was unread - the list holds only the keywords and the ETB trigger. It looks at the top three of your library, keeps one there and puts the rest into your graveyard, so it digs, self-mills and fills the yard, none of which was written down.

kept.name: Family Reunion
kept.why: Mode two gives all your creatures hexproof until end of turn, which is a protection trick answering a targeted removal spell or an edict. grants:hexproof records the keyword; nothing recorded the card's job.

kept.name: Syr Vondam, the Lucent
kept.why: He has lifelink printed on him, so he gains life every time he connects. The catalogue records eff:gain-life for lifelink elsewhere (Beloved Princess in this same batch) and it was simply missed here.

kept.name: Ferropede
kept.why: "This creature can't be blocked" is the first line of the card and the reason the damage trigger ever fires. Only the trigger's payoff was recorded.

kept.name: Malakir Blood-Priest
kept.why: "Each opponent loses X life" is a table-wide drain, which is what makes it a Commander card rather than a two-player one.

kept.name: Despotic Scepter
kept.why: The card's only ability was completely unread - the list holds nothing but its cost and colour. "{T}: Destroy target permanent you own" taps as a cost and destroys YOUR OWN permanent. Deliberately not eff:destroy: it can never answer an opponent's threat, and marking it as removal would file a self-sacrifice engine as an answer.

kept.name: Cybermat
kept.why: "It gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking artifact creatures" is the whole payoff and no effect word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Fell Flagship
kept.why: Crew 3 is "Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 3 or more" - tapping other creatures is a real cost this Vehicle demands every turn.

kept.name: Duskfang Mentor
kept.why: Three unread things. The activated ability costs {T}; a lifelink counter grants lifelink, which is what the second ability then keys off; and "each creature you control with lifelink" is a board-wide counter distribution, not a single target.

kept.name: Clay-Fired Bricks // Cosmium Kiln
kept.why: The back face was not read at all - it creates two Gnome tokens and gives your creatures +1/+1, and neither appears. On the front, the search is specifically for a basic land (a Plains) and ends with a shuffle, and the craft cost exiles another artifact you control or one from your graveyard.

kept.name: Exquisite Archangel
kept.why: The replacement effect exiles this creature as its cost - the Angel is spent to reset your life total, and the exile half was unrecorded.

kept.name: Arm-Mounted Anchor
kept.why: It is Equipment and attaches to a creature, which was unrecorded. "Then discard two cards unless you discard a Pirate card" makes YOU discard - a real cost of the draw, and the list only carried eff:discard-nothing for it.

kept.name: Crisis of Conscience
kept.why: Mode two destroys all nonland, nontoken permanents including your own - a symmetric board wipe. scope:all records that it is mass; only scope:wipe records that it kills your own board, which is what keeps it out of decks it would ruin.

kept.name: Monkey Cage
kept.why: "Sacrifice this artifact and create X Monkeys" - the Cage eats itself, once, when any creature enters. Not eff:sacrifice, which would read as an edict pointed at an opponent.

kept.name: Scholarship Sponsor
kept.why: Symmetric group ramp: every player behind on lands searches. The 'each player' reach is not recorded.

kept.name: Bad Deal
kept.why: Hits every opponent with discard and every player with life loss; the symmetric reach is unrecorded.

kept.name: Riders of Gavony
kept.why: 'Human creatures you control have protection from creatures of the chosen type' is a grant and nothing in the list says so.

kept.name: Nocturnal Hunger
kept.why: Gift a Food creates a Food token, and the unkicked mode costs you 2 life. Only the destroy clause was read.

kept.name: The Master of Lake-town
kept.why: 'Whenever a player loses life' is the card's main trigger and was never recorded; it watches every player, not just opponents.

kept.name: Endless Whispers
kept.why: The creature is returned from its owner's graveyard; the graveyard is where this card operates.

kept.name: Oath of Lieges
kept.why: Triggers on each player's upkeep and can ramp any player who is behind.

kept.name: Grim Return
kept.why: An instant with no triggered ability at all - trig:dies claims it triggers on death. It reads a creature card in a graveyard, which was not recorded.

kept.name: Eye of Ojer Taq // Apex Observatory
kept.why: Back face lets the next spell of the chosen type be cast without paying its mana cost, and you choose that type. Craft's cost exiles this artifact plus two other permanents or graveyard cards. Only the mana ability was read.

kept.name: Banshee of the Dread Choir
kept.why: Myriad is an attack trigger; the token copies were recorded but the trigger that makes them was not.

kept.name: Blinding Angel
kept.why: 'That player skips their next combat phase' is the whole card and produced no effect word.

kept.name: Contagion
kept.why: The alternative cost is paying 1 life and exiling a black card from hand; neither half was recorded.

kept.name: Tel-Jilad Stylus
kept.why: The list has no effect word at all. It moves a permanent you own to the bottom of your library, and the ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Promise of Power
kept.why: The second mode makes an X/X Demon token; entwine means both modes can happen. Only the draw mode was read.

kept.name: Sage of the Skies
kept.why: Copying this spell puts a token creature onto the battlefield, and copying a spell on the stack is what the trigger does.

kept.name: Abolish
kept.why: 'You may discard a Plains card rather than pay this spell's mana cost' is an alternative cost and was not recorded.

kept.name: Dark Dabbling
kept.why: Regenerating a creature keeps it alive, and spell mastery regenerates each other creature you control - a mass save. Only the cantrip was read.

kept.name: Basri, Tomorrow's Champion
kept.why: The token ability costs {T} as well as {W} and an exert, and the cycling trigger grants hexproof as well as indestructible.

kept.name: Shifting Wall
kept.why: Its cost is {X} alone, so mana value collapses to zero and mv:cheap is an artefact - the card is only cheap if you pay nothing. The counters go on itself only, which eff:add-counters-self already says; the generic word makes it read as a counters-matters card.

kept.name: Avengers Assemble!
kept.why: 'Heroes you control get +2/+2' is an anthem over your whole board and produced no facet.

kept.name: Luminate Primordial
kept.why: Exiles a creature for each opponent - multi-target removal, not a single hit.

kept.name: Faith's Fetters
kept.why: This is the archetypal pacifism-style answer: the permanent cannot attack, cannot block and cannot activate. Only the activated-ability half and the lifegain were read, so the card could not be reached as removal.

kept.name: Seymour Flux
kept.why: The upkeep trigger is paid by 'you may pay 1 life'; the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Urborg Scavengers
kept.why: The keyword clause names twelve keywords and only five were recorded, and the whole card reads the cards exiled with it, which no zone word said. Deliberately NOT adding grants:* for those keywords - it grants them to itself, and a grants:hexproof/indestructible here would file it as a protection card the way Paradise Druid and Syr Ginger are wrongly filed.

kept.name: Concerted Effort
kept.why: The card's entire job is granting seven keywords to your whole team, and only vigilance was recorded. It also reads those keywords off your board.

kept.name: Mouse Trapper
kept.why: Valiant triggers on becoming the target of a spell or ability you control - the same family as heroic - and only a bare trig:cast was recorded.

kept.name: Kitsune Ace
kept.why: The first mode grants the attacking Vehicle first strike; only the untap mode was read.

kept.name: Baron Helmut Zemo
kept.why: Boast copies the exiled cards before casting them, and the connive trigger fires when YOU cast a black spell - a spellslinger trigger, not a generic cast one.

kept.name: Roadkill Rodney
kept.why: Squad's token copies are made by an enters trigger; the copies were recorded but the trigger was not.

kept.name: Recruitment Officer
kept.why: Nothing is ever exiled - the creature goes to your HAND and the rest go to the bottom of the library. Impulse means exiling off the top to play the cards, so both words are false and would offer this to exile-matters and impulse decks.

kept.name: Wing It
kept.why: A flying counter permanently grants flying to the creature; only the counter and the pump were recorded.

kept.name: Nikara, Lair Scavenger
kept.why: Partner with is an enters trigger on this creature and nothing recorded it. The payoff watches ANOTHER creature you control leaving, and it costs you 1 life; the tutor pulls Yannik out of a library.

kept.name: Clara Oswald
kept.why: Her first ability only functions if she is your commander, and Doctor's companion is a commander rule; nothing said so.

kept.name: Kormus Bell
kept.why: It turns every Swamp into a creature and fixes it at 1/1. The list only recorded that it looks at lands, so the engine could not tell what it does.

kept.name: Staff of the Sun Magus
kept.why: It triggers on spells YOU cast, and on a Plains you control entering, which is a second trigger the list missed entirely.

kept.name: Lifeline
kept.why: The whole card is mass recursion out of the graveyard and neither the return nor the graveyard was written down.

kept.name: Clone Shell
kept.why: It digs four deep and picks one, hides it in exile, then moves it from exile to the battlefield. Only the library was recorded.

kept.name: Prison Term
kept.why: Enchanted creature can't attack or block; only the activated-ability lock was recorded. It also re-attaches itself, and shutting a creature off without destroying it is exactly neutralise.

kept.name: Poison the Waters
kept.why: It is a modal spell, Choose one, and nothing recorded that the caster picks.

kept.name: Blessed Hippogriff // Tyr's Blessing
kept.why: The adventure half grants indestructible until end of turn, which is a protection trick, not just a keyword grant.

kept.name: Hellcarver Demon
kept.why: Exiling the top six and casting from among them is the definition of impulse draw; the list had the free casting but not where the cards come from.

kept.name: Visions of Brutality
kept.why: Enchanted creature can't block, which is half the aura and was not recorded.

kept.name: Avarice Amulet
kept.why: +2/+0 was not recorded at all, and the granted upkeep ability draws you a card every turn, which is the reason to play the card.

kept.name: Workhorse
kept.why: It is a mana source that eats its own +1/+1 counters, and neither the mana nor the counter-removal cost was written down.

kept.name: Guild Globe
kept.why: The second ability adds two mana for a tap and a self-sacrifice; only the cantrip half was recorded.

kept.name: Ingenious Smith
kept.why: It looks at four cards and puts one in your HAND. Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top, so both words are false; eff:look-and-pick already says what it does.

kept.name: Iron-Shield Elf
kept.why: Granting itself indestructible for a discard is a protection effect, not merely a keyword.

kept.name: The Eagles Are Coming!
kept.why: It makes 4/4 fliers, which was missing entirely, and the return is of creatures YOU own, which is a self-bounce rather than a generic zone move.

kept.name: Undercity Informer
kept.why: It mills from library to graveyard and neither zone was recorded, which is the whole reason the card is played.

kept.name: Boiling Rock Rioter
kept.why: It exiles from a graveyard and later casts the card from exile; neither zone was written down.

kept.name: Turncoat Kunoichi
kept.why: The card is exile-based creature removal and carried no effect word at all, so nothing could ever offer it as an answer.

kept.name: Marut
kept.why: It creates Treasure tokens, which was missing, and the trigger is conditional on mana from a Treasure having been spent to cast it.

kept.name: Moat
kept.why: The entire card stops ground creatures attacking and it carried no effect word whatsoever.

kept.name: Barter in Blood
kept.why: There is no sacrifice COST here; it is an edict forcing each player to sacrifice. Marking it as a sacrifice outlet tells the engine it can be used to feed an aristocrats deck on demand, which it cannot.

kept.name: Akroma's Blessing
kept.why: Mass protection from a colour is the reason to play it, and the list only described it as a pump.

kept.name: Consulate Surveillance
kept.why: The activated ability prevents all damage from a source and was not recorded; only the energy counters were.

kept.name: Ruin Rat
kept.why: This is graveyard hate, not removal. Plain eff:exile reads as an answer to a permanent, which the card cannot do.

kept.name: Ori, Plate Stacker
kept.why: Everything the card does happens on an enters trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Nightmare Sower
kept.why: It triggers on spells YOU cast during an opponent's turn, and the -1/-1 counter is a counter placed on a creature as well as a shrink.

kept.name: Drannith Healer
kept.why: The lifegain payoff, which is the whole card, was missing; only the cycling was recorded.

kept.name: Abandoned Sarcophagus
kept.why: It lets you cast cycling spells from your graveyard and carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Breathless Knight
kept.why: The trigger explicitly includes this creature itself entering, and lifelink gains life the way it does on other cards in this batch.

kept.name: Urza Assembles the Titans
kept.why: Only chapter I's scry was read. Chapter I also reveals the top card and takes a planeswalker into hand (look-and-pick, library, hand); chapter II puts a planeswalker card from your HAND straight onto the battlefield, which is exactly eff:put-onto-battlefield and was entirely missing.

kept.name: Wand of Vertebrae
kept.why: Only the {T} mill clause was read. The second ability exiles the Wand itself as a cost and shuffles up to five cards from YOUR graveyard back into your library, so the whole graveyard/library half of the card was unrecorded.

kept.name: Descend upon the Sinful
kept.why: The delirium half creates a 4/4 Angel token and eff:create-token was missing outright. 'Exile all creatures' is a symmetric board sweep that eats your own board, which is what scope:wipe is for; scope:all alone does not say that.

kept.name: Isolation Cell
kept.why: The card's entire function is a tax: 'loses 2 life unless they pay {2}'. eff:lose-life was recorded and the 'unless they pay' half, which is the reason the card exists, was not.

kept.name: The Ghoul, Gunslinger
kept.why: Rad counters go on a PLAYER. The downstream mill and life loss were recorded but not the counter placement itself, so nothing says this card puts counters on players.

kept.name: Body Snatcher
kept.why: 'exile it unless you discard a creature card' makes you discard from hand, which is the reanimator-enabler half of the card. Neither the discard nor the hand was recorded.

kept.name: Swarm, Being of Bees
kept.why: Mayhem lets you cast this card from your own graveyard. That is the self-recursion shape eff:recur-self covers (unearth, escape, disturb, blitz, cast-from-graveyard); the list had the graveyard zone but no word saying the card comes back.

kept.name: Angelic Sleuth
kept.why: The card had no trigger word at all. It triggers whenever ANOTHER permanent you control leaves the battlefield, so it wants the base trig:leaves plus the -other split, the same way trig:enters-other is used.

kept.name: Sidequest: Hunt the Mark // Yiazmat, Ultimate Mark
kept.why: kw:transform is the printed keyword but nothing said the card transforms itself. The back face was almost entirely unread: sacrificing another creature or artifact is an activation cost, and the ability grants indestructible and taps Yiazmat.

kept.name: Belbe's Portal
kept.why: Only 'choose a creature type' was read. The ability the card is played for, {3},{T}: put a creature card of that type from your hand onto the battlefield, contributed nothing at all.

kept.name: Foot Chopper
kept.why: The enters trigger creates a 1/1 Ninja token before attaching, and eff:create-token was missing. The combat trigger sacrifices the equipped creature to draw, and no sacrifice word was recorded.

kept.name: Plunge into Darkness
kept.why: The second mode was read only as far as look-and-pick. It is paid for with any amount of life, digs that many cards off your library, and EXILES everything you did not take.

kept.name: Helm of Obedience
kept.why: The list held only kw:mill and the activation costs, so the card did nothing at all as far as the engine was concerned. It taps, mills an opponent, sacrifices itself, and puts a creature card out of their graveyard onto the battlefield under YOUR control, which is the reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Doctor Doom, Unrivaled
kept.why: The tap ability wins the game outright once your library is empty and eff:win-game was missing. It also checks your library, which is why it is a self-mill payoff.

kept.name: N'Yami-Class Mother Ship
kept.why: The combat trigger looks at the top card of your library. eff:look-and-pick was recorded but nothing said the card manipulates the library.

kept.name: Cataclysm
kept.why: Every player sacrifices all but four permanents. This is one of the most destructive symmetric sweeps printed and it eats your own board, which scope:all does not say. Without scope:wipe nothing can keep it out of a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Wake the Reflections
kept.why: Populate creates a token that is a COPY of a creature token you control. eff:create-token was recorded; the copying, which is the whole mechanic, was not.

kept.name: Masterful Flourish
kept.why: A one-mana instant that gives your own creature indestructible is a protection trick. grants:indestructible says what it grants; eff:protect is what it does, and it is how the card gets offered as an answer to removal.

kept.name: Undercellar Sweep
kept.why: The second ability, which is where all the value is, triggers whenever you attack and had no trigger word recorded at all.

kept.name: Mammoth Umbra
kept.why: Umbra armor saves the enchanted creature from destruction by sacrificing the Aura instead. The list recorded the +3/+3 and vigilance and nothing about the totem-armor protection, which is the reason this Aura is played over a bigger one.

kept.name: Elvish Dreadlord
kept.why: Only the death trigger was read. Encore exiles the card from your graveyard as a cost and creates a token COPY of it for each opponent, so the entire second half of the card was silent.

kept.name: Kaya, Orzhov Usurper
kept.why: Her +1 exiles cards from a graveyard, which is graveyard hate and is kept apart from plain eff:exile for exactly that reason. Neither the hate word nor the graveyard zone was present, and the +1 loyalty cost adds counters where only cost:remove-counters was recorded.

kept.name: The Princess Takes Flight
kept.why: Chapter I exiles a creature and chapter II gives +2/+2 and flying. Only the flying grant and the chapter III return were recorded, so two of the three chapters were unread.

kept.name: Jet, Rebel Leader
kept.why: It cheats a creature card straight onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and it digs five deep into your library. Only the looking half was written down; the part that actually puts a body into play was not.

kept.name: Celestial Archon
kept.why: Bestow makes this an Aura spell with enchant creature, so it attaches to a creature. The pump and the two keyword grants were recorded and the attaching itself was not.

kept.name: Selfless Glyphweaver // Deadly Vanity
kept.why: Exiling itself is the activation cost of the front face, and the back face destroys all creatures and planeswalkers other than one chosen permanent, which includes your own board. The only exclusion is the single chosen permanent, so this is a genuine symmetric wipe rather than a filtered one.

kept.name: Gustha's Scepter
kept.why: The list held nothing but the type line and the cost. The card taps to move cards from hand to exile, taps again to return them to hand, and dumps everything exiled with it into the graveyard when you lose control of it. I used eff:move-zone rather than eff:exile because exiling your own cards from hand is not removal, and eff:exile would file this as an answer to a threat.

kept.name: Purging Stormbrood // Absorb Essence
kept.why: The Omen half gives the target lifelink and hexproof until end of turn. The +2/+2 was recorded and both keyword grants were dropped.

kept.name: Ellyn Harbreeze, Busybody
kept.why: Tapping is the whole activation cost, and the ability digs into the top of your library. Neither was written down.

kept.name: Endless Cockroaches
kept.why: It returns itself from the graveyard whenever it dies, which is exactly the endlessly recurring sacrifice fodder that word is for. The bounce and the death trigger were recorded but nothing said the card comes back on its own.

kept.name: Veilstone Amulet
kept.why: Making your creatures untargetable by opponents is a hexproof grant and it is there to keep them alive through removal. Only the cast trigger and the printed keyword were recorded, so nothing said what the trigger actually does.

kept.name: Bloodline Culling
kept.why: It is a modal spell with two bullets and nothing recorded that the caster picks. I did not add scope:wipe: -2/-2 is restricted to creature tokens, and a restricted sweeper is not a board wipe.

kept.name: Twisted Abomination
kept.why: Swampcycling discards this card as part of its cost and searches the library for a land. The search effect was recorded but neither the discard cost nor the fact that it is a land it fetches, which is what separates this from a generic tutor.

kept.name: Author of Shadows
kept.why: The list held only the enters trigger and said nothing about what happens. It exiles EVERY opponent's graveyard, which is real graveyard hate and matters both as a card and as anti-synergy against a graveyard deck, and it then plays a card out of that exile.

kept.name: Trusty Retriever
kept.why: It is a modal enters trigger and the choice was not recorded, and the second mode returns a card to your hand.

kept.name: Azra Smokeshaper
kept.why: Granting indestructible to a creature you control keeps it alive, which is what eff:protect says, and Ninjutsu returns an unblocked attacker to hand as its cost. eff:pump is wrong: nothing on this card changes power or toughness, and grants:indestructible already says what the trigger does, so the pump word only makes it look like an anthem.

kept.name: Attended Healer
kept.why: The token trigger fires on gaining life and no trigger word said so, which is the whole reason this card is in a lifegain deck. eff:pump is wrong: the activated ability grants lifelink and changes no power or toughness, and grants:lifelink already carries it.

kept.name: Drinker of Sorrow
kept.why: The first line is literally that this creature can't block, and there is an exact word for it. scope:all is wrong: sacrificing one permanent of your choice affects one permanent, not everything, and that word is read as a mass effect.

kept.name: Skull Storm
kept.why: Three separate things were missing. It copies itself once per commander cast, every opponent who cannot sacrifice loses half their life, and both halves hit each opponent rather than a single target.

kept.name: Stinkdrinker Bandit
