kept.why: The trigger gives an unblocked Rogue +2/+1 and no effect word was recorded at all, so the card said it triggers on attacking and did nothing.

kept.name: Gary Clone
kept.why: Squad's token copies come from a real enters trigger on this card, which was not recorded, and the attack trigger gives every copy +1/+0, which was also not recorded.

kept.name: Mindless Conscription
kept.why: Amass was read but neither of its two triggers was. It fires when the enchantment enters and again on your third draw each turn, and the draw trigger is what makes this a card in a draw-matters deck.

kept.name: Cliffside Rescuer
kept.why: The ability costs both a tap and the sacrifice. Only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Demonic Vigor
kept.why: It is an Aura and nothing said it attaches to a creature, and the death trigger returns the card to its owner's hand.

kept.name: Inverter of Truth
kept.why: The list held only the printed keywords and the enters trigger, so the card that swaps your library for your graveyard said it does nothing. It moves every card out of your library into exile and shuffles your whole graveyard back in. I used eff:move-zone rather than eff:exile because exiling your own library is not removal. I did not add col:none: devoid removes the card's colour but its mana cost still contains black pips, so its colour identity is black.

kept.name: Immovable Rod
kept.why: The ability costs a tap, and the target both loses its abilities and is stopped from attacking or blocking. eff:neutralise covered only the losing-abilities half, and there are exact words for the other two.

kept.name: Lord of the Pit
kept.why: The upkeep trigger makes you sacrifice a creature every turn, which is the defining thing about this card and the reason it belongs with sacrifice outlets. Only the 7 damage backstop was recorded.

kept.name: Ironclad Slayer
kept.why: The returned Aura or Equipment goes to your hand, and the hand zone was not recorded even though the graveyard was.

kept.name: Cooped Up
kept.why: "Enchanted creature can't attack or block" is two unrecorded clauses and is exactly a Pacifism-style neutralise. eff:exile-own is wrong: -own means flickering YOUR permanent, and this aura exiles the creature it is enchanting, which is an opponent's. Plain eff:exile already covers it.

kept.name: End Hostilities
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures" with no restriction to opponents is a symmetric board wipe, yours included. It carried scope:all but nothing said it kills your own board, which is what keeps a wipe out of a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Walking Skyscraper
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each modified creature you control" was entirely unread; the card carried no eff: word at all.

kept.name: Chitin Gravestalker
kept.why: "costs {1} less to cast for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard" gave neither the cost reduction nor the graveyard interest. The card is a graveyard payoff and nothing said so.

kept.name: Talus Paladin
kept.why: "have Allies you control gain lifelink" was unrecorded. The trigger reads "this creature OR another Ally", so it fires on its own arrival too and needs trig:enters-self beside the existing trig:enters-other.

kept.name: Tenacious Dead
kept.why: The card had NO effect word at all. Its whole text is bringing itself back from the graveyard for {1}{B}, which is exactly eff:recur-self, and "you may pay {1}{B}. If you do" is the do-if-cost-paid pattern.

kept.name: Grasping Shadows // Shadows' Lair
kept.why: Only the draw was read. The front face triggers on attacking alone, grants two keywords, counters itself up and transforms; the back face taps for {B} and pays a dread counter to draw and lose 1 life. Nine clauses were silent. Counters-on-itself uses the -self word so this does not read as a counters deck.

kept.name: Pestilent Spirit
kept.why: "Instant and sorcery spells you control have deathtouch" is a blanket static over a whole card type, the same shape as Lancer Sliver in this batch, which carries scope:all.

kept.name: Timesifter
kept.why: The card carried only its trigger timing and no effect whatsoever. It exiles off the top of every library each upkeep and hands somebody an extra turn, which is the entire reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Survivor's Med Kit
kept.why: "Choose one that hasn't been chosen" is a modal card and nothing said so; the Food mode creates a token, and the ability costs {1} and a tap.

kept.name: Mangara of Corondor
kept.why: The tap cost was unrecorded, and the ability exiles Mangara along with the target. Exiling itself is the card's defining drawback and the blink-and-reuse angle that makes it played at all.

kept.name: Blood Speaker
kept.why: "Whenever a Demon you control enters, return this card from your graveyard to your hand" returns ITSELF. eff:return-from was recorded for the tutor half, but nothing said the card recurs itself.

kept.name: Oroku Saki, Shredder Rising
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative cast cost that requires returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand. That is a real cast-time cost and cost:cast-return-to-hand is exactly the word for it; nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Footsteps of the Goryo
kept.why: "Sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step" is an unrecorded clause and is the card's entire drawback; the list read as clean reanimation.

kept.name: Repel the Abominable
kept.why: It prevents ALL damage from all non-Human sources for the turn, a mass fog rather than a single prevention shield, and nothing recorded the breadth.

kept.name: Indoctrination Attendant
kept.why: "create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token" was not recorded at all; the bounce half was, the payoff was not.

kept.name: Emptiness
kept.why: Both triggers are gated on "if {W}{W} was spent to cast it" / "if {B}{B} was spent". That is the cares:mana-spent condition and it is the whole design of the card.

kept.name: Fleetwheel Cruiser
kept.why: "When this Vehicle enters, it becomes an artifact creature until end of turn" was unrecorded, and self-animating on arrival is what separates this Vehicle from one that needs crewing before it can ever attack.

kept.name: Karn's Sylex
kept.why: The activation costs a tap and exiles the Sylex itself, neither recorded. "Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less" hits your own board too, so it needs scope:wipe alongside the scope:all it already had.

kept.name: Nomad Mythmaker
kept.why: Tap cost unrecorded, and the ability puts the Aura onto the battlefield "attached to a creature you control", which is an attach effect and not merely a return.

kept.name: Kitesail Freebooter
kept.why: "Exile that card until this creature leaves the battlefield" was not recorded. The card had cares:zone:hand but no word for what it actually does to the card it finds.

kept.name: Alchemist's Gift
kept.why: "Target creature gets +1/+1" is unrecorded, and "your choice of deathtouch or lifelink" is a genuine modal choice on resolution.

kept.name: Quicksilver Fountain
kept.why: The card carried its two trigger timings and no effects. It puts flood counters on lands each upkeep and removes all of them at end step, affecting every player.

kept.name: Vengeful Pharaoh
kept.why: "Whenever combat damage is dealt to you or a planeswalker you control" is the trigger that makes the card work from the graveyard, and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Triumph of Saint Katherine
kept.why: The death trigger exiles the card itself and the top six, then puts the pile back on top of your library. Only trig:dies was recorded, so the recursion loop that is the card's whole point was invisible.

kept.name: Aligned Hedron Network
kept.why: It exiles ALL creatures with power 5 or greater, everyone's included, and selects on power. Neither the breadth nor the power condition was recorded. Not marked scope:wipe: it exiles rather than destroys, and only the big creatures.

kept.name: Settle the Score
kept.why: "Put two loyalty counters on a planeswalker you control" is a real add-counters effect and the list has no counter verb at all.

kept.name: Illicit Masquerade
kept.why: "Whenever a creature you control with an impostor counter on it dies" is a death trigger and the list has no dies trigger. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: the exile is of your own dead creature, not removal, and eff:exile would file this as an answer.

kept.name: Lodestone Bauble
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact". cost:sacrifice-self is recorded and the tap half of the same cost was dropped.

kept.name: Fell Gravship
kept.why: "When this Spacecraft enters, mill three..." is an ETB and the card carried NO enters trigger. Station puts charge counters on this Spacecraft itself, so eff:add-counters-self. grants:flying is wrong: at 8+ the Spacecraft HAS flying, it does not give flying to anything else, and kw:flying already records that.

kept.name: Rhystic Tutor
kept.why: Only two facets for a card whose whole point is the tax clause. "Unless any player pays {2}" is eff:unless-pays, and it searches your library.

kept.name: Ancestral Katana
kept.why: "Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone" is an attack trigger and none was recorded. "You may pay {1}. When you do, attach this Equipment" is the pay-for-more shape.

kept.name: Barbed Wire
kept.why: "{2}: Prevent the next 1 damage" is a prevention ability that was entirely unrecorded. And it damages EACH player at their upkeep, which includes you, so eff:damage-self is true of it and is the drawback a player actually feels.

kept.name: Ruthless Radrat
kept.why: Squad's cost is "Exile four cards from your graveyard" as an additional cost to cast, and neither the cost nor the graveyard interest was recorded. Squad's own rule is "When this creature enters, create that many tokens", which is a genuine ETB, and eff:create-token was recorded with no trigger to hang it on.

kept.name: Kazandu Blademaster
kept.why: "Whenever this creature OR another Ally you control enters" fires on itself as well as on others. Only trig:enters-other was recorded, which reads as a card that ignores its own arrival.

kept.name: Fraying Line
kept.why: Three of the four clauses of the upkeep ability were unrecorded. It exiles ITSELF, it removes all rope counters from all creatures, the mass exile happens only if a player declines to pay {2}, and "each creature without a rope counter on it" is a board-wide effect. Not scope:wipe: it exiles rather than destroys.

kept.name: Wax-Wane Witness
kept.why: The card's only non-keyword line produced NOTHING. "Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, this creature gets +1/+0" is two triggers, a pump, and the clearest possible statement that this is a lifegain-matters card.

kept.name: The Monumental Facade
kept.why: A colourless utility land: it taps for {C} and carries no coloured mana symbol anywhere, so its colour identity is empty. Every other colourless permanent in this batch carries col:none and this one was missed.

kept.name: Night Scythe
kept.why: Crew 2 is "Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 2 or more", which is exactly cost:tap-others - the same word Fell Gravship's Station correctly carries in this batch.

kept.name: Lethal Vapors
kept.why: "You skip your next turn" is the entire drawback of the escape hatch and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Force of Virtue
kept.why: The free-cast clause was entirely unread: "you may exile a white card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is an alternative casting cost that exiles from hand and cares about white cards. Not eff:cast-free - it has a cost, it is just not mana.

kept.name: Lich's Mirror
kept.why: It shuffles your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library. eff:move-zone records the movement but not the shuffle.

kept.name: Wall of Hope
kept.why: "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain that much life" - the trigger was recorded and the effect it produces was not, so the card read as doing nothing.

kept.name: Templar Knight
kept.why: The ability searches your library for a legendary artifact. eff:search-library was recorded without the zone it searches.

kept.name: Ghoulcaller's Chant
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and the modality was unrecorded. Both modes return cards to your hand.

kept.name: Bloodbond Vampire
kept.why: Its whole card is "Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature". trig:gains-life is recorded; nothing said this is a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Aradesh, the Founder
kept.why: The one real ability line produced no effect words at all. It grants double strike, it draws a card, it checks whether power is 4 or greater, and enlist itself taps a nonattacking creature you control and adds its power to the attacker.

kept.name: Azula, Ruthless Firebender
kept.why: "You get an experience counter for each player who discarded" is a counter on a PLAYER, not on a permanent, and eff:add-counters would be the wrong word for it. The activated ability also gives her menace, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Cleric of Life's Bond
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature" - the second of its two abilities had no trigger recorded, and eff:add-counters-self was left hanging with nothing to fire it. It both gains life and is paid for gaining life.

kept.name: Edge of the Divinity
kept.why: "As long as enchanted creature is white, it gets +1/+2" is half the card and only cares:color:b was recorded. It reads both colours.

kept.name: Deadeye Tracker
kept.why: Its whole activated ability is "Exile two target cards from an opponent's graveyard" - graveyard hate - and none of that was written down. The {T} in the activation cost was also missing.

kept.name: Malakir Familiar
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life" makes this a lifegain payoff, not merely a card with a lifegain trigger. trig:gains-life records the event; nothing recorded that the deck is about gaining life.

kept.name: Buried Treasure
kept.why: Only the Treasure half was read. Discover 5 exiles from the top of the library and casts the hit without paying its mana cost, and the ability is activated by exiling the card from your graveyard.

kept.name: Morality Shift
kept.why: "Then shuffle your library" was not recorded.

kept.name: Jester's Cap
kept.why: Almost nothing was read. The ability costs {T} and a sacrifice, it exiles three cards, and it shuffles the target player's library. I have deliberately NOT added eff:search-library: the gloss is "searches your library" and this searches an opponent's, so it would read as a tutor.

kept.name: Delif's Cone
kept.why: The activation cost is "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact" and only the sacrifice half was recorded.

kept.name: Cogwork Assembler
kept.why: "Create a token that's a copy of target artifact. That token gains haste." Only eff:create-token was recorded, which loses the fact that it is a copy effect. I have left the end-step cleanup exile alone - that clause is bookkeeping, not an exile effect the deck wants.

kept.name: Night Clubber
kept.why: Blitz grants "When this creature dies, draw a card". The engine already read eff:draw out of that reminder text but not the trigger that produces it. I left grants:haste off deliberately - blitz's haste is on itself only and the word would read as granting haste to your board.

kept.name: Drossclaw
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger - "When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 Germ, then attach this to it" - and the token and attach were recorded while the trigger that fires them was not.

kept.name: Arbiter of Knollridge
kept.why: The entire body of the card - "each player's life total becomes the highest life total among all players" - produced no effect word at all. It sets life totals and it does so for every player.

kept.name: Dawnstrike Vanguard
kept.why: The counters go on "each creature you control other than this creature", which is a board-wide effect, not a single target.

kept.name: Cut Short
kept.why: Nothing in the text refers to white. The only colour word on the card is convoke's reminder text ("one mana of that creature's color") and the card's own {W} pip. Being a white card is not caring about white, and this tells the engine it belongs in a white-matters deck.

kept.name: Ultron the Annihilator
kept.why: The second ability is entirely about artifacts arriving in your graveyard - "whenever another artifact is put into your graveyard from the battlefield" is a dies trigger - and neither the zone nor the trigger was recorded. The drain was.

kept.name: Vampire Scrivener
kept.why: The card has two symmetrical triggers and only the gain-life one was read. "Whenever you lose life during your turn" is the other half. It is also a lifegain payoff rather than merely a card with a lifegain trigger.

kept.name: The War Games
kept.why: Chapter I creates three Warrior tokens for each player and goads them, and neither the token making nor the goad effect was recorded (only the kw). Chapters I, II and III all affect every player or every Warrior.

kept.name: Glaive of the Guildpact
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each Gate you control" - the two granted keywords were recorded and the actual pump was not.

kept.name: Loran, Disciple of History
kept.why: "Whenever Loran OR another legendary creature you control enters" - Loran's own arrival triggers it, so this is both an enters-self and an enters-other trigger. Only enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Bitter Ordeal
kept.why: The card searches a library, EXILES the card found, and shuffles - none of which was recorded. Gravestorm counts permanents put into a graveyard this turn, which is the card's whole payoff condition.

kept.name: Iron Hills Blacksmith
kept.why: "When this creature enters, create a colorless Equipment artifact token named Axe" - the trigger was recorded and the token it makes was not.

kept.name: The Elderspell
kept.why: "Put two loyalty counters on it for each planeswalker destroyed this way" is half the card and produced nothing. "Destroy any number of target planeswalkers" is mass removal rather than a single-target kill.

kept.name: Highcliff Felidar
kept.why: "For each opponent, choose a creature with the greatest power... Destroy those creatures" hits every opponent at once, which no word said.

kept.name: Djeru's Resolve
kept.why: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn" is the reason to cast the card and produced no word - only the untap and the cycling draw were read.

kept.name: Fiendslayer Paladin
kept.why: "can't be the target of black or red spells" - it reads both colours and only red was recorded.

kept.name: General's Kabuto
kept.why: "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to equipped creature" is half of what this Equipment does and produced no word. Only the shroud grant was read.

kept.name: Sting, Bilbo's Sword
kept.why: It puts hone counters on ITSELF for each creature the opponent controls, and hone counters grant +1/+0 to the equipped creature. Neither the counter placement nor the stat boost was recorded, so the card read as an Equipment that only attaches.

kept.name: Livewire Lash
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +2/+0" was never read. The Aura equivalents in this batch (Nyxborn Unicorn, Radiant Grace) carry eff:pump for the same clause; Equipment should too.

kept.name: Reno and Rude
kept.why: Only the combat-damage trigger and a bare eff:sacrifice were read. It exiles the top card of a library and lets you play it, which is exactly eff:impulse, and the "you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do" clause is an on-demand sacrifice outlet gated on a cost. eff:exile is deliberately NOT added: nothing is removed from the battlefield and the card would misfile as removal.

kept.name: Angel of Condemnation
kept.why: The first ability exiles a creature and RETURNS it at the next end step, which is a flicker and is how this card is played; a permanent exile would not qualify. The second exiles "until this creature leaves the battlefield", a real leaves-the-battlefield trigger that was unread.

kept.name: Coffin Queen
kept.why: The whole back half of the activated ability was unread: "When this creature becomes untapped or you lose control of this creature, exile that creature." eff:gain-control was considered and rejected - a card in a graveyard is not a permanent being stolen.

kept.name: Words of Waste
kept.why: Three facets on a card whose whole text is a repeatable group discard. It makes EACH opponent discard, so it is a mass effect, and discard is a hand-zone effect.

kept.name: Dermotaxi
kept.why: It becomes a COPY of the imprinted card; eff:set-pt is a misread of that clause and would file it with "becomes a 4/4" animation effects. It also reads the exile zone every activation, and the imprint happens as it enters.

kept.name: Chaos Shrine's Black Crystal
kept.why: It exiles YOUR OWN dying creatures and returns them with a finality counter - an exile-and-return engine. eff:exile-own rather than eff:exile, because the creatures are yours and plain eff:exile would read as removal. The finality counter was unread.

kept.name: Dragonback Lancer
kept.why: Mobilize sacrifices the token it made at the next end step. The token creation was read and the sacrifice was not.

kept.name: Scales of Shale
kept.why: Affinity for Lizards makes the spell cost {1} less for each Lizard. Same shape as Ghalta's self cost reduction, which the vocabulary treats as eff:reduce-cost.

kept.name: Criminal Past
kept.why: It grants "+X/+0, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard" and only the menace half of that sentence was read.

kept.name: Infernal Offering
kept.why: "Each player who sacrificed a creature this way draws two cards" was entirely unread. eff:draw-each was rejected: it is you and one chosen opponent, not everyone.

kept.name: Foreboding Statue // Forsaken Thresher
kept.why: "untap it, then transform it" produced no transform effect, and the back face's "At the beginning of your first main phase, add one mana" produced no step trigger.

kept.name: Prehistoric Pet
kept.why: "This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power" is a blocking restriction and was unread. cares:power was considered and rejected - that word means the card scales with power, and this one only compares it.

kept.name: Nyxborn Unicorn
kept.why: Bestow makes it an Aura attached to a creature, and mentor triggers on attacking. Both clauses are in the printed text and produced nothing.

kept.name: Hand of Emrakul
kept.why: "You may sacrifice four Eldrazi Spawn rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is an additional/alternative cast cost paid by sacrificing, which the generic eff:sacrifice does not say.

kept.name: Radiant Grace // Radiant Restraints
kept.why: It is an Aura (attaches), and when the enchanted creature dies the Aura goes to the graveyard and this trigger returns it to the battlefield transformed - it brings ITSELF back, which is eff:recur-self, and none of that was recorded.

kept.name: Engineered Explosives
kept.why: Its cost is {X} alone, so its mana value is 0 and it reads as a cheap card. It is only cheap if you pay nothing for it, which makes it useless as an Engineered Explosives. This is the known X-spell mana-value artefact.

kept.name: Northampton Farm
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read; two whole activated abilities were skipped. It exiles a creature YOU OWN (a blink enabler), sacrifices itself to return that creature to the battlefield, and returns every other exiled card to hand. Plain eff:exile is deliberately not added so it does not read as removal.

kept.name: Remembrance
kept.why: The search clause was read but not what it searches or where the card ends up: it digs through your library, puts the card into your hand and shuffles.

kept.name: Custodi Squire
kept.why: Will of the council is a vote and nothing recorded that, and the returned cards go to your hand rather than the battlefield.

kept.name: Toshiro Umezawa
kept.why: The card's entire payoff - casting an instant from YOUR GRAVEYARD - produced no effect word at all, so a graveyard-instants commander looked like it did nothing. Bushido's printed reminder is also a real pump on a block trigger.

kept.name: Wurmwall Sweeper
kept.why: "When this Spacecraft enters, surveil 2" had the surveil but no enters trigger. Station puts charge counters on it equal to the tapped creature's power, so it both grows itself with counters and reads power.

kept.name: Bloodvial Purveyor
kept.why: "Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+0 for each Blood token defending player controls" was unread. eff:create-token was deliberately NOT added - the Blood tokens go to the OPPONENT, and claiming it makes tokens would put it in token decks where it is a liability. See the proposed word.

kept.name: Deadly Alliance
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature in your party" is half the card and produced nothing.

kept.name: Fortuitous Find
kept.why: Both modes return a card from the graveyard to your HAND, and only the graveyard half of that movement was recorded.

kept.name: Soul Conduit
kept.why: This card carried NO effect facet whatsoever - its one ability, exchanging two players' life totals, was completely unread, as was the tap in its activation cost.

kept.name: Eastfarthing Farmer
kept.why: "target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Food you control" was unread; only the token and the Food's lifegain reminder were.

kept.name: Mer-Ek Nightblade
kept.why: Outlast is "{B}, {T}" - the tap in the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Leonardo's Technique
kept.why: Sneak returns an unblocked attacker to hand as its alternative cost; cost:return-to-hand was read but not that the card is moving cards to the hand zone.

kept.name: Eerie Gravestone
kept.why: It mills four and then puts a creature card from among them into your hand - a graveyard-to-hand retrieval that was entirely unread; only the mill and the ETB draw were.

kept.name: Tallyman of Nurgle
kept.why: Its one triggered ability fires at the beginning of your end step and no step trigger was recorded, so the card read as a vanilla lifelinker that draws from nowhere.

kept.name: Pain's Reward
kept.why: The high bidder loses life equal to the high bid. Only the draw half of the card was recorded.

kept.name: Hardlight Containment
kept.why: An Oath of Lieges style exile: the creature comes back when the Aura leaves, so the leave trigger and the return were both unrecorded. Wall of Nets in this same batch carries trig:leaves/trig:leaves-self for exactly this shape.

kept.name: Soul Transfer
kept.why: It is a modal spell ('Choose one', with both modes if you control an artifact and an enchantment) and nothing recorded the choice.

kept.name: Guardian of the Gateless
kept.why: 'it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature it's blocking' is a pump and the whole triggered ability's effect was missing - only the trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Renegade Map
kept.why: It searches for one basic land. Nothing here affects everything, which is what scope:all means.

kept.name: Martyrdom
kept.why: 'the next 1 damage that would be dealt to target creature, planeswalker, or player is dealt to this creature instead' is redirection, not merely prevention. The list held only eff:prevent-damage and type:instant.

kept.name: Forum Filibuster
kept.why: It returns an Aura or Equipment card FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD to the battlefield. The token and the attach were recorded and the recursion, which is the reason to play the card, was not.

kept.name: Oracle's Vault
kept.why: The second ability plays the exiled card 'without paying its mana cost'. eff:impulse covers exiling off the top; it does not say the card is free.

kept.name: Dread
kept.why: Its main ability - 'whenever a creature deals damage to you, destroy it' - produced no facet at all: no effect and no trigger. The last line shuffles it from the graveyard into its library, which is a zone move (same shape as Mortuary's 'put that card on top of your library' in this batch).

kept.name: Severed Strands
kept.why: It destroys one target creature an opponent controls. Nothing about it affects everything.

kept.name: Lone Rider // It That Rides as One
kept.why: The end step trigger transforms it, which was unrecorded. 'if you gained 3 or more life this turn' is a lifegain condition, not a lifegain trigger, so cares:lifegain is the right word rather than trig:gains-life. Lifelink gains life, and every other lifelink card in this batch (Thurid, Invisible Woman, Dust Animus) carries eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Thurid, Mare of Destiny
kept.why: 'Whenever you cast a Pegasus, Unicorn, or Horse creature spell, copy it' - the copy itself was missing, and the trigger was recorded only as the bare trig:cast with neither the 'you cast' direction nor the creature-spell subject.

kept.name: Eater of the Dead
kept.why: Its only ability exiles a creature card from a graveyard and nothing recorded the exile - the list held just eff:untap, so the card read as a creature that untaps itself for free.

kept.name: Wall of Nets
kept.why: 'return all cards exiled with it to the battlefield' was unrecorded; the leave trigger was there with no effect under it. The exile zone is where those cards are held.

kept.name: Kinzu of the Bleak Coven
kept.why: 'create a token that's a copy of that creature' is a copy effect and 'pay 2 life' is a life cost, neither recorded. scope:all is wrong: the trigger fires on one creature at a time, nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Wilfred Mott
kept.why: He puts a nonland permanent card onto the battlefield from among the cards looked at, which is the payoff of the whole ability; eff:look-and-pick only says he looked. The looking is at the top of your library.

kept.name: Katara, Heroic Healer
kept.why: Lifelink gains life, and it is the only life-related thing on the card. Thurid, Invisible Woman and Dust Animus in this same batch all pair kw:lifelink with eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Arcbound Fiend
kept.why: Moving a +1/+1 counter FROM target creature takes a counter off it, which nothing recorded - only the adding half was. Modular has a dies trigger ('When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature') and no death trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Embermouth Sentinel
kept.why: With a Dragon it puts the land onto the battlefield rather than on top of the library, which is real ramp and was unrecorded. scope:all is wrong: it finds one basic land.

kept.name: Dai Li Indoctrination
kept.why: It is modal and the choice was unrecorded. Earthbend 2 puts two +1/+1 counters on the land (ctr:+1/+1 is present with no effect placing them) and the animated land has haste.

kept.name: Reaper's Talisman
kept.why: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks, it gains deathtouch until end of turn' - the grant was missing entirely, which is half of what the Equipment does.

kept.name: Blood Beckoning
kept.why: Kicker: paying {3} more returns two creature cards instead of one. Nothing recorded that paying extra gives more.

kept.name: Opalescence
kept.why: The card's entire text turns every other non-Aura enchantment into a creature and sets its base power and toughness to its mana value, and neither was recorded - the list was only cares:type:enchantment, scope:all and type:enchantment.

kept.name: Living Phone
kept.why: There is no exile anywhere on this card and nothing is played off the top. It looks at five cards and puts one into your hand, which eff:look-and-pick already says. eff:impulse would have it filed as an impulse-draw card in decks built around exile-and-play.

kept.name: Perigee Beckoner
kept.why: The entire enters ability was unrecorded apart from the trigger: it gives another creature +2/+0 and grants it a death trigger that returns it to the battlefield. Only kw:warp and the enters trigger were there.

kept.name: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai
kept.why: A land whose only mana is {C} and whose only text produces a colourless token has no colour identity at all. Every other colourless card in this batch carries the word.

kept.name: Presumed Dead
kept.why: The +2/+0 half of the effect was never recorded; only the granted dies-trigger was read.

kept.name: Lys Alana Scarblade
kept.why: The ability targets ONE creature. 'the number of Elves you control' is a count used to size the effect, not a selector that reaches everything, so scope:all is a miscount.

kept.name: Pharika's Libation
kept.why: A modal 'Choose one' spell - the choice itself is unrecorded.

kept.name: Brigid, Hero of Kinsbaile
kept.why: The '{T}:' in the activation cost was dropped, and the damage hits every attacking or blocking creature that player controls, which is a mass effect not a single target.

kept.name: Monk's Fist
kept.why: Job select creates a Hero token when the Equipment enters and the equipped creature gets +1/+0. Only the attach half was read - the token, the pump and the enters trigger were all missing.

kept.name: Turtles Forever
kept.why: The list was a single word for a card that tutors four legendary creatures, puts two in hand and shuffles the rest back. Nothing it does was recorded.

kept.name: Ghost Ark
kept.why: The ability reaches every artifact creature card in your graveyard, which is a mass selector. The trigger event itself has no word.

kept.name: Mystic Barrier
kept.why: Only the attack restriction was read. The enters trigger, the recurring upkeep trigger, the left/right choice and the fact that it binds every player were all missing.

kept.name: Sanguine Spy
kept.why: The end step ability was recorded as a trigger with no effect. It pays 2 life to draw a card, and both the payment and the draw were missing.

kept.name: Nightshade Assassin
kept.why: The entire enters ability was unread: revealing black cards from your hand to give a creature -X/-X. The shrink is the reason anyone plays this card.

kept.name: Demon of Death's Gate
kept.why: cost:sacrifice says this is a repeatable sacrifice OUTLET (Ashnod's Altar, Viscera Seer). It is not - paying 6 life and sacrificing three black creatures is an ALTERNATIVE COST to cast the spell, which is the cast- family. Filing it as an outlet puts a 9-mana Demon in aristocrats decks as an enabler.

kept.name: Jerren, Corrupted Bishop // Ormendahl, the Corrupter
kept.why: Both of the front face's triggers were missing (enters, and another nontoken Human dying), as was the transform clause and its pay-to-do condition. The back face is a free repeatable sacrifice outlet that draws a card, and neither half of that was recorded at all - the most load-bearing omission on the card.

kept.name: Cleansing Meditation
kept.why: The threshold half returns every card destroyed this way to the battlefield, which is the entire reason to play it over any other enchantment wipe. Only the destroy was read.

kept.name: Avenging Huntbonder
kept.why: The counter is recorded but not what the counter does. A double strike counter genuinely gives another attacking creature double strike.

kept.name: Attentive Skywarden
kept.why: kw:transform records that the word appears; nothing recorded that the card transforms an Incubator token, which is the whole ability.

kept.name: The Pandorica
kept.why: eff:exile is wrong: phasing out is not exiling, the permanent never changes zone and its Auras and counters stay with it. The real card untaps a permanent, phases it out indefinitely while The Pandorica stays tapped, and brings it back when it untaps or leaves. eff:neutralise is exactly this shape (Imprisoned in the Moon), and the tap cost and both delayed triggers were missing.

kept.name: Scythe of the Wretched
kept.why: The trigger is a creature DYING and the return is under YOUR control, so it takes an opponent's dead creature. Neither the trigger nor the theft was recorded.

kept.name: Invincible Hymn
kept.why: Your life total becomes the number of cards in your library - the library is what the card reads and that was never recorded.

kept.name: Empyrial Armor
kept.why: +1/+1 for each card in your hand. The hand size dependency, which is the whole card, was unrecorded.

kept.name: Curse of the Cabal
kept.why: Sacrificing half a player's permanents is a mass effect, not a single edict.

kept.name: Crack in Time
kept.why: It triggers twice - on entering and at the beginning of your first main phase every turn - and neither the standard enters words nor the main phase step were recorded.

kept.name: Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
kept.why: eff:impulse means exiling off the top of your library to PLAY those cards. Keskit exiles nothing and plays nothing - it looks at three and puts two in your HAND, which eff:look-and-pick already says. cares:zone:exile has no clause behind it either. Marking a sacrifice outlet as impulse draw sends it to the wrong decks.

kept.name: Mourner's Surprise
kept.why: The creature card is returned to your HAND, not the battlefield, and the hand was unrecorded.

kept.name: Restoration Specialist
kept.why: eff:bounce-own means returning your own permanents from the BATTLEFIELD to hand (a blink or a reset). This card returns cards from the GRAVEYARD to hand, which eff:return-from already says correctly. The wrong word makes it read as a bounce effect.

kept.name: Sunbird Standard // Sunbird Effigy
kept.why: The craft ability was read only as the keyword. It exiles this artifact plus other permanents you control and/or cards from your graveyard, and returns the card transformed - three separate things, none recorded.

kept.name: Deadly Plot
kept.why: It is a modal spell ("Choose one —") and nothing recorded that the caster picks the mode.

kept.name: Twilight Shepherd
kept.why: Persist returns it from the graveyard to the battlefield, which is exactly self-recursion; the list only recorded the dies trigger and the -1/-1 counter.

kept.name: Hungry Ghoul
kept.why: "Sacrifice another creature" is one creature as an activation cost. Nothing here affects everything - this is a word scan off "another creature", and it tells the engine the card is a mass effect.

kept.name: Ashiok, Wicked Manipulator
kept.why: Three separate clauses exile: the life-payment replacement exiles off your library, the +1 exiles one of the two cards looked at, and the -7 exiles the top X of a player's library. Nothing recorded any exiling.

kept.name: Mysterious Limousine
kept.why: Half the trigger was unread: it returns each other card exiled with this Vehicle to the battlefield, and the exile lasts only until this Vehicle leaves the battlefield, which is a delayed leaves-trigger on itself. It plainly cares about the exile zone.

kept.name: Murder Investigation
kept.why: The card's entire payoff is creating X 1/1 Soldier tokens and the list did not say it makes tokens at all - it recorded only the dies trigger and that it cares about power.

kept.name: Devout Invocation
kept.why: A seven-mana sorcery whose whole point is making a 4/4 Angel for each creature tapped, recorded as doing nothing but tapping your own creatures.

kept.name: Kor Bladewhirl
kept.why: Rally reads "whenever this creature OR another Ally you control enters", so it triggers on its own arrival too; only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Righteous Confluence
kept.why: "Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once" - the modal choice itself was unrecorded.

kept.name: Reign of the Pit
kept.why: It creates an X/X Demon and that was missing entirely. The sacrifice is an EFFECT on resolution (each player sacrifices, an edict), not a cost paid to cast it - eff:sacrifice already says so, and cost:sacrifice wrongly makes it look like a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Spring-Loaded Sawblades // Bladewheel Chariot
kept.why: The back face's ability turns the Vehicle into an artifact creature (animate) and its cost is tapping two other untapped artifacts you control, neither of which was recorded.

kept.name: Twinblade Geist // Twinblade Invocation
kept.why: Disturb casts it back out of your own graveyard, which is self-recursion, and the back face replaces its own trip to the graveyard with exiling itself. Only the granted double strike was recorded.

kept.name: Sarevok, Deathbringer
kept.why: It triggers at EACH player's end step and drains that player, so it hits the whole table rather than one opponent.

kept.name: United Battlefront
kept.why: Recorded as nothing but eff:look-and-pick. It digs seven deep and puts up to two permanents from the library straight onto the battlefield, so it plainly cares about the library and moves cards between zones.

kept.name: Gurgling Anointer
kept.why: "Whenever you draw your second card each turn" is a draw trigger and nothing recorded it, so the card looked like it grew for no stated reason.

kept.name: Reverence
kept.why: Its whole condition is a power comparison (power 2 or less) and it is a global static affecting every such creature at the table.

kept.name: Morgul-Knife Wound
kept.why: The granted ability exiles the creature unless its controller pays 2 life every upkeep - the recurring tax is the point of the card and only the shrink and the exile were recorded.

kept.name: Harmonious Archon
kept.why: "Non-Archon creatures have base power and toughness 3/3" is a set-P/T effect on every creature in play, and only eff:neutralise was recorded for it.

kept.name: Tri-Sentinel, Act of Vengeance
kept.why: The enter trigger fires FOR EACH OPPONENT, shooting a creature belonging to every one of them, not a single target.

kept.name: Ghastly Gloomhunter
kept.why: Kicker: "If this creature was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters" is the pay-more-get-more shape, and nothing recorded that the bonus is conditional on paying.

kept.name: Magitek Scythe
kept.why: The whole enters-trigger was unread: it is a triggered ability on its own arrival, it grants first strike until end of turn, and it makes that creature must-be-blocked, which is a lure.

kept.name: Harbinger of Night
kept.why: Putting a -1/-1 counter on EACH creature every upkeep makes creatures smaller and repeatedly kills small ones; recorded only as adding counters, which hides that it is a recurring shrinking sweeper.

kept.name: Archfiend's Vessel
kept.why: Its payoff is a 5/5 flying Demon token and that was missing outright, so the card read as pure self-exile. Lifelink gains life, recorded on other lifelink cards in this batch but not here.

kept.name: Fanatic of the Harrowing
kept.why: Two of its three clauses were unread: it draws a card if you discarded, and "each player discards" includes you and hits the whole table.

kept.name: Kaya, Spirits' Justice
kept.why: The +2 is "Surveil 2, then exile a card from a graveyard" - it carried kw:surveil but no eff:surveil, and the graveyard exiling (hate) was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Aurification
kept.why: Almost the entire card was unread. It triggers when a creature deals damage to YOU, puts a gold counter on it, gives every gold-countered creature defender, and on leaving removes all gold counters from all creatures. Only the leaves trigger was recorded, so a defensive lock read as doing nothing.

kept.name: Voyager Glidecar
kept.why: The activated ability turns it into an artifact creature and gives it flying, paid for by tapping three other untapped creatures you control. Only the counter and the scry were recorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Vatmother
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you get a poison counter" puts a counter on a player and nothing said so; it is the clause proliferate decks care about.

kept.name: Valor
kept.why: Its whole working ability is "as long as this card is in your graveyard" - a graveyard-matters card with no graveyard word.

kept.name: Hokori, Dust Drinker
kept.why: "Lands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps" is symmetric and global, so scope:all; the prohibition itself is unsayable and is the whole card.

kept.name: Aethersphere Harvester
kept.why: "Pay {E}: This Vehicle gains lifelink until end of turn" was not recorded at all.

kept.name: The Great Mound
kept.why: "{3}, {T}: Create a tapped Vibranium token" is a whole ability with no token word. It is a land with no colour identity, so col:none.

kept.name: The Moment
kept.why: "Destroy each nonland permanent" hits everything including yours, so scope:all. "It phases out until The Moment leaves the battlefield" was entirely unread. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: the destroy is filtered by mana value, the same restriction that keeps Elspeth and Hour of Reckoning out of that word.

kept.name: Plasmancer
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything - it is one ETB that searches your own library for a basic Swamp. scope:all here comes from the search selector, and it makes a one-shot tutor read as a global effect.

kept.name: Raiders' Spoils
kept.why: Half the card was missing: "you may pay 1 life. If you do, draw a card" gave no draw word, no life-payment word and no do-if-paid word. This is a Warrior card-advantage engine and nothing said it draws.

kept.name: Sunblade Samurai
kept.why: Channel is "{2}, Discard this card" - a discard-self cost that also makes this a discard-matters/reanimator-friendly card - and the ability searches your library.

kept.name: Devastating Mastery
kept.why: "Destroy all nonland permanents" is unrestricted and symmetric, which is the definition of scope:wipe, and nothing marked it - so nothing can keep it out of a go-wide deck. The opponent returning two permanents to hand was also unread.

kept.name: White Glove Gourmand
kept.why: "if another Human died under your control this turn" is a death payoff and no word said the card cares about creatures dying. The trigger is at end step, so this is the honest signal rather than a literal dies trigger.

kept.name: Ashes of the Fallen
kept.why: "Each creature card in your graveyard has the chosen creature type" - the card does nothing except to your graveyard, and had no graveyard word.

kept.name: Gideon, Champion of Justice
kept.why: Only the ultimate's exile was read. The +1 puts loyalty counters on him; the 0 turns him into a creature with power and toughness set by his counters, gives him indestructible and prevents all damage to him. "Exile all other permanents" is a board wipe that takes your side too, and the wipe word matters most - without it he can be offered to a token deck.

kept.name: Honored Knight-Captain
kept.why: An ETB token plus a sacrifice-tutor for one Equipment. Nothing affects everything; the word comes from the library search selector, same fault as Plasmancer.

kept.name: Spectral Snatcher
kept.why: Swampcycling is "{2}, Discard this card: Search your library...". The search was recorded and the discard cost and the library were not.

kept.name: Essence Pulse
kept.why: Only "you gain 2 life" was read. "Each creature gets -X/-X" is the entire point of the card: a symmetric mass shrink, so shrink, scope:all and scope:wipe (the same reading Toxic Deluge and Languish get). X is the life you gained this turn, which is a lifegain payoff.

kept.name: Return Triumphant
kept.why: "Create a Young Hero Role token attached to it" makes a token and attaches it, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Goremand
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" was unread - it is what makes this an aristocrats card rather than a six-mana flier.

kept.name: Tenured Inkcaster
kept.why: "Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks" is an attack trigger and no attack word was present.

kept.name: Briber's Purse
kept.why: The whole activated ability was missing: it costs {1}, a tap and a gem counter, and the effect stops a creature attacking or blocking. The counters enter on itself, so add-counters-self as well as the generic word.

kept.name: Xenosquirrels
kept.why: "remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature. If you do..." is a remove-counters cost with a do-if-paid effect, and neither was recorded. It also cares about die rolls, which nothing can express.

kept.name: Hero of Bretagard
kept.why: The card counts cards going to exile from your hand and permanents exiled from the battlefield, and carried no exile word at all. It also grants itself indestructible at ten counters, the same way it grants itself flying at five (which was recorded).

kept.name: Reverent Mantra
kept.why: "You may exile a white card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is a free-spell alternative cost that was unread. It is a mass protection trick, which is what the card is for. It changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong and would read it as a go-wide combat pump.

kept.name: Smelting Vat
kept.why: The activation includes {T} and the effect reveals the top eight of your library; neither the tap cost nor the library was recorded.

kept.name: Dutiful Replicator
kept.why: "create a token that's a copy of target token you control" is a copy effect and carried no copy word, and "you may pay {1}. When you do" is the do-if-paid shape.

kept.name: Ill-Gotten Gains
kept.why: "Each player discards their hand" includes you, which is eff:discard-self, and it is a symmetric effect hitting every player, so scope:all. Only the opponent-facing eff:discard was recorded.

kept.name: Scarblade Scout
kept.why: Milling two of your own cards is a graveyard enabler - the cards go to your yard, which is the whole reason to play it in a black deck. eff:mill alone does not say whose graveyard is being filled.

kept.name: Confession Dial
kept.why: Granting escape lets you cast a legendary creature out of your graveyard, which is exactly eff:cast-from-graveyard and was missing. Nothing on this card changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong, and it never returns a card either - the escape cast does the moving, so eff:return-from overstates it.

kept.name: Instruments of War
kept.why: "Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" is an anthem and the entire point of the card, and no effect word was recorded at all - only eff:choose for picking the type.

kept.name: Seht's Tiger
kept.why: The list carried no effect words whatsoever. The enter trigger gives you protection from a colour of your choice, which is grants:protection plus a real choice on resolution.

kept.name: Sigrid, God-Favored
kept.why: "exile ... until Sigrid leaves the battlefield" sets up a delayed trigger keyed on Sigrid leaving, which is how the exiled creature comes back. Same shape the database already records with trig:leaves/trig:leaves-self on Champion of the Weird.

kept.name: Ratchet Bomb
kept.why: The second ability's cost is "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact" and cost:sacrifice-self was missing. Destroying each nonland permanent at a given mana value is a mass effect, so scope:all. Deliberately not scope:wipe: the mana value restriction means it is often a one-sided sweep rather than a Wrath.

kept.name: Surestrike Trident
kept.why: "Equipped creature has first strike" is half the card and no grants: word was recorded.

kept.name: Spiked Pit Trap
kept.why: "Create a Treasure token" on a roll of 10 or better is a token effect and eff:create-token was missing entirely. The activated ability also costs {T}, so cost:tap.

kept.name: Cloister Gargoyle
kept.why: The list had no effect words at all. Once you have completed a dungeon it gets +3/+0 (eff:pump) and has flying (grants:flying); both are conditional but both are real.

kept.name: Sleeper Dart
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact" and neither cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Shredder, Unrelenting
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative cast cost that returns an unblocked attacker you control to hand, which is precisely cost:cast-return-to-hand. eff:pump is wrong - the trigger grants deathtouch and changes no power or toughness, and grants:deathtouch already says what happens.

kept.name: Cracked Skull
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature", so eff:attach, the same word Equipment and Fortifications on this list already carry. "When enchanted creature is dealt damage, destroy it" is a trigger on damage being dealt and trig:dealt-damage was missing, so the destroy had no trigger attached to it.

kept.name: Champion of the Weird
kept.why: Three costs and an effect were all unrecorded: beholding a Goblin and exiling it is an additional cost to cast (cost:cast-exile), the activated ability costs "Pay 1 life" (cost:life), and the leaves trigger returns the exiled card to its owner's hand (eff:return-from, operating on the exile zone).

kept.name: Leonardo, Sewer Samurai
kept.why: Casting creature spells from your graveyard is eff:cast-from-graveyard, and Sneak is an alternative cost returning an unblocked attacker to hand. trig:attacks is wrong - nothing on this card triggers on attacking; Sneak merely has him enter attacking. eff:return-from is wrong for the same reason as Confession Dial: he grants permission to cast, he does not return anything.

kept.name: C.A.M.P.
kept.why: "Whenever fortified land is tapped for mana" is exactly trig:tapped-for-mana and no trigger word was recorded at all. It also creates a Junk token when the colours match, and eff:create-token was missing.

kept.name: Virulent Wound
kept.why: The poison counter is the reason this card exists and eff:poison was missing. "When that creature dies this turn" is a delayed trigger on a creature dying (trig:dies), and a -1/-1 counter makes the creature smaller, which is what makes this removal rather than a counters payoff.

kept.name: Beamsaw Prospector
kept.why: "Create a Lander token" is the entire death trigger and eff:create-token was missing - only the token's own search ability had been read.

kept.name: Empty the Pits
kept.why: Delve pays for the spell by exiling cards from your graveyard, so this is a graveyard-fuelled card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Curse of Leeches // Leeching Lurker
kept.why: "At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, they lose 1 life and you gain 1 life" is an upkeep trigger and no trigger word was recorded, so the drain hung off nothing.

kept.name: Invasion of Ravnica // Guildpact Paragon
kept.why: The back face triggers whenever YOU cast a two-colour spell, and neither cast word was recorded, so the whole dig-six ability had no trigger.

kept.name: Sigil of Distinction
kept.why: It is an Equipment with an equip ability, so eff:attach, matching the other Equipment on this list. Its equip cost is "Remove a charge counter from this Equipment", which is cost:remove-counters.

kept.name: Constable of the Realm
kept.why: Renown 2 puts two +1/+1 counters on Constable itself, so eff:add-counters-self. The exile lasts "until this creature leaves the battlefield", which is a delayed trigger on it leaving.

kept.name: Skyclave Shade
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed restriction on itself and was unread.

kept.name: Seraph of the Masses
kept.why: Convoke taps other creatures you control as an additional cast cost, which is exactly what cost:cast-tap-others names.

kept.name: Monument to Perfection
kept.why: Only the land search was read. The first ability costs {T}. The second turns the artifact into a 9/9 creature (animate + set-pt) that gains indestructible and toxic 9, which hands out poison counters.

kept.name: Frodo, Determined Hero
kept.why: "During your turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to Frodo" is a whole ability with no facet.

kept.name: Seraphic Greatsword
kept.why: The token is made off an attack trigger on the equipped creature; nothing recorded the trigger.

kept.name: Escarpment Fortress
kept.why: "Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card" produced neither the trigger nor the draw.

kept.name: The Cloning of Shredder
kept.why: All three chapters CREATE TOKENS and that was missing entirely. Chapters II and III read cards exiled with the Saga, so it cares about exile. The exile in chapter I is an effect, not a cost, so cost:exile is wrong.

kept.name: Broodrage Mycoid
kept.why: Descend checks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard, which is a genuine graveyard care rather than a word scan.

kept.name: Creeping Dread
kept.why: "Each player discards a card" includes you, and it is a symmetric mass effect. Only the opponent half was read.

kept.name: Swashbuckler's Whip
kept.why: The equipped creature is granted reach, unrecorded. Discover 10 casts the exiled card without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Boggart Mob
kept.why: Champion was left entirely unread: it is an enters trigger that exiles another Goblin you control, and a leaves trigger that returns it to the battlefield.

kept.name: Dead Weight
kept.why: -2/-2 is removal, not enhancement. Filed as a pump it reads as a voltron aura when it is a one-mana kill spell.

kept.name: Orzhov Charm
kept.why: Mode one returns your own creature and its Auras to hand, which is the definition of eff:bounce-own and was missing.

kept.name: Orator of Ojutai
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may reveal a Dragon card from your hand" is a cast cost with no facet.

kept.name: Slaughter
kept.why: Buyback—Pay 4 life is an additional cost of life paid on casting.

kept.name: Syphon Soul
kept.why: It hits each other player rather than a single target; the mass scope was unread (rec:partial).

kept.name: Heroic Sacrifice
kept.why: The card's main clause redirects all damage aimed at you and your creatures onto one creature, and the trigger moves that creature's counters onto another. Only the draw was read.

kept.name: Cranial Archive
kept.why: The activation cost is "Exile this artifact", not sacrificing it. The distinction matters: it never reaches the graveyard, so it is not sacrifice-outlet fodder.

kept.name: Illness in the Ranks
kept.why: Creature tokens get -1/-1: this is token hate, the opposite of a pump. As eff:pump it could be offered to a tokens deck as an anthem.

kept.name: Cloudbound Moogle
kept.why: Plainscycling {2} discards this card as part of the activation cost.

kept.name: Forsaken Wastes
kept.why: The upkeep drain hits each player, and the third ability triggers when this becomes the target of a spell. Both unread.

kept.name: Brainspoil
kept.why: Transmute discards this card as part of its activation cost.

kept.name: Feed the Cauldron
kept.why: It creates a Food token and the token creation was missing, though the Food's lifegain was recorded.

kept.name: Wail of War
kept.why: Mode one gives all creatures an opponent controls -1/-1; only the graveyard mode was read.

kept.name: Sculpted Sunburst
kept.why: Opponents choose a creature with equal or lesser POWER, so power is the axis it reads. It then exiles every creature not chosen, including yours, which is a board wipe and should be refused by go-wide decks.

kept.name: Brass Herald
kept.why: Two of its three abilities were unread: it reveals the top four and takes the ones you want, and it is an anthem giving every creature of the chosen type +1/+1.

kept.name: Obstinate Gargoyle
kept.why: Persist returns the card itself to the battlefield after it dies, which is exactly eff:recur-self.

kept.name: Desperate Bloodseeker
kept.why: Lifelink gains life; the same reading is already applied to other lifelink creatures in this batch.

kept.name: Spell Satchel
kept.why: Magecraft triggers on YOUR instant and sorcery casts and puts a counter on this artifact. The counter-removal costs were read but the ability that supplies the counters was not.

kept.name: Arco-Flagellant
kept.why: Squad's reminder text is a real enters trigger that creates copy tokens, and neither enters facet was recorded. "This creature can't block" was read by nothing. eff:pump is wrong: gaining indestructible until end of turn changes no power or toughness, and grants:indestructible already says it.

kept.name: Gift of Fangs
kept.why: The aura is two-sided and only the upside was read. "Otherwise, it gets -2/-2" is a shrink on any non-Vampire, which is how this card is used as removal.

kept.name: Malevolent Witchkite
kept.why: The enters trigger sacrifices any number of your own artifacts, enchantments and tokens. Only the draw half was recorded, so the card reads as pure card draw with no sacrifice at all.

kept.name: Saw
kept.why: Two of the three things the Equipment does were unrecorded: it draws a card on each attack, and "you may sacrifice a permanent ... if you do" is a repeatable sacrifice outlet, which is the whole reason to play it.

kept.name: Banish to Another Universe
kept.why: The card's entire effect is exiling an opponent's nonland permanent and nothing recorded it, so a removal spell carried no removal verb at all. "Until this enchantment leaves the battlefield" is a real leaves trigger on itself.

kept.name: Demonic Bargain
kept.why: The card exiles thirteen cards off the top and then searches; only the search was recorded. It is emphatically a library card and the zone was missing.

kept.name: Demon of Wailing Agonies
kept.why: Lieutenant gives it +2/+2 as well as the granted sacrifice trigger, and the size change was not recorded.

kept.name: Skeletal Vampire
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects a group. The enters trigger makes two tokens, the activated ability makes two more, and the last line regenerates itself. All single or self effects.

kept.name: Thrór's Map
kept.why: A basic-land tutor and a loot ability. Neither touches a group of permanents or players, so the mass-effect word is a false positive.

kept.name: Vault 13: Dweller's Journey
kept.why: Chapter I is "For each player, exile up to one other target enchantment or creature that player controls", which hits every player at once rather than one target.

kept.name: Rooftop Percher
kept.why: It exiles cards from graveyards, which is graveyard hate, not removal. Plain eff:exile files it as an answer to a permanent, which it cannot do.

kept.name: Delaying Shield
kept.why: Only the upkeep timing was recorded, so the engine knew when it did something and nothing about what. It replaces damage dealt to you with delay counters on itself, then removes all of them on your upkeep.

kept.name: Isareth the Awakener
kept.why: "You may pay {X}. When you do" is an optional cost the reanimation hangs on, and the returned creature comes back with a corpse counter. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Final Payment
kept.why: The additional cost - pay 5 life or sacrifice a creature or enchantment - was read by nothing, so a card that is a sacrifice payoff and a life-payment card looked like a plain removal spell.

kept.name: Soul-Shackled Zombie
kept.why: The enters trigger exiles up to two cards from a graveyard and only the drain half was recorded. The drain hits each opponent, not one player.

kept.name: Triarch Stalker
kept.why: The card's only payoff is that creatures attacking the chosen player have menace, and neither the granted keyword nor the fact that it applies to a whole group was recorded.

kept.name: Mechanical Mobster
kept.why: Connive is draw a card then discard a card, and only the counter half of it was read. The enters trigger also exiles from a graveyard, so the graveyard zone belongs on it.

kept.name: Runed Stalactite
kept.why: It gives +1/+1 and no pump was recorded at all. "Is every creature type" is changeling granted to the equipped creature, which is the reason the card exists in tribal decks.

kept.name: Skeleton Shard
kept.why: The list held only the card type. It is a repeatable tap ability that returns an artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand, and none of that was written down.

kept.name: Zombie Trailblazer
kept.why: Both abilities grant swampwalk or change a land's type; neither changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. Both target a single permanent, so scope:all is wrong too.

kept.name: High Ground
kept.why: "Each creature you control" is a static effect on a whole group, which was unrecorded. The card otherwise carried no effect word at all, and the missing word does not exist yet.

kept.name: Thornbow Archer
kept.why: The attack trigger drains each opponent who does not control an Elf, which is a table-wide effect rather than a single target.

kept.name: Killian's Confidence
kept.why: The whole second half was unread: it triggers on your creatures dealing combat damage, lets you pay {W/B}, and returns itself from the graveyard. eff:return-from was recorded generically, which reads as recursion for other cards rather than for itself.

kept.name: Vibranium Mining Mech
kept.why: "Whenever this Vehicle enters or attacks, create a tapped Vibranium token" — the card's whole payoff is making tokens and nothing recorded it. eff:add-mana is already there from the token's reminder text, so half the clause was read and half was dropped.

kept.name: June, Bounty Hunter
kept.why: "June can't be blocked as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn" is an evasion clause with no facet at all. eff:draw comes from the Clue token's printed reminder ("{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card"), the same reading that gave Canyon Crawler eff:gain-life off its Food and this card's own Vibranium sibling eff:add-mana.

kept.name: Shattered Acolyte
kept.why: It has lifelink. Child of Night, Seraph of Dawn and Basri's Acolyte all carry eff:gain-life for the same keyword, so this is the convention being applied unevenly rather than a judgement call.

kept.name: Gelatinous Cube
kept.why: The Dissolve ability reads "Put target creature card ... exiled with this creature into its owner's graveyard" — it looks at the exile zone and moves a card out of it, and neither was recorded. I deliberately did NOT add eff:return-from or trig:leaves-self for the "until this creature leaves" clause: the card that comes back is the opponent's, and tagging it as recursion would read as graveyard value the deck can use.

kept.name: Sanctuary Blade
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has protection from the last chosen color." Both halves of the only line that does anything were missing; the list had eff:attach and stopped.

kept.name: Null Brooch
kept.why: "Discard your hand" as an activation cost makes this a hand-emptying card, which is a real deckbuilding property (it is free once you are hellbent). Left cost:discard as it stands rather than swapping it for cost:discard-self, since I cannot tell from the vocabulary which of the two this database uses for discarding your own cards.

kept.name: Abigale, Poet Laureate // Heroic Stanza
kept.why: Prepared is defined on the card as "you may cast a copy of its spell". Copying spells is the entire reason to play her and nothing recorded it. Not adding eff:cast-free — the reminder does not say the copy is free.

kept.name: Chimeric Mass
kept.why: "Becomes a Construct artifact creature" is eff:animate exactly, and "power and toughness are each equal to the number of charge counters" is eff:set-pt; neither was recorded. It enters with X counters on ITSELF, which is how Royal Talon Fighter Jet is tagged. mv:cheap is wrong: the cost is {X} alone, so mana value collapses to 0 and the card reads as a two-drop when it is only cheap if you pay nothing for it. Royal Talon keeps mv:cheap correctly because {X}{W}{W} has a real mana value of 2.

kept.name: Jocasta, Automaton Avenger
kept.why: The counter goes on Jocasta herself, so the -self word applies (compare Lightless Evangel and Sunstar Lightsmith in this same batch). "Return it to the battlefield" from the graveyard is a return that eff:recur-self alone does not state; Hexmark Destroyer in this batch carries both for the same shape.

kept.name: Basri's Acolyte
kept.why: Lifelink, same as Child of Night and Seraph of Dawn which both carry it.

kept.name: Harvester of Misery
kept.why: "{1}{B}, Discard this card: Target creature gets -2/-2" — discarding itself is the cost of its second removal ability and no cost word was recorded. Kept scope:wipe: "other creatures get -2/-2" is symmetric and not restricted to opponents, which is the case that word is for, and it is the right anti-synergy signal against a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Savanti Romero, Time's Exile
kept.why: "You draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of counters" — the card's payoff, and the largest miss in this batch. Only the counter half of the trigger was read.

kept.name: Resistance Reunited
kept.why: "Equipped creatures you control gain indestructible" affects a group rather than one target, the same reading that gives Chief of the Edge and Ajani's -3 scope:all. Did not add eff:protect — grants:indestructible already states the protection and I could not confirm the two are meant to co-occur.

kept.name: Heartless Pillage
kept.why: "Create a Treasure token" was not recorded at all despite the card carrying kw:treasure, and eff:add-mana follows the Treasure's printed reminder ("Add one mana of any color") the same way the Vibranium token gave Vibranium Mining Mech eff:add-mana.

kept.name: Liar's Pendulum
kept.why: Four facets for a card whose ability is "{2}, {T}: ... You may reveal your hand ... draw a card". The tap cost, the draw and the fact that it reads your own hand were all absent — the engine currently believes this artifact does nothing.

kept.name: Quintessential Katana
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage, untap it and you gain 2 life.'" Only the untap half of the granted ability was read: the pump, the lifegain and the combat-damage trigger it hands to the creature were all dropped.

kept.name: Patron of the Valiant
kept.why: Puts a counter on EACH creature you control with a counter, which is a board-wide effect and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Second Breakfast
kept.why: The first half of the card, 'up to two target creatures each get +2/+1', was not recorded at all - only the Food token was.

kept.name: Cho-Manno's Blessing
kept.why: The whole point of the Aura is that the enchanted creature has protection from the chosen colour, and only the 'choose a colour' half was written down.

kept.name: Nurturing Pixie
kept.why: Returns a nonland permanent YOU control to hand - that is the card's whole value (resetting your own enter-the-battlefield triggers) and only the counter it gets afterwards was recorded.

kept.name: Sanguine Indulgence
kept.why: 'Costs {3} less if you've gained 3 or more life this turn' is a cost reduction gated on lifegain; neither the reduction nor the lifegain condition was recorded.

kept.name: Aura Fracture
kept.why: 'Destroy target enchantment' hits one permanent. Nothing here affects everything; the word appears to have fired on the loose 'a land' sacrifice cost and would read as a sweeper.

kept.name: Wedgelight Rammer
kept.why: The entire enter-the-battlefield clause was missing: it triggers on entering and makes a 2/2 Robot token. Station also puts charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to the tapped creature's power, so it both counters itself and cares about power.

kept.name: Heliod's Punishment
kept.why: The enchanted creature can't attack or block. eff:neutralise covers losing abilities but the attack and block locks are separate real restrictions and both words exist.

kept.name: Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine
kept.why: Both activated abilities cost {T}; the reanimated creature gains haste; the {T} ability exiles the top three of your library; and the payoff ability reads cards exiled with Yggdrasil, so exile is a zone this card genuinely works from.

kept.name: Hollow One
kept.why: 'Costs {2} less for each card you've cycled or discarded this turn' is a cost reduction and is the reason the card is played; only the cycling half was recorded.

kept.name: Wick's Patrol
kept.why: The second half of the trigger gives an opponent's creature -X/-X, which is the removal half of the card. Only the mill was recorded.

kept.name: Wings of Hubris
kept.why: 'Sacrifice this Equipment:' is the activation cost of the unblockable ability - it eats only itself, which is the -self form.

kept.name: Resplendent Mentor
kept.why: The static ability applies only to WHITE creatures you control, and nothing recorded the colour condition.

kept.name: Silverquill Command
kept.why: 'Choose two —' is a modal spell; the modes were all recorded but not the fact that the caster picks.

kept.name: Diabolic Servitude
kept.why: Two of the three abilities were unrecorded: it triggers when the reanimated creature dies, and it exiles that creature both then and when the enchantment leaves.

kept.name: Sandman's Quicksand
kept.why: Mayhem lets you cast this from your graveyard if you discarded it, so the graveyard is a zone this card is played from, not incidental.

kept.name: Necromancer's Covenant
kept.why: The entire enter trigger was missing: it exiles all creature cards from a graveyard (graveyard hate) and makes a Zombie token for each. Only the lifelink static was recorded.

kept.name: Bond of Revival
kept.why: 'It gains haste until your next turn' is why this reanimation spell is chosen over cheaper ones, and it was not recorded.

kept.name: Carrion Cruiser
kept.why: Crew 1 taps other creatures you control as a cost, which was unrecorded. Nothing on the card affects everything - it mills two and returns one card - so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Endless Horizons
kept.why: Only the library search was recorded. It exiles the Plains it finds, shuffles, and then every upkeep returns one of those exiled cards to your hand, so exile is the zone the whole engine runs through.

kept.name: Pathway Arrows
kept.why: The granted ability taps the damaged creature only if it is COLORLESS, which is a real condition and the reason the card exists in Eldrazi-hate sideboards.

kept.name: Epochrasite
kept.why: When it dies it exiles ITSELF with time counters and suspend, which brings it back. It is recursive fodder and neither the self-exile nor the self-recursion was recorded.

kept.name: Honor the Fallen
kept.why: Exiling is the spell's EFFECT, not a cost paid to cast it - cost:exile is wrong. It hits all creature cards in ALL graveyards, so scope:all is what is missing.

kept.name: Lingering Tormentor
kept.why: Persist returns this creature to the battlefield after it dies - it brings itself back, which is exactly what eff:recur-self names and what makes it sacrifice fodder.

kept.name: Demon of Catastrophes
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature' is a cast cost, not a repeatable sacrifice outlet. Recorded as cost:sacrifice it reads as an altar, which would put it in aristocrats decks as an enabler when it is a payoff that needs one.

kept.name: Undercity Eliminator
kept.why: It exiles ONE target creature an opponent controls after an optional sacrifice. Nothing affects everything, and scope:all makes a single-target removal creature read as a sweeper.

kept.name: Bond of Agony
kept.why: 'Each other player loses X life' hits the whole table, which is what makes it a finisher rather than a one-target drain.

kept.name: Exalted Angel
kept.why: 'Whenever this creature deals damage, you gain that much life' - the lifegain trigger fires but the lifegain itself was never written down, so the card's entire payoff is invisible.

kept.name: Aeon Engine
kept.why: The card had nothing recorded but its colour and type. Its only ability costs {T} and exiling itself.

kept.name: Hopeful Eidolon
kept.why: It has lifelink itself and grants lifelink, so it gains life. Other lifelink creatures in the catalogue carry eff:gain-life and this one did not.

kept.name: Declaration in Stone
kept.why: This is a premier white removal spell and the exile - the entire first sentence - was not recorded. Only the Clue tokens the opponent gets were.

kept.name: Golem Artisan
kept.why: The second ability, granting your choice of flying, trample or haste, was completely unrecorded; only the +1/+1 pump was.

kept.name: That Which Was Taken
kept.why: The ability that does the work was missing: {4}, {T} puts a divinity counter on a permanent, and the static then makes EVERY permanent carrying one indestructible.

kept.name: Tasigur's Cruelty
kept.why: "Each opponent discards two cards" is a symmetric hit on every opponent, so scope:all. Delve is paid by exiling cards from your own graveyard, which is both a graveyard-caring card and an exile cost.

kept.name: Archon of Redemption
kept.why: The trigger reads "Whenever THIS CREATURE or another creature you control with flying enters", so it fires on both its own arrival and on other fliers. Only the bare trig:enters was recorded, which loses which direction it listens in.

kept.name: Inside Information
kept.why: It exiles from the top of an opponent's LIBRARY, which is not written down anywhere on the list. And the exiled spells are cast by paying life equal to mana value rather than the mana cost, which is a life cost.

kept.name: Alchemist's Assistant
kept.why: The Renew ability puts a lifelink counter on TARGET CREATURE. The list records grants:lifelink but not that it puts a counter on another creature at all.

kept.name: Magebane Armor
kept.why: Both of the equipment's actual effects were missing: it gives +2/+4 (a pump) and prevents all noncombat damage dealt to the equipped creature. The list held only eff:attach, so the engine thought this Equipment does nothing when attached.

kept.name: Grimdancer
kept.why: It enters with counters on ITSELF, which is eff:add-counters-self, and the two counters are "your choice" from three, which is eff:choose. grants:deathtouch was recorded but the other two keywords it can give itself were not.

kept.name: Sloppity Bilepiper
kept.why: The activation cost is {2}, {T}, Sacrifice A CREATURE - the tap was missing, and cost:sacrifice-self is wrong because it eats another creature rather than only itself. cost:sacrifice is already correctly present, so this is a real on-demand outlet, not a one-shot self-sacrifice.

kept.name: Go Blank
kept.why: Half the card was unread: "Then exile that player's graveyard" is the graveyard-hate clause and the only reason anyone plays this over a plain discard spell.

kept.name: Champion of Stray Souls
kept.why: The reanimation ability costs {3}{B}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice X OTHER CREATURES. Neither the tap nor the sacrifice was recorded, so a genuine repeatable sacrifice outlet reads as free.

kept.name: Faith's Shield
kept.why: Nothing on this card changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. Granting protection to keep a permanent alive is eff:protect, and the fateful hour mode covers YOU AND EACH PERMANENT you control, which is a mass effect.

kept.name: Alabaster Host Intercessor
kept.why: The exile lasts "until THIS CREATURE leaves the battlefield", a real leaves-the-battlefield clause that returns the opponent's creature and was unrecorded. Plainscycling is paid by discarding this card, which is a discard cost.

kept.name: Nevermore
kept.why: "As this enchantment enters, choose a nonland card name" is a choice the card makes, and what it stops is spells on the stack being cast. Only eff:cant-cast was recorded, with nothing saying a choice is involved.

kept.name: Regna's Sanction
kept.why: "For each player, choose friend or foe" is an explicit choice the caster makes, and it is what decides which half of the card each player gets.

kept.name: Dark Endurance
kept.why: Granting indestructible until end of turn to save a creature from removal or combat is the card's whole purpose. eff:pump is correctly present for the +2/+0, but nothing recorded that it keeps the creature alive.

kept.name: Cavernous Maw
kept.why: "This land becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature until end of turn" is a manland activation and nothing on the list said so. It is a colourless land producing {C}, so it has no colour identity.
