kept.name: Alharu, Solemn Ritualist
kept.why: "Whenever a nontoken creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it DIES, create a 1/1 Spirit" - the token creation was recorded but not the death trigger that produces it, which is what makes this a counters-plus-aristocrats commander.

kept.name: Avengers Quinjet
kept.why: The ability triggers on enters OR ATTACKS and the attack half was missing. It is also a modal "choose one", and Crew 3 is paid by tapping other creatures you control.

kept.name: Super-Adaptoid
kept.why: The entire trigger puts keyword counters on ITSELF. eff:set-pt covered the power-setting line but nothing recorded that it grows itself with counters. I deliberately did not add the ten grants: words, because it only gains each keyword if the chosen creature already has it, so claiming grants:indestructible would file a conditional mirror as a protection card.

kept.name: Homicide Investigator
kept.why: "Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control DIE, investigate" - the Clue token was recorded but not the death trigger, so an aristocrats card reads as an unconditional token maker.

kept.name: Nefarious Lich
kept.why: The card's cost is exiling cards from your own graveyard for every point of damage, so it is deeply graveyard-caring and that was unrecorded. "If you would gain life, draw that many cards instead" is a lifegain-matters clause. I did NOT add eff:exile-graveyard: it exiles YOUR OWN graveyard as a cost, and that word is graveyard hate, which would file this as an answer to other people's graveyards.

kept.name: Minion Reflector
kept.why: It creates "a token that's a COPY of that creature" - copying is the whole card and eff:create-token alone loses it. The token only happens if you pay {2}, which is a pay-for-more effect.

kept.name: Discerning Taste
kept.why: "Look at the top four cards, put one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard" is exactly look-and-pick, and the rest going to your graveyard plus the payoff being measured off creature cards put there makes it a self-mill card that cares about the graveyard.

kept.name: Unbreakable Bond
kept.why: It returns the creature "with a lifelink counter on it". grants:lifelink was recorded but not that a counter is placed, which is how the keyword sticks permanently.

kept.name: Rinoa, Angel Wing
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread. The first ability pumps every flier you control +1/+1 (eff:pump, scope:all) alongside the recorded vigilance. The second is a death trigger on your attacking creatures that reanimates one from the graveyard with a flying counter on it - a dies trigger, a return from graveyard, a counter and a granted keyword, none of them written down. The list said only "grants vigilance at begin combat".

kept.name: Abyssal Gorestalker
kept.why: "When this creature enters, EACH PLAYER sacrifices two creatures" - the only thing this card does was missing entirely. It is a symmetric double edict and the list recorded no effect at all.

kept.name: Magus of the Disk
kept.why: "Destroy all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments" hits YOUR board as well as everyone else's. eff:destroy plus scope:all does not distinguish a one-sided sweeper from a symmetric one, and the anti-synergy check that keeps board wipes out of go-wide decks reads scope:wipe.

kept.name: Infernal Vessel
kept.why: "When this creature dies... return IT to the battlefield" is a creature that brings itself back, which is precisely eff:recur-self and makes it real sacrifice fodder. The counters and the dies trigger were recorded but not the return, so the list said it dies and grows and never comes back.

kept.name: Fetid Gargantua
kept.why: The counter trigger draws two cards and nothing recorded it. The list stops after adapt.

kept.name: The Book of Vile Darkness
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unread: it taps, exiles itself, and exiles two other artifacts you control as its cost.

kept.name: Kaya, Ghost Assassin
kept.why: The 0 ability was entirely unrecorded. It exiles Kaya or a target creature and returns that card to the battlefield on your next upkeep; only the two minus abilities were read.

kept.name: Rayblade Trooper
kept.why: The second ability triggers on a nontoken creature you control dying. The token creation was recorded but not what triggers it.

kept.name: Spoils of Blood
kept.why: The card's entire text is creating an X/X Horror token and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Three Bowls of Porridge
kept.why: The ability costs {2} and a tap, and the third mode sacrifices the artifact itself. Only the three mode outcomes were read.

kept.name: Rally for the Throne
kept.why: Adamant checks that at least three white mana was spent to cast it, which is a mana-spent condition and is unrecorded.

kept.name: Doctor Strange, Surgeon
kept.why: Lifelink gains life (the convention elsewhere in this data), and the replacement effect doubling all your lifegain was completely unread despite being the card's defining line.

kept.name: Sunstone
kept.why: It prevents ALL combat damage that would be dealt this turn, a global fog, not a targeted prevention.

kept.name: Rampaging Spiketail
kept.why: Swampcycling is discard-this-card as a cost to search the library for a land. The search effect was recorded but neither the cost nor the land-fetch was.

kept.name: Taranika, Akroan Veteran
kept.why: The attack trigger gives the creature BASE power and toughness 4/4, which is setting P/T, not the pump the list currently implies through untap alone.

kept.name: Turtle Van
kept.why: It doubles the number of +1/+1 counters on the crewing creature if it is a Mutant, Ninja, or Turtle. Only the single counter was read.

kept.name: Suntouched Myr
kept.why: Sunburst counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, which is a mana-spent condition.

kept.name: Blink Dog
kept.why: Teleport phases it out, which is how it survives removal. Only the printed keywords were read; the activated ability produced nothing.

kept.name: Glimmer Seeker
kept.why: The survival trigger draws a card when you control a Glimmer. Only the token half of the if/else was recorded.

kept.name: Lo and Li, Twin Tutors
kept.why: The tutor is an enters trigger and neither trigger word is present, so nothing says when the search happens. It also searches your library.

kept.name: Matt Murdock, Justice Seeker
kept.why: The counter only arrives if you pay {1}, a reflexive may-pay trigger, and that conditionality was unread.

kept.name: Draconian Gate-Bot
kept.why: The second mode destroys a target Attraction and no effect word was recorded for either mode.

kept.name: Mogis's Marauder
kept.why: The card grants haste and intimidate to up to X creatures and carried no effect or grant word at all, only the devotion colour.

kept.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
kept.why: The second ability was entirely unread: exile this card from your graveyard as a cost to add one mana of any colour. The card also references graveyards in both abilities.

kept.name: Demonic Collusion
kept.why: Buyback here is an additional cost of discarding two cards as you cast it, and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Spellbinder
kept.why: The combat trigger copies the imprinted card before casting it free; only the free cast was read. The card also reads the exile zone for its imprinted instant.

kept.name: Extract the Truth
kept.why: Modal spell ("Choose one —"): you pick which of two things it does.

kept.name: Black Widow, Super Spy
kept.why: The whole payoff clause was unread: it exiles cards off the top of a library and lets you cast the exiled card until end of turn with any type of mana. That is the impulse shape, and it cares about both the library it digs through and the exile zone it casts from.

kept.name: Helm of Possession
kept.why: The gain-control ability costs {2}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature. The sacrifice half was recorded and the tap half was not.

kept.name: Realmbreaker's Grasp
kept.why: Enchanted permanent can't attack, can't block, and can't activate anything but mana abilities. It is left on the battlefield and made harmless, which is exactly what eff:neutralise names (Pacifism, Witness Protection).

kept.name: Seraph of the Scales
kept.why: Afterlife 2 is a dies trigger. The token creation was recorded but nothing said when it happens.

kept.name: Phyrexian Devourer
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is exiling the top card of your library, and the sacrifice trigger reads its own power ("when this creature's power is 7 or greater"). Neither was written down.

kept.name: Imperious Oligarch
kept.why: Afterlife 1 is a dies trigger; only the token half was recorded.

kept.name: Age of Ultron
kept.why: Chapter II creates a 2/2 Robot Villain token for each opponent and the card carried no token verb at all. Chapters I and III were read and II was not.

kept.name: Dwarven Mattock
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+2. The attach and the ETB were recorded, the stat boost was not.

kept.name: A Tale for the Ages
kept.why: "Enchanted creatures you control get +2/+2" is a mass static buff, the same shape as Paragon of Open Graves and Ultron, both of which carry scope:all.

kept.name: Taj-Nar Swordsmith
kept.why: "You may pay {X}. If you do, search your library ... then shuffle." The optional-cost gate and the shuffle were both unread, and the search is a library search.

kept.name: Topaz Dragon // Entropic Cloud
kept.why: The Adventure gives deathtouch to every creature you control, not to one target. The grant was recorded without its scope.

kept.name: Abuelo's Awakening
kept.why: "It's a 1/1 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types" turns an artifact or enchantment into a creature and fixes its power and toughness. Only the return and the counters were read.

kept.name: Soul Exchange
kept.why: The additional cost to cast is exiling a creature you control, and it puts a +2/+2 counter on the reanimated creature if that exiled creature was a Thrull. Both clauses were missing.

kept.name: Foul Roads
kept.why: The land's third ability sacrifices itself to create a 1/1 Pilot token. Only the mana ability had been read.

kept.name: Infernal Genesis
kept.why: Each player mills a card on their own upkeep, and the token count is that card's mana value. The mill verb was absent (only the kw marker was there) and the effect is symmetric across every player.

kept.name: Essence Reliquary
kept.why: The card had no verb at all. Its only ability is {T}: return another permanent you control, plus the Auras on it, to hand - a tap cost and a bounce of your own permanent.

kept.name: Roadside Assistance
kept.why: The Aura's enters trigger creates a 1/1 Pilot token and the card carried no token verb; only the +1/+1 and lifelink half was read.

kept.name: Fishing Pole
kept.why: The granted ability puts a bait counter on the Equipment (only the removal of counters was recorded) and its cost is {1}, {T}, Tap Fishing Pole.

kept.name: Shuri's Fabricator
kept.why: The enters trigger creates two Vibranium tokens, the reanimation ability costs {6}, {T}, and it returns the artifact with a finality counter on it. Three separate clauses unread; only the return and the token's mana reminder had been.

kept.name: Diamond Knight
kept.why: "Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color" is a cast trigger on your own spells and nothing recorded that the counters have a trigger at all.

kept.name: Bloodthorn Flail
kept.why: It is an Equipment, so equipping attaches it (every other Equipment in this batch carries eff:attach), and its equip cost can be paid by discarding a card. Used cost:discard rather than cost:discard-self because the card discarded is any card from hand, not this one - cycling on Suffocating Fumes is the -self case.

kept.name: Ovalchase Daredevil
kept.why: The card returns ITSELF from the graveyard to your hand whenever an artifact enters. eff:return-from was recorded but not the fact that the card it brings back is itself, which is what makes it recursive fodder.

kept.name: Geometric Nexus
kept.why: The token ability costs {6}, {T}, Remove all charge counters. Both cost halves were unread; only the counters being added was.

kept.name: Faerie Macabre
kept.why: Its activation cost is discarding this card from hand - the reason it is graveyard hate you never have to cast - and it targets cards in graveyards.

kept.name: Nyxathid
kept.why: Its size is set by the number of cards in the chosen opponent's hand. Did not add eff:shrink: it shrinks only itself, and eff:shrink is read as removal.

kept.name: Kalastria Healer
kept.why: The rally trigger reads "whenever THIS creature or another Ally you control enters", so it fires on its own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Dross Harvester
kept.why: Only the controller loses life; the life GAIN on creatures dying is correctly recorded and left alone.

kept.name: Blood Clock
kept.why: Each player returns a permanent they control to hand unless they pay 2 life. The payment clause (eff:unless-pays) and the self-bounce (eff:bounce-own, a repeatable way to re-use your own enters-the-battlefield permanents) both produced no word at all.

kept.name: Martyr of Sands
kept.why: Revealing X white cards from your hand is part of the activation cost, and nothing recorded either the hand zone or the reveal cost.

kept.name: Leech Collector // Bloodletting
kept.why: The trigger is 'whenever you gain life for the first time each turn' and neither the trigger nor the lifegain-matters word was present. Nothing about prepared or the back face touches exile.

kept.name: Wanderer's Twig
kept.why: 'then shuffle' is a real clause and the shuffle was not recorded.

kept.name: Powerstone Shard
kept.why: The mana ability's cost is {T} and the tap cost was missing.

kept.name: Eyetwitch
kept.why: Learn includes 'discard a card to draw a card', so the card replaces itself on death. Nothing recorded any draw.

kept.name: Precipitous Drop
kept.why: The whole point of the Aura is that the enchanted creature gets -2/-2, or -5/-5 with a completed dungeon. No effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Nihilith
kept.why: The triggered ability removes a time counter from this card, which nothing recorded. cares:zone:hand comes only from the suspend reminder text 'rather than cast this card from your hand' and does not make this a hand-matters card.

kept.name: Vraska, Scheming Gorgon
kept.why: The ultimate grants deathtouch to your creatures and gives them an ability that makes a damaged opponent lose the game. Both clauses produced nothing.

kept.name: Famished Paladin
kept.why: 'Whenever you gain life, untap this creature' is a lifegain payoff and only the trigger was recorded, not that the card wants a lifegain deck.

kept.name: High Sentinels of Arashin
kept.why: 'This creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it' is a real static boost clause and produced no effect word.

kept.name: Bushmeat Poacher
kept.why: 'You gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness' was not recorded; only the draw half of the ability was.

kept.name: The Last Ride
kept.why: The card gets -X/-X where X is your life total. That is a penalty on itself, not a pump, and it can pump nothing. eff:shrink is deliberately not added in its place because the card cannot shrink an opposing creature and should not read as removal.

kept.name: Bold Plagiarist
kept.why: The mirrored counters are put on this creature, so by the -self convention the card grows itself. Only the generic word was present.

kept.name: Moira and Teshar
kept.why: The trigger is 'whenever YOU cast a historic spell', which is the spell-caster split of trig:cast and was not recorded.

kept.name: Shaman en-Kor
kept.why: The card carried NO effect word at all. Both abilities move damage from one creature to another, and the second one takes damage aimed at your creature onto itself, which is how the card keeps your creatures alive.

kept.name: Angelic Cub
kept.why: It triggers on becoming the target of a spell or ability, which is the targeting split of the cast trigger; only the bare trig:cast was there.

kept.name: Kraken's Eye
kept.why: It triggers only on BLUE spells and nothing recorded which colour it watches.

kept.name: Void Mirror
kept.why: The whole card is the condition 'if no colored mana was spent to cast it', and nothing recorded that it reads what mana was spent.

kept.name: Lich's Tomb
kept.why: 'Sacrifice a permanent for each 1 life you lost' is the entire downside of the card and produced no effect word.

kept.name: Shade's Form
kept.why: 'When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control' is a reanimation from the graveyard and a steal when the Aura is placed on an opponent's creature. Only the pump ability had been read.

kept.name: Elite Spellbinder
kept.why: It exiles a nonland card from the opponent's hand and taxes it {2} more to cast. Neither clause produced a word.

kept.name: Assassin's Ink
kept.why: 'This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control an artifact and {1} less if you control an enchantment' was entirely unread, the same shape the vocabulary already carries for self cost reduction.

kept.name: Unyielding Gatekeeper
kept.why: 'Exile another target nonland permanent. If you controlled it, return it to the battlefield tapped' is a blink of your own permanent, which is what eff:exile-own plus eff:return-from and the exile zone say. Only the one-way exile and the consolation token were recorded.

kept.name: Intervention Pact
kept.why: 'At the beginning of your next upkeep, pay {1}{W}{W}' is a delayed upkeep trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Riling Dawnbreaker // Signaling Roar
kept.why: The Omen half creates a 2/2 Soldier token and no effect word records it; tok:soldier is absent too but that prefix is printed data.

kept.name: Amorphous Axe
kept.why: +3/+0 was never written down, and "is every creature type" is the whole reason this card is played (it makes the wearer count as your tribe). grants:changeling is the only word for having all creature types.

kept.name: Crackdown Construct
kept.why: The list had no effect and no trigger: the card pumps itself off every non-mana activation. eff:pump covers the pump; the trigger has no word.

kept.name: Militia Bugler
kept.why: Nothing is exiled. It looks at four, takes one to hand and bottoms the rest, which is eff:look-and-pick (already present). eff:impulse means exiling off the top to play, and cares:zone:exile follows it wrongly.

kept.name: Long-Lost Lances
kept.why: It grants first strike as well as vigilance, and "creatures you control that are equipped" is a group effect like Oathsworn Giant's, which carries scope:all.

kept.name: Avarice Totem
kept.why: Exchange control is two directions. It steals a permanent (eff:gain-control, present) and hands the Totem over (eff:give-control, missing).

kept.name: Aurelia's Vindicator
kept.why: This is a removal spell on a body and carried no removal word: it exiles up to X creatures. Deliberately not adding eff:exile-graveyard - the graveyard clause is an optional rider on a board-removal effect and tagging a white lifelink Angel as graveyard hate would misfile it.

kept.name: Oath of Kaya
kept.why: The second ability triggers on an opponent attacking a planeswalker you control, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Tragedy Feaster
kept.why: The Infusion clause sacrifices a permanent every end step unless you gained life; no sacrifice word was present.

kept.name: Venerated Loxodon
kept.why: It counters up every creature that convoked it, so it is a mass effect on your board rather than a single target.

kept.name: Crooked Scales
kept.why: The ability costs {4} and {T} and the tap was missing. Losing the flip destroys a creature YOU control, which is exactly eff:destroy-own and is the card's whole risk.

kept.name: Happily Ever After
kept.why: The card wins the game outright at upkeep and that clause produced no word at all - the only reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Unhallowed Pact
kept.why: The Aura reanimates the creature it enchants when it dies; the list recorded the trigger and none of the effect.

kept.name: Chittering Skitterling
kept.why: "Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Draw a card" is a single sacrifice and a single draw. Nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Young Necromancer
kept.why: Exiling two cards from your graveyard is the price of the reanimation and no cost word recorded it.

kept.name: Chainer's Edict
kept.why: Flashback brings the card back from the graveyard. Elspeth, Sun's Nemesis in this same batch carries eff:recur-self for escape, so this is the same claim written down inconsistently.

kept.name: Reaping Willow
kept.why: Lifelink gains life (Mesa Unicorn is recorded that way), and the reanimation ability costs two counters off itself, which had no cost word.

kept.name: Endless Obedience
kept.why: Nothing in the text mentions black. Venerated Loxodon, the white convoke card in this batch, carries no matching colour word, so this is unsupported.

kept.name: Kayla's Command
kept.why: The counter mode also grants double strike, and "Choose two" is a modal spell. Nothing here touches more than one creature, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Avacyn, Guardian Angel
kept.why: Both activated abilities prevent all damage from a chosen colour and neither produced any effect word - the list described a vanilla flying vigilance body. Preventing all damage to a creature is also what keeps it alive.

kept.name: Blight Herder
kept.why: It makes three Eldrazi Scions and that was unrecorded; it also moves cards from exile to graveyards, which is the processor cost. There is no enters trigger on this card at all - the trigger is on cast, already present.

kept.name: Skyclave Shadowcat
kept.why: The second ability draws a card whenever a countered creature you control dies. Both the trigger and the draw were missing, so half the card was invisible.

kept.name: Sickening Dreams
kept.why: Discarding X is an additional cost to cast, not just an effect. X damage to each creature and each player is a symmetric sweeper that kills your own board, the Blasphemous Act shape.

kept.name: Liliana's Influence
kept.why: The tutor half produced nothing at all. The -1/-1 counters on each creature you don't control are one-sided mass shrinking, which is what makes this removal rather than a counters card. Correctly not scope:wipe, since it spares your board.

kept.name: Immortal Coil
kept.why: It prevents all damage dealt to you, and it makes you lose the game when your graveyard empties. Neither the payoff nor the drawback was recorded.

kept.name: Last Laugh
kept.why: It sacrifices itself when no creatures remain, the same shape Thran Quarry records with eff:sacrifice. Not marking scope:wipe: one instance is a single point of damage, not a board wipe.

kept.name: Slum Reaper
kept.why: The list had a trigger and no effect whatsoever. It is a symmetric edict hitting each player, so it sacrifices and it reaches everyone.

kept.name: Elspeth, Sun's Nemesis
kept.why: The -1 gives up to two creatures +2/+1 and no pump word was present.

kept.name: Spawning Pool
kept.why: The land turns itself into a 1/1 Skeleton, which is exactly eff:animate and was the only unrecorded ability on the card.

kept.name: Contested War Zone
kept.why: The control-change fires when a creature deals combat damage to you and the trigger event had no word, leaving eff:give-control attached to nothing.

kept.name: Citanul Flute
kept.why: It searches for one creature card and puts it in hand. Nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Demonmail Hauberk
kept.why: An Equipment pumping its single wearer, with one creature sacrificed to equip. Nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Moonlight Bargain
kept.why: You look at the top five and take the survivors into hand, which is the look-and-pick shape rather than a plain draw. eff:draw and eff:mill are already right.

kept.name: Netherborn Phalanx
kept.why: "Each opponent loses 1 life for each creature they control" is a mass drain, so scope:all (the same word Underhanded Designs and Dreg Recycler carry for the identical wording). Transmute's cost is "{1}{B}{B}, Discard this card", which is a discard-self cost. The transmute search reads the library, so cares:zone:library belongs with eff:search-library.

kept.name: Sinister Concoction
kept.why: "Discard a card" is one of the activation costs, not just an effect. It already carries eff:discard-self; the cost word is what tells the engine this is a discard outlet.

kept.name: Plague Engineer
kept.why: The entire card is "creatures of the chosen type your opponents control get -1/-1" and no facet recorded it. That is eff:shrink, and it hits every creature of the type rather than a target, so scope:all. Nothing recorded what this card DOES at all before.

kept.name: Stinging Hivemaster
kept.why: "When this creature dies, create a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite token" - the token creation was never written down, only the cares:sub:mite word scan from reading the token's name.

kept.name: Ordeal of Heliod
kept.why: "When you sacrifice this Aura, you gain 10 life" is a sacrifice trigger, and the counter clause sacrifices the Aura itself. Neither the trigger nor the sacrifice was recorded, so the payoff had no route to the gain-life.

kept.name: Dark Bargain
kept.why: The list held only eff:damage-self, which is the drawback. The card looks at the top three of your library, puts two in hand and one in the graveyard - a two-card draw and a self-mill. Compare Moonlight Bargain, which carries eff:draw and eff:mill for the same wording.

kept.name: Spreading Plague
kept.why: cares:color:c means colorless, and this card says "share a color with it" - a word scan on "color". Colorless creatures are the ones it never touches, so the word is exactly backwards. Left scope:wipe off deliberately: it is a colour-filtered destroy, not a whole-board wipe.

kept.name: MJ, Rising Star
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on MJ" is a lifegain payoff. trig:gains-life records the trigger; cares:lifegain is what makes it findable as a lifegain card.

kept.name: Lethal Throwdown
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" - the additional cost was not recorded at all, so nothing marks this as a sacrifice payoff.

kept.name: Spirit of Resistance
kept.why: "Prevent ALL damage that would be dealt to you" is blanket prevention, not a single prevention shield.

kept.name: Salt Road Skirmish
kept.why: "They gain haste until end of turn" and "Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step" are both unrecorded. The tokens are temporary, which is a real part of what this card is.

kept.name: Lockjaw Snapper
kept.why: "Put a -1/-1 counter on each creature with a -1/-1 counter on it" - the entire death trigger was missing. It puts counters on things, and on each of them rather than a target.

kept.name: Cinderhaze Wretch
kept.why: "Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: Untap this creature" - the counter is the activation cost of the untap, and only the untap was recorded.

kept.name: Celestial Crusader
kept.why: "Other WHITE creatures get +1/+1" is a mono-white anthem. The colour condition is the whole point of the card and no facet named it.

kept.name: Decimator Web
kept.why: "Gets a poison counter" - the list has the generic eff:add-counters and ctr:poison but not eff:poison, so nothing marks it as an infect or toxic payoff.

kept.name: Ichor Drinker
kept.why: The incubate ability is activated FROM the graveyard by exiling this card, and neither the graveyard zone nor the exile-self cost was recorded. A one-drop that keeps working from the yard reads as a plain lifelink creature without them.

kept.name: Nighthaze
kept.why: Swampwalk is evasion, not a power or toughness boost - the card gives no +N/+N at all, so eff:pump would offer it as a combat trick. grants:swampwalk and eff:draw already say what it does.

kept.name: Dig Up the Body
kept.why: Casualty 1 is "as you cast this spell, you may sacrifice a creature with power 1 or greater". eff:copy records the reward and nothing recorded that the card is a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Brain Maggot
kept.why: It exiles a nonland card from the opponent's hand; only eff:discard was recorded, and no discard actually happens. Kept eff:discard because the card is hand disruption in every practical sense, but the exile is what it literally does.

kept.name: Forbidden Crypt
kept.why: Two whole clauses unrecorded: "if you can't, you lose the game", and "if a card would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile that card instead". The second is why this card is dangerous and nothing said it exiles anything.

kept.name: Debt to the Kami
kept.why: Modal card, 'Choose one', with two different edict modes; nothing recorded that the caster picks a mode.

kept.name: Sanctifier en-Vec
kept.why: The ETB exiles all black or red cards from ALL graveyards, and the static replacement exiles anything black or red that would go to a graveyard. Hardest graveyard hate in the format and the list said nothing about graveyards. It carried cares:color:r while the card names black first, so cares:color:b was a plain omission.

kept.name: Hardened Escort
kept.why: Granting another creature you control indestructible until end of turn keeps it alive through removal. Ollenbock Escort in this same batch carries eff:protect for the identical grant.

kept.name: Foreboding Steamboat
kept.why: EACH PLAYER exiles two creatures, so scope:all. The attack trigger moves a card out of the exile zone into a graveyard, which is cares:zone:exile plus eff:move-zone. Investigate makes a Clue, which is card draw; Tolls of War in this batch carries eff:draw for the same Clue.

kept.name: Vampire Soulcaller
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' produced no word at all. The ETB returns a card from the graveyard to your HAND, which is the destination zone.

kept.name: Shield Mare
kept.why: The list had only eff:gain-life and the printed subtype. It has an enters trigger and it did not say so. 'Can't be blocked by red creatures' is conditional evasion and eff:cant-be-blocked is the only word for it.

kept.name: Desolation
kept.why: EACH PLAYER who tapped a land sacrifices one, and it damages EACH PLAYER who sacrificed a Plains. Symmetrical, not targeted.

kept.name: Cartouche of Ambition
kept.why: It is an Aura enchanting a creature you control. Twisted Embrace in this batch, also 'enchant creature you control', carries eff:attach.

kept.name: Bark of Doran
kept.why: It compares toughness against power and then assigns damage by toughness. Armored Armadillo in this batch carries cares:power for the same shape, 'where X is its toughness'.

kept.name: Disciple of Perdition
kept.why: A whole mode went unread. 'Exile target opponent's graveyard' is graveyard hate and produced no word. The card is also modal on death, sometimes both modes.

kept.name: Mark of the Vampire
kept.why: An Aura that pumps and grants lifelink is a voltron aura; it attaches to a creature. Twisted Embrace and Bark of Doran in this batch both carry eff:attach.

kept.name: Darkest Hour
kept.why: Making all creatures black is the enabler for every black-matters payoff, so the card genuinely cares about black.

kept.name: Risen Executioner
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' produced no word.

kept.name: Scream Puff
kept.why: The Food token's printed reminder is '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life'. Food Coma in this batch carries eff:gain-life for the same token.

kept.name: Olivia's Dragoon
kept.why: A repeatable free discard outlet, which is what madness and hellbent decks want it for. Patchwork Gnomes in this batch carries cares:zone:hand for the identical 'Discard a card:' cost.

kept.name: Patchwork Gnomes
kept.why: Regeneration keeps the creature alive, which is what eff:protect names; the tagger already reads 'regenerate' as protection elsewhere. The list recorded the cost and nothing the ability does.

kept.name: Food Coma
kept.why: It exiles a creature an opponent controls and carried NO removal word at all. It read as a token maker that gains life, so no deck would ever choose it as an answer.

kept.name: Noble Purpose
kept.why: 'You gain that much life' is the whole card and it was not recorded. The list had only the trigger and the type.

kept.name: Romana II
kept.why: It creates a token that is a COPY of a token, and copying was unrecorded. The ability also costs {1} and {T}; Nuisance Engine in this batch carries cost:tap for the same '{2}, {T}:' shape.

kept.name: Era of Enlightenment // Hand of Enlightenment
kept.why: Chapter III exiles the Saga itself and returns it transformed. Neither the self-exile nor the transform was recorded, so the half of the card that turns into a creature was invisible.

kept.name: Soul of Innistrad
kept.why: WRONG. eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand. This returns creature CARDS from the graveyard, which eff:return-from already says correctly. As written it would be offered as a blink or self-bounce enabler.

kept.name: Plague Mare
kept.why: 'Can't be blocked by white creatures' is conditional evasion and produced no word.

kept.name: Damping Matrix
kept.why: The card's ENTIRE text is a ban on activated abilities and it carried only col:none, scope:all and its type. The stax effect was completely unread.

kept.name: Gustcloak Savior
kept.why: Pulling a blocked creature out of combat saves it from lethal damage, which is what eff:protect names. The list recorded the untap and not the effect.

kept.name: Tolls of War
kept.why: 'Whenever you sacrifice a permanent during your turn' had no trigger word. Kingpin, Wilson Fisk in this batch carries trig:sacrificed for the identical shape.

kept.name: Syndic of Tithes
kept.why: Extort is "whenever YOU cast a spell", so the trigger is trig:cast-own, not the bare trig:cast. And the drain only happens if you pay {W/B}, which is exactly the do-if-cost-paid shape.

kept.name: Shredder's Revenge
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and nothing recorded that the caster picks between two different effects.

kept.name: Search for Dagger
kept.why: It digs six cards deep into your library, which nothing recorded. The trigger is on your COMMANDER entering, a different permanent from this enchantment, so it is trig:enters-other.

kept.name: Regna, the Redeemer
kept.why: Partner with is an enters trigger on Regna herself and no enters trigger was recorded at all. It also tutors Krav out of the library and shuffles.

kept.name: Invisible Force Field
kept.why: Giving four of your permanents indestructible in response is a protection trick, which is the whole card and the only reason it is played.

kept.name: The Thanos-Copter
kept.why: "Vehicles you control become artifact creatures" is a mass animation and none of that was recorded. Crew 2 is paid by tapping other creatures, the same as Grond's cost:tap-others.

kept.name: Summoner's Egg
kept.why: The whole card was unread past its triggers: it exiles a card from HAND face down and later returns it from EXILE to the battlefield. Deliberately not adding eff:exile, because the exiled card is your own and that word would file this as removal.

kept.name: Stave Off
kept.why: Protection from a chosen colour is how this keeps a creature alive; only the keyword grant was recorded.

kept.name: Pyromancer's Gauntlet
kept.why: It only boosts RED instants, sorceries and planeswalkers, so it genuinely cares about the colour, not merely the card types.

kept.name: Basilica Guards
kept.why: Same extort reading as Syndic of Tithes: the trigger is on your own casts, and the drain is conditional on paying {W/B}.

kept.name: April O'Neil, Kunoichi Trainee
kept.why: "Can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater" reads the blocker's power, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Break Ties
kept.why: It is a three-mode modal spell and nothing said so. Reinforce is paid by discarding this card, the same shape Pest Control's cycling already carries.

kept.name: Corrupted Grafstone
kept.why: The mana ability costs {T} and no tap cost was recorded. Choosing a colour off a graveyard card is the same choice shape Stave Off carries.

kept.name: Profane Procession // Tomb of the Dusk Rose
kept.why: Both back-face abilities cost {T}, the front face transforms itself, and the payoff puts a creature EXILED WITH IT onto the battlefield UNDER YOUR CONTROL. That last clause is a theft engine and none of it was recorded.

kept.name: Noetic Scales
kept.why: The card carried NO effect word at all. It bounces every creature whose power exceeds its controller's hand size, symmetrically across all players.

kept.name: Apocalypse Demon
kept.why: The upkeep trigger taps this creature unless you sacrifice another one, and neither the self-tap nor the sacrifice outlet was recorded. The sacrifice clause is the reason this card is played in aristocrats decks.

kept.name: Solid Footing
kept.why: "As long as enchanted creature has vigilance" is a genuine keyword check and the second half of the card was unread.

kept.name: Antiquities on the Loose
kept.why: The flashback payoff puts a +1/+1 counter on EACH Spirit you control, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Rite of Belzenlok
kept.why: Every chapter of this Saga creates tokens, two Clerics twice and then a 6/6 Demon, and the card carried no eff:create-token at all. Only the token's drawback clause had been read.

kept.name: Lieutenants of the Guard
kept.why: Half the council's dilemma makes 1/1 Soldier tokens and only the counter half was recorded.

kept.name: Myr Incubator
kept.why: The card searches your library for artifacts and creates that many Myr tokens, and neither was recorded; only the shuffle at the end had been read.

kept.name: Great Hall of Starnheim
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything. It sacrifices itself plus one creature and makes one token. scope:all would read it as a mass effect.

kept.name: Sweettooth Witch
kept.why: One Food token, one sacrifice, one target player loses 2 life. There is no mass effect for scope:all to describe.

kept.name: Raven's Crime
kept.why: Retrace is paid by discarding a LAND card from hand, which is a discard cost distinct from cost:discard-self and is the reason the card is played.

kept.name: Forum Necroscribe
kept.why: Ward is a tax the opponent pays or loses their spell, which is the eff:unless-pays shape. Nothing on this card affects everything, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Crovax, Ascendant Hero
kept.why: Red is never mentioned; this looks like a scan of "Nonwhite". The card cares about WHITE, and the -1/-1 half was completely unread, which is the half that makes it a one-sided sweeper.

kept.name: Gonti's Machinations
kept.why: "Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn" is the engine that charges the card and no trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Peacekeeper
kept.why: The card carried no effect word. "Creatures can't attack" is the entire point of it, and the upkeep trigger sacrifices itself unless you pay.

kept.name: Grond, the Gatebreaker
kept.why: It turns itself into an artifact creature while you control an Army, on top of crew, and no animation was recorded.

kept.name: Gibbering Descent
kept.why: Hellbent skips your upkeep step, which was unread, and the upkeep drain hits EACH player symmetrically.

kept.name: Nurturing Presence
kept.why: The granted ability pumps the enchanted creature whenever another creature you control enters, and neither the pump nor that trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Tiller of Flesh
kept.why: Incubate 2 off a cast trigger affects nothing globally; "one or more permanents" is a targeting clause, not a mass effect.

kept.name: Truce
kept.why: EACH player may draw two, so this is symmetric draw rather than the one-sided eff:draw already recorded.

kept.name: Canonized in Blood
kept.why: Descend checks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard, so the card genuinely reads the graveyard and nothing said so.

kept.name: Damocles Base, Sword of Kang
kept.why: The villainous choice's second branch is "they lose 2 life and you draw two cards". The life loss is recorded and the draw is not.

kept.name: Fifty Feet of Rope
kept.why: All three abilities include {T} in their cost and no tap cost was recorded. The Tie Up ability's "doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step" has no word at all.

kept.name: Whispersteel Dagger
kept.why: Nothing returns to any zone. It lets you CAST a creature spell out of the damaged player's graveyard, which is exactly eff:cast-from-graveyard; eff:return-from claims a reanimation/regrowth effect the card does not have.

kept.name: Staff of the Flame Magus
kept.why: The one trigger has two halves and only the bare trig:cast was written down. It fires on a spell YOU cast (trig:cast-own), specifically a RED one (cares:color:r), and equally on a Mountain you control entering, which is another permanent entering (trig:enters / trig:enters-other).

kept.name: Angel of Grace
kept.why: Both abilities were unread. The enters trigger is a damage replacement that stops your life falling below 1 (eff:prevent-damage), and the graveyard ability sets your life total to 10 (eff:set-life) by exiling this card from the graveyard as a cost (cost:exile-self, cares:zone:graveyard).

kept.name: Razor Rings
kept.why: It deals 4 damage to a creature and only the lifegain rider was recorded. The damage is the whole spell.

kept.name: Invasion of Eldraine // Prickle Faeries
kept.why: The back face triggers at the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, and the trigger is conditional on that player having two or fewer cards in hand. Neither the step trigger nor the hand-size condition was written down.

kept.name: Brotherhood Ambushers
kept.why: The card has no triggered ability of any kind. Freerunning is an alternative cost checking whether combat damage was already dealt this turn; nothing happens when this creature attacks, so a trigger word misdescribes it.

kept.name: Lost Auramancers
kept.why: Nothing here touches every permanent or every player. It is a single death trigger that tutors one enchantment; scope:all reads as a mass effect and would let a sweeper check or a group-affecting rule pick this up.

kept.name: Origin of the Avengers
kept.why: Chapter II puts a Hero creature card from your HAND straight onto the battlefield, which is precisely eff:put-onto-battlefield and is the chapter's main line. The hand is the zone it reads.

kept.name: The Witch's Vanity
kept.why: Two of the three chapters create tokens - a Food and a Wicked Role - and the card carried no token-making word at all. The Role token arrives attached to a creature you control (eff:attach).

kept.name: The Masters of Evil
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is discarding this card (cost:discard-self), which was unrecorded, and the effect digs through your library for a Plan card (cares:zone:library) alongside the eff:search-library already present.

kept.name: Radiant's Judgment
kept.why: It can only destroy a creature with power 4 or greater, so it reads a creature's power to decide legality. cares:power is the word for that and is absent.

kept.name: Dearly Departed
kept.why: The static ability applies to EACH Human creature you control as it enters - other creatures, not this one - so it wants trig:enters-other beside the bare trig:enters, and it affects a whole group of your permanents rather than one target.

kept.name: Madame Masque
kept.why: Connive is a draw and a discard and neither was recorded, though the +1/+1 counter it can leave behind was. The second ability triggers whenever you draw your second card each turn (trig:draws-card), which is the card's whole payoff and was missing.

kept.name: Invasion of Belenon // Belenon War Anthem
kept.why: The back face is an anthem - creatures you control get +1/+1 - and the whole of it was unread. Only the front face's token had a word.

kept.name: Oppressive Rays
kept.why: This is a Pacifism variant: the enchanted creature cannot attack or block unless its controller pays {3}. The tax words were recorded but the two restrictions that make it removal were not.

kept.name: Dynavolt Tower
kept.why: The damage ability costs {T} plus five energy and no tap cost was written down.

kept.name: Jo Grant
kept.why: The static ability grants cycling to each historic card in your HAND; the hand is the zone this card operates on and it was not recorded.

kept.name: Benalish Commander
kept.why: The token-making trigger fires only while this card is EXILED under suspend, so exile is a zone it genuinely cares about.

kept.name: Page, Loose Leaf
kept.why: The whole grandeur ability was unread. Its cost is discarding another card (cost:discard, not -self, since the discarded card is a second copy), and its effect digs through your library revealing until it finds an instant or sorcery and takes it (eff:look-and-pick, cares:zone:library).

kept.name: The Biblioplex
kept.why: The second ability looks at the top card of your library and may put it in your hand. The card carried the mana ability only; the digging effect had no word.

kept.name: Veiled Ascension
kept.why: Every effect on this card was unread. It puts flying counters on EACH face-down creature you control (eff:add-counters, scope:all), those counters give flying (grants:flying), and it keeps doing so as further face-down creatures of yours enter (trig:enters-other).

kept.name: Liliana, the Necromancer
kept.why: Nothing on this planeswalker returns a permanent from the battlefield to hand. The -1 returns a creature CARD from the graveyard to hand, which eff:return-from already covers correctly; eff:bounce-own would file her as a blink or self-bounce payoff she has nothing to do with.

kept.name: Hercules, Olympian Hero
kept.why: The attack trigger also gives him indestructible until end of turn, and the second ability triggers when he is dealt damage for the first time each turn. Only the counters half of the card was read.

kept.name: Serpent's Soul-Jar
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all, only its trigger. Dying Elves are moved from the graveyard to exile (eff:move-zone - deliberately not eff:exile, which would file this as removal, nor eff:exile-graveyard, which is hate and would mark it as working AGAINST the graveyard deck it belongs in), and the activated ability costs a tap and 2 life while reading the cards it has exiled.

kept.name: Boneyard Mycodrax
kept.why: Scavenge is "{4}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard" - it eats itself out of the graveyard as an activation cost, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Saltskitter
kept.why: Only the exile half was read. It returns itself from exile to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step, which is a delayed end-step trigger and a return from exile.

kept.name: Umbilicus
kept.why: The list held only the trigger timing and said nothing about what the card does. It is a pay-2-life-or-bounce tax: the pay-or-else shape is eff:unless-pays and returning a permanent to its owner's hand is a zone move.

kept.name: Scrib Nibblers
kept.why: The tap ability was entirely unread. It exiles the top card of a target player's library and gains you 1 life if it is a land; only the landfall untap was recorded.

kept.name: Throne of the Grim Captain // The Grim Captain
kept.why: Craft exiles this artifact plus four permanents or graveyard cards as a cost and returns the card transformed. The back face's attack trigger and the put-an-exiled-creature-onto-the-battlefield half were both missing.

kept.name: Rime Transfusion
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +2/+1 and no pump was recorded; only the conditional unblockable ability was read.

kept.name: Aggressive Negotiations
kept.why: It exiles a nonland card out of the opponent's revealed hand. Only the +1/+1 counter clause was read.

kept.name: Too Evil to Stay Dead
kept.why: Teamwork 4 is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, so the precise word is the cast variant. cost:tap-others is left in place because it is not wrong, but on its own it reads as an activated-ability cost.

kept.name: Necroplasm
kept.why: "Destroy each creature with mana value equal to the number of +1/+1 counters" hits every creature on the board, yours included. Not scope:wipe: it is filtered by mana value, which this project's own rule keeps out of the wipe word.

kept.name: Gloomfang Mauler
kept.why: Backup 2 is an enters-the-battlefield trigger and nothing recorded one. Swampcycling discards this card as a cost to search the library. Deliberately NOT cares:zone:library-land: it fetches to HAND, so treating it as land ramp would be wrong.

kept.name: Thunderbolts Conspiracy
kept.why: The whole payoff was unread. It reanimates the Villain from the graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it; only the dies trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Blood Funnel
kept.why: The card carried no effect word at all. It makes your noncreature spells cost {2} less and counters them unless you sacrifice. Not eff:unless-pays, which is glossed as taxing the OPPONENT - this taxes you.

kept.name: Bloodcrazed Socialite
kept.why: The attack trigger's payoff was missing: sacrifice a Blood token and it gets +2/+2. Not cost:sacrifice, which means an on-demand outlet; this only eats a token on attack.

kept.name: Demon's Due
kept.why: With the direction word removed it reads as what it is - a draw spell. Keeping eff:lose-life would keep asserting it drains someone else.

kept.name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
kept.why: "Arcane spells you cast cost {1} less to cast" is half the card and no cost-reduction word was recorded.

kept.name: Eidolon of Astral Winds
kept.why: The constellation payoff was entirely unread: base power and toughness 4/4 plus flying. The trigger also fires on this creature's own arrival, not only on other enchantments.

kept.name: Detention Chariot
kept.why: The main ability - exile an opponent's artifact or creature until this leaves - was missing entirely; only the cycling draw was read. Crew 3 taps other creatures as a cost, and the exile is undone by a leaves-the-battlefield trigger.

kept.name: Urza's Sylex
kept.why: "Destroy all other permanents" is a symmetric board wipe and was recorded only as eff:destroy. Its costs (tap, exile itself), its leaves-the-battlefield trigger and the optional pay-{2} tutor rider were all unread.

kept.name: Susurian Dirgecraft
kept.why: No enters trigger was recorded for the ETB edict. Station puts charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to the tapped creature's power, so it both grows itself and genuinely scales with power.

kept.name: Wispmare
kept.why: Evoke means it is sacrificed when it enters - it eats only itself, once, which is what cost:sacrifice-self records.

kept.name: Cabal Therapy
kept.why: The flashback cost is an alternative CAST cost paid by sacrificing a creature. cost:sacrifice is kept as well because in practice this is used as a repeatable sacrifice outlet from the graveyard.

kept.name: Barbed Spike
kept.why: It creates a 1/1 Thopter token and then attaches to it. The attach was recorded and the token creation was not.

kept.name: Soul Swindler
kept.why: "This creature has indestructible" while you have visited an Attraction, and nothing in the list said the card is hard to kill. Follows the corpus convention (Primaris Chaplain records a self-gain of indestructible the same way).

kept.name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
kept.why: Commander creatures you control get +1/+1. The lifelink grant was recorded and the anthem was not.

kept.name: Copper Tablet
kept.why: It triggers on EACH player's upkeep, so it damages you on your own turn as well. That drawback is a real fact about the card and was invisible.

kept.name: Makindi Patrol
kept.why: The rally trigger reads "whenever this creature OR another Ally you control enters", so it fires on its own arrival too; only the other-creature half was recorded.

kept.name: Clay Revenant
kept.why: "{2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is exactly self-recursion. The generic eff:return-from cannot say the card brings ITSELF back, which is the whole reason to play it.

kept.name: Doom Foretold
kept.why: The failure clause creates a 2/2 white Knight token and no token-making word was recorded, though tok:knight-adjacent care was.

kept.name: Warehouse Tabby
kept.why: The trigger is an enchantment you control being put into a GRAVEYARD from the battlefield; the graveyard zone was not recorded.

kept.name: Farsight Mask
kept.why: The card had a draw effect with no trigger attached. It fires whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you.

kept.name: Distorting Lens
kept.why: Its only ability is a {T} activation and the tap cost was not recorded, so the card carried no cost and no effect.

kept.name: Necrosquito
kept.why: It triggers on another creature or artifact you control being put into a GRAVEYARD from the battlefield; the graveyard zone was missing.

kept.name: Buzzard-Wasp Colony
kept.why: The ETB is an optional sacrifice that pays off with a card, and the dies trigger moves the dead creature's counters onto THIS creature - neither the pay-for-more shape nor the self-counter growth was recorded.

kept.name: Line Cutter
kept.why: "Roll to visit your Attractions" is a die roll, which is what eff:random covers. The card otherwise had no effect word at all.

kept.name: Warden of the Inner Sky
kept.why: With three or more counters it has flying and vigilance, and nothing in the list said so - neither a printed keyword nor a grant. Recorded as grants:* to match the corpus convention for a self-gain (Primaris Chaplain, Susurian Dirgecraft).

kept.name: You're Confronted by Robbers
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and eff:choose (lets you choose what they do) is exactly that. The list records both modes and not the fact that you pick between them.

kept.name: Gate to Phyrexia
kept.why: It destroys TARGET artifact, one thing, once per turn. Nothing here affects everything, so scope:all is a word-scan artefact and it would tell the engine this is a mass effect.

kept.name: Sun-Blessed Healer
kept.why: Lifelink gains you life, and the engine already pairs kw:lifelink with eff:gain-life on Vish Kal and Hidden Dragonslayer, so this list is inconsistent with its own convention. Kicker is the textbook "gives more if you pay": the reanimation clause only happens if it was kicked.

kept.name: Enduring Ideal
kept.why: "then shuffle" is unrecorded. Epic gives a real upkeep trigger - "At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, copy this spell" - and the copy is recorded while the trigger that causes it is not. I deliberately did NOT add eff:cant-cast: the epic restriction stops YOUR spells, and that word means stopping an opponent's, which would file this as a Silence effect.

kept.name: No Rest for the Wicked
kept.why: It returns ALL creature cards in your graveyard that died this turn, not a target. That is a mass effect and matches how scope:all is used on Avenge and Dauntless Veteran.

kept.name: Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes
kept.why: Lifelink. Same inconsistency as Sun-Blessed Healer: the engine writes eff:gain-life beside kw:lifelink on other cards in this batch and omitted it here.

kept.name: Avenge
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast if a player attacked you" is a cost reduction and is completely unrecorded. This is the same shape as Ghalta, whose whole card is a self cost reduction.

kept.name: Forbidding Spirit
kept.why: The entire card is unread - the list has no eff: word at all. It is a Ghostly Prison: creatures cannot attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each, which is eff:unless-pays (taxes the opponent), and it applies to every attacking creature, not a target.

kept.name: Head of the Hunt
kept.why: eff:exile-graveyard means exiling cards that are already in a graveyard, and this card never touches a graveyard - it replaces death with exile before the card gets there. It genuinely exiles creatures, so eff:exile, and "if a creature an opponent controls would die" is a death trigger, which is what makes the Wolf.

kept.name: Endless Ranks of HYDRA
kept.why: The card's first line creates a Villain token per opponent and eff:create-token is missing entirely. "Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is eff:recur-self, which the generic eff:return-from does not say, and it happens only if you pay {1}{B}.

kept.name: Bridge from Below
kept.why: "Exile this card" is the second half of the card and is unrecorded. It is the drawback the whole card is balanced around.

kept.name: Evolved Sleeper
kept.why: The third ability draws a card and nothing records it. Both the first two abilities set base power and toughness (2/2, then 3/3), which is eff:set-pt, not a counter effect.

kept.name: Ghostblade Eidolon
kept.why: Bestow makes this an Aura with enchant creature, so it attaches to a creature. Fear, an ordinary Aura in this batch, carries eff:attach; a bestow creature does the same thing and does not.

kept.name: Scurrilous Sentry
kept.why: Connive is spelled out in the reminder text as draw a card, then discard a card. Only the +1/+1 counter half was read; the draw and the discard are both missing.

kept.name: Unswerving Sloth
kept.why: It gains indestructible when it attacks saddled - kw:indestructible is a printed keyword it does NOT have, so the granting is what is true and it is unrecorded. "Untap all creatures you control" is a mass untap, not a target.

kept.name: Ojutai Exemplars
kept.why: "Choose one —" is modal and unrecorded. Nothing on this card affects everything: the three modes are tap a target, pump itself, and blink itself, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Thopter Squadron
kept.why: Removing a +1/+1 counter is the activation cost of the token ability and only the counter-adding half was read. Nothing here is a mass effect - one token, one counter, one sacrifice - so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Living Brain, Mechanical Marvel
kept.why: The card's only ability turns an artifact into a creature, and eff:animate is missing while only the trailing "Untap it" was read. "Base power and toughness 3/3" is eff:set-pt.

kept.name: Black Poplar Shaman
kept.why: Regenerating a target Treefolk is keeping a creature alive, which is what eff:protect means. The list carries the printed keyword and no effect word at all, so nothing can find this card as protection.

kept.name: Robot Domination
kept.why: The payoff of the whole card is three Robot Villain tokens and eff:create-token is missing. The trigger puts a plan counter on itself each time, and it fires when creature cards are put into your graveyard, which includes them dying - only the draw was read.

kept.name: Static Snare
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each attacking creature" is a cost reduction and is unrecorded.

kept.name: Cloudkill
kept.why: All creatures get -X/-X, yours included, off a commander's mana value, which in Commander is routinely lethal to the whole board. Shefet Archfiend in this same batch carries scope:wipe for a smaller -2/-2 that spares itself; this one spares nothing.

kept.name: Ribskiff
kept.why: Crew 3 taps other creatures you control as its cost. Demolition Stomper and Unswerving Sloth both carry cost:tap-others for crew and saddle in this batch, so this one is simply missing it.

kept.name: Hallowed Burial
kept.why: Puts ALL creatures on the bottom of libraries, including your own. That is a one-sided-in-name-only board sweep and the engine needs to know it hits your board, exactly as it does for -X/-X sweepers. scope:all alone does not say 'this kills your own creatures too'.

kept.name: Angelic Armaments
kept.why: The list carried only eff:attach and stopped. Equipped creature gets +2/+2 (a pump) and has flying (a grant). Both clauses were unread.

kept.name: Candy Grapple
kept.why: Bargain is an additional cost to CAST: sacrifice an artifact, enchantment or token. And '-5/-5 instead if bargained' is the pay-more-get-more shape eff:do-if-cost-paid exists for. Only the shrink was read.

kept.name: One-Eyed Scarecrow
kept.why: -1/-0 makes creatures SMALLER, it does not pump them; eff:pump here tells the ranker this is a creature-buff card when it is a flying hoser. It also genuinely cares about the flying keyword, which is the whole of what it does.

kept.name: Horror of the Broken Lands
kept.why: 'Gets +2/+1 until end of turn' was never recorded, so the card reads as a cycling body with no payoff at all.

kept.name: Writhing Necromass
kept.why: 'This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard' is a cost reduction and was entirely unread - the same shape recorded for Ghalta, where the card's whole text is the discount.

kept.name: Sold Out
kept.why: It creates a Clue token and the token verb is missing; eff:draw was recorded from the Clue's reminder text while the thing that MAKES the Clue was not.

kept.name: Boneyard Desecrator
kept.why: Sacrificing one other creature and making one Treasure affects nothing globally. scope:all is a word scan artefact and would read this as a mass effect.

kept.name: Knight of Doves
kept.why: 'An enchantment you control' is a single permanent you own, not everything. Nothing on this card is global.

kept.name: Settle Beyond Reality
kept.why: 'Choose one or both' is a modal spell and the modality itself was unrecorded.

kept.name: Blinkmoth Well
kept.why: A land whose only mana symbol is {C}, with no coloured pip anywhere: its colour identity is empty. Every other colourless permanent in this batch carries col:none and this one was missed.

kept.name: Daily Bugle Reporters
kept.why: 'When this creature enters, choose one' - a modal ETB, and the choice was not recorded.

kept.name: Compass Gnome
kept.why: 'reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top' - the shuffle clause was dropped.

kept.name: Walker of the Wastes
kept.why: 'Gets +1/+1 for each land you control named Wastes' is its entire non-keyword text and produced no verb at all - the card read as a vanilla trampler.

kept.name: Journeyer's Kite
kept.why: The shuffle at the end of the search was unread. scope:all is wrong: fetching one basic land to your own hand touches nothing but you.

kept.name: Ruinous Waterbending
kept.why: Two whole clauses unread. 'If this spell's additional cost was paid' is the pay-more-get-more shape, and 'whenever a creature dies this turn, you gain 1 life' is a dies trigger the spell creates. scope:wipe is correct and kept - all creatures get -2/-2 including yours.

kept.name: Serum Powder
kept.why: Everything but the mana ability was unread. It exiles your whole hand and draws that many cards, which is the reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Nezumi Shortfang // Stabwhisker the Odious
kept.why: 'Flip this creature' turns it to its other face, and the back face's whole ability is an each-opponent's-upkeep trigger. Neither the flip nor the timing was recorded, so the back face's drain reads as having no trigger.

kept.name: Vision, Synthezoid Avenger
kept.why: 'Choose one' on every off-turn cast is a modal trigger and the modality was unrecorded.

kept.name: Underworld Sentinel
kept.why: This exiles from YOUR OWN graveyard and returns the cards later - it is a reanimator engine, not graveyard hate. eff:exile-graveyard is the hate word and marking this card with it puts a graveyard payoff on the wrong side of the anti-synergy check. It does care about the exile zone, since it tracks cards exiled with it.

kept.name: Witchbane Orb
kept.why: 'You have hexproof' is the reason the card exists and no grant was recorded - only the Curse destruction was read.

kept.name: Neglected Heirloom // Ashmouth Blade
kept.why: The back face grants first strike, unrecorded, and 'transform this Equipment' is a real transform effect rather than only a thing it cares about.

kept.name: Bottomless Vault
kept.why: The mana ability's costs were unread: it taps and removes storage counters. Without them the card looks like a land that adds mana for free.

kept.name: Wedding Security
kept.why: 'Sacrifice a Blood token' is a sacrifice cost paid on each attack; eff:do-if-cost-paid records the payoff but nothing recorded the cost itself.

kept.name: Sentinel Totem
kept.why: Only the scry was read. 'Exile all graveyards' is the card - genuine, symmetric graveyard hate, paid for by tapping and exiling itself.

kept.name: Fortress Kin-Guard
kept.why: Endure 1 is a choice between a +1/+1 counter and a 1/1 Spirit token; only the counter half was recorded, so the token mode is invisible.

kept.name: Raving Dead
kept.why: 'Choose an opponent at random' each combat is a randomness effect and was not recorded.

kept.name: Heron of Hope
kept.why: 'If you would gain life, you gain that much plus 1' is a lifegain payoff and results in gaining life; neither was recorded, so a lifegain card carried no lifegain word at all. eff:pump is wrong - nothing here changes power or toughness, the activated ability grants lifelink and grants:lifelink already says so.

kept.name: Moonlit Lamenter
kept.why: The entire activated ability was unread: it removes a counter to draw a card. The list recorded only that it enters with a -1/-1 counter, so a repeatable draw engine looked like a blank body.

kept.name: Barrenton Medic
kept.why: Both abilities were unread except the untap. The first is a damage prevention ability with a tap cost; the second pays a -1/-1 counter onto itself as an activation cost (cost:add-counters), which is how it untaps.

kept.name: Merciless Enforcers
kept.why: The activated ability hits each opponent, not one target, which is the symmetric-reach signal every other 'each opponent' card in this batch carries.

kept.name: Magus of the Abyss
kept.why: It triggers on each player's upkeep and destroys a creature that player controls, so it is a recurring edict aimed at everybody rather than a single removal spell.

kept.name: Wall of Souls
kept.why: 'Whenever this creature is dealt combat damage' is the whole trigger of the card and no trigger word was recorded, so the damage looked unconditional.

kept.name: Blessed Breath
kept.why: Protection from a colour keeps the creature alive (eff:protect); it changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is a false read of the word 'gains'.

kept.name: Nether Void
kept.why: The counter is conditional on the caster declining to pay {3}. Without eff:unless-pays it reads as a hard counter on every spell rather than a tax.

kept.name: Marsh Flitter
kept.why: The second ability was entirely unread: it is a sacrifice outlet (sacrifice a Goblin as an activation cost) and it sets base power and toughness to 3/3.

kept.name: Journey to Oblivion
kept.why: Nothing at all was recorded about what the card does. It exiles a nonland permanent an opponent controls, and its own cost reduction per party member is a cost reducer in the same sense Ghalta's is.

kept.name: Answered Prayers
kept.why: The second half turns the enchantment itself into a 3/3 Angel creature, which is an animation and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Fight or Flight
kept.why: The timing was unread. It fires at the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn and separates all creatures that player controls, so it is a repeating symmetric attack restriction rather than a one-shot.

kept.name: Benalish Sleeper
kept.why: The kicked trigger makes each player sacrifice a creature, an edict, and none of that was written down. The whole effect is gated on paying the kicker, which is exactly the do-if-cost-paid shape.

kept.name: Carrion
kept.why: The sacrifice is an additional cost to CAST the spell, not an on-demand outlet. cost:sacrifice would file it alongside Ashnod's Altar, which it is not.

kept.name: Ulcerate
kept.why: 'You lose 3 life' is a drawback to the caster, the opposite of what eff:lose-life tells the engine.

kept.name: Contested Game Ball
kept.why: The Treasure token at the end of the activated ability was unrecorded, as was the trigger condition: it changes hands whenever you are dealt combat damage.

kept.name: Sky Crier
kept.why: It has lifelink, which every other lifelink card in this batch records as eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Dust of Moments
kept.why: It is a modal spell (choose one), and either mode touches each permanent and each suspended card rather than a target.

kept.name: The Filigree Sylex
kept.why: Two of the three abilities sacrifice the Sylex as a cost and one removes ten oil counters from among your permanents as a cost; neither cost was recorded. The middle ability destroys each nonland permanent at that mana value, so it reaches everything, though the mana-value restriction keeps it short of a true board wipe.

kept.name: Hundred-Handed One
kept.why: Monstrosity 3 puts three +1/+1 counters on it, which was unrecorded, and while monstrous it has reach.

kept.name: Elite Interceptor // Rejoinder
kept.why: The spell half reads 'tap OR untap target creature' and only the tap was recorded.

kept.name: Sautekh Immortal
kept.why: It counts creatures that died this turn, so it is a payoff for creatures dying and belongs with graveyard-and-sacrifice cards; nothing in its list said so.

kept.name: Cuombajj Witches
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and the tap cost was missing, which matters because it is the whole limit on how often the pinging happens.

kept.name: Postmortem Professor
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' is a printed drawback on itself and was not written down.

kept.name: Remember the Fallen
kept.why: It is modal - choose one or both - and the choice was unrecorded.

kept.name: Patrol Signaler
kept.why: {Q} is the untap SYMBOL, so untapping is the activation cost (cost:untap, already present). The card untaps nothing as an effect.

kept.name: Deconstruction Hammer
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +1/+1, which was unrecorded, and the granted ability sacrifices the Hammer itself to destroy the artifact or enchantment.

kept.name: Bound in Gold
kept.why: It leaves the permanent on the battlefield but takes away attacking, blocking, crewing and every non-mana activated ability, which is precisely a Pacifism-style neutralisation and is what makes this card removal rather than a blank aura.

kept.name: Elspeth's Smite
kept.why: The second sentence replaces the creature dying with exiling it, so this answers a recursive or indestructible-adjacent threat and the exile was unrecorded.

kept.name: Hagra Diabolist
kept.why: The trigger reads 'whenever this creature OR another Ally you control enters', so it fires on its own arrival too; only the other-permanent half was recorded.

kept.name: Sorcerous Spyglass
kept.why: Looking at the opponent's hand and naming the card happens as the artifact enters, and nothing recorded that the card does anything on arrival.

kept.name: Lumbering Battlement
kept.why: Everything the card does was unread. It exiles your own nontoken creatures until it leaves, which is a blink, and it grows by +2/+2 for each card exiled with it.

kept.name: Repair and Recharge
kept.why: It creates a tapped Powerstone token and only the mana that token makes was recorded, never the token itself.

kept.name: Harsh Annotation
kept.why: The token is created by the destroyed creature's CONTROLLER, so it is compensation handed to the opponent, not a token your deck makes. Recorded this way it files a removal spell into a tokens deck.

kept.name: Promise of Tomorrow
kept.why: Only the triggers were read. It exiles your own creatures as they die and then returns every card exiled with it to the battlefield, which is a mass reanimation out of exile and the whole point of the card.

kept.name: Along the Crooked Way
kept.why: The second ability triggers whenever a creature card leaves your graveyard, and nothing recorded that trigger at all.

kept.name: Blighted Blackthorn
kept.why: Read only as far as the trigger. Blight 2 puts two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control, and if you do it you draw a card. Both the counters and the draw were missing.

kept.name: Curse of Conformity
kept.why: It is not a targeted effect: every nonlegendary creature that player controls is set to 3/3, so it wants the mass-effect word alongside eff:set-pt.

kept.name: Palisade Giant
kept.why: The damage is not prevented, it is dealt to the Giant instead, and eff:redirect-damage is the exact word for that. It applies to all damage to you and every other permanent you control, so it is a mass effect.

kept.name: Purity
kept.why: Everything except flying was dropped. It prevents all noncombat damage to you, gains life equal to what it prevented, and shuffles itself back into the library from the graveyard.

kept.name: Rite of the Moth
kept.why: The reanimated creature comes back with a finality counter on it, which is a counter the card puts on a permanent and was not recorded.

kept.name: Illuminator Virtuoso
kept.why: The trigger is specifically that it becomes the target of a spell YOU control. Bare trig:cast reads as any cast trigger and loses both the targeting condition and whose spell it is, which is the entire deckbuilding hook.

kept.name: City of Shadows
kept.why: The first ability was missed entirely: exiling a creature you control is a real cost, and the storage counter it puts on itself is what the mana ability later reads.

kept.name: Cabal Paladin
kept.why: It triggers on spells you cast, not any cast, and the damage goes to each opponent rather than to a target.

kept.name: Prayer of Binding
kept.why: The exile lasts only until this enchantment leaves the battlefield, so its own departure is a trigger that hands the permanent back. That half of an Oblivion Ring effect was unrecorded.

kept.name: Mastery of the Unseen
kept.why: The lifegain trigger, which is the card's payoff, was missing outright, and manifest works off the top of your library.

kept.name: Requiting Hex
kept.why: Blight 1 is an additional cost paid by putting a -1/-1 counter on your own creature, and the two life is explicitly conditional on having paid it.

kept.name: Grafted Skullcap
kept.why: It draws an extra card every draw step. Only the discard half of the card was recorded, which makes a card-advantage artifact read as pure downside.

kept.name: Pilfering Imp
kept.why: The ability costs {1}{B}, {T} and a sacrifice. The tap was dropped, so a card that can only do this once and only at sorcery speed reads as freely repeatable.

kept.name: Misery's Shadow
kept.why: The whole first line, replacing opponents' creature deaths with exile, produced no word. Only the firebreathing-style pump was read.

kept.name: Spurnmage Advocate
kept.why: Half the ability was unread: it returns two cards from an opponent's graveyard to their hand, which is the drawback that pays for the removal.

kept.name: Quest for the Holy Relic
kept.why: Removing five quest counters and sacrificing the enchantment are the costs of the search, and neither was recorded.

kept.name: Blood Baron of Vizkopa
kept.why: It has protection from black as well as white and only the white half was noted, and the conditional +6/+6 is a real pump that nothing recorded.

kept.name: Dreamstealer
kept.why: Eternalize was read only as a token copy. It is activated from the graveyard and exiles this card as its cost, which makes it a creature that brings itself back, the same shape as unearth or embalm.

kept.name: Kimoyo Beads
kept.why: Only the token mode was read. The other two modes draw a card and gain 3 life, and the third also exiles this artifact and returns it, blinking itself to reset the chosen modes.

kept.name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
kept.why: Exploit is an enters trigger and nothing recorded that it does anything on arrival. The payoff makes each opponent sacrifice, which is a mass edict rather than a targeted one.

kept.name: Ice Floe
kept.why: The ability costs {T}, so it holds down one attacker at a time. Without it the card reads as a repeatable tapper.

kept.name: Political Triumph
kept.why: Only the plan counters it puts on itself were recorded. The payoff puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, which is a different effect on other permanents.

kept.name: Sunstar Chaplain
kept.why: The tap ability is paid for by removing a +1/+1 counter from one of your creatures, so the card both makes and spends counters and only the making was recorded.

kept.name: Center Soul
kept.why: Granting protection from a colour to your own creature is a save — the card's whole job is keeping a creature alive through removal or blocks. It has grants:protection but nothing that says it is a protection spell.

kept.name: Prismatic Geoscope
kept.why: The domain mana ability is '{T}: Add X mana'. The tap cost was never written down, so the card reads as a mana source with no cost.

kept.name: Oust
kept.why: 'Its controller gains 3 life' is the OPPONENT gaining life — Oust is a one-mana removal spell with a drawback, not a lifegain card. As written it can be offered to a lifegain deck as a payoff.

kept.name: Cage of Hands
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature can't attack or block' produced nothing at all — the list only records the aura returning itself to hand. This is a Pacifism, which makes a creature harmless without destroying it, so it is removal and needs eff:neutralise to be seen as one.

kept.name: Skinwing
kept.why: Living weapon is 'When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 Germ, then attach this to it'. The token and the attach are recorded and the trigger that causes them is not.

kept.name: Hei Bai, Spirit of Balance
kept.why: 'When Hei Bai leaves the battlefield, put its counters on target creature you control' puts counters on ANOTHER permanent. Only eff:add-counters-self was recorded, which is the first ability.

kept.name: Temporal Isolation
kept.why: Preventing all damage the enchanted creature would deal, plus shadow, turns a threat into a blank permanent. That is removal and nothing in the list says so.

kept.name: Light of the Legion
kept.why: It is a 4/4, so pt:big (power 5 or more) is false. 'A +1/+1 counter on each WHITE creature you control' is a colour-matters payoff that was unrecorded, and mentor triggers on attack.

kept.name: Eternal Taskmaster
kept.why: It returns a creature CARD from your graveyard to your hand. eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures off the battlefield to hand (the blink and re-cast effect), which this card cannot do. eff:return-from already records the recursion correctly.

kept.name: Tormod's Cryptkeeper
kept.why: The ability costs '{T}, Sacrifice this creature'. Only the sacrifice half was recorded.

kept.name: Dora Milaje Elite
kept.why: The enters trigger creates a Vibranium token and no word said the card makes a token — only the token's own mana ability was read. 'Sacrifice this creature: Legendary permanents you control gain indestructible' is a save for your board, which is what eff:protect names.

kept.name: The Rack
kept.why: The damage happens 'at the beginning of the chosen player's upkeep' and scales with the number of cards in their hand. Neither the recurring upkeep trigger nor the hand-size payoff was written down, so it reads as a one-shot damage artifact.

kept.name: Leonardo, Leader in Blue
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative cost that requires returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand as you cast. That is exactly cost:cast-return-to-hand, and it is what makes the card work with evasive attackers.

kept.name: Rattleblaze Scarecrow
kept.why: It has haste only while you control a RED creature. The black condition was recorded as cares:color:b and the red one was not, so half the card's colour-matters text is missing.

kept.name: Archangel's Light
kept.why: 'Shuffle your graveyard into your library' is a shuffle and the word exists. Only the generic zone move was recorded.

kept.name: Barbed Bloodletter
