kept.why: 'That creature gains wither until end of turn' produced no grant word — the list records the attach and the +1/+2 only.

kept.name: Elektra, Daughter of the Hand
kept.why: Sneak {1}{B}{B} is an alternative cost paid by returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand, the same shape as ninjutsu. Nothing recorded that cost.

kept.name: Brood of Cockroaches
kept.why: It brings ITSELF back from the graveyard to your hand every time it dies, which is the definition of eff:recur-self. Only the generic eff:return-from was recorded, so the engine cannot tell it apart from a card that reanimates something else — and self-recursion is why this card is sacrifice fodder.

kept.name: Treasury Thrull
kept.why: Extort is 'Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}'. The drain and lifegain payoffs were recorded but not the cast trigger that fires them.

kept.name: Faerie Guidemother // Gift of the Fae
kept.why: The Adventure half gives +2/+1 as well as flying. Only the flying grant was written down.

kept.name: Korlash, Heir to Blackblade
kept.why: Grandeur is an activated cost that discards another card from hand. cost:discard-self is for discarding this card (cycling); this discards a different card.

kept.name: Eyes in the Skies
kept.why: Populate creates a token that is a copy of a creature token you control. The copying half was unrecorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Marauder
kept.why: Both printed restrictions were missing: it cannot block at all, and it cannot attack unless you pay. mv:cheap is an artefact of a cost of {X} alone collapsing to mana value 0 - this card is never cheap, you pay X, and calling it cheap offers it to decks wanting one and two drops.

kept.name: Shadowborn Demon
kept.why: Everything it does is singular: destroy TARGET non-Demon creature, sacrifice A creature. Nothing affects the whole board, and scope:all reads as a mass effect.

kept.name: Shared Triumph
kept.why: Creatures of the chosen type get +1/+1 - an anthem, and nothing recorded that it pumps at all. It hits every creature of that type on every board, so the effect is mass rather than targeted.

kept.name: Concealing Curtains // Revealing Eye
kept.why: The {2}{B} activated ability transforms it, which is what the whole front face is for. Deliberately not adding eff:draw: it is the OPPONENT who draws after discarding, so recording it as card draw would be false.

kept.name: Wither and Bloom
kept.why: The second half is activated from the graveyard by exiling it from there. The card is a graveyard-value card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Vesperlark
kept.why: Evoke sacrifices it when it enters, which is precisely how the leaves-the-battlefield reanimation trigger is paid for. It eats only itself, once.

kept.name: Commanding Presence
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and the pump was unrecorded, as was the fact that this is an Aura that attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Gideon, Martial Paragon
kept.why: The 0 ability was read as nothing: he becomes a 5/5 creature (animate), gains indestructible, and all damage that would be dealt to him is prevented. Only the +2 and -10 abilities had produced words.

kept.name: Sorcerer's Strongbox
kept.why: The ability costs {2} and {T}; the tap in the cost was missing. Not adding a sacrifice word - it sacrifices ITSELF on a win, which is neither an outlet nor a cast cost.

kept.name: Oteclan Landmark // Oteclan Levitator
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread. Craft exiles this artifact plus another artifact you control or an artifact card from your GRAVEYARD, and returns it transformed. The back face's flying grant is triggered by attacking and no attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Stardew Valley
kept.why: The third ability draws a card and then hands the chosen permanent to another player, and neither was written down. Nothing on this land affects everything - every ability is one target or one token.

kept.name: Mystic Skull // Mystic Monstrosity
kept.why: The {5}, {T} ability transforms it, which is the entire reason to play the front face.

kept.name: Tomb Blade
kept.why: Unearth returns it with haste. The recursion was recorded, the haste it comes back with was not.

kept.name: Getaway Car
kept.why: It returns a creature YOU control - the one that crewed it - to your hand, which is the whole point of the card with enter-the-battlefield creatures. No effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Mukotai Soulripper
kept.why: It gains menace until end of turn and that was unrecorded. It sacrifices one other artifact or creature and puts one counter on itself, so nothing here is a mass effect.

kept.name: Xander's Pact
kept.why: Casualty is an additional cost to CAST, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet, so the outlet word is wrong and misfiles this sorcery as aristocrats machinery. Also missing: you pay life rather than mana cost for anything you cast, and the whole effect is exiling cards off the top of libraries to cast them.

kept.name: Slumbering Walker
kept.why: It enters with counters on ITSELF, and the end-step trigger is paid by removing a counter from it. Only the generic counter word was there.

kept.name: Devouring Greed
kept.why: Sacrificing Spirits is an additional cost to cast this sorcery, not a repeatable sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice tells the engine this is an outlet a deck can rely on.

kept.name: Jawbone Skulkin
kept.why: It grants haste and nothing else - no power or toughness changes hands, so eff:pump is false. It can only target a RED creature, which is a real restriction and the only thing that decides whether the card is playable.

kept.name: Great Ugly-Looking Goblin // Clap! Snap!
kept.why: The front face's only ability grants menace to every creature you control with a +1/+1 counter, and neither the grant nor its board-wide reach was recorded.

kept.name: Orb of Dreams
kept.why: It applies to EVERY permanent every player plays, which is the only thing about it, and the scope was missing.

kept.name: Civic Saber
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each of its colours. The Equipment was recorded as attaching to something and doing nothing when it got there.

kept.name: Extractor Demon
kept.why: It triggers on ANOTHER creature leaving the battlefield, not on itself. Not adding trig:dies - leaving the battlefield is wider than dying and claiming a dies trigger would be an overstatement.

kept.name: Oxidda Golem
kept.why: Affinity for Mountains is a cost reduction on itself, the same shape already recorded for cards whose whole text is 'this spell costs less'.

kept.name: Covetous Elegy
kept.why: It creates a Treasure token per opposing creature and no token word was recorded at all - only the mana they eventually make. It also empties every board down to two creatures INCLUDING YOURS, which is exactly the thing a go-wide deck must not be handed.

kept.name: Captain's Hook
kept.why: Nothing about what the Equipment actually does was recorded. It gives +2/+0 and menace, and when it comes unattached it destroys that permanent - which is your own creature, since you can only equip your own. eff:destroy would file this as removal, which it is not.

kept.name: Liege of the Pit
kept.why: The upkeep trigger sacrifices a creature every turn - the card's defining drawback and its one real interaction with a deck. Only the 7 damage fallback was recorded.

kept.name: Mark of Asylum
kept.why: It prevents all noncombat damage to every creature you control - a blanket protective effect against sweepers, and neither its reach nor the fact that it keeps your creatures alive was recorded.

kept.name: Aetherborn Marauder
kept.why: The entire enter-the-battlefield ability produced no effect word: it takes +1/+1 counters off your other permanents and piles them onto itself. It also has lifelink, so it gains life.

kept.name: Taster of Wares
kept.why: The card had no effect word whatsoever. An opponent exiles a card out of their hand, and you may then cast it from exile. Not eff:discard - the card is exiled, which is a different answer for anything that cares about graveyards.

kept.name: Nazar, the Velvet Fang
kept.why: His first ability triggers whenever YOU GAIN LIFE, which makes him a lifegain payoff and nothing said so. The three life is lost by you as the price of drawing, not drained from an opponent, so eff:lose-life reads him as a drain card he is not. Removing three feeding counters is the cost of that reflexive trigger.

kept.name: Chaplain of Alms // Chapel Shieldgeist
kept.why: The back face replaces its own death by exiling itself instead of going to a graveyard, which is why it cannot be recurred twice. That clause produced nothing.

kept.name: Viv Vision, Teen Synthezoid
kept.why: The attack trigger draws a card and the whole trigger is conditioned on her power being 4 or greater. Neither the draw nor the power check was recorded, so a card-draw commander could never see her.

kept.name: Thrasher Brute
kept.why: "Whenever this creature OR ANOTHER Warrior your team controls enters" is two events. Only the bare trig:enters was recorded, so nothing could tell it apart from a self-only ETB or from a Tatyova-style other-permanent trigger.

kept.name: Kiku, Night's Flower
kept.why: "Target creature deals damage to itself equal to its power" is a repeatable damage-based kill and the list carried no effect verb at all - only the cost and cares:power. Not eff:damage-self, which means damage to YOU.

kept.name: Trynn, Champion of Freedom
kept.why: Partner with is an ETB trigger ("When this creature enters, target player may put Silvar into their hand from their library, then shuffle") and neither the trigger nor the shuffle was recorded. Only the end-step token half had been read.

kept.name: Amulet of Safekeeping
kept.why: The entire first ability - counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {1} - was unread; only the "creature tokens get -1/-0" half had been recorded. This is a tax/counter permanent and carried neither verb.

kept.name: Purple Pentapus
kept.why: The recursion ability costs "Tap an untapped creature you control", a convoke-style crew cost that was not recorded anywhere in the list.

kept.name: Fountain of Ichor
kept.why: "{3}: This artifact becomes a 3/3 Dinosaur artifact creature until end of turn" is the card's whole second ability and produced no verb - the list read as a plain mana rock.

kept.name: Nahiri's Binding
kept.why: This is a Pacifism variant that also shuts off activated abilities: the permanent stays on the battlefield doing nothing. eff:neutralise is precisely "turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it", and without it this white removal aura carries only prohibition words and can be offered for no removal job.

kept.name: Divining Witch
kept.why: The activation cost is {1}{B}, {T}, Discard a card - the tap was missing entirely and the discard was recorded as an EFFECT. Discarding as a cost is cost:discard (compare Sliversmith in this same batch); eff:discard-self would advertise it as a discard outlet, which it is not. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile for the six cards exiled off the top of its own library: that word is read as removal and this is a tutor.

kept.name: Undead Gladiator
kept.why: "Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is the card's defining ability and only the generic eff:return-from was recorded. eff:recur-self is the word for a card that brings ITSELF back, which is what makes it a repeatable cycling engine.

kept.name: Faceless Butcher
kept.why: The leave-the-battlefield half - "return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control" - produced no verb, so the card read as pure exile removal with a dangling trig:leaves. It also tracks a card in exile.

kept.name: Militia's Pride
kept.why: "You may pay {W}. If you do, create ..." is an optional-cost payoff and the conditional half was unread; the list showed an unconditional attack-trigger token maker.

kept.name: Rose Tyler
kept.why: Her attack trigger puts time counters ON HERSELF and nothing recorded it - only the static eff:pump that reads those counters. She is a self-growing creature, which is what eff:add-counters-self exists to say (and correctly NOT eff:add-counters, which would read as a counters-matters payoff).

kept.name: Changeling Hero
kept.why: Champion is an ETB plus a leaves-the-battlefield trigger that returns the exiled creature, and none of the four triggers or the return was recorded - only the eff:exile-own half. Compare Faceless Butcher in this batch, which carries the full set for the same shape.

kept.name: Sentinel of the Eternal Watch
kept.why: "At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn" is the card's only ability and its timing was unrecorded, so the tap effect hung off no trigger at all.

kept.name: Sigil of Myrkul
kept.why: "and it gains deathtouch until end of turn" was not recorded; only the counter and the mill were. Granting deathtouch is half of what makes this enchantment worth playing.

kept.name: Redemptor Dreadnought
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread: the additional casting cost (exile a creature card from your graveyard) and the attack trigger's +X/+X. The list carried cares:power with nothing to explain why. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard - that word means graveyard hate, and this eats its OWN graveyard as a cost, so it belongs in a graveyard deck rather than against one.

kept.name: Rabaroo Troop
kept.why: Plainscycling is "{2}, Discard this card: search ... then shuffle" and neither the discard-itself cost nor the shuffle was recorded, though the search was.

kept.name: Credit Voucher
kept.why: The {T} in the activation cost was missing. Shuffling cards from hand INTO YOUR LIBRARY is not discarding - nothing reaches the graveyard - so eff:discard-self would offer this to madness, reanimator and discard-payoff decks wrongly. It is a hand-to-library move plus a shuffle.

kept.name: Board the Weatherlight
kept.why: The list held nothing but mv:cheap and the type - the card's entire text (look at the top five, take a historic card, bottom the rest) produced no verb at all. eff:look-and-pick is exactly this shape, and it is library selection rather than a draw or a search.

kept.name: Auratouched Mage
kept.why: It puts the tutored Aura onto the battlefield ATTACHED to itself, which is the whole point of the card and produced no verb; only the search and the shuffle were read.

kept.name: Mardu Woe-Reaper
kept.why: "Whenever THIS CREATURE or another Warrior you control enters" - the self half was missing while trig:enters-other was present, so its own ETB was invisible. Same fault as Thrasher Brute in this batch.

kept.name: Fear of Immobility
kept.why: "put a stun counter on it" was unread - the list showed a plain tapper. The counter is on an opponent's creature and is the reason the tap sticks.

kept.name: Curse of Oblivion
kept.why: The recurring upkeep trigger had no timing words at all, and a card whose entire job is eating graveyards two cards at a time did not say it cares about the graveyard.

kept.name: Ecstatic Awakener // Awoken Demon
kept.why: The ability ends "then transform this creature" and nothing records the transform. kw:transform is the printed keyword; eff:transform is what it actually does on resolution.

kept.name: Magus of the Tabernacle
kept.why: The granted ability is a full upkeep trigger with a tax attached: "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature unless you pay {1}." Only the sacrifice was recorded. This is a stax card and the tax is the whole point of it.

kept.name: Enslave
kept.why: "You control enchanted creature" is the main clause of the card and it is missing entirely. Only the 1 damage per upkeep was read.

kept.name: Play of the Game
kept.why: "Exile all nonland permanents" clears the whole board including your own. A go-wide deck must not be offered this, which is exactly what scope:wipe is consumed for; scope:all alone does not say the card destroys your own side.

kept.name: Myr Landshaper
kept.why: The ability is "{T}: ..." and the tap cost is not recorded.

kept.name: Hallow
kept.why: It targets a spell on the stack, which nothing in the list records. It is a spell-interaction card, not just a lifegain card.

kept.name: Enduring Renewal
kept.why: The draw replacement ends "Otherwise, draw a card" and reveals the top card of your library; neither the draw nor the library interaction was recorded, only the mill half.

kept.name: Souls of the Faultless
kept.why: "Whenever this creature is dealt combat damage" is the trigger and no trig: word is present at all - the gain/drain sit on the card with nothing saying when they happen.

kept.name: Nezumi Cutthroat
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed line of the card and is entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Possessed Portal
kept.why: The end-step clause hits every player, not a target, so it is symmetric; the draw-denial half is unsayable.

kept.name: Heroic Return
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast if a creature is attacking you" is unrecorded. Self cost reduction is what eff:reduce-cost covers (the same shape as Ghalta).

kept.name: Ori, Keeper of Songs
kept.why: "Ori gets +1/+0 and has vigilance" is the entire functional text and nothing records either half. kw:vigilance is the printed keyword line; the conditional self-grant is a separate claim, the same way Bonepicker Skirge carries grants:deathtouch for its own conditional grant.

kept.name: Scion of the Swarm
kept.why: "Whenever you gain life" makes this a lifegain payoff. trig:gains-life records the trigger but nothing says the card belongs in a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Wheel of Torture
kept.why: X is "3 minus the number of cards in their hand" - the card counts opponents' hand size, which is its whole design (a discard/hellbent payoff), and nothing records it.

kept.name: Angel of Salvation
kept.why: The entire enters-the-battlefield ability - "prevent the next 5 damage that would be dealt this turn" - is missing. The card carries only its keywords and a trigger with no effect attached.

kept.name: Fatal Fissure
kept.why: Earthbend 4 puts four +1/+1 counters on the land and the animated land has haste. ctr:+1/+1 and eff:animate are recorded but the counters being placed and the haste grant are not.

kept.name: Eater of Hope
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. "Destroy target creature" is single-target and the regenerate is on itself. scope:all here would make it read as a sweeper.

kept.name: Knight of Grace
kept.why: "This creature gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a black permanent" is a real power/toughness change and is unrecorded; the card currently carries only keywords and cares:color:b.

kept.name: Tabaxi Toucaneers
kept.why: Myriad is an attack trigger ("Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent..."). The token copies are recorded but nothing says when they happen, so it cannot be found as an attack-trigger card.

kept.name: Life of Toshiro Umezawa // Memory of Toshiro
kept.why: Four unrecorded clauses: the first mode is "+2/+2 until end of turn" (only the -1/-1 mode's eff:shrink was read); chapter III exiles this Saga and returns it transformed; and the back face's mana ability costs {T}, which is not recorded beside cost:life.

kept.name: Quest for the Gravelord
kept.why: The payoff - "Create a 5/5 black Zombie Giant creature token" - is entirely missing, as is its cost of removing three quest counters and sacrificing the enchantment. Only the counter-accumulating half was read.

kept.name: Bonepicker Skirge
kept.why: Corrupted grants it deathtouch AND lifelink; grants:deathtouch was recorded and the lifelink half of the same clause was not.

kept.name: Ultron Drone
kept.why: The power-up ability creates a 2/2 Robot Villain token and that is unrecorded - only the counters on itself were read, so half the ability is missing.

kept.name: Pyrrhic Strike
kept.why: Blight 2 is an additional cost that puts two -1/-1 counters on your own creature, and "If this spell's additional cost was paid, choose both instead" is exactly the pay-more-get-more shape. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Swampsnare Trap
kept.why: eff:pump is wrong and reverses the card: the aura gives -5/-3, so it is eff:shrink. It also costs {1} less if it targets a creature with flying, which is both a cost reduction and a genuine flying-matters clause (it is a removal aura built to answer fliers).

kept.name: Dread Drone
kept.why: The two Eldrazi Spawn it makes read "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}". The card is a ramp card and nothing in its list says it produces mana.

kept.name: Poet's Quill
kept.why: Learn is a real card-draw clause ("discard a card to draw a card") and nothing recorded it. The equipped creature has lifelink, so the card gains life; it already carries grants:lifelink but no life-gain effect.

kept.name: Hedonist's Trove
kept.why: Its first clause exiles an opponent's whole graveyard, which is graveyard hate and was entirely unrecorded. The other two clauses play and cast cards from exile, so it cares about the exile zone. eff:return-from is wrong: nothing is returned from anywhere, and marking it as recursion puts a hate piece in graveyard-value decks.

kept.name: Fiend of the Shadows
kept.why: Its combat trigger exiles a card from an opponent's hand and lets you play it, so it exiles and it cares about the exile zone. "Sacrifice a Human" is a sacrifice cost and was not written down at all.

kept.name: Sparring Regimen
kept.why: The whole second line is "Whenever you attack" and there was no attack trigger on the card. Learn draws a card.

kept.name: Ruinous Path
kept.why: Only the destroy clause was read. Awaken puts four +1/+1 counters on a land you control and turns that land into a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste, which is counters, animation and a haste grant.

kept.name: Disciples of Gix
kept.why: The tutor ends "then shuffle" and the shuffle was not recorded.

kept.name: Diamond Valley
kept.why: The ability costs "{T}, Sacrifice a creature". The sacrifice half is recorded and the tap half is missing.

kept.name: Lim-Dûl's Hex
kept.why: "unless they pay {B} or {3}" is a tax clause and was unrecorded. It fires for EACH player, so it is a symmetric effect and it damages you too unless you pay.

kept.name: Staff of the Wild Magus
kept.why: Two of the three ways this triggers were missing. It fires on a spell YOU cast (trig:cast-own, not just the bare trig:cast) and on a Forest you control entering, which is another permanent entering.

kept.name: Oketra's Last Mercy
kept.why: Setting your life total to your starting total from below it is a life gain event by the rules, and it is what the card is played for. Only eff:set-life was recorded, so no lifegain deck can see it.

kept.name: Yukora, the Prisoner
kept.why: It sacrifices ALL your non-Ogre creatures. eff:sacrifice alone does not say the victims are yours, which is the whole hazard of the card in a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Ranger's Hawk
kept.why: The cost is "{3}, {T}, Tap another untapped creature you control". cost:tap-others is recorded but the card tapping itself is not.

kept.name: Takeno, Samurai General
kept.why: "Each other Samurai creature you control gets +1/+1 for each point of bushido" is a mass anthem, the same shape that carries scope:all on other pump-everything creatures.

kept.name: Forcefield
kept.why: The card's only ability prevents combat damage and the list carried no effect word at all. It read as a blank artifact.

kept.name: Serrated Arrows
kept.why: It puts -1/-1 counters on creatures, which shrinks them and is how it kills things. eff:add-counters alone reads as a +1/+1 counters card.

kept.name: Phylactery Lich
kept.why: "As this creature enters, put a phylactery counter on an artifact you control" is an enters trigger and neither enters word was present.

kept.name: Cerebral Confiscation
kept.why: It is a modal "Choose one" spell and the second mode has you choose the card the opponent discards.

kept.name: Shambling Cie'th
kept.why: Its whole payoff is returning ITSELF from the graveyard, which is exactly eff:recur-self and was missing. eff:bounce-own is wrong: nothing is returned from the battlefield to hand, so it would put this in bounce and blink decks. scope:all is wrong: nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Bathe in Light
kept.why: The card grants protection from a colour and neither the grant nor the fact that it saves your creatures was recorded. It read as nothing but a colour choice.

kept.name: Shrine of Loyal Legions
kept.why: The entire first line was unread. It triggers on your upkeep and on you casting a white spell, and it puts a charge counter on itself each time, which is the engine that makes the token clause worth anything.

kept.name: Auratog
kept.why: "This creature gets +2/+2" affects one creature, itself. scope:all claims a mass effect that is not there.

kept.name: Befriending the Moths // Imperial Moth
kept.why: Chapters I and II give +1/+1 and flying, so it pumps, and only the flying grant was recorded. Chapter III exiles the Saga itself and returns it transformed.

kept.name: Tangle Tumbler
kept.why: Its crew-like ability turns the Vehicle into an artifact creature, which is animation, and it pays for that by tapping two other permanents you control.

kept.name: Necropolis Fiend
kept.why: The ability gives -X/-X to a single target creature. scope:all wrongly claims a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Zealot's Conviction
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and carried no attach word. Corrupted grants the enchanted creature first strike, which was unrecorded.

kept.name: Springjack Shepherd
kept.why: The card's only ability creates Goat tokens and eff:create-token was missing entirely, so a token deck cannot see it. It counts white mana symbols on your permanents, which is a real white-devotion check.

kept.name: Eerie Soultender
kept.why: It returns a creature CARD from the graveyard to hand, which eff:return-from already records. eff:bounce-own means returning your own battlefield creatures and would put a recursion card into bounce and blink decks.

kept.name: Neutralize the Guards
kept.why: Its main clause gives every creature an opponent controls -1/-1 and neither the shrink nor the mass scope was recorded, so a removal spell read as a pure surveil card. Surveil puts cards into your graveyard, which is why the card is played in graveyard decks.

kept.name: Blossoming Calm
kept.why: "You gain hexproof until your next turn" was not recorded at all - only the 2 life was. The hexproof half is the whole reason the card is played.

kept.name: Mortarpod
kept.why: +0/+1 is a pump and was missing. The granted "Sacrifice this creature:" is a free repeatable sacrifice outlet, which is what this card is actually played for. Living weapon is an enters trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Resourceful Return
kept.why: It returns a creature card from the GRAVEYARD to hand, not your own creature from the battlefield. eff:bounce-own makes it read as a blink/save effect. eff:return-from already states it correctly.

kept.name: Synapse Necromage
kept.why: The card's only ability makes two Fungus tokens and eff:create-token was absent - the list recorded the dies trigger and nothing it does.

kept.name: Dawn of the Dead
kept.why: The reanimated creature gains haste, which is the point of the card (it is sacrificed or attacks before the end-step exile). Not adding eff:exile deliberately: the exile is of your own reanimated creature and eff:exile would file a reanimation enchantment as removal.

kept.name: Midnight Oil
kept.why: Only the hour counters were read. It draws an extra card every draw step, removes two counters doing it, sets your maximum hand size, and drains you on every discard - four clauses, none recorded.

kept.name: Jade Monolith
kept.why: Redirecting damage away from a creature is how this keeps creatures alive, and the damage is redirected to YOU, which is a real cost the list did not state.

kept.name: Heart-Shaped Herb
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unread: it prevents 1 damage from every opponent source, it returns the sacrificed creature from the graveyard to the battlefield (it is a sacrifice-and-reanimate engine, not just a sacrifice), and it makes you the monarch.

kept.name: Aether Shockwave
kept.why: It is a modal "Choose one -" spell and the modality was not recorded.

kept.name: King Solomon's Frogs
kept.why: The activated ability - become the monarch by tapping and exiling itself - was entirely unread. Deliberately not adding eff:draw: the card draw goes to the permanents' CONTROLLERS, mostly opponents, and eff:draw would read as card advantage for you.

kept.name: Necromancer's Stockpile
kept.why: Discarding a creature card is the activation cost and no cost word was recorded. cost:discard rather than cost:discard-self, because -self across this vocabulary means the card itself is discarded/sacrificed/exiled (cf. cost:sacrifice-self on Blight Keeper, Death Cultist, Infernal Idol).

kept.name: Strength of Lunacy
kept.why: +2/+1 was not recorded; only the protection half of the aura was read.

kept.name: Raffine's Silencer
kept.why: Connive is draw a card then discard a card. The counter was recorded and the loot was not, so a card that genuinely fills the graveyard and filters reads as neither.

kept.name: Orzhov Keyrune
kept.why: The second ability - the whole reason a Keyrune is not just a Signet - was unread. It turns itself into a creature with lifelink.

kept.name: Soulcoil Viper
kept.why: {T} is part of the activation cost and was not recorded, and the finality counter it puts on the reanimated creature was not either.

kept.name: Mirran Bardiche
kept.why: For Mirrodin! is an enters trigger that creates the token; the token and attach were recorded but no trigger word was.

kept.name: Gelid Shackles
kept.why: "Enchanted creature can't block" is the aura's main clause and was missing entirely. eff:pump is wrong: nothing here makes a creature bigger - granting defender is a restriction, not a buff.

kept.name: False Cure
kept.why: The card is a lifegain-punisher and nothing recorded that it triggers on, or cares about, life being gained. Only the resulting life loss was read.

kept.name: Infernal Kirin
kept.why: Bare trig:cast does not say whose spell. This triggers on spells YOU cast, which is what separates a spellslinger payoff from a stax piece taxing opponents.

kept.name: Merrow Bonegnawer
kept.why: It is repeatable graveyard hate and neither the exile nor the graveyard was recorded, so the card reads as an untapper. {T} is part of the cost. scope:all is wrong - the untap trigger affects only itself.

kept.name: Kheru Mind-Eater
kept.why: The third clause - you may play the exiled cards - was unread, and it is the payoff half of the card. Not adding eff:exile: the exile is of cards in an opponent's hand and eff:exile would file this as removal.

kept.name: Banishment
kept.why: The exile lasts "until this enchantment leaves the battlefield" - the linked return trigger was not recorded, so nothing says this is an Oblivion Ring that gives the permanents back when answered.

kept.name: Skorpekh Destroyer
kept.why: The trigger reads "whenever an artifact you control enters" but the effect gives first strike to this creature alone. scope:all claims it affects everything.

kept.name: Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald
kept.why: The tutor shuffles and searches the library and neither was recorded beyond the bare eff:search-library.

kept.name: Gixian Infiltrator
kept.why: "Whenever you sacrifice another permanent" is a trigger condition; the effect is one counter on itself. scope:all reads as affecting the whole board.

kept.name: Angelheart Vial
kept.why: The whole first ability is missing. "Whenever you're dealt damage, you may put that many charge counters on this artifact" is a damage trigger (trig:dealt-damage) that puts counters on itself (eff:add-counters-self). Only the activated half was read.

kept.name: Opal-Eye, Konda's Yojimbo
kept.why: Both activated abilities were unread. "{T}: The next time a source of your choice would deal damage this turn, that damage is dealt to Opal-Eye instead" is a redirect and needs cost:tap for the {T}. "{1}{W}: Prevent the next 1 damage" is eff:prevent-damage. This is a dedicated damage-soaking blocker and carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Death-Rattle Oni
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast for each creature that died this turn" is a cost reduction and was not read. The enters trigger destroys ALL other damaged creatures, so scope:all. Not scope:wipe - restricted to creatures dealt damage this turn, which is exactly the kind of restriction that turns a wipe into a payoff.

kept.name: Pinnacle Starcage
kept.why: The second ability's token half is missing entirely: "create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each card put into a graveyard this way". The enters trigger exiles ALL artifacts and creatures with mana value 2 or less (scope:all), and the second ability reads back the cards exiled with this artifact, so it genuinely cares about the exile zone.

kept.name: Hythonia the Cruel
kept.why: Monstrosity 3 puts three +1/+1 counters on itself, which was unread. "Destroy all non-Gorgon creatures" is scope:all. Deliberately NOT scope:wipe: sparing Gorgons is a restriction, and Hythonia herself survives, so this is a one-sided finisher rather than a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Bitter Revelation
kept.why: Nothing about this card touches exile. eff:impulse means exiling cards off the top to play them; this puts two into your HAND and the rest into your GRAVEYARD, which is a draw-two plus a self-mill-two, and both were missing. cares:zone:exile is the same word-scan error following the wrong impulse reading.

kept.name: Vengeful Strangler // Strangling Grasp
kept.why: Six clauses unread. Front face: "This creature can't block" (eff:cant-block-self); the death trigger returns IT to the battlefield from the graveyard, which is eff:recur-self plus eff:return-from, transformed (eff:transform) and attached to a creature (eff:attach). Back face: the drain is on "At the beginning of your upkeep", so trig:step and trig:step:upkeep. Only trig:dies and the two effects of the back face were present.

kept.name: Commander's Authority
kept.why: The granted ability is "At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white Human creature token". The token half was read and the timing was not.

kept.name: Fated Retribution
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures and planeswalkers" with no restriction and no exception for your own board. This is the unrestricted symmetric case scope:wipe exists for, and without it nothing stops the engine putting it in a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Thief of Hope
kept.why: "Whenever YOU cast a Spirit or Arcane spell" - the trigger is on your own casts, and only the direction-free trig:cast was recorded.

kept.name: Restless Apparition
kept.why: Persist returns this creature from the graveyard to the battlefield. eff:return-from was recorded but not the fact that what it returns is ITSELF, which is what makes it repeatable sacrifice fodder.

kept.name: Staff of the Mind Magus
kept.why: The trigger has two halves and only the cast half was read. "or an Island you control enters" is a permanent-enters trigger on another permanent. The cast half is on your own spells.

kept.name: Koma's Faithful
kept.why: "EACH player mills three cards" - symmetric, so scope:all. The mill was read and the fact that it hits everyone was not.

kept.name: Aphemia, the Cacophony
kept.why: "You may exile an enchantment card from your graveyard" is a cost paid out of your own graveyard, which is the payoff that makes this an enchantment-graveyard card. Deliberately NOT eff:exile-graveyard: that word means graveyard hate and would tell the engine Aphemia works AGAINST a graveyard plan, when she is built for one.

kept.name: Sigil of the New Dawn
kept.why: "You may pay {1}{W}. If you do, return that card to your hand" - the optional payment was not read, so nothing records that the recursion is repeatable but costed.

kept.name: Reveille Squad
kept.why: "Untap ALL creatures you control" - the untap was read, the fact that it is your whole board was not.

kept.name: Levitating Statue
kept.why: "{2}: This artifact becomes a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn" - the entire second ability was unread. It is the only reason the accumulated +1/+1 counters matter.

kept.name: Arrogant Outlaw
kept.why: "EACH opponent loses 2 life" - a multiplayer drain, not a single-target one. Siege Zombie in the same batch carries scope:all for the identical wording.

kept.name: Cemetery Desecrator
kept.why: Only the first mode was read. "Exile another card from a graveyard" is genuine graveyard hate (any graveyard, not yours as a cost). "Choose one" is modal. The second mode gives a creature -X/-X, which is eff:shrink and is the half that makes this a removal spell.

kept.name: Neighborhood Guardian
kept.why: The card had a trigger and NO effect. "Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn" is eff:pump. The trigger is on another creature you control entering (trig:enters-other), and it is gated on "with power 2 or less" (cares:power).

kept.name: Key to the Side-Door
kept.why: Both abilities tap ({2},{T} and {1},{T}) and the second also requires discarding a legendary card. Neither cost was recorded, so the second ability reads as a free draw-two.

kept.name: Detained by Legionnaires
kept.why: A Pacifism turns a creature into something harmless without destroying it, which is what eff:neutralise names. The two can't-clauses were read individually but nothing said this is an ANSWER, so it could never fill a removal slot.

kept.name: Returned Reveler
kept.why: "EACH player mills three cards" - symmetric. Same wording and same omission as Koma's Faithful in this batch.

kept.name: Bound by Moonsilver
kept.why: "Sacrifice another permanent: Attach this Aura to target creature" - the sacrifice cost was read but not what it buys, which is moving the Aura (eff:attach). And like Detained by Legionnaires, locking a creature out of attacking, blocking and transforming is neutralising it, which is what makes it removal.

kept.name: Krovod Haunch
kept.why: The death trigger creates two 1/1 Dog tokens and nothing recorded that it makes tokens (tok:dog is present but no eff:create-token). The trigger is also the "you may pay {1}{W}. If you do" shape that eff:do-if-cost-paid exists for.

kept.name: Scarblade Elite
kept.why: The ability destroys one target creature. scope:all means the effect touches everything, and this is a single-target removal activation; the mass-effect word is a mis-scan here.

kept.name: Proper Burial
kept.why: The entire card is "you gain life equal to that creature's toughness" and the list records the trigger but not the effect. Without eff:gain-life the card looks like a dies-trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Blessing of the Nephilim
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each of its colors. The list has no effect word at all, so a card whose only job is making a creature bigger reads as doing nothing.

kept.name: Intercessor's Arrest
kept.why: Enchanted permanent can't attack, block, or crew, and its activated abilities are switched off. That is exactly turning a permanent into something harmless without destroying it, the Pacifism/Darksteel Mutation shape, which is what makes this a removal spell rather than a random aura.

kept.name: Skeletal Grimace
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 as well as the regenerate ability. The +1/+1 half was never written down.

kept.name: Karai's Technique
kept.why: "Choose one or both" is a modal spell and eff:choose is the word for it. Sneak is an alternative cost paid by returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand, which is what cost:cast-return-to-hand records.

kept.name: Manhole Cover
kept.why: The enters trigger gives a creature indestructible until end of turn, which is a way to keep a creature alive through removal. grants:indestructible records the keyword but not that the card's purpose is protection.

kept.name: Guarded Heir
kept.why: It has lifelink and no life-gain word, while other plain lifelink creatures in the same data (Bishop's Soldier) carry eff:gain-life. The keyword does gain life every time it connects.

kept.name: Vow to Erebor
kept.why: "It gets +2/+2 until end of turn" is half the card and no pump word is recorded; only the untap and the Equipment clause were read.

kept.name: Foot Elite
kept.why: The attack trigger gives another creature you control indestructible until end of turn, which is a way of keeping your creature alive in combat, not only a stat change.

kept.name: Gem of Becoming
kept.why: The ability's cost is {3}, {T}, Sacrifice, and the tap half was never recorded. The effect searches your library for an Island, a Swamp and a Mountain, which is a land fetch out of the library.

kept.name: Fire Nation Salvagers
kept.why: The second ability triggers whenever your creatures with counters deal combat damage to a player, and only the enters trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Tymaret Calls the Dead
kept.why: Chapters I and II create a 2/2 Zombie token and no token-making word is present (tok:zombie is not there either, but the effect word is the part missing from what I may edit). The chapter is also the "you may exile a card, if you do, create" shape that eff:do-if-cost-paid exists for.

kept.name: Hellish Sideswipe
kept.why: It destroys one target creature or Vehicle. scope:all means the effect touches everything; a single-target removal spell is not a mass effect, and the compound "creature or Vehicle" filter appears to have been misread as a global one.

kept.name: Gideon, the Oathsworn
kept.why: The +2 turns Gideon into a 5/5 creature that is still a planeswalker, which is exactly eff:animate and was not recorded. The -9 exiles Gideon himself alongside the opponents' creatures, which is the eff:exile-self case.

kept.name: Blinding Powder
kept.why: The granted ability prevents all combat damage that would be dealt to the equipped creature this turn. Only the attach was recorded, so an Equipment whose whole purpose is keeping a creature alive in combat reads as a blank.

kept.name: Celebrate the Mountain-king
kept.why: Only the enter triggers were recorded and none of what they do. It exiles a nonland permanent per opponent (O-ring removal), and recruit is draw a card, then discard a card, then create a 1/1 Human Soldier token.

kept.name: Mephidross Vampire
kept.why: The granted ability puts a +1/+1 counter on the creature that has it, and Mephidross has that ability too, so it grows itself. The type-changing clause, which is the whole reason the card is played, has no word at all.

kept.name: Sadistic Sacrament
kept.why: The list records only that it looks at a library. Stripping three (or fifteen) cards out of an opponent's library is the card's entire function. eff:mill is the word this engine already uses for exiling from an opponent's library, per Thoughtpicker Witch in this same batch. eff:search-library is deliberately not added: it would file an opponent-library attack as a tutor.

kept.name: Hedron Matrix
kept.why: The equipment's only effect is +X/+X and it was not written down. The list said it attaches and nothing about what attaching does.

kept.name: Thoughtpicker Witch
kept.why: It sacrifices a creature, not itself. It is a repeatable sacrifice outlet, which cost:sacrifice already says correctly; cost:sacrifice-self claims the card eats itself once and would keep it out of the outlet slot an aristocrats deck needs.

kept.name: Agonizing Remorse
kept.why: "You lose 1 life" is a rider on resolution, not an additional cost. cost:life means life is spendable as a resource, which is what a Ad Nauseam or K'rrik deck looks for, and this card offers none. No replacement word is added: the hand half is exile rather than discard, and plain eff:exile would misfile a hand-attack spell as creature removal.

kept.name: Osseous Exhale
kept.why: Five damage to an attacking or blocking creature is the whole card and eff:damage was absent, so the engine could not offer it as an answer at all. The 2 life is conditional on beholding a Dragon, which is the optional additional cost, so eff:do-if-cost-paid is exact.

kept.name: Gravestorm
kept.why: Only the upkeep trigger was recorded. It draws you a card every turn the opponent declines, and it looks at their graveyard. eff:exile-graveyard is deliberately not added: the opponent chooses to exile their own card, and giving this the hate verb would make it read as working against a graveyard deck that would happily play it.

kept.name: Redrock Sentinel
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. It draws one card and makes one Treasure off a single land sacrifice. A false scope:all makes a small value engine look like a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Case of the Gateway Express
kept.why: The enter trigger has every creature you control deal 1 damage to a creature you do not, which is a real removal effect on a wide board and was not written down. Only the solved pump was recorded.

kept.name: Xathrid Gorgon
kept.why: This is a repeatable Song of the Dryads: the target keeps existing but becomes a defender artifact whose abilities cannot be activated. eff:neutralise is exactly that and was missing, so a Gorgon that answers a threat every turn read as a counter-placer. It also grants defender, which is how the target stops attacking.

kept.name: Chancellor of the Dross
kept.why: The drain happens at the beginning of the first upkeep and no trigger word was recorded, so the effect floated with nothing saying when it fires.

kept.name: Virulent Plague
kept.why: -2/-2 makes creatures smaller, it does not pump them. As written the engine read the format's best token sweeper as an anthem, which is the opposite of what it does and would put it in a tokens deck.

kept.name: Sandbender Scavengers
kept.why: "Whenever you sacrifice another permanent" is half the card and had no trigger word, so nothing connected it to a sacrifice outlet. The death trigger was recorded and this one was not.

kept.name: Magus of the Will
kept.why: It is a one-shot Yawgmoth's Will: nothing is returned anywhere, you cast spells and play lands straight out of the graveyard. eff:return-from claims recursion to hand or battlefield and is wrong. Its activation cost, tap and exile itself, was also entirely missing.

kept.name: Soldier of the Pantheon
kept.why: A one-drop with protection from multicolored that gains you 1 life on an opponent's cast affects nothing globally. The word looks like it came from reading "multicolored spell" as a class-wide selector.

kept.name: Bag of Devouring
kept.why: Only the draw ability was recorded. It triggers whenever you sacrifice another artifact or creature, it exiles those permanents of yours, its last ability sacrifices itself, rolls a d10, and returns cards from exile to hand. Nothing here affects everything, so scope:all goes. eff:exile-own rather than eff:exile because the things exiled are your own, and plain eff:exile would file a sacrifice engine as removal.

kept.name: Fey Steed
kept.why: The second ability draws a card whenever an opponent targets your creature or planeswalker and that was not recorded at all. eff:pump is wrong: nothing on this card changes power or toughness, it only grants indestructible, which grants:indestructible already says. Grisly Transformation in this same batch grants a keyword with no P/T change and correctly carries no eff:pump.

kept.name: Sunstar Expansionist
kept.why: The enter trigger creates a Lander token and the token-making verb was missing, so only the token's own search text was recorded. Nothing on the card affects everything; the landfall pump is on itself alone.

kept.name: Candletrap
kept.why: This is a Pacifism: defender plus preventing all its combat damage turns the creature harmless without destroying it, and neither the prevention nor eff:neutralise was recorded. eff:exile-own is wrong and points the wrong way: the coven ability exiles the enchanted creature, which is the opponent's threat, not one of your own permanents being flickered.

kept.name: Gleam of Authority
kept.why: "Gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on other creatures you control" is the reason the card exists and no pump verb was recorded, so a counters-deck payoff read as a plain vigilance aura.

kept.name: Enduring Bondwarden
kept.why: Backup 1 is an enters trigger ("When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature") and neither enters word was recorded. Only the dies half was read.

kept.name: Squire's Lightblade
kept.why: "That creature gains first strike until end of turn" is a grant to another creature and was not written down.

kept.name: Temporary Lockdown
kept.why: It exiles EACH nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less, including your own. Not marked scope:wipe deliberately: it exiles rather than destroys and is restricted by mana value, which is the restriction that turns a sweeper into a filtered answer.

kept.name: Blessed Defiance
kept.why: The whole second sentence was unread: "When that creature dies this turn, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying." That is a death trigger and a token. grants:flying deliberately not added - the flying belongs to the token, it is not granted to your creatures.

kept.name: Cateran Summons
kept.why: The text ends "then shuffle".

kept.name: Liliana's Scrounger
kept.why: "put a loyalty counter on a Liliana planeswalker you control" is a counter placed on another permanent and no effect word was recorded at all. trig:dies deliberately not added: "if a creature died this turn" is an intervening-if condition on an end-step trigger, not a death trigger.

kept.name: Thallid Omnivore
kept.why: "If a Saproling was sacrificed this way, you gain 2 life" was unread.

kept.name: Accorder Paladin
kept.why: Battle cry pumps each other attacking creature (+1/+0). The trigger was recorded but not what it does.

kept.name: Besotted Knight // Betroth the Beast
kept.why: The adventure creates a Royal Role token attached to a creature you control, and the Role gives +1/+1. Only eff:protect (from ward) was recorded, so the token and the attachment were both missing.

kept.name: Detainment Spell
kept.why: "{1}{W}: Attach this Aura to target creature" is an activated re-attach and was unread.

kept.name: Gollum, Riddle Master
kept.why: The trigger is "Whenever an OPPONENT casts a spell". Only the undirected trig:cast was recorded, which reads the same as a card paid for your own casting - the opposite deck.

kept.name: Consulate Crackdown
kept.why: It exiles ALL artifacts your opponents control - a mass effect, and no scope word was recorded.

kept.name: Comet Crawler
kept.why: "you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, this creature gets +2/+0" is exactly an optional cost paying for more. cost:sacrifice deliberately NOT added: this is locked to attacking and is not an on-demand sacrifice outlet, and a false outlet is worse than none.

kept.name: Qutrub Forayer
kept.why: The second mode - "Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard" - was completely unread. That is graveyard hate, which is why it needs eff:exile-graveyard rather than plain eff:exile.

kept.name: Ragged Veins
kept.why: "Whenever enchanted creature is dealt damage" - the trigger itself was missing, only its consequence was recorded.

kept.name: Conductive Machete
kept.why: Manifest dread looks at the top two cards of your library and takes one onto the battlefield. The token and the mill were recorded, the selection was not.

kept.name: Sanctuary Wall
kept.why: The stun counters were entirely unread - one on the tapped creature and one on this creature. Only the tap was recorded.

kept.name: Blood of the Martyr
kept.why: It applies to damage dealt to ANY creature, and its purpose is keeping your creatures alive. Neither the scope nor the protection was recorded.

kept.name: Scolding Administrator
kept.why: The dies trigger moves its counters onto another target creature - counters on a different permanent, which eff:add-counters-self does not say.

kept.name: Student of Warfare
kept.why: Level up puts a level counter on itself and the level bands set its base power and toughness to 3/3 then 4/4. Only the printed counter type and keywords were recorded, so it carried no effect at all.

kept.name: Armageddon Clock
kept.why: The damage goes to EACH player, and no scope word was recorded.

kept.name: Ritual of the Machine
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" is a cast cost, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice tells the engine this is an Ashnod's Altar, which it is not - it eats exactly one creature, once, when cast.

kept.name: Skullcap Snail
kept.why: "target opponent exiles a card from their hand" - the card had a zone word and no effect at all. eff:discard deliberately not used: the card is exiled, not discarded, and the two are different for anything reading a graveyard.

kept.name: Relic Putrescence
kept.why: "its controller gets a poison counter" was entirely unread - the trigger was recorded and its consequence was not.

kept.name: Graceful Reprieve
kept.why: The creature is returned from the graveyard to the battlefield, which is the zone the return is from.

kept.name: Invasion of Ulgrotha // Grandmother Ravi Sengir
kept.why: ADD: the back face triggers "Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies" and no death trigger was recorded. REMOVE: the only counter clause on the card puts a +1/+1 counter on Grandmother Ravi Sengir herself, which eff:add-counters-self already says; the generic word claims it puts counters on other permanents, which it never does.

kept.name: Lunarch Mantle
kept.why: The granted ability is "{1}, Sacrifice a permanent: This creature gains flying" - a repeatable, on-demand sacrifice outlet that the enchanted creature gains. Genuinely an outlet, unlike an additional cast cost.

kept.name: Aspect of Lamprey
kept.why: It grants lifelink to the enchanted creature, so it gains you life. Every other lifelink card in this batch (Knight of Meadowgrain) carries eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Mirror of Fate
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the sacrifice, and the whole card is about your library: it exiles all of it and stacks chosen cards on top. Moving exiled cards back to the library is a zone move, not a return to hand or battlefield.

kept.name: Skybox Ferry
kept.why: Crew 2 is paid by tapping other creatures you control, which nothing on the list records.

kept.name: Blade-Blizzard Kitsune
kept.why: Ninjutsu puts this card onto the battlefield from your hand. cost:return-to-hand records what you pay and nothing records what you get.

kept.name: Divine Sacrament
kept.why: It pumps WHITE creatures specifically. Nothing recorded that the anthem is colour-restricted.

kept.name: Klaw, Master of Sound
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread: it gives itself indestructible when you play a card from exile, and its combat damage trigger exiles the top card of a library face down for you to play, which is exactly impulse draw off an opponent's library.

kept.name: Captain Marvel, Shooting Star
kept.why: Both halves gain life (the exiled creature's controller, then you), and the second ability triggers on a creature leaving the battlefield for exile. None of the lifegain or the zone-change trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Sheriff of Safe Passage
kept.why: Plot exiles this card from your hand as part of its cost, which is unrecorded.

kept.name: Kuro, Pitlord
kept.why: The upkeep trigger sacrifices Kuro itself unless you pay. The list records the trigger timing and the -1/-1 ability but nothing about the card eating itself.

kept.name: Nagao, Bound by Honor
kept.why: Bushido triggers on blocking and on becoming blocked. Only the attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Spirit en-Dal
kept.why: Forecast is activated from your hand and its cost is revealing this card from hand. Neither the zone nor the reveal cost was recorded.

kept.name: Harvestguard Alseids
kept.why: The entire effect - preventing all damage to a creature - was missing, and it is a protection effect. Constellation also triggers on this creature's own entry, not only other enchantments. scope:all came from the words 'all damage'; the effect hits ONE target creature, so it is not a mass effect.

kept.name: Soul Link
kept.why: The card does exactly one thing, gain life, and that was not written down. It also has a second trigger for the creature BEING dealt damage, distinct from the dealing trigger already listed.

kept.name: Clearwater Goblet
kept.why: Sunburst puts charge counters on it for each colour of mana spent to cast it, so it both cares about mana spent and grows itself with counters. Only the lifegain payoff was recorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Furnace
kept.why: The first ability costs {T}, and the card is pure graveyard hate that never recorded caring about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Doomed Artisan
kept.why: The whole first line - Sculptures can't attack or block - was unread, and the token it makes has its power and toughness set by a count rather than printed.

kept.name: Mage Hunter
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on an OPPONENT casting, and specifically on instants and sorceries. Only the bare trig:cast was recorded, which does not say whose spell or which kind.

kept.name: Monk of the Open Hand
kept.why: It puts a counter on itself only. Nothing about this card affects everything, so scope:all is a wrong word that reads it as a mass effect.

kept.name: Zamriel, Seraph of Steel
kept.why: Giving your equipped creatures indestructible on your turn is a keep-your-creatures-alive effect; only the raw grant was recorded.

kept.name: Trusted Pegasus
kept.why: It changes no power or toughness at all - it grants flying, which grants:flying already records. eff:pump is wrong.

kept.name: The Mana Rig
kept.why: It makes Powerstone tokens that tap for mana and neither the token making nor the ramp was recorded. It never exiles anything: the {X}{X}{X} ability looks at the top X and puts cards into HAND, so eff:impulse and cares:zone:exile are both wrong and would file a ramp rock as an exile-matters card.

kept.name: Ascent of the Worthy
kept.why: Chapter III returns the creature with a flying counter on it, which is a counter placement nothing recorded.

kept.name: Stalwarts of Osgiliath
kept.why: The second ability triggers on drawing your second card each turn and no draw trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Stalking Stones
kept.why: It is a manland: {6} turns it into a 3/3 creature. The animation clause was completely unread.

kept.name: Prison Sentence
kept.why: Only the scry was recorded. This is a Pacifism that also shuts off activated abilities, so it turns a permanent harmless without destroying it.

kept.name: Path of the Schemer
kept.why: 'Each player mills two cards' affects everyone, and the Will of the Planeswalkers clause is a vote.

kept.name: Inner Demon
kept.why: The enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying. Both were unread - only the -2/-2 half of the card was recorded.

kept.name: Iname, Death Aspect
kept.why: The search ends by shuffling your library, which is unrecorded.

kept.name: Adipose Offspring
kept.why: Emerge is cast by sacrificing a creature as part of the cost, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Tomb of Urami
kept.why: The second ability makes a 5/5 flying Demon token by sacrificing all your lands. Neither the token nor the sacrifice cost was recorded - only the mana ability and the self-damage were.

kept.name: Harvest Hand // Scrounged Scythe
kept.why: Only the death trigger was read. It returns ITSELF from the graveyard (eff:recur-self, cares:zone:graveyard), and the whole back face was ignored: it is an Equipment that attaches, pumps +1/+1 and grants menace to a Human.

kept.name: The Mountain-king's Return
kept.why: Chapter I makes a 1/1 Human Soldier token if the discarded card was nonland. The draw, discard, reanimation and counter were all recorded; the token was not.

kept.name: Sickleslicer
kept.why: Living weapon is a triggered ability - 'When this Equipment enters, create a Germ token, then attach this to it.' The token and attach were recorded but the enter trigger that causes them was not.

kept.name: Fog on the Barrow-Downs
kept.why: This is a Pacifism variant that also strips creature types: it turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it, which is exactly eff:neutralise (same family as Darksteel Mutation, Lignify, Witness Protection). It is an Aura with 'Enchant creature', so it attaches.

kept.name: Dream Seizer
kept.why: Blight 1 puts a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control. Only the opponents' discard was read; the counter half of the ability produced nothing.

kept.name: Ruin Raider
kept.why: Nobody is drained here - YOU lose life equal to the revealed card's mana value. eff:lose-life reads as a drain payoff and would file a card-advantage engine into an aristocrats deck. The direction word this needs does not exist yet, so it is proposed rather than swapped.

kept.name: The Caves of Androzani
kept.why: Chapters II and III act on EVERY non-Saga permanent on the battlefield, not on a target. Nothing recorded that this is a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Orim's Prayer
kept.why: Nothing on this card taxes anybody. 'Whenever one or more creatures attack you, you gain 1 life for each attacking creature' has no payment clause at all - eff:unless-pays is a misread and would offer this card as an interaction piece.

kept.name: Injector Crocodile
kept.why: Swampcycling's cost is literally '{2}, Discard this card'. The search was recorded but not what it costs, so the card reads as a free tutor.

kept.name: Fire Nation Warship
kept.why: Crew 2 taps other creatures you control to animate this. Air Response Unit in the same batch carries cost:tap-others for the identical mechanic; this one does not.

kept.name: Armory Mice
kept.why: The entire card is '+0/+2 as long as two or more nonland permanents entered under your control this turn' and NOT ONE effect word was recorded. It pumps itself.

kept.name: Savior of Ollenbock
kept.why: Training triggers on attacking, which was missing. The card's main ability exiles a creature from the battlefield OR a creature card from a graveyard and holds it in exile until this leaves - none of exile, graveyard exile or the exile zone was recorded, so an O-Ring-shaped removal creature reads as a counters creature.

kept.name: Paleontologist's Pick-Axe // Dinosaur Headdress
kept.why: Craft's cost is 'Exile this artifact, Exile one or more creatures you control and/or creature cards from your graveyard' - self-exile, exiling other things, and both zones, none recorded. The back face's 'When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control' is an enter trigger that was also missed.

kept.name: Knight of Malice
kept.why: 'This creature gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a white permanent' is the card's only non-keyword line and it produced no effect word at all.

kept.name: Kingpin's Pet
kept.why: Extort triggers on spells YOU cast (trig:cast-own, as Leering Emblem carries for the same wording), and its shape is 'you may pay {W/B}. If you do...' - value gated behind an optional payment.

kept.name: Portcullis
kept.why: Only the exile half was read. The exiled creatures come back when Portcullis leaves the battlefield - a delayed return from exile keyed on this permanent leaving. Without it the card reads as permanent removal rather than a suspended-board lock.

kept.name: The Spear of Bashenga
kept.why: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks the monarch, destroy target tapped nonland permanent' - the destroy was recorded but not that it is an attack trigger.

kept.name: Descendant of Storms
kept.why: 'You may pay {1}{W}. If you do, it endures 1.' The counter and token were read; the optional payment gating them was not.

kept.name: Evershrike's Gift
kept.why: '{1}{W}, Blight 2: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand' is the card bringing ITSELF back (eff:recur-self), paid for by putting two -1/-1 counters on your own creature (cost:add-counters). It is also an Aura with 'Enchant creature', so it attaches.

kept.name: Marble Titan
kept.why: The card reads a creature's power ('power 3 or greater') to decide who it locks down, and nothing recorded that. Its actual effect - stopping permanents untapping - has no word in the vocabulary at all.

kept.name: Guiding Bolt
kept.why: It can only kill a creature with power 4 or greater - the card reads power to decide legality, the same reading Depressurize and Savior of Ollenbock already record.

kept.name: Griffin Canyon
kept.why: The untap was recorded but not the second half of the same ability - 'If it's a creature, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn'. The land also produces only {C} and has no coloured symbol anywhere, so its colour identity is genuinely empty.

kept.name: Council Guardian
kept.why: The whole point of the vote is that this creature gains protection from the winning colour, and no effect word was recorded for it - the card currently reads as a vanilla 5/5 with an enter trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Expert-Level Safe
kept.why: Almost nothing on this card was read. It exiles cards off the top of your own library face down and later puts everything exiled with it into owners' hands, and the ability costs {1} and a tap. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: the cards exiled are your own library, and eff:exile would file this as a removal spell.

kept.name: Liberated Livestock
kept.why: The death trigger creates THREE tokens and none was recorded - the card carries no effect word whatsoever. It then puts Aura cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield attached to those tokens, which is a hand cheat, an Aura reanimation and an attach all in one clause.

kept.name: Agadeem Occultist
kept.why: The reanimation was read but not that it costs a tap, so the ability reads as free and repeatable at will.

kept.name: Silent Gravestone
kept.why: This is a graveyard hate artifact and NOTHING about graveyards was recorded - only the draw at the end. It protects every graveyard from targeting and then exiles itself along with all cards from ALL graveyards.

kept.name: Consuming Ashes
kept.why: kw:surveil is present as a printed keyword but the effect word is missing, so the card reads as exile-only. Foraging Wickermaw in the same batch carries both for the same wording.

kept.name: Kinsbaile Borderguard
kept.why: The death trigger makes a Kithkin Soldier token for each counter on it and no word says the card makes tokens at all. Only the enters-with-counters half was read.

kept.name: Fear of Abduction
kept.why: Two whole clauses unread: exiling a creature you control is an additional cost to cast, and the leaves trigger returns every card exiled with it to its owner's hand. The card parks cards in exile and fetches them back, so exile is a zone it genuinely works with.

kept.name: Captain America, Unbowed
kept.why: Handing your Soldiers and Heroes indestructible is the definition of keeping your creatures alive. grants:indestructible says which keyword; nothing said what the card is for.

kept.name: March of Souls
kept.why: The second sentence, which is half the card, was never read: every destroyed creature's controller gets a 1/1 flying Spirit.

kept.name: Pilgrim of the Ages
kept.why: {6}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand is self-recursion. eff:return-from is generic and does not say the card buys itself back.

kept.name: Sunspear Shikari
kept.why: It gains first strike AND lifelink while equipped. grants:first strike was recorded and its twin was dropped.

kept.name: Ruthless Negotiation
kept.why: The main clause, target opponent exiles a card from their hand, produced no effect word at all. Only the conditional draw was read.

kept.name: Deathless Pilot
kept.why: {3}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand. eff:return-from does not distinguish buying itself back from returning something else.

kept.name: Sinister Possession
kept.why: The trigger is on attacking OR blocking and only the blocking half was recorded.

kept.name: High Fae Negotiator
kept.why: Bargain is sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token as an additional cost to cast, and the whole enters trigger is conditional on having paid it. kw:bargain names the keyword; nothing recorded the sacrifice.

kept.name: Grand Master of Flowers
kept.why: At seven loyalty he becomes a 7/7 creature, which is the card's whole plan and had no word (eff:set-pt was recorded without eff:animate, so the engine knew the size and not that it is a creature). He also gains indestructible, both abilities cost loyalty counters the way Kaya's minus does, and the second +1 searches your library.

kept.name: Archangel of Strife
kept.why: Each player chooses war or peace as it enters, and which they pick decides what the anthem does. The choice itself was unread.

kept.name: Treacherous Urge
kept.why: The last sentence sacrifices the stolen creature at the next end step. It is what makes this a temporary theft rather than a permanent one and it was unread.

kept.name: Treacherous Pit-Dweller
kept.why: The enters trigger, which is the drawback the card is built around, produced no trigger word, and it fires only when the creature enters from a graveyard. Undying also returns it from the graveyard to the battlefield by itself, which is exactly eff:recur-self.

kept.name: Restless Dreams
kept.why: Discarding X cards is an additional cost to cast and sets X for the reanimation. eff:discard-self says you discard; nothing said it was the price of casting.

kept.name: Champion of the Clachan
kept.why: Beholding and exiling a Kithkin is an additional cost to cast, and the leaves trigger returns the exiled card to its owner's hand. Only the anthem and the trigger's existence were read, not what the trigger does.

kept.name: Soul Tithe
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on upkeep and the sacrifice only happens unless the controller pays X, which is a tax rather than an unconditional sacrifice. trig:step alone loses the timing and eff:sacrifice alone overstates it.

kept.name: Tundra Tank
kept.why: Firebending triggers on attacking and produces the mana that is recorded, but the attack trigger itself was not. Granting a creature indestructible is keeping your creatures alive.

kept.name: Entomber Exarch
kept.why: It is a modal enters trigger, choose one. Both modes were read and the choice between them was not.

kept.name: Gideon's Phalanx
kept.why: Spell mastery gives every creature you control indestructible, a mass effect that keeps your board alive. Only the keyword grant was recorded, with nothing saying it hits the whole team or what it is for.

kept.name: Blessing of Belzenlok
kept.why: The conditional half of the card, lifelink if the target is legendary, was unread.

kept.name: Myth Realized
kept.why: The {W} ability turns this enchantment into a Monk Avatar creature whose power and toughness equal its lore counters. That is the entire payoff and neither the animation nor the P/T setting was recorded.

kept.name: Apostle of Invasion
kept.why: It gains double strike under the Corrupted condition, recorded only as the bare keyword. The condition itself, which is what makes it an infect payoff, has no word available.

kept.name: Wall of Mourning
kept.why: Two whole clauses are unread. It exiles cards off the top of YOUR library face down (library and exile zones), and the Coven trigger later moves one of those exiled cards to its owner's hand, which is a zone move and a return. Deliberately NOT eff:exile: that word is the removal verb, and filing a self-stash as removal would offer this card as an answer to a threat.

kept.name: Celestial Judgment
kept.why: It destroys EACH creature not chosen, yours included, so it is a board wipe and not merely a mass effect. Only one creature per distinct power survives. scope:all alone cannot tell a symmetric wipe from a global pump.

kept.name: Midnight Angel Armor
kept.why: The enters trigger creates a 1/1 white Soldier token before attaching. eff:attach was read and the token half of the same sentence was not.

kept.name: Scourge of the Undercity
kept.why: It has lifelink printed, so it gains life when it deals damage. Mold Folk in this same batch carries eff:gain-life off lifelink, so this is an omission rather than a convention.

kept.name: Binding Negotiation
kept.why: Only the discard half was read. The second sentence puts a face-up EXILED card the opponent owns into their GRAVEYARD, which is a zone move and touches two zones nothing recorded.

kept.name: Sudden Salvation
kept.why: There is no triggered ability on this card at all. It is an instant that targets permanent cards already in graveyards; 'put there from the battlefield this turn' is a targeting restriction, not a dies trigger. Everything else is correct.

kept.name: Veil of Assimilation
kept.why: The trigger reads 'Whenever THIS artifact or another artifact you control enters', so it fires on its own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded, which says it needs a second artifact.

kept.name: Intermediate Chirography
kept.why: The Level 2 ability is 'Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn' and no trigger word covered it. Not adding trig:dies for Level 3: 'if a modified creature died this turn' is an intervening-if condition on an end step trigger, not a dies trigger.

kept.name: Leshrac's Sigil
kept.why: 'you may pay {B}{B}. If you do, ...' is the optional-cost-then-effect shape exactly, and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Magnetic Snuffler
kept.why: The enters trigger returns an Equipment card from YOUR GRAVEYARD to the battlefield. eff:attach caught only the 'attached to this creature' tail; the recursion itself and the graveyard zone were both unread. This is a genuine reanimation effect.

kept.name: Hidden Retreat
kept.why: The activation cost puts a card from your HAND on top of your LIBRARY, and the effect targets an instant or sorcery SPELL on the stack. Only the damage prevention was read; all three zones were missed.

kept.name: Starfighter Pilot
kept.why: Surveil looks at the top of your library and may put it into your graveyard. Those are real zone signals for a graveyard deck, and only the bare eff:surveil was recorded.

kept.name: Distress
kept.why: This is a targeted discard spell aimed at an opponent, not self-discard. Binding Negotiation in this same batch, which is the same effect worded with 'target opponent', correctly carries eff:discard alone. Leaving eff:discard-self on makes it look like a madness or reanimator enabler.

kept.name: Liminal Hold
kept.why: It exiles a nonland permanent until this enchantment leaves, so exile is where the card sits. Not adding a leaves trigger: the modern 'until this leaves' wording is a duration on the one enters trigger, not a second triggered ability.

kept.name: Monoskelion
kept.why: The activation cost is 'Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature'. The counters going ON were read and the cost taking them OFF was not, which is the whole reason the card is a repeatable damage outlet in a counters deck.

kept.name: Mudbutton Cursetosser
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' is a printed line of rules text with no facet at all against it.

kept.name: Safe Haven
kept.why: The upkeep half returns EACH CARD EXILED WITH THIS LAND to the battlefield. Only the exiling half was read, so the land currently reads as a way to remove your own creatures with no way back.

kept.name: The Fantasticar
kept.why: Three separate effects were entirely unread. It creates FOUR 4/4 Construct tokens, it turns itself into an artifact creature until end of turn (animate), and it sacrifices itself to do so. The card currently carries no effect verb whatsoever.

kept.name: Sunspring Expedition
kept.why: The payoff ability costs 'Remove three quest counters from this enchantment and sacrifice it'. Only the counter accumulation and the life gain were read, not either half of what pays for it.

kept.name: Consecrate // Consume
kept.why: The front half exiles a card from a graveyard, which eff:exile-graveyard records but no zone word did.

kept.name: Heirloom Mirror // Inherited Fiend
kept.why: 'remove them and TRANSFORM it' is the whole point of the front face and only the printed kw:transform was there. The back face's '{2}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard' is graveyard hate that nothing recorded, and both faces touch the graveyard (mill, then exiling from it).

kept.name: Loxodon Lifechanter
kept.why: 'you may have your life total BECOME the total toughness of creatures you control' sets a life total, which is a different thing from gaining life and has its own word. Only the activated pump was read.

kept.name: Infernal Darkness
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep, so the bare trig:step needed its step. 'If a land is tapped for mana' is a replacement on tapping for mana and trig:tapped-for-mana is the nearest existing word for it, but see the proposal - the effect half is unsayable.

kept.name: Kagemaro, First to Suffer
kept.why: Both halves of the card count cards in your hand - its P/T and the size of the -X/-X sweep - so hand size is the thing it cares about and nothing recorded that. The scope:wipe is correct: a symmetric mass -X/-X is a board wipe.

kept.name: Dreamdrinker Vampire
kept.why: "it gains menace until end of turn" was not written down at all - the only evasion the card has is unrecorded.

kept.name: Glass Casket
kept.why: The exile lasts "until this artifact leaves the battlefield", which is a linked leave trigger returning the creature. The record read the enters half and stopped (rec:partial), so the card looks like permanent exile when it is not.

kept.name: Glint-Sleeve Siphoner
kept.why: The card's entire payoff - "you draw a card" - was missing, so a two-mana repeatable draw engine read as an energy counter with no use. "You may pay {E}{E}. If you do" is exactly the pay-for-more shape.

kept.name: Soul Stair Expedition
kept.why: The activation cost - remove three quest counters AND sacrifice it - was entirely unrecorded, so a one-shot sacrifice engine read as a free repeatable recursion. scope:all is wrong: the card returns up to two target cards and affects nothing globally, and a false scope:all next to cares:type:creature is what makes a graveyard enchantment look like a sweeper.

kept.name: Illumination
kept.why: It counters a spell, which is a stack interaction, and that zone was not recorded.

kept.name: Murdock's Crusade
kept.why: It is a modal spell ("choose one", both with teamwork) and nothing recorded the choice. Teamwork is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, so it belongs on the cast-cost word alongside cost:cast-sacrifice and cost:cast-life; cost:tap-others is the activated-ability tap cost (correct on Ruthless Waterbender's waterbend, wrong here).

kept.name: Unmask
kept.why: "You may exile a black card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is the alternative cost that defines this card, and it was unrecorded - the free-spell half of a Force of Will shaped card.

kept.name: Airlift Chaplain
kept.why: It mills three and then takes a Plains or a cheap creature from among them into your hand. Only the mill was recorded, so the card reads as pure self-mill when it is self-mill plus selection out of the graveyard.

kept.name: Tatsumasa, the Dragon's Fang
