kept.why: "Exile Tatsumasa" is the activation cost and was unrecorded, so the token looked free and repeatable. "Return Tatsumasa to the battlefield when that token dies" is a genuine dies trigger and was also missing.

kept.name: Divine Intervention
kept.why: It enters with two counters ON ITSELF and removes them from itself. Only the generic eff:add-counters was present, which reads as putting counters on other things.

kept.name: Patron of the Nezumi
kept.why: Rat offering is an alternative cast cost that sacrifices a Rat, and nothing recorded it - the card looked like a plain seven-drop. Its trigger watches permanents going to opponents' graveyards, so the graveyard zone belongs on it too.

kept.name: Legion Vanguard
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and decides from it; the library was not recorded. I have deliberately not added cares:zone:library-land - explore keeps a land rather than searching for one, and calling it a land tutor would make this a ramp card.

kept.name: Unnatural Endurance
kept.why: "Regenerate it" is the reason to play the card - a combat trick that keeps a creature alive - and only the +2/+0 was recorded. Not adding col:none: devoid removes colour but the {B} in the cost keeps the colour identity black.

kept.name: Phyrexian Missionary
kept.why: Kicker with "if it was kicked" is precisely the pay-more-get-more shape and nothing recorded the conditional half.

kept.name: Black Widow, Intel Expert
kept.why: The card's only real ability draws four cards across two players and eff:draw was missing entirely, so a repeatable draw engine had no effect word at all. I have not added eff:draw-each: only the damaged opponent draws, not every player.

kept.name: Rath's Edge
kept.why: It taps for {C} and has no coloured symbol anywhere, so its colour identity is genuinely empty. scope:all is wrong - it deals 1 damage to ONE any target and touches nothing else on the board.

kept.name: Patrician's Scorn
kept.why: "If you've cast another white spell this turn, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost" is the whole reason this card is played and neither the white-spells condition nor the free cast was recorded.

kept.name: Volatile Rig
kept.why: Losing the first coin flip sacrifices the creature; the sacrifice was unrecorded. Left scope:all in place - 4 damage to each creature and each player really is board-wide.

kept.name: Blind Hunter
kept.why: The drain triggers on "when this creature enters OR the creature it haunts dies" and only the dies half was recorded, so the immediate half of a two-for-one was invisible. Haunt exiles the card itself when it dies, which is also unrecorded.

kept.name: Devoted Caretaker
kept.why: The card had NO effect word at all - only the cares words from the spell types it protects against. It is a repeatable protection engine: {W}, {T} is a tap cost, and it grants protection to keep your permanent alive.

kept.name: Bone Picker
kept.why: The record was completely empty of effects. "This spell costs {3} less to cast if a creature died this turn" is the entire card - a one-mana 3/2 flier with deathtouch in a deck that sacrifices - and the cost reduction was unsaid.

kept.name: Sly Requisitioner
kept.why: The trigger watches artifacts going to the GRAVEYARD from the battlefield and that zone was missing. Improvise taps your artifacts to help cast it, which is a cast-time cost nothing recorded.

kept.name: Necrotic Plague
kept.why: The card returns ITSELF from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield every time the enchanted creature dies - that endless recursion is the whole card and none of it was recorded. The ability it grants triggers at the beginning of upkeep, which was also unread.

kept.name: Stone by Sunlight
kept.why: It is a modal spell and the choice was unrecorded. The second mode grants indestructible to save a creature, which is a protection trick.

kept.name: Didgeridoo
kept.why: It puts ONE Minotaur card from your hand onto the battlefield. Nothing about it is board-wide, and a false scope:all makes a narrow tribal cheat look like a mass effect.

kept.name: Veteran Survivor
kept.why: The +3/+3 was entirely unrecorded, and so were both zones it works across - it exiles from a GRAVEYARD and then counts the cards exiled with it. I have deliberately NOT added grants:hexproof: it grants hexproof only to itself, and that word currently confers the protection role, which would file a graveyard-hate creature as a way to protect your commander.

kept.name: Waste Management
kept.why: The last sentence makes a 2/2 Rogue token for each creature card exiled, and eff:create-token was missing entirely. cost:exile is wrong: nothing is exiled as a COST here (the only additional cost is the kicker, which is mana). The exiling is the spell's effect, already recorded as eff:exile-graveyard.

kept.name: The Spot, Living Portal
kept.why: The enters trigger exiles a nonland permanent (real removal, eff:exile) AND a permanent card from a graveyard (eff:exile-graveyard, which this vocabulary deliberately keeps apart from eff:exile). Neither verb was recorded, so the engine could see the return half and not the removal half. cares:zone:exile because the death trigger reads back the cards it put in exile.

kept.name: Sorceress Queen
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and cost:tap was missing. "has base power and toughness 0/2" is exactly eff:set-pt; only eff:neutralise was recorded, which says the outcome but not the mechanism.

kept.name: Doombot Harbinger
kept.why: The death trigger returns a creature card from the graveyard to your HAND, and only cares:zone:graveyard was recorded. Consistent with how Brilliant Halo and Distended Mindbender are keyed in this same batch.

kept.name: Death Pits of Rath
kept.why: The card is one trigger and carried no trigger word at all: "Whenever a creature is dealt damage" is trig:dealt-damage. scope:all because it watches EVERY creature on the battlefield, both players', not a target.

kept.name: Karma
kept.why: It triggers on each player's upkeep and damages each of them in turn, so its reach is global rather than targeted. eff:damage and the upkeep step words were already right.

kept.name: Trapped in the Tower
kept.why: This is a Pacifism variant: the creature survives but can no longer attack, block or use activated abilities. That is precisely "turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it", and without the word the engine cannot count this as removal at all.

kept.name: Midnight Recovery
kept.why: The spell returns a creature card to your hand and cares:zone:hand was missing. Cipher lets the encoded card be cast "without paying its mana cost", which is eff:cast-free; the engine already read eff:copy off the same reminder text, so it is reading cipher and stopped halfway.

kept.name: Pristine Angel
kept.why: "it has protection from artifacts and from each color" is a granted protection keyword and no grants: word was recorded. This is the whole reason the card is played and the list said nothing about it.

kept.name: Deadlock Trap
kept.why: The activated ability's cost is "{T}, Pay {E}" and cost:tap was missing, so the engine did not know the tapper needs to tap.

kept.name: Gnarled Scarhide
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +2/+1" is a pump and no pump word was present. "This creature can't block" is a restriction on ITSELF, which is eff:cant-block-self; only the bestowed eff:cant-block was recorded, so the drawback on its own body was invisible.

kept.name: Evernight Shade
kept.why: Undying returns this creature from the graveyard to the battlefield when it dies. eff:recur-self is glossed exactly "brings itself back from the graveyard", and trig:dies is the trigger. The engine already read the +1/+1 counter out of the undying reminder text, so it saw the counter and missed the recursion.

kept.name: Urgoros, the Empty One
kept.why: "If the player can't, you draw a card" is a real draw clause that was dropped. cares:zone:hand for the random discard, matching how Confessor and Distended Mindbender are keyed.

kept.name: Helm of Chatzuk
kept.why: Granting banding changes no power or toughness. eff:pump says the card makes creatures bigger, which would put this in enhance slots on a false claim. grants:banding already says what it does.

kept.name: Distended Mindbender
kept.why: Emerge is an alternative cast cost paid by sacrificing a creature, which is exactly cost:cast-sacrifice (an additional/alternative cost to CAST, as opposed to an on-demand outlet). Nothing recorded the sacrifice at all.

kept.name: Terror Ballista
kept.why: "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature" eats another permanent on demand each combat, which is the outlet sense of cost:sacrifice. eff:sacrifice alone reads as a card that makes someone sacrifice, not as a repeatable outlet an aristocrats deck wants.

kept.name: Necrogen Spellbomb
kept.why: Both abilities work on hands (a forced discard and a draw) and no hand word was recorded.

kept.name: Favored Hoplite
kept.why: Heroic does two things and only the counter was written down. "prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn" is eff:prevent-damage, and it is half the card's value in combat.

kept.name: The Kingpin of Crime
kept.why: Extort triggers on spells YOU cast. Only the generic trig:cast was present; trig:cast-own is the word that distinguishes a spellslinger payoff from a stax trigger on opponents' spells.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: White
kept.why: The card's entire text is a damage prevention shield and it carried NO effect word at all: the list was acost, a colour and a mana value. eff:prevent-damage is the whole card.

kept.name: Decoy Ploy
kept.why: "Choose one or both" is a modal spell, which is eff:choose. Both modes return a card to your hand, so cares:zone:hand belongs alongside cares:zone:graveyard.

kept.name: Silverskin Armor
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1" and no pump word was recorded, so an equipment whose main line is a stat boost read as doing nothing to power and toughness.

kept.name: Frenzy Sliver
kept.why: Frenzy 1 gives an unblocked Sliver +1/+0 until end of turn. The list had the trigger and the tribe but no effect, so the card read as doing nothing.

kept.name: Xathrid Demon
kept.why: The upkeep trigger sacrifices a creature and drains each opponent for the sacrificed creature's POWER. Neither the sacrifice nor the power-scaling was written down; only eff:lose-life survived.

kept.name: Deathless Angel
kept.why: It grants indestructible, it does not change power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong (every correct eff:pump in this batch is a P/T buff). Granting indestructible to a creature is exactly 'keeps your creatures alive'.

kept.name: Grave Birthing
kept.why: Three of its four clauses were unrecorded: it is graveyard hate, it makes a token, and the printed token text is 'Sacrifice this token: Add {C}', so it produces mana. Only the cantrip was read.

kept.name: Hunt for Specimens
kept.why: The token it makes carries 'When this token dies, you gain 1 life'. The engine already read eff:gain-life out of that clause, so the matching death trigger belongs with it.

kept.name: Kayla's Reconstruction
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top. It looks at seven, puts cards straight onto the battlefield from the library, and bottoms the rest. eff:impulse would file a white reanimator-style spell as red impulse draw.

kept.name: Auxiliary Boosters
kept.why: Its enters trigger creates a 2/2 Robot token and attaches to it. The attach half was recorded and the token half was not.

kept.name: Wreck Hunter
kept.why: The whole card was unread apart from its type line: it makes a Powerstone token per nonland card put into a graveyard this turn, and the printed reminder text is '{T}: Add {C}'.

kept.name: Ruthless Sniper
kept.why: It puts a -1/-1 counter, which is putting a counter (Torment of Venom in this batch carries eff:add-counters for exactly that), and 'you may pay {1}. If you do' is the pay-for-more template.

kept.name: Veteran's Armaments
kept.why: The granted ability is a scaling pump that fires on attack or block, and none of the three was written down; only the attach and the Soldier trigger were.

kept.name: Skyship Weatherlight
kept.why: It shuffles after the search, stashes the cards in exile, and its activated ability returns one of them to hand. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: the exile is a self-stash, and eff:exile confers the removal role, which would file this as an answer.

kept.name: Ajani's Response
kept.why: 'This spell costs {3} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature' is a real cost reduction and produced no word at all; only the destroy clause was read.

kept.name: Ego Drain
kept.why: The card's main effect - the opponent discards the card you choose - was entirely unrecorded. The list held only what the card mentions, never what it does.

kept.name: Echo of Dusk
kept.why: Descend 4 gives it +1/+1 as well as lifelink. The lifelink half was read and the P/T half was not.

kept.name: Chittering Rats
kept.why: The list had a trigger and no effect. Putting a card from hand on top of library is a zone move between two zones the card never named as facets.

kept.name: Kor Entanglers
kept.why: The rally trigger reads 'whenever this creature OR another Ally you control enters', so it fires on its own arrival too. Only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Baleful Beholder
kept.why: It is a modal enters trigger and the second mode gives your whole team menace. Only the first mode's sacrifice was read.

kept.name: Diregraf Horde
kept.why: The reflexive trigger exiles up to two cards from graveyards, which is real graveyard hate and was missing entirely.

kept.name: Bonds of Faith
kept.why: The +2/+2 on a Human was not recorded; only the downside half (can't attack or block) was. Not adding eff:neutralise: the pacifism is conditional on the target not being a Human, so offering this as removal would be wrong more often than right.

kept.name: Perfect Intimidation
kept.why: 'Choose one or both' is a modal spell and nothing said so.

kept.name: Torment of Venom
kept.why: Three -1/-1 counters make the creature smaller, which is how this kills things, and the rider is the classic 'loses life unless they sacrifice or discard' tax. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Attack-in-the-Box
kept.why: The list had a trigger and no effect at all. The attack trigger gives it +4/+0. Not adding a sacrifice word: it eats only itself and as a delayed effect rather than a cost, and eff:sacrifice would read as an edict.

kept.name: Beckon Apparition
kept.why: It exiles a card from a graveyard; eff:exile-graveyard was recorded but the zone it cares about was not.

kept.name: Back on Track
kept.why: It creates a 1/1 Pilot token as well as reanimating. Only the reanimation was read.

kept.name: Sengir Vampire
kept.why: The trigger is a creature dying and that was missing. The counter goes on ITSELF, so the generic word reads Sengir Vampire as a counters-matters card and would offer it to a Hardened Scales deck; the -self word is the one that is true.

kept.name: Summon the School
kept.why: "Tap four untapped Merfolk you control: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is an activated self-return from the graveyard. eff:return-from is present but the self-recursion is the point of the card.

kept.name: Lens of Clarity
kept.why: Its only real ability is "You may look at the top card of your library ... any time". The list carries no facet at all for that, so a top-of-library-matters card reads as doing nothing.

kept.name: Halo Scarab
kept.why: The activated ability creates a Treasure token. eff:add-mana was taken from the Treasure reminder text but the token creation itself was never recorded.

kept.name: Pallid Mycoderm
kept.why: "Sacrifice a Saproling:" is a real on-demand sacrifice outlet eating another creature, and the pump is a filtered mass pump of your Fungi and Saprolings, the same shape that carries scope:all on Fortifying Provisions and Soraya the Falconer.

kept.name: Gerrard Capashen
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 1 life for each card in target opponent's hand" is half the card and no lifegain word was recorded.

kept.name: Give No Ground
kept.why: The list is type:instant alone. "Target creature gets +2/+6 until end of turn" is a pump and nothing records it.

kept.name: Liliana's Indignation
kept.why: The payoff counts "each creature card put into your graveyard this way", so it is a self-mill graveyard payoff, not just a mill spell.

kept.name: Down, Down to Goblin-town
kept.why: Chapter I is "Target opponent reveals their hand ... That player discards that card". Temporal Intervention carries eff:discard for word-for-word the same clause; this one does not.

kept.name: Dread Slaver
kept.why: "Whenever a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies" is a death trigger with no trig:dies, and returning that creature to the battlefield under your control is taking a permanent off its owner, which is what the card is played for.

kept.name: Strandwalker
kept.why: Living weapon is an enters trigger: "When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 Germ, then attach this to it." The token and the attach were both recorded but the trigger that causes them was not.

kept.name: Sickening Shoal
kept.why: "You may exile a black card with mana value X from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is an alternative casting cost paid by exiling, exactly the shape Lashknife records with cost:cast-tap-others.

kept.name: Shinewend
kept.why: The destroy ability costs "{1}{W}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature". The counters going on were recorded and the counter being spent was not.

kept.name: Boon of Erebos
kept.why: "Regenerate it" is the reason the card is cast: it keeps a targeted creature alive through removal or combat. Nothing in the list says the card protects anything.

kept.name: Iona's Blessing
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2" is unrecorded; only the vigilance grant is there.

kept.name: Relic Axe
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1. If it's a Warrior, it gets +2/+1 instead." No pump word at all, though the attach and the Warrior care were both recorded.

kept.name: Inevitable End
kept.why: The granted ability is "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature." eff:sacrifice was already taken from that granted ability, so the recurring upkeep timing that drives it belongs with it.

kept.name: Oathsworn Knight
kept.why: The whole third line - "prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it" - is unrecorded. It is a damage prevention replacement effect that spends its own counters, which is what makes the card durable.

kept.name: Queen Mother Ramonda
kept.why: "As long as you're the monarch, creatures with power 2 or less can't attack you" is a real attack restriction and half the card; only the monarch clause was recorded.

kept.name: It Doesn't Add Up
kept.why: "Suspect it" gives the reanimated creature menace, which the card genuinely grants. Deliberately not adding eff:cant-block, the other half of suspect: that word is used for stopping an OPPONENT's blocker and reading it here would file a reanimation spell as combat interaction.

kept.name: Clever Lumimancer
kept.why: Magecraft is "Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +2/+2". The pump is missing entirely, the trigger is recorded only as the bare trig:cast so nothing says it is YOUR spells, and the two specific spell-type triggers that make it a spellslinger card are absent.

kept.name: Merchant of Many Hats
kept.why: "{2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is an activated self-return; the card's entire function is recurring itself and only the generic eff:return-from was recorded.

kept.name: Mimic
kept.why: "{2}: This artifact becomes a Shapeshifter artifact creature with base power and toughness 3/3" is a whole ability the list does not mention. It animates itself and sets a base P/T.

kept.name: Servant of Tymaret
kept.why: "{2}{B}: Regenerate this creature" is unrepresented. Poultice Sliver in this same batch carries eff:protect for regenerate, so this is the established word for it.

kept.name: Predator, Flagship
kept.why: "{2}: Target creature gains flying" changes no power or toughness. grants:flying already carries the real information; eff:pump makes a card that boosts nothing surface as a combat pump.

kept.name: Goldmeadow Nomad
kept.why: Its only ability is activated by exiling it from the graveyard, so the graveyard is where this card lives and works. cost:exile-self is recorded but the zone is not. Garza's Assassin and Spider-Slayer in this batch both carry both words for the same shape.

kept.name: Search Party Captain
kept.why: "This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature you attacked with this turn" is half the card and produced nothing. A self cost reduction is what eff:reduce-cost is for.

kept.name: Garza's Assassin
kept.why: Recover is read only as eff:return-from. It triggers when another of your creatures is put into your graveyard from the battlefield (trig:dies), it returns THIS card from the graveyard (eff:recur-self, which is the word for a card that brings itself back), and the cost is paying half your life (cost:life).

kept.name: Heartseeker
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+1. The destroy half is recorded and the stat boost is not.

kept.name: Meanders Guide
kept.why: "you may tap another untapped Merfolk you control" is the pivot of the whole ability and nothing records it. eff:tap-own is exactly taps-your-own-permanents.

kept.name: Trostani's Judgment
kept.why: Populate is literally "create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control". eff:create-token records that a token appears; eff:copy records that it is a copy of something you already have, which is what makes the card work.

kept.name: Goldwarden's Helm
kept.why: For Mirrodin! is an enters trigger: "When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it." The token and the attach are recorded but the trigger that causes them is not.

kept.name: Scathing Shadelock // Venomous Words
kept.why: The entire back half is unread. Venomous Words gives target creature you control +2/+0 and deathtouch until end of turn, and the list contains neither.

kept.name: Brain in a Jar
kept.why: Two thirds of the first ability is missing. It puts a charge counter on itself, and it casts an instant or sorcery from your hand WITHOUT PAYING ITS MANA COST, which is the reason anybody plays the card. Only the scry from the second ability was read.

kept.name: Shell Skulkin
kept.why: It can only target a BLUE creature, which is a real colour restriction and the only thing narrowing the card. Meanwhile eff:pump is wrong: granting shroud alters no power or toughness, and grants:shroud already says what the card does.

kept.name: Foul Renewal
kept.why: The second sentence, "Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn", is the removal half of the card and produced nothing. rec:partial confirms the reading stopped after the reanimation clause.

kept.name: Transcendent Master
kept.why: Level up {1} is "Put a level counter on this". ctr:level records that level counters exist on it; nothing records that the card puts them there itself.

kept.name: Syndicate Enforcer
kept.why: Extort triggers "whenever YOU cast a spell". trig:cast is present but not the direction, and the direction is the whole point: this is a payoff for your own spells, not a punisher of opponents'.

kept.name: Nightshade Stinger
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is one of only two lines on the card and is entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Withercrown
kept.why: "Enchanted creature has base power 0" sets a base power. eff:neutralise records the outcome but not that the mechanism is a base P/T change, which matters because it is beaten differently from a shrink.

kept.name: Poultice Sliver
kept.why: "ALL Slivers have ..." grants the ability to every Sliver on the battlefield, including opponents'. The list reads it as a single-creature effect.

kept.name: Squee's Toy
kept.why: The card has exactly one ability and the list contains no effect word at all: "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn." Both the tap cost and the prevention are missing.

kept.name: Priest of the Wakening Sun
kept.why: "you gain 2 life" is unrecorded although it is the whole payoff of the upkeep trigger, and the reveal comes from your hand. scope:all is wrong: nothing on this card touches a group. It reveals one card, gains 2 life, and tutors one card.

kept.name: Plated Onslaught
kept.why: Affinity for artifacts makes the spell cost {1} less for each artifact you control. That is a cost reduction and nothing records it.

kept.name: Heaven's Gate
kept.why: The card's entire text is about the colour white and the list carries only its mana value and card type.

kept.name: Spider-Slayer, Hatred Honed
kept.why: The second ability creates TWO tapped 1/1 Robot artifact creature tokens with flying and the list does not say the card makes tokens at all. Only the damage trigger was read.

kept.name: Final Flourish
kept.why: Kicker here is an additional cost paid by sacrificing an artifact or creature as you cast it, which is precisely cost:cast-sacrifice. Nothing records that this card eats a permanent, which is how an aristocrats deck would find it.

kept.name: Desperate Farmer // Depraved Harvester
kept.why: "When another creature you control dies, transform this creature." kw:transform is the printed keyword; eff:transform records that the card actually turns itself over, which is the effect of the trigger.

kept.name: Hero of the Dunes
kept.why: The second line, "Creatures you control with mana value 3 or less get +1/+0", is a static anthem over your whole board and produced nothing. rec:partial confirms the reading stopped after the enters trigger.

kept.name: Empyrial Storm
kept.why: "When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you've cast your commander" is a cast trigger that copies the spell, and neither the trigger nor the copying was recorded. Only the token half of the card was read.

kept.name: Deep Goblin Skulltaker
kept.why: Descend checks whether a permanent card was put into your graveyard this turn. The card's whole condition is a graveyard check and nothing said so.

kept.name: Uneasy Alliance
kept.why: "Enchanted creature can't attack or block" produced nothing. That clause is the card: it turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it, which is what eff:neutralise names, and it is why this is a removal aura rather than a token maker.

kept.name: Roads Go Ever, Ever On
kept.why: Only chapter I's lifegain was read. I also searches the library for two basic Plains, exiles them and shuffles; II and III return an exiled card to hand; IV pumps a creature by +1/+1 for each Plains. Six of the card's seven effects were missing.

kept.name: Woolly Razorback
kept.why: "Prevent all combat damage it would deal and it has defender" produced neither word. Only the counter bookkeeping was read. Self-grants are recorded elsewhere in this data (Songbird grants:flying to itself), so grants:defender is consistent.

kept.name: Mindlash Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability is "{1}, Sacrifice this permanent: Each player discards a card", so every Sliver including this one can eat itself for value. The sacrifice cost was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Exquisite Huntmaster
kept.why: Encore was read as a bare keyword. It exiles the card from your graveyard as a cost and creates token copies of it, so the card keeps producing bodies from the graveyard after it dies. Only the dies-trigger token was recorded.

kept.name: Morkrut Necropod
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. "Sacrifice another creature or land" hits exactly one permanent you control, so scope:all is a false mass-effect signal, most likely read off the "creature or land" disjunction.

kept.name: Bereaved Survivor // Dauntless Avenger
kept.why: The front face transforms itself and that verb was missing; the back face's reanimation is on an attack trigger, which was never recorded even though eff:return-from was. Mana value is 2 ({1}{W}) so it is cheap; the row carries no cost, which is why that was lost. scope:all has no supporting clause - a dies trigger watching your creatures is not a mass effect.

kept.name: Dub
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2" was not read at all. Only the first strike grant survived, so the largest aura pump in the batch reads as a keyword granter.

kept.name: Antler Skulkin
kept.why: The ability can only target a white creature, which is a real colour restriction the card is built around and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Skyblinder Staff
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+0" produced nothing. Only the evasion clause was read.

kept.name: Sungold Sentinel
kept.why: The coven ability gives it hexproof from a colour and makes it unblockable by creatures of that colour. Only the word "choose" was recorded, so the whole second half of the card was missing. Deliberately not adding cares:zone:graveyard: this is graveyard hate and eff:exile-graveyard already says so, while cares:zone:graveyard would falsely mark it as a graveyard-synergy card.

kept.name: Bellowing Mauler
kept.why: "Each player loses 4 life unless they sacrifice" hits every player at once. The symmetric reach of the effect was not recorded, so it reads as a single-target drain.

kept.name: Inscribed Tablet
kept.why: The activation is "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice" and the tap was dropped; the effect digs five cards off the top of your library, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Graf Rats
kept.why: The meld trigger exiles this creature (and Midnight Scavengers). Only the timing was read, so the card records a begin-combat trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Anointed Peacekeeper
kept.why: "As this creature enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name" is an entry effect that repeats on every re-entry, so it is an enters-the-battlefield payoff and nothing recorded a trigger.

kept.name: Leyline Dowser
kept.why: "You may put an instant or sorcery card milled this way into your hand" moves a card out of the graveyard, which is half the card's value and was not recorded. scope:all has no supporting clause - tapping one legendary creature you control is not a mass effect.

kept.name: Ulamog's Despoiler
kept.why: This is a Processor: its entry effect moves two cards your opponents own out of exile into their graveyards. Only the counters it ends up with were recorded, so the card's entire exile-matters clause and its enter-time effect were missing.

kept.name: White Widow, Free Agent
kept.why: "When White Widow enters, choose one" is a modal trigger and the modality was not recorded, so the card reads as doing both halves unconditionally.

kept.name: Tenth District Hero
kept.why: The first ability makes it a 4/4 that gains vigilance. Only the set power/toughness half was read; the keyword it grants itself was dropped.

kept.name: Repel the Vile
kept.why: "Choose one" was not recorded, and the creature mode only answers a creature with power 4 or greater, which is a real restriction on when this is removal at all.

kept.name: Pillory of the Sleepless
kept.why: An aura that stops a creature attacking or blocking and drains its controller is removal in the same sense as Darksteel Mutation or Witness Protection: it turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it. The individual clauses were read but nothing said the card is an answer.

kept.name: Blinding Light
kept.why: "Tap all nonwhite creatures" is a one-sided sweeper for a white deck. The colour restriction that makes it asymmetric was not recorded.

kept.name: Black Panther, Most Dangerous
kept.why: "Other creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn" is a team-wide pump and produced nothing at all. Only the damage reflection and his own counters were read.

kept.name: Celestial Convergence
kept.why: The card's entire purpose - "the player with the highest life total wins the game" - was not recorded; only the counter bookkeeping was. It is an alternate win condition and it is only castable in a deck that intends to be at the highest life total.

kept.name: Words of Worship
kept.why: The card carried only its activation cost and its type. "You gain 5 life instead" is the whole effect and nothing recorded that it gains life, so a repeatable 5-life engine reads as a blank enchantment.

kept.name: Stir Up Trouble
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature or pay {4}" is an additional casting cost and nothing recorded it. cost:cast-sacrifice is exactly that word.

kept.name: Lethal Sting
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control" is a counter paid as a cost and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Restore Balance
kept.why: Every player sacrifices creatures down to the fewest, so this empties your own board as well as theirs. That is the whole point of scope:wipe: a go-wide deck must never be offered this. scope:all alone does not carry the "yours too" warning.

kept.name: Magus of the Balance
kept.why: Only the sacrifice-self cost and scope:all were recorded, so the entire body of the ability was missing. It makes players sacrifice lands and creatures (eff:sacrifice) and discard (eff:discard, and eff:discard-self because you are one of those players), and it wipes your own board too. The activation cost also contains {T}, which cost:tap records.

kept.name: Path of Peril
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures" kills yours as well, and under cleave it kills everything with no restriction at all. scope:all was there; the symmetric-destruction word was not.

kept.name: Blood Operative
kept.why: Lifelink means it gains life, which is how Daggerdrome Imp and Cat-Gator are recorded in this same batch. "You may pay 3 life" is cost:life. And the third line brings the card itself back out of your graveyard, which is precisely eff:recur-self and is the reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Conch Horn
kept.why: The list held only the sacrifice cost, so the card's entire function was missing: it draws two cards, its ability costs {T}, and it then moves a card from your hand to the top of your library. It is a draw artifact and nothing said so.

kept.name: Pitiless Pontiff
kept.why: It grants deathtouch and indestructible and changes no power or toughness at all, so eff:pump is false; grants:deathtouch and grants:indestructible already say what it does. scope:all is also wrong, since the ability affects only this creature, nothing else.

kept.name: Ballynock Trapper
kept.why: "Whenever you cast a WHITE spell" is a colour condition and cares:color:w exists for it. scope:all is wrong: the tap ability hits one target creature, not everything.

kept.name: Baleful Eidolon
kept.why: Bestow makes this an Aura attached to a creature that it then pumps. eff:attach is the word for attaching to a creature, and without it this reads as a plain deathtouch body rather than something that suits up a creature.

kept.name: Mine Worker
kept.why: "{T}: You gain 1 life" is the whole card and eff:gain-life was absent. The list recorded the tap cost and a stray cares:sub:plant scanned out of the name "Power Plant Worker", but not the effect itself.

kept.name: Scourgemark
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" that buffs the creature it attaches to. The draw and the pump were recorded; the attaching was not, so nothing marks it as a card that suits up a creature.

kept.name: Great Desert Prospector
kept.why: "Create a tapped Powerstone token for each other creature you control" makes tokens, and eff:create-token was missing entirely. Only eff:add-mana was there, which describes what the tokens later do rather than what the card does.

kept.name: Beetle-Headed Merchants
kept.why: It sacrifices one other permanent, draws one card and puts one counter on itself. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Makindi Ox
kept.why: "Tap target creature an opponent controls" is a single target. scope:all overstates it.

kept.name: Contaminated Ground
kept.why: "Enchanted land is a Swamp" overwrites the land's own types and abilities, so a utility land becomes a plain Swamp without being destroyed. That is the same shape as Song of the Dryads and Imprisoned in the Moon, which is what eff:neutralise is for. Only the life loss was recorded, so the land-hate half of the card was invisible.

kept.name: Bloodsworn Squire // Bloodsworn Knight
kept.why: The ability transforms this creature when there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, and eff:transform was absent. The back face's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard, which is eff:set-pt. eff:pump is wrong: it gains indestructible and is tapped, and no power or toughness is added.

kept.name: Kithkin Harbinger
kept.why: It searches for one Kithkin card and puts it on top. Nothing is affected everywhere.

kept.name: Shamble Back
kept.why: "Exile target creature card from a graveyard" reads a graveyard, and the graveyard zone was not recorded although eff:exile-graveyard was. Every other graveyard-exiler in this batch carries both.

kept.name: Soulreaper of Mogis
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card" affects one creature and draws one card. It is a sacrifice outlet, not a mass effect.

kept.name: Stone Retrieval Unit
kept.why: "Create a tapped Powerstone token" makes a token and eff:create-token was missing. Same omission as Great Desert Prospector: only the mana the token later produces was recorded.

kept.name: Vanguard's Shield
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +0/+3" is a stat buff and eff:pump was missing, so the equipment recorded that it attaches but not what it does once attached.

kept.name: Temporary Truce
kept.why: "Each player may draw up to two cards" makes everyone draw, not just you. eff:draw was recorded and the symmetry was not, which is the important half of a card whose whole character is that it helps the table.

kept.name: Unsettling Twins
kept.why: Manifest dread looks at the top two cards of your library and takes one, binning the other. The token and the mill were recorded but not the selection, and not that it reads your library at all.

kept.name: Bishop of Binding
kept.why: The attack trigger gives a Vampire +X/+X, and eff:pump was missing, so half the card was unrecorded. X is the power of the exiled card, which is cares:power, and the card genuinely reads the exile zone to find that number.

kept.name: Postmortem Lunge
kept.why: "It gains haste" was not recorded, and haste is the reason this reanimation is a one-turn combo piece rather than a value spell.

kept.name: Fabled Hero
kept.why: Heroic puts one +1/+1 counter on this creature. Nothing about it affects everything.

kept.name: Grasp of the Hieromancer
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +1/+1" is a straight P/T buff and nothing recorded it. The tap half was read and the pump half was dropped.

kept.name: Defiant Salvager
kept.why: Sacrificing one artifact or creature as an activation cost affects a single permanent. Nothing here touches everything.

kept.name: Bubble Matrix
kept.why: "Prevent ALL damage that would be dealt to creatures" is genuinely board-wide, and preventing all damage to creatures is exactly keeping creatures alive. Only eff:prevent-damage was recorded.

kept.name: Unfortunate Accident
kept.why: The Mercenary token it creates carries "{T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0". A granted quoted ability's effects belong to the card that grants them, the same way a token-maker's create word does.

kept.name: Powerstone Fracture
kept.why: "Destroy target creature or planeswalker" is single-target spot removal. scope:all beside eff:destroy reads as a symmetric sweeper, which is the opposite of what this card is.

kept.name: Ruin Processor
kept.why: The whole cast trigger is moving a card an opponent owns from EXILE into their graveyard, and only the incidental "gain 5 life" was recorded. The processor mechanic is exile-matters and the list said nothing about exile at all.

kept.name: Martial Law
kept.why: Detain does three things and the list recorded none of them, carrying only kw:detain and the upkeep trigger. The reminder text spells it out: the creature can't attack, can't block, and its activated abilities can't be activated.

kept.name: Snooping Page
kept.why: Repartee makes this creature unblockable for the turn and no facet said so. Nothing on the card affects everything, so scope:all is a false positive from the "instant or sorcery" selector.

kept.name: Dread Wanderer
kept.why: The recursion is gated on "only if you have one or fewer cards in hand", a real hellbent-style condition the list did not record.

kept.name: Skulltap
kept.why: Sacrificing one creature as an additional cost and drawing two. Nothing is board-wide.

kept.name: Kindly Ancestor // Ancestor's Embrace
kept.why: Disturb casts this card from your own graveyard, which is the card bringing itself back. Wickerfolk Indomitable and Dread Wanderer in this same batch carry eff:recur-self for the same shape.

kept.name: Null Profusion
kept.why: "Whenever YOU play a card, draw a card" is specifically your own casts, and only the undirected trig:cast was recorded.

kept.name: Archon's Glory
kept.why: Only the +2/+2 was read. Bargain is an optional sacrifice paid as you cast, and the bargained mode grants flying and lifelink - three of the card's four clauses were missing.

kept.name: Gruesome Encore
kept.why: "It gains haste" is a printed grant on the reanimated creature and was not recorded.

kept.name: Merciless Resolve
kept.why: One creature or land sacrificed as an additional cost, then draw two. Nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Sightless Ghoul
kept.why: "This creature can't block" produced no facet at all, and undying returning it from the graveyard to the battlefield is the card recurring itself, which eff:return-from alone does not say.

kept.name: Luminous Bonds
kept.why: A creature that can't attack or block is a permanent turned harmless without being destroyed, which is the definition of the word. This is a Pacifism, and it is removal - without eff:neutralise nothing can ever offer it as an answer.

kept.name: Serene Master
kept.why: The card had only its block trigger and no effect word. Exchanging its power with the blocked creature's sets both creatures' power to a new value, which is the closest true word for what happens.

kept.name: Kayla's Music Box
kept.why: Both abilities were entirely unread - the list held nothing but costs and type. Exiling the top card face down and later being allowed to play cards exiled with it is textbook impulse draw, and both abilities tap.

kept.name: Practiced Tactics
kept.why: The card's only effect is dealing damage to a creature and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: False Floor
kept.why: The activation taps and exiles the artifact itself, neither recorded. "Exile ALL untapped creatures" is symmetric mass removal that takes your own board with it, which is what scope:wipe is for; scope:all alone does not warn a go-wide deck off it.

kept.name: Phyrexian Vault
kept.why: Sacrificing one creature to draw one card. Single permanent, nothing board-wide.

kept.name: Visage of Dread // Dread Osseosaur
kept.why: The back face triggers on "enters OR attacks" and only the enters half was read. Craft's cost exiles the artifact itself and exiles creatures you control and/or creature cards from your graveyard - three cost and zone clauses with no word between them.

kept.name: Seasoned Hallowblade
kept.why: Granting itself indestructible in response to removal is protection, which nothing recorded. It gives no +N/+N at all, so eff:pump is wrong and would have it competing for enhance slots against cards that actually make creatures bigger.

kept.name: Ent-Draught Basin
kept.why: The ability's cost is {X}, {T} and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Jar of Eyeballs
kept.why: The activation is {3}, {T}, Remove all eyeball counters. Neither the tap nor the counter removal was recorded, so the card looks like it pays only mana.

kept.name: Lotusguard Disciple
kept.why: Handing a creature indestructible until end of turn is keeping it alive, and that had no word. Nothing on this card changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is a mislabel.

kept.name: Gideon's Company
kept.why: The second ability puts a loyalty counter on a Gideon planeswalker - counters on another permanent, which eff:add-counters-self does not cover. "Whenever you gain life" makes this a lifegain payoff and only the raw trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Absolute Grace
kept.why: Protection from black is a statement about a colour, and the card carried no colour word.

kept.name: Argivian Avenger
kept.why: The ability grants a CHOICE of four keywords and only deathtouch was recorded. It also gives itself -1/-1, which is a shrink, not a pump.

kept.name: Deathmark
kept.why: Destroying a white creature is hate, not a white-matters card. This is the word-scan fault: the engine would read a mono-black removal spell as caring about white.

kept.name: Recumbent Bliss
kept.why: Only the incidental upkeep lifegain was recorded. The whole point of the card is a Pacifism: the creature can't attack or block, which is a permanent turned harmless without being destroyed.

kept.name: Triskelavus
kept.why: The token-making ability is paid for by removing a +1/+1 counter from itself, which is the whole reason it enters with three.

kept.name: Hold for Ransom
kept.why: The granted ability makes the creature's controller sacrifice it, and the aura is a Pacifism that renders the creature harmless without destroying it.

kept.name: Green Goblin, Back for More
kept.why: Mayhem lets you cast this card from your own graveyard, which is exactly a permanent bringing itself back. Neither the recursion nor the graveyard interest was recorded.

kept.name: Auriok Windwalker
kept.why: The attach ability costs {T} and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Kyoki, Sanity's Eclipse
kept.why: The trigger is on spells YOU cast, not on any cast. Only the generic trig:cast was present.

kept.name: Wrench
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +1/+1 and no pump was recorded, only the vigilance grant and the tap ability.

kept.name: Syndicate Heavy
kept.why: Extort is a trigger on every spell you cast, which was not recorded at all. The end-step trigger checks whether you gained 4 or more life this turn, so it is a lifegain payoff, and the Clue it makes draws a card.

kept.name: Duty-Bound Dead
kept.why: Exalted is spelled out in the text: whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1. Neither the attack trigger nor the pump was recorded.

kept.name: Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple
kept.why: The trigger reads 'this creature OR another', so it fires on itself entering too. The transform ability costs {T} and the sacrifice of another permanent, which is a genuine sacrifice outlet, and the back face's entire trigger is on creatures dying. None of that was recorded.

kept.name: Synod Sanctum
kept.why: Only the blink half was recorded. The second ability sacrifices the artifact and returns every card exiled with it from exile to the battlefield, which is the payoff the card exists for.

kept.name: Namazu Trader
kept.why: The attack trigger lets you sacrifice another creature or artifact on demand every combat, which is a sacrifice outlet, not just the eff:sacrifice already recorded.

kept.name: Krumar Initiate
kept.why: The endure ability costs {T} alongside the X life; only the life payment was recorded.

kept.name: Multiform Wonder
kept.why: Only flying was recorded of the three keywords it can choose between, and the entire second ability was missed: +2/-2 or -2/+2 is both a pump and a shrink, chosen on resolution. Paying {E} removes energy counters.

kept.name: Relic Amulet
kept.why: The card is a spellslinger payoff and none of that was written down: it triggers on instants and sorceries YOU cast, it puts the charge counters on itself, and the damage ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Killer's Mask
kept.why: Manifest dread looks at the top two cards of your library and takes one, and neither the library interest nor the look-and-pick was recorded.

kept.name: Sacred Mesa
kept.why: The upkeep trigger sacrifices the enchantment itself unless you feed it a Pegasus. Both halves of that were missing; only the token making was recorded.

kept.name: Malicious Eclipse
kept.why: The second sentence replaces death with exile for every creature an opponent controls, which is the reason to play it over a plain -2/-2 sweeper.

kept.name: Ebony Charm
kept.why: Mode two exiles up to three cards from a single graveyard, which is graveyard hate and must be eff:exile-graveyard rather than plain eff:exile; it also genuinely looks at a graveyard. No mode changes power or toughness - the third mode only grants fear - so eff:pump is unsupported.

kept.name: Nightmare's Thirst
kept.why: The whole second sentence was unread: -X/-X until end of turn is eff:shrink, and X is the life you gained this turn, which is exactly cares:lifegain.

kept.name: Archery Training
kept.why: It is an Aura with 'Enchant creature', so it attaches to a creature. Other Auras in this batch carry eff:attach and this one does not.

kept.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Spy Kit
kept.why: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks alone' is an attack trigger and no trig word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Pollen Lullaby
kept.why: 'Prevent ALL combat damage that would be dealt this turn' is a global effect, so scope:all. The clash payoff, stopping an opponent's creatures untapping, has no word at all.

kept.name: Raven Wings
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has flying. Both clauses were unread - the list recorded only the attach and the Bird type change.

kept.name: Bound in Silence
kept.why: An Aura that attaches to a creature. It is also a Pacifism: the creature is left on the battlefield and made harmless, which is precisely the eff:neutralise gloss, and it is what makes this card removal rather than a blank enchantment.

kept.name: Arden Angel
kept.why: 'Roll a four-sided die' is unrecorded, and the recursion is entirely conditional on that roll.

kept.name: Wight
kept.why: The trigger event is a creature dying, which had no trig word. It then exiles that creature card out of the graveyard, which is exile-from-graveyard rather than plain exile.

kept.name: Candlelight Vigil
kept.why: 'Enchant creature' - the Aura attaches to a creature and that clause was unread.

kept.name: Digsite Conservator
kept.why: Almost nothing on this card was read. Its activated ability sacrifices itself to exile up to four cards from a single graveyard, and the death trigger is 'you may pay {4}. If you do, discover 4' - a pay-for-more effect that casts a card without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Pentarch Paladin
kept.why: The destroy ability costs {W}{W} and {T}; the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Boros Elite
kept.why: Battalion gives it +2/+2 until end of turn. The trigger was recorded and the effect it produces was not.

kept.name: Guul Draz Specter
kept.why: 'Gets +3/+3 as long as an opponent has no cards in hand' is both a pump and a card that checks hand size; the discard clause also concerns hands. Only the discard was read.

kept.name: Spiritcall Enthusiast // Scrollboost
kept.why: Both halves were unread. The front triggers on other permanents you control - tokens - entering, and the Scrollboost half gives one or two creatures +2/+2.

kept.name: Grim Reaper's Scythe
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T} as well as mana, and the returned creature comes back with a finality counter, which is a counter being placed (the same reading Cauldron's Gift already gets for its +1/+1 counter).

kept.name: Patron of the Kitsune
kept.why: Fox offering is an alternative cast cost that requires sacrificing a Fox, which is a sacrifice paid to cast the spell.

kept.name: Dream Spoilers
kept.why: The trigger is on spells YOU cast, during an opponent's turn. Only the generic trig:cast was recorded, which does not say whose spell.

kept.name: Ajani's Influence
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the library, so both the impulse word and the exile-zone word are false - this is look at five, take one to hand, which eff:look-and-pick already covers. It does care about the card being white.

kept.name: Gutsplitter Gang
kept.why: Blight 2 places counters and no effect word was recorded at all - the card read as a bare trigger.

kept.name: Scepter of Empires
kept.why: The damage ability costs {T} and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Mycologist
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. The upkeep counter is on itself, the token is one Saproling, and the sacrifice outlet takes one Saproling. scope:all is unsupported by any clause.

kept.name: Bog Rats
kept.why: 'Can't be blocked by Walls' is an evasion restriction on blockers and was the only line of text on the card; the list recorded nothing at all for it. Narrow evasion, but the vocabulary has no finer word.

kept.name: Colfenor's Plans
kept.why: Only the enters trigger was read. It exiles the top seven of your library and lets you play them, which is the textbook impulse shape, and it skips your draw step.

kept.name: Primordial Gnawer
kept.why: Discover 3 exiles cards off the top of the library and casts the hit without paying its mana cost. Only the trigger was recorded; the whole effect was not.

kept.name: Pack's Disdain
kept.why: Gives a creature -1/-1 for each permanent of the chosen type. The choice was recorded and the actual effect, making a creature smaller, was not.

kept.name: Cleaving Reaper
kept.why: Pay 3 life returns THIS card from your graveyard to your hand. eff:return-from is the generic word; this is the self-recursion case.

kept.name: Blood Price
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top. It looks at four and puts two into hand, which eff:look-and-pick already says. Both words point the engine at an impulse-draw deck this card has no part in.

kept.name: Brightfield Glider
kept.why: Attacking while saddled gives it +1/+2. The flying grant was read and the size bonus in the same clause was not.

kept.name: Clockwork Beetle
kept.why: Every counter it puts is on itself, which eff:add-counters-self already says. The generic word makes a 1/1 artifact creature read as a counters payoff.

kept.name: Livio, Oathsworn Sentinel
kept.why: Both abilities were entirely unread. The first exiles a creature with an aegis counter on it; the second taps to return every card exiled that way to the battlefield. The card had no effect word at all.

kept.name: Radiant, Serra Archangel
kept.why: 'Protection from the color of your choice' is a choice made on resolution, the same shape as Rhystic Cave's 'choose a color'.

kept.name: You're Ambushed on the Road
kept.why: It is a modal 'Choose one' spell. Both mode bodies were read and the choice between them was not.

kept.name: Wand of Denial
kept.why: {T} is in the activation cost, the mill is optional on paying 2 life, and the card ends up in a graveyard. Only the mill itself was recorded.

kept.name: Icatian Store
kept.why: It taps for the mana ability, stores upkeep counters on itself, and the mana is paid for by removing those counters. Only the trigger timing and the mana were read.

kept.name: Copper Gnomes
kept.why: It puts ONE artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield. Nothing here affects everything, and scope:all is what the engine reads to decide a card is a mass effect.

kept.name: Rhystic Cave
kept.why: 'unless any player pays {1}' is the rhystic tax clause, the thing that distinguishes this land from a plain any-colour source.

kept.name: Ultron's Auxiliary
kept.why: The counters only ever go on itself, so the generic word makes it read as a counters payoff. It also triggers on an artifact card reaching the graveyard from ANYWHERE, not only from the battlefield, which trig:dies alone cannot say.

kept.name: Darksteel Garrison
kept.why: The second ability triggers when the fortified land becomes tapped and pumps a creature +1/+1. Only the indestructible grant and the attach were read.

kept.name: Grim Harvest
kept.why: Recover triggers when a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield and returns THIS card from the graveyard to your hand. The whole recover clause was unread; only the front half of the card was.

kept.name: Serrated Biskelion
kept.why: A -1/-1 counter on target creature is repeatable creature removal. The counter words say what it puts down; nothing said it makes the target smaller.

kept.name: Carrion Locust
kept.why: It exiles a card from an opponent's graveyard. Only the incidental 1 life loss was recorded, so the graveyard hate half of the card is invisible.

kept.name: Eddytrail Hawk
kept.why: The flying grant on attack is gated on paying {E}, which is what makes the energy the card produces matter.

kept.name: Flitting Guerrilla
kept.why: 'Each player mills two cards' is symmetric and hits every player, not a targeted mill.

kept.name: Scarab Feast
kept.why: The card's whole main effect, exiling up to three cards from a graveyard, was unread. Only the cycling clause was recorded, so a dedicated graveyard hate instant reads as a cantrip.

kept.name: Jennika, Bad Apple Big Sister
kept.why: Plainscycling is paid by discarding this card. The search and the tokens were read; the cost was not.

kept.name: Undercity's Embrace
kept.why: The lifegain is conditional on controlling a creature with power 4 or greater, which is a power check the list does not record.

kept.name: Grasping Giant
kept.why: It triggers when it BECOMES blocked, which trig:becomes-blocked already says. It has no trigger for blocking something itself, and vigilance means it is not a blocker card.

kept.name: Despondency
kept.why: -2/-0 makes a creature smaller, it is not a pump; as written the engine reads a removal aura as a buff. It is also an Aura that attaches, and it returns ITSELF from the graveyard to hand.

kept.name: Valor of the Worthy
kept.why: The second half of the card was unread entirely: when the enchanted creature leaves the battlefield it makes a 1/1 flying Spirit. It is also an Aura, so it attaches.

kept.name: Toolcraft Exemplar
kept.why: "it also gains first strike until end of turn" is a second clause the list never records - only the +2/+1 was read.

kept.name: Wailing Ghoul
kept.why: Milling two puts cards into your graveyard, which is the whole reason this card is played. The text names the zone.

kept.name: Contaminated Bond
kept.why: The trigger is "attacks OR blocks" and only the blocking half was read.

kept.name: Group Project
kept.why: The flashback cost is "Tap three untapped creatures you control" - an alternative cast cost paid by tapping your team, which nothing in the list records.

kept.name: Jhoira's Toolbox
kept.why: "Regenerate target artifact creature" keeps another creature alive, which is what eff:protect means. (Living Wall regenerates only itself and is deliberately left alone.)

kept.name: Dead-Iron Sledge
kept.why: Both halves of "blocks or becomes blocked" are unrecorded, and "destroy both creatures" always destroys the equipped creature you control - the card's defining drawback.

kept.name: Lithoform Blight
kept.why: "Enchanted land loses all land types and abilities" is exactly turning a permanent harmless without destroying it - the land half of Song of the Dryads. Only the cantrip was read.

kept.name: Kalemne's Captain
kept.why: Monstrosity 3 puts three +1/+1 counters on it (ctr:+1/+1-self is already there but the effect word is missing), and "exile ALL artifacts and enchantments" is a mass effect.

kept.name: False Prophet
kept.why: "Exile all creatures" on death is a symmetric board wipe that takes your own board with it - a go-wide deck must not be offered this.

kept.name: Scrapheap Scrounger
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed drawback clause the list never read.

kept.name: Call to the Void
kept.why: Every player loses two creatures, so it is a mass effect, and you are made to choose one of your OWN creatures to be destroyed.

kept.name: Thoughtweft Trio
kept.why: Champion is two triggers and a return: it triggers on entering, exiles another Kithkin you control (eff:exile-own is already recorded), and on leaving returns that card from exile to the battlefield. Only the exile half was read.

kept.name: Cellar Door
kept.why: It puts a card from a library into a graveyard and then reads that graveyard card's type - the text names the zone twice.

kept.name: Azorius Arrester
kept.why: Detain is three restrictions and only the bare keyword was recorded, so the card reads as doing nothing at all.

kept.name: Toymaker
kept.why: "Target noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature" is an animate, "with power and toughness each equal to its mana value" sets P/T, and the ability costs {T}. Only the discard was read.

kept.name: Curse of Wizardry
kept.why: "Whenever a player casts a spell of the chosen color" is a cast trigger and nothing recorded it. Left as the base word rather than trig:cast-opponent because it hits you too.

kept.name: Shredder's Armor
kept.why: "Attach it to target creature you control" is an explicit attach the list is missing, and the equip cost is sacrificing another nonland permanent.

kept.name: Yomiji, Who Bars the Way
kept.why: It watches permanents going to a graveyard and returns them from there; the zone is named in the trigger and in the effect.

kept.name: Diregraf Scavenger
kept.why: "Exile up to one target card from a graveyard" is graveyard hate and was not read at all - only the drain and lifegain that follow it were.

kept.name: Solar Tide
kept.why: Entwined it destroys every creature on the board including yours, and the entwine cost sacrifices two lands, which is an additional cost to cast.

kept.name: Foot Ninjas
kept.why: Sneak is an alternative cast cost paid by returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand, and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Miasma Demon
kept.why: The whole ETB was unread: it makes you discard, and shrinks creatures. Only the trigger words were recorded.

kept.name: Graveyard Shift
kept.why: "This spell has flash as long as ..." was not recorded. Same self-granting shape as Spirit of the Night's conditional first strike, which does carry grants:first strike.

kept.name: Lightning Coils
kept.why: "remove all of them from it" is a real counter removal and was missing. Deliberately not adding eff:exile for "exile them at the beginning of the next end step": it exiles its own tokens as a drawback, and eff:exile would file it as removal.

kept.name: Sun Clasp
kept.why: Enchant creature is an attachment and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Ichorplate Golem
kept.why: Both halves of the card were unread: it puts an oil counter on the creature that entered, and its static gives +1/+1 to creatures with oil counters.

kept.name: Sinuous Vermin
kept.why: Monstrosity 3 puts three +1/+1 counters on it, and it has menace while monstrous. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Kithkin Spellduster
kept.why: Persist returns it from the graveyard to the battlefield, which is the self-recursion word rather than only the generic return.

kept.name: Daring Archaeologist
kept.why: The second ability, "whenever you cast a historic spell", produced no trigger word at all. It also returns a card to your hand.

kept.name: Quill-Blade Laureate // Twofold Intent
kept.why: The sorcery half gives +1/+0 and only the double strike grant was recorded.

kept.name: No Way Out
kept.why: The discard is recorded but the hand it comes from is not, unlike every other discard card in this batch.

kept.name: Quilled Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability costs {T}, and Quilled Sliver is itself a Sliver so it has that ability too. "All Slivers have" is an everything-scope static, the same shape as Absolute Law's "all creatures have protection".

kept.name: The Meep
kept.why: "creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X" sets power and toughness and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Reverent Howl
kept.why: It is a "Choose one —" modal spell and the mode choice itself was not recorded.

kept.name: Bala Ged Thief
kept.why: "Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters" names itself explicitly, so it triggers on its own arrival too.

kept.name: Subterranean Hangar
kept.why: Removing storage counters is the cost of the mana ability and only the tap cost was recorded.

kept.name: Tsabo's Web
kept.why: "Each land ... doesn't untap" affects every such land and was recorded as nothing at all beyond the cantrip.

kept.name: Revoke Demise
kept.why: "This spell costs {2} less to cast if ..." is a cost reduction and produced nothing. Same self-reducing shape the word was created for on Ghalta.

kept.name: Stomped by the Foot
kept.why: Kicker here is an additional cost paid by sacrificing an artifact or creature, and paying it upgrades -2/-2 into -5/-5. Neither the cost nor the pay-for-more shape was recorded.

kept.name: Lim-Dûl the Necromancer
kept.why: "you may pay {1}{B}. If you do" is the pay-for-more shape, and the second ability regenerates a Zombie, which keeps a creature alive. Deliberately not adding eff:gain-control: it reanimates from a graveyard rather than stealing a permanent, and eff:gain-control would file it as an answer to a threat.

kept.name: Daredevil Dragster
kept.why: It puts a velocity counter on itself at end of combat and that was unread.

kept.name: Disowned Ancestor
kept.why: Outlast includes {T} in its cost and only the counter was recorded.

kept.name: Silverflame Ritual
kept.why: Adamant checks "at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell", which is exactly cares:mana-spent. Nothing in the list recorded the condition.

kept.name: Dreams of Steel and Oil
kept.why: It exiles TWO cards: one from the opponent's hand and one from their graveyard. Only the graveyard half (eff:exile-graveyard) was written down, so the hand-attack half was invisible. Deliberately not adding cares:zone:graveyard - exiling a graveyard is hate, not caring about one.

kept.name: Dreadwurm
kept.why: It gains indestructible on landfall; it never changes power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. And the effect is on itself alone, so scope:all ("affects everything") is wrong - grants:indestructible already says what happens.

kept.name: Indebted Samurai
kept.why: Bushido is spelled out in the card text - "whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1" - and none of those three things was read; only kw:bushido was recorded, which names the keyword without saying what it does. scope:all is wrong: the death trigger puts a counter on itself, nothing global.

kept.name: Corpse Blockade
kept.why: It gains deathtouch, it does not get bigger, so eff:pump is wrong (grants:deathtouch is already there and is correct). scope:all is wrong - the effect is on this creature only; the sacrifice is a cost, which cost:sacrifice already records.

kept.name: Séance
kept.why: It creates a token that is a COPY of a creature card - that is the whole card and eff:copy was missing. Left eff:return-from and eff:exile-graveyard alone: recurring from your own yard is what it does even if the wording is exile-and-copy.

kept.name: Lonesome Unicorn // Rider in Need
kept.why: The Adventure half's entire text is "Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance" and eff:create-token was absent. The engine read the creature side's vigilance and stopped.

kept.name: Planar Guide
kept.why: Two misses. The activation cost is "Exile this creature" (cost:exile-self). And it exiles ALL creatures and returns them at end step, which includes your own board - this is a mass blink, so eff:exile-own belongs alongside eff:exile.

kept.name: Otherworldly Escort
kept.why: When it dies it returns ITSELF to the battlefield - eff:recur-self, the most important thing the card does, was missing. The activated ability's costs "{T}" and "Remove a charge counter" were both dropped too.

kept.name: Fortunate Few
kept.why: Every player saves one nonland permanent and everything else is destroyed, yours included. That is a symmetric board wipe and only the bare eff:destroy was recorded.

kept.name: Haunted Dead
kept.why: The recursion ability costs "Discard two cards" - a real cost that makes this a discard-outlet card, and it was not written down. eff:recur-self was already correct.

kept.name: Lich
kept.why: Four of five clauses were unread; only eff:lose-game survived. It makes you lose life equal to your life total (eff:lose-life); it replaces lifegain with drawing that many cards (eff:draw plus cares:lifegain, since the card keys off gaining life); and "whenever you're dealt damage, sacrifice that many nontoken permanents" is trig:dealt-damage plus eff:sacrifice.

kept.name: Gibbering Barricade
kept.why: The ability gains you 1 life and draws a card. Nothing is affected globally - the "a creature" is the sacrifice cost, already covered by cost:sacrifice.

kept.name: Sorin, Vampire Lord
kept.why: The -8 gives each Vampire "{T}: Gain control of target creature", which is the ultimate and the reason to play the card. Only the +1 pump and the -2 damage/lifegain were read.

kept.name: Chainer's Torment
kept.why: Chapter III creates an X/X Nightmare Horror token and eff:create-token was missing entirely - the engine read the damage and lifegain chapters and gave up on the third.

kept.name: Cruel Sadist
kept.why: The damage ability costs "Remove X +1/+1 counters from this creature". It is a counter-removal outlet as well as a counter accumulator, and only the adding half was recorded.

kept.name: Nighthowl Pursuer
kept.why: Ferocious checks "you control a creature with power 4 or greater" - that is cares:power and it was not read at all.

kept.name: Odric's Outrider
kept.why: The counter goes on ONE target creature you control. scope:all reads as an anthem or mass effect and this is neither; trig:dies and eff:add-counters already describe it correctly.

kept.name: Ravening Warg
kept.why: Same Ferocious clause as Nighthowl Pursuer - "a creature with power 4 or greater" - unread.

kept.name: Crown of Empires
kept.why: "Gain control of that creature instead" is the payoff half of the ability and was dropped; only eff:tap survived, so the card read as a tapper rather than a theft effect.

kept.name: Painwracker Oni
kept.why: Its upkeep trigger makes you sacrifice a creature and nothing in the list said so - the card carried a trigger step with no effect attached to it.

kept.name: Case of the Pilfered Proof
kept.why: "Whenever a Detective you control enters" is an enters-trigger watching OTHER permanents, and no trigger word was present at all - eff:add-counters sat there with nothing causing it.

kept.name: Thunderous Orator
kept.why: The card names eight keywords and the list read only two of them. "The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, indestructible, lifelink, menace, and trample" - it both CARES about controlling a creature with each keyword and GRANTS each one, so six grants: and four cares:kw: words were missing (cares:kw:flying, first strike, deathtouch and lifelink were already there).

kept.name: Earwig Squad
kept.why: It exiles three cards from an opponent's library and no effect word was recorded - the card had a trigger and no consequence. Deliberately NOT adding eff:search-library or eff:shuffle: both are glossed as your own library, and marking this as a tutor would be worse than leaving it silent.

kept.name: Aerial Modification
kept.why: "As long as enchanted permanent is a Vehicle, it's a creature in addition to its other types" is exactly eff:animate, and it is the clause that makes the card worth playing in a Vehicles deck. Only the +2/+2 and flying were read.

kept.name: Mindleech Ghoul
kept.why: Exploit is an enters-the-battlefield trigger and no trigger word was present. The opponents EXILE a card from hand rather than discarding it, so eff:exile was missing; left eff:discard in place because the hand-attack signal is right even though the wording is exile.

kept.name: Wall of Bone
kept.why: Regenerate is the only thing this card does beyond blocking and the list recorded nothing but the keyword name. eff:protect ("keeps your creatures alive") is the honest reading - the tagger already treats regenerate as protection.

kept.name: Divine Deflection
kept.why: "Divine Deflection deals that much damage to any target" - it is half a burn spell and eff:damage was absent, so nothing said the card can kill something or hit a face.

kept.name: Arcane Spyglass
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything: it draws one card and puts a counter on itself. scope:all is a false mass-effect claim.

kept.name: Pit Keeper
kept.why: eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand. This returns a creature CARD from the graveyard, which eff:return-from already says.

kept.name: Suncleanser
kept.why: It is a modal 'choose one' ETB and nothing recorded that. The counter prohibition is the real point of the card and has no word.

kept.name: Enduring Sliver
kept.why: Outlast is '{2}, {T}: put a +1/+1 counter', so the ability taps. The tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Static Net
kept.why: The whole first ability exiles an opponent's nonland permanent (this is a removal spell and nothing said so), and the second creates a Powerstone token. Only the incidental life gain and the token's mana ability were recorded.

kept.name: Rousing of Souls
kept.why: It creates a 1/1 Spirit for each nonland card revealed and no word recorded the token making at all.

kept.name: Necrobite
kept.why: There is no +N/+N anywhere on this card, so eff:pump is false. Regenerating a targeted creature is exactly keeping your creature alive.

kept.name: Meadowboon
kept.why: The only thing this card does - put a +1/+1 counter on EACH creature a player controls - was not recorded at all. The list held only the evoke keyword and the leave trigger.

kept.name: Thran Foundry
kept.why: The activation costs {1}, a tap and exiling itself, and neither cost was recorded. It affects one target player, not everything. eff:exile-graveyard is kept: strictly it shuffles rather than exiles, but the card is graveyard hate and treating it as such is correct.

kept.name: Quick-Draw Dagger
kept.why: 'That creature gains first strike until end of turn' was unread.

kept.name: Gluttonous Slug
kept.why: Evolve triggers on another creature you control entering, not on itself. Only the undirected trig:enters was recorded.

kept.name: Social Snub
kept.why: 'Each player sacrifices a creature' is the main body of the spell and no sacrifice word was recorded. It hits every player, hence scope:all.

kept.name: Dire Mimic
kept.why: '{3}: this becomes a Shapeshifter artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5' - the whole second ability was unread. It animates the artifact and it sets P/T.

kept.name: Order of the Sacred Torch
kept.why: It counters only BLACK spells. The colour restriction is the defining condition of the card and was not recorded.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Red
kept.why: The card's only ability prevents damage and no effect word at all was recorded - it carried nothing but its cost and cares:color:r.

kept.name: Kithkin Armor
kept.why: The evasion is keyed on 'creatures with power 3 or greater', so it genuinely reads power. Sacrificing it to prevent all damage to the enchanted creature is keeping your creature alive.

kept.name: Sphere of Annihilation
kept.why: It exiles ALL creatures and planeswalkers at or under the counter count, itself included, AND all such cards in graveyards - the mass scope, the self-exile and the graveyard hate were all missing. It also enters with X void counters on itself.

kept.name: Magnetic Web
kept.why: 'Whenever a creature with a magnet counter on it attacks' is a real attack trigger, and both static abilities affect all creatures carrying magnet counters.

kept.name: Splinter & Leo, Father & Son
kept.why: 'Choose one or both' is a modal choice and nothing recorded it. The trigger is their own enter-the-battlefield trigger, so it wants the -self form as well as the bare one.

kept.name: Wanderbrine Trapper
kept.why: It taps ONE target creature an opponent controls, paying with one other untapped creature. Nothing about this affects everything.

kept.name: Wirefly Hive
kept.why: The activation costs {T} and that was unrecorded, and the losing half of the coin flip destroys ALL permanents named Wirefly - a real destroy effect with mass scope that was entirely missing.

kept.name: Thrashing Wumpus
kept.why: It damages each creature and each player, so the mass scope was missing, and 'each player' includes you - this pings its own controller every activation.

kept.name: Season of the Witch
kept.why: 'Destroy all untapped creatures that didn't attack' is a mass effect and the scope was missing. The upkeep clause sacrifices the enchantment unless you pay 2 life, so both the life cost and the self-sacrifice were unread. Deliberately not scope:wipe: the destruction is filtered to untapped non-attackers rather than the whole board.

kept.name: Kabira Vindicator
kept.why: Level up puts a level counter on this creature, which is the card growing itself with counters, and no counter word was recorded.

kept.name: Steelshaper Apprentice
kept.why: It searches for one Equipment card and puts it in your hand. There is no mass effect on this card.

kept.name: Quag Sickness
kept.why: The aura gives -1/-1 for each Swamp. It makes the creature SMALLER, so eff:pump states the opposite of what the card does; this is a removal-shaped aura.

kept.name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
kept.why: 'Other creatures you control get -1/-1' shrinks, it does not pump - the recorded word says the opposite. The reanimation ability also costs {T} and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Tyrannical Pitlord
kept.why: The chosen creature 'gets +3/+3 and has flying' - only the pump was recorded, not the granted keyword. The leave trigger sacrifices a creature you control, which is a real sacrifice effect. It also does something as it enters (choosing the creature), which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Renegade's Getaway
kept.why: Granting indestructible until end of turn is keeping a permanent alive, not making it bigger. The card changes no power or toughness anywhere, so eff:pump is a false reading; grants:indestructible plus eff:protect is what it does.

kept.name: Timely Reinforcements
kept.why: The whole second half of the card creates three 1/1 Soldier tokens and no token-making word was present. Only the lifegain clause had been read.

kept.name: Stonebinder's Familiar
kept.why: It triggers on cards being put into exile, which nothing recorded. The counter goes only on itself, so the generic eff:add-counters wrongly reads it as a card that grows OTHER things - eff:add-counters-self already says it correctly.

kept.name: Dredge
kept.why: It sacrifices one creature or land and draws one card. Nothing affects everything, so scope:all misreads a one-for-one spell as a mass effect.

kept.name: Boonweaver Giant
kept.why: Only the library search was read. It also searches your graveyard AND your hand, puts the Aura onto the battlefield rather than into your hand, attaches it to itself, and shuffles.

kept.name: Shrine of Burning Rage
