kept.why: The entire first line was unread - it has an upkeep trigger AND a cast trigger, both putting a charge counter on itself, and it specifically cares that the spell you cast is red. Only the damage half of the card had been recorded.

kept.name: Reave Soul
kept.why: It can only destroy a creature with power 3 or less, so power is a condition the card reads. Nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Parting Thoughts
kept.why: 'you lose X life' was not recorded at all; the card is a two-sided effect that costs you life. Adding eff:lose-life matches how Hemlock Vial in this same batch records its own life loss.

kept.name: Creeping Chill
kept.why: The second half of the card - the reason anyone plays it - was entirely unread. It triggers when it is milled from your library to your graveyard and exiles itself to repeat the effect. The damage also hits each opponent, which scope:all says and which Criminal Enterprise in this batch already carries for the same wording.

kept.name: Blessed Spirits
kept.why: It puts a counter on itself when you cast an enchantment. Nothing on the card affects everything, so scope:all is a false reading.

kept.name: Valkyrie's Sword
kept.why: The enters trigger makes a 4/4 Angel token if you pay, and no token-making word was present. The 'you may pay {4}{W}. If you do' shape is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Hemlock Vial
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unread: it taps and sacrifices itself as a cost, and grants deathtouch to your equipped creatures and Equipment.

kept.name: Infernal Scarring
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets +2/+0' was not recorded - only the granted death trigger was. This is a genuine power buff.

kept.name: Angel's Tomb
kept.why: The card's whole point is that it becomes a 3/3 Angel creature, and nothing said so. Only the trigger that turns it on was recorded.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Black
kept.why: Nothing at all had been read off this card's only line. It prevents damage, and it does so specifically from a black source.

kept.name: Paragon of New Dawns
kept.why: Both abilities are restricted to white creatures - the anthem and the vigilance grant. That colour condition was not recorded.

kept.name: Cloak and Dagger, Entwined
kept.why: The entire ability was unread. It has an enters trigger that exiles a card or a creature, and the exile lasts until this leaves the battlefield, which is a leaves trigger. Only the lifelink keyword had produced anything.

kept.name: Skull Collector
kept.why: 'Regenerate this creature' keeps it alive and had no effect word. Death Ward in this same batch records regeneration as eff:protect.

kept.name: Navigator's Compass
kept.why: The activated ability requires tapping and that cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Myr Servitor
kept.why: 'Each player returns all cards named Myr Servitor' is symmetric - it returns your opponents' copies too, which is the whole character of the card and was not recorded.

kept.name: Quantum Entanglement
kept.why: This is a repeatable blink and carried no blink word, no trigger and no timing. It exiles your own creature and returns it, it triggers both on entering and at the beginning of your end step, and the effect is gated on paying {1}{W}. Only the vague eff:protect had been read.

kept.name: Fodder Launch
kept.why: It shrinks one target creature and damages that creature's controller. Nothing is symmetric or mass, so scope:all wrongly reads spot removal as a sweeper.

kept.name: Alabaster Mage
kept.why: Granting lifelink changes no power or toughness. grants:lifelink already says what the ability does; eff:pump makes it look like a combat trick it is not.

kept.name: Basilica Bell-Haunt
kept.why: 'Each opponent discards a card' hits every opponent, not one target. That symmetry was not recorded.

kept.name: Shadow Prophecy
kept.why: Only the 'lose 2 life' clause was read. It looks at the top X cards of your library and takes up to two into hand (look-and-pick), and puts the rest into your graveyard, which is self-mill.

kept.name: Kozilek's Pathfinder
kept.why: The activated ability was not read at all. '{C}: Target creature can't block this creature' stops a creature blocking.

kept.name: Absorb Vis
kept.why: Basic landcycling's cost is '{1}{B}, Discard this card', which is a discard-self cost the list does not record.

kept.name: Captured by the Consulate
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature can't attack' is a whole clause with no word for it; only the target-changing trigger was read.

kept.name: Stuffed Bear
kept.why: The only ability on the card, '{2}: This artifact becomes a 4/4 green Bear artifact creature', turns a noncreature permanent into a creature and produced no effect word at all.

kept.name: Halls of Mist
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep specifically, not merely at some step. The attack restriction applies to every creature on the battlefield, not one target.

kept.name: Nita, Forum Conciliator
kept.why: It exiles an instant or sorcery from an opponent's graveyard, so the graveyard zone is what the ability reads. The trigger is 'whenever YOU cast a spell you don't own', which is a you-cast trigger, not merely a cast trigger.

kept.name: Abyssal Nocturnus
kept.why: 'This creature gets +2/+2' was not read; only the fear grant was. The list said nothing about the size change at all.

kept.name: Blazethorn Scarecrow
kept.why: 'as long as you control a red creature' is a real colour condition the list does not carry. The green half has no word available at all.

kept.name: Guardian of the Forgotten
kept.why: The trigger condition was dropped entirely: this fires when a modified creature you control DIES. Manifest also takes the top card of your library, so the library is the zone it reads.

kept.name: Ticket Turbotubes
kept.why: The second ability, '{3}, {T}: You get {TK} (a ticket counter)', puts a counter on you the player, in the same family as energy and experience. Nothing in the list records it.

kept.name: Swallow Whole
kept.why: The card exiles one target tapped creature and puts one counter on one creature. Nothing about it is a mass effect, so scope:all reads it as a sweeper-shaped card it is not.

kept.name: Adorned Crocodile
kept.why: Renew is activated from the graveyard and its cost is 'Exile this card from your graveyard'. Both the zone the ability lives in and the exile-self cost are missing, so the card reads as a plain death trigger.

kept.name: Xenic Poltergeist
kept.why: The card's only ability produced no words at all. It turns a noncreature artifact into a creature, and the cost of doing so is tapping.

kept.name: Hallowed Moonlight
kept.why: Only 'draw a card' was read. The replacement exiles any creature that enters without being cast, and it applies to every creature and every player, not one target.

kept.name: Feudkiller's Verdict
kept.why: It makes a 5/5 white Giant Warrior token and the list says only that it gains life. The token half of the card is entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Arcbound Wanderer
kept.why: Modular's second half is 'When it dies', which is more precise than the generic leaves trigger already present. Sunburst counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, which is exactly cares:mana-spent.

kept.name: Rosecot Knight
kept.why: The whole enters trigger was reduced to the fallback counter. It looks at the top six cards of your library and takes one into hand, which is the main thing the card does.

kept.name: Nectar Faerie
kept.why: The ability grants lifelink and changes no power or toughness. grants:lifelink already carries it, and eff:pump makes this look like a combat trick that pumps a creature. Spare from Evil in the same batch grants protection and correctly carries no eff:pump.

kept.name: Frontier Seeker
kept.why: Nothing on this card exiles anything or plays a card from exile. It looks at the top five, puts one in HAND and the rest on the bottom of the library. eff:impulse would file it with Light Up the Stage, and cares:zone:exile is a zone the card never touches.

kept.name: Elspeth, Undaunted Hero
kept.why: The minus two searches your library AND/OR GRAVEYARD and puts the card onto the battlefield. The graveyard half of that search, and the fact that it can reanimate from there, are both unrecorded.

kept.name: Jester's Mask
kept.why: The ability costs '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact'. The sacrifice is recorded and the tap is not.

kept.name: Flaming Fist Officer
kept.why: The trigger is on ANOTHER creature you control leaving, not on this one leaving. The bare trig:leaves cannot tell those apart, and the -other form is the convention used for trig:enters-other on Guul Draz Overseer in this same batch.

kept.name: Red Room Recruit
kept.why: Connive is spelled out on the card as draw a card, then discard a card. Only the resulting counter was recorded, so a card that genuinely draws and loots reads as neither.

kept.name: Sea Gate Colossus
kept.why: The card's only line is 'This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature in your party', and it produced no effect word at all. This is the Ghalta shape: the whole card is a cost reduction.

kept.name: Ballista Charger
kept.why: Crew 3 is 'Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 3 or more', which is literally a tap-other-creatures cost and is the only way to use the Vehicle.

kept.name: Glacial Plating
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep, and that trigger is what grows the Aura. Halls of Mist in this same batch carries trig:step for the identical keyword, so this one is inconsistent as well as incomplete.

kept.name: Sigarda's Imprisonment
kept.why: Two whole clauses were missed: the enchanted creature cannot attack or block, and the ability makes a Blood token. eff:exile-own is wrong and actively harmful: 'Enchant creature' has no controller restriction and this is removal aimed at an opponent's creature, so calling it a blink of your own permanent would offer it to flicker decks as an enabler.

kept.name: Flesh Carver
kept.why: "When this creature dies, create an X/X black Horror creature token" - the death trigger makes a token and nothing in the list said so.

kept.name: Butcher's Glee
kept.why: "Regenerate it" saves the targeted creature from destruction, which is what eff:protect describes. Only the pump and lifelink halves were recorded.

kept.name: One Thousand Lashes
kept.why: The drain is "At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller", so it has an upkeep trigger the list omitted. A creature that cannot attack, cannot block and cannot use its activated abilities has been rendered harmless without being destroyed, which is eff:neutralise and is what makes this a removal card.

kept.name: Nyla, Shirshu Sleuth
kept.why: "you lose X life and create X Clue tokens" - both the life loss and the token making were missing. The end-step ability returns "target card exiled with Nyla", so the card genuinely cares about the exile zone.

kept.name: Dreadful Apathy
kept.why: "Enchanted creature can't attack or block" produced nothing at all. eff:exile-own means flickering your own permanents; this exiles the enchanted creature (normally an opponent's) permanently, so it is wrong and would read as a blink card.

kept.name: Bushi Tenderfoot // Kenzo the Hardhearted
kept.why: "When a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies, flip this creature" is a death trigger and a change to the card's other face. Neither was recorded; only the back face's bushido triggers were.

kept.name: Leave No Trace
kept.why: It destroys the target "and each other enchantment that shares a color with it", a mass selector that hits your own enchantments too, not a single target.

kept.name: Altar Golem
kept.why: "Altar Golem's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures on the battlefield" is a characteristic-setting effect and nothing in the list expressed it.

kept.name: Voltstorm Angel
kept.why: Only the energy counters were read. The combat trigger is "you may pay {E}{E}. When you do, choose one" (eff:do-if-cost-paid, eff:choose) and its two modes grant vigilance and lifelink, or pump every other creature you control.

kept.name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
kept.why: The trigger is specifically "whenever ANOTHER creature you control leaves the battlefield", which trig:leaves-other states exactly. The counter goes only on itself, so it already has eff:add-counters-self; the generic eff:add-counters reads as putting counters on other things and would file this as a counters-matters card.

kept.name: Intimidation Tactics
kept.why: "You choose an artifact or creature card from it. Exile that card." The whole main effect of the spell produced no verb; only the cycling half was read.

kept.name: Story Circle
kept.why: "prevent that damage" is the entire point of the card and only the colour choice was recorded.

kept.name: Offalsnout
kept.why: It exiles a card from a graveyard, so it reads graveyards. The list already carries eff:exile-graveyard but not the zone.

kept.name: Beckoning Will-o'-Wisp
kept.why: "Creatures attacking the last chosen player get +1/+0" is a mass pump and produced no effect word at all.

kept.name: Abattoir Ghoul
kept.why: "Whenever a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies" is a death trigger; only the life gain it produces was recorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Portal
kept.why: The card had NO effect words whatsoever. It looks at the top ten of your library, exiles half of them, searches the other half and puts a card into your hand, then shuffles the rest back. It is a tutor and every part of it was unread.

kept.name: Sleeper's Guile
kept.why: "When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand" is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger on itself, and returning itself from the graveyard is self-recursion. Left trig:dies alone since it is a defensible reading of the same clause.

kept.name: Unwilling Ingredient
kept.why: Its only real ability is activated from the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"), which the list did not record; cost:exile-self alone does not say where from.

kept.name: Serene Sleuth
kept.why: A Clue is card draw ("{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card"), which is how Nyla is already read in this same batch, and the card makes one on entry and more each combat.

kept.name: Mesmeric Fiend
kept.why: Both halves of the card were unread: it exiles a nonland card from an opponent's hand, then returns that exiled card when it leaves. The list carried the two triggers and neither of the effects.

kept.name: Grim Reaper, Lethal Legionnaire
kept.why: "you may pay {3}{B}. When you do..." is a pay-for-more trigger, and the reanimated creature arrives "with a finality counter on it", a counter placed on another permanent.

kept.name: Warren Weirding
kept.why: "that player creates two 1/1 black Goblin Rogue creature tokens, and those tokens gain haste until end of turn" - the token half of the card produced nothing, only the edict.

kept.name: Hezrou // Demonic Stench
kept.why: Both faces hit "each blocking creature" / "each creature that blocked this turn", a mass selector rather than a single target.

kept.name: Aerial Boost
kept.why: Convoke is an additional/alternative casting cost paid by tapping your own creatures, which is exactly cost:cast-tap-others. Nothing recorded the cost at all.

kept.name: Bartered Cow
kept.why: The card's only effect is 'create a Food token' and eff:create-token was missing entirely. eff:gain-life was recorded off the Food reminder text but the token-making itself, the actual clause, was not.

kept.name: Mine Excavation
kept.why: Conspire taps two untapped creatures you control as you cast. The copy half was read (eff:copy) but the cost half was not.

kept.name: Seer of Stolen Sight
kept.why: Its trigger is 'whenever artifacts and/or creatures you control are put into a graveyard from the battlefield'. It is a graveyard-matters card and carried no graveyard word.

kept.name: Call to Serve
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets +1/+2' was not recorded. Only the flying grant was read.

kept.name: Downwind Ambusher
kept.why: It is a modal 'choose one —' spell and no word said so. Both modes were read but the choice between them was not.

kept.name: Paralyze
kept.why: eff:tap-own is wrong: this Aura enchants ANY creature and taps the enchanted one, which is an opponent's creature in every real use. It is not tapping your own permanents. It is a lockdown removal Aura in the Imprisoned in the Moon class, tapped and never untapping, so it earns eff:neutralise. The upkeep clause ('At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller, that player may pay {4}') gave neither a step trigger nor the optional-payment word. I deliberately did NOT add eff:untap: the untap belongs to the opponent buying their creature back, and filing this as an untapper would put it in front of decks looking for Seedborn Muse effects.

kept.name: Ominous Parcel
kept.why: Nothing on this card is mass. One ability searches for a single basic land, the other deals 4 damage to a single target creature. scope:all is simply false and would make it read as a sweeper-adjacent card.

kept.name: Piston Sledge
kept.why: 'When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control' is an attach effect and eff:attach was absent. 'Equip—Sacrifice an artifact' is a sacrifice cost paid with another permanent, which is cost:sacrifice rather than cost:sacrifice-self.

kept.name: Pursuit of Knowledge
kept.why: 'you may put a study counter on this enchantment instead' accumulates counters on itself, and only the removal half (cost:remove-counters) was recorded.

kept.name: Iron Bully
kept.why: The counter goes on TARGET creature, not on Iron Bully. -self means the card grows itself, and this one never does. eff:add-counters already covers the real effect.

kept.name: Citizen V, Helmut Zemo
kept.why: 'Whenever you gain life' is the definition of a lifegain payoff. The trigger word was there but nothing said the card is a lifegain-matters card, which is the signal a lifegain deck would need to find it.

kept.name: Belbe's Armor
kept.why: '-X/+X' raises toughness as well as lowering power. Only the shrink half was read; the toughness boost is a real combat trick and is what the card is usually pointed at your own creature for.

kept.name: Parish-Blade Trainee
kept.why: Training is an attack trigger: 'Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' The counters were read but the event that causes them was not, so it does not read as an attacking-matters card.

kept.name: Night Dealings
kept.why: 'put that many theft counters on this enchantment' puts them on itself, and only the generic eff:add-counters was present. The activated ability searches your library and carried no library word, unlike other tutors.

kept.name: Time Bomb
kept.why: The payoff hits 'each creature and each player', which is mass, and no scope word was recorded. The activation cost is '{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact' and neither the tap nor the self-sacrifice was read. I left scope:wipe off deliberately: the damage is variable and often small, so calling it a board wipe would be a stronger claim than the card supports.

kept.name: Gild
kept.why: The Gold token it creates is a one-shot mana source ('Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color'). The token was recorded but the mana it produces was not, which is the same gap Treasure makers have.

kept.name: Reprisal
kept.why: 'target creature with power 4 or greater' is a power check and cares:power was missing.

kept.name: Deathless Behemoth
kept.why: This is the exact eff:recur-self card: it returns ITSELF from your graveyard to your hand for a sacrifice cost. eff:bounce-own is wrong, that word means returning your creatures from the battlefield to hand and nothing here leaves the battlefield. scope:all is wrong, sacrificing two specific Scions affects nothing globally.

kept.name: You Hear Something on Watch
kept.why: A modal 'Choose one —' spell with no word for the choice. Both modes were read; the modality was not.

kept.name: Undercity Plague
kept.why: Cipher's payoff is casting a copy of the encoded card without paying its mana cost. eff:copy was recorded but the free-cast half, which is the whole reason to cipher a six-mana sorcery, was not.

kept.name: Favorable Destiny
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets +1/+2 as long as it's white' was never recorded; only the shroud clause was read.

kept.name: Soulflayer
kept.why: The card names eleven keywords it can give itself and only five grants were recorded (flying, first strike, deathtouch, haste, trample). The text is explicit: 'The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, reach, trample, and vigilance.' The six missing ones are the same claim as the five that were kept, and hexproof and indestructible are the two that matter most to a player.

kept.name: Starling, Aerial Ally
kept.why: It grants flying and nothing else. No power or toughness changes anywhere on the card, so eff:pump is a false reading of 'gains ... until end of turn'. grants:flying already carries the whole effect.

kept.name: Casting of Bones
kept.why: The entire payoff clause was unread: 'draw three cards, then discard one of them'. The card carried only the dies trigger, so a card-draw Aura looked like a blank.

kept.name: Ninja's Kunai
kept.why: The granted ability's cost is 'Sacrifice Ninja's Kunai', so the Equipment eats itself to deal the damage. Nothing recorded that the effect is one-shot.

kept.name: Koya, Death from Above
kept.why: Only the exile half was read. The delayed clause is the whole card: 'At the beginning of the next end step, you may pay {3}{B}. If you don't, return that card to the battlefield.' That is an end-step trigger, an optional payment that changes the outcome, and a return from exile. Without them the card reads as unconditional removal, which it is not.

kept.name: Fetid Imp
kept.why: '{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn' changes no power or toughness. grants:deathtouch is the whole ability; eff:pump is a misread of the word 'gains'.

kept.name: Glorifier of Suffering
kept.why: "put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures" is bounded targeting, not a global effect. The word "each" is doing the damage here - nothing on this card touches every permanent or every player.

kept.name: Carrionette
kept.why: Three clauses were unread. "unless that creature's controller pays {2}" is a tax (eff:unless-pays); "Exile this card AND target creature" exiles itself as well as the target; and "Activate only if this card is in your graveyard" makes it a genuine graveyard-matters card, which is the whole point of the card.

kept.name: World Queller
kept.why: The list carried the upkeep trigger and nothing the ability does. "each player sacrifices a permanent" is a repeating symmetric edict (eff:sacrifice + scope:all) and "you may choose a card type" is a real choice on resolution.

kept.name: Treacherous Link
kept.why: Nothing is prevented. "All damage that would be dealt to enchanted creature is dealt to its controller instead" is a replacement, and eff:redirect-damage - already on the card - says it exactly. Leaving prevent-damage on puts this in fog and damage-prevention pools it does not belong in.

kept.name: Shieldmage Advocate
kept.why: The whole ability was unread - the list held only the activation cost number. It taps ({T}), returns a card from an opponent's graveyard to their hand, and prevents all damage to any target from a chosen source.

kept.name: Cathedral of Serra
kept.why: "White legendary creatures you control have 'bands with other legendary creatures'" is a granted banding ability and nothing recorded that it grants anything at all.

kept.name: Roxxon Brutes
kept.why: Basic landcycling is "{2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land" - discarding itself is a real cost this card lets you pay, and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Sneering Shadewriter
kept.why: "EACH opponent loses 2 life" hits every opponent, which is what separates this from the single-target drains it currently looks identical to.

kept.name: Sunscour
kept.why: The alternative cost was entirely unread: "You may exile two white cards from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is a cast-time exile cost paid out of hand.

kept.name: Lagonna-Band Trailblazer
kept.why: Heroic puts one counter on this creature when you target it. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Cover of Winter
kept.why: The card's actual function - "prevent X of that damage, where X is the number of age counters" - was missing. The list recorded only that it accumulates counters.

kept.name: Mangara's Tome
kept.why: Half the card was unread. It exiles the five searched cards in a face-down pile, and the activated ability moves a card from that exile pile to hand in place of a draw.

kept.name: Hunter of Eyeblights
kept.why: The removal ability is "{2}{B}, {T}: Destroy target creature with a counter on it" - the tap in the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Clockwork Dragon
kept.why: "Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, remove a +1/+1 counter from it at end of combat" - the list had the adding of counters and not the removing, which is the card's whole drawback.

kept.name: Overzealous Muscle
kept.why: It does not have indestructible printed, it GAINS indestructible from its own trigger, and nothing recorded that it grants anything.

kept.name: Martyred Rusalka
kept.why: It sacrifices A CREATURE, not itself - the card stays on the battlefield and can be used again every turn. cost:sacrifice-self says the opposite (eats only itself, once) and hides that this is a repeatable free sacrifice outlet, which cost:sacrifice already correctly records.

kept.name: Death's Approach
kept.why: "gets -X/-X, where X is the number of creature cards in its controller's graveyard" - the size of the effect is read straight off a graveyard and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Rustic Clachan
kept.why: Reinforce 1 is "{1}{W}, Discard this card: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature" - discarding itself is a cost this land lets you pay, and it was unrecorded.

kept.name: Forum Familiar
kept.why: "return another target permanent YOU CONTROL to its owner's hand" is a self-bounce, which is how this card is used to re-trigger your own arrivals. The generic eff:move-zone does not say whose permanent moves.

kept.name: Liliana's Spoils
kept.why: Nothing on this card touches exile and nothing is played from exile. It looks at the top five, takes one to hand and bottoms the rest - eff:look-and-pick, already present, is the correct word. Marking it impulse draw would offer it to decks built on exile-and-cast payoffs it cannot support.

kept.name: Monoist Circuit-Feeder
kept.why: The entire enters trigger was unread: "target creature you control gets +X/+0 and target creature an opponent controls gets -0/-X". It both pumps and shrinks, which is also what makes it a removal-ish artifact payoff.

kept.name: Hog-Monkey
kept.why: "target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains menace until end of turn" - the grant to another creature was missing; only the counters it puts on itself were recorded.

kept.name: Lightform
kept.why: It attaches itself to the manifested creature (eff:attach), and manifest looks at the top card of your library (cares:zone:library). Left eff:create-token alone though manifest puts a real card, not a token, since nothing else records that it makes a body.

kept.name: Snake Cult Initiation
kept.why: Poisonous 3 gives three poison counters on combat damage. The whole point of the card was unrecorded.

kept.name: Ronin, Shadow Stalker
kept.why: The second ability is {T}, Sacrifice an Equipment: target creature gets -4/-4. None of the tap cost, the sacrifice cost or the -4/-4 was read.

kept.name: Shatter the Oath
kept.why: It creates a Wicked Role token attached to a creature you control, and that Role gives +1/+1. Only the destroy half and the Role's death drain were read.

kept.name: Mutual Destruction
kept.why: It destroys one target creature. Nothing about this spell is a mass effect; scope:all would read it as a board wipe.

kept.name: Vanquish the Weak
kept.why: 'target creature with power 3 or less' is a power check, which is exactly what cares:power records.

kept.name: Suspension Field
kept.why: The exile lasts only until this enchantment leaves the battlefield, and the creature then returns. The return half of the card was unrecorded.

kept.name: Encircling Fissure
kept.why: Awaken puts two +1/+1 counters on a land you control and turns it into a 0/0 Elemental with haste, none of which was read. The prevention covers all combat damage from one opponent's whole board.

kept.name: Henchbots
kept.why: The exile lasts until this creature leaves the battlefield and the creature comes back then. Same shape as Suspension Field.

kept.name: Wire Surgeons
kept.why: Encore creates token COPIES of the graveyard creature and they gain haste. Both were missing from an ability that is the whole card.

kept.name: Vampiric Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability triggers when a creature dealt damage by that Sliver dies. Did not add scope:all: the grant is confined to Slivers rather than affecting everything.

kept.name: Deepwood Ghoul
kept.why: Regenerate keeps the creature alive, which is what eff:protect records; Vigilant Martyr already carries it for the same wording.

kept.name: Ultimo, Civilization's End
kept.why: The second ability's cost is discarding this card from hand. Left scope:all off: 'each opponent sacrifices' is an edict, not a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Seedpod Caretaker
kept.why: Mode two transforms an Incubator token you control, which no effect word recorded, and the card is a 'choose one' modal.

kept.name: Burdened Stoneback
kept.why: The ability's cost is removing a counter from itself, and it enters with two -1/-1 counters on itself.

kept.name: Herald of Anafenza
kept.why: Outlast is {2}{W}, {T} — the tap cost sits inside the reminder text and was not read.

kept.name: Raffine's Informant
kept.why: Connive is draw a card then discard a card. Only the resulting counter was recorded; the draw and the discard, which are the card's actual effect, were not.

kept.name: Vitality Hunter
kept.why: Monstrosity X puts X +1/+1 counters on itself, and becoming monstrous puts lifelink counters on up to X other creatures, granting them lifelink. The card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Devour Intellect
kept.why: 'If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast this spell' is a mana-spent condition.

kept.name: Innocent Traveler // Malicious Invader
kept.why: An opponent may sacrifice a creature, it transforms itself if nobody does, and the back face gets +2/+0 conditionally. The card carried no effect word.

kept.name: Myr Quadropod
kept.why: Switching power and toughness changes a creature's printed stats, and eff:set-pt is the only word in the vocabulary for altering P/T to fixed values. The card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: God-Pharaoh's Faithful
kept.why: It triggers on blue, black OR red spells and only black was recorded. scope:all is wrong: a cast trigger gaining you 1 life affects nothing broadly.

kept.name: Unified Front
kept.why: The entire card is creating Kor Ally tokens and no effect word said so.

kept.name: Winter Soldier, Icy Assassin
kept.why: He gets +2/+0 for each Equipment attached, and the ability returns him from the graveyard to the battlefield (eff:return-from alongside the eff:recur-self already there, matching Scrapwork Rager).

kept.name: Dramatist's Puppet
kept.why: It can put another counter of each kind on the permanent; only the removal half was read.

kept.name: Loyal Sentry
kept.why: It triggers when it BLOCKS a creature, not when it becomes blocked. trig:blocks is already there and is the correct one.

kept.name: Morkrut Behemoth
kept.why: The sacrifice is an additional cost to CAST the spell, not an activated ability cost. Mutual Destruction in this same batch is correctly filed as cost:cast-sacrifice for the identical wording.

kept.name: Cryptex
kept.why: The first ability costs {T} and collect evidence 3, which exiles cards from your graveyard, and it puts an unlock counter on itself. Only the mana and the sacrifice payoff were read.

kept.name: Vigilant Martyr
kept.why: The second ability counters a target spell and costs {T}. The countering half of the card was entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Boneknitter
kept.why: Regenerate target Zombie keeps a creature alive; same treatment as Vigilant Martyr's regenerate.

kept.name: Corpsehatch
kept.why: The two Eldrazi Spawn it makes sacrifice for {C}, printed on the card. That mana is why the card is played and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Distracting Geist // Clever Distraction
kept.why: Disturb is a cast-from-graveyard mechanic - the card brings itself back from the yard as the Aura half, which is exactly eff:recur-self, and nothing recorded that it cares about the graveyard at all. The back face also says 'If Clever Distraction would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead', which is a literal self-exile and was unread.

kept.name: Priest of Yawgmoth
kept.why: The activated ability is '{T}, Sacrifice an artifact:'. cost:sacrifice was recorded and the tap half of the same cost was not, so a mana engine that must tap read as one that does not.

kept.name: Nimble Hobbit
kept.why: 'you may sacrifice a Food or pay {2}{W}. When you do...' is a sacrifice outlet (cost:sacrifice) wrapped in the pay-for-more reflexive trigger shape (eff:do-if-cost-paid). Only the resulting tap was written down.

kept.name: Balancing Act
kept.why: Every player sacrifices down to the lowest permanent count - a symmetric mass board clear that hits your own side, which is what scope:wipe is for and is precisely the anti-synergy signal a go-wide deck needs. 'Each player discards cards the same way' also touches hands and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Sivvi's Valor
kept.why: Redirecting all damage that would hit a creature onto yourself keeps that creature alive, which is the job eff:protect names. The card was recorded only as damage plumbing, so no deck could ever choose it as a protection spell.

kept.name: Crook of Condemnation
kept.why: The second ability's cost is 'Exile this artifact' (cost:exile-self) and its effect is 'Exile ALL graveyards' (scope:all), neither of which was read - only the targeted first ability was. A dedicated piece of graveyard hate also carried no cares:zone:graveyard.

kept.name: Shauku, Endbringer
kept.why: 'Shauku can't attack if there's another creature on the battlefield' is a hard self-restriction and the whole reason this card is unplayable as a beater. It was completely unread.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Green
kept.why: The card's entire text is a damage prevention effect and the list held only the activation cost and the type. It said nothing at all about what the card does.

kept.name: Knight of Obligation
kept.why: Extort is 'Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much.' The drain was read but the trigger was not narrowed to your own casts, the stack was not noted, and the optional payment is the do-if-cost-paid shape. Contemplation in this same batch carries the full set for the identical trigger.

kept.name: Bat Colony
kept.why: 'Whenever a Cave you control enters' is a trigger on another permanent arriving, not on this one, and only trig:enters-self was recorded. 'for each mana from a Cave spent to cast it' is literally cares:mana-spent, which nothing captured.

kept.name: Fleeting Spirit
kept.why: 'Discard a card: Exile this creature. Return it at the beginning of the next end step' is a discard cost paid by you (cost:discard-self - only the generic cost:discard was there), it sets up a delayed end-step trigger, and its whole purpose is dodging removal, which is eff:protect.

kept.name: Divine Smite
kept.why: 'If that permanent is black, exile it instead' is a colour condition and the only reason the card ever exiles anything. It was unread.

kept.name: Blistergrub
kept.why: Bog Wraith in this same batch carries eff:cant-be-blocked for the identical swampwalk line and Blistergrub does not, so two copies of one keyword read differently. 'each opponent loses 2 life' is an all-opponents selector.

kept.name: Mire's Grasp
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets -3/-3' makes the creature SMALLER. Recorded as eff:pump, this removal aura reads to the engine as a card that grows creatures, so it can be offered as a way to buff your own board and can never be chosen as removal.

kept.name: Tomb Robber
kept.why: Discarding here is the activation COST of the explore ability, not an effect the card produces - it is a discard outlet, which is a different job from a card that makes you discard. Explore also reveals the top of your library and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Swordsman, Sharp Scoundrel
kept.why: Connive is 'draw a card, then discard a card, then a +1/+1 counter if the discard was nonland'. Only the counter was read - the draw and the discard, which are the whole reason connive is a graveyard and card-filtering payoff, were both missing.

kept.name: Spirit Cairn
kept.why: 'you may pay {W}. If you do, create a token' is the pay-for-more shape, and the trigger watches ANY player discarding, not just you. The list held four words for a card with a trigger, an optional cost and a token.

kept.name: Kithkin Rabble
kept.why: Its power and toughness count the number of WHITE permanents you control - a mono-white payoff. The colour condition, which is the entire card, was unread; cares:color:w already exists and is used by 148 cards.

kept.name: Patched Plaything
kept.why: The counters go on this creature itself, not on something else, and the condition is 'if you cast it from your hand' - the drawback only applies from hand, which is the whole point of the card and was unrecorded.

kept.name: D'Avenant Healer
kept.why: The card has TWO abilities and the second one, 'Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn', was read as nothing at all. Both abilities also cost {T}, which was missing.

kept.name: Inscription of Ruin
kept.why: This is a modal spell - 'Choose one. If this spell was kicked, choose any number instead' - and nothing recorded that it offers a choice. The discard mode also touches an opponent's hand.

kept.name: Cackling Fiend
kept.why: Each opponent discards a card, which is a hand-attack effect; every other discard card in this batch (Wit's End, Sin Collector) carries cares:zone:hand and this one does not.

kept.name: Grinning Totem
kept.why: The activation cost is {2}, {T}, Sacrifice, and only cost:sacrifice-self was recorded, so the tap cost is missing. The card exiles the searched card (eff:exile absent) and sets up two delayed upkeep triggers, neither of which is recorded. Deliberately NOT adding eff:shuffle: the opponent shuffles their library, not you, and the gloss says 'shuffles your library'.

kept.name: All Hallow's Eve
kept.why: The first line exiles the card itself, the upkeep trigger removes a scream counter from it, and the payoff returns ALL creature cards from EVERY player's graveyard to the battlefield, which is as mass as an effect gets. All three were unread.

kept.name: Dancing Sword
kept.why: When the equipped creature dies the Equipment itself becomes a 2/1 Construct artifact creature, which is exactly 'turns a permanent into a creature'. Not adding grants:flying: the flying is printed on the body it becomes rather than granted to another permanent.

kept.name: Malevolent Awakening
kept.why: It returns ONE target creature card from your graveyard for a sacrifice. Nothing about it affects everything, and telling the engine this is a mass effect is a plain misread.

kept.name: Drag to the Bottom
kept.why: Each creature gets -X/-X where X is at least 1, unrestricted and symmetric, so it kills your own board too. That is the same shape as Toxic Deluge and Yahenni's Expertise, which is what scope:wipe exists for; scope:all alone does not tell the engine it is dangerous to a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Griffin Protector
kept.why: The effect is +1/+1 on ITSELF until end of turn. The 'another creature you control' is the trigger condition, not the target, so nothing here affects everything - this reads as an anthem to the engine and it is not one.

kept.name: Merciless Repurposing
kept.why: Incubate 3 creates a token carrying three +1/+1 counters, so the card genuinely puts counters onto a permanent and that clause produced nothing.

kept.name: Detention Vortex
kept.why: Enchanted permanent can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated. That is a Pacifism-style lockdown and it is the definition of eff:neutralise, 'harmless without destroying it'. Only eff:cant-activate was read, so the engine could not see this as removal at all.

kept.name: Withering Wisps
kept.why: The activated ability deals 1 damage to EACH creature and EACH player, which is a genuine mass effect and was unrecorded. Not adding scope:wipe: 1 damage is a sweeper only against x/1s, not a board wipe.

kept.name: Mark of the Oni
kept.why: 'You control enchanted creature' is the entire card and produced no facet. Only the sacrifice-if-no-Demons drawback was read, so the engine knew the downside and not the effect.

kept.name: Driftgloom Coyote
kept.why: 'exile ... until this creature leaves the battlefield' is a delayed trigger on this creature leaving, which is what makes the exile temporary and what makes the card blinkable. Neither leave-word was recorded.

kept.name: Sin Collector
kept.why: 'You choose an instant or sorcery card from it and exile that card' - the card's whole effect is an exile and it carried no effect verb at all, only what it looks at. Not eff:discard: the card is exiled from hand, never discarded.

kept.name: Devouring Sugarmaw // Have for Dinner
kept.why: The Adventure half creates a 1/1 Human token AND a Food token, and eff:create-token is entirely absent. The upkeep trigger also sacrifices an artifact, enchantment or token. Not adding cost:sacrifice: this is not an on-demand outlet, it is an upkeep tax you may decline.

kept.name: Appetite for Brains
kept.why: The card's only effect is exiling a card with mana value 4 or greater out of an opponent's hand, and the list held no effect verb whatsoever - just cares:zone:hand and its own mana value.

kept.name: Gossamer Chains
kept.why: The activation cost is returning this enchantment to its owner's hand, which is the reusable-every-turn engine of the card. eff:move-zone was recorded instead, which describes the movement but not that it is a repeatable cost.

kept.name: Oasis
kept.why: The land's entire ability - tap to prevent 1 damage to a creature - produced no facets at all beyond acost:1. It also has no mana symbols anywhere, so its colour identity is empty and col:none is missing.

kept.name: Bola Slinger
kept.why: Backup 1 is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ('When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature'). eff:add-counters was recorded but the trigger that causes it was not, so the engine sees the counter with no idea when it happens.

kept.name: Yellowjacket, Heartless Marauder
kept.why: The effect is +1/+0 and lifelink on Yellowjacket alone. 'Another Villain you control' is the trigger condition, not the thing affected, so this is not a mass effect - same misread as Griffin Protector.

kept.name: Anointer of Valor
kept.why: 'you may pay {3}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature' is the optional-payment shape eff:do-if-cost-paid names, and the counter was recorded as unconditional.

kept.name: Rise to Glory
kept.why: 'Choose one or both' is a modal spell and the modality produced nothing, so the engine reads it as a flat reanimation spell rather than one that also rebuys an Aura.

kept.name: Dungeon Crawler
kept.why: It returns ITSELF from the graveyard, which is exactly eff:recur-self, and the destination is your hand.

kept.name: Unscrupulous Agent
kept.why: The whole card is "target opponent exiles a card from their hand" and it carried no effect word at all - only the trigger and cares:zone:hand.

kept.name: Bladed Ambassador
kept.why: The only counter it ever places is the oil counter it enters with, on itself. The generic word makes it read as a counters-matter card.

kept.name: Azorius Justiciar
kept.why: Detain was left as a bare keyword with no effects. Its reminder text says the creatures can't attack, can't block, and their activated abilities can't be activated.

kept.name: Devouring Strossus
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature: Regenerate" is a sacrifice OUTLET. eff:sacrifice was recorded for the upkeep trigger but the activated cost was not.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: White
kept.why: The card's entire main ability prevents damage and no prevention word was present - it only carried the cycling half.

kept.name: Heliod's Emissary
kept.why: "Whenever this creature or enchanted creature attacks, tap target creature" - the tap effect was recorded but the trigger that fires it was not.

kept.name: Blood-Chin Fanatic
kept.why: X is the sacrificed creature's power, so the card scales off power and wants big Warriors.

kept.name: Kuro's Taken
kept.why: Bushido was left as a bare keyword. It reads "whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn" - two triggers and a pump.

kept.name: Agent 13, Sharon Carter
kept.why: The investigate trigger fires on a creature attacking alone, and a Clue is a draw (Sokka's Sword Training in this same batch carries eff:draw for making one).

kept.name: Kami of Restless Shadows
kept.why: It is a modal "choose one" card. eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the BATTLEFIELD to hand; both modes act on the graveyard, which eff:return-from and eff:move-zone already cover.

kept.name: Vampire's Bite
kept.why: The kicked half grants lifelink and nothing recorded it. Kicker is the "pay more, get more" shape eff:do-if-cost-paid describes.

kept.name: Weapon Rack
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and no tap cost was recorded. Moving a counter OFF the artifact is a removal of counters as well as a placement.

kept.name: Desert's Hold
kept.why: The aura's main clause is a Pacifism: the enchanted creature can't attack or block. Only the activated-ability shutoff was recorded.

kept.name: Demonlord of Ashmouth
kept.why: Two whole abilities were unread: the enters trigger exiles it unless you sacrifice another creature, and undying is a dies trigger that brings it back from the graveyard.

kept.name: Long-Bodied Grey Dog
kept.why: The card makes a Treasure token and carried no token word at all - only cares:sub:treasure from a word scan. A Treasure is a mana source, which is why this card is played.

kept.name: Possessed Goat
kept.why: The discard is on the left of the colon, so it is a cost, not an effect. Urborg Syphon-Mage and Oona's Prowler in this same batch use cost:discard for the identical wording.

kept.name: Blind Zealot
kept.why: "You may sacrifice it" is the price of the removal, and nothing recorded that this creature eats itself.

kept.name: Soulscour
kept.why: "Destroy all nonartifact permanents" is the widest board wipe in the batch and it destroys your own board too. It carried only scope:all.

kept.name: Channel Harm
kept.why: It prevents ALL damage to you and every permanent you control for the turn - a fog that keeps your creatures alive, which no word on it said.

kept.name: Lake-town Lookout
kept.why: Recruit was left as a bare keyword. Its reminder text is draw a card, discard a card, then create a Human Soldier token - three effects, none recorded.

kept.name: Feaster of Fools
kept.why: Devour 2 has it enter with twice as many +1/+1 counters on itself; the sacrifice cost was recorded but not what the sacrifice buys.

kept.name: Cult Healer
kept.why: It grants itself lifelink until end of turn, which every other lifelink-granting card in the batch records as grants:lifelink. The trigger is another permanent (an enchantment you control) entering, not itself, so it wants trig:enters-other alongside the bare trig:enters.

kept.name: Woebringer Demon
kept.why: "At the beginning of EACH player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature" is a symmetric edict hitting every player, not a single target.

kept.name: Kiyomaro, First to Stand
kept.why: All three of its abilities key off the number of cards in your hand - P/T, the vigilance condition, and the seven-life trigger. This is a hand-size card and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Boros Mastiff
kept.why: Battalion grants it lifelink until end of turn; the grant itself was unrecorded, only the downstream eff:gain-life.

kept.name: Doubtless One
kept.why: Both of its abilities were missing. Its power and toughness are SET equal to the number of Clerics (eff:set-pt, exactly as Kiyomaro carries), and "whenever this creature deals damage, you gain that much life" is lifegain. The card had a damage trigger recorded with nothing attached to it.

kept.name: Bebop, Warthog Warrior
kept.why: Swampcycling {2} searches your library for a Swamp card. eff:search-library was recorded but not that the thing searched for is a land, which is what makes this a fixing/ramp effect rather than a tutor.

kept.name: Vampire Interloper
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is the whole of its second line and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Thrull Wizard
kept.why: It is a soft counter - "unless that spell's controller pays {B} or {3}" is the tax clause (eff:unless-pays). It also only answers BLACK spells, which is a real restriction on what it can do and belongs as cares:color:b.

kept.name: Arashin Sunshield
kept.why: The entire enters trigger - "exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard" - was unrecorded. This is graveyard hate and carried no graveyard word at all; only the unrelated tap ability was read.

kept.name: Retched Wretch
kept.why: "When this creature dies... return it to the battlefield under its owner's control" is self-recursion. The card carried a dies trigger with no effect attached to it.

kept.name: Gnashing of Teeth
kept.why: It is a modal spell ("Choose one —"), which nothing recorded, and its second mode gives ALL creatures a target player controls -1/-1, which is a mass effect rather than a single target.

kept.name: Acid-Spewer Dragon
kept.why: The turn-face-up trigger puts a counter on EACH other Dragon you control - a mass effect, the same shape as "Rhinos you control have menace" which is recorded as scope:all elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Baku Altar
kept.why: The first of its two abilities was entirely unread: "Whenever YOU cast a Spirit or Arcane spell, you may put a ki counter on this artifact" is a cast trigger you control that grows the artifact. Only the token-making half was recorded.

kept.name: Chainflail Centipede
kept.why: "Whenever this creature or equipped creature attacks, it gets +2/+0" - both the attack trigger and the pump were missing. Only the reconfigure attach was read.

kept.name: Spy Kit
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1. The stat boost was dropped; only the attach was recorded.

kept.name: Sultai Emissary
kept.why: Manifest puts the top card of your LIBRARY onto the battlefield. The token creation was recorded but not that it comes off the top of your library.

kept.name: Thalia's Geistcaller
kept.why: Two gaps. It has lifelink (every other lifelink card here records eff:gain-life), and "whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard" is a cast trigger on your own spells, which was unrecorded - the graveyard word alone does not say a cast triggers it.

kept.name: Haunted Plate Mail
kept.why: "{0}: this permanent becomes a 4/4 Spirit artifact creature" is the card's defining ability and nothing said it animates. It read as a plain +4/+4 equipment.

kept.name: Bog Hoodlums
kept.why: "This creature can't block" was unrecorded; only the clash trigger was read.

kept.name: Strands of Undeath
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and carried no attach word, unlike Parasitic Implant in the same batch. Deliberately not adding eff:protect for the regenerate line: the enchanted creature is normally an opponent's, so regenerating it is not keeping YOUR creatures alive.

kept.name: Watchers of the Dead
kept.why: The activation cost is literally "Exile this creature", which is cost:exile-self. The card is pure graveyard hate and every other graveyard card in the batch (Nether Shadow, Reconstructed Thopter) carries cares:zone:graveyard.

kept.name: Celestial Kirin
kept.why: "Whenever YOU cast a Spirit or Arcane spell" is a self-cast trigger, not a generic one. It reads the mana value of a spell on the stack, the same pairing Rewards of Diversity already carries. Deliberately NOT marking scope:wipe: the destruction is filtered by mana value, and this file records filtered wipes (Elspeth, Hour of Reckoning) being correctly refused that word.

kept.name: Eriette's Whisper
kept.why: Only the discard half was read. The second sentence creates a Role token and attaches it to a creature you control, and the Role gives +1/+1. Three whole clauses missing.

kept.name: Case of the Gorgon's Kiss
kept.why: Solved it becomes a 4/4 with deathtouch AND lifelink; grants:deathtouch is already there from the same clause so lifelink is a straight omission. Its solve condition watches creature cards going to graveyards, which is exactly what an aristocrats deck cares about.

kept.name: Thraben Gargoyle // Stonewing Antagonizer
kept.why: "{6}: Transform this creature" is an activated ability that turns it to its other face. kw:transform is the printed keyword; the effect itself was never recorded.

kept.name: Dry Spell
kept.why: It deals 1 damage to each PLAYER, which includes you. -self means the effect lands on you, and this is symmetric damage, not one-sided reach.

kept.name: Boot Nipper
kept.why: It enters with a counter on ITSELF, which is eff:add-counters-self. A lifelink counter grants lifelink, matching the grants:deathtouch already present for the other half of the same choice. eff:gain-life is a word scan off "lifelink" - there is no gain-life clause on this card, and Case of the Gorgon's Kiss in this same batch has lifelink without it.

kept.name: Favor of the Mighty
kept.why: "EACH creature with the greatest mana value" is a global static affecting every player's board, not a targeted grant.

kept.name: Talon of Pain
kept.why: The whole first half is unread: it triggers whenever a source you control deals damage to an opponent, and puts a charge counter on itself. Only the activated damage ability was recorded.

kept.name: Cenn's Enlistment
kept.why: Retrace is an additional cost to cast: discard a land card. It also casts from the graveyard, so the card genuinely cares about that zone for its own recursion.

kept.name: Frontline Strategist
kept.why: It prevents ALL combat damage every non-Soldier creature would deal that turn, on both sides of the table, which is a board-wide fog rather than a single prevention.

kept.name: Light of Day
kept.why: The card names black creatures specifically. cares:color:b exists in the vocabulary and is the only word that records which colour it hoses.

kept.name: Vulturous Aven
kept.why: Exploit is an ETB trigger ("when this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature") and the payoff fires when it exploits, i.e. when a creature is sacrificed. Three triggers on one card, none recorded; only the sacrifice cost was.

kept.name: Manor Gargoyle
kept.why: "This creature has indestructible as long as it has defender" is a static grant to itself and was not read at all; only the flying half of the card was.

kept.name: Cruel Alliance
kept.why: Teamwork's additional cost is tapping any number of creatures you control with total power 2 or more, which is precisely cost:cast-tap-others.

kept.name: Gix's Caress
kept.why: The second half creates a tapped Powerstone token. eff:add-mana was recorded from the token's reminder text but the token creation itself was not, so the card reads as a mana source that makes nothing.

kept.name: Nettlevine Blight
kept.why: The granted ability triggers at the beginning of the end step and re-attaches the aura to another permanent. Only the sacrifice was read; the timing and the movement were not.

kept.name: Doomfall
kept.why: It is a modal "Choose one" spell and nothing recorded the choice.

kept.name: Adventurers' Guildhouse
kept.why: The card's entire function is granting "bands with other legendary creatures", and the grant was never written down - the facet list says only that it cares about legendary creatures.

kept.name: Spare Dagger
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 (unread), the granted ability triggers on attack (unread), and the damage is paid for by sacrificing the Dagger itself (unread). Only eff:attach and the damage survived.

kept.name: HYDRA Infiltration
kept.why: "Whenever a creature you control attacks alone" is an attack trigger and is the entire second half of the card; only the ETB discard was read.

kept.name: Oath of Lim-Dûl
kept.why: "sacrifice a permanent other than this enchantment unless you discard a card" produced neither word. Both halves of the choice are real effects: it sacrifices your permanents, or it makes you discard.

kept.name: Lassoed by the Law
kept.why: The first ETB is an O-ring: "exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield". Only the token half was read, so the card's actual removal clause was invisible.

kept.name: Howltooth Hollow
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. Hideaway looks at the top four of your library and exiles one, and the second ability plays that exiled card without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Disciple of Caelus Nin
kept.why: Nothing but the ETB trigger was recorded. Each player chooses up to five permanents and everything else phases out permanently, which is a symmetric board-wide effect and a choice.

kept.name: Thermal Navigator
kept.why: "Sacrifice an artifact: This creature gains flying" affects only itself. scope:all says the card affects everything and is a word-scan artefact.

kept.name: Time Reaper
kept.why: "put target face-up card they own in exile on the bottom of their library. If you do, you gain 3 life." The lifegain and the exile-to-library move were both dropped.

kept.name: Shrouded Lore
kept.why: The repeat loop is "You may pay {B}. If you do, repeat this process", which is exactly a pay-for-more effect, and the card ends by putting the chosen card into your hand.

kept.name: Sands of Time
kept.why: "Each player skips their untap step" produced no word, and the upkeep effect taps and untaps every artifact, creature and land every player controls.

kept.name: Soul Collector
kept.why: It returns the dead creature "to the battlefield under your control" - it takes opponents' creatures, not only its own back, so it steals as well as reanimates.

kept.name: Mistmoon Griffin
kept.why: "When this creature dies, exile it, then return..." - the self-exile clause was not recorded.

kept.name: Steppe Lynx
kept.why: Landfall pumps only this creature. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Triad of Fates
kept.why: Only the counter and the exile were read. The {B} ability draws two cards, and the {W} ability exiles a creature and returns it to the battlefield, which is a blink.

kept.name: Spiteful Hexmage
kept.why: The card literally reads "create a Cursed Role token attached to target creature you control" and the Role sets the creature to 1/1. Neither the token creation nor the power/toughness setting was recorded.

kept.name: Kitsune Mystic // Autumn-Tail, Kitsune Sage
kept.why: Only the end-step trigger was read. The trigger flips the card to its other face, and the back face's {1} ability moves an Aura from one creature to another.

kept.name: Magus of the Bridge
kept.why: The second ability exiles this creature, and both triggers key on creatures being put into a graveyard from the battlefield.

kept.name: Hypnox
kept.why: Both triggers were recorded and neither effect was. It exiles an opponent's entire hand and later returns those exiled cards.

kept.name: Engineered Plague
kept.why: "All creatures of the chosen type get -1/-1" - the whole point of the card produced no word beyond the choice of type.

kept.name: Sarpadian Empires, Vol. VII
kept.why: The activated ability costs {3} and a tap, and the card opens by choosing one of five colour/type combinations as it enters.

kept.name: Mirror-Sigil Sergeant
kept.why: The copy trigger is conditional on "if you control a blue permanent", which is a genuine colour condition the card is built around, not an incidental mention.

kept.name: Squad Rallier
kept.why: Nothing is exiled: it looks at the top four, puts one in your HAND and bottoms the rest. eff:impulse means exiling off the top to play the cards, which would offer this to impulse-draw decks wrongly.

kept.name: Dissatisfied Customer
kept.why: "roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3 or less, you lose that much life" produced nothing at all - neither the die roll nor the life loss.

kept.name: Gruesome Deformity
kept.why: An Aura with "Enchant creature" attaches to a creature, which is what eff:attach records; only the granted keyword was noted.

kept.name: Biblioplex Tomekeeper
kept.why: "choose up to one —" is a modal ETB and produced no word.

kept.name: Bottled Cloister
kept.why: Only the upkeep trigger was recorded. It exiles your hand each opponent's upkeep, returns those cards on yours, and draws a card. eff:move-zone rather than eff:exile deliberately: it exiles YOUR OWN hand as a protection, so eff:exile would file it as removal.

kept.name: Hankyu
kept.why: The granted abilities put aim counters on Hankyu and then remove all of them as a cost to deal that much damage. Only the damage half was read.

kept.name: Celestial Purge
kept.why: "Exile target black or red permanent" is a hoser. Answering a colour is not caring about it, and this tells the engine a mono-white exile spell belongs in a red deck. (It also names black, so the word scan was inconsistent as well as wrong.)

kept.name: Pollen Remedy
kept.why: Kicker—Sacrifice a land is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, which is cost:cast-sacrifice. cost:sacrifice means an on-demand sacrifice outlet; this card cannot eat a permanent repeatedly and is not an outlet, so it is misfiled.

kept.name: Blazing Torch
kept.why: The granted ability is "{T}, Sacrifice Blazing Torch: deals 2 damage". Sacrificing itself as a cost was never recorded.

kept.name: Cowed by Wisdom
kept.why: The printed line is "can't attack or block unless its controller pays {1} for each card in your hand". Only the tax (eff:unless-pays) was recorded; the restriction itself, which is what the card is for, was not.

kept.name: Cleansing
kept.why: "unless any player pays 1 life" is a straight unless-pays clause and was missing. It destroys EVERY land including your own, which is a symmetric mass destroy with no opponent restriction, so scope:wipe applies the same way Cleanfall (destroy all enchantments) already carries it.

kept.name: Betrayal of Flesh
kept.why: Entwine—Sacrifice three lands is an additional cost to cast and produced no cost word at all.

kept.name: Leering Onlooker
kept.why: Its only ability is activated FROM the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"). cost:exile-self was recorded but nothing said the card operates from the graveyard, which is the whole reason a graveyard deck wants it.

kept.name: Soul Separator
kept.why: "Create a token that's a copy of that card" is a copy effect and was missing. Nothing on this card returns anything: it EXILES the creature card from the graveyard and makes two tokens, so eff:return-from is wrong and would offer it as recursion.

kept.name: Witch's Vengeance
kept.why: "Creatures of the creature type of YOUR CHOICE" - the player chooses a creature type on resolution, the same shape as Ward of Lights choosing a colour.

kept.name: Helvault
kept.why: The third ability returns ALL cards exiled with it to the battlefield when it dies, and neither the return nor the fact that it parks cards in exile and cares about them later was recorded.

kept.name: Vile Requiem
kept.why: The removal ability costs "{1}{B}, Sacrifice this enchantment" and no sacrifice cost was recorded at all.

kept.name: God-Favored General
kept.why: "you may pay {2}{W}. If you do, create two ... tokens" is exactly the pay-for-more shape and was missing.

kept.name: Kitsune Healer
kept.why: The list carried NO effect and NO cost. Both abilities prevent damage and both are {T} abilities.

kept.name: Unburied Earthcarver
kept.why: The card sacrifices one other creature and puts a counter on itself. Nothing here affects everything; scope:all appears to have come from the words "another creature" and would read as a mass effect.

kept.name: Ward of Lights
kept.why: "Enchanted creature has protection from the chosen color" is the entire point of the Aura and no grant was recorded - only the fact that you choose something.

kept.name: Luke Cage, Power Man
kept.why: "he gets +2/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn" produced neither the pump nor the grant. The kw:indestructible present is the printed keyword list, not the granted effect.

kept.name: Gravestone Strider
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. The second ability is graveyard hate ("Exile target card from a graveyard"), paid for by exiling itself from your graveyard, so it both operates from and attacks graveyards.

kept.name: Volrath the Fallen
kept.why: The ability costs "Discard a creature card" and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Moment of Glory
kept.why: Cast from a graveyard it also puts a +1/+1 counter on EACH OTHER creature you control, a mass effect the list does not mention.

kept.name: Liliana's Scorn
kept.why: Half the card is "search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Liliana, Death Mage ... put it into your hand" and only the destroy clause was read.

kept.name: Spontaneous Flight
kept.why: "Put a flying counter on it" grants flying permanently. The counter itself was recorded but not what it does.

kept.name: Gnarlbark Elm
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unread. 'Target creature gets -2/-2' is eff:shrink, and 'Remove two counters from this creature' is a real activation cost. It also enters with counters on ITSELF, which is eff:add-counters-self rather than only the generic.

kept.name: Orzhov Guildmage
kept.why: 'Each player loses 1 life' is a symmetric effect hitting everybody, which is what scope:all records. eff:lose-life alone says nothing about it being global.

kept.name: Scour the Desert
kept.why: Half the card was missing. It creates X 1/1 Bird tokens and the list carried cares:sub:bird with no token verb at all, so nothing could ever choose this for a tokens deck. I deliberately did NOT add eff:exile-graveyard: it exiles from YOUR OWN graveyard to pay for the birds, and marking it as graveyard hate would make it read as working against the deck it belongs in.

kept.name: Animate Wall
kept.why: grants:defender is exactly backwards and is a word scan off the reminder text: the Aura lets the enchanted Wall attack AS THOUGH IT DIDN'T have defender. It grants nothing of the kind. It is an Aura, so it does attach to a creature.

kept.name: Abundant Maw
kept.why: Emerge is an alternative cast cost that sacrifices a creature. That is precisely cost:cast-sacrifice and it was unread, so a sacrifice deck cannot see that this card eats a creature to be cast.

kept.name: Cement Shoes
kept.why: The granted quoted ability was never read. 'At the beginning of your end step, tap this creature' taps a creature you control on an end step trigger. eff:tap-own rather than eff:tap because the equipped creature is always yours (equip targets a creature you control).

kept.name: Earsplitting Rats
kept.why: The regenerate ability's cost was unread: 'Discard a card' is a real activation cost. And the enters trigger hits EACH player, which is scope:all. I left eff:discard-self off because the card is aimed outward, not at filling your own graveyard.

kept.name: Cold Storage
kept.why: The second ability was almost entirely unread: sacrificing the artifact is an activation cost, and returning every creature card exiled with it to the battlefield is eff:return-from. It tracks cards in exile, hence cares:zone:exile. eff:exile is wrong and dangerous here: it only ever exiles a creature YOU control, so it is a blink engine, not removal, which eff:exile-own already says correctly.

kept.name: Consul's Lieutenant
kept.why: Renown puts the +1/+1 counter on ITSELF. Only the generic eff:add-counters was present, which reads as putting counters on other things; the self word is what a counters-on-the-commander plan actually looks for.

kept.name: Conceited Witch // Price of Beauty
kept.why: The Adventure creates a Wicked Role token and attaches it to a creature you control. Neither the token verb nor the attach was recorded, so a token deck and an aura/voltron deck are both blind to the only thing the Adventure half does.

kept.name: Spike Cannibal
kept.why: It moves counters from ALL creatures, not from a target. Without scope:all nothing records that this is a one-sided board-wide counter strip rather than a single-target effect.

kept.name: Shriveling Rot
kept.why: Only the second mode was half read. Mode one turns any damage into destruction ('whenever a creature is dealt damage, destroy it'), which is eff:destroy on a trig:dealt-damage trigger, and both modes apply to every creature on the board rather than to a target. It is also a modal spell, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Hair-Strung Koto
kept.why: Nothing on this card is global. The cost taps ONE untapped creature you control and the effect makes a single target player mill one card. scope:all makes it look like a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Blue
kept.why: The card had NO effect word at all, only its cost and type. Its entire function is preventing damage from a blue source, so it was invisible to anything looking for damage prevention. The colour hoser dimension is real, matching how protection-from-a-colour is recorded elsewhere.

kept.name: Wall of Resurgence
kept.why: Only the counters clause was read. The land BECOMES a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that is still a land, which is animation, a set power and toughness, and a granted keyword. That is the whole reason to play the card and none of it was written down.

kept.name: Testament Bearer
kept.why: Both removed words are false: nothing is exiled and nothing is played from exile. It looks at three and puts one in your HAND, which is a dig, not impulse draw. Leaving eff:impulse on it would let an impulse-draw commander pick it as a payoff for something it does not do. eff:draw added because a card genuinely reaches your hand.

kept.name: Rot Farm Mortipede
kept.why: The entire trigger payoff was unread. It gets +1/+0 and gains menace and lifelink, and the list carried only the bare printed keyword words with no verb, so nothing recorded that this card pumps or grants evasion when your graveyard empties.

kept.name: Hunted Nightmare
kept.why: The ETB puts a deathtouch counter on a creature and no effect word was recorded at all - the list stopped at the trigger. eff:add-counters is the effect. I did NOT add grants:deathtouch: the counter goes on a creature the OPPONENT controls, so reading this as a deathtouch granter would be backwards.

kept.name: Preacher
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unread. {T} is the cost, and gaining control of an opponent's creature for as long as this stays tapped is theft - eff:gain-control. Without it a repeatable Control Magic reads as a vanilla 2/2.

kept.name: Burden of Guilt
kept.why: It taps the ENCHANTED creature, and this aura goes on an opponent's blocker - that is the whole point of the card. The controller of an enchanted creature is unknown from the text, so the plain eff:tap is correct and the -own claim is an overreach that files a tapper as a card that taps your own board.

kept.name: Solarion
kept.why: Both halves of the activated ability were missing their words: {T} is the cost, and 'double the number of +1/+1 counters' is a doubling effect, not merely adding some. eff:add-counters-self is already there and is true but understates a card whose counters go 1, 2, 4, 8.

kept.name: Radioactive Man
kept.why: The trigger was recorded and its effect was not. Halving a player's life total on combat damage is life loss, and it is the only thing this card does beyond deathtouch.

kept.name: Orphans of the Wheat
kept.why: The tapping half was read (eff:tap-own) and the payoff half was dropped - it gets +1/+1 for each creature tapped, which is what the tapping is FOR.

kept.name: Remorseless Punishment
kept.why: A punisher offers three outcomes and only the life loss was written down. The opponent may instead discard two cards or sacrifice a creature or planeswalker, so this card genuinely causes discard and edict-style sacrifice. I left eff:unless-pays off because the alternative is not paying mana.

kept.name: Acrobatic Cheerleader
kept.why: The trigger's timing was read and its effect was not - it puts a flying counter on itself. I did NOT add grants:flying: it gives flying only to itself via a counter, and that word carries an anthem/evasion-granter meaning this card does not earn.

kept.name: Dawnbringer Charioteers
kept.why: It has printed lifelink and no life-gain effect recorded, while the other lifelink creature in this batch (Black Panther) carries eff:gain-life - the same keyword should read the same way on both.

kept.name: Ambuscade Shaman
kept.why: The +2/+2 was missing entirely, so a creature whose only ability is a repeating anthem-on-arrival had no effect word. The trigger also reads 'this creature OR another creature you control enters', so it fires on its own arrival too and wants the -self word alongside the -other one already present.

kept.name: Dashing Bloodsucker
kept.why: Eerie triggers on an enchantment YOU control entering, which is trig:enters-other rather than the bare trigger. Its effect - +2/+0 and lifelink until end of turn - had no words at all; eff:gain-life was present without anything explaining where the life comes from.

kept.name: Sedraxis Alchemist
kept.why: The ETB is conditional on controlling a blue permanent, which is a real deck-building constraint the list did not record. This is a cares: word that is not a type or subtype, so it is in scope.

kept.name: Infected Vermin
kept.why: Both abilities deal damage to EACH creature and EACH player - this is a Pestilence, and the list read it as though it pinged one thing. I left eff:damage-self off because the damage is symmetric rather than aimed at you.

kept.name: Auntie's Snitch
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' had no word. More importantly eff:return-from is too weak for what the last ability does: it returns THIS CARD from your graveyard to your hand, which is the recursion word, and it is the whole reason the card is played.

kept.name: Healing Salve
kept.why: A modal card with two modes and only the first was recorded. The second prevents the next 3 damage to any target. I left eff:choose off because its gloss reads as choosing what an opponent does rather than picking a mode.

kept.name: Empty the Catacombs
kept.why: 'Each player returns ALL creature cards from their graveyard' is a mass symmetric recursion, and without the scope word it reads like a single-target raise dead.

kept.name: Defang
kept.why: Preventing all damage the enchanted creature would deal is exactly turning a permanent into something harmless without destroying it - the Pacifism shape. eff:prevent-damage alone files it as a damage-prevention trick rather than as removal, which is what it actually is.

kept.name: Salvage Titan
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread. Sacrificing three artifacts INSTEAD of paying the mana cost is an additional/alternative cast cost, and the graveyard ability returns THIS CARD, which is recursion rather than the generic eff:return-from already listed.

kept.name: Mirror Universe
kept.why: cost:sacrifice-self was recorded and the {T} half of the same activation cost was not.

kept.name: Nirkana Cutthroat
kept.why: Level up is 'put a level counter on this' and no effect word was recorded - both level-up cards in this batch have the counter type and nothing that says the card puts it there itself.

kept.name: Hedron-Field Purists
kept.why: Same gap as Nirkana Cutthroat: level up puts a level counter on this creature and only the counter type was recorded.

kept.name: Fevered Convulsions
kept.why: A repeatable -1/-1 counter maker is how this deck kills creatures, and eff:add-counters alone does not say the creature gets smaller - it reads identically to a +1/+1 counter engine.

kept.name: Dreadbringer Lampads
kept.why: Constellation reads 'whenever THIS CREATURE or another enchantment you control enters', so it fires on its own arrival as well; only the -other half was recorded.

kept.name: Allied Assault
kept.why: The card had no effect word whatsoever - the only thing it does is give up to two creatures +X/+X.

kept.name: Gollum the Abandoned
kept.why: Three clauses unread. Exiling a card from an OPPONENT'S graveyard is graveyard hate and needs the separate word rather than being invisible; the sacrifice ability returns Gollum himself from the graveyard, which is recursion; and 'Gollum can't block' had nothing at all.

kept.name: Oketra's Attendant
kept.why: Embalm's cost is exiling this card from your graveyard, and only the token and copy effects were recorded. cost:discard-self covers cycling but nothing covered the embalm cost.

kept.name: Nightmare Incursion
kept.why: It searches a library and exiles the cards it finds, and neither act was written down. Only the library zone was recorded, so the card looked like it merely mentioned a library.

kept.name: Coffin Purge
kept.why: Its whole purpose is exiling a card out of a graveyard, and it can be cast from its own graveyard via flashback. eff:exile-graveyard was there without the graveyard care that every other piece of graveyard hate carries.

kept.name: Elephant Graveyard
kept.why: Regenerating a creature keeps it alive, which is what eff:protect records. Medicine Bag in this same batch carries eff:protect for the identical regenerate clause; this land does not.

kept.name: Ramosian Sergeant
kept.why: It fetches ONE Rebel permanent card from your library. Nothing about it affects everything on the board; the word looks to have come from the filter over library cards rather than from the effect's reach.

kept.name: Forsaken City
kept.why: Its untap ability is paid for by exiling a card from your hand, and no facet recorded that the hand is involved.

kept.name: Fretwork Colony
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is the card's first line and had no word at all. That is exactly what eff:cant-block-self says.

kept.name: Diversionary Tactics
kept.why: The effect is "Tap target creature" - one creature. Tapping two of your own creatures is the cost, already recorded as cost:tap-others, so nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Unified Strike
kept.why: It only works if the attacker's POWER is less than or equal to the number of Soldiers. Counting a creature's power is what cares:power is for and it was missing.

kept.name: Island of Wak-Wak
