kept.why: Three separate gaps in a one-line card: the ability costs {T}, "has base power 0" is setting power and toughness rather than only neutralising, and it can only ever target a creature WITH FLYING, which makes it a flyer answer.

kept.name: Eye of Doom
kept.why: The enter trigger puts doom counters on permanents and nothing recorded that counters are placed. The activated ability costs {T} and sacrificing itself, neither written down, and "destroy each permanent with a doom counter" hits every player's board, not one target.

kept.name: Entrails Feaster
kept.why: It eats a creature card out of a graveyard every upkeep - that is graveyard hate and graveyard caring, and neither was recorded, so only the counter half of the card was read. If you decline, it taps itself, which is eff:tap-own.

kept.name: Medicine Bag
kept.why: The ability's cost is {1}, {T} and discarding a card. Neither the tap nor the discard was recorded as a cost, so the card read as though regeneration were free.

kept.name: Festering March
kept.why: After the -1/-1 it exiles itself with three time counters. The self-exile clause had no word.

kept.name: Boarded Window
kept.why: "Creatures attacking you get -1/-0" is the card's actual effect and nothing recorded it - only the self-exile clause was read. It applies to every creature attacking you, hence scope:all.

kept.name: Equipoise
kept.why: Each upkeep it phases out lands, then artifacts, then creatures, across a whole player's board. Only the trigger timing and the type mentions had been recorded, so the effect itself was unwritten. scope:all covers the breadth; the phasing itself needs a new word.

kept.name: Deftblade Elite
kept.why: Its activated ability prevents all combat damage to and from it, which is half the card and had no word. Only provoke had been read.

kept.name: Ravenous Necrotitan
kept.why: The enter trigger makes you sacrifice a creature unless the corrupted condition is met, and nothing recorded that a sacrifice happens at all.

kept.name: Dreaded Bat-Cloud
kept.why: "This spell costs {3} less to cast if a creature died this turn" is a cost reduction and carried no facet, so the card read as a plain flier with deathtouch.

kept.name: Crumbling Sanctuary
kept.why: Its one line does two things and neither was recorded: damage to a player is replaced, so no damage is dealt, and cards are exiled off the top of that player's library instead.

kept.name: Self-Assembler
kept.why: It searches for a single Assembly-Worker card and puts it in your hand. It touches nothing on the battlefield, so "affects everything" is wrong; the word appears to come from scanning the library filter.

kept.name: Urborg Justice
kept.why: The number of creatures sacrificed is counted from creatures put into YOUR graveyard from the battlefield this turn. It is a graveyard-count payoff and nothing said so.

kept.name: Canal Dredger
kept.why: The ability is "{T}: Put target card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library" and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Needlebite Trap
kept.why: Its alternative cost is unlocked only if an opponent gained life this turn. That is a lifegain-matters condition and it was entirely unrecorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Splicer
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and opens by choosing one of four keywords, and neither was written down. Double strike appears nowhere on the card - it names flying, first strike, trample and shadow - so cares:kw:double strike looks like first strike being expanded and is simply false.

kept.name: Skeletal Wurm
kept.why: "{B}: Regenerate this creature" is its only ability and no judgement word recorded what regeneration does. It keeps a creature alive, which is eff:protect, applied consistently with Medicine Bag.

kept.name: Junkyo Bell
kept.why: Nothing at all had been recorded for what this card does. Each upkeep it gives a creature +X/+X where X is your creature count, and then sacrifices that creature at the next end step. Both the pump and the sacrifice were missing.

kept.name: Mind Carver
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +1/+0, or +3/+1, and no pump was recorded - only the attach. The bonus is conditional on an opponent having eight or more cards in their graveyard, which makes it a graveyard-count card.

kept.name: Aven Shrine
kept.why: The entire effect of the card is "that player gains X life" and eff:gain-life is absent. The list records the trigger (trig:cast) and what it counts (cares:zone:graveyard) but not the thing that happens.

kept.name: Corrupted Zendikon
kept.why: "Enchanted land is a 3/3 black Ooze creature. It's still a land." This is a land animation and nothing in the list says so. The dies trigger and the return are already recorded; the animation, which is the whole point of the card, was not.

kept.name: Torture Chamber
kept.why: The activated ability is "{1}, {T}, Remove all pain counters from this artifact:" and neither the tap nor the counter removal is recorded. cost:remove-counters is exact: removing the counters is the cost and the damage scales off how many were removed.

kept.name: Project Deathlok Soldier
kept.why: "{2}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is an activated self-return, which is precisely eff:recur-self. eff:return-from is present but is generic and does not say the card brings ITSELF back, which is what makes it repeatable sacrifice fodder.

kept.name: Nightmare Void
kept.why: Dredge 2 returns this card from the graveyard to hand every time you would draw. eff:mill and eff:return-from are recorded but nothing says the card recurs itself, which is the reason the card is played at all.

kept.name: Touch of Moonglove
kept.why: "Whenever a creature dealt damage by that creature dies this turn, its controller loses 2 life" is a dies trigger. eff:lose-life is recorded with no trigger to hang it on.

kept.name: Wall of Resistance
kept.why: "put a +0/+1 counter on it" — the end-step trigger is recorded but the effect it produces is not. The card's only function is growing itself.

kept.name: Thrull Retainer
kept.why: "Sacrifice this Aura: Regenerate enchanted creature." The sacrifice-of-itself cost is unrecorded, and regenerating a creature keeps it alive, which is what eff:protect describes. The list currently says only that it pumps.

kept.name: Carrion Rats
kept.why: "any player may exile a card from their graveyard" is graveyard exile, and the list records only the two triggers with no effect at all. It is a graveyard-interaction card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Soul of Theros
kept.why: The second ability is activated from the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"). cost:exile-self is recorded but nothing says the graveyard is where the card operates from, which is half of why it is played.

kept.name: Steel Exemplar
kept.why: "unless two or more colors of mana were spent to cast it" is exactly what cares:mana-spent names. The counters are recorded, the condition gating them is not.

kept.name: Soulcage Fiend
kept.why: "each player loses 3 life" is symmetric and hits you too. Consistent with how scope:all is used elsewhere in this batch for each/any-player and any-creature selectors (Moonlit Wake, Aven Shrine).

kept.name: Guardian of the Great Door
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap four untapped artifacts, creatures, and/or lands you control" is a CAST cost, not an activated-ability cost. The vocabulary draws that distinction throughout (cost:cast-sacrifice vs cost:sacrifice, cost:cast-life vs cost:life), and Sun-Dappled Celebrant's convoke in this same batch correctly carries cost:cast-tap-others.

kept.name: Eye for an Eye
kept.why: It deals damage to the source's controller and nothing recorded that it deals damage at all.

kept.name: Cessation
kept.why: Enchanted creature can't attack. The only clause with an actual effect on the board was unrecorded; only the self-return was captured.

kept.name: Tangle Golem
kept.why: Affinity for Forests is a cost reduction on this spell and is the card's entire text.

kept.name: Shell of the Last Kappa
kept.why: Nothing at all was recorded about what it DOES. It taps and sacrifices itself as costs, exiles a spell off the stack (which is a counter in function, the reminder text says the spell has no effect), holds the cards in exile, and later casts one without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Angelheart Protector
kept.why: Granting indestructible until end of turn to a creature you control is keeping your creature alive; only the keyword grant was recorded.

kept.name: Spark Rupture
kept.why: The whole second paragraph was unread. Every planeswalker with loyalty loses all abilities (harmless without being destroyed), becomes a creature, and has its power and toughness set. It affects all planeswalkers, not one.

kept.name: Screaming Phantom
kept.why: Milling moves a card from your library to your graveyard; both zones were unrecorded, and self-mill is what makes this card a graveyard enabler.

kept.name: Hooded Assassin
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal card and the choice itself was unrecorded.

kept.name: Wolfbat
kept.why: "You may pay {B}. If you do, return this card..." is an optional payment for a bigger effect.

kept.name: Luminous Wake
kept.why: The trigger is "attacks or blocks" and only the blocking half was recorded.

kept.name: Kjeldoran Dead
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature" is one creature you control, not a mass effect. scope:all here would read as a board-affecting sacrifice.

kept.name: Charmed Pendant
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and the tap cost was unrecorded.

kept.name: Skywhaler's Shot
kept.why: It only answers a creature with power 3 or greater, so it genuinely keys on power.

kept.name: Tidehollow Sculler
kept.why: Both triggers were empty of effects: it exiles a card from an opponent's hand, holds it in exile, and returns it when it leaves. Only the triggers and the hand zone were recorded.

kept.name: Serenity
kept.why: It destroys ALL artifacts and enchantments symmetrically, including your own, on every one of your upkeeps. That is a wipe and an artifact or enchantment deck must not be handed it.

kept.name: Brainwash
kept.why: Enchanted creature can't attack unless {3} is paid. The tax was recorded but not what the tax stops.

kept.name: HYDRA Troopers
kept.why: Milling two cards moves them off the top of your library; the graveyard side was recorded and the library side was not.

kept.name: Spiteful Returned
kept.why: "Whenever this creature or enchanted creature attacks" - the drain and the trigger that fires it were half-recorded; the attack trigger was missing.

kept.name: Riptide Replicator
kept.why: The token ability costs {T}, and as it enters you choose a colour and a creature type, the same shape already recorded as eff:choose on Cursed Rack.

kept.name: Extirpate
kept.why: It targets a card in a graveyard and searches a graveyard, hand and library, yet the graveyard zone and the search were both unrecorded. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: eff:exile-graveyard is kept apart so graveyard hate is not filed as creature removal.

kept.name: Borough Backup
kept.why: Basic landcycling discards this card as the cost, which is the -self form (this card), not a generic discard cost.

kept.name: Kheru Bloodsucker
kept.why: Its main trigger is a creature you control dying and no dies trigger was recorded at all, and the "you gain 2 life" half of the drain was missing. This is an aristocrats commander payoff that read as neither.

kept.name: Void Maw
kept.why: Dying creatures are exiled under it and the pump cost moves a card from exile to a graveyard; neither zone was recorded, and the replacement applies to every other creature.

kept.name: Phantasmagorian
kept.why: "When you cast this spell" had no cast trigger recorded, and discarding three cards to return it from the graveyard is bringing itself back, which is the whole reason anyone plays it. Not adding eff:counter: it counters only ITSELF and would misfile as interaction.

kept.name: Worthy Cause
kept.why: Sacrificing a creature here is an additional cost to CAST the spell, which is the cost:cast-sacrifice case, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Esgaroth Garrison
kept.why: Recruit is spelled out in reminder text as draw a card, then discard a card, then create a 1/1 token if the discard was nonland. All three effects were unrecorded; only the keyword and the P/T setting were.

kept.name: Nick Fury, Spymaster
kept.why: It puts a creature card from your hand straight onto the battlefield, which has its own word, and the hand zone was unrecorded.

kept.name: Pharika's Spawn
kept.why: "When it enters this way, each opponent sacrifices a creature" - the edict had no entry trigger recorded at all, and it hits each opponent rather than one.

kept.name: Triumphant Surge
kept.why: "Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater" checks power, which is exactly cares:power.

kept.name: Mental Vapors
kept.why: Cipher was left unread. It exiles the card encoded on a creature (cares:zone:exile), triggers whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player (trig:deals-damage), and casts a copy without paying its mana cost (eff:cast-free).

kept.name: Molting Snakeskin
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +2/+0 and nothing recorded the pump; only the granted regenerate was read.

kept.name: Gang Up
kept.why: "Destroy target creature with power X or less" is a power check.

kept.name: Belfry Spirit
kept.why: "When this creature enters" is its own ETB (trig:enters was present without trig:enters-self), and haunt exiles this card itself when it dies.

kept.name: Ramosian Lieutenant
kept.why: The search does not put the card in hand, it puts it onto the battlefield, which nothing recorded. Nothing on this card affects everything, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Mogis's Favor
kept.why: Escape costs {2}{B} plus exiling two other cards from your graveyard; the exile cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Shadows' Verdict
kept.why: It removes every creature and planeswalker of mana value 3 or less from the battlefield, yours included. That is a board wipe, exiling rather than destroying.

kept.name: Dauthi Mindripper
kept.why: Shadow is evasion: it can be blocked only by shadow creatures. Only the half stopping it from blocking was recorded, the same way swampwalk is read as eff:cant-be-blocked on Zodiac Rat.

kept.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier
kept.why: Crew 6 taps any number of your creatures as a cost, which is precisely cost:tap-others.

kept.name: Lightkeeper of Emeria
kept.why: Multikicker: the life gain scales with how many extra times you paid, which is the "gives more if you pay" word.

kept.name: Cutthroat Centurion
kept.why: It sacrifices one other permanent and pumps only itself. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Silumgar Scavenger
kept.why: Exploit was left as a bare keyword: it is an enters trigger that sacrifices a creature. The card also gives itself haste. It only watches your own creatures dying, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
kept.why: Three clauses were unread: cards go from library to your hand (card advantage), each one only unless an opponent pays 3 life (the tax), and the rest are exiled.

kept.name: Guardians of Koilos
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever. Its whole ability returns another historic permanent you control to its owner's hand, which is a self-bounce and can rebuy an ETB.

kept.name: Ichorid
kept.why: Its recursion is paid for by exiling a black creature card from your graveyard; the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Vizkopa Confessor
kept.why: Extort was left as a bare keyword although it is a trigger on every spell you cast. The ETB also pays life as a cost and exiles the chosen card from the opponent's hand rather than only discarding it.

kept.name: Honorbound Page // Forum's Favor
kept.why: The back half gives target creature +1/+0; only the granted flying was recorded.

kept.name: Abuna's Chant
kept.why: The second mode prevents the next 5 damage to target creature, and entwine means both modes can happen. Only the life gain was read.

kept.name: Cry of the Carnarium
kept.why: It exiles all creature cards put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn, which is graveyard hate and is kept apart from plain eff:exile.

kept.name: Ensouled Scimitar
kept.why: {3} turns the Equipment itself into a 1/5 Spirit artifact creature with flying. Nothing recorded that it animates.

kept.name: Villainous Syndication
kept.why: It mills one card at a time and reanimates a single creature. Nothing on it affects everything.

kept.name: Sorcerer's Broom
kept.why: "you may pay {3}. If you do, create a token" is exactly the optional-payment shape; nothing recorded that the copy costs mana.

kept.name: Kuon, Ogre Ascendant // Kuon's Essence
kept.why: Only the front face's end-step trigger was read. The back face triggers at EACH player's upkeep (trig:step:upkeep) and the edict hits every player (scope:all). The front face flips itself into its other face (eff:transform).

kept.name: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T}, and connive is draw a card then discard a card. Only the counter half was recorded, so the draw and the discard were invisible.

kept.name: Divine Presence
kept.why: It replaces damage from ANY source to ANY permanent or player. A global replacement effect, not a targeted one.

kept.name: Thornmantle Striker
kept.why: "choose one —" was unrecorded; the card is modal and the engine could not tell it apart from a card that does both.

kept.name: Apostle of Purifying Light
kept.why: The ability targets a card in a graveyard. eff:exile-graveyard was there but nothing said the card looks at graveyards.

kept.name: Expedition Skulker
kept.why: It gives deathtouch to ITSELF, conditionally. kw:deathtouch already records that. grants:deathtouch reads as "hands deathtouch to your creatures", which is the documented self-grant false positive (the Paradise Druid / Shimmer Dragon shape).

kept.name: Ichor Shade
kept.why: Its condition is an artifact or creature being put into a GRAVEYARD from the battlefield; nothing recorded the zone it watches.

kept.name: Maggot Carrier
kept.why: "each player loses 1 life" is symmetric and hits you too; the list read as a one-sided drain.

kept.name: Metallurgeon
kept.why: The ability costs {W} and {T}; the tap cost was missing.

kept.name: Paladin en-Vec
kept.why: Word scan. Protection from red is a defensive keyword already carried by kw:protection; it does not make this a red-matters card. The list is also self-inconsistent, carrying red but not black from the same clause.

kept.name: Dominator Drone
kept.why: "each opponent loses 2 life" is scope:all. Ingest is a combat-damage trigger that exiles the top card of a library, and neither the trigger nor the zone was recorded. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: that word confers the removal role and this answers no permanent.

kept.name: Urza's Tome
kept.why: "Then discard a card unless you exile a historic card from your graveyard" - the discard and the graveyard were both unread. Not adding eff:exile-graveyard: it exiles your OWN card as a cost, so marking it as graveyard hate would make it read as anti-synergy with the deck it belongs in.

kept.name: Spiteful Shadows
kept.why: "Whenever enchanted creature is dealt damage" is a damage-taken trigger; only the resulting damage was recorded.

kept.name: Reluctant Dounguard
kept.why: The whole trigger was missing - it fires when ANOTHER creature you control enters, and it REMOVES a counter. eff:add-counters says it puts counters on other things; the only counters it places are the two it enters with, on itself.

kept.name: Encumbered Reejerey
kept.why: Same shape: the becomes-tapped trigger and the counter removal were both unread, and the counters it places are on itself only.

kept.name: Sky Tether
kept.why: Granting defender stops the creature attacking. This is a pseudo-removal aura and nothing in the list said it stopped anything.

kept.name: Shadow Slice
kept.why: Cipher was only half read: it exiles this spell card encoded on a creature, and whenever that creature deals combat damage its controller casts a copy without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Kami of the Waning Moon
kept.why: It grants fear to a SINGLE target creature. scope:all reads as an anthem-shaped global effect, which is the false-positive shape that puts a card in the wrong role.

kept.name: Edifice of Authority
kept.why: Both abilities were completely unread - the list only recorded the brick counter. The second one stops a creature attacking, blocking, and activating abilities until your next turn.

kept.name: Stoneforge Acolyte
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top: it looks at four, takes an Equipment to HAND, bottoms the rest. eff:impulse would file it as impulse draw and cares:zone:exile is a phantom. scope:all is noise on a look-at-four.

kept.name: Ancestral Vengeance
kept.why: The enchanted creature gets -1/-1, which is a shrink and is how this aura kills things. eff:pump is the opposite claim - the only thing it grows is done by the +1/+1 counter, already recorded as eff:add-counters.

kept.name: Thought Distortion
kept.why: "This spell can't be countered" was unread, as was the graveyard half of the exile, and "all noncreature, nonland cards" is an all-selector. Not adding eff:exile: it exiles cards from a hand and a graveyard, and that word would let it fill a creature-removal slot it cannot serve.

kept.name: Weirding Shaman
kept.why: It creates two tokens. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Ninja of the Hand
kept.why: "Each opponent discards a card" is symmetric across opponents, not a single-target discard.

kept.name: Guul Draz Vampire
kept.why: The list had NO effect word at all. The card gives itself +2/+1 (and intimidate, which the printed keyword layer carries).

kept.name: Blood-Cursed Knight
kept.why: It gives lifelink to ITSELF when you control an enchantment. kw:lifelink already records that; grants:lifelink reads as handing lifelink to your team. Same self-grant fault as Expedition Skulker.

kept.name: Sins of the Past
kept.why: The entire point of the card - casting an instant or sorcery FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD WITHOUT PAYING ITS MANA COST - produced no verb; only the self-exile clean-up was read.

kept.name: Scion of Vitu-Ghazi
kept.why: Populate is spelled out in the card's own reminder text: "Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control." The list records the token creation and not the copying.

kept.name: Abandon Hope
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard X cards" is a cast-time discard cost. eff:discard-self records that you discard but not that it is an additional cost of casting, which is the distinction cost:cast-discard exists to draw.

kept.name: Riftmarked Knight
kept.why: Flanking's effect is in the text: "the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn". The engine already read the two triggers off that same sentence (trig:blocks, trig:becomes-blocked) and dropped the effect.

kept.name: Aven Riftwatcher
kept.why: "When this creature enters or leaves the battlefield, you gain 2 life" is a genuine two-event trigger on itself, and not one of the four trigger words is recorded. Only the gain-life half was read.

kept.name: Briarblade Adept
kept.why: The whole encore ability was dropped: it is activated from the graveyard by exiling this card (cost:exile-self, cares:zone:graveyard) and creates token copies of itself that gain haste. Only the attack trigger was read.

kept.name: Graf Reaver
kept.why: Exploit's reminder text is on the card: "When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature." That is an enters trigger on itself that sacrifices one of your own creatures, and none of the three words is present - a real sacrifice payoff piece reading as none.

kept.name: Conductor of Cacophony
kept.why: Removing a +1/+1 counter is the activation cost, and "1 damage to each other creature and each player" is a symmetric board effect, so scope:all. The generic eff:add-counters is wrong: the only counters this card ever places are the two it enters with, on itself, which eff:add-counters-self already says. Left generic it reads as a counters-matters card.

kept.name: Ghostly Possession
kept.why: Preventing all combat damage dealt to and by the enchanted creature turns a permanent into something harmless without destroying it, which is exactly what this word is for. The list records the prevention and never says the aura is answering a creature.

kept.name: Kitsune Dawnblade
kept.why: Bushido 1 is printed with its reminder text: "Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn." Two triggers and a pump, none recorded, though the card is marked as fully read.

kept.name: Memory Leak
kept.why: The entire main effect is missing. The card exiles a nonland card from an opponent's graveyard or hand, and the list carries only the cycling half (draw, discard cost). Nothing says it exiles anything.

kept.name: Leonin Lightbringer
kept.why: "As long as this creature is equipped, it gets +1/+1" is a real pump and is the only non-keyword line on the card. Nothing in the list reflects it. (Ward's tax is left alone - the ward keyword is already recorded and treating every warded creature as a taxing card would be a different claim.)

kept.name: Maddening Imp
kept.why: The ability's cost is {T} and cost:tap is absent. The delayed "At the beginning of the next end step, destroy each of those creatures that didn't attack" is a real end-step trigger, written in the card's own text rather than reminder text.

kept.name: Drogskol Infantry // Drogskol Armaments
kept.why: The back face is an aura giving +2/+2 and nothing in the list says the card pumps anything. "If Drogskol Armaments would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead" is a self-exile replacement.

kept.name: Caravan Escort
kept.why: Level up puts a level counter on itself and the creature grows as a result, which is precisely what this word describes. The list carries ctr:level and never says the card does anything with it.

kept.name: Thorntooth Witch
kept.why: +3/-3 is a toughness reduction that kills a creature - this is a removal card and only the pump half was read. scope:all is wrong: the effect is on a single target creature, and comparable single-target pumps in this batch (Revelation of Power, Veteran's Reflexes) correctly carry no scope word. It appears to have come from the breadth of "a Treefolk spell", not from the effect.

kept.name: Kingpin's Enforcers
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. It is lifelink plus a sacrifice outlet that draws one card. The word looks scanned off the breadth of "an artifact or creature" in the cost, and it makes a two-mana sac outlet read as a global effect.

kept.name: Revelation of Power
kept.why: "It also gains flying and lifelink until end of turn" - two granted keywords, neither recorded. Only the +2/+2 was read.

kept.name: Idol of Endurance
kept.why: The activated ability taps, casts a creature spell "without paying its mana cost", and does it from among cards exiled with this artifact. Free-casting is the reason the card is played and none of it is written down. (Deliberately not adding eff:exile: the exiling is of your own graveyard as a resource, and that word feeds removal.)

kept.name: Pulsar Squadron Ace
kept.why: "Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Spacecraft card from among them and put it into your hand" is exactly looking at cards and taking one, off the top of the library. The list records only the consolation counter.

kept.name: Guard Duty
kept.why: A creature with defender can't attack - that is the rule, and stopping the creature attacking is the entire function of this aura. grants:defender records the keyword and says nothing about what the aura does, so the card cannot be seen as the pseudo-removal it is.

kept.name: Spoils of the Vault
kept.why: Every card revealed and not named is exiled, and nothing in the list says the card exiles. The self-inflicted life loss has no word at all, hence the proposal.

kept.name: Makeshift Battalion
kept.why: The only counter this card ever places is on itself, which eff:add-counters-self already records. The generic word makes a lone battalion body read as a counters-matters enabler, which is the distinction the -self split exists to draw.

kept.name: Boggart Prankster
kept.why: "Target attacking Goblin you control gets +1/+0" is the card's only effect and the list has no eff: word at all - it records the trigger and the tribe and nothing about what happens.

kept.name: Blessed Wine
kept.why: "Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep" creates a delayed upkeep trigger, in the card's own text. The draw is recorded but not that it is deferred to upkeep.

kept.name: Ultimate Nullification
kept.why: The sacrifice is an additional cost to CAST the spell, not an on-demand outlet, and cost:sacrifice on a sorcery makes a one-shot wipe read as a sacrifice engine. Exiling all creatures is a symmetric board wipe that takes your own board with it, which is what scope:wipe is for and what a go-wide deck needs to be warned about.

kept.name: Aladdin's Lamp
kept.why: The ability costs {X} and {T}, looks at the top X cards of your library, and ends "then draw a card". Only the look-and-pick was recorded - the tap cost, the library and the draw are all absent.

kept.name: Alabaster Potion
kept.why: The second mode is "Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to any target this turn" and half the card is unrecorded. Only the lifegain mode was read.

kept.name: Basri, Devoted Paladin
kept.why: The -1 sets up "Whenever a creature attacks this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it", a genuine attack trigger. The counters and the pump were read; the trigger that delivers them was not.

kept.name: Bearer of Silence
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed line with no word recorded. "You may pay {1}{C}. If you do, target opponent sacrifices a creature" is a pay-for-more effect, and the trigger fires on you casting it. The edict was read and its condition and its drawback were not.

kept.name: Bucky Barnes, Eager Ally
kept.why: Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top. It looks at four cards and puts one in HAND, which is eff:look-and-pick (already present). eff:impulse would file a white dig creature as a red impulse-draw payoff.

kept.name: Phyrexian Etchings
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep puts an age counter on this permanent at the beginning of your upkeep, so it grows itself and it has an upkeep trigger. trig:step and trig:step:end were recorded from the draw clause only.

kept.name: Magnificent End
kept.why: 'This spell costs {3} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature' is a cost reduction and nothing in the list records it.

kept.name: Keepsake Gorgon
kept.why: Monstrosity 1 puts a +1/+1 counter on this creature. ctr:+1/+1 is already implied by the printed keyword but the effect verb was missing.

kept.name: Dimensional Breach
kept.why: Only the exile half was read. The cards sit in exile and each player returns one to the battlefield at their upkeep, so it returns from exile on a recurring upkeep trigger. It also takes EVERY permanent including your own, which is what a go-wide deck must be warned off.

kept.name: Furious Forebear
kept.why: It returns ITSELF from the graveyard to hand, which is eff:recur-self. eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand and nothing here does that.

kept.name: Unmake the Graves
kept.why: The card names no colour. It returns creature cards from your graveyard; convoke's reminder text mentions 'that creature's color' generically. Nothing makes this a black-matters card.

kept.name: Scale Blessing
kept.why: After the bolster it puts a counter on EACH creature you control with a +1/+1 counter, a mass effect, which is how the other 'creatures you control' cards in this batch are recorded.

kept.name: Shining Shoal
kept.why: 'You may exile a white card with mana value X from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost' is an alternative cast cost paid by exiling, and no cost word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Stormfront Riders
kept.why: 'Whenever this or another creature is returned to your hand from the battlefield' is a leaves-the-battlefield trigger. Only the ETB was recorded, so the token engine, which is the whole card, had no trigger word.

kept.name: Viper, Cruel Conspirator
kept.why: The second ability grants your choice of deathtouch or lifelink and neither keyword grant was recorded. The choice between two modes is a real choice on resolution.

kept.name: Specter of Mortality
kept.why: 'Each other creature gets -X/-X' was not recorded at all, so the card's actual effect was invisible. It is symmetric and kills your own board too, which a token deck must be warned off.

kept.name: Ajani's Last Stand
kept.why: The token comes from sacrificing this enchantment itself, which is a self-sacrifice cost rather than only the generic eff:sacrifice already listed.

kept.name: Binding Agony
kept.why: The list carried NO effect verb at all. It is an Aura that attaches to a creature, it triggers whenever that creature is dealt damage, and it deals that much damage to the creature's controller.

kept.name: Disruptor Wanderglyph
kept.why: It exiles a card from an OPPONENT'S GRAVEYARD, which is graveyard hate. Plain eff:exile reads as an answer to a permanent and would offer this as removal, which it is not.

kept.name: Solstice Zealot
kept.why: The tap ability is '{T}, Pay {E}: Tap target creature' and the tap symbol in the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Thunder Totem
kept.why: '{1}{W}{W}: This artifact becomes a 2/2 white Spirit artifact creature' turns a permanent into a creature and that whole ability was unread.

kept.name: Healing Grace
kept.why: Half the card is 'Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn by a source of your choice' and only the lifegain was recorded.

kept.name: Deadly Designs
kept.why: The destroy happens by sacrificing this enchantment once it has five plot counters, and the self-sacrifice was not recorded.

kept.name: Caught in the Brights
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature can't attack or block' is the main clause and was entirely unread. The exile hits the ENCHANTED creature, which is the opponent's; eff:exile-own means flickering your own permanents and would read this as a blink card.

kept.name: Ingenious Leonin
kept.why: 'If that creature is a Cat, it gains first strike until end of turn' was not recorded.

kept.name: Transcendent Archaic
kept.why: The whole converge ability was unread: it draws X cards and then makes you discard two. The list carried no effect verb.

kept.name: Mindstorm Crown
kept.why: Only the damage half was recorded. The upkeep trigger draws a card when you had an empty hand, which is the reason to play the card.

kept.name: Prairie Dog
kept.why: The activated ability is a Hardened Scales style replacement: if you would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put that many plus one instead. Nothing recorded that it modifies counter placement at all.

kept.name: Suppression Bonds
kept.why: An Aura with 'Enchant nonland permanent' attaches to that permanent; the restriction verbs were recorded but the attachment was not.

kept.name: Blaring Recruiter
kept.why: Partner with is a 'When this creature enters' trigger and the list records no trigger at all. The tutor pulls the partner out of a library, so the library zone is the one it touches.

kept.name: Dawnglare Invoker
kept.why: '{8}: Tap all creatures target player controls' is a mass tap, the same shape as Ivory Giant's 'tap all nonwhite creatures' which is already marked scope:all.

kept.name: Aim for the Head
kept.why: It is a modal spell ('Choose one'). Nothing in the list records that the caster picks between two different effects.

kept.name: Mob
kept.why: Convoke taps your creatures while casting, which is a cast-time cost paid with other permanents. Nothing on the card mentions black or black permanents: the only colour word is the generic 'that creature's colour' in the convoke reminder, so cares:color:b is a word-scan artefact that would file a plain removal spell as a black-matters card.

kept.name: Harsh Justice
kept.why: The whole card is a delayed trigger on combat damage being dealt, and only eff:damage was recorded. Without the trigger the list reads like a burn spell rather than a combat trick.

kept.name: Consecrated by Blood
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and the stat change was never written down. Only the flying grant and the regenerate outlet were recorded.

kept.name: Wishmonger
kept.why: The list has no effect word at all for a card whose only ability grants protection from a colour, which is how it keeps a creature alive through removal.

kept.name: Phantom Flock
kept.why: Its damage-prevention replacement effect and the counter it takes off itself to pay for it are both unrecorded; only the counters it enters with were captured.

kept.name: Tormented Thoughts
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature' is a cast-time cost, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet. Leaving cost:sacrifice on it makes a one-shot sorcery look like a repeatable outlet an aristocrats deck can build around.

kept.name: Durable Coilbug
kept.why: Its only ability returns itself from the graveyard, which is exactly recursive fodder. eff:return-from alone reads as generic recursion of other cards.

kept.name: Vicious Offering
kept.why: Kicker—sacrifice a creature is an additional cast cost and no sacrifice word was recorded at all. The bigger -5/-5 only happens if that cost was paid.

kept.name: Carrion Beetles
kept.why: The list records nothing the card does. It is a repeatable tap-and-exile graveyard hate ability, which is the one thing a reader most needs to know about it.

kept.name: Voltaic Whip
kept.why: Only the equip machinery was recorded. The +2/+0 and the granted 'whenever this creature attacks alone, you draw a card' trigger are both missing. I have deliberately not added eff:lose-life: the life loss falls on you, and the vocabulary's drain word would misread it as reaching an opponent.

kept.name: Sludge Crawler
kept.why: Ingest is a combat damage trigger spelled out on the card and no trigger was recorded. Not adding col:none: devoid removes colour but the {B} in its cost keeps its colour identity black.

kept.name: Clockwork Servant
kept.why: Adamant checks that three mana of the same colour was spent to cast it, which is the one condition on the card and is unrecorded.

kept.name: Monomania
kept.why: The card is entirely about emptying a hand down to one card, and only the bare discard verb was recorded.

kept.name: Kellan's Lightblades
kept.why: Bargain is paid as you cast, not activated on demand, so cost:sacrifice wrongly presents it as a sacrifice outlet. The upgrade from 3 damage to outright destruction happens only if that cost was paid.

kept.name: Spiritualize
kept.why: Only eff:draw was recorded, so the lifegain that is the entire point of the card is absent along with the damage trigger that produces it.

kept.name: Daxos's Torment
kept.why: Nothing recorded that it turns itself into a 5/5 flying hasty Demon, which is the whole card. Its constellation trigger also fires on itself entering, not only on other enchantments.

kept.name: Vanguard of the Rose
kept.why: Granting itself indestructible keeps it alive but changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong and would file it as an enhance card. Nothing here affects more than the one creature, so scope:all is wrong too: 'another creature or artifact' is the sacrifice cost's selector, not a mass effect.

kept.name: Rancorous Archaic
kept.why: Converge counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, and no word records that the card cares what was spent.

kept.name: Norritt
kept.why: The second ability forces an opponent's creature to attack this turn if able, which is the force-attack effect eff:goad names; nothing in the list said the card does anything to combat.

kept.name: Necromancer's Magemark
kept.why: The death replacement returns YOUR enchanted creature to its owner's hand, which is eff:bounce-own, and saving it from dying is eff:protect. Nothing ever reaches the graveyard, so the graveyard care and the recursion word both read this as reanimation, which it is not.

kept.name: Bride's Gown
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 (and +0/+2), and gains first strike under the Groom's Finery condition. The list recorded the attaching and neither thing the Equipment actually does.

kept.name: Reckless Imp
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a real restriction on itself and was not written down.

kept.name: Shadow Stinger
kept.why: Combat damage to a player mills three (kw:mill was there but no eff:mill), the activated ability grants itself deathtouch, and its cost is tapping ANOTHER untapped Rogue you control.

kept.name: Hexgold Slith
kept.why: The attack trigger gains it first strike, and it is a "you may pay {E}{E}. If you do" optional-payment ability.

kept.name: Heir of Falkenrath // Heir to the Night
kept.why: The activated ability transforms this creature; the list held the printed kw:transform but nothing saying the card itself performs a transform.

kept.name: Brass Gnat
kept.why: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {1}. If you do, untap this creature" is the pay-for-more shape.

kept.name: Gateway Shade
kept.why: Both abilities pump only this creature. Nothing affects everything, so scope:all reads it as an anthem.

kept.name: Definitely Not a Turtle
kept.why: It looks at the top six and puts a card into your HAND, bottoming the rest. Nothing is exiled and nothing is played off the top, so both the impulse word and the exile care are false.

kept.name: Appeal to Eirdu
kept.why: The whole spell is "one or two target creatures each get +2/+1" and eff:pump was missing entirely. The only mention of colour is convoke's reminder text about a creature's colour, which is not caring about white.

kept.name: World-Weary
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets -4/-4. This is a removal aura, not a pump aura.

kept.name: Entrancing Lyre
kept.why: It only targets a creature with power X or less, which is a power check. The target also stays tapped for as long as the Lyre is tapped, so it renders a permanent harmless without destroying it rather than tapping it once.

kept.name: Kinjalli's Dawnrunner
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and may put it into your hand or your graveyard; nothing said the card looks at the library.

kept.name: Compulsory Rest
kept.why: A Pacifism-style aura: enchanted creature can't attack or block. Neither restriction was recorded, so the only word on it was the 2 life from the granted ability.

kept.name: Knight of the Last Breath
kept.why: Afterlife 3 is a dies trigger that makes three Spirits and nothing said the card triggers on dying. Nothing on the card affects everything, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Stronghold Discipline
kept.why: "Each player loses 1 life for each creature they control" is symmetric and hits the whole table, including you.

kept.name: Aether Poisoner
kept.why: The attack trigger is "you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, create a Servo", an optional payment for more.

kept.name: Dredging Claw
kept.why: "Whenever a creature enters from your graveyard, you may attach this Equipment to it" is a trigger on another permanent entering, and it is specifically about creatures coming back from the graveyard. None of that was written down.

kept.name: Pledge of Loyalty
kept.why: Granting protection from the colours of permanents you control keeps the enchanted creature alive; Black Ward, the same effect narrowed to one colour, carries eff:protect.

kept.name: Bogbrew Witch
kept.why: The tutor costs {2} and {T}, and it searches your library. Only eff:search-library was present.

kept.name: Dreamspoiler Witches
kept.why: It triggers on spells YOU cast (during an opponent's turn), not on anyone's cast.

kept.name: Death Match
kept.why: The whole payoff is "target creature of their choice gets -3/-3" and no effect word was recorded at all - the card read as a trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Guardian Zendikon
kept.why: It makes the enchanted land a 2/6 Wall creature with defender. Turning a permanent into a creature was not recorded, only the bounce when it dies.

kept.name: Qarsi High Priest
kept.why: The ability costs {1}{B}, {T} and sacrificing another creature, and it manifests off the top of your library. It is a sacrifice outlet and none of that was written down.

kept.name: Loathsome Curator
kept.why: Exploit is "when this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature" - an enters trigger on itself that sacrifices. Only the cost side was recorded.

kept.name: Light from Within
kept.why: It is an anthem: each creature you control gets +1/+1 for each white mana symbol in its cost. The card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Amber Prison
kept.why: The tapped permanent does not untap for as long as the Prison stays tapped, so this is permanent lockdown rather than a one-shot tap, and nothing said the card answers a threat.

kept.name: Dwarfhold Champion
kept.why: The list carried no effect word at all. "As long as this creature is equipped, it gets +0/+2" is a pump of itself.

kept.name: Polygraph Orb
kept.why: Only the life loss was read. The ETB digs four deep and takes two, the graveyard is a destination and a cost source, and the activated ability is a tap plus collect evidence (exiling from your own graveyard) that taxes each opponent.

kept.name: Kor Dirge
kept.why: Redirecting all damage off a creature you control is a way of keeping it alive, which is what eff:protect names. The redirect and prevent words alone describe the mechanism and not the job.

kept.name: Ordeal of Erebos
kept.why: "When you sacrifice this Aura, target player discards two cards" is a trigger on the Aura being sacrificed, and nothing recorded the trigger condition.

kept.name: Mysterious Pathlighter
kept.why: "Each creature you control that has an Adventure enters with an additional counter" affects your whole board, not one target.

kept.name: Soul Search
kept.why: Marked as fully read while carrying neither of its two effects: it exiles a card out of the opponent's hand and may create a Spirit token.

kept.name: Aesthir Glider
kept.why: "This creature can't block" was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Choking Restraints
kept.why: eff:exile-own says this flickers your own permanent. It exiles the ENCHANTED creature, which is an opponent's creature in every real use, so the word points the card at the wrong player. The Pacifism clause produced nothing, and shutting a creature off without killing it is exactly eff:neutralise.

kept.name: Rackling
kept.why: The damage scales off the number of cards in the opponent's hand, so hand size is something this card genuinely reads.

kept.name: Threefold Signal
kept.why: Only the scry was read. The second half hands replicate to your three-colour spells and there is a word for granting it.

kept.name: Shrouded Shepherd // Cleave Shadows
kept.why: The Adventure half, Cleave Shadows, gives every creature your opponents control -1/-1 and was entirely unread.

kept.name: Groom's Finery
kept.why: The equip and the attach were read but neither thing the Equipment actually does: +2/+0 (and a conditional +0/+2) is a pump, and it grants deathtouch.

kept.name: Worry Beads
kept.why: It carries the printed keyword and not the effect: every player mills a card each upkeep. The mill hits all players, so it is not a targeted effect.

kept.name: Tsabo's Decree
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures of that type that player controls" is a mass destroy, not a single target. Not scope:wipe, since it only touches one player's board and only one creature type.

kept.name: Runed Crown
kept.why: The search was read but not what it does with the card, and the search reaches your hand and graveyard as well as your library. Putting a Rune straight onto the battlefield attached is not a cast.

kept.name: Screaming Shield
kept.why: The granted mill ability was read and the +0/+3 was not.

kept.name: Astral Confrontation
kept.why: The exile was read and the cost reduction clause was not. The card genuinely costs less to cast the wider you are attacking.

kept.name: Ramosian Captain
kept.why: The library search was recorded but not that the Rebel arrives on the battlefield rather than in hand.

kept.name: Blade of the Swarm
kept.why: Only the first mode was read. This is a modal ETB, and the second mode answers an exiled warp card by putting it on the bottom of its owner's library.

kept.name: D'Avenant Trapper
kept.why: "Whenever YOU cast a historic spell" - the trigger listens to your own casts, so the split word applies, not just the generic trig:cast.

kept.name: Victor Mancha, Runaway
kept.why: It exiles a card from YOUR OWN graveyard and lets you play it - graveyard recursion, not graveyard hate. eff:exile-graveyard is the hate word and would make this read as anti-synergy in the very deck that wants it. Nothing is ever returned to any zone, so eff:return-from is false; the card is played from exile, which is eff:cast-from-graveyard plus a real reference to the exile zone.

kept.name: Umbral Juke
kept.why: Modal "Choose one -": the caster picks between an edict and a token, which is exactly what eff:choose records.

kept.name: Chosen of Markov // Markov's Servant
kept.why: The activation cost is "{T}, Tap an untapped Vampire" - it taps itself as well as another creature, and only cost:tap-others was recorded. The effect itself is a transform, which the list did not say at all (kw:transform is the printed keyword, not the effect).

kept.name: Light of Sanction
kept.why: "Prevent ALL damage that would be dealt to creatures you control" is a mass, ongoing effect over your whole board, and its whole purpose is keeping your creatures alive under your own sweepers and pingers.

kept.name: Chimeric Egg
kept.why: The entire second ability was unrecorded. It turns the artifact into a 6/6 Construct creature with trample, paid for by removing three charge counters. The list had the counter-gaining half and nothing about what the counters buy.

kept.name: Cabal Interrogator
kept.why: {T} is part of the activation cost and was missing. "you choose one of them" is a targeted discard where the caster picks the card, the same reading Addle already carries as eff:choose.

kept.name: Vizier of Deferment
kept.why: The list recorded flash and an enters trigger and NOTHING the card does. It exiles a creature and returns it to the battlefield at the next end step. Deliberately eff:exile rather than eff:exile-own: the target is any "target creature" that attacked or blocked, so the controller is unknown and unknown must stay unknown.

kept.name: Girder Goons
kept.why: Blitz grants "When this creature dies, draw a card", so a blitzed Girder Goons is a genuine card-draw source. Only the token half of the card was recorded.

kept.name: Haunted Angel
kept.why: The tokens go to opponents, so the generic word is not merely incomplete, it points the wrong way.

kept.name: Tenured Oilcaster
kept.why: The conditional +3/+0 static buff was not recorded at all, and "each player mills a card" is a symmetric effect hitting the whole table.

kept.name: Thought Prison
kept.why: Only the 2 damage was recorded. The card also makes a player reveal their hand, has you choose a nonland card from it, and exiles that card; the damage half triggers whenever any player casts a spell matching the exiled card, which is a cast trigger watching the stack and referring back to the exile zone.

kept.name: Alaborn Zealot
kept.why: "When this creature BLOCKS a creature" fires when it is the blocker. trig:becomes-blocked is the opposite event, when an attacker is blocked, and this creature never gets it. trig:blocks is already present and is correct.

kept.name: Kinsbaile Courier
kept.why: Encore creates a token copy for each opponent, so the card genuinely makes tokens on top of copying, and encore is activated by exiling the card from your graveyard, which the list never mentioned.

kept.name: Dark Triumph
kept.why: "you may sacrifice a creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is a sacrifice paid to cast the spell. The list recorded the pump and nothing about how the card is paid for, so it read as a plain five-mana anthem instead of a free aristocrats trick.

kept.name: Conversion Chamber
kept.why: It exiles an artifact card from a graveyard; the effect word was there but the zone reference was not.

kept.name: Maze of Shadows
kept.why: The second half of the second ability, "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn", was entirely unrecorded - the list had only the untap.

kept.name: Slab Hammer
kept.why: The whole triggered ability was missing its payload: returning a land you control to hand is the cost, and +2/+2 until end of turn is what it buys. Only the equip and the attack trigger were recorded.

kept.name: Sunseed Nurturer
kept.why: "if you control a creature with power 5 or greater" is a power check, which is exactly what cares:power records, and it is the condition the whole lifegain hangs on.

kept.name: Consuming Aetherborn
kept.why: Backup 1 is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ("When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature"). The counter and the lifelink grant were recorded but the trigger that delivers them was not, so nothing said this card does anything on arrival.

kept.name: Mutant Surveyor
kept.why: The max speed ability is paid by exiling this card FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD, so the draw is a graveyard ability. Neither the cost nor the zone was recorded.

kept.name: The Stone Brain
kept.why: Its cost is {2}, {T}, and exiling itself, none of which was recorded. It also names a card and exiles up to four copies from hand and library as well as the graveyard, so plain eff:exile and eff:choose both apply. Deliberately NOT adding eff:search-library, eff:shuffle or eff:draw: all three happen to the targeted OPPONENT, and recording them would file a hate artifact as a tutor, a shuffler and a draw spell.

kept.name: Grim Roustabout
kept.why: Unleash's real cost is "It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it", which is a restriction on this creature and was not recorded anywhere.

kept.name: Buy Your Silence
kept.why: The second sentence creates a Treasure token and no token-making word was recorded; only the Treasure subtype was noted.

kept.name: Altar of the Lost
kept.why: The mana ability costs {T}, which was not recorded. The mana is also locked to casting flashback spells from a graveyard, so the card only functions alongside a graveyard.

kept.name: Steel Dromedary
kept.why: Only the counters it enters with were read. The combat trigger moves a +1/+1 counter OFF this creature and ONTO target creature, which is both a removal and an addition, and neither was written down.

kept.name: Inner Sanctum
kept.why: It prevents ALL damage to EVERY creature you control, which is board-wide and was not marked. Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep and only the generic step word was present.

kept.name: Blaring Captain
kept.why: Partner with is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ("When this creature enters, target player may put Blaring Recruiter into their hand from their library"). The tutor effect was recorded but the trigger that causes it was not.

kept.name: Foul-Tongue Invocation
kept.why: The 4 life is conditional on having revealed or controlled a Dragon as an additional cost, which is exactly a pay-more-get-more clause and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Essence Feed
kept.why: The text states the tokens have "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}". Three Eldrazi Spawn are a mana source and nothing on the card said mana is produced.

kept.name: Formation
kept.why: "Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep" is a delayed upkeep trigger; only the draw was recorded, not when it happens.

kept.name: Action News Crew
kept.why: The Channel ability's cost is "{6}, Discard this card". Discarding itself as a cost was not recorded, though the same shape is recorded on cycling cards in this batch.

kept.name: Erebos's Emissary
kept.why: The pump is paid for by discarding a creature card, a cost that was missing. Bestow makes it an Aura with enchant creature, so it attaches to a creature, and that was missing too.

kept.name: Thought Gorger
kept.why: "If you do, discard your hand" is a discard and was not recorded at all. The counters are counted from cards in your hand, so the card genuinely reads your hand.

kept.name: Syndicate Trafficker
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything. The word comes from the unbounded selector in the sacrifice COST ("Sacrifice an artifact"); the ability itself only touches this one creature.

kept.name: Check for Traps
kept.why: It exiles a card out of an opponent's hand and no exile word was recorded, which is the card's main effect. The 1 life is a drawback on resolution, not a cost to cast or activate, and eff:lose-life already covers it.

kept.name: Battlefield Medic
kept.why: The card's only ability was entirely unread. It prevents damage to a creature, and the ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Kor Chant
kept.why: Redirecting all damage off your creature onto another is a combat trick that keeps your creature alive, and nothing marked it as protection.

kept.name: Sepulcher Ghoul
kept.why: Same word-scan fault as Syndicate Trafficker: the ability pumps only itself. The all-scope comes from "another creature" in the sacrifice cost.

kept.name: Icatian Skirmishers
kept.why: The attack trigger gives first strike to all creatures banded with it. Only its own printed first strike keyword was recorded, not the grant.

kept.name: Skirk Ridge Exhumer
kept.why: The activation cost is "{B}, {T}, Discard a card" and neither the tap nor the discard cost was recorded.

kept.name: Samite Elder
kept.why: The card's entire ability was unread: it taps to give EVERY creature you control protection from a permanent's colors, which is a board-wide protective effect.

kept.name: Minion of Leshrac
kept.why: "unless you sacrifice a creature other than this creature" — the card makes you sacrifice a creature every upkeep and nothing recorded that. Used eff:sacrifice rather than cost:sacrifice because it is a forced upkeep choice, not an on-demand outlet.

kept.name: Weathered Bodyguards
kept.why: The damage is not prevented, it is "dealt to this creature instead" — that is a redirection. eff:redirect-damage says exactly that; eff:prevent-damage is a different effect and would make it look like a Fog.

kept.name: Clockwork Steed
kept.why: The {X},{T} ability puts the counters on ITSELF (eff:add-counters-self) and pays {T} as a cost (cost:tap), neither of which was written down. The end-of-combat ability removes a counter (eff:remove-counters) and is a step trigger (trig:step) — the whole clause was unread.

kept.name: Grave Consequences
kept.why: "Each player may exile any number of cards from their graveyard" is graveyard hate and the list said nothing about graveyards at all. "Each player loses 1 life for each card in their graveyard" is symmetric, so scope:all.

kept.name: Eradicate
kept.why: It searches "graveyard, hand, and library" and exiles from all three. Only the hand was recorded. Did not add eff:search-library or eff:shuffle: both are glossed as YOUR library and this searches an opponent's, so they would read as a tutor.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Red
kept.why: The card's entire main ability is "prevent that damage" and the list had only the cycling half. This is the one card in the batch where eff:prevent-damage is literally correct.

kept.name: Reflective Golem
kept.why: "you may pay {2}. If you do, copy that spell" is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid. scope:all is wrong: the card affects one spell targeting one creature — the word almost certainly came from scanning "targets only".

kept.name: Pious Wayfarer
kept.why: "target creature gets +1/+1" affects one creature. Nothing here affects everything; the word looks like a scan artefact from "an enchantment you control enters".

kept.name: Despoiler of Souls
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed drawback that was not recorded, and eff:cant-block-self is the exact word for it. scope:all is wrong — exiling two cards from your own graveyard as a cost affects nothing globally, the word likely came from "two other creature cards".

kept.name: Torture
kept.why: Repeatably putting -1/-1 counters on the enchanted creature makes it smaller and is how this card kills things. The counter facets alone do not say the creature shrinks, so removal-style readers cannot see it.

kept.name: Tariff
kept.why: "unless they pay that creature's mana cost" is a tax and eff:unless-pays was missing. cost:sacrifice is wrong and actively harmful: that word means sacrificing as a cost you pay on demand, i.e. a sac outlet, and Tariff is a one-sided edict — eff:sacrifice (already present) is the correct half.

kept.name: Iron Suitcase
kept.why: "{3}: This artifact becomes a 3/3 Construct artifact creature with flying" was entirely unread — half the card. eff:animate is the word for turning a permanent into a creature, and the animation grants flying.

kept.name: Bob, Reluctant HYDRA Agent
kept.why: "return him to his owner's hand" returns your own permanent to hand. Only the generic eff:move-zone was recorded, which does not say the bounce is of your own creature — and self-bouncing is the whole engine of this card.

kept.name: Crypt Lurker
kept.why: The list recorded nothing but the ETB trigger — every actual effect was missing. "sacrifice a creature or discard a creature card" are the two costs, "If you do, draw a card" is the payoff and the classic eff:do-if-cost-paid shape.

kept.name: Glory-Bound Initiate
kept.why: "it gets +1/+3 and gains lifelink until end of turn" — neither the pump nor the granted keyword was written down. kw:lifelink is the printed keyword on the exert trigger, but the card GRANTS lifelink to itself and grants:lifelink is what a reader looking for lifelink enablers needs.

kept.name: Noble Templar
kept.why: Plainscycling is "{2}, Discard this card" — discarding itself is a real cost and was not recorded, though the search half was.

kept.name: Last Voyage of the _____
kept.why: Three clauses were unread. It literally says "attach this Aura to it" (eff:attach), "Enchanted creature gets +2/+0 for each name sticker" (eff:pump), and "When this Aura leaves the battlefield, sacrifice enchanted creature" (eff:sacrifice). Only the reanimation was recorded.

kept.name: Wicker Warcrawler
kept.why: "put a -1/-1 counter on it" — the card's only ability puts a counter on itself and no eff: word recorded it at all. Used the -self form per the convention; did not add the generic eff:add-counters or eff:shrink, since this is a drawback on itself and should not read as a counters payoff.

kept.name: Cry of Contrition
kept.why: "When the creature this card haunts dies, target player discards a card" is a death trigger and was not recorded. Haunt exiles this card from the graveyard, so it does care about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Nirkana Assassin
kept.why: trig:gains-life was there but cares:lifegain — the word that says this is a lifegain-matters card — was not. eff:pump is wrong: the card grants deathtouch and changes no power or toughness.

kept.name: Inkshape Demonstrator
kept.why: The Repartee trigger pumps this creature only. Nothing on the card affects everything; the word looks like a scan artefact from the ward reminder text.

kept.name: Neverending Torment
kept.why: "search target player's library for X cards ... and exile them" is the card's whole effect and eff:exile was missing. Epic copies the spell "at the beginning of each of your upkeeps", which is a real recurring upkeep trigger.

kept.name: Lost Legacy
kept.why: It exiles from hand and library as well as the graveyard, so bare eff:exile was missing alongside eff:exile-graveyard, and the graveyard zone itself was not recorded. Did not add eff:draw — the draws go to the targeted player, not to you, and would read as card advantage.

kept.name: Negative Zone Portal
kept.why: Almost nothing was recorded but the coin flip. The main ability exiles from an opponent's graveyard (graveyard hate), draws a card, and taps as a cost; the upkeep trigger sacrifices the artifact and returns a card from exile to hand. Cards exiled WITH this artifact means it cares about the exile zone too.

kept.name: Hedron Blade
kept.why: "Whenever equipped creature becomes blocked by one or more colorless creatures, it gains deathtouch" — the entire second ability was unread: the trigger, the granted keyword, and the fact that it cares about colorless creatures.

kept.name: Booby Trap
kept.why: "When the chosen player draws a card with the chosen name" is a draw trigger and was the only thing that makes this card ever do anything. Did not add trig:enters-self — "As this artifact enters" is a replacement effect, not a trigger.

kept.name: Grisly Survivor
kept.why: "this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn" was not recorded — the list had the trigger conditions and no effect at all.

kept.name: Silverquill Silencer
kept.why: The trigger is specifically 'whenever an OPPONENT casts a spell', which is the stax/tax direction, and the bare trig:cast cannot say whose cast it watches. cares:zone:stack matches how other cast-watchers in this batch are recorded.

kept.name: Trigon of Corruption
kept.why: Its whole payload is repeatedly putting -1/-1 counters on creatures, which makes creatures smaller and is the card's only interaction. With only eff:add-counters it reads as a counters engine rather than as removal.

kept.name: Rampaging Monument
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. It puts +1/+1 counters on ITSELF when you cast a multicolored spell. scope:all here is a word-scan artefact and misfiles a lone beater as a mass effect.

kept.name: Dirty Wererat
kept.why: Three clauses were unread. The regenerate ability costs discarding a card from hand (cost:discard, not the -self form which is discarding this card, as with cycling). Threshold gives it +2/+2, which is eff:pump, and makes it unable to block, which is eff:cant-block-self.

kept.name: Shrine of Piercing Vision
kept.why: Only the second half of the card was read. The first line is an upkeep trigger AND a your-cast trigger that puts a charge counter on itself, none of which was recorded, and the activated ability's {T} cost was missing.

kept.name: Thriving Rats
kept.why: The attack trigger is 'you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it' - an optional paid upgrade, which is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid. Nothing in the list said the counter is conditional on paying.

kept.name: Lifebane Zombie
kept.why: The enter trigger exiles a creature card out of an opponent's hand and nothing in the list recorded that it exiles anything at all. It was carrying only the cares words for the hand and the colour.

kept.name: Evincar's Justice
kept.why: 'each creature and each player' includes you and your board: it damages you (eff:damage-self) and it is a symmetric board sweeper, so a go-wide deck should be warned off it the same way it is warned off other mass -X/-X and destroy effects.

kept.name: Deepwood Legate
kept.why: 'you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost' is the card's headline clause and produced no word at all - the whole list was the {B} pump ability.

kept.name: Skyclave Sentinel
kept.why: Kicker {4} with 'If this creature was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters' is a paid upgrade, and nothing recorded that the counters are conditional.

kept.name: Siege Striker
kept.why: The attack trigger ends 'this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature tapped this way'. The tapping was recorded and the pump it pays for was not.

kept.name: Landscaper Colos
kept.why: The enter trigger moves a card from an opponent's graveyard to the bottom of their library - a zone move against a graveyard, and neither was recorded. Basic landcycling discards this card as its cost, the same shape as cycling elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Strongarm Tactics
kept.why: 'Each player discards a card' includes you, so it makes YOU discard as well as an opponent, and it is a symmetric effect hitting the whole table.

kept.name: Stone Docent
kept.why: The only ability on the card is activated FROM the graveyard by exiling itself from there. The cost was recorded and the fact that the card lives in and cares about the graveyard was not.

kept.name: Iron League Steed
kept.why: Fabricate 1 is an enter-the-battlefield trigger. The counter and the token were both recorded but nothing said when they happen, so it reads as a static rather than an arrival payoff.

kept.name: Summoned Dromedary
kept.why: '{1}{W}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand' is literally bringing itself back from the graveyard. eff:return-from is generic and does not say the card recurs itself.

kept.name: Seizures
kept.why: It is an Aura with 'Enchant creature' and nothing recorded that it attaches. The damage is also conditional - 'unless that player pays {3}' - which is a tax the list did not carry.

kept.name: Tawnos's Coffin
kept.why: Over half the card was unread. It taps ITSELF as an activation cost and taps nothing else, so eff:tap ('taps things down') is wrong and cost:tap is what is true. The delayed trigger - when it leaves the battlefield or becomes untapped, return the exiled permanent - produced no trigger word and no return word at all.

kept.name: Rhox Veteran
kept.why: Battle cry gives each other attacking creature +1/+0. The tap trigger was recorded and the team pump the keyword provides was not.

kept.name: Death Rattle
kept.why: Delve pays for the spell by exiling cards from your graveyard. A delve card genuinely wants a full graveyard and pays an exile cost, and neither was written down.

kept.name: Warped Devotion
kept.why: The list was a single word. The card triggers whenever a permanent is returned to a player's hand - a zone change off the battlefield into hand - and nothing recorded the trigger or that hands are what it watches.

kept.name: Hedron Scrabbler
kept.why: Landfall pumps only THIS creature. It affects nothing else, so scope:all is wrong and would file a single small body as a mass effect.

kept.name: Bloodsky Berserker
kept.why: 'It gains menace until end of turn' was unrecorded. And nothing here affects everything - both the counters and the menace land on itself alone - so scope:all is a scan artefact.

kept.name: Mystic Compass
kept.why: The activated ability's {T} was not recorded. Its actual effect, changing a land's basic type, has no word in the vocabulary at all, so the card currently says nothing about what it does.

kept.name: Knight of Cliffhaven
kept.why: Level up puts a level counter on itself every activation. The counter kind was recorded but not the fact that the card grows itself with counters.

kept.name: Gaze of Justice
kept.why: The additional cost specifically taps three untapped WHITE creatures you control, which is a real white-creature-count requirement the list did not carry. The spell exiles ONE target creature, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Lotus-Eye Mystics
kept.why: Prowess is a cast trigger that pumps: "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1". The list records the keyword but none of what it does. Bushido on Nezumi Ronin in the same batch is expanded (eff:pump plus its triggers), so this is an omission rather than a policy.

kept.name: Zhalfirin Lancer
kept.why: The pump and the vigilance are on this creature alone. scope:all means the effect hits a whole group; it has come from the trigger's "another Knight you control" selector, which watches a group but changes nothing about who is affected. Leaving it in reads this as an anthem.

kept.name: Ixalan's Binding
kept.why: The second sentence, "Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card", is a whole clause producing nothing. It is a real casting restriction and eff:cant-cast is exactly that word.

kept.name: Guardian Kirin
kept.why: The counter goes on this creature only. The word has come from the "another creature you control dies" trigger selector, not from an effect that affects everything.

kept.name: Flight of Equenauts
kept.why: Nothing on this card cares about white. The convoke reminder says "one mana of that creature's color", which is any colour. A 7-mana white flier with convoke is not a white-matters card.

kept.name: Necropolis
kept.why: The +0/+1 counters go on Necropolis itself, which is the whole point of the card (it grows by eating your graveyard). eff:add-counters alone reads as putting counters on other things. Deliberately not adding eff:exile-graveyard: exiling your own creature card as a cost is fuel, not graveyard hate, and cost:exile already records it.

kept.name: Origin of Black Widow
kept.why: Chapter II is "Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn" - a mass grant over your whole board, which is what scope:all is for. grants:deathtouch is already there but nothing said it was team-wide.

kept.name: Caligo Skin-Witch
kept.why: "if it was kicked, each opponent discards two cards" is a conditional payoff for paying an extra cost, which is precisely eff:do-if-cost-paid. The discard is already recorded; the fact that it only happens when you pay is not.

kept.name: Mourning Thrull
kept.why: "you gain that much life" produced nothing at all - the card is marked rec:partial and the lifegain is the entire second half of it. trig:deals-damage was read and the effect hanging off it was not.

kept.name: Fendeep Summoner
kept.why: Three gaps in one line. The ability costs {T}, which is not recorded. It turns Swamps into creatures, which is eff:animate. And it sets them to 3/5, which is eff:set-pt rather than a pump. As it stands the card records only what it looks at and nothing it does.

kept.name: Mountain Stronghold
kept.why: The land grants "bands with other legendary creatures", a banding variant, and nothing recorded that it grants anything. It also genuinely cares about the colour of your creatures - only RED legendary creatures get it.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Green
kept.why: The main ability - "{W}: prevent that damage" - produced nothing; only the cycling half was read. This is a damage prevention card that currently reads as a cantrip.

kept.name: Suspicious Shambler
kept.why: The ability is activated FROM the graveyard - it is a card you want to mill or discard. cost:exile-self records the cost but nothing records that the graveyard is where this card operates, which is the reason to play it.

kept.name: Blightspeaker
kept.why: Neither ability affects a group: one drains a single target player, the other tutors one Rebel. scope:all appears to have come from the search filter and says something untrue about the card.

kept.name: Throne of Bone
kept.why: "you gain 1 life" is the only thing this artifact does and it was not recorded at all - the list has the trigger and the colour it watches but no effect. The "you may pay {1}. If you do" clause is eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Enshrouding Mist
kept.why: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn" is the middle clause and produced nothing, though it is the reason to cast the card. That is also what makes it a save-your-creature trick, so eff:protect applies.

kept.name: Warren Pilferers
kept.why: "this creature gains haste until end of turn" is unrecorded. The recursion half was read and the haste half was not.

kept.name: Glaze Fiend
kept.why: The +2/+2 is on Glaze Fiend alone. The word has come from the "another artifact you control enters" trigger, which watches a group but pumps only itself.

kept.name: Dominaria's Judgment
kept.why: The card names white, blue, black, red and green in the same sentence and only white and red were recorded. Adding blue and black makes the reading of the clause consistent with itself. Green cannot be added because the vocabulary has no cares:color:g - see the proposal on Rune of Protection: Green.

kept.name: Hedron Rover
kept.why: Landfall pumps this creature only. scope:all has come from the "a land you control enters" trigger selector rather than from anything that affects a whole group.

kept.name: Meditation Puzzle
kept.why: Convoke is on the card and its cost effect is missing. Flight of Equenauts in this same batch carries cost:cast-tap-others for the identical keyword, so this is an inconsistency rather than a judgement call.

kept.name: Nemesis Trap
kept.why: "Create a token that's a copy of that creature" is the second half of the card and produced nothing - only the exile was read. It makes a token and it copies a creature, and both words exist.

kept.name: Wall of Forgotten Pharaohs
kept.why: The ability is "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage..." and the tap cost is not recorded, though acost:1 and the damage are. A pinger that must tap is a different card from one that does not.

kept.name: Gideon's Resolve
kept.why: The whole enters trigger - searching your library and/or graveyard for a card and putting it in your hand - produced nothing. Only the static anthem was read. This is a tutor as well as an anthem and nothing said so.

kept.name: Brink of Disaster
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature or land": it attaches to a permanent, which is how the destroy trigger ever fires. Cultist's Staff in this batch carries eff:attach for the equivalent Equipment case.

kept.name: Spire Golem
kept.why: Affinity for Islands makes the spell cost less and nothing records it. cares:type:land is the only trace of the whole first line.

kept.name: Collective Nightmare
kept.why: The card never mentions a colour. The only word in the text near a colour is convoke's reminder ('one mana of that creature's color'), which is a word-scan artefact, not a black-matters card.

kept.name: Festering Evil
kept.why: Both abilities hit EACH creature and EACH player, so it is a symmetric board-and-face pinger (scope:all) that also damages you (eff:damage-self). The second ability sacrifices the enchantment as a cost and nothing recorded that. Not scope:wipe: damage is not a mass destroy.

kept.name: Temporal Aperture
kept.why: The card had four facets and none of them was an effect. It shuffles, taps as a cost, works off the top of your library, and lets you play that card without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Spincrusher
kept.why: The second ability is entirely unrecorded: it spends a +1/+1 counter as a cost to make itself unblockable.

kept.name: Enormous Energy Blade
kept.why: The attach trigger taps the creature it just attached to, which is a creature you control, and nothing recorded that drawback.

kept.name: Primal Clay
kept.why: 'your choice of a 3/3, a 2/2 with flying, or a 1/6 Wall' is a modal choice made by you and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Suncrusher
kept.why: The destroy ability costs {T} as well as a counter. Sunburst counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, which is exactly cares:mana-spent.

kept.name: Nezumi Freewheeler // Hideous Fleshwheeler
kept.why: The activated ability transforms this creature and nothing recorded it (kw:transform is the printed keyword, not the effect). The mill hits EACH player, so it is symmetric.

kept.name: Divine Light
