kept.why: Preventing ALL damage to ALL creatures you control is a fog for your board: scope:all for the breadth, eff:protect because keeping your creatures alive is the whole card. It had three facets and only one effect.

kept.name: Desolation Angel
kept.why: Kicker changes the effect from 'destroy all lands you control' to 'destroy all lands'. That is the definition of doing more if you pay, and it is the difference between a drawback and a Armageddon.

kept.name: Mage Hunters' Onslaught
kept.why: The second sentence is a delayed trigger on any creature blocking this turn; only its lose-life consequence was recorded, not the trigger.

kept.name: Forced Worship
kept.why: The whole point of the Aura, 'enchanted creature can't attack', produced no effect word at all. Only the bounce ability was recorded.

kept.name: Catapult Squad
kept.why: The ability deals 2 damage to ONE target attacking or blocking creature. Nothing here affects everything; the word looks scanned off 'two untapped Soldiers you control'.

kept.name: Widow's Bite
kept.why: Nothing gets bigger on either mode, so eff:pump has no source (mode one grants deathtouch, mode two is -2/-2 and already has eff:shrink). Added: it is modal (eff:choose), teamwork taps your creatures as an additional cost to cast (cost:cast-tap-others), and paying that cost gets you both modes instead of one (eff:do-if-cost-paid).

kept.name: Dark Supplicant
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the three Clerics, it shuffles when it searches the library, and it searches your HAND as well as graveyard and library.

kept.name: The End
kept.why: 'This spell costs {2} less if your life total is 5 or less' produced nothing. It also exiles every same-named card out of the controller's graveyard, which is graveyard exile. Deliberately NOT adding cares:zone:graveyard: this attacks a graveyard rather than using one, and that distinction is the reason eff:exile-graveyard is a separate word.

kept.name: Guardian Archon
kept.why: Giving you and a permanent you control protection from a player until end of turn is a protection effect; grants:protection records the keyword granted but eff:protect is what says the card keeps your things alive.

kept.name: Kaervek's Spite
kept.why: The card had ONE effect word and its entire additional cost, sacrificing every permanent you control and discarding your hand, was unrecorded. Both are cast-time costs, not effects.

kept.name: Grave Defiler
kept.why: Revealing the top four and keeping the Zombies is dig-and-take; the ETB produced no effect word at all, only cares: words.

kept.name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
kept.why: Sacrificing it to prevent all damage from a red source is a fog that keeps your creatures alive; only eff:prevent-damage was recorded, which does not say the protection is for your side.

kept.name: Kithkeeper
kept.why: Neither ability affects everything: it makes X tokens (X counting colours among your permanents) and pumps only itself. The word looks scanned off 'permanents you control' / 'creatures you control'.

kept.name: Ghost-Lit Stalker
kept.why: Channel discards this card as the cost of the second ability, exactly the way cycling does, and it was unrecorded.

kept.name: Wine of Blood and Iron
kept.why: The delayed 'sacrifice this artifact at the beginning of the next end step' clause produced nothing. It is literally an end-step trigger and it is the whole downside of the card.

kept.name: Thopter Arrest
kept.why: 'until this enchantment leaves the battlefield' means the exile ends when the enchantment goes, which is the defining fragility of an O-Ring and was unrecorded. Not adding eff:return-from: the card returned is the opponent's and reading it as recursion would be worse than silence.

kept.name: Gideon's Battle Cry
kept.why: Only the first sentence was read. The second is a tutor that searches your library AND your graveyard, returns a card from the graveyard to hand, and shuffles.

kept.name: Bösium Strip
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever. Casting instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard is precisely eff:cast-from-graveyard, and the ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Forced March
kept.why: "Destroy all creatures with mana value X or less" is a symmetric board wipe - X is chosen by the caster and it kills your own board too, which is exactly what scope:wipe records. A go-wide deck should be warned off it.

kept.name: Goldmeadow Dodger
kept.why: Its only ability is evasion - it can't be blocked by creatures with power 4 or greater - and the list carried no effect word at all. Not cares:power: it does not scale with power, it just names a threshold.

kept.name: Qarsi Sadist
kept.why: Exploit is an enters-the-battlefield trigger ("When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature") and neither enters word was present. The same cycle's Rakshasa Gravecaller carries trig:enters, so this is an inconsistency as well as a gap.

kept.name: Unrooted Ancestor
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything - the ability grants indestructible to itself and taps itself. scope:all makes it read like an anthem or a mass effect.

kept.name: Crown of the Ages
kept.why: The ability costs {4} and {T}, so cost:tap was simply missing, and moving an Aura onto another creature is an attach effect. The card previously carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Eternal Student
kept.why: The only ability is activated from the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"), so this is a genuine graveyard card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Thran Golem
kept.why: The three granted keywords were recorded but the +2/+2 was not. It gets bigger as well as evasive.

kept.name: Mind Swords
kept.why: The sacrifice is an alternative cost paid when casting the spell, not a repeatable sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice tells the engine this is an outlet an aristocrats deck can use on demand, which is false - it can only ever be paid once, as this spell is cast.

kept.name: Hecatomb
kept.why: "Sacrifice this enchantment unless you sacrifice four creatures" is a real sacrifice effect and no word recorded it - only the tap-a-Swamp cost and the damage were written down.

kept.name: Foggy Swamp Hunters
kept.why: It conditionally gives itself lifelink and menace. The convention on this data is that a conditional keyword gets both the printed kw: word and a grants: word (Markov Crusader in the same batch has kw:haste plus grants:haste for the identical wording).

kept.name: Takklemaggot
kept.why: Only the 1 damage and the dies trigger were recorded. The card also puts a -0/-1 counter on the enchanted creature at every upkeep (counters, shrinking, and an upkeep trigger), and when that creature dies it returns ITSELF from the graveyard to the battlefield, which is self-recursion.

kept.name: Rishadan Pawnshop
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever. It taps for its cost and shuffles a permanent you control into its owner's library - a zone change into the library.

kept.name: Rakshasa Gravecaller
kept.why: It creates two 2/2 Zombie tokens and eff:create-token was missing entirely, which is the whole reason to play the card. Exploit is also a self-enters trigger and only the generic trig:enters was present.

kept.name: Bog Naughty
kept.why: The ability gives -3/-3 to a single target creature. Nothing here affects everything, and scope:all would make it read as a mass shrink effect.

kept.name: Scarecrow
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all. Its one ability costs {6} and {T} and prevents all damage from creatures with flying, so it genuinely does care about the flying keyword - it is a flying deterrent.

kept.name: Reaper of Night // Harvest Fear
kept.why: The attack trigger checks whether the defending player has two or fewer cards in hand, so this card really does read hand size - not just cause discard.

kept.name: Devout Decree
kept.why: It exiles a creature or planeswalker "that's black or red" and only cares:color:r was recorded. Half the hoser was missing.

kept.name: Festercreep
kept.why: Only the counter it enters with was recorded. The ability's cost is removing a +1/+1 counter, and its effect gives ALL other creatures -1/-1 - a repeatable sweeper for small creatures, which is the entire point of the card.

kept.name: Sadistic Skymarcher
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Vampire card from your hand or pay {1}" is a real cast-time cost and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Ravenous Demon // Archdemon of Greed
kept.why: "Transform this creature" had no effect word (only the printed kw:transform). The back face's trigger is specifically at the beginning of your upkeep, it sacrifices a Human as an effect, and if you can't it taps itself.

kept.name: Lightbringer
kept.why: It can only exile a BLACK creature - a colour hoser - and nothing recorded the colour it keys on.

kept.name: Atalya, Samite Master
kept.why: The card carried no effect word at all. Its one ability taps, and does either damage prevention or life gain.

kept.name: Cursed Flesh
kept.why: The enchanted creature gets -1/-1. It makes a creature smaller, not bigger; eff:pump would offer this Aura to a deck looking to grow its own creatures. Bog Naughty in this same batch correctly uses eff:shrink for -3/-3.

kept.name: Ondu Rising
kept.why: Granting lifelink to every attacking creature gains life, and it applies to any creature attacking this turn rather than a single target. Cast for its awaken cost it also puts four +1/+1 counters on a land you control and turns that land into a creature, which no word recorded.

kept.name: Paragon of Modernity
kept.why: The ability checks whether exactly three colours of mana were spent to activate it. That is precisely what cares:mana-spent records and it was absent.

kept.name: Vengeful Warchief
kept.why: "Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn" is a life-loss trigger and nothing in the list records what the trigger listens for.

kept.name: Goldmeadow Stalwart
kept.why: The additional cost to cast is revealing a Kithkin card from hand; the reveal cost is unrecorded.

kept.name: Survivor of Korlis
kept.why: The whole activated ability is played FROM the graveyard (exile this card from your graveyard). Nothing said the card operates from there.

kept.name: Force Bubble
kept.why: Three clauses were unread. It replaces damage dealt to you (prevention), it puts depletion counters on itself, and it removes all of them each end step. Only the end-step timing had been recorded.

kept.name: Bloodmist Infiltrator
kept.why: The payoff clause - it can't be blocked this turn - was missing entirely. scope:all is wrong: it sacrifices ONE other creature and makes ONE creature unblockable, it affects nothing globally.

kept.name: Soul Burn
kept.why: "Spend only black and/or red mana on X" and lifegain capped by "the amount of {B} spent on X" is exactly a card that cares which mana paid for it.

kept.name: Sustaining Spirit
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep. trig:step was recorded but not which step.

kept.name: Aether Inspector
kept.why: The attack trigger is "you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, create a Servo" - paying energy spends counters, and the whole clause is a pay-for-more effect. Neither was recorded (Die Young in this same batch already carries cost:remove-counters for paying {E}).

kept.name: Blight-Breath Catoblepas
kept.why: The entire card is "target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X" and no effect word was recorded at all - it read as a creature that does nothing.

kept.name: Yoke of the Damned
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and carried no attach word. eff:destroy-own is wrong: enchant creature is unrestricted and this is a removal aura pointed at an opponent's creature, not a card that destroys your own permanents.

kept.name: Infernal Reckoning
kept.why: It can only target a COLORLESS creature. That restriction is the card's defining property (Eldrazi hate) and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
kept.why: Fabricate 1 is "when this creature enters". Both effects were recorded and the trigger that causes them was not.

kept.name: Vectis Gloves
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+0. Only the attach was recorded, so the equipment read as doing nothing to the creature.

kept.name: Charge Across the Araba
kept.why: The bounce half was read and the payoff half was not: creatures you control get +1/+1 for each Plains returned.

kept.name: Tsabo's Assassin
kept.why: The destroy ability costs {T}. The tap cost was not recorded, so the repeatable removal reads as free.

kept.name: Necrotic Fumes
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile a creature you control" - the additional cost was unrecorded.

kept.name: Tower of Coireall
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and no tap cost was recorded.

kept.name: Bojuka Brigand
kept.why: "This creature can't block" was read as nothing. It also triggers on ITSELF entering ("whenever this creature or another Ally"), and only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Guan Yu, Sainted Warrior
kept.why: The death trigger shuffles him into his owner's library and no effect word was recorded - the card read as a trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Gryffwing Cavalry
kept.why: The attack trigger is "you may pay {1}{W}. If you do..." - an optional pay-for-more clause that was not recorded.

kept.name: Shrine of Boundless Growth
kept.why: Only the mana ability was read. The whole first line - a charge counter at the beginning of your upkeep AND whenever you cast a green spell - produced no trigger and no counter effect, so the card read as a rock rather than as something that grows.

kept.name: Revel Ruiner
kept.why: Connive is draw a card, then discard a card. Only the resulting +1/+1 counter was recorded; the draw and the discard were not.

kept.name: Redeem the Lost
kept.why: Granting protection from a chosen colour is a protection trick and no effect word said so. Clash also reveals and repositions the top card of a library.

kept.name: Dagger of the Worthy
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +2/+0; the afflict life loss was read but the pump was not.

kept.name: Urza's Engine
kept.why: The second ability gives attacking creatures banded with it trample. kw:trample is only its own printed keyword; the grant to other creatures was unrecorded.

kept.name: Green Ward
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and carried no attach word, and protection from green on your creature is a keep-it-alive effect.

kept.name: Heartstabber Mosquito
kept.why: The removal only happens "if it was kicked" - a pay-more-for-more clause, which is what this word is for.

kept.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
kept.why: Renown 1 puts the +1/+1 counter on ITSELF. Only the generic eff:add-counters was recorded, which reads as a card that grows other creatures.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Black
kept.why: The whole first ability is damage prevention and the list has only the cycling half (cost:discard-self, eff:draw). Nothing recorded that it prevents damage. Deliberately not adding cares:color:b - a hoser aimed at black is not a black-matters card, same as 'destroy target green creature' not being a green card.

kept.name: Case File Auditor
kept.why: 'When this creature enters and whenever you solve a Case, look at the top six cards of your library' - the ETB trigger and the library zone are both unrecorded; only eff:look-and-pick survived.

kept.name: Helicarrier Strike
kept.why: Teamwork is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, not an activated-ability cost. The vocabulary splits these everywhere (cost:cast-sacrifice/cost:sacrifice, cost:cast-discard/cost:discard, cost:cast-life/cost:life), and cost:tap-others is the activated form used correctly on Black Oak of Odunos in this same batch.

kept.name: Urza's Chalice
kept.why: rec:partial, and what was dropped is the entire effect: 'you may pay {1}. If you do, you gain 1 life.' The list records only that it watches artifact casts. Apothecary Initiate in this batch is the identical template and carries both words.

kept.name: Sigiled Sentinel
kept.why: Backup 1 reads 'When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature'. It is an ETB trigger and neither trigger word is on the card, so the counter and the vigilance grant appear to come from nowhere.

kept.name: Fodder Tosser
kept.why: '{T}, Discard a card:' is the activation cost. cost:tap is missing outright, and the discard is a COST, not an effect it inflicts - eff:discard-self would have it read as a card that makes you discard for value. Rune of Protection in this same batch uses cost:discard-self correctly for its cycling.

kept.name: Oracle en-Vec
kept.why: cost:tap is missing though {T} is the whole activation cost, and 'other creatures can't attack' is a real attack restriction the list does not mention. Not adding trig:step:end for the delayed destroy - that is a delayed trigger the ability creates, not an end-step-matters card.

kept.name: Vengeful Dreams
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard X cards' is precisely cost:cast-discard. eff:discard-self makes it read as a card that discards for value (a reanimator enabler) when the discard is the price of the exile.

kept.name: Phyrexian Totem
kept.why: Two of three abilities were unread (rec:partial). '{2}{B}: This artifact becomes a 5/5 ... artifact creature with trample' is an animation that grants itself trample, and 'sacrifice that many permanents' is a real sacrifice of your own board. Only the mana ability and the damage trigger were recorded.

kept.name: Angelic Favor
kept.why: 'you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay this spell's mana cost' is a cast cost paid by tapping other creatures, and nothing on the list says so. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile-own for 'Exile it at the beginning of the next end step' - that is a one-way drawback with no return, and eff:exile-own means a blink.

kept.name: Vampire's Zeal
kept.why: rec:partial, and the dropped clause is 'If it's a Vampire, it gains first strike until end of turn'. Only the +2/+2 was read.

kept.name: Culling Drone
kept.why: Ingest fills the exile zone, which is what the whole processor archetype is paid for, and the list records only cares:zone:library.

kept.name: Vengeful Villagers
kept.why: 'you may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do...' is a repeatable free sacrifice outlet, once per combat. eff:do-if-cost-paid records that a price exists but not that the price is eating your own permanents, which is the thing an aristocrats deck is looking for.

kept.name: Vial of Poison
kept.why: It grants deathtouch and changes no power or toughness. eff:pump is glossed 'pumps creatures' and would have this read as a combat trick that makes something bigger. grants:deathtouch already carries the real effect.

kept.name: Owlin Historian
kept.why: rec:partial - the third ability, 'this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn', is entirely absent. Not adding trig:leaves for the graveyard-leave trigger: that word's population reads as battlefield-leave (trig:leaves-self at 134 of 166) and I would rather leave it alone than mislabel the zone.

kept.name: Etched Host Doombringer
kept.why: rec:partial. It is a modal card ('choose one —') with no eff:choose, and the entire second mode - putting three defense counters on a battle or removing three - produced nothing. Only the drain mode was read.

kept.name: Agent Maria Hill
kept.why: The counter goes on HER and nowhere else ('put a +1/+1 counter on her'). eff:add-counters-self is already present and correct; the generic word alongside it is the exact misfile the -self split exists to prevent, where a card that grows itself reads as a counters-matters card. Moriok Rigger in this same batch carries only the -self word for the same shape.

kept.name: Extricator of Sin // Extricator of Flesh
kept.why: rec:partial, and the back face is almost unread. '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a non-Eldrazi creature: Create a 3/2 token' is a genuine repeatable sacrifice outlet with a tap cost, and neither cost word is present. The delirium clause transforms the permanent (eff:transform, kw:transform alone only says the card has a back face). The ETB 'you may sacrifice another permanent. If you do, create' is the do-if-cost-paid shape used on Vengeful Villagers.

kept.name: Infernal Rebirth
kept.why: Basic landcycling's cost is "{2}, Discard this card" - the card discards itself to activate, which every other cycling card in this batch records as cost:discard-self.

kept.name: Knight of Sursi
kept.why: Flanking gives the blocking creature -1/-1 until end of turn. That is a real shrink effect and nothing in the list records it.

kept.name: Lingering Death
kept.why: rec:partial and it shows: the Aura attaches to a creature (Enchant creature) and its whole payload is an end-step trigger, neither of which is written down.

kept.name: Mind Raker
kept.why: The processor clause moves an opponent's card from exile to their graveyard. Only the discard half was read. It genuinely cares about the exile zone - that is the whole cost of the trigger. Deliberately NOT col:none: devoid removes colour, not colour identity, and this card's identity is still black.

kept.name: Ghost-Lit Redeemer
kept.why: The channel ability's cost is "{1}{W}, Discard this card".

kept.name: Dire Fleet Interloper
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and either takes it or puts it back. The library interaction is unrecorded; only the counter half was read.

kept.name: Screeching Bat // Stalking Vampire
kept.why: The only thing this card does is "you may pay {2}{B}{B}. If you do, transform this creature" and neither the payment-gate nor the transform was recorded.

kept.name: Oriss, Samite Guardian
kept.why: Two whole abilities were unread. The first is "{T}: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature" - a tap cost and a damage prevention. Grandeur's cost is discarding ANOTHER card (cost:discard, not -self), and its effect stops spells AND stops attacking; only eff:cant-cast was recorded.

kept.name: Soul Echo
kept.why: The damage replacement (each 1 damage that would be dealt to you removes a counter instead) is a prevention effect and was unread. Deliberately did NOT add eff:sacrifice for the upkeep clause - it sacrifices ITSELF as a drawback and tagging it would make this read as a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Restless Bones
kept.why: Nothing on this card changes power or toughness. "Target creature gains swampwalk" is an evasion grant, already recorded as grants:swampwalk, and reading it as a pump would offer this card to a deck wanting pump effects.

kept.name: Weight of Conscience
kept.why: rec:partial - it is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and the attachment was never recorded.

kept.name: White Scarab
kept.why: rec:partial - it is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and the attachment was never recorded.

kept.name: Lash of Malice
kept.why: +2/-2 is a toughness reduction and this card is played as removal for a small creature. Only the +2 half was read.

kept.name: Paliano, the High City
kept.why: The land's only ability is "{T}: Add one mana of any color chosen..." and neither the tap cost nor the mana was recorded, so the engine currently believes this land produces nothing.

kept.name: Kami of the Honored Dead
kept.why: "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain that much life" - the trigger was recorded and the life gain was not. Soulshift 6 is a death trigger, and only its return half was read.

kept.name: Ramosian Commander
kept.why: The search does not go to hand - it puts the Rebel straight onto the battlefield, which is a different and much stronger thing than a tutor and is unrecorded.

kept.name: Ice Cauldron
kept.why: Only the mana was read. Both abilities cost {T}; the second costs removing a charge counter; the first puts a charge counter on this artifact; and the card exiles from your hand and lets you cast from exile, so both zones matter. Deliberately did NOT add eff:exile - that word confers the removal role and this exiles your OWN card from your own hand.

kept.name: Study Break
kept.why: Learn is either a Lesson to hand or discard-a-card-draw-a-card; either way it is card advantage and the list records only the tap half.

kept.name: Mournwhelk
kept.why: Evoke sacrifices this creature when it enters, which is what makes evoke creatures playable as one-shot fodder for death triggers. Nothing in the list says it eats itself.

kept.name: Noxious Vapors
kept.why: "Each player reveals their hand ... then discards all other nonland cards" is a symmetric mass discard, and neither the breadth nor the hand interaction was recorded - the list is two words long for a card that empties every hand in the game.

kept.name: Perimeter Enforcer
kept.why: rec:partial - the entire second line is "whenever another Detective you control enters ... this creature gets +1/+1", an enters-other trigger and a pump, and none of it is written down.

kept.name: Howling Banshee
kept.why: "Each player loses 3 life" hits everyone; the list records the life loss but not that it is symmetric.

kept.name: Ivory Cup
kept.why: The card's only payoff is "you may pay {1}. If you do, you gain 1 life" and neither the payment gate nor the life gain was recorded - the trigger was read and the effect after it was not.

kept.name: Aura Extraction
kept.why: Putting a target enchantment on top of its owner's library is a tuck, a real answer to a permanent, and the only effects listed are the cycling ones. Not eff:exile or eff:destroy - it does neither.

kept.name: Decaying Soil
kept.why: The threshold ability triggers on a nontoken creature being put into your graveyard from the battlefield, which is a dies trigger, and its return is gated on paying {1}. Deliberately did NOT add eff:exile-graveyard for the upkeep clause: it exiles from YOUR OWN graveyard as a cost, and that word means graveyard hate, which would file this graveyard-value enchantment as working against the decks that want it.

kept.name: Alabaster Leech
kept.why: The tax names white spells specifically, and the colour is the whole condition. Left scope:all off deliberately - it taxes only spells you cast, not everyone's, unlike Gloom.

kept.name: Rancid Earth
kept.why: The destroy is on ONE target land; the mass part is 1 damage to each creature and each player, which kills almost nothing and destroys no board. scope:wipe means the whole battlefield dies, yours too, and reading a land-destruction spell as a board wipe would make the anti-synergy check refuse it in go-wide decks for no reason. scope:all and eff:damage already carry the symmetric damage honestly.

kept.name: Serra Disciple
kept.why: 'this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn' is a pump and nothing recorded it. The trigger is 'whenever YOU cast a historic spell', so it is the own-cast trigger, not the bare one.

kept.name: Sibsig Icebreakers
kept.why: 'each player discards a card' is symmetric and hits everyone, including you. eff:discard alone reads as one-sided hand attack.

kept.name: Indestructible Aura
kept.why: Preventing all damage to a creature for the turn is the classic protection trick - it keeps your creature alive through removal and combat. eff:prevent-damage says the mechanism; eff:protect says the job, which is how a deck finds it.

kept.name: Descent into Madness
kept.why: Two clauses were unread: it puts a despair counter on ITSELF every upkeep (that counter is the whole engine), and 'each player exiles X permanents they control and/or cards from their hand' is symmetric across the table. Not scope:wipe - it exiles rather than destroys, and it does so one permanent at a time over many turns.

kept.name: Whetstone
kept.why: 'Each player mills two cards' is symmetric - your own library goes too. eff:mill alone reads as pointing at an opponent.

kept.name: Moonring Mirror
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all, only its two triggers. It exiles the top of your library on every draw and can exile your whole hand, then returns everything it holds to your hand. Deliberately NOT eff:exile: that word puts a card in the removal role, and this exiles only your own cards - eff:move-zone is the honest verb for library-to-exile-to-hand.

kept.name: Hixus, Prison Warden
kept.why: The card carried no trigger word. The ability fires when a creature deals combat damage to YOU, so the event is damage being received - a defensive punisher trigger. Not trig:deals-damage, which is used for a creature triggering off damage it deals (Toski, Rankle).

kept.name: Instill Infection
kept.why: A -1/-1 counter makes the creature permanently smaller and kills anything with one toughness. eff:add-counters is direction-blind - it reads the same as a +1/+1 counter - so nothing said this is an answer to a creature.

kept.name: Bargain
kept.why: 'TARGET OPPONENT draws a card' - you draw nothing. Leaving eff:draw makes a lifegain gift look like a draw spell. The 7 life is the only thing the card does for its controller and eff:gain-life already says so.

kept.name: Start // Finish
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature' was unread. That is the additional-cost sacrifice, distinct from a sacrifice outlet, and it is what makes the back half free fodder for an aristocrats deck.

kept.name: Daraja Griffin
kept.why: It destroys target BLACK creature - a colour hoser, and the colour is the whole restriction on the ability. Same treatment Freewind Falcon's protection from red already gets in this batch.

kept.name: Last Breath
kept.why: 'creature with power 2 or less' is a power check and nothing recorded it. The 4 life goes to the TARGET'S CONTROLLER, which is the opponent you are pointing at - it is the drawback, not a payoff, so eff:gain-life falsely offers this removal spell to a lifegain deck.

kept.name: Dueling Coach
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T}, which was unrecorded, and 'each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it' is a mass effect over your board rather than a single target.

kept.name: Tetravus
kept.why: Both halves of the engine were unread as costs: you remove +1/+1 counters from it to get tokens, and you exile its tokens to get the counters back. The card is a counter/token loop and nothing said it spends either resource.

kept.name: Festival
kept.why: 'Creatures can't attack this turn' is every creature on the battlefield, not a targeted one. eff:cant-attack alone reads like a single-creature lockdown.

kept.name: Crown of Awe
kept.why: Protection from BLACK and from red. cares:color:r is present and the black half was simply dropped, so half the hoser was invisible.

kept.name: Bargaining Table
kept.why: X is the number of cards in an OPPONENT'S HAND - the whole card is a hand-size check, and nothing recorded that it looks at hands.

kept.name: Scholar of Athreos
kept.why: 'Each opponent loses 1 life' hits the whole table, which is what makes it a drain rather than a single-target ping - and the life you gain scales with the number of opponents.

kept.name: Serpent Generator
kept.why: The ability costs {4} and {T}; the tap was unrecorded, so nothing knew this is a once-per-turn token engine rather than a repeatable one.

kept.name: Mage Tower Referee
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects more than itself - it puts a counter on ITSELF when you cast a multicolored spell. scope:all claims a mass effect that does not exist and would make a two-mana 1/1 read as a board-wide card.

kept.name: Wasteland Strangler
kept.why: The card had no effect word at all - only Devoid and its enters trigger. It processes a card an opponent owns from EXILE into their GRAVEYARD, then gives a creature -3/-3, which is real removal. All four zones and the shrink were missing, so a 3-mana removal creature read as doing nothing.

kept.name: Pestilent Souleater
kept.why: It gains INFECT until end of turn - no power or toughness changes, so eff:pump is false and would offer it to a deck looking for a pump effect. grants:infect already carries the real ability. {B/P} can be paid with 2 life, so the ability is genuinely activatable off life.

kept.name: Shieldhide Dragon
kept.why: 'put a +1/+1 counter on EACH OTHER Dragon creature you control' is a mass effect over your board - the tribal payoff - and it read as a single counter.

kept.name: Nightcreep
kept.why: It makes every creature black and every land a Swamp - a black-matters and swampwalk enabler, so the colour it names is the point of the card.

kept.name: Sorrow's Path
kept.why: The block-swapping ability costs {T} and that was unrecorded. It is also a land with no mana cost and no coloured symbols anywhere, so its colour identity is genuinely empty. Deliberately NOT eff:damage: the 2 damage hits YOU and YOUR OWN creatures, so recording it as damage would offer this to a deck looking for a burn effect - eff:damage-self already says it hurts you.

kept.name: Inventor's Goggles
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything. 'Whenever an Artificer you control enters, you may attach this Equipment to it' moves one Equipment onto one creature. scope:all claims a board-wide effect a one-mana Equipment does not have.

kept.name: Infinity Formula
kept.why: The equipped-creature clause is entirely unread. It gets +1/+2 (eff:pump) and is granted "Whenever this creature attacks, you gain 2 life" - a real attack trigger (trig:attacks) that gains life (eff:gain-life). Only the ETB attach was recorded.

kept.name: Zarda, the Power Princess
kept.why: "Other Heroes you control have exalted" is a keyword grant to other creatures and grants:exalted exists in the vocabulary. The list records who it looks at (cares:sub:hero) and nothing it does.

kept.name: Ogre Marauder
kept.why: On attack it gains "this creature can't be blocked" unless the defender sacrifices. The evasion half of the trigger was dropped; only the sacrifice half was recorded.

kept.name: Knight of Sorrows
kept.why: Afterlife 1 is a death trigger - "When this creature dies, create a 1/1 Spirit". eff:create-token and tok:spirit are there but nothing says when it happens.

kept.name: Tar Fiend
kept.why: Devour 2 is two unread clauses: you sacrifice any number of your own creatures (cost:sacrifice) and it enters with twice that many +1/+1 counters on itself (eff:add-counters-self). Only the ETB discard was read.

kept.name: Razor Golem
kept.why: Affinity for Plains reduces this spell's cost by {1} per Plains. Stratadon in the same batch carries eff:reduce-cost for the identical domain-style self-reduction, so this is an inconsistency rather than a judgement call.

kept.name: Hobble
kept.why: Two of the Aura's three lines are unread: "Enchanted creature can't attack" and "can't block if it's black". Only the ETB cantrip was recorded, so a removal-shaped Aura reads as a draw spell.

kept.name: Gauntlets of Chaos
kept.why: An exchange of control is two directions. eff:gain-control records the half where you take theirs; you also hand over your own artifact, creature or land, which is eff:give-control.

kept.name: Skulking Killer
kept.why: The card is marked rec:full and carries NO effect word at all. "Target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn" is eff:shrink - the same word Morkrut Banshee and Lurking Chupacabra get for the same clause.

kept.name: Veilborn Ghoul
kept.why: It returns ITSELF from the graveyard, which is eff:recur-self (Ashen Ghoul carries it for the same shape) - eff:return-from alone reads as generic recursion of other cards. "This creature can't block" is eff:cant-block-self and was unread. scope:all is wrong: the card has no mass effect, it triggers off one land entering.

kept.name: Master Skald
kept.why: "You may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do..." is an optional cost (cost:exile) gating the return - the eff:do-if-cost-paid template. Note this is your OWN graveyard as a cost, so eff:exile-graveyard would be wrong: this is not graveyard hate.

kept.name: Soul-Strike Technique
kept.why: Manifest puts the top card of your library onto the battlefield. The library interaction is unrecorded; the list only has the token and the pump.

kept.name: Faceless Devourer
kept.why: The leave-the-battlefield half returns the exiled card to the battlefield and was never written down; the card also parks a card in exile for as long as it lives.

kept.name: Leonin of the Lost Pride
kept.why: This is graveyard hate, not removal. It exiles a card from an opponent's graveyard, so it wants the graveyard-hate verb; plain eff:exile would make the engine offer it as an answer to a permanent.

kept.name: Smogsteed Rider
kept.why: It changes no power or toughness. It hands out fear, which grants:fear already says. eff:pump is the until-end-of-turn wording being mistaken for a stat boost.

kept.name: Clockwork Vorrac
kept.why: "remove a +1/+1 counter from it at end of combat" is half of what the card does and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Ballynock Cohort
kept.why: "as long as you control another white creature" is a genuine white-matters condition on your own board, not a hate clause.

kept.name: Mephitic Ooze
kept.why: The combat-damage trigger destroys the creature it hit. The trigger was recorded and its effect was not, so the card read as a pump with no payoff.

kept.name: Masticore
kept.why: The upkeep trigger makes you discard a card every turn (or lose the Masticore). Nothing recorded the discard.

kept.name: Drana's Silencer
kept.why: The whole enter trigger is -X/-X on an opponent's creature. The card carried a trigger and no effect at all.

kept.name: Jester's Scepter
kept.why: Only the counter half was recorded. It exiles the top five cards of a library and the counter ability is fed from those exiled cards, tapping to do it.

kept.name: Militant Angel
kept.why: The enter trigger makes Knight tokens and no token-making verb was present, only the Knight subtype care.

kept.name: Vulshok Gauntlets
kept.why: +4/+2 is the reason to play the Equipment and was not recorded. The untap drawback has no word at all.

kept.name: Omenport Vigilante
kept.why: It gives itself double strike conditionally, the same shape as Pouncing Lynx in this batch, which carries grants:first strike alongside its printed keyword.

kept.name: Seekers' Squire
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and decides from it. The counter was recorded, the library look was not.

kept.name: Iconic Shield
kept.why: +1/+2 was missing, and the granted ability triggers on attack, which is when the indestructible it already records actually happens.

kept.name: Soul Summons
kept.why: Manifest takes the top card of your library, so the card is library-facing as well as token-making.

kept.name: Boon of Emrakul
kept.why: +3/-3 is played as removal. Only the pump half was recorded, so the engine could not see it kills a small creature.

kept.name: Dystopia
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep pays 1 life per age counter, an escalating life cost that was not written down.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Blue
kept.why: The activated ability prevents damage and that is the whole card. Only the cycling half was recorded.

kept.name: Zulaport Enforcer
kept.why: At level 3 it can be blocked only by black creatures, which is evasion. Blue Scarab in this same batch carries eff:cant-be-blocked for the identical restriction wording.

kept.name: Waxmane Baku
kept.why: The ki counters it puts on itself were missing, and the trigger is specifically on spells YOU cast rather than any cast.

kept.name: Festival of the Guildpact
kept.why: Preventing the next X damage to you is the reason the card exists and only the cantrip was recorded.

kept.name: Sunscourge Champion
kept.why: Eternalize is a graveyard recursion mechanic: it brings the creature back as a token from the graveyard, paying by discarding a card and exiling itself. Only the token and copy outputs were recorded.

kept.name: Orzhov Pontiff
kept.why: The trigger fires on entering as well as on the haunted creature dying, and only trig:dies was recorded. It is also a modal "choose one", and haunt exiles the card itself when it dies.

kept.name: Warden of the Wall
kept.why: "During turns other than yours, this artifact is a 2/3 Gargoyle artifact creature with flying" turns a permanent into a creature and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Battering Ram
kept.why: It grants itself banding at beginning of combat, and the destroy clause triggers on becoming blocked by a Wall. Only the combat-step trigger and the destroy were recorded.

kept.name: Sadistic Slash
kept.why: Mayhem lets you cast this card from your graveyard. Nothing recorded that the graveyard is a live zone for it or that it brings itself back.

kept.name: Harmless Assault
kept.why: It prevents ALL combat damage from all attacking creatures, a global effect.

kept.name: Visionary Augmenter
kept.why: Fabricate 2 is "When this creature enters". The counters and the tokens were recorded but not that they happen on its own arrival, which is what makes it a blink target.

kept.name: Forbidden Ritual
kept.why: "loses 2 life unless that player sacrifices a permanent or discards a card" is a tax on the opponent and a discard, neither recorded.

kept.name: Volrath's Dungeon
kept.why: The second ability costs a discard and moves a card from a player's hand to the top of their library. Only the pay-5-life destroy clause was read.

kept.name: Illusionary Mask
kept.why: Its entire function is casting a creature card from your hand without paying its mana cost, and the list carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Horn of Plenty
kept.why: "they may pay {1}. If the player does, they draw a card" is a draw gated on paying; only the cast trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Mishra's Helix
kept.why: "{X}, {T}: Tap X target lands" and the list carried no effect and no tap cost.

kept.name: Demonic Hordes
kept.why: The upkeep clause taps this creature and sacrifices a land; only the activated land destruction was read.

kept.name: Hawkeye, Bowslinger
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. It puts a counter on itself and scries 1 off your own cast trigger.

kept.name: Stern Judge
kept.why: "Each player loses 1 life for each Swamp they control" is symmetric and global.

kept.name: Disturbing Plot
kept.why: Conspire taps two untapped creatures you control as an additional cost to cast. The copy was recorded but not what pays for it.

kept.name: Thirsting Shade
kept.why: Printed lifelink gains life, recorded on other lifelink creatures in this batch but not here.

kept.name: Kitesail Apprentice
kept.why: "it gets +1/+1 and has flying" while equipped. The flying was recorded, the stat boost was not.

kept.name: Transmogrifying Licid
kept.why: It becomes an Aura and attaches itself to a target creature for {1} and a tap, and the enchanted creature gets +1/+1. The list carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Whipgrass Entangler
kept.why: The granted ability is "can't attack or block unless its controller pays". The tax was recorded but not what it stops.

kept.name: Moonlit Strider
kept.why: Soulshift 3 is "When this creature dies, you may return target Spirit card...". The return was recorded but not that it triggers on death.

kept.name: Syphon Life
kept.why: Retrace casts this from the graveyard by discarding a land in addition to its other costs. None of the three was recorded.

kept.name: Order of the Stars
kept.why: "As this creature enters, choose a color." The choice was recorded but not that it happens on arrival.

kept.name: Cursed Land
kept.why: The damage is an upkeep trigger on the enchanted land's controller; the timing was not recorded.

kept.name: Famine
kept.why: 3 damage to each creature AND each player is a symmetric sweeper that kills your own board and hits your own life total. scope:all alone does not say it is bad for a go-wide deck.

kept.name: Magnanimous Magistrate
kept.why: "you may remove that many reprieve counters from this creature. If you do, return that card to the battlefield" - removing counters is the cost paid for the reanimation, and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Angry Mob
kept.why: Its power and toughness ARE EACH EQUAL TO a value - a characteristic-defining P/T set, which is eff:set-pt. It pumps no creature, so eff:pump is wrong and would read as a combat trick.

kept.name: Boneclad Necromancer
kept.why: "exile target creature card from a graveyard" - it reads a graveyard, which is the whole condition on its token, and no zone word was recorded.

kept.name: Steward of Solidarity
kept.why: The ability's cost is "{T}, Exert this creature". The tap in the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Baron Sengir
kept.why: Three whole clauses were unrecorded: the trigger is "whenever a creature ... DIES" (trig:dies), the counter goes on Baron Sengir himself (eff:add-counters-self, where only the generic word was present), and "{T}: Regenerate another target Vampire" is both a tap cost and a keep-it-alive effect.

kept.name: Clandestine Meddler
kept.why: Only the keyword names were recorded and none of what the card does. It surveils (eff:surveil), the second ability triggers on attack (trig:attacks), and suspect is defined on the card itself as granting menace and taking away blocking.

kept.name: Battle Brawler
kept.why: "As long as you control a red or white permanent" - the card's entire bonus is conditional on controlling those colours, which is a genuine colour condition rather than a word scan.

kept.name: Graven Abomination
kept.why: "exile target card from defending player's graveyard" is graveyard hate and the card carried no effect word at all - only the attack trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Rain of Daggers
kept.why: Nothing is paid to cast this: "You lose 2 life for each creature destroyed this way" happens on resolution, so cost:life is wrong. eff:lose-life added to match how the corpus already records self life loss, with the direction gap proposed separately.

kept.name: Park Bleater
kept.why: "Whenever another creature you own enters" is an others-enter trigger and neither trigger word was recorded, and the second ability's cost includes {T}.

kept.name: Sol Grail
kept.why: "{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color" - the tap cost on the mana ability was not recorded.

kept.name: Makindi Shieldmate
kept.why: "Whenever THIS CREATURE or another Ally you control enters" - it triggers on its own arrival as well as on others', and only trig:enters-other was recorded.

kept.name: Red Ward
kept.why: It is an Aura with "Enchant creature" and carries no attach word, unlike the other Auras in this batch.

kept.name: Sentinel
kept.why: The card carried no effect word at all. "Change this creature's base toughness to 1 plus the power of target creature" both sets a P/T and reads a creature's power.

kept.name: Razor Barrier
kept.why: "gains protection from artifacts or from the color of your choice" changes no power or toughness, so eff:pump is wrong. What it actually does is keep a permanent alive through removal or combat.

kept.name: Academic Probation
kept.why: Only the first mode's first half was recorded. It is modal ("Choose one"), and the entire second mode - "it can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated" - was missing. That mode is a Pacifism-shaped answer that leaves the permanent on the battlefield, which is what eff:neutralise names.

kept.name: Benediction of Moons
kept.why: "When the creature this card haunts DIES, you gain 1 life for each player" - the second lifegain has a death trigger and no trigger word was recorded.

kept.name: Coalition Flag
kept.why: An Aura with "Enchant creature you control" and no attach word.

kept.name: Liliana's Defeat
kept.why: "Destroy target BLACK creature or BLACK planeswalker" - the card only functions against black permanents, which is a genuine colour condition rather than an incidental mention.

kept.name: Gallant Pie-Wielder
kept.why: "This creature has double strike as long as ..." - it conditionally grants itself double strike, the same shape as Battle Brawler's grants:first strike in this batch, and only the printed keyword was recorded.

kept.name: Paupers' Cage
kept.why: "if that player has two or fewer cards in hand" - the whole card is a hand-size punisher and nothing recorded that it reads hands.

kept.name: Jötun Grunt
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep. Only the generic trig:step was recorded. (eff:exile-graveyard left alone deliberately: it bottoms rather than exiles, but the card is graveyard hate and that is what the word is read as.)

kept.name: Honorable Passage
kept.why: "prevent that damage" is the card's primary effect and was entirely missing - only the redirect half was recorded. "a source of your choice" is also a choice on resolution.

kept.name: Charmed Clothier
kept.why: The card carried no effect words at all. It creates a token, that token comes in attached to a creature, and the Role's reminder text on the card grants +1/+1.

kept.name: Keeper of the Dead
kept.why: The cost is "{B}, {T}" and the tap was not recorded. The activation condition compares creature cards in graveyards, so the card genuinely reads graveyards.

kept.name: Draugr's Helm
kept.why: The ETB makes a 2/2 Zombie Berserker token and neither that nor the optional 'pay {2}{B}, if you do' payment gate is recorded. Only the equip half of the card was read.

kept.name: Grisly Sigil
kept.why: Casualty is an additional cost paid as you CAST the spell, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice tells an aristocrats deck this is a free sac outlet, which it is not.

kept.name: Gaze of Pain
kept.why: The unblocked creature deals damage EQUAL TO ITS POWER. That is the scales-with-power shape (damage off power), which nothing on the list says.

kept.name: Nettling Imp
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T} and cost:tap was missing. The compulsion to attack has no word at all.

kept.name: Castigate
kept.why: The card's whole effect is exiling a nonland card out of an opponent's hand and eff:exile is absent, so the list says only that it looks at a hand. Note this is exile, not discard, so eff:discard would be wrong.

kept.name: Powder Keg
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and sacrificing the Keg itself, and it destroys EACH artifact and creature at that mana value rather than a single target. All three were missing. Not scope:wipe: the mana-value restriction means it is not a whole-board destroy.

kept.name: Pus Kami
kept.why: Soulshift is a death trigger ('when this creature dies, you may return target Spirit card'). eff:return-from is recorded but the trigger that fires it is not.

kept.name: Ebony Horse
kept.why: Half the ability is 'prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn' and no word records it. Only the untap was read.

kept.name: Swooping Protector
kept.why: It enters with a shield counter ON ITSELF. The generic verb is what makes a card read as a counters-matters payoff; the -self word is the one that exists to keep those apart.

kept.name: Task Force
kept.why: The card's only ability is 'whenever this becomes the target of a spell or ability, it gets +0/+3'. Neither the pump nor the targeting trigger was recorded, leaving a bare trig:cast that says nothing. Hero of the Pride, the same shape, carries trig:cast:targeting.

kept.name: Mourning
kept.why: The enchanted creature gets -2/-0. That is making a creature smaller, not pumping it, and as tagged the card reads as a buff aura when it is a debuff.

kept.name: Arbalest Elite
kept.why: The ability's cost is {2}{W}, {T} and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit
kept.why: The end-step trigger transforms the creature, and its condition is 'if you gained 3 or more life this turn', which is a genuine lifegain-matters check rather than a word scan. kw:transform records the printed keyword; nothing recorded that the card actually does the transforming.

kept.name: Darksteel Brute
kept.why: '{3}: This artifact becomes a 2/2 Beast artifact creature' is the card's only ability and nothing on the list expresses it. As tagged it is an indestructible blank.

kept.name: Poisoner's Apprentice
kept.why: The ETB gives target creature an opponent controls -4/-4. The condition (cares:lifegain) was recorded but the effect itself was not, so the card does nothing as far as the engine can see.

kept.name: Floating Shield
kept.why: Both halves keep a creature alive: the aura grants protection from a chosen colour and sacrificing it grants protection to any creature until end of turn. grants:protection records the keyword; eff:protect is what says the card's job is keeping your creatures alive.

kept.name: Duskmantle Operative
kept.why: 'Can't be blocked by creatures with power 4 or greater' is the card's entire text and the list is empty of it. Black Scarab, the same conditional-evasion shape, carries eff:cant-be-blocked.

kept.name: Ballroom Brawlers
kept.why: The attack trigger gives this and one other creature first strike or lifelink, and NONE of that is recorded. The list currently says only that something happens when it attacks.

kept.name: Hollow Specter
kept.why: The combat damage trigger is 'you may pay {X}. If you do...' and the optional payment gate is not recorded, so the card reads as unconditional discard.

kept.name: Wall Off
kept.why: 'This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature your opponents control' is a real clause and nothing records it. The token and lifegain were read, the cost reduction was not.

kept.name: Vraska's Scorn
kept.why: The card searches your library and graveyard for a named card and no search word is present, so only the life loss was read.

kept.name: Gleam of Resistance
kept.why: Basic landcycling's cost is {1}{W} plus discarding this card, and the discard cost is missing. Fade from Memory, the same cycling shape, carries cost:discard-self.

kept.name: Blood Host
kept.why: The ability sacrifices one other creature and puts a counter on itself and gains 2 life. Nothing here affects everything, so scope:all is a false positive that reads this as a mass effect.

kept.name: Parasitic Grasp
kept.why: The whole first clause is 'deals 3 damage to target [Human] creature' and no damage word was recorded. Only the lifegain half of the card was read.

kept.name: Inquisitor's Ox
kept.why: 'This creature gets +1/+0' is a power/toughness change and had no pump word. Same shape as Ardent Recruit in this batch, which does carry eff:pump for a conditional static bonus.

kept.name: Abuna Acolyte
kept.why: Both abilities prevent damage and both cost {T}, and neither eff:prevent-damage nor cost:tap was recorded. The card's entire function was missing from its list.

kept.name: Tallowisp
kept.why: The trigger is 'whenever YOU cast a Spirit or Arcane spell', which is the own-cast split, not the bare trig:cast it currently carries alone.

kept.name: Gutwrencher Oni
kept.why: 'Discard a card if you don't control an Ogre' makes you discard, and no discard word was recorded. The upkeep trigger was read and its effect was not.

kept.name: Daru Spiritualist
kept.why: 'It gets +0/+2 until end of turn' is a pump and was missing. The trigger was read and the effect it produces was not.

kept.name: Hundred-Battle Veteran
kept.why: 'This creature gets +2/+4' is a power/toughness change with no pump word. Only the graveyard-cast half of the card was read.

kept.name: Forlorn Pseudamma
kept.why: 'You may pay {2}{B}. If you do, create a token' is the optional-cost shape and was not recorded, so the token looks unconditional.

kept.name: Estwald Shieldbasher
kept.why: The card gains indestructible and never changes power or toughness. grants:indestructible already says what it does; eff:pump is a false positive from reading a keyword grant as a stat change.

kept.name: Leonin Den-Guard
kept.why: 'It gets +1/+1' while equipped is a power/toughness change and no pump word was recorded, though the vigilance half was.

kept.name: Kyren Toy
kept.why: The mana ability's cost is 'Remove X charge counters from this artifact'. The counter-adding half was read and the counter-spending half, which is how the card actually makes mana, was not.

kept.name: Kindly Stranger // Demon-Possessed Witch
kept.why: '{2}{B}: Transform this creature' is an activated transform and no effect word records it. kw:transform is the printed keyword, not the thing the ability does.

kept.name: Traveling Plague
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets -1/-1 for each plague counter, which is shrink and not pump. The last line returns this Aura from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield, which is a self-recursion out of the graveyard, and the trigger for it is another permanent leaving the battlefield.

kept.name: Skyreach Manta
kept.why: Sunburst reads 'a +1/+1 counter for each color of mana spent to cast it', which is exactly the mana-spent word. The counters were recorded but not what sizes them.

kept.name: Abyssal Hunter
kept.why: 'Deals damage equal to its power' scales with power, and that scaling was not recorded.

kept.name: Ancient Vendetta
kept.why: It searches the opponent's graveyard, hand AND library and exiles from all three, so a plain eff:exile belongs beside eff:exile-graveyard. The graveyard zone it hates was the one zone not listed, while hand and library both were.

kept.name: Unnatural Hunger
kept.why: 'At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller' is an upkeep trigger and neither step word was recorded, so the card reads as having no trigger at all.

kept.name: Eye of Singularity
kept.why: The second ability triggers on any other permanent entering, not on itself, and both destroy clauses hit every permanent sharing a name across all players.

kept.name: Sparkhunter Masticore
kept.why: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card' is a cast-time discard cost and was unrecorded. The {3} ability gains indestructible and changes no stats, so eff:pump is a keyword grant misread as a stat change.

kept.name: Enlistment Officer
kept.why: Reveal the top four, keep the Soldiers, bottom the rest is precisely look-and-pick. The trigger was read and the selection it performs was not.

kept.name: Transgress the Mind
kept.why: The chosen card is exiled, not discarded, and no exile word was recorded. Deliberately not adding col:none: devoid removes the card's colour but its colour identity is still black from the {B} in its cost.

kept.name: Guardians' Pledge
kept.why: It pumps only WHITE creatures you control, so the colour restriction is load-bearing and was unrecorded. Same shape as Hellfire in this batch, which does carry cares:color:b for 'nonblack'.

kept.name: Knight of Dawn
kept.why: {W}{W} grants protection from a colour of your choice - that is a protection effect, not a power/toughness boost. Nothing on this card changes P/T, so eff:pump is unsupported.

kept.name: Rusted Relic
kept.why: Metalcraft turns this artifact into a 5/5 Golem artifact creature. Turning a permanent into a creature is exactly eff:animate; only eff:set-pt was recorded, which says the size and not that it becomes a creature at all.

kept.name: Ruthless Disposal
kept.why: The discard and the sacrifice are ADDITIONAL COSTS TO CAST, not an on-demand outlet and not an effect. cost:sacrifice would advertise this sorcery as a sacrifice outlet an aristocrats deck can use repeatedly, which it is not.

kept.name: Mobile Fort
kept.why: {3}: gets +3/-1 until end of turn. The only real effect on the card was not recorded at all - the list held nothing but the printed defender keyword.

kept.name: Traitor's Clutch
kept.why: +1/+0 was missed entirely. Shadow is evasion: the creature can be blocked only by creatures with shadow, so in practice it is unblockable, which is what eff:cant-be-blocked names.

kept.name: Juntu Stakes
kept.why: It applies to every creature with power 1 or less on every battlefield, so scope:all is warranted; the untap lock itself is unsayable.

kept.name: Angelic Protector
kept.why: "Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability" is precisely trig:cast:targeting, and the +0/+3 it gives itself was not recorded. The bare trig:cast left says a spell was cast and not that this card is the target.

kept.name: Trueheart Duelist
kept.why: Embalm is paid by exiling this card FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD to make a token copy of it. The list recorded the token and the copy but nothing about the graveyard the ability is played from, so the card looks like it does nothing after it dies.

kept.name: Demonic Appetite
kept.why: It is an Aura, so it attaches to a creature. Nothing on it affects everything: the buff is on one enchanted creature and the upkeep clause sacrifices one creature, so scope:all is a false positive.

kept.name: Lyev Decree
kept.why: Detain is three effects and the list held only the printed keyword and the mana value. Detained creatures cannot attack, cannot block, and their activated abilities cannot be activated, so the engine could not offer this card as interaction of any kind.

kept.name: Angelic Voices
kept.why: The pump is live only while you control no nonwhite, nonartifact creatures - the card genuinely checks the colour of your board, which is what cares:color:w is for.

kept.name: Haunting Wind
kept.why: It triggers on ANY artifact becoming tapped or having an ability activated, by any player, and damages that artifact's controller. It is a symmetric board-wide tax, not a targeted effect.

kept.name: Karfell Kennel-Master
kept.why: Granting indestructible to two creatures until end of turn keeps them alive through a wipe or removal spell. grants:indestructible names the keyword; eff:protect is what makes the card findable as protection.

kept.name: Echo Chamber
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as {4}, it creates a token that is A COPY of a creature, and that token gains haste. Only eff:create-token was recorded, so the card read as a generic token maker rather than a clone.

kept.name: Genju of the Fields
kept.why: Three whole clauses missing: it is an Aura (attaches), {2} turns the enchanted Plains into a 2/5 creature (animate), and when that land hits the graveyard you may return THIS CARD from your graveyard to your hand, which is self-recursion and the whole reason the Genju cycle is played.

kept.name: Gravebind
kept.why: The card destroys nothing. "Target creature can't be regenerated this turn" is a rider that stops a regeneration shield; reading it as removal would let the engine fill a removal slot with a card that cannot kill anything.

kept.name: Brightspear Zealot
kept.why: +2/+0 was not recorded. The condition is spells YOU have cast this turn, so trig:cast-own is the precise word - a bare trig:cast does not distinguish a spellslinger payoff from a card that watches an opponent.

kept.name: Walking Wall
kept.why: {3}: gets +3/-1 until end of turn. Same omission as Mobile Fort - the only effect on the card was absent and the list held nothing but the printed defender keyword.

kept.name: Twisted Experiment
kept.why: It is an Aura and attaches to a creature; only the P/T change was recorded.

kept.name: Ashnod's Cylix
kept.why: The list held nothing but the mana value and the activation cost. The ability taps, looks at the top three cards of a library, keeps one and exiles the other two - a library-attacking exile effect the engine could not see at all.

kept.name: Merciless Eternal
kept.why: Afflict 2 is "whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player loses 2 life". eff:lose-life was recorded but not what causes it, so the card did not read as a combat-damage-style payoff.

kept.name: Ulna Alley Shopkeep
kept.why: Infusion gives it +2/+0 while you have gained life this turn. cares:lifegain records the condition and nothing recorded the effect.

kept.name: Wasp of the Bitter End
kept.why: The optional cost is sacrificing THIS creature, which is cost:sacrifice-self and was missing. Nothing here affects everything - it destroys one target creature - so scope:all is a false positive.

kept.name: Syndicate Messenger
kept.why: Afterlife 1 triggers when this creature dies. The token was recorded but not the death trigger, so an aristocrats deck looking for creatures that pay off on dying could not find it.

kept.name: Siegecraft
kept.why: It is an Aura that enchants a creature, so it attaches to one. Only the +2/+4 was recorded.

kept.name: Absolver Thrull
kept.why: The ability reads 'When this creature enters OR the creature it haunts dies' and only the dies half was recorded, so the enters trigger is missing entirely. Haunt also exiles the card itself when it dies.

kept.name: Brackish Trudge
kept.why: '{1}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand' is exactly a creature bringing itself back from the graveyard; the generic eff:return-from does not say it returns itself.

kept.name: Orzhov Racketeers
kept.why: Afterlife 2 is a death trigger that makes the two Spirit tokens. eff:create-token was recorded but the trigger that produces it was not, so nothing marks this as an aristocrats/death payoff.

kept.name: Crypt Creeper
kept.why: It exiles a card from a graveyard, so it reads and acts on the graveyard zone. The exile verb is there but the zone it cares about is not.

kept.name: Remove Enchantments
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread. It returns your own enchantments and Auras from the battlefield to your hand, and it then destroys your OWN enchantments and Auras as well as opponents'. Not eff:bounce-own, which is deliberately narrowed to creatures returning to hand and these are enchantments.

kept.name: Measure of Wickedness
kept.why: 'Whenever another card is put into your graveyard from anywhere' is the card's second ability and nothing recorded that it watches the graveyard.

kept.name: Wandering Graybeard
kept.why: The kinship trigger ends 'you gain 4 life' and no lifegain word was recorded at all. The whole payoff of the card was missing.

kept.name: Shambling Swarm
kept.why: Only the dies trigger was recorded and none of what it does. It distributes three -1/-1 counters among up to three creatures (counters put on things, and creatures made smaller) and then removes those counters at the next end step.

kept.name: Mogg Cannon
kept.why: The last sentence, 'Destroy that creature at the beginning of the next end step', destroys a creature you control and was not recorded. It is the drawback that defines the card.

kept.name: Sheer Drop
kept.why: The whole awaken half was unread: three +1/+1 counters on a land you control, and that land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste.

kept.name: Dauntless Cathar
kept.why: Its only ability is activated from the graveyard ('Exile this card from your graveyard'), so it is a graveyard card and nothing said so.

kept.name: Corrupted Roots
kept.why: It is an Aura enchanting a land, so it attaches to a permanent. Only the life loss was recorded.

kept.name: Dawnfluke
kept.why: The entire enters ability, 'prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn', produced no effect word. The card carried a trigger with nothing on the end of it.

kept.name: Frightcrawler
kept.why: The threshold clause was unread: it gets +2/+2 and it can't block. Both halves are the whole reason to play the card.

kept.name: Yixlid Jailer
kept.why: It exiles nothing. 'Cards in graveyards lose all abilities' is a static shutdown, and calling it an exile tells the engine it removes cards from graveyards, which it does not. It does read graveyards, so the zone word is right.

kept.name: Pegasus Stampede
kept.why: The land sacrifice is buyback, an additional cost paid as you cast the spell, not a repeatable sacrifice outlet on a permanent. cost:sacrifice would offer this to an aristocrats deck as a way to sacrifice creatures on demand, which it cannot do.

kept.name: Coalition Skyknight
kept.why: Enlist adds the tapped creature's power to this creature's until end of turn, which is a power boost. Only the tap cost and the attack trigger were recorded.

kept.name: Desperate Sentry
kept.why: The delirium clause gives it +3/+0 and was not recorded; only the death trigger and token were.

kept.name: High-Flying Ace
kept.why: The activated ability specifically targets a creature WITHOUT flying, so the card reads the flying keyword. Marginal, and the rest of the list is correct.

kept.name: Vengeful Archon
kept.why: The whole first half of the ability is "Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to you" and nothing recorded that it prevents damage. eff:redirect-damage covers the second half only.

kept.name: Gemini Engine
kept.why: "Sacrifice the token at end of combat" was unrecorded. Archdemon of Unx in this same batch carries eff:sacrifice for sacrificing your own creature, so this is the consistent word.

kept.name: Dragon Bell Monk
kept.why: Prowess triggers on spells YOU cast. The generic trig:cast is present but does not say whose cast, which is the same self/other distinction the vocabulary draws everywhere else.

kept.name: Virtue's Ruin
kept.why: This is a black hoser that destroys white creatures. Destroying a thing is not caring about it - the same fault as "destroy target artifact" becoming an artifacts card. Left in place it tells the engine this is a white-matters payoff. Deliberately NOT adding scope:wipe: it is a colour-filtered wipe, and filtered wipes (Hour of Reckoning, Olivia's Wrath, Elspeth) are correctly refused that word.

kept.name: Malakir Soothsayer
kept.why: "You draw a card and you lose 1 life" is a draw engine paying a small price, not a drain spell.

kept.name: Spinning Darkness
kept.why: The alternative cost - exiling the top three black cards of your own graveyard - was entirely unrecorded, so nothing knew this is a card you cast for free out of a stocked graveyard. cost:cast-exile is the cast-time member of the cost family (alongside cost:cast-sacrifice, cost:cast-life).

kept.name: Searing Light
kept.why: "with power 2 or less" is a power condition and the card carries no power word.

kept.name: Crowd of True Believers
kept.why: "gets +1/+0 until end of turn" was unrecorded; only the incidental 1 life was.

kept.name: Corpse Traders
kept.why: The cost is "Sacrifice a creature", which eats something ELSE on demand - that is cost:sacrifice, already present, and it makes this a real sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice-self means a card that eats only itself once, which this is not, and carrying both says two contradictory things.

kept.name: Underworld Charger
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a whole printed line with nothing recorded for it.

kept.name: Razortip Whip
kept.why: The activation cost is "{1}, {T}" and the tap was dropped. Without it nothing knows this needs to be untapped, and it reads as a repeatable free ping.

kept.name: Runeforge Champion
kept.why: It searches library AND graveyard - neither zone was recorded - and the second line, "You may pay {1} rather than pay the mana cost for Rune spells you cast", is a cost reduction that was entirely unread.

kept.name: Final Strike
kept.why: Both halves of the card were missing: the additional cost is sacrificing a creature (so this is a sacrifice payoff, not a burn spell), and the damage is equal to that creature's power.

kept.name: Twinning Glass
kept.why: Only acost:2, col:none and type:artifact were recorded - nothing about what it does. It taps, it casts a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.

kept.name: Ragged Recluse // Odious Witch
kept.why: The back face's only ability triggers on attacking and no attack trigger was recorded, so the drain reads as untethered to combat. NOT adding eff:transform: at 14 cards that word is plainly reserved for transforming OTHER permanents, and kw:transform already covers a card flipping itself.

kept.name: Faceless One
kept.why: "If Faceless One is your commander, choose a color before the game begins" is a genuine commander-zone card and carried no commander word.

kept.name: Minion Missile
kept.why: The additional cost - sacrifice a creature or discard a card - was unrecorded, and it is the reason this card is played in a sacrifice deck rather than as a plain removal spell. Both options need their word.

kept.name: Clockwork Gnomes
kept.why: The {T} in the activation cost was dropped. eff:protect because regenerating a target keeps a creature alive, which is what that word means, and the card had no effect word at all - kw:regenerate is a printed keyword and says nothing about who benefits.

kept.name: Choking Fumes
kept.why: A -1/-1 counter on each attacking creature is a combat trick that kills X/1s. With only eff:add-counters it reads as a counters-matter card of the +1/+1 sort; eff:shrink is what says it makes creatures smaller and is what marks it as interaction.

kept.name: Beloved Beggar // Generous Soul
kept.why: "If Generous Soul would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead" - a self-exile replacement with nothing recorded for it.

kept.name: Advance Scout
kept.why: The ability grants first strike and changes no power or toughness. grants:first strike is already present and is the true word; eff:pump is a plain factual error.

kept.name: Courageous Outrider
kept.why: The card looks at the top four and puts one in HAND, putting the rest on the bottom. Nothing is ever exiled, so cares:zone:exile is false, and eff:impulse specifically means exiling off the top to play the cards - reading it here files a white tribal tutor as a red impulse-draw card. eff:look-and-pick, already present, is exactly right.

kept.name: Never Happened
kept.why: It exiles from the graveyard and carried no graveyard zone word. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile even though it also hits the hand: eff:exile-graveyard exists precisely so graveyard hate is not read as creature removal, and adding the general verb would undo that split.

kept.name: Origin of Captain America
kept.why: Chapter II creates an Equipment token and no token-making word was recorded, so two thirds of the Saga was read and the middle chapter was not.

kept.name: Green Scarab
kept.why: It is an Aura that enchants a creature and carried no attach word, so nothing knew it goes on a creature - kw:enchant and sub:aura are printed facts, not behaviour.

kept.name: Brace for Impact
kept.why: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn" is a protection trick that saves a creature from removal or combat. eff:prevent-damage records the mechanic; eff:protect records that it keeps a creature alive, which is the job the card does.

kept.name: Rank Officer
kept.why: "You may discard a card. If you do, create a 2/2 Zombie" is an optional payment for a bonus, which is exactly what eff:do-if-cost-paid describes. Everything else on the card is already read.

kept.name: Marketwatch Phantom
kept.why: The trigger is "whenever ANOTHER creature you control enters", which is trig:enters-other and not merely the base trig:enters - the split matters because a card triggering on other creatures arriving is a go-wide payoff, not a self-ETB card. It also reads power ("with power 2 or less"), which cares:power records.

kept.name: Failed Conversion
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets -4/-4" makes a creature SMALLER. eff:pump is the opposite claim and files this aura as an enhance card when it is removal - a permanent -4/-4 kills most creatures in the format.

kept.name: Chieftain en-Dal
kept.why: "Attacking creatures gain first strike" changes no power or toughness. grants:first strike is the whole effect. Compare Marketwatch Phantom, which grants flying only and correctly carries no eff:pump, against Dance of Shadows, which does give +1/+0 and correctly does.

kept.name: Infernal Pet
kept.why: The counter goes on this creature and nowhere else, so eff:add-counters-self is the right word and the generic verb reads it as a Hardened Scales deck - the same flattening the -self split exists to prevent. Black Mana Battery in this same batch correctly carries only the -self form. Nothing on the card affects everything, so scope:all is a misread too.

kept.name: Powerstone Engineer
kept.why: "When this creature dies, create a tapped Powerstone token" - the card's entire effect is making a token and the word was missing outright.

kept.name: Copper Carapace
kept.why: Only the equip machinery was read. "Equipped creature gets +2/+2" is eff:pump and "and can't block" is eff:cant-block - the drawback that separates this from every other cheap Equipment.

kept.name: Plague Fiend
kept.why: Only the trigger was read. "Destroy that creature unless its controller pays {2}" is a real destroy effect and a real tax, which is why the card is rec:partial with no verb describing what it actually does.

kept.name: Black Mana Battery
kept.why: The second ability's cost is "Remove any number of charge counters from this artifact". The charge counters going on are recorded; spending them is not.

kept.name: Goldmeadow Lookout
kept.why: The activation cost is "{W}, {T}, Discard a card". Neither the tap nor the discard was recorded as a cost, so nothing marks this as a spellshaper - a repeatable discard outlet, which is the reason a graveyard deck plays it.

kept.name: Mardu Outrider
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card" is a cast cost, not an effect. cost:cast-discard is the precise word and is what tells a madness or graveyard deck this card feeds it.

kept.name: Seraph of New Capenna // Seraph of New Phyrexia
kept.why: Only the printed keywords were read; both faces' abilities were skipped. Front: "{4}{B/P}: Transform this creature" is eff:transform. Back: "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, this creature gets +2/+1" is a trigger, a genuine sacrifice outlet that eats OTHER permanents, an optional payment, and a pump.

kept.name: Liu Bei, Lord of Shu
kept.why: "Liu Bei gets +2/+2 as long as you control..." is a conditional self-pump. Griffin Rider in this same batch has the identical shape and correctly carries eff:pump; Liu Bei's clause was left unread, which is why he is rec:partial.

kept.name: Heart of Light
kept.why: Preventing all damage dealt BY the enchanted creature turns it into something harmless without destroying it - a Pacifism variant. eff:prevent-damage alone records the mechanic but leaves the card serving no role, when it is a removal aura.

kept.name: Enemy of Enlightenment
kept.why: "Each player discards a card" includes you, so the effect is symmetrical - eff:discard alone reads it as one-sided, and scope:all is what says it hits everyone. The static ability counts cards in opponents' hands, so the card genuinely looks at hands.

kept.name: Jeskai Student
kept.why: Prowess triggers on spells YOU cast. The bare trig:cast cannot tell a spellslinger payoff from a stax card that punishes opponents casting, which is the distinction the -own split exists for.

kept.name: Seize the Soul
kept.why: "When the creature this card haunts dies, destroy target creature. Create a Spirit token." - the haunt half is a death trigger that repeats the whole spell, and no trigger word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Ring of Immortals
kept.why: The ability costs "{3}, {T}" and the tap symbol was never recorded. Every other tap-activated card in this batch (Whetwheel, Infantry Veteran, Copper-Leaf Angel, Tezzeret's Simulacrum) carries cost:tap.

kept.name: Helica Glider
kept.why: "Enters with your choice of a flying counter or a first strike counter on it" puts counters on itself and nothing recorded the counter placement. Matches Emblazoned Golem and Ursine Fylgja in this same batch, which both emit eff:add-counters-self for an enters-with clause.

kept.name: Agent of Atlas
