kept.why: Prowess is "whenever YOU cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1". The pump was never recorded, and trig:cast is the undirected word - prowess is unambiguously your own cast, which is what trig:cast-own says.

kept.name: Daring Skyjek
kept.why: Battalion grants itself flying until end of turn. Every other "gains <keyword> until end of turn" card in this batch carries eff:pump alongside the grants: word - Twilight Panther, Scuttling Butler, Trespasser il-Vec, Garrison Griffin, Kinsbaile Balloonist. This one was missed.

kept.name: Mire Blight
kept.why: "When enchanted creature is dealt damage, destroy it" is a trigger on being dealt damage and no trigger word was recorded at all - the card looked like an unconditional destroy.

kept.name: Erebos's Titan
kept.why: "Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" brings itself back. Only eff:return-from was recorded, which is the generic word and does not say the card recurs ITSELF. Grixis Slavedriver in this batch carries both.

kept.name: Unconventional Tactics
kept.why: The Zombie trigger returns THIS card from the graveyard to hand, which is self-recursion and the whole reason the card is played in a Zombie deck. Only the generic eff:return-from was recorded.

kept.name: Coalition Honor Guard
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever - only cares: words - so the engine knows what it looks at and nothing about what it does. Forcing opponents to aim their targeted spells and abilities at this creature is how it keeps your other permanents alive, which is what eff:protect means. The precise word is missing from the vocabulary and is proposed below.

kept.name: Ursine Fylgja
kept.why: Two whole clauses were unread. "Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to this creature" is the card's entire purpose and no prevention word was recorded, and "Remove a healing counter from this creature:" is an activation cost. Only the counter-adding half of the card was written down.

kept.name: Deathless Ancient
kept.why: "Return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is self-recursion - the card's only ability and the reason it is played. Only the generic eff:return-from was recorded.

kept.name: Alabaster Wall
kept.why: The entire activated ability was unread. "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to any target" gives both the tap cost and the prevention effect, and the card carried neither - it read as a plain Defender body.

kept.name: Artifact Ward
kept.why: Three of the four components of protection from artifacts are printed on this card: can't be blocked by artifact creatures, all damage from artifact sources prevented, and can't be targeted by abilities from artifact sources. Only the blocking and damage halves were recorded, so nothing said the enchanted creature is being shielded.

kept.name: Alms Beast
kept.why: "Creatures blocking or blocked by this creature have lifelink" is the card's only ability and it carried no effect word at all - just pt:big and its type line. Deliberately NOT adding eff:gain-life: the lifelink is granted to whatever is fighting it, including the opponent's creatures, so the life gain is not yours.

kept.name: Militia Rallier
kept.why: "This creature can't attack alone" is a restriction on itself and nothing records it. The untap trigger is already there.

kept.name: Seafarer's Quay
kept.why: It grants "bands with other legendary creatures" to your blue legends. That is a banding variant and the only thing the card does; the list records who it looks at and not what it gives.

kept.name: Orzhov Euthanist
kept.why: The ability triggers on TWO events - "when this creature enters OR the creature it haunts dies" - and only the dies half was written down. Haunt also exiles the creature itself when it dies.

kept.name: Kithkin Zephyrnaut
kept.why: The kinship payoff is "+2/+2 and gains flying and vigilance". Only the flying third was recorded; the pump and the vigilance were dropped.

kept.name: Shimian Specter
kept.why: It searches graveyard, hand and library and exiles every copy. Nothing but the hand reveal was written down. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: that word files a card as creature removal, and this is extraction, which is why eff:exile-graveyard exists separately (Cranial Extraction in this same batch is recorded that way).

kept.name: Tormentor's Trident
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and the pump was never recorded, so the Equipment reads as attaching to a creature and doing nothing to it. The "attacks each combat if able" half still has no word - see propose.

kept.name: Ghoulsteed
kept.why: "Discard two cards" is part of the activation cost and no cost word records it. Left eff:discard-self alone since you do end up discarding.

kept.name: U.S.Agent, John Walker
kept.why: The whole card is "create an Equipment token and attach it", and neither the token nor the attach was recorded - only that it enters and that it looks at Equipment.

kept.name: Abomination
kept.why: "Destroy that creature at end of combat" is the entire payoff and no effect word was recorded at all; only the two block triggers were.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Artifacts
kept.why: The only ability on the card prevents damage and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Lashknife Barrier
kept.why: The damage reduction applies to every creature you control, not to one target. Same shape as Parapet and Silver Seraph in this batch, both of which carry scope:all for a "creatures you control" static.

kept.name: Repeat Offender
kept.why: Suspecting itself gives it menace and stops it blocking. Only the counter half of the ability was recorded.

kept.name: Nyxborn Eidolon
kept.why: Bestow makes it an Aura with enchant creature, so it genuinely attaches to a creature; the pump is recorded but not the fact that it hangs off a creature.

kept.name: Orim, Samite Healer
kept.why: The card has exactly one ability, "{T}: Prevent the next 3 damage", and NEITHER half was recorded - no effect and no tap cost.

kept.name: Launch Party
kept.why: It destroys ONE target creature. Nothing about the card affects everything; the sacrifice is an additional cast cost and is already recorded correctly.

kept.name: Down for Repairs
kept.why: "Destroy up to one target Attraction" was dropped entirely; only the discard half was recorded.

kept.name: Rouse
kept.why: "You may pay 2 life rather than pay this spell's mana cost" is an alternative cast cost paid in life and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Debtors' Transport
kept.why: Afterlife triggers when the creature dies. The token creation is recorded but the trigger that causes it is not, so nothing connects the card to a sacrifice or aristocrats deck.

kept.name: Triassic Egg
kept.why: Sacrificing itself is the cost of the whole payoff and was missing; the ability is modal ("choose one"); and the first mode puts a creature from your HAND onto the battlefield, which was not recorded in any form.

kept.name: Bloodcrazed Hoplite
kept.why: Every effect on the card is single-target - a counter on itself, then remove a counter from one target creature an opponent controls. Nothing affects everything.

kept.name: Takeno's Cavalry
kept.why: The {T} in the activated ability was never recorded as a tap cost. Bushido 1 is a real triggered ability - whenever it blocks or becomes blocked it gets +1/+1 - and none of the trigger or the pump was written down.

kept.name: Crystal Rod
kept.why: The whole payoff of the card - you gain 1 life - was missing. It watches specifically for BLUE spells, and the 'you may pay {1}. If you do' shape is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Vampirism
kept.why: 'Other creatures you control get -1/-1' is a real downside clause the list did not carry at all. The pump on the enchanted creature was recorded and the shrink on everything else was not.

kept.name: Protective Parents
kept.why: The card literally creates a Role token and creates it attached to a creature, and neither was written down - only the +1/+1 counter from the Role's granted text made it into the list.

kept.name: Pattern Matcher
kept.why: It searches your library and then shuffles. eff:search-library was recorded but the library zone and the shuffle were not.

kept.name: Thousand Moons Crackshot
kept.why: 'you may pay {2}{W}. When you do, tap target creature' is the pay-for-more shape; the tap was recorded but the optional cost was not.

kept.name: Spinal Parasite
kept.why: The ability's EFFECT removes a counter from target permanent - only the cost side (cost:remove-counters) was recorded. Sunburst counts colours of mana spent to cast it, which is cares:mana-spent.

kept.name: Sinister Strength
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets +3/+1' is the entire card and no effect word at all was recorded for it.

kept.name: Witch's Mist
kept.why: The activated ability costs {2}{B} and {T}; the tap in the cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Shrine of Limitless Power
kept.why: Only the sacrifice ability was read. The first line is two triggers - your upkeep, and whenever you cast a black spell - and both put a charge counter on the Shrine itself, none of which was written down.

kept.name: Deadly Wanderings
kept.why: It applies only when you control EXACTLY ONE creature, and only that creature gets the bonus. That is the opposite of a board-wide effect, so scope:all tells the engine something false.

kept.name: Deicide
kept.why: The second sentence searches graveyard, hand and library and exiles the cards it finds. Hand was recorded; graveyard and library were not, and exiling cards out of a graveyard is genuine graveyard hate.

kept.name: Clear the Stage
kept.why: The recursion clause is gated on controlling a creature with power 4 or greater, which is a real power check the list did not carry.

kept.name: Sengir Bats
kept.why: The trigger is a creature DYING and nothing recorded that. The counter goes on this creature itself, so the -self form was missing too.

kept.name: Ramosian Rally
kept.why: 'you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay this spell's mana cost' is an alternative cost paid by tapping your own creatures, and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Crovax the Cursed
kept.why: 'If you don't, remove a +1/+1 counter from Crovax' was unrecorded - the ability takes counters off as well as putting them on. 'you may sacrifice a creature. If you do' is the pay-for-more shape. Nothing on this card affects everything, so scope:all is wrong.

kept.name: Cavalry Master
kept.why: 'Other creatures you control with flanking have flanking' is a grant and no grants word was recorded. Flanking itself gives the blocking creature -1/-1, which is a shrink the list did not carry.

kept.name: Vampiric Embrace
kept.why: The counter trigger fires when a damaged creature DIES; the death trigger was never recorded, only the counter it produces.

kept.name: Oni Possession
kept.why: It buffs one enchanted creature and makes you sacrifice one creature each upkeep. Nothing here reaches the whole board.

kept.name: Horizon Seed
kept.why: The trigger is specifically on spells YOU cast, which the generic trig:cast does not say, and it watches the stack.

kept.name: Diamond Kaleidoscope
kept.why: The token ability costs {3} and {T}; the mana ability costs sacrificing a Prism token. Neither cost was recorded, so the card reads as free tokens and free mana.

kept.name: Soul Strings
kept.why: 'unless any player pays {X}' is the tax clause that defines the card and no word covered it.

kept.name: Mosquito Guard
kept.why: Reinforce is paid by discarding this card. The counter it gives was recorded; the discard cost was not.

kept.name: Tendrils of Despair
kept.why: It hits target OPPONENT, one player. The additional cost sacrifices one creature. Neither clause is board-wide.

kept.name: Legion's End
kept.why: It exiles cards from hand AND graveyard - graveyard was missing while eff:exile-graveyard was already there, which was inconsistent. No library is touched anywhere on this card, so cares:zone:library is a false read.

kept.name: Consul's Shieldguard
kept.why: "you may pay {E}. If you do" is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid and was unread. The indestructible goes on ANOTHER target attacking creature, so this genuinely keeps your creatures alive - unlike the self-regenerators in this batch, which I deliberately left without eff:protect.

kept.name: Circling Vultures
kept.why: Only the upkeep timing was read. It exiles the top creature card of your graveyard as the price of staying alive (cost:exile, and it plainly cares about the graveyard), and it can discard itself at instant speed, which is the whole reason the card is played. I used cost:exile rather than eff:exile-graveyard on purpose: it eats YOUR graveyard, so filing it as graveyard hate would make it read as anti-synergy in the decks that want it.

kept.name: Pious Interdiction
kept.why: Only the 2 life was read. "Enchanted creature can't attack or block" is the entire card and produced nothing, so a Pacifism was invisible as removal.

kept.name: Identity Crisis
kept.why: It exiles the graveyard AND the hand; only the graveyard half was recorded.

kept.name: Cursed Courtier
kept.why: The ETB creates a token and attaches it, and none of that was written down. The Role sets the creature to 1/1, which is eff:set-pt.

kept.name: Pyrrhic Revival
kept.why: The mass reanimation was read but the additional -1/-1 counter on every returned creature was not.

kept.name: Skyhunter Cub
kept.why: It gets +1/+1 while equipped. Only the granted flying was recorded.

kept.name: Join the Maestros
kept.why: Casualty is an additional cost paid as you cast: sacrifice a creature. The copy effect was read, the cost that buys it was not.

kept.name: Circle of Confinement
kept.why: The whole second ability was unread - an opponent casting a Vampire spell naming a card exiled with this gains you 2 life. That is a cast trigger watching opponents, referencing the exile zone.

kept.name: Scepter of Fugue
kept.why: A repeatable discard engine points at a hand; Identity Crisis in this same batch carries cares:zone:hand for the same reason.

kept.name: Brass Man
kept.why: "you may pay {1}. If you do, untap this creature" - the untap was read, the optional payment gating it was not.

kept.name: Unholy Citadel
kept.why: The card's only function is granting an ability to your black legendary creatures, and no grants word was present.

kept.name: Soul Spike
kept.why: The pitch cost - exile two black cards from hand instead of paying {5}{B}{B} - is why anyone plays this, and it was entirely unread.

kept.name: Zombie Cannibal
kept.why: Only the combat damage trigger was read. Exiling a card from the damaged player's graveyard is asymmetric graveyard hate, which is the card's whole effect.

kept.name: Sword of the Ages
kept.why: The ability taps and sacrifices any number of OTHER creatures you control; only the self-sacrifice was recorded, so it did not read as a sacrifice outlet at all.

kept.name: Mishra's War Machine
kept.why: "unless you discard a card" and "tap it" were both unread - the damage to you was the only clause that landed.

kept.name: Astrolabe
kept.why: "Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep" is a delayed upkeep trigger; the draw was recorded but its timing was not.

kept.name: Lapis Lazuli Talisman
kept.why: Triggers specifically on a BLUE spell being cast, and the colour is the whole condition. The other cares:color words are present on comparable cards; this one was simply dropped.

kept.name: Stench of Evil
kept.why: "deals 1 damage to that land's controller unless they pay {2}" is a tax on the opponent and nothing in the list said so.

kept.name: _____ _____ Rocketship
kept.why: "This Vehicle gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each name sticker" is a pump and the whole attack trigger was recorded as a bare trig:attacks with no effect.

kept.name: Isolation Zone
kept.why: An O-Ring: the exile lasts "until this enchantment leaves the battlefield", so the card genuinely does something on leaving. Only the enters half was recorded.

kept.name: Phantom Nomad
kept.why: Half the card was unread. "If damage would be dealt to this creature, prevent that damage" is prevention, and "Remove a +1/+1 counter" takes counters off - the list had only the counters going on.

kept.name: Court Homunculus
kept.why: "gets +1/+1 as long as you control another artifact" is a static buff, the same shape as Holy Armor's "Enchanted creature gets +0/+2" which does carry eff:pump. The list recorded the artifact condition and not the effect it produces.

kept.name: General Jarkeld
kept.why: The ability's cost is "{T}:" and no cost word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Perilous Predicament
kept.why: "Each opponent sacrifices an artifact creature and a nonartifact creature" is a mass edict hitting every opponent, not a single sacrifice.

kept.name: Manaforce Mace
kept.why: "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each basic land type" is the entire card and only the attaching was recorded.

kept.name: Catacomb Dragon
kept.why: The -X/-0 is a shrink and was missing entirely. trig:blocks is the wrong event: this triggers when it BECOMES BLOCKED while attacking, it never blocks, and the pair says it is a defensive card.

kept.name: Clockwork Condor
kept.why: "remove a +1/+1 counter from it at end of combat" takes counters off, which is the point of the card, and only the counters going on were recorded.

kept.name: Silverquill Apprentice
kept.why: Magecraft was recorded as a bare trig:cast with no effect: "target creature gets +1/+0" is a pump. The trigger is on spells YOU cast and names instant and sorcery specifically, all three of which the vocabulary can say.

kept.name: Ondu War Cleric
kept.why: Its only ability is "{T}, Tap an untapped Ally you control: You gain 2 life". Nothing here affects everything - cost:tap-others already carries the tapping.

kept.name: War Barge
kept.why: The second sentence was completely unread: "When this artifact leaves the battlefield this turn, destroy that creature." That is a leaves trigger and a destroy, and it is the reason anyone plays the card.

kept.name: Reinforced Bulwark
kept.why: Its one activated ability - "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you" - produced neither a cost word nor an effect word.

kept.name: Commander Greven il-Vec
kept.why: "When Commander Greven il-Vec enters, sacrifice a creature" is one creature, yours. eff:sacrifice already says it; scope:all reads it as a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Wall of Caltrops
kept.why: "this creature gains banding until end of turn" was not recorded. And it has defender, so it can never attack and can never become blocked - the trigger is "whenever this creature blocks", which trig:blocks already covers.

kept.name: Hour of Glory
kept.why: The card touches no graveyard and no library. It exiles a creature, then exiles same-named cards from the controller's HAND - cares:zone:hand is already there and is correct. eff:exile-graveyard is graveyard hate and this is not that.

kept.name: Stillmoon Cavalier
kept.why: "Protection from white AND from black". cares:color:w is already recorded for the white half and the black half was dropped, so the record is asymmetric about one printed line.

kept.name: Benalish Faithbonder
kept.why: Enlist "add its power to this creature's until end of turn" is a pump and no effect word was recorded. cares:kw:haste is a scan of the reminder phrase "without summoning sickness" - the card names no keyword and is not a haste-matters card.

kept.name: Split-Tail Miko
kept.why: Its only ability, "{W}, {T}: Prevent the next 2 damage", produced no cost word and no effect word - the card currently reads as doing nothing.

kept.name: Flunk
kept.why: "X is 7 minus the number of cards in that creature's controller's hand" - the card is a hand-size payoff and the list recorded only the shrink.

kept.name: Hand of Justice
kept.why: "Destroy target creature" is one target. cost:tap-others already carries "Tap three untapped white creatures you control"; nothing about this affects everything.

kept.name: Prismatic Ward
kept.why: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to enchanted creature by sources of the chosen color" is the card. Only the colour choice was recorded, so the aura read as doing nothing at all.

kept.name: Grim Javelineer
kept.why: "target attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn" is a pump and nothing recorded it; only the surveil half was read.

kept.name: Ornate Kanzashi
kept.why: The entire activated ability was unread. It taps as a cost, and exiling the top card of a library to play it this turn is exactly impulse draw. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile: that word confers the removal role and this is card advantage, not an answer.

kept.name: Strength of Isolation
kept.why: "Enchanted creature gets +1/+2" is unrecorded; only the protection half was read.

kept.name: Sorin's Guide
kept.why: The whole enters trigger was unread. It is a tutor that searches both library and graveyard and puts the card into hand, so it is also graveyard recursion.

kept.name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
kept.why: The only ability on the card produced no facet at all. Combat damage that would hit you being dealt to this creature instead is precisely eff:redirect-damage.

kept.name: Humble the Brute
kept.why: "target creature with power 4 or greater" is a power condition and cares:power was missing.

kept.name: Fodder Cannon
kept.why: It deals 4 damage to ONE target creature. Nothing about the card affects everything, so scope:all is false and would make it read as a sweeper.

kept.name: Scarab of the Unseen
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the sacrifice, and only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Excavator
kept.why: The whole ability was unread apart from the sacrifice cost. It taps, and granting landwalk grants evasion (the printed reminder says the creature can't be blocked).

kept.name: Profit // Loss
kept.why: The Loss half gives opponents' creatures -1/-1 and only the Profit half's pump was read.

kept.name: Skirsdag Supplicant
kept.why: "Each player loses 2 life" is symmetrical and hits everyone; the drain was recorded without its scope.

kept.name: Necrosavant
kept.why: It returns itself and sacrifices one creature. Nothing on the card affects everything.

kept.name: Sivvi's Ruse
kept.why: Only the bare prevention was read. It can be cast without paying its mana cost, it prevents ALL damage to all creatures you control, and keeping your creatures alive is what eff:protect names.

kept.name: Debilitating Injury
kept.why: -2/-2 makes a creature smaller. This is a removal aura, and eff:pump makes it read as a creature buff, which is the opposite of what it does.

kept.name: Horn of Deafening
kept.why: The only ability on the card produced no facet at all. It taps and prevents all combat damage from a creature.

kept.name: Hornet Cannon
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and that was unrecorded. The delayed "destroy it at the next end step" is left alone deliberately: it is the token's own drawback, and trig:step:end would make this read as an end-step-matters card.

kept.name: Feast or Famine
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and the modality was unrecorded.

kept.name: Stirring Honormancer
kept.why: The whole enters trigger was unread. Looking at the top X and taking one is exactly eff:look-and-pick, and putting the rest into your graveyard is self-mill.

kept.name: Blinding Beam
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal spell and only the tap mode was read.

kept.name: Kraul Swarm
kept.why: It returns ITSELF from the graveyard, which is eff:recur-self (the same shape as Necrosavant). eff:bounce-own means returning your own creatures from the battlefield to hand and would put this in a blink or bounce deck, which is wrong. scope:all is false: nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Paladin of Prahv
kept.why: Both halves of the card gain you life and the effect was entirely missing; only the trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Path of Peace
kept.why: The life goes to the destroyed creature's OWNER, which is normally the opponent. This is a removal spell with a drawback, not a lifegain card, and the word would offer it to lifegain decks as a payoff.

kept.name: Professor of Symbology
kept.why: Learn is unread. Outside a Lessons sideboard the only live mode is "discard a card to draw a card", which is a rummage: it draws and it makes you discard. The list records the keyword and nothing it does.

kept.name: Xathrid Slyblade
kept.why: The activated ability grants first strike AND deathtouch; only grants:deathtouch was written down. It does not gain hexproof, it loses it, so nothing is added there.

kept.name: Magitek Infantry
kept.why: "gets +1/+0 as long as you control another artifact" is a pump and is entirely absent. Only the search half of the card was read.

kept.name: Genju of the Fens
kept.why: Two whole clauses missing. It turns a Swamp into a 2/2 creature (eff:animate), and its last line returns THIS CARD from your graveyard to your hand every time the land dies, which is self-recursion, not just a generic return.

kept.name: Facevaulter
kept.why: It pumps only itself, off a sacrifice cost. Nothing about it affects everything; scope:all here is the untargeted selector "a Goblin" being misread as a mass effect.

kept.name: Kemuri-Onna
kept.why: Its two effects are "target player discards a card" and returning itself to hand. Neither is mass. scope:all reads off the broad "a Spirit or Arcane spell" trigger filter and tells the engine the card affects the whole board, which it never does.

kept.name: Alabaster Dragon
kept.why: The death trigger is unrecorded: it shuffles itself from the graveyard into the library. That is a zone move and a shuffle. Not eff:recur-self - it goes to the library, not back to play.

kept.name: Lunar Avenger
kept.why: Sunburst counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, which is exactly what cares:mana-spent says and nothing else in the list expresses.

kept.name: Vengeful Vampire
kept.why: Undying returns this creature to the battlefield from the graveyard. eff:return-from is generic; the fact that it brings ITSELF back is the thing a sacrifice deck is looking for.

kept.name: Kalastria Nightwatch
kept.why: Its whole card is "whenever you gain life". trig:gains-life records the trigger but nothing records that this is a lifegain-matters payoff, which is what cares:lifegain exists for.

kept.name: Goldmane Griffin
kept.why: Only the two printed keywords and the trigger were read. The entire ETB - search library AND graveyard for a card and put it into your hand - produced no effect word at all.

kept.name: Minister of Pain
kept.why: Exploit is half read. It is an enters-the-battlefield trigger that sacrifices a creature (neither the trigger nor the sacrifice effect is recorded), and the -1/-1 clause triggers on that sacrifice. Only the payoff's eff:shrink survived.

kept.name: Silverquill Pledgemage
kept.why: Magecraft is barely read. It grants lifelink as well as flying (grants:flying alone is recorded), and the trigger is specifically on YOU casting an instant or a sorcery, which is what a spellslinger deck keys off. The generic trig:cast says none of that.

kept.name: Royal Decree
kept.why: It punishes "a Swamp, Mountain, black permanent, or red permanent" - the red half is recorded and the black half is not. Cumulative upkeep also triggers at the beginning of your upkeep, so the bare trig:step is under-specified.

kept.name: Illuminated Folio
kept.why: An activated ability that reveals two cards and draws one. It affects nothing but you; scope:all is a false positive off the untargeted "two cards that share a color".

kept.name: Gangrenous Zombies
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as sacrificing itself, and only the sacrifice was recorded. (Deliberately not marked scope:wipe - 1 to 2 damage to each creature is not a board wipe.)

kept.name: Glory Bearers
kept.why: The card's only ability gives an attacking creature +0/+1 and NO effect word was recorded for it - the list has the trigger and the scope but nothing saying what happens.

kept.name: Pitiless Vizier
kept.why: It gains indestructible and no grants: word records it, so nothing can see this as a protection effect.

kept.name: Machine Man, Model X-51
kept.why: Both halves of the trigger - a counter and flying - are on Machine Man alone. scope:all comes off the broad "a noncreature spell" filter and wrongly claims a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Covenant of Blood
kept.why: Convoke was not recorded at all (compare Will-Forged Golem, which carries cost:cast-tap-others for the same keyword). cares:color:b is a word scan - most likely off the name "Blood" or convoke's reminder text - and nothing on this card cares about black.

kept.name: Grind // Dust
kept.why: The front half literally puts -1/-1 counters on two creatures and no counter-placing verb was recorded; eff:shrink alone says the creatures get smaller but not that counters were the means, which is what a counters deck reads. Aftermath casts the second half from the graveyard, which is the same claim disturb and escape make, and Covert Cutpurse in this same batch already carries eff:recur-self for disturb.

kept.name: Agency Coroner
kept.why: Nothing on this card affects everything. The whole text is a single activated ability that sacrifices ONE other creature and draws. scope:all almost certainly leaked from the 'another creature' selector, and it makes a one-shot sacrifice outlet read as a mass effect.

kept.name: Drana's Chosen
kept.why: Cohort taps this creature and ONE untapped Ally to make one token. There is no group selector anywhere on the card. Same leak as Agency Coroner: an 'a/another <thing> you control' cost being read as a mass scope.

kept.name: Caprichrome
kept.why: Devour artifact 1 ends with 'it enters with that many +1/+1 counters on it'. cost:sacrifice records the price and nothing records what is bought, so a card that grows itself off sacrificed artifacts reads as a sacrifice outlet that does nothing.

kept.name: Syndicate Guildmage
kept.why: 'Tap target creature with power 4 or greater' is an explicit power comparison, which is exactly what cares:power names. The card is a hoser aimed at big creatures and nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Umezawa's Charm
kept.why: It opens with 'Choose one —' and the three modes are recorded as if all three happen. eff:choose is the word for a card that lets you pick which effect you get, and every other charm-shaped card needs it to be told apart from a card that does all three.

kept.name: Ambulatory Edifice
kept.why: The list records only that it enters, and nothing at all about what happens. It gives a creature -1/-1 (eff:shrink), the trigger is gated on paying 2 life (cost:life), and the 'you may pay ... When you do' shape is precisely eff:do-if-cost-paid. As it stands the engine reads this as a vanilla body with an empty ETB.

kept.name: MACH-1, Swooping Scoundrel
kept.why: 'When MACH-1 enters AND whenever you gain life, surveil 1' - both triggers were dropped, so a two-mana lifegain payoff reads as a flier that surveils for no stated reason. trig:gains-life and cares:lifegain are what put it in the deck it belongs to; Doctor Jane Foster in this same batch already carries cares:lifegain for a weaker lifegain reference.

kept.name: Covert Cutpurse // Covetous Geist
kept.why: The back face reads 'If Covetous Geist would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead' - it exiles itself, which is the whole reason disturb cannot be reused. Nothing recorded it, and eff:exile-self is the exact word for that replacement.

kept.name: Carnophage
kept.why: Its entire text is an upkeep payment of 1 life every turn, and the list records only that something happens at upkeep. cost:life is the one word that says what the card actually asks of you; without it the card carries no effect facet at all.

kept.name: Conversion
kept.why: Two of the three things this card does were unrecorded. 'Sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay {W}{W}' is cost:sacrifice-self, and 'All Mountains are Plains' is a genuine mass effect, so scope:all belongs. The land-type change itself has no word at all, hence the proposal.

kept.name: Dread of Night
kept.why: 'White creatures get -1/-1' makes creatures SMALLER. eff:pump is the wrong direction and is the more damaging error of the two - it files a black anti-white hoser as a creature-pump card, so a go-wide deck could be offered a card that shrinks its own board only if it is white. eff:shrink is the word this vocabulary keeps for negative modification.

kept.name: Pooling Venom
kept.why: This is an Aura you put on somebody else's land: it drains its controller when it taps and then blows it up. eff:destroy-own says the card destroys YOUR permanents, which inverts the card. eff:destroy is already present and is the correct reading; keeping both makes it look like a self-sacrifice piece as well as removal.

kept.name: Loxodon Partisan
kept.why: Battle cry is 'whenever this creature attacks, each OTHER attacking creature gets +1/+0'. The attack trigger was recorded and the effect it causes was not, so a go-wide anthem-on-a-stick reads as a vanilla 3/3 that triggers on attack and does nothing. The group selector earns scope:all on the same footing as Gerrard's Battle Cry in this batch.

kept.name: Baneblade Scoundrel // Baneclaw Marauder
kept.why: Both faces give each blocking creature -1/-1 and nothing recorded the -1/-1 at all - the whole reason the card is played. The night face adds 'whenever a creature blocking this creature dies, that creature's controller loses 1 life', so trig:dies is a second missing trigger; eff:lose-life is already there with no trigger to explain it. I deliberately did NOT add scope:all here: 'each creature blocking it' plus eff:shrink could be misread as a board sweeper.

kept.name: Hieromancer's Cage
kept.why: 'exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls UNTIL THIS ENCHANTMENT LEAVES THE BATTLEFIELD' is the O-Ring shape, and the leave half was not recorded. It matters in play: the exile is conditional and the card giving the permanent back is a real, exploitable event. I left eff:return-from off on purpose, since it would file a removal spell as recursion.

kept.name: Dragon Mask
kept.why: The ability ends 'Return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step' - it returns YOUR OWN creature to hand, which is half the card and is what makes it a blink-adjacent enabler rather than a pump artifact. eff:bounce-own is the exact word.

kept.name: Fruit of Tizerus
kept.why: Every facet of escape was dropped except the bare keyword. It is cast from your graveyard (cares:zone:graveyard, eff:recur-self, matching how disturb is recorded on Covert Cutpurse in this batch) and its additional cost exiles three other cards from that graveyard (cost:exile). Without them a recursive drain spell reads as a one-shot two-point drain with no graveyard relevance at all.

kept.name: Roiling Horror
kept.why: Its only real ability triggers while the card is EXILED under suspend ("Whenever a time counter is removed from this card while it's exiled"), so the exile zone is where this card lives and works. Nothing recorded that.

kept.name: Prakhata Pillar-Bug
kept.why: The card changes no power or toughness at all - it only grants lifelink, already covered by grants:lifelink. Armory Guard, a pure keyword grant, correctly carries no eff:pump, so this is a false positive that would file a lifelink enabler as a combat trick.

kept.name: Cabal Patriarch
kept.why: Both abilities read "Target creature gets -2/-2" - one creature, chosen. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Noggin Whack
kept.why: Word scan off the prowl reminder text ("if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with a Rogue"). It is a sorcery with no attack trigger of any kind. Morsel Theft, the same prowl shape, correctly lacks it.

kept.name: Soulblade Corrupter
kept.why: Partner with is an ENTERS trigger - "When this creature enters, target player may put Soulblade Renewer into their hand from their library, then shuffle." The tutor was recorded (eff:search-library) but the trigger that causes it was not, and the library is the zone it reaches into.

kept.name: Puncturing Light
kept.why: "with power 3 or less" is a power check. Bring Down in this same batch carries cares:power for "power 4 or greater"; this is the identical shape read the other way.

kept.name: Soul-Guide Gryff
kept.why: It exiles a card FROM a graveyard, so it interacts with that zone. Yawgmoth's Agenda carries both eff:exile-graveyard and cares:zone:graveyard; this card had only the effect.

kept.name: Pulse of the Dross
kept.why: "return Pulse of the Dross to its owner's hand" - the card buys itself back, which is the whole reason to play it as a repeatable discard spell. Three facets recorded and that clause was not one of them.

kept.name: Thran Lens
kept.why: "All permanents are colorless" is as global as an effect gets, and the card had no effect word at all - three facets, none of them describing what it does.

kept.name: Morsel Theft
kept.why: "If this spell's prowl cost was paid, draw a card" is exactly a bonus conditional on having paid a cost.

kept.name: Undercity Necrolisk
kept.why: It sacrifices one other creature and puts a counter on itself. Two single permanents, nothing mass.

kept.name: Memoricide
kept.why: It exiles from hand and LIBRARY as well as the graveyard, so eff:exile-graveyard alone understates it. It searches a graveyard, which the zone words did not record (hand and library were both there). And "Choose a nonland card name" is a genuine choice the card makes you make. Deliberately NOT adding eff:search-library: that would file a stax card as a tutor.

kept.name: Night Terrors
kept.why: Two facets recorded and neither says what the card does. "Exile that card" is its entire effect. Note it exiles rather than discards, so eff:discard would be wrong here.

kept.name: Death of a Thousand Stings
kept.why: "you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is the card bringing itself back, which is the definition of the word. Generic eff:return-from was there but does not say it is self-recursion.

kept.name: Yawgmoth's Agenda
kept.why: Two of its three lines were unread. "You may play lands and cast spells from your graveyard" is casting from the graveyard, not merely playing lands from it. And "You can't cast more than one spell each turn" is a real casting restriction - the drawback that defines this card.

kept.name: Beacon of Destiny
kept.why: Four facets and not one described the card. Its only ability redirects damage that would hit you onto itself, and it costs {T} to do it.

kept.name: Kitsune Palliator
kept.why: Three facets, none of them the card. "Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to each creature and each player" is damage prevention, it is genuinely global, and the ability costs {T}.

kept.name: Leonin Iconoclast
kept.why: "destroy target enchantment creature an opponent controls" is one creature, and explicitly restricted to an opponent. The opposite of affecting everything.

kept.name: Mourning Patrol // Morning Apparition
kept.why: The back face reads "If Morning Apparition would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead" - it exiles itself. That clause was unrecorded.

kept.name: Marsh Casualties
kept.why: Kicker: "If this spell was kicked, those creatures get -2/-2 instead." A bigger effect for paying more, which is precisely what the word is for.

kept.name: Rag Man
kept.why: The ability costs {B}{B}{B} and {T}. The tap was not recorded, so nothing knew this is a once-per-turn engine rather than a repeatable one.

kept.name: Krovikan Horror
kept.why: It returns ITSELF from your graveyard to your hand every end step, which generic eff:return-from does not say. And scope:all is wrong: "deals 1 damage to any target" is a single ping, not a board effect.

kept.name: Circle of Affliction
kept.why: "you may pay {1}. If you do, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life" - the drain only happens if you pay.

kept.name: Soaring Stoneglider
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile two cards from your graveyard or pay {1}{W}" is exile as an ADDITIONAL CAST cost, which is a sharper claim than the generic cost:exile already present.

kept.name: Cursed Scroll
kept.why: The activated ability's cost includes {T} and cost:tap was missing. It also reveals a card at random from your hand and only works when it can name what is there, so the hand zone is genuinely part of what it reads.

kept.name: Devout Harpist
kept.why: Its only ability costs {T} and cost:tap was absent.

kept.name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
kept.why: The whole ability is activated from the graveyard (exile this card from your graveyard). cost:exile-self was recorded but nothing said the card operates from the yard.

kept.name: Imperial Mask
kept.why: Two clauses were unread. Teammates CREATE token copies, which is token creation as well as copying, and the second line grants hexproof outright.

kept.name: Scars of the Veteran
kept.why: The alternative cost (exile a white card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost) was not recorded at all, and the counters arrive on a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step.

kept.name: Elspeth's Devotee
kept.why: The entire enter-the-battlefield clause was dropped. It searches library AND graveyard, and shuffles if it searched the library. Only the trigger itself had been read.

kept.name: Soultether Golem
kept.why: Vanishing 1 removes a time counter at the beginning of your upkeep. The counter-adding half was recorded and the counter-removing half with its upkeep trigger was not.

kept.name: Cateran Enforcer
kept.why: The tutor ends with 'then shuffle' and the shuffle was not recorded.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Artifacts
kept.why: The card's entire first line prevents damage and carried no facet for it. Only the cycling half had been read.

kept.name: Sinstriker's Will
kept.why: It is an Aura with 'Enchant creature' and nothing said it attaches. The granted ability deals damage equal to the creature's power, which is a real power-scaling reference rather than an incidental word.

kept.name: Wooden Sphere
kept.why: The payoff clause was entirely unread: you gain 1 life, and only if you choose to pay {1}. The trigger was recorded with no effect attached to it.

kept.name: Bloodcurdler
kept.why: The threshold clause grants an end-step trigger that exiles two cards from your graveyard, and neither the trigger nor the exile was recorded. Only the upkeep mill had been read.

kept.name: Unassuming Sage
kept.why: It creates a Role token, which is token creation, and only if you pay {2}. The Role attaches to it and carries an attack trigger. The scry was taken from that same reminder text, so the trigger that produces it belongs too.

kept.name: Pin Collection
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and no pump was recorded, unlike the other Equipment in this batch.

kept.name: Urza's Avenger
kept.why: Only flying of the four granted keywords was recorded, and the -1/-1 half of the ability was dropped entirely.

kept.name: Doom Cannon
kept.why: The ability's cost is {3}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature of the chosen type. Neither the tap nor the sacrifice was recorded, and the sacrifice is of another creature rather than of itself.

kept.name: Kjeldoran Gargoyle
kept.why: The damage trigger's whole payoff is 'you gain that much life' and no lifegain was recorded.

kept.name: Mourner's Shield
kept.why: The second ability was unread: it costs {2} and {T} and prevents all damage from a chosen source. It also reads the imprinted card in exile to decide which colour it stops.

kept.name: Aven Warcraft
kept.why: The threshold half was unread. It lets you choose a colour and gives your whole board protection from it, which is a protection trick and not merely the +0/+2 that was recorded.

kept.name: Endure
kept.why: Prevents all damage to you AND every permanent you control - a mass, one-sided fog. scope:all for the board-wide reach, eff:protect because keeping your creatures alive is exactly what it does.

kept.name: Shieldmage Elder
kept.why: Blanking the damage a creature would deal keeps your blockers and your team alive, which is the protection job. The second ability targets a SPELL on the stack, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Hyalopterous Lemure
kept.why: -1/-0 is applied to itself, so the removal signal is wrong.

kept.name: Golden-Scale Aeronaut
kept.why: Backup 1 reads 'When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.' The counter was recorded and the trigger that causes it was not.

kept.name: Slimy Dualleech
kept.why: The whole ability - '+1/+0 and gains deathtouch until end of turn' - was unread. Only the timing was recorded. NOT adding cares:power: the power 2 or less clause is a threshold on the target, not an effect that scales with power, and cares:power would tell the engine this deck wants big creatures when it wants small ones.

kept.name: Razor Hippogriff
kept.why: It returns an artifact card from the GRAVEYARD to hand, which eff:return-from already records. eff:bounce-own means returning your own permanents from the battlefield - the blink/bounce signal a Chulane or Brago deck asks for - and this card cannot do that.

kept.name: Pteron Ghost
kept.why: Regenerating a target permanent keeps it alive, which is the protection job. It regenerates a TARGET rather than itself, so this is the case that genuinely is protection.

kept.name: Elite Skirmisher
kept.why: The card taps ONE target creature. Nothing here affects everything; scope:all is a word-scan artefact and it feeds the mass-effect reading.

kept.name: Walking Desecration
kept.why: The activated cost includes {T} and nothing recorded it, and the entire effect - the forced attack - has no word.

kept.name: Rhystic Circle
kept.why: Only the activation cost was recorded and nothing the card DOES. 'Any player may pay {1}. If no one does...' is the rhystic tax shape, and the payoff is damage prevention.

kept.name: Steadfast Armasaur
kept.why: '{1}{W}, {T}: deals damage equal to its toughness to target creature' - both the tap in the cost and the damage itself were unread. Only acost:3 survived.

kept.name: Arctic Foxes
kept.why: Conditional evasion - it cannot be blocked by creatures with power 2 or greater when the defender has a snow land - and nothing recorded the evasion. Same treatment landwalk gets on Lost Soul in this batch.

kept.name: Murderous Spoils
kept.why: 'You gain control of all Equipment that were attached to it' is a permanent theft clause and was completely unread. Only the destroy half was recorded.

kept.name: A Good Day to Pie
kept.why: The second clause returns THIS card from your graveyard to your hand. eff:return-from records that something is returned; eff:recur-self is what says the card brings itself back.

kept.name: Entropic Specter
kept.why: 'As this creature enters, choose an opponent' is an enters trigger and neither enters word was present. Its power and toughness are each set to the chosen player's hand size, which is a characteristic-setting ability and had no word.

kept.name: Rathi Intimidator
kept.why: 'then shuffle' was unread. scope:all is wrong: a fear creature with a one-target tutor does nothing global.

kept.name: Razormane Masticore
kept.why: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature unless you discard a card' makes you discard every turn and nothing recorded it - the upkeep timing was there with no effect attached to it.

kept.name: Knockout Blow
kept.why: The card deals 4 damage to a creature and eff:damage was missing entirely - only the lifegain and the red-creature cost clause survived. NOT adding eff:reduce-cost: the discount is on this spell itself, not a cost reduction the deck benefits from.

kept.name: Slaughter Drone
kept.why: '{C}: This creature gains deathtouch' changes no power or toughness. grants:deathtouch already carries it; eff:pump is a false read of the word 'gains'.

kept.name: Dutiful Griffin
kept.why: It returns THIS card from the graveyard to your hand, which is the eff:recur-self shape. scope:all is wrong - sacrificing two enchantments to rebuy itself touches nothing globally.

kept.name: Jabari's Banner
kept.why: Granting flanking is not a pump - no power or toughness changes. grants:flanking already says what it does; eff:pump is a false read of 'gains'.

kept.name: Scampire
kept.why: The reanimated creature 'gains haste' and nothing recorded it. NOT adding eff:exile for the end-step exile clause: that exiles the card it just reanimated, and eff:exile confers the removal role, which would misfile a reanimation card as an answer.

kept.name: Infinite Obliteration
kept.why: It searches the opponent's graveyard as well as hand and library; hand and library were recorded and the graveyard was not, although eff:exile-graveyard is present. NOT adding eff:search-library or eff:shuffle: both describe doing it to YOUR library, and this is aimed at an opponent - reading it as a tutor would be wrong.

kept.name: Elgaud Inquisitor
kept.why: Printed lifelink gains life, and the convention in this data records it (Insatiable Harpy in this same batch carries eff:gain-life for lifelink alone).

kept.name: Hagra Crocodile
kept.why: 'This creature can't block' is a whole line of the card and was unread; eff:cant-block-self is exactly that word. scope:all is wrong - the landfall pump is on itself only.

kept.name: Energy Storm
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep is an upkeep trigger, so trig:step is there but the specific step word is missing. The third line is entirely about creatures WITH FLYING, which is a real 'cares about flying' statement and the flying half of the card is unrecorded.

kept.name: Smog Elemental
kept.why: 'Creatures with flying your opponents control get -1/-1' is a shrink, not a pump - the engine read the P/T modification and lost its sign, which makes an opposing-flyer hoser look like an anthem. The card is also explicitly about flying creatures and carried nothing saying so.

kept.name: Honorable Scout
kept.why: The trigger counts 'black and/or red' creatures. Red was recorded and black was dropped, so half the hoser condition is missing.

kept.name: Cruel Deceiver
kept.why: The second ability grants this creature 'Whenever this creature deals damage to a creature, destroy that creature'. The card currently carries no effect word at all - it reads as doing nothing - when it is in fact a repeatable creature-destroy on a damage trigger. Not adding grants:deathtouch deliberately: it destroys rather than granting the keyword, and indestructible beats it.

kept.name: Slithery Stalker
kept.why: The leave trigger returns the exiled card to the battlefield, which is a real return effect and was unrecorded - the card was read as one-way exile. Green could not be added alongside cares:color:w because the vocabulary has no cares:color:g.

kept.name: Sanguine Praetor
kept.why: 'Sacrifice a creature' is a repeatable sacrifice OUTLET that eats other creatures, not a card that eats only itself once. Carrying both words makes an aristocrats engine indistinguishable from a Sakura-Tribe Elder. cost:sacrifice is correct and stays.

kept.name: Borrowed Malevolence
kept.why: 'Choose one or both' is a modal spell and the modality is unrecorded.

kept.name: Deathmark Prelate
kept.why: 'Destroy target non-Zombie creature' is single-target removal. scope:all says the card affects everything, which would let it read as a board wipe and could put it in a go-wide deck as a mass answer.

kept.name: Crypt Angel
kept.why: The ETB returns a card from graveyard to HAND and the hand zone was unrecorded. The restriction is 'blue or red creature card', and neither colour was recorded while cares:color:w (from protection from white) was.

kept.name: Silkwrap
kept.why: The creature is exiled and tracked in exile until this leaves, and the exile zone was unrecorded.

kept.name: Avacynian Missionaries // Lunarch Inquisitors
kept.why: The whole front face is 'transform it' and no transform effect was recorded - it is the card's only action. The back face exiles a creature and holds it in exile.

kept.name: Scent of Jasmine
kept.why: The card reads your hand ('reveal any number of white cards in your hand') and scales off it; the hand zone was unrecorded.

kept.name: Sightless Brawler
kept.why: 'Enchanted creature gets +3/+2' is unrecorded - as a bestow Aura the pump is the entire reason to cast it that way. Not adding eff:attach, since ordinary Auras in this data set carry kw:enchant and sub:aura without it and I am matching that convention.

kept.name: Carrion Imp
kept.why: It exiles a creature card from a graveyard - eff:exile-graveyard is there but the graveyard zone is not, unlike Funeral Pyre in the same batch which carries both.

kept.name: Insubordination
kept.why: 'At the beginning of the end step of enchanted creature's controller' is an end-step trigger and no timing word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Queen's Agent
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and either takes it or bins it; the library was unrecorded.

kept.name: Justice
kept.why: 'Whenever a red creature or spell deals damage' is a damage trigger and only the upkeep trigger was recorded, so the card's actual payoff has no trigger word.

kept.name: Quarry Colossus
kept.why: The card carried NO effect word. Its ETB tucks a creature into its owner's library - that is removal, and as written the engine sees a 5/5 body that does nothing.

kept.name: Funeral Pyre
kept.why: 'Its owner creates a 1/1 white Spirit' is a real token creation and was unrecorded. cost:exile is wrong: the spell costs {W} and has no additional cost - the exile is the EFFECT, and reading it as a cost makes this look like a card that exiles from your own resources to pay for something.

kept.name: Soul Bleed
kept.why: 'At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller' is an upkeep trigger and no timing word was recorded.

kept.name: Skullmane Baku
kept.why: "Whenever you cast a Spirit or Arcane spell" is a cast trigger on your own spells and was recorded nowhere; the trigger's effect puts a ki counter on the Baku itself, which is eff:add-counters-self. Only the activated -X/-X half had been read.

kept.name: Ersatz Gnomes
kept.why: Both abilities are {T} abilities and the list carried no cost:tap at all. The first targets a SPELL, so it reaches the stack.

kept.name: Hope Charm
kept.why: It is a modal spell ("Choose one —") and nothing recorded that the caster picks the mode.

kept.name: Delif's Cube
kept.why: Neither ability had been read at all. The first is a {T} ability that puts a cube counter on the Cube itself off a delayed attack trigger; the second removes a cube counter as a cost to regenerate a creature, which is what keeps a creature alive (the same reading the tagger already gives "regenerate target").

kept.name: Obsidian Acolyte
kept.why: Granting protection from black to a creature is keeping your creature alive through removal. grants:protection records the keyword; nothing recorded the job.

kept.name: Phyrexian Broodlings
kept.why: It is a sacrifice outlet that puts one counter on itself. Nothing about it affects everything, and scope:all would read it as a board-wide effect.

kept.name: Fend Off
kept.why: The whole front half of the card is "Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by target creature" and only the cycling half had been read.

kept.name: Mind Extraction
kept.why: The sacrifice is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, not an on-demand outlet. cost:sacrifice would file this sorcery alongside Ashnod's Altar and Viscera Seer as a sacrifice outlet an aristocrats deck can use repeatedly, which it is not.

kept.name: Demonic Torment
kept.why: A creature that cannot attack and whose combat damage is prevented has been turned harmless without being destroyed. That is a Pacifism, which is the exact shape eff:neutralise names.

kept.name: Mind Maggots
kept.why: "Discard any number of creature cards" is you discarding from your own hand, and only the counters half was recorded.

kept.name: Seasoned Consultant
kept.why: "This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn" is the entire effect of the trigger and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Stasis Cocoon
kept.why: An artifact that cannot attack, cannot block and cannot have its abilities activated has been made harmless without being destroyed. The three prohibition words are each true but none says that the card is removal.

kept.name: Gempalm Avenger
kept.why: The cycling trigger anthem was completely unread: Soldier creatures get +1/+1 AND gain first strike, and it hits every Soldier on the battlefield rather than a target.

kept.name: Trench Stalker
kept.why: It grants itself deathtouch AND lifelink under the same condition. grants:deathtouch was recorded and its twin was not.

kept.name: Squeaking Pie Sneak
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Goblin card from your hand or pay {3}" is a real cast cost and no cost word was recorded.

kept.name: Clinging Darkness
kept.why: -4/-1 makes a creature smaller, not bigger. eff:pump reads this Aura as a buff for your own team when it is a removal spell that kills a small creature.

kept.name: Muse Vessel
kept.why: Nothing at all had been read from either ability. The first is a {T} ability that exiles a card out of an opponent's hand; the second reaches back into exile to play what was taken.

kept.name: Decorated Griffin
kept.why: Its only ability prevents combat damage to you and no effect word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Plague Wight
kept.why: "Each creature blocking it gets -1/-1" is the whole effect of the trigger and only the trigger itself was recorded.

kept.name: Painsmith
kept.why: The trigger pumps ONE target creature. scope:all would read it as a global anthem when it is a single-target combat trick.

kept.name: Knight of Valor
kept.why: Both flanking and the activated ability give blocking creatures -1/-1, and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Keldon Battlewagon
kept.why: "This creature can't block" is a printed restriction on itself and nothing recorded it. The activated ability's cost is tapping ANOTHER untapped creature you control, which is cost:tap-others, not a tap of itself.

kept.name: Freewind Equenaut
kept.why: The granted ability it has while enchanted is "{T}: deals 2 damage" - the damage was recorded but the tap cost that pays for it was not.

kept.name: Power Armor
kept.why: The pump ability costs {3} and {T}; the tap cost was missing.

kept.name: Reaping the Rewards
kept.why: Buyback here is "sacrifice a land" as an additional cost paid while casting, which is exactly cost:cast-sacrifice. Only the lifegain was recorded.

kept.name: Nearheath Chaplain
kept.why: Its only real ability is activated FROM the graveyard (exile this card from your graveyard). cost:exile-self was recorded but nothing said the card operates out of the yard.

kept.name: The Prismatic Piper
kept.why: The whole card is a conditional on "If The Prismatic Piper is your commander" - it does literally nothing otherwise.

kept.name: Benalish Missionary
kept.why: The list carried no effect word at all. The card's only ability prevents all combat damage from a blocked creature, paid with {1}{W} and a tap.

kept.name: Feebleness
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets -2/-1. That is a shrink, and calling it a pump files a removal aura as a creature buff.

kept.name: Graveyard Shovel
kept.why: The list carried no effect word at all. Its ability exiles a card from a graveyard, gains 2 life if that card was a creature, and costs {2} and a tap.

kept.name: Induce Despair
kept.why: The additional cost is revealing a creature card from your hand, and X is read off that card - the whole spell is sized by what is in your hand. Only the shrink was recorded.

kept.name: Cho-Arrim Legate
kept.why: "You may cast this spell without paying its mana cost" when the land condition is met. Nothing recorded that it can be cast for free.

kept.name: Wooden Stake
kept.why: The destroy effect was recorded but neither half of the trigger that causes it ("blocks or becomes blocked by a Vampire") was.

kept.name: Battle Cry
kept.why: Only the untap was recorded. The second sentence is a delayed trigger on any creature blocking that gives +0/+1, and the untap is specifically of WHITE creatures you control, which is a real colour condition.

kept.name: Dispossess
kept.why: It searches the opponent's graveyard as well as hand and library; hand and library were both recorded and the graveyard was not. Deliberately NOT adding bare eff:exile: this never touches the battlefield, so it is hate rather than removal, and eff:exile-graveyard already says what it is.

kept.name: Bastion Mastodon
kept.why: "{W}: This creature gains vigilance until end of turn" changes no power or toughness. grants:vigilance already says what it does; eff:pump is an invented buff.

kept.name: Plague Sliver
kept.why: The granted ability is an upkeep trigger and neither the step nor the upkeep word was present. It also applies to ALL Slivers, every player's included, which is a genuinely global static.

kept.name: Jamuraan Lion
kept.why: The list carried no effect word at all. Its only ability stops a creature blocking, for {W} and a tap.

kept.name: Vigil for the Lost
kept.why: The trigger was recorded and what it actually does was not: pay {X} and gain X life. The optional payment is exactly eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Unwavering Initiate
kept.why: Embalm is paid by exiling this card from your graveyard, so the cost and the zone it works from were both missing. It also brings itself back as a token, which is the same self-recursion job as unearth and eternalize.

kept.name: Cursed Ronin
kept.why: Bushido is a triggered ability, not a static one: "whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1". The pump was recorded and the two triggers that cause it were not. Infernal Medusa in this same batch carries both words for the identical wording.

kept.name: Specter's Shriek
kept.why: The whole card is an exile: "you may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player exiles that card", plus a second exile from your own hand. Only cares:zone:hand was recorded, so a targeted hand-exile read as a card that does nothing. Not eff:discard - the card never uses that word and exile from hand is a different effect. I left cares:color:b off: the nonblack clause is a drawback condition, not a statement that this is a black-matters card.

kept.name: Soul Sculptor
kept.why: The ability is "{1}{W}, {T}:" and the tap cost was not recorded. eff:neutralise is right and stays. Not eff:animate - that turns a permanent into a creature and this does the reverse.

kept.name: Infernal Medusa
kept.why: Both triggers end in "destroy that creature at end of combat" and the card carried no effect word at all - only the two triggers and the type words. It read as a creature that triggers on blocking and then does nothing.

kept.name: Rabid Bloodsucker
kept.why: "each player loses 2 life" is symmetric and hits you too. eff:lose-life alone reads as one-sided drain; scope:all is how the rest of the catalogue records an effect that reaches everyone.

kept.name: Griffnaut Tracker
kept.why: "exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard" is graveyard hate and the card carried no effect word for it (rec:partial - the enters trigger was read and its body was not). eff:exile-graveyard is the word kept apart from plain eff:exile for exactly this.

kept.name: Thirsting Axe
kept.why: "if equipped creature didn't deal combat damage to a creature this turn, sacrifice it" - the end step trigger was recorded but its body was not, so the card read as a pure +4/+0 equipment with no drawback.

kept.name: Sheltered Valley
kept.why: No coloured mana symbol anywhere on the card and it taps for {C}, so its colour identity is empty. Every other colourless permanent in this batch (Iron Star, Magma Mine, Heliophial, Leashling, Diviner's Lockbox, Volrath's Laboratory, Al-abara's Carpet) carries col:none and this one was missed.

kept.name: Soaring Hope
kept.why: "{W}: Put this Aura on top of its owner's library" is a zone move and no word covered it - the list stopped at the lifegain and the flying grant. Deliberately NOT eff:attach: at 695 cards that word is the equipment/attach vocabulary, and no Aura in this batch carries it, so adding it here would break that convention rather than fix a gap.

kept.name: Dega Sanctuary
kept.why: The card names black AND red twice - "a black or red permanent", then "a black permanent and a red permanent". cares:color:b was recorded and cares:color:r was dropped, so half the condition is missing.

kept.name: Peace Talks
kept.why: Two clauses, one recorded. "players and permanents can't be the targets of spells or activated abilities" is a blanket shroud on the whole board and had no word at all. scope:all because both clauses reach every player and every permanent, not just yours.

kept.name: Heron-Blessed Geist
kept.why: The only ability that matters is activated FROM the graveyard ("Exile this card from your graveyard"). cost:exile-self was recorded but nothing said the card operates in the graveyard, so a graveyard deck could not find it.

kept.name: Iron Star
kept.why: The card carried the trigger and the colour it watches for, and nothing for what it actually does: "you may pay {1}. If you do, you gain 1 life". Both halves were missing - the lifegain and the pay-to-get-it structure.

kept.name: Diviner's Lockbox
kept.why: Cost is "{1}, {T}:" and the tap was not recorded. It also reveals the top card of your library, which nothing said. eff:draw was already there and is right.

kept.name: Leashling
kept.why: "Return this creature to its owner's hand" is a self-bounce; a creature returning itself counts as eff:bounce-own by the same reading that keeps Whitemane Lion in that word. The cost puts a card on top of your library, hence cares:zone:library. eff:move-zone stays but it is the vaguer of the two.

kept.name: Coils of the Medusa
kept.why: "Sacrifice this Aura:" is the activation cost of the destroy ability and no cost word was recorded. The +1/-1 stays as eff:pump alone; I did not add eff:shrink, since the P/T change is one modification and eff:pump already carries it.

kept.name: Thriving Ibex
kept.why: "you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it" is optional-payment structure and had no word. I left eff:add-counters alongside eff:add-counters-self deliberately: the counters only ever go on this creature, but the base word is emitted alongside the split word elsewhere in the catalogue, so removing it would break that convention rather than fix a fault.

kept.name: Volrath's Laboratory
kept.why: The token ability costs "{5}, {T}" and the tap was not recorded. eff:create-token was already there.

kept.name: Gallowbraid
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep. The generic trig:step was recorded but not which step, so the card sat outside every upkeep-matters reading.

kept.name: Heliophial
kept.why: Sunburst counts the colours of mana spent to cast it, which is precisely what cares:mana-spent says. Nothing recorded that the card's whole size depends on how it was paid for.

kept.name: Al-abara's Carpet
kept.why: This card carried NO effect word whatsoever - just acost, col:none and the type. Its only ability is "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn by attacking creatures without flying", which is eff:prevent-damage, activated for "{5}, {T}".

kept.name: Trap Runner
kept.why: The card had no effect or cost word at all. The tap cost is real and recordable. I could NOT record what it does - "target unblocked attacking creature becomes blocked" has no word in the vocabulary and eff:force-block is the wrong direction (that is forcing a creature to block THIS one, gloss and all). I did not propose a new word because the shape is rare enough that I could not show it recurs.

kept.name: Trenching Steed
kept.why: "This creature gets +0/+3 until end of turn" affects one creature - itself. scope:all says the card affects everything, and this one affects nothing but its own body. The pump, the sacrifice cost and the land reference are all correct.

kept.name: Dai Li Censor
kept.why: "This creature gets +2/+2" is a self-pump, not a board-wide effect. cost:sacrifice is right and is the useful word here - this is a repeatable sacrifice outlet - so the false scope word is the only thing wrong.

kept.name: Stonerise Spirit
kept.why: "Target creature gains flying until end of turn" is single-target, so scope:all is false. eff:pump is false too: nothing on this card changes power or toughness, it grants an ability, and grants:flying already records that. Soaring Hope in this same batch grants flying and correctly carries no eff:pump, which is the convention I am matching.

kept.name: Cateran Overlord
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature: Regenerate this creature" is a genuine on-demand sacrifice outlet — it eats other creatures, repeatably, for one mana-free activation. Nothing in the list said so; cost:sacrifice-self would have been the wrong word since it does not eat itself.

kept.name: Public Execution
kept.why: The second sentence, "Each other creature that player controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn", produced no word at all. The list recorded only the destroy.

kept.name: Charm Peddler
kept.why: The activation cost is "{W}, {T}, Discard a card" and neither the tap nor the discard cost was recorded. It is a repeatable discard outlet, which is the whole reason a deck would run it. eff:discard-self is left in place — activating it does make you discard — but the cost: word is the accurate one.

kept.name: Vessel of Malignity
kept.why: "Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand" is hand attack and produced no effect word. Deliberately NOT eff:exile: that facet is read as removal, and this answers no permanent.

kept.name: Rapid Decay
kept.why: The list recorded only the cycling ability. "Exile up to three target cards from a single graveyard" — the entire reason the card exists, and a piece of graveyard hate — produced nothing.

kept.name: Barrow Ghoul
kept.why: It must exile a creature card from your graveyard every upkeep or be sacrificed, so it wants a stocked graveyard. Only the upkeep timing was recorded. Not marked eff:exile-graveyard: it eats your OWN graveyard as an upkeep tax and is not hate, and that word is read as working against a graveyard deck.

kept.name: Guard Dogs
kept.why: The card carried no effect word whatsoever — only its activation cost tier and its type. It taps to prevent all combat damage a creature would deal.

kept.name: Arcum's Weathervane
kept.why: Both abilities are "{2}, {T}" and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Grotesque Hybrid
kept.why: Three separate omissions. The combat-damage trigger destroys the creature it damaged, which is real removal and produced nothing. The activated ability grants protection from green and from white, and discards a card as its cost. Only the flying half of that ability was read.

kept.name: Springjack Knight
kept.why: Winning the clash grants a creature double strike until end of turn; only the clash keyword and the attack trigger were recorded.

kept.name: Thraben Foulbloods
kept.why: Delirium gives it menace, and the grant itself was not recorded — only the printed keyword. Consistent with how the same shape is handled on Imperial Lancer in this batch, which carries both kw:double strike and grants:double strike.

kept.name: Drudge Spell
kept.why: The activation cost exiles two creature cards from your graveyard, so it is a graveyard payoff and neither the cost nor the graveyard interest was recorded. Its leave trigger destroys all Skeleton tokens, which had no word at all. Marked eff:destroy-own rather than eff:destroy: the tokens are the ones it made and they are yours, so the generic verb would wrongly file this as removal.

kept.name: Exorcist
kept.why: "Destroy target black creature" is a black-colour hoser and the list records no colour reference at all. Same shape as Sphere of Law (cares:color:r) and Crimson Acolyte (cares:color:r) elsewhere in this batch.

kept.name: Tawnos's Wand
kept.why: The activation cost is "{2}, {T}" and cost:tap is missing. It also selects on "power 2 or less", which is cares:power, exactly as Raft Security Officer has it for "power 3 or less".

kept.name: Ramroller
kept.why: "Gets +2/+0 as long as you control another artifact" is a conditional self-pump and eff:pump is absent, though the same self-pump wording carries it on Dungeon Shade and Dapper Shieldmate. The "attacks each combat if able" clause has no word available at all.

kept.name: Charmed Griffin
kept.why: The whole enters trigger is unrecorded: it puts artifact or enchantment cards onto the battlefield from hands. eff:put-onto-battlefield is the effect (the gloss says from hand, which this is, merely other players' hands) and cares:zone:hand is the zone it reads.

kept.name: Order of the White Shield
kept.why: Protection from black is a colour reference and nothing in the list records it. Crimson Acolyte carries cares:color:r for protection from red.

kept.name: Flesh Allergy
kept.why: It destroys ONE target creature. scope:all claims it affects everything, and almost certainly came from the word scan on "the number of creatures that died this turn", which is a count for the life loss, not a mass selector.

kept.name: Prophecy
kept.why: It reveals the top card of an opponent's library and reads it. Visions, the same kind of top-of-library peek, carries cares:zone:library and this does not.

kept.name: Circle of Solace
kept.why: The only thing the activated ability does is prevent damage, and no damage word is on the card. It records the choose-a-type clause and then stops.

kept.name: Topan Freeblade
kept.why: Renown puts the +1/+1 counter on THIS creature, so it is the -self form, as Emissary of Sunrise has for explore. The generic word reads as putting counters on other things, which it never does.

kept.name: Benevolent Ancestor
kept.why: The ability is "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage" and neither half is written down. The list currently says only that it has defender.

kept.name: Kithkin Zealot
kept.why: The trigger counts "each black and/or red permanent". Red was picked up and black was dropped, so the card reads as caring about only half of what it names.

kept.name: Cateran Kidnappers
kept.why: It tutors ONE Mercenary onto the battlefield. Nothing about it is a mass effect; scope:all is a false positive (the same one is on Cateran Slaver).

kept.name: Weight of the Underworld
kept.why: -3/-2 makes the creature SMALLER. eff:pump says it pumps creatures, which is backwards, and it hides the fact that this is removal. eff:shrink is the correct word and is what Bloodtallow Candle carries for -5/-5.

kept.name: Time of Heroes
kept.why: "Each creature you control with a level counter gets +2/+2" is a mass anthem and the list records only the counter type. Gate Hound and Mightstone both carry scope:all for the same "creatures you control / attacking creatures" shape.

kept.name: Cateran Slaver
kept.why: It searches for ONE Mercenary. Same false positive as Cateran Kidnappers; the card has no mass effect.

kept.name: Thran Tome
kept.why: The card's entire text is unrecorded - the list is only cost, colour, subtype and type. It taps, it reveals the top three of your library, it puts one of them into your graveyard, and drawing two cards is the reason anyone plays it.

kept.name: Weakness
kept.why: -2/-1 shrinks the creature. Same inversion as Weight of the Underworld: eff:pump reads as a buff and makes a removal aura look like a Voltron piece.

kept.name: Emissary of Sunrise
kept.why: Explore reveals the top card of your library and takes it to hand if it is a land. The counter half is recorded and the library half is not, the same peek Visions is credited for.

kept.name: Eager First-Year
kept.why: Magecraft here triggers on YOU casting an instant or sorcery and pumps this creature, and none of that is on the list: no pump word at all, and only the bare trig:cast where the specific words exist (trig:cast-own, trig:cast:instant, trig:cast:sorcery). As it stands a spellslinger deck cannot see it.

kept.name: Dapper Shieldmate
kept.why: The shield counter goes on THIS creature as it enters, so it is the -self form. The generic word implies it puts counters on other permanents, which would make it look like a counters enabler.

kept.name: Droning Bureaucrats
kept.why: The whole ability is missing: it taps, and it stops EACH creature of the chosen mana value from attacking or blocking. The list currently records only the activation costs, so a repeatable mass fog/lockdown reads as a vanilla body.

kept.name: Suppress
kept.why: The card exiles a player's entire hand face down and gives it back at the end step of their next turn, and the list is just cares:zone:hand and the card type. It exiles (eff:exile), the cards sit in exile (cares:zone:exile), they come back (eff:return-from), and "all cards from their hand" is a mass selector (scope:all).

kept.name: Gloom Surgeon
kept.why: It exiles cards off the top of your own library every time it is dealt combat damage; nothing records that it touches your library. Not adding eff:exile, which would wrongly read as removal.

kept.name: Grifter's Blade
kept.why: "As this Equipment enters ... it enters attached to that creature" is a genuine enters effect, so blinking or recasting it re-attaches it. No enters facet at all.

kept.name: Trained Pronghorn
kept.why: A repeatable ability that prevents all damage to itself is a keep-it-alive effect, not just raw prevention.

kept.name: Infernal Denizen
kept.why: The card's main ability is stealing creatures and its downside gives one away; neither is recorded. The {T} activation cost is missing. scope:all is wrong - nothing here is board-wide, it is a single targeted steal and a single creature handed over.

kept.name: Exclusion Ritual
kept.why: The static half of the card - a permanent name ban - is entirely unrecorded, and the ban reads the exiled card, so exile is a live zone for it.

kept.name: Restrain
kept.why: Half the card is missing: it prevents all combat damage from an attacker and only the cantrip was written down.

kept.name: Gloomdrifter
kept.why: The granted ability is an enters trigger ("When this creature enters, nonblack creatures get -2/-2") and no enters facet is recorded, so the -2/-2 looks like it happens from nowhere.

kept.name: Test of Faith
kept.why: Preventing the next 3 damage to a creature is the classic save-your-creature combat trick, not just generic prevention.

kept.name: Cho-Arrim Alchemist
kept.why: {T} is part of the activation cost and is not recorded; every other tap-activated card in this batch carries cost:tap. Left cost:discard alone rather than guessing between cost:discard and cost:discard-self.

kept.name: Kree Commandos
kept.why: Prowess is spelled out in the text: it triggers on your own noncreature spells and pumps itself. Only the bare trig:cast was recorded.

kept.name: Serra's Hymn
kept.why: The entire payoff clause - sacrifice it to prevent X damage divided among any number of targets - is missing, both the effect and the sacrifice cost. Only the counter accrual was read.

kept.name: Shatter Assumptions
kept.why: "Choose one —" is a modal card and nothing records the choice.

kept.name: Rashida Scalebane
