kept.why: {T} is in the activation cost and the lifegain clause ("You gain life equal to its power") was dropped entirely.

kept.name: Chimeric Staff
kept.why: The card's only ability turns itself into a creature and nothing records it; the list has the Construct subtype it makes but not the animation.

kept.name: Gargantuan Leech
kept.why: The cost reduction clause is unrecorded - it is half the card's text and the whole reason to play it in a Cave deck.

kept.name: Dread Warlock
kept.why: "Can't be blocked except by black creatures" is evasion and carries no effect word; Seeker in this same batch has eff:cant-be-blocked for the identical wording. Not adding cares:color:b - this is evasion, not a black-matters card.

kept.name: Sengir Nosferatu
kept.why: It creates a Bat token and nothing records token creation - the largest omission on the card. It exiles ITSELF as an activation cost, so by the -self/-own convention this is eff:exile-self plus cost:exile-self; eff:exile-own claims it flickers your other permanents, which it does not.

kept.name: Ugin's Construct
kept.why: The whole ETB - forcing you to sacrifice a coloured permanent - is unrecorded.

kept.name: Deathknell Kami
kept.why: Soulshift is a death trigger and no trig:dies is recorded, so the graveyard return looks unconditional.

kept.name: Delraich
kept.why: Sacrificing three creatures is an ALTERNATIVE COST TO CAST, not an on-demand sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice is documented as meaning an outlet, which would put this in aristocrats decks as a repeatable sac engine; it is a one-shot casting cost.

kept.name: Kabira Outrider
kept.why: The ETB pumps a creature and no pump word is recorded - the card's only effect is missing. The size of the pump depends on party, which the vocabulary cannot say at all.

kept.name: Stir the Pride
kept.why: Modal card with no eff:choose, and the second mode's lifegain is completely unrecorded - it is the mode a lifegain deck plays the card for.

kept.name: Memory Theft
kept.why: The last sentence moves an Adventure card from exile to a graveyard and neither the zone move nor the exile interaction is recorded.

kept.name: Morinfen
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep happens at the beginning of your upkeep; the generic trig:step is recorded without the step it actually uses.

kept.name: Arcum's Whistle
kept.why: Only the destroy clause was read. The ability costs {T}, the whole card hangs on 'that player may pay {X}. If they don't pay...' which is the unless-pays shape, and the destroy is a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step.

kept.name: Weigh Down
kept.why: 'Target creature gets -3/-3' hits exactly one creature, and the additional cost exiles exactly one card. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Inquisitor's Snare
kept.why: 'If that creature is black or red' - the red half was recorded and the black half was not.

kept.name: Geistcatcher's Rig
kept.why: It can only point at a creature WITH FLYING. That restriction is the whole card and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: The Wretched
kept.why: 'Gain control of ALL creatures blocking this creature' - a mass selector, not a single target.

kept.name: Filthy Cur
kept.why: 'You lose that much life' was not recorded. The trigger was read and the effect it causes was dropped.

kept.name: Spawnbinder Mage
kept.why: 'Tap target creature' is one creature. Cohort taps one Ally as a cost, which cost:tap-others already carries.

kept.name: Thought Dissector
kept.why: The list was a mana cost and nothing else - none of the three things it does was read. It taps, it puts the rest of the revealed cards into that player's graveyard (mill), it puts an artifact card onto the battlefield under YOUR control (steals it), and it works off the top of an opponent's library.

kept.name: Akron Legionnaire
kept.why: Its entire text stops your creatures attacking and no eff: word recorded that.

kept.name: Relic Bane
kept.why: The granted ability's effect was read (eff:lose-life) but not when it happens. The life loss is an upkeep trigger.

kept.name: Reaper of Flight Moonsilver
kept.why: Sacrificing one other creature to pump itself affects two creatures, neither of them everything.

kept.name: Rats' Feast
kept.why: The card does nothing but interact with a graveyard and only eff:exile-graveyard recorded it.

kept.name: Auriok Glaivemaster
kept.why: 'It gets +1/+1 and has first strike' - the first strike half was recorded and the +1/+1 was dropped.

kept.name: Muzzle
kept.why: Preventing all damage the enchanted creature would deal is the Pacifism family: the creature survives and stops mattering. Without this word the card is invisible as an answer, and eff:prevent-damage alone reads as a combat trick.

kept.name: Veteran Bodyguard
kept.why: Nothing is prevented. The damage is dealt in full, to the Bodyguard instead of to you, which is exactly what eff:redirect-damage names.

kept.name: Fall to Earth
kept.why: Basic landcycling is paid by discarding this card. The search was recorded and the cost was not - Disciple of Law's cycling in the same batch carries cost:discard-self.

kept.name: HYDRA Disintegrator
kept.why: 'Create a 2/1 black Villain creature token' was dropped entirely. The attach that follows it was recorded, so the reading stopped mid-clause.

kept.name: Thraben Heretic
kept.why: 'Exile target creature card from a graveyard' - the graveyard is the zone the whole ability reads from.

kept.name: White Mana Battery
kept.why: The mana ability's cost is removing any number of charge counters. Putting counters on was recorded; taking them off, which is how the card actually pays, was not.

kept.name: Samite Ministration
kept.why: 'Damage from a black or red source' - only the red half was recorded.

kept.name: Disposal Mummy
kept.why: This is graveyard hate and bare eff:exile makes it read as creature removal, so the engine will offer it as an answer to a threat. It cannot exile a permanent at all - only a card in an opponent's graveyard.

kept.name: Ondu Greathorn
kept.why: Landfall pumps only itself (+2/+2 until end of turn). Nothing here affects everything; the class selector is on the trigger's watched lands, not on the effect.

kept.name: Burrenton Bombardier
kept.why: Reinforce discards THIS card as the activation cost, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Parallax Dementia
kept.why: It is an Aura that enchants a creature, so it attaches. Every other clause was read.

kept.name: Clockwork Beast
kept.why: Every counter on this card goes on or comes off ITSELF, so the generic eff:add-counters understates it. The end-of-combat clause removes a counter and nothing recorded a removal or the step trigger, and the activated ability taps.

kept.name: Kitsune Bonesetter
kept.why: The whole card was unread: its only ability prevents 3 damage to a creature, and it taps to do it. It carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Aysen Highway
kept.why: It grants plainswalk specifically to WHITE creatures, a stated colour condition that was dropped.

kept.name: Tek
kept.why: It gets +0/+2 with a Plains and +2/+0 with a Swamp. The three granted keywords were read and both power/toughness clauses were not.

kept.name: Darkling Stalker
kept.why: The regeneration ability keeps it alive and only kw:regenerate was recorded, which is the printed keyword rather than what it does. Matches Daru Mender in this same batch.

kept.name: Sawtooth Thresher
kept.why: Removing two counters gives it +4/+4 until end of turn. The counter cost was read, the pump it buys was not.

kept.name: Stunning Shot
kept.why: It taps a creature an OPPONENT controls. eff:tap is already present and correct; eff:tap-own claims it taps your own permanents, which reads it as an untapper/tap-payoff enabler.

kept.name: Mystic Familiar
kept.why: Threshold gives it +1/+1 as well as protection from black. Only the protection half was read.

kept.name: Demon's Herald
kept.why: The cost sacrifices a blue, a black AND a red creature; blue and black were recorded and red was dropped. It also taps, and it searches your library.

kept.name: Phyrexian Warhorse
kept.why: The pump is +2/+1 on itself, so nothing affects everything. Kicker is the pay-more-get-more shape: pay {W} extra and the enters trigger makes a Soldier.

kept.name: Candles of Leng
kept.why: Its main line draws a card and that was missing entirely - only the mill half was read. It also taps, checks names against your graveyard, and reveals the top of your library.

kept.name: Corpulent Corpse
kept.why: Suspend was left entirely unread: it exiles itself as the cost of an alternative way to play it, then casts it without paying its mana cost from exile.

kept.name: Cateran Brute
kept.why: It searches a library for one Mercenary. It touches nothing on the battlefield, let alone everything.

kept.name: Seraph
kept.why: The trigger is a creature dying. eff:gain-control and eff:return-from were read but the event that starts them was not.

kept.name: Ichor Explosion
kept.why: The sacrifice is an additional cost to CAST, not an activated-ability cost, so it should not read as a sacrifice outlet. And -X/-X to ALL creatures is a symmetric board wipe that kills your own board too.

kept.name: Lithomancer's Focus
kept.why: Half the card is preventing all damage from colourless sources to that creature. Only the +2/+2 was read.

kept.name: Thraben Sentry // Thraben Militia
kept.why: The only effect is transforming itself, which nothing recorded, and it affects nothing else - the 'another creature you control' is the trigger's watch list, not the effect's reach.

kept.name: Hikari, Twilight Guardian
kept.why: Hikari exiles and returns HERSELF, not another of your creatures. eff:exile-own is the blink-your-board word and would put her in a deck built to flicker ETB creatures, which she cannot do. The trigger is also specifically on spells YOU cast.

kept.name: Ravenous Harpy
kept.why: It sacrifices one other creature and puts one counter on itself. The 'another creature' selector in the cost is not an effect that reaches everything.

kept.name: Clay Statue
kept.why: Its only ability is regeneration, and the card carried no effect word at all - just the printed keyword.

kept.name: Endoskeleton
kept.why: The card was completely unread: it taps to give a creature +0/+3 for as long as it stays tapped, and carried no effect or cost word.

kept.name: Emissary of Hope
kept.why: "you gain 1 life for each artifact that player controls" is the whole payoff of the card and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Arrogant Poet
kept.why: It gains flying, which grants:flying already records; no power or toughness changes, so eff:pump is false. The 2 life is a real cost the card asks you to pay.

kept.name: Snow Hound
kept.why: The ability only works on a green or blue creature you control, so it is a colour-matters card; blue is the half the vocabulary can express.

kept.name: Haunted Cadaver
kept.why: "you may sacrifice it. If you do, that player discards three cards" is a self-sacrifice paid for an upside, and neither half was written down.

kept.name: Pentagram of the Ages
kept.why: The card had no facet describing what it does at all: it taps to prevent damage from a source of your choice.

kept.name: Obelisk of Undoing
kept.why: Nothing recorded the ability. "{6}, {T}: Return target permanent you both own and control to your hand" is a tap cost returning your own permanent to hand.

kept.name: Saheeli's Silverwing
kept.why: The enters trigger looks at the top of an opponent's library and no facet mentioned the library at all.

kept.name: Scuttling Death
kept.why: Soulshift 4 triggers when this creature dies. Crawling Filth in the same batch carries trig:dies for the identical keyword; this one was missing it.

kept.name: Caregiver
kept.why: The cost is "Sacrifice a creature", any creature, which cost:sacrifice already says. cost:sacrifice-self means a card that eats only itself, which this is not.

kept.name: Drought
kept.why: "Spells cost an additional Sacrifice a Swamp to cast for each black mana symbol" is the entire point of the card and the list held only the upkeep trigger.

kept.name: Serra's Liturgy
kept.why: The destroy ability's activation cost is sacrificing this enchantment itself, which is exactly what cost:sacrifice-self means.

kept.name: Robo-Piñata
kept.why: "When Robo-Piñata dies, choose one —" is a modal effect and nothing recorded the choice.

kept.name: Angel's Herald
kept.why: The ability taps and searches your library; the tap cost and the library zone were both missing.

kept.name: Irradiate
kept.why: "gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each artifact you control" makes a creature smaller, not bigger. This is a removal spell filed as a combat trick.

kept.name: Bone Flute
kept.why: -1/-0 to all creatures kills nothing, because toughness is untouched. scope:wipe means destroying the whole board including yours, and this destroys nothing.

kept.name: Sanctified Charge
kept.why: "White creatures you control also gain first strike" is a colour condition and no facet recorded it.

kept.name: Worms of the Earth
kept.why: The list held only the upkeep trigger. It deals 5 damage, and its two land-denial lines have no word at all.

kept.name: Tourach's Chant
kept.why: "Whenever a player puts a Forest onto the battlefield" is a permanent-entering trigger on someone else's permanent, and the damage is a punisher the player can decline by paying a -1/-1 counter.

kept.name: Corrupting Licid
kept.why: The activated ability costs {T} (no cost:tap recorded) and its whole payload is "Attach it to target creature", which is eff:attach and was missing entirely.

kept.name: Proud Mentor
kept.why: Partner with is a triggered ability: "When this creature enters, target player may put Impetuous Protege into their hand from their library". The search was recorded but the trigger that causes it was not.

kept.name: Plow Through Reito
kept.why: "Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Plains returned this way" is the entire payoff of the card and no pump word was recorded. The Plains bounce was read and the reason for it was not.

kept.name: Aurora Eidolon
kept.why: Three clauses unread. "Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to any target" is eff:prevent-damage; the ability costs sacrificing itself; and "return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is self-recursion, which is what makes it repeatable. Generic eff:return-from was recorded but not the precise self word.

kept.name: Assembly Hall
kept.why: The ability costs {4} and {T}; cost:tap was missing. It also both checks your hand ("Reveal a creature card in your hand") and puts the found card there, which is a genuine hand-zone interaction.

kept.name: Pure Intentions
kept.why: The second ability returns THIS card from the graveyard to hand when an opponent discards it, so it brings itself back. Only the generic eff:return-from was recorded.

kept.name: Rising Miasma
kept.why: The awaken half was not read at all. It puts three +1/+1 counters on target land you control (eff:add-counters), turns that land into a 0/0 Elemental creature (eff:animate) and gives it haste (grants:haste). Only the -2/-2 sweep was recorded.

kept.name: Stalwart Aven
kept.why: Renown puts the +1/+1 counter on THIS creature and nothing else, so this is the self word, not the generic one. The generic verb makes a creature that only grows itself read as a counters-matters card, which is the split eff:add-counters-self exists for (cf. Dead Reveler and Purraj in the same batch, both correctly self-only).

kept.name: Baton of Courage
kept.why: Sunburst was left unread. It enters with charge counters on itself (eff:add-counters-self, same shape as unleash on Dead Reveler) and the number of them is decided by how many colours of mana were spent casting it, which is exactly cares:mana-spent.

kept.name: Jubilant Mascot
kept.why: "you may pay {3}{W}. If you do, support 2" is the pay-for-more shape. Purraj of Urborg in this same batch carries eff:do-if-cost-paid for the identical wording.

kept.name: Joven's Tools
kept.why: The ability is "{4}, {T}" and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Faithful Squire // Kaiso, Memory of Loyalty
kept.why: Only the end-step trigger and the back face's flying were read. Missing: the cast trigger ("Whenever you cast a Spirit or Arcane spell", yours specifically), the ki counter it puts on itself, the flip to its other face, and the whole back-face ability - remove a ki counter as a cost to prevent all damage to a creature.

kept.name: Living Armor
kept.why: The costs were read and the effect was not: "Put X +0/+1 counters on target creature" is eff:add-counters, and toughness counters make the creature bigger, so eff:pump too (Soldier On in this batch carries both for the same shape).

kept.name: Purgatory
kept.why: Only the upkeep trigger was read; both abilities were otherwise blank. It triggers on a nontoken creature being put into your graveyard from the battlefield (trig:dies), moves that card to exile, and later returns an exiled card to the battlefield for {4} and 2 life. Deliberately eff:move-zone rather than eff:exile: this exiles your OWN dead creatures as setup for reanimation, and eff:exile would confer the removal role on a card that answers nothing. Deliberately not eff:exile-graveyard either, which is hate.

kept.name: Sandals of Abdallah
kept.why: The second sentence was unread: "When that creature dies this turn, destroy this artifact." That is a death trigger and a destruction of your own permanent. eff:destroy rather than eff:destroy-own would misfile a self-destructing artifact as removal.

kept.name: Mercadian Lift
kept.why: Only the counter-adding half was read. The second ability removes X winch counters (a counter-removal cost) to put a creature from your HAND straight onto the battlefield, which is exactly eff:put-onto-battlefield. None of the three was recorded.

kept.name: Arrogant Bloodlord
kept.why: The trigger checks "a creature with power 1 or less" (cares:power) and its effect destroys this creature, your own permanent. Only the two trigger words were recorded and the whole effect was missing.

kept.name: Yawgmoth Demon
kept.why: "tap this creature and it deals 2 damage to you" - the damage half was read, the tap half was not. It taps your own permanent, so eff:tap-own rather than eff:tap.

kept.name: Gust Walker
kept.why: Exerting gives it +1/+1 as well as flying. grants:flying was recorded and the +1/+1 was dropped entirely.

kept.name: Calming Licid
kept.why: Almost the whole card was unread. The ability costs {W} and {T} (cost:tap), it attaches itself to a creature as an Aura (eff:attach), and the enchanted creature can't attack (eff:cant-attack) - that last clause is the entire point of the card and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Soratami Cloud Chariot
kept.why: The second activated ability prevents all combat damage to and by target creature. Only the flying-granting ability was read.

kept.name: Endemic Plague
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" is a cast cost, not an activated sacrifice outlet - Death Bomb in this same batch uses cost:cast-sacrifice for the identical wording. Left as cost:sacrifice it reads as a repeatable outlet, which a one-shot sorcery is not.

kept.name: Sicken
kept.why: The aura gives -1/-1. That is a shrink, not a pump - Ghoulflesh in this same batch has the identical -1/-1 clause and is correctly tagged eff:shrink. As it stands this removal aura reads as a creature buff.

kept.name: Essence Bottle
kept.why: Only the counter-adding ability was read. The payoff ability removes all elixir counters (a counter-removal cost) to gain 2 life for each, and the life gain - the whole purpose of the card - was not recorded at all.

kept.name: Fairgrounds Patrol
kept.why: Its only ability is activated by exiling it FROM YOUR GRAVEYARD, so the card wants to be in the graveyard. cost:exile-self was recorded but nothing said which zone it operates from.

kept.name: Wall of Tombstones
kept.why: "change this creature's base toughness to 1 plus the number of creature cards in your graveyard" sets a characteristic outright. The upkeep trigger and the graveyard care were recorded but the effect it performs was not.

kept.name: Slayer's Cleaver
kept.why: Equipped creature gets +3/+1 (no pump recorded) and "must be blocked by an Eldrazi if able" is a lure effect, which is what eff:force-block describes. Only the attach and the Eldrazi care were read.

kept.name: Boneshard Slasher
kept.why: Threshold gives it +2/+2. The graveyard condition was recorded and the effect it enables was not. I have deliberately not added a sacrifice word for the granted "sacrifice it" clause - that is a drawback and would read as an aristocrats enabler.

kept.name: Security Blockade
kept.why: The enchanted land gains "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you." The token half was read and the granted ability - half the card - was not.

kept.name: Deepcavern Imp
kept.why: Echo-Discard a card is a cost paid from hand. eff:discard-self records that you discard; nothing recorded that it is a cost. Not cost:discard-self, which is for discarding this card itself (as on Sicken's cycling).

kept.name: Ambitious Aetherborn
kept.why: Fabricate 1 triggers when this creature enters. Both outcomes (counter or token) were recorded but the trigger that produces them was missing entirely, so nothing marks it as an enters-the-battlefield card.

kept.name: Spire Mangler
kept.why: The ETB gives a flying creature +2/+0 and nothing recorded that it pumps at all.

kept.name: Basri's Aegis
kept.why: The whole second sentence was unread: it searches your library AND graveyard for a card, puts it into your hand, then shuffles. Only the counters clause had been recorded.

kept.name: Exhumer Thrull
kept.why: The trigger is a genuine two-event one, 'when this enters OR the creature it haunts dies'. Only the dies half was recorded, so the enters half is invisible.

kept.name: Stain the Mind
kept.why: It exiles from hand and library as well as the graveyard, so the general exile verb is missing, and the graveyard zone it searches is not recorded. Nothing on this card refers to the colour black; cares:color:b is a scan of the mana cost and would file a generic name-stripping sorcery as a black-matters card.

kept.name: War Oracle
kept.why: Renown puts the +1/+1 counter on ITSELF and on nothing else. The generic word reads as a counters deck; the -self word is what this card actually does.

kept.name: Death-Mask Duplicant
kept.why: It exiles creature cards out of your graveyard and then reads the cards in exile for their keywords, and neither zone was recorded. The text names haste, double strike and trample alongside the flying and first strike already listed.

kept.name: Clockwork Avian
kept.why: Every counter goes on itself, so the generic word misfiles it as a counters payoff. The end-of-combat clause takes a counter OFF and was not recorded at all, and the pump ability costs {X} and a tap.

kept.name: Inventive Wingsmith
kept.why: The end-step trigger was recorded and what it DOES was not: it puts a flying counter on itself, which both grows it with a counter and makes it an evasive creature.

kept.name: Femeref Knight
kept.why: Flanking triggers when a creature BLOCKS this one and gives that blocker -1/-1. Nothing on this card pumps anything; the vigilance ability grants a keyword only.

kept.name: Entropic Eidolon
kept.why: The second ability returns this card from your own graveyard to your hand whenever you cast a multicoloured spell. Only the generic return verb was there, so its self-recursion is unreadable.

kept.name: Scrying Glass
kept.why: The payoff of the whole card is 'you draw a card' and no effect word was recorded at all. The ability also costs a tap.

kept.name: Unliving Psychopath
kept.why: The removal ability costs {B} and a tap; the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Avenging Angel
kept.why: When it dies it puts ITSELF back on top of its owner's library. The generic move-zone verb hides that this is a self-recurring threat.

kept.name: Lairwatch Giant
kept.why: It triggers when IT blocks two or more creatures, not when it is blocked. trig:blocks is already there and is the correct one.

kept.name: Loxodon Anchorite
kept.why: Its only ability prevents 2 damage and taps to do it, and neither was recorded, so the card reads as doing nothing.

kept.name: Tablet of Epityr
kept.why: The trigger was recorded and its effect was not: you may pay {1}, and if you do you gain 1 life.

kept.name: Rampart Crawler
kept.why: 'Can't be blocked by Walls' is conditional evasion and nothing recorded it, the same shape as the swampwalk creatures in this batch which do carry the word.

kept.name: Chimeric Coils
kept.why: The ability turns the artifact into an X/X creature and no effect word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Viscid Lemures
kept.why: It gives itself swampwalk, which is evasion. The grant was recorded but not what the grant achieves, unlike the other swampwalk creatures in this batch.

kept.name: Samite Healer
kept.why: The whole card is "{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to any target" and neither the tap cost nor the prevention was recorded, so the list said nothing at all about what it does.

kept.name: Exotic Curse
kept.why: "Enchant creature" - it is an Aura that attaches to a creature, which nothing in the list recorded.

kept.name: Banshee
kept.why: "{X}, {T}: ... deals half X damage ... to any target, and half X damage ... to you." The tap cost and the damage it deals to its own controller were both unrecorded.

kept.name: Vicious Betrayal
kept.why: The pump (+2/+2 for each creature sacrificed) was missing entirely. The sacrifice is "as an additional cost to cast this spell", which is cost:cast-sacrifice; cost:sacrifice means an on-demand outlet, which this is not - it cannot eat a creature at instant speed or repeatedly.

kept.name: Mire's Malice
kept.why: Awaken 3 was left unread. It puts three +1/+1 counters on a land you control and turns that land into a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste, so it genuinely adds counters, animates a permanent and grants haste.

kept.name: Parallax Nexus
kept.why: Only the fading keyword and the leave trigger were recorded. Removing a fade counter is the activation cost, the ability exiles a card from an opponent's hand, and the leave trigger returns every card exiled with it from exile to its owner's hand.

kept.name: Amulet of Kroog
kept.why: Its one ability, "{2}, {T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to any target", produced no judgement words at all.

kept.name: Steadfast Sentinel
kept.why: Eternalize is activated from the graveyard by exiling this card, and it brings the creature back as a token copy of itself. The list recorded the copy and the token but not that the card recurs itself out of the graveyard at its own exile cost.

kept.name: Surprise Deployment
kept.why: The delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step returns the creature you put onto the battlefield to your hand, which is a bounce of your own creature and a step trigger; both were missing. scope:all is wrong - it puts one creature onto the battlefield and affects nothing else.

kept.name: Sworn Defender
kept.why: "This creature's power becomes the toughness of target creature ... and its toughness becomes 1 plus the power of that creature" sets power and toughness outright and reads the other creature's power. Neither was recorded, so the card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Kyren Archive
kept.why: Only the upkeep trigger was recorded. It exiles the top card of your library each upkeep and the activated ability costs discarding your hand and sacrificing itself to return every card exiled with it to its owner's hand. I deliberately did not add eff:exile: the cards exiled are your own library cards held in reserve, and eff:exile is what the engine reads as removal.

kept.name: Phyrexian War Beast
kept.why: "Sacrifice a land and this creature deals 1 damage to you" affects one land and its own controller. scope:all would tell the engine this is a mass effect.

kept.name: Heroic Teamwork
kept.why: Teamwork taps creatures as an additional cost to CAST, which is cost:cast-tap-others (the same shape as convoke); cost:tap-others is for an activated ability that taps other creatures. It also cares about total power 3 or more, and the card draw is conditional on having paid that cost.

kept.name: Silumgar Butcher
kept.why: Exploit is "When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature", so this is an enters trigger on itself. Nothing recorded that the card does anything when it arrives.

kept.name: Pit Spawn
kept.why: "Whenever this creature deals damage to a creature, exile that creature" is real removal and was not recorded - the list had the trigger but not what the trigger does.

kept.name: Death Charmer
kept.why: "that creature's controller loses 2 life unless they pay {2}" is a tax on the opponent, which eff:unless-pays names exactly.

kept.name: Null Caller
kept.why: It makes one 2/2 Zombie token for one exiled creature card. Nothing about it is mass, and scope:all reads as "affects everything".

kept.name: Weakstone
kept.why: "Attacking creatures get -1/-0" makes creatures smaller. eff:pump is the opposite of what the card does and would offer this as a way to make your own team bigger.

kept.name: Telethopter
kept.why: The cost taps one untapped creature you control and the effect gives flying to this creature alone. Nothing is affected in bulk.

kept.name: Rise of Extus
kept.why: Learn was left unread: it either fetches a Lesson from outside the game or discards a card to draw a card. It also exiles a card from a graveyard, which the list did not record as caring about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Eye of Yawgmoth
kept.why: The activation taps the artifact and the effect reveals cards from the top of your library, neither of which was recorded. I did not add eff:exile - the cards exiled are the rest of your own reveal, not an opponent's permanent, and eff:exile is what the engine reads as removal.

kept.name: Nimana Sell-Sword
kept.why: The trigger reads "whenever THIS CREATURE or another Ally you control enters", so it fires on its own arrival as well as on other Allies - trig:enters-other was recorded and trig:enters-self was not. scope:all is wrong: the only effect is "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature", a single permanent, so nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Urborg Panther
kept.why: The second ability sacrifices a creature named Feral Shadow AND a creature named Breathstealer as well as itself, so it eats OTHER creatures - cost:sacrifice-self alone understates it. It also ends "then shuffle", which eff:shuffle names and nothing on the list did.

kept.name: Gore Vassal
kept.why: "Put a -1/-1 counter on target creature" makes that creature permanently smaller and kills an X/1. The list recorded the counter mechanics (eff:add-counters, ctr:-1/-1) but nothing said the card diminishes a creature, which is what it is for.

kept.name: Drudge Sentinel
kept.why: The ability is "{3}: Tap this creature. It gains indestructible until end of turn." There is no power or toughness change anywhere on the card, so eff:pump is false; grants:indestructible already carries what the ability does.

kept.name: Touch of the Eternal
kept.why: "Your life total becomes that number" is a life-total assignment, not a gain or a loss, and eff:set-life is exactly the word for it. The list carried only the upkeep timing and said nothing about what the trigger does.

kept.name: Gravegouger
kept.why: The list recorded only that it has an enters trigger and a leaves trigger, and nothing about what either one does. It exiles up to two cards from a single graveyard, which is graveyard hate (eff:exile-graveyard, cares:zone:graveyard), and on leaving it moves those cards out of exile back to a graveyard (cares:zone:exile, eff:move-zone). eff:return-from is deliberately not proposed: the cards go back to a GRAVEYARD, not to hand or battlefield, so calling this recursion would misfile it.

kept.name: Fen Hauler
kept.why: "This creature can't be blocked by artifact creatures" is conditional evasion and was not written down at all - cares:type:artifact came from improvise and says nothing about how it gets through.

kept.name: Curse Artifact
kept.why: The whole card is "at the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted artifact's controller...", a recurring upkeep trigger, and the timing was missing entirely. eff:attach was deliberately not added: this Aura enchants an ARTIFACT, so treating it as a creature attachment would file a punisher as an enhancement.

kept.name: Krovikan Fetish
kept.why: It is an Aura that enchants a creature and gives it +1/+1, so it attaches to a creature - the same thing eff:attach records for Equipment and other creature Auras. Nothing on the list said the card sticks to a creature at all.

kept.name: Undercity Scavenger
kept.why: "You may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature, then scry 2" is an optional cost paid for a bigger effect, which is what eff:do-if-cost-paid names. scope:all is wrong: one creature is sacrificed and the counters go on this creature only, so nothing is mass.

kept.name: Ghosts of the Innocent
kept.why: "If A SOURCE would deal damage to A PERMANENT OR PLAYER, it deals half that damage instead" is a global replacement covering every source and every recipient, including your own. eff:prevent-damage was recorded without any note that it applies to the whole table.

kept.name: Diplomacy of the Wastes
kept.why: The final clause is "that player loses 2 life" and no drain word was on the list; only the discard half had been read.

kept.name: Cyclopean Tomb
kept.why: The death trigger's whole job is "remove all mire counters from a land", which eff:remove-counters names and the list did not carry, and that trigger recurs "at the beginning of each of your upkeeps", so the upkeep timing was missing too.

kept.name: Martyr's Cry
kept.why: "For each creature exiled this way, ITS CONTROLLER draws a card" makes every player with an exiled white creature draw, not just you. eff:draw alone reads as a card-advantage spell for its caster, which is the opposite of what this symmetrical effect does. scope:wipe was deliberately not added - the exile is restricted to white creatures, and this project keeps that word for unrestricted board destruction.

kept.name: Shapeshifter
kept.why: The card's entire text is a power and toughness assignment ("power is equal to the last chosen number and its toughness is 7 minus that number") and eff:set-pt was absent, so the list said only that it does something at upkeep. "As this creature enters, choose a number" is also an entry event and neither enters word was present.

kept.name: Phyrexian Scuta
kept.why: Kicker - Pay 3 life is an optional ADDITIONAL COST PAID AS YOU CAST, which cost:cast-life names precisely; the recorded cost:life reads as an activated-ability cost and this card has no activated ability. "If this creature was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters" is the paid-for bonus, which is eff:do-if-cost-paid.

kept.name: Razorjaw Oni
kept.why: "Black creatures can't block" was recorded only as scope:all with no verb, so the list said the card affects everything without saying what it does. eff:cant-block is exactly a blocking prohibition placed on other creatures.

kept.name: Haunting Misery
kept.why: The exile is stated as "an additional cost to cast this spell", which is the distinction cost:cast-exile draws against the general cost:exile already present. eff:exile-graveyard was deliberately not added - these are your OWN creature cards being spent as fuel, not graveyard hate.

kept.name: Lingering Phantom
kept.why: "Whenever YOU cast a historic spell" is your own cast, not any player's, so the bare trig:cast understates it. "You may pay {B}. If you do" is eff:do-if-cost-paid. Most importantly the card returns ITSELF from your graveyard to your hand, which is exactly eff:recur-self - the generic eff:return-from on the list reads as recursion of other cards and hides that this is a self-recurring body.

kept.name: Chimeric Idol
kept.why: "becomes a 3/3 Turtle artifact creature until end of turn" is turning a permanent into a creature and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Crippling Fatigue
kept.why: The flashback cost is {1}{B} AND "Pay 3 life". Paying life to cast is a real cost and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Master Healer
kept.why: The card's entire text is a tap ability that prevents 4 damage, and the list carried nothing but the type line and subtypes.

kept.name: Childhood Horror
kept.why: Threshold gives it +2/+2 (a self pump) and takes away its ability to block. Neither clause was read - only the graveyard condition was.

kept.name: Enfeeblement
kept.why: Enchanted creature gets -2/-2. That is a shrink, not a pump - eff:pump would tell a deck builder this is an anthem. It is also an Aura that attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Temple Thief
kept.why: "can't be blocked by enchanted creatures or enchantment creatures" is conditional evasion, the same shape as landwalk, and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Vexing Arcanix
kept.why: The ability costs {3} and a tap, and it reveals the top card of a library.

kept.name: Tuinvale Guide
kept.why: Celebration gives it +1/+0 and lifelink. The keyword was recorded as printed but neither the pump nor the grant was.

kept.name: Dread Charge
kept.why: It makes every black creature you control unblockable, not one target.

kept.name: Ventifact Bottle
kept.why: The upkeep trigger taps the artifact and removes all charge counters from it before adding mana. Both halves were unread.

kept.name: Sun's Bounty
kept.why: Recover triggers when a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, which is a creature-dying trigger and is why this card belongs in a sacrifice deck.

kept.name: Puffer Extract
kept.why: "Destroy it at the beginning of the next end step" destroys your own creature. Only the pump half was read, which makes the card look strictly good.

kept.name: Ritual of Steel
kept.why: Enchant creature - it attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Warp Artifact
kept.why: The damage happens at the beginning of the enchanted artifact's controller's upkeep and the trigger timing was not recorded.

kept.name: Absolving Lammasu
kept.why: Suspecting an opponent's creature stops it blocking, which is the mechanically relevant half of suspect. I left menace off deliberately - it is given to an OPPONENT's creature, so grants:menace would read as a benefit to your own board.

kept.name: Nighthawk, Dark Defender
kept.why: It triggers on Nighthawk's own arrival as well as on other Heroes. scope:all is wrong: the effect is "target creature gets +1/+1", a single target, not a global pump.

kept.name: Ghastly Remains
kept.why: "if this card is in your graveyard, you may pay {B}{B}{B}. If you do, return it to your hand" is the card bringing itself back, which is exactly what eff:recur-self names.

kept.name: Glyph of Doom
kept.why: The card destroys creatures and carried no effect word whatsoever - it read as a card that only cares about Walls.

kept.name: Mind Whip
kept.why: "that player may pay {3}. If they don't..." is a tax on the opponent. It is also an Aura on a creature, and the trigger is specifically an upkeep.

kept.name: Call for Blood
kept.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature" is a cast cost, not a repeatable sacrifice outlet. cost:sacrifice would file this as an outlet an aristocrats deck can rely on, which it is not.

kept.name: Netter en-Dal
kept.why: The ability costs {W}, a tap, and discarding a card. Neither cost was recorded.

kept.name: Stronghold Taskmaster
kept.why: "Other black creatures get -1/-1" shrinks the board, it does not pump it - as written this card looked like a black anthem. It also genuinely cares about the colour black.

kept.name: Rune of Protection: Lands
kept.why: The whole point of the card is preventing damage and only the cycling half had been read.

kept.name: Ritual of the Returned
kept.why: It creates a Zombie token, which was entirely missing, and it uses a creature card in your graveyard as the resource, so it is a graveyard-value card rather than only graveyard hate.

kept.name: Chain of Silence
kept.why: "they may copy this spell" was unread. The sacrifice is the OPPONENT optionally giving up a land as part of the effect, not a cost you pay, so cost:sacrifice would wrongly file this as a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Mishra's Groundbreaker
kept.why: It turns a land into a 3/3 creature and that clause was completely unread; the ability also costs a tap.

kept.name: Infernal Caretaker
kept.why: It returns ALL Zombie cards from ALL graveyards, a mass recursion, and nothing marked it as global.

kept.name: Hypnotic Cloud
kept.why: Kicker {4} makes the discard three cards instead of one, which is exactly "gives more if you pay", and only the printed keyword was recorded.

kept.name: Phyrexian Grimoire
kept.why: The list held nothing but the type line. The ability taps, reads the top two cards of your graveyard, and returns one of them to your hand.

kept.name: Ruthless Cullblade
kept.why: It gets +2/+1 while an opponent is at 10 or less life and the list carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Leap of Faith
kept.why: Preventing all damage to a creature was entirely unread, and that is the card's protective half. eff:pump is wrong - nothing here changes power or toughness, the card only grants flying, which grants:flying already records.

kept.name: Noble Steeds
kept.why: "gains first strike" changes no power or toughness. grants:first strike already carries the whole effect; eff:pump falsely marks this as a pump source.

kept.name: Stone Haven Pilgrim
kept.why: Granting itself lifelink on attack means the deck gains life, which is what a lifegain payoff is looking for. eff:pump is correct here - it really does get +1/+1.

kept.name: Soul Charmer
kept.why: The whole payoff clause was unread: it gains 2 life, and it taxes the opponent {2} to stop it. Only the trigger was recorded.

kept.name: Ironclad Revolutionary
kept.why: "You may sacrifice an artifact. If you do..." is the pay-for-more shape; the optionality was not recorded.

kept.name: Wicked Reward
kept.why: It pumps ONE target creature. Nothing here affects everything.

kept.name: Cabal Surgeon
kept.why: Returns a single target creature card. Not a mass effect.

kept.name: Salt Road Patrol
kept.why: Outlast is {1}{W}, {T}: put a counter on it. The tap in the cost was dropped.

kept.name: Sphere of Reason
kept.why: It keys on a BLUE source dealing damage. Its sibling Sphere of Truth correctly carries cares:color:w and this one carries no colour word at all.

kept.name: Vampire Hounds
kept.why: It pumps only itself. No mass selector anywhere on the card.

kept.name: Hypochondria
kept.why: "{W}, Discard a card:" is an activation COST, which makes this a repeatable discard outlet. It was filed as an effect that makes you discard, which loses the outlet.

kept.name: Desperate Research
kept.why: It reveals the top seven cards of your library; the library interaction was unrecorded. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile - the exile is of your own revealed leftovers, and eff:exile would file this as removal.

kept.name: Kami of the Painted Road
kept.why: "Whenever YOU cast a Spirit or Arcane spell" is a self-cast trigger. Only the undirected trig:cast was present, which does not separate it from an opponent-cast tax card.

kept.name: Planeswalker's Scorn
kept.why: The card had NOTHING but its activation cost. It gives -X/-X and reveals a card from the opponent's hand; both clauses were unread.

kept.name: Nav Squad Commandos
kept.why: Battalion gives it +1/+1 as well as untapping it. Only the untap was recorded.

kept.name: Rhystic Shield
kept.why: The additional +0/+2 is taxed "unless any player pays {2}" - the rhystic clause the card is named for was not read.

kept.name: Fylgja
kept.why: Only the counter-adding half was read. It prevents damage, pays for that by removing a healing counter, and it is an Aura that attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Painbringer
kept.why: The ability costs {T} as well as the graveyard exile. The tap was dropped.

kept.name: Nakaya Shade
kept.why: The pump only happens unless a player pays {2}; the tax clause was unread.

kept.name: Stench of Decay
kept.why: A symmetric -1/-1 to all nonartifact creatures kills your own small creatures too, which is the anti-synergy scope:wipe exists to flag. Plague Dogs in this same batch carries it for the identical -1/-1 shape.

kept.name: Warlord's Elite
kept.why: This is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, not an activated ability cost. The cast- form is the correct word, the same distinction Wicked Reward draws with cost:cast-sacrifice.

kept.name: Opal Titan
kept.why: It becomes a 4/4 with protection from the spell's colours. The animation was read and the protection it grants itself was not.

kept.name: Rhet-Crop Spearmaster
kept.why: Exerting gives +1/+0 as well as first strike. Only the keyword grant was recorded.

kept.name: Spirit Shackle
kept.why: The card had no effect words at all. It puts a -0/-2 counter on the enchanted creature, which both adds a counter and makes it smaller, and it is an Aura that attaches.

kept.name: Bog Down
kept.why: Kicker is an additional cast cost of sacrificing two lands, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Songstitcher
kept.why: The whole card is a damage prevention ability and no effect word was recorded at all. It also keys on the target having flying.

kept.name: Nimana Skitter-Sneak
kept.why: The static ability gives itself +1/+0 and menace under a graveyard condition; neither the pump nor the granted keyword was recorded.

kept.name: Urza's Miter
kept.why: The payoff clause was never read: it draws a card, and only if you choose to pay {3}.

kept.name: Ivory Charm
kept.why: The third mode prevents damage and was unread. scope:wipe is wrong: -2/-0 leaves toughness untouched, so nothing dies and no board is destroyed.

kept.name: Repentant Vampire
kept.why: The trigger is on a creature dying and it puts the counter on itself; the dies trigger and the self-counter direction were both missing.

kept.name: Planeswalker's Mirth
kept.why: Carried no effect word at all. It gains life and reads a card from the opponent's hand.

kept.name: Revenant Patriarch
kept.why: Nothing about what it does was recorded: it makes a player skip a combat phase, it cannot block, and the whole enters ability is conditional on {W} having been spent to cast it.

kept.name: Toxic Abomination
kept.why: YOU lose 2 life. eff:lose-life reads as draining an opponent, so this card is filed as a drain payoff when it is a drawback on a 2/1. Same direction split the engine already makes for damage and discard.

kept.name: Shriek of Dread
kept.why: eff:pump is wrong: no power or toughness changes anywhere on this card. It only grants fear, which grants:fear already records.

kept.name: Molten-Tail Masticore
kept.why: The upkeep clause sacrifices it unless you discard, and neither half was recorded.

kept.name: Circle of Protection: Shadow
kept.why: Carried no effect word. The entire card is damage prevention.

kept.name: Wellgabber Apothecary
kept.why: Carried no effect word. The ability prevents all damage to a target.

kept.name: Urborg Shambler
kept.why: eff:pump is backwards: -1/-1 makes creatures smaller. It is a static anthem keyed on the colour black.

kept.name: Wave of Terror
kept.why: It destroys EACH creature of a mana value, which is a mass effect. Not scope:wipe, because the mana value restriction makes it a filtered sweep rather than a board wipe.

kept.name: Clergy en-Vec
kept.why: Carried no effect word and no cost word. It taps to prevent damage.

kept.name: Sentry Oak
kept.why: Winning the clash gives it +2/+0, which was unread.

kept.name: Spinal Graft
kept.why: It is an Aura, so it attaches to a creature, and its trigger fires when the enchanted creature is targeted.

kept.name: Hired Muscle // Scarmaker
kept.why: Almost nothing was read. It triggers on your own casts, puts ki counters on itself, flips to its other face, and the back removes a counter as a cost to grant fear.

kept.name: Clockwork Swarm
kept.why: The counters go on and come off ITSELF, the activated ability taps, and the shrink clause is an end-of-combat step trigger. Only the generic eff:add-counters was recorded.

kept.name: Haazda Shield Mate
kept.why: Neither half was recorded: it sacrifices itself on upkeep unless paid for, and its ability prevents damage.

kept.name: Greater Realm of Preservation
kept.why: Carried no effect word although the whole card prevents damage, and it reads "black or red source" while only red was recorded.

kept.name: Xanthic Statue
kept.why: Carried no effect word. It turns itself into an 8/8 creature with trample.

kept.name: Outbreak
kept.why: The -1/-1 on all creatures of a type was never read, and the alternative cost is a discard.

kept.name: Withstand
kept.why: rec:partial - the whole first line was never read. It prevents 3 damage to any target and then draws.

kept.name: Wolf in _____ Clothing
kept.why: rec:partial - the trigger is recorded but not what it does. The sticker gives up to X target creatures -1/-1.

kept.name: Moorland Inquisitor
kept.why: It gains first strike and nothing touches power or toughness. grants:first strike already carries the keyword; eff:pump means a P/T change, as Dovin's Automaton (+2/+2 and vigilance) shows by carrying both.

kept.name: Kor Sky Climber
kept.why: Same as Moorland Inquisitor - gains flying, no P/T change. Gustrider Exuberant grants flying and correctly carries no eff:pump.

kept.name: Scarred Vinebreeder
kept.why: It pumps only itself for a cost. Nothing here affects everything - scope:all is a scan artefact, probably off 'Exile an Elf card from your graveyard'.

kept.name: Mana Skimmer
kept.why: rec:partial - the trigger was read and its effect was not. It taps a land the damaged player controls.

kept.name: Lost Order of Jarkeld
kept.why: rec:partial - eff:choose covers 'choose an opponent' but not the second line, which is a characteristic-defining ability setting its own power and toughness.

kept.name: Nova Pentacle
kept.why: The ability costs {3}, {T} and the tap was never recorded.

kept.name: Samite Sanctuary
kept.why: The card has no effect word at all - its entire text is a repeatable damage prevention shield.

kept.name: Fleet-Footed Monk
kept.why: No rec: facet and no effect word - the compiler read nothing. 'Can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or greater' is conditional evasion, which is what eff:cant-be-blocked is for.

kept.name: Knowledge Vault
kept.why: rec:partial - only the sacrifice and the leaves trigger were read. The first ability costs {T}, the second discards your own hand, and cards move library to exile to hand or graveyard. eff:exile is deliberately NOT proposed: it confers the removal role and this exiles your own library, so eff:move-zone is the honest word.

kept.name: Vibrating Sphere
kept.why: Only the +2/+0 half was read. On other players' turns it gives your creatures -0/-2, which is the other half of the card.

kept.name: Broken Visage
kept.why: rec:partial - only the destroy was read. It also creates a Spirit token and then sacrifices that token at the next end step.

kept.name: Scavenging Harpy
kept.why: This is graveyard hate, not removal. Per the standing convention eff:exile-graveyard is kept apart from eff:exile, and leaving eff:exile on it makes an opponent's-graveyard exile read as an answer to a creature.

kept.name: Gustrider Exuberant
kept.why: The grant is a mass effect on your board - 'Creatures you control with power 5 or greater gain flying' - the same shape as Warrior's Honor, which carries scope:all.

kept.name: Sandstone Deadfall
kept.why: It destroys ONE target attacking creature. scope:all is a scan artefact off 'Sacrifice two lands', and it makes a single-target removal artifact read as a board wipe.

kept.name: Andradite Leech
kept.why: rec:partial - only the pump ability was read. The static line makes your black spells cost {B} more, which is unwritten. (cares:color:b deliberately not added: the colour reference is a penalty on your own spells, not a black-matters payoff.)

kept.name: Quickening Licid
kept.why: rec:partial - the activation costs {1}{W} and {T}, and the ability attaches the Licid to a target creature as an Aura. Neither was recorded.

kept.name: Haunting Echoes
kept.why: Nothing on this card touches a hand - it exiles a graveyard and then the matching cards from that player's library. cares:zone:hand is wrong. (eff:search-library deliberately not added: it searches the TARGET player's library, and that word means you tutor from your own.)

kept.name: Wayward Angel
kept.why: rec:partial - threshold gives +3/+3 (unread) and an upkeep trigger. cost:sacrifice is a misfile that matters: that word means an on-demand outlet, and this is a FORCED upkeep sacrifice with no choice, so it currently reads as an aristocrats enabler when it is a drawback.

kept.name: Bone Mask
kept.why: The whole point of the card is 'prevent that damage' and it had no prevention word at all; the ability also costs {T}.

kept.name: Steppe Glider
kept.why: The activated ability grants flying AND vigilance; only grants:vigilance was recorded.

kept.name: Cabal Inquisitor
kept.why: 'Target player discards a card' hits one player. scope:all means the effect touches everything, which this does not.

kept.name: Life Matrix
kept.why: The ability costs {4}, {T} and the tap cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Junk Golem
kept.why: The upkeep trigger sacrifices the creature unless you pay a +1/+1 counter. Neither the sacrifice nor the recurring counter payment was written down.

kept.name: Runed Arch
kept.why: The ability costs {X}, {T}, Sacrifice; only the sacrifice was recorded.

kept.name: Straw Golem
kept.why: The only effect is sacrificing itself. Nothing about this card affects everything.

kept.name: Stromgald Spy
kept.why: The card's entire effect is making the defending player play with their hand revealed, and no facet described it at all. Also proposing a word for the effect itself.

kept.name: Angel of Fury
kept.why: The death trigger shuffles it from the graveyard into the library and neither the shuffle nor the zone change was recorded.

kept.name: Flowstone Sculpture
kept.why: Discarding a card is the activation cost, and the ability is modal (a counter, or one of three keywords).

kept.name: Organ Grinder
kept.why: 'Target player loses 3 life' is a single target, not a global effect.

kept.name: Sadistic Augermage
kept.why: The list held only trig:dies. The trigger makes EACH player move a card from hand to the top of their library, which is a symmetrical zone-change effect touching both zones.

kept.name: Night // Day
kept.why: Only the Night half (-1/-1) was read. The Day half pumps every creature a target player controls, so both the pump and the mass scope are missing.

kept.name: Grave Servitude
kept.why: +3/-1 is a pump as well as a shrink, and it is an Aura that attaches to a creature.

kept.name: Pyramids
kept.why: The ability opens 'Choose one —' and the modal nature was not recorded.

kept.name: Corrupt Official
kept.why: Regenerating itself keeps it alive; the same effect was already recorded as eff:protect on Life Matrix, which merely grants regeneration.

kept.name: Stoic Champion
kept.why: The card gets +2/+2 whenever a player cycles and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Samite Censer-Bearer
kept.why: Prevention applies to each creature you control, which is a mass effect rather than a single target.

kept.name: Decompose
kept.why: A dedicated graveyard-hate spell that did not record caring about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Whirling Catapult
kept.why: Exiling the top two cards of your library is the activation cost, and the damage only hits creatures WITH FLYING, which is the card's whole selection rule.

kept.name: Fasting
kept.why: Skipping your draw step to gain 2 life is the reason the card exists and neither half was recorded.

kept.name: Vassal's Duty
kept.why: The redirected damage is dealt to YOU, and the purpose is keeping your legendary creature alive.

kept.name: Earthblighter
kept.why: 'Destroy target land' is one land, not a global effect.

kept.name: Benalish Lancer
kept.why: Kicker is exactly 'pay more, get more' and the extra counters plus first strike are conditional on it.

kept.name: Sword-Swallowing Seraph
kept.why: The +1/+1 counter ability costs {1}{W} and {T}. The tap cost was never recorded.

kept.name: Malach of the Dawn
kept.why: {W}{W}{W}: Regenerate this creature is a repeatable way to keep a creature alive, which is what eff:protect means. Draconian Cylix already carries it for the same effect.

kept.name: Draconian Cylix
kept.why: The ability costs {2}, {T} and a random discard. Neither the tap nor the discard was recorded as a cost. Left eff:discard-self alone: this is a repeatable discard outlet and that reading is still true, even if the discard is paid rather than caused.

kept.name: Chrome Replicator
kept.why: The entire enters trigger makes a 4/4 Construct token and the list records no effect at all, only the trigger.

kept.name: Auriok Siege Sled
kept.why: It has two abilities and only the first was read. The second, '{1}: Target artifact creature can't block this creature', is eff:cant-block.

kept.name: Pillar Tombs of Aku
kept.why: It triggers on EACH player's upkeep and taxes every player, not just an opponent. The symmetry is the defining thing about this card.

kept.name: Giant Slug
kept.why: The activated ability sets up a delayed trigger at the beginning of your next upkeep, so the card does have an upkeep trigger. Deliberately no evasion word: the landwalk type is chosen on resolution and eff:cant-be-blocked would claim a general unblockable creature.

kept.name: Glint Hawk Idol
kept.why: Both halves of the card turn this artifact into a 2/2 Bird creature with flying, and neither the animation nor the flying was recorded. eff:animate is the whole point of the card.

kept.name: Strength of Unity
kept.why: The Aura's only effect is +1/+1 for each basic land type and no effect word was recorded at all. Did not add eff:attach: that word is carried by Equipment and attach effects, not by every Aura's enchant line.

kept.name: Aether Searcher
kept.why: The enters trigger ends 'If you searched your library this way, shuffle', which was not recorded.

kept.name: Rag Dealer
kept.why: Its whole ability, '{2}{B}, {T}: Exile up to three target cards from a single graveyard', was completely unread. This is a repeatable graveyard hate creature and the list said nothing about graveyards at all.

kept.name: Mortiphobia
kept.why: Both abilities exile from a graveyard and eff:exile-graveyard is recorded, but the card was not marked as caring about the graveyard zone.

kept.name: Healer's Headdress
kept.why: The equipped creature gets +0/+2 and gains a quoted '{T}: Prevent the next 1 damage' ability. Neither the stat change nor the granted ability was read; only the attach half was.

kept.name: Leeching Licid
kept.why: The ability costs {B} and {T} and attaches this permanent to a creature, and the drain triggers at the enchanted creature's controller's upkeep. Only the damage clause had been read.

kept.name: Sangrophage
kept.why: The upkeep trigger is a recurring 2 life payment and no cost or effect word was recorded for it. Did not add eff:tap-own: it taps only itself as a drawback, and that word reads as an enabler for untap payoffs.

kept.name: Mystic Crusader
kept.why: It has protection from black AND from red, and only cares:color:r was recorded. This is an inconsistency in the existing list rather than a new reading.

kept.name: Corrupted Harvester
kept.why: A repeatable regeneration outlet fed by sacrificing creatures. cost:sacrifice is recorded but the thing it buys, keeping the creature alive, is not.

kept.name: Great Defender
kept.why: The card's only line is 'Target creature gets +0/+X' and the list recorded no effect whatsoever.

kept.name: Discordant Dirge
kept.why: The discard ability costs {B} and sacrificing this enchantment. The sacrifice cost was never recorded, though the counter accumulation and the discard both were.

kept.name: Suture Spirit
kept.why: {W/B}{W/B}{W/B}: Regenerate target creature is a repeatable way to keep your creatures alive, and no effect word was recorded for it.

kept.name: Horrible Hordes
kept.why: Rampage triggers when this creature BECOMES BLOCKED, which trig:becomes-blocked already records. It never triggers on this creature blocking, and the vocabulary keeps those two events as separate words.

kept.name: Midnight Ritual
kept.why: The whole point of the card is missing: it creates a 2/2 Zombie for each creature card exiled. The exile is the spell's resolution, not an activation or additional cast cost, so cost:exile is wrong. Deliberately NOT adding eff:exile-graveyard: this eats YOUR OWN graveyard as fuel and that word is the graveyard-hate word, so it would file a graveyard payoff as an attack on graveyard decks.

kept.name: Scourge of Numai
kept.why: This card drains nobody. It makes YOU lose 2 life each upkeep unless you control an Ogre, which is a pure drawback.

kept.name: Tattoo Ward
kept.why: Three clauses were unread: it is an Aura that attaches to a creature, it gives +1/+1, and it grants protection from enchantments. Only the sacrifice-to-destroy clause was recorded.

kept.name: Thrull Champion
kept.why: The second ability steals a Thrull permanently, which is nowhere in the list, and it costs {T} to activate.

kept.name: Hallowed Healer
kept.why: Both abilities are '{T}: Prevent the next N damage' and neither the tap cost nor the damage prevention was recorded, so the card currently claims to do nothing at all.

kept.name: Warrior Angel
kept.why: The trigger was recorded and its effect was not: whenever it deals damage you gain that much life.

kept.name: Ragamuffyn
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything. It sacrifices one creature or land to draw one card, at a single point. scope:all appears to have been picked up from the plural selector in the cost.

kept.name: Sandsower
kept.why: The effect is 'Tap target creature', one target. The cost taps three of your own creatures, which cost:tap-others already records. Nothing about this is a mass effect.

kept.name: Infernal Harvest
kept.why: Returning X Swamps is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, which cost:cast-return-to-hand names exactly. eff:move-zone reads as something the spell does on resolution, and the only thing it does on resolution is deal damage.

kept.name: Testament of Faith
kept.why: The one ability turns the enchantment into an X/X Wall creature with defender, and neither the animation nor the granted defender was recorded, so the card carried no effect word at all.

kept.name: Stenchskipper
kept.why: 'If you control no Goblins, sacrifice this creature' is a self-destruct drawback, not a sacrifice outlet.

kept.name: Reflecting Mirror
kept.why: The ability costs {X}, {T}; the tap in the activation cost was not recorded.

kept.name: Ring of Ma'rûf
kept.why: The card carried no ability words whatsoever. Its one ability costs {5}, {T} and exiling itself. The wish effect that follows has no word in the vocabulary and I have not invented one for it, since fetching a card from outside the game does nothing in Commander.

kept.name: Defensive Maneuvers
kept.why: It gives +0/+4 to every creature of a chosen type, on all sides of the table, and neither the pump nor the mass scope was recorded. Left eff:choose off deliberately: that word appears to be for modal 'choose one' spells rather than for naming a creature type.

kept.name: Zombie Boa
kept.why: The delayed trigger is 'Whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature of that color', and the trigger event was missing while its effect (eff:destroy) was recorded.

kept.name: Titanium Man
kept.why: It is a modal attack trigger ('choose one'), which eff:choose names. Neither mode changes power or toughness: one grants flying, already recorded as grants:flying, and the other deals 1 damage. eff:pump is wrong.

kept.name: Scent of Nightshade
kept.why: The size of the effect is read off your hand, revealing any number of black cards in it. The card genuinely cares about hand contents and that was unrecorded.

kept.name: Rhystic Syphon
kept.why: "Unless target player pays {3}" is a tax the opponent may buy out of, which is exactly eff:unless-pays. The drain half was read and the tax half was not.

kept.name: Apocalypse Chime
kept.why: The activation cost is "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact". The sacrifice was read and the tap symbol was missed. Not adding scope:wipe: the destroy is restricted to cards named in one expansion, which is a filtered wipe, not a symmetric board wipe.

kept.name: Innocence Kami
kept.why: Nothing here affects everything. It taps ONE target creature and untaps ITSELF. scope:all here is the Purphoros-style false positive where an unrelated clause supplies a mass word.

kept.name: Grim Strider
kept.why: It pumps nothing. "gets -1/-1 for each card in your hand" makes it SMALLER, so eff:pump is a false claim of an enhance effect. Deliberately not swapping to eff:shrink either, because that word feeds the removal role and this card cannot answer an opposing creature.

kept.name: Bog Glider
kept.why: A tutor for one Mercenary onto the battlefield affects one card. Nothing about this is mass.

kept.name: Knight of the Pilgrim's Road
kept.why: Renown puts the +1/+1 counter on ITSELF. The generic word reads as a counters payoff that puts counters on other things, which is the exact self/other split the vocabulary keeps apart.

kept.name: Clutch of Undeath
kept.why: "Otherwise, it gets -3/-3" was never read. On any non-Zombie this aura is removal, and only the +3/+3 half of the sentence is currently recorded.

kept.name: Jandor's Ring
kept.why: The activation is "{2}, {T}, Discard the last card you drew this turn". Both the tap and the discard cost were dropped; only the draw was read, so the card reads as free card draw.

kept.name: Serra's Boon
kept.why: "Otherwise, it gets -2/-1" is unread, so half the card is missing. The whole aura keys on whether the creature is white, which is a real colour care and not a word scan on a destroy clause.

kept.name: Volunteer Reserves
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep. The generic trig:step is there and the specific step it names is not.

kept.name: Exile into Darkness
kept.why: "you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand" is the card bringing ITSELF back. eff:return-from is recorded generically, but nothing says the thing returned is this card.

kept.name: Undead Servant
kept.why: The whole payoff clause, "create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each card named Undead Servant in your graveyard", produced no effect word at all. The card currently reads as an enters trigger that does nothing.

kept.name: Alchor's Tomb
kept.why: "{2}, {T}" includes a tap cost, and "becomes the color of your choice" is a choice made on resolution, matching the other choose-a-colour cards in this batch. The card carried no effect word whatsoever.

kept.name: Vectis Dominator
kept.why: The ability costs {T}, and "unless its controller pays 2 life" is a tax the opponent may buy out of. Only the tap effect and the life loss were read, not the cost or the unless clause.

kept.name: Nim Shambler
kept.why: "Sacrifice a creature: Regenerate this creature" is a free, repeatable sacrifice OUTLET, which is one of the most load-bearing things a card can be. It eats another creature, so cost:sacrifice rather than cost:sacrifice-self.

kept.name: Nyx Infusion
kept.why: "Otherwise, it gets -2/-2" is unread. On a non-enchantment creature this aura is removal and only its pump half is recorded.

kept.name: Planar Despair
kept.why: "All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn for each basic land type among lands you control" is an unrestricted symmetric mass shrink that kills your own board too, the same shape as the other -X/-X sweepers. scope:all alone does not say the deck's own creatures die.

kept.name: Marsh Gas
kept.why: -2/-0 destroys nothing, ever. It cannot kill a single creature, so calling it a board wipe is wrong. scope:all is correct and stays.

kept.name: Parasitic Bond
kept.why: "At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller" is an upkeep trigger and neither the generic step word nor the upkeep word was recorded. Only the damage was read.

kept.name: Acidic Dagger
kept.why: Three unread pieces: the {T} in the activation cost, the combat damage trigger that is the whole point of the card, and the leaves-the-battlefield trigger that sacrifices it. Only the destroy was read.

kept.name: Secure Detention
kept.why: "Enchanted permanent can't attack or block" produced nothing. This is a Pacifism with the abilities switched off as well, so it is removal that turns a permanent harmless without destroying it. Currently only the token and the ability shutoff are recorded, so it can be chosen for nothing.

kept.name: Zulaport Chainmage
kept.why: "Target opponent loses 2 life" affects one player. Nothing on this card is mass.

kept.name: Sewers of Estark
kept.why: This is not a triggered ability. "If it's attacking" is a condition checked on the chosen creature when the instant resolves, not a whenever-this-attacks trigger, and reading it as one puts an attack payoff on a combat trick.

kept.name: Opal Archangel
kept.why: It becomes "a 5/5 Angel creature with flying and vigilance", so the animation hands it two keywords and neither was written down. Nothing on the card affects everything: it is one opponent's cast animating this one permanent.

kept.name: Voracious Hatchling
kept.why: Lifelink gains life and that was missed, as the same keyword on Caravan Hurda in this batch shows. It triggers on white spells as well as black, and only cares:color:b was recorded. The four -1/-1 counters enter on ITSELF, so the generic word reads as putting counters on other things. Nothing here is mass.

kept.name: Farrel's Mantle
kept.why: An Aura that enchants a creature, so it attaches. The damage is 'equal to its power plus 2', which is a genuine scales-with-power reading rather than a power threshold.

kept.name: Mercenary Informer
kept.why: The activated ability puts a creature on the bottom of its owner's library, a battlefield-to-library zone move that nothing in the list recorded. The card also has no effect facet at all today. The first line is a static about BLACK spells and abilities, which is a real colour condition.

kept.name: Instigator
kept.why: The activation cost is '{1}{B}{B}, {T}, Discard a card' and neither the tap nor the discard was recorded. Discarding a card (not this card) is cost:discard, matching Pegasus Refuge and Sanctum Spirit in this same batch.

kept.name: Redeem
kept.why: Preventing ALL damage to two creatures for the turn is a protection trick that keeps your creatures alive, not merely incidental damage prevention. The list recorded the prevention and not the purpose.

kept.name: Wandering Champion
kept.why: 'you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card' pays a discard the list never recorded. The trigger is gated on controlling a blue or red permanent, which is a real colour condition the card is built around.

kept.name: Farmstead
kept.why: The granted ability is an upkeep trigger with an optional 'pay {W}{W}. If you do, you gain 1 life' payment. Only the life gain was written down, so nothing recorded when it happens or that it must be paid for. eff:attach deliberately NOT added: this enchants a land, and that word means attaching to a creature.

kept.name: Dying Wail
kept.why: An Aura with 'Enchant creature'. It attaches to a creature and nothing said so.

kept.name: Petra Sphinx
kept.why: The ability costs {T} and that was missing outright. It reveals the top card of a library, so the library zone is what it operates on. eff:draw deliberately not added: the card goes to the targeted PLAYER's hand, usually an opponent's, and filing it as draw would read as a draw engine.

kept.name: Flow of Maggots
kept.why: Cumulative upkeep triggers at the beginning of your upkeep, and only the generic trig:step was recorded. 'Can't be blocked by non-Wall creatures' is real evasion and no facet expressed it.

kept.name: Aven Redeemer
kept.why: The whole activated ability was unrecorded: it costs {T} and prevents the next 2 damage to any target. The list had flying and nothing else.

kept.name: Hidden Horror
kept.why: The card's only ability was entirely unread. It sacrifices itself unless you discard a creature card, so both the discard cost and the self-sacrifice belong. Same shape the engine already uses on Mine Bearer and Call to Arms in this batch.

kept.name: Kithkin Healer
kept.why: The only ability on the card was unrecorded. It costs {T} and prevents 1 damage to any target.

kept.name: Sanctum Spirit
kept.why: 'This creature gains indestructible until end of turn' is a grant and was not recorded. The list carries the discard cost and the lifelink but nothing about what the ability actually does.

kept.name: Gearsmith Guardian
kept.why: The pump is conditional on controlling a BLUE creature. The colour condition is the whole of the card's text and nothing recorded it.

kept.name: Swell of Courage
kept.why: Reinforce is '{X}{W}{W}, Discard this card:'. Discarding the card itself is the -self form, and it is the only way to reach the counters the list already credits it with.

kept.name: Dazzling Beauty
kept.why: 'Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep' is a delayed upkeep trigger. The list recorded the draw with no indication it is delayed.

kept.name: Dakmor Plague
kept.why: 3 damage to EACH creature kills your own board as well, which is the symmetric sweeper this word exists to mark, the same reading damage sweepers like Blasphemous Act get. 'each player' includes you, so it also damages its own controller.

kept.name: Wand of Ith
kept.why: The {T} in the activation cost was missing. It reveals from the target's hand, and 'discards it unless they pay 1 life' / 'unless they pay life equal to its mana value' is exactly the taxing-unless-pays shape, which nothing recorded.

kept.name: Hired Torturer
kept.why: The activation costs {T} and that was missing. It reveals a card from the opponent's hand, so the hand is a zone it operates on.

kept.name: Prismatic Circle
kept.why: The whole activated ability is a damage prevention shield ({1}: prevent the next damage from a source of the chosen colour) and no effect word was recorded at all.

kept.name: Carrion Wurm
kept.why: "any player may exile three cards from their graveyard" is graveyard exile and the card was carrying no effect word for it.

kept.name: Spirit Flare
kept.why: Damage is dealt equal to the tapped creature's power, so the card genuinely reads power.

kept.name: Vigilant Sentry
kept.why: The granted ability costs {T}. Nothing triggers on attacking - "target attacking or blocking creature" is a target restriction, and trig:attacks is a word scan off it.

kept.name: Necrogen Scudder
kept.why: "When this creature enters, you lose 3 life" is a drawback aimed at its own controller. Recording it as eff:lose-life tells the engine this is a drain card, which is the opposite of true.

kept.name: Hazduhr the Abbot
kept.why: The ability had no effect word at all. It costs {X},{T} and redirects the next X damage onto Hazduhr, and it only works on white creatures you control, which is a genuine colour condition rather than a target restriction.

kept.name: Runesword
kept.why: Two later clauses were unread: a leaves-the-battlefield trigger on the targeted creature, and a replacement that exiles any creature it damages instead of letting it die.

kept.name: Loyal Cathar // Unhallowed Cathar
kept.why: Only trig:dies was recorded. The card returns ITSELF to the battlefield transformed, and the back face carries "This creature can't block"; none of that was written down.

kept.name: Phyrexian Boon
kept.why: The aura gives -1/-2 to a non-black creature, so it shrinks as well as pumps. Only eff:pump was recorded.

kept.name: Corpse Lunge
kept.why: The exile is an ADDITIONAL COST TO CAST, not an activated-ability cost. The vocabulary draws that distinction elsewhere (cost:sacrifice vs cost:cast-sacrifice) and only the generic cost:exile was present.

kept.name: Loxodon Mender
kept.why: The ability costs {W},{T} and the tap was not recorded.

kept.name: Shadowbane
kept.why: The lifegain clause is conditional on the prevented damage coming from a BLACK source, which is a real colour condition (the same shape the engine already reads on Phyrexian Boon), not a target restriction.

kept.name: Chimney Imp
kept.why: The death trigger moves a card from hand to top of library and nothing was recorded for it - only kw:flying and trig:dies. Prying Questions in the same batch carries exactly these three for the identical clause.

kept.name: Fallen Askari
kept.why: The card literally says "This creature can't block", so a trig:blocks on it can never fire; it comes from the flanking reminder text, which is a becomes-blocked trigger and is already recorded. The can't-block clause itself was unread.

kept.name: Sanctum Custodian
kept.why: The card carried no effect word at all. Its one ability costs {T} and prevents the next 2 damage to any target.

kept.name: Vault Guardsman
kept.why: The exile lasts only "until this creature leaves the battlefield", so the card carries a delayed return keyed on itself leaving. Only the ETB half was recorded.

kept.name: Frightshroud Courier
kept.why: Almost nothing was recorded. The ability costs {2}{B},{T} and gives a target Zombie +2/+2 and fear; none of the three was written down.

kept.name: Flay
kept.why: The second discard happens "unless they pay {1}", which is the tax clause and was unread.

kept.name: Grapeshot Catapult
kept.why: It can only ever target a creature WITH FLYING, so it genuinely reads the keyword. It carries kw:flying today, which says the Catapult has flying - it does not.

kept.name: Kjeldoran Home Guard
kept.why: The -0/-1 counter goes on this creature itself, and only the generic eff:add-counters was present.

kept.name: Opal Gargoyle
kept.why: It animates into a 2/2 Gargoyle WITH FLYING and the flying was never recorded. scope:all is wrong: the only thing this card affects is itself, so a word meaning "affects everything" misdescribes it.

kept.name: Spineless Thug
kept.why: Its entire text is "This creature can't block" and the list records nothing at all. rec:full was claimed over a card whose one line was unread.

kept.name: Zombie Assassin
kept.why: It destroys ONE target nonblack creature. A single-target removal spell is the opposite of scope:all, and leaving it there risks the card reading as a board wipe.

kept.name: Deathcurse Ogre
kept.why: "Each player loses 3 life" is a symmetrical, everyone-hits effect and nothing said so; eff:lose-life alone reads as a targeted drain.

kept.name: Rashka the Slayer
kept.why: The +1/+2 was not recorded at all. Rashka BLOCKS black creatures; he does not become blocked, so trig:becomes-blocked is the wrong direction of the same event (trig:blocks, already present, is correct).

kept.name: Goblin War Wagon
kept.why: "You may pay {2}. If you do, untap this creature" is exactly the pay-for-more shape and was unrecorded.

kept.name: Jade Statue
